savitṛsadṛśī rūpe sāvitrīvaradānajā |
sūyamānā sukhaṃ sā vai sāvitrīnāmataḥ kṛtā ||58||
tajjanmasamaye brahmā devaiḥ sahājagāma ha |
puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ tadā kṛtvā yayau dhāma svakaṃ tataḥ ||59||
nityaṃ tasyāstu bālāyā darśanārthaṃ surādayaḥ |
samāyāntyadṛśyarūpā mudā tvaśvapatigṛhe ||1.366.60||
vaikuṇṭhasadṛśaṃ rājño bhavanaṃ samaśobhata |
kālena yauvanaṃ prāptā divyā devī vyarājata ||6 1 ||
brahmāṃśa samabhūt kāle dyumatsenātmajo balī |
satyavāniti nāmnā saḥ kumāro guṇavāridhiḥ ||62||
sā varaṃ varayāmāsa satyavantaṃ svayaṃvare |
rājā tasmai dadau tāṃ ca ratnābhūṣaṇabhūṣitām ||63||
vivāhavidhinā tāṃ sa nītvā varo gṛhaṃ yayau |
gārhasthyapātivratyādidharmāścarati sā satī ||64||
saṃvatsare vyatīte ca satyavān piturājñayā |
jagāma phalakāṣṭhārthamaraṇyaṃ ghātake dine ||65||
sāvitrī pātivratākhyadharmabalena tanmṛteḥ |
kālaṃ jñātvā tatpaścād yayau yatra gataḥ patiḥ ||66 ||
śuṣkakāṣṭhāni cādātuṃ yatate satyavān bhuvi |
śirovedanayā prāṇām̐statyāja taṃ tadā yamaḥ ||67||
baddhvā sūkṣmaśarīreṇa yuktaṃ yayau yamālayam |
taddehaṃ vṛkṣapatreṣu rakṣitvānuyayau satī ||68 ||
satīṃ dṛṣṭvā yamastāṃ vai provāca nyāyayugvacaḥ |
aho kva yāsi sāvitri mānuṣī saśarīriṇi || 69 | |
yadi vāñchati cāgantuṃ kāntena saha dharmiṇī |
dehaṃ tyaktvā samāyāhi sadehā na gatiḥ khalu || 1.366.70 | |
tava bhartuḥ samāyātaḥ pūrṇaḥ kālo’tra mānave |
sa karmaphalabhogārthaṃ satyavān yāti madgṛham || 71 ||
karmaṇā janma jantūnāṃ mṛtyuścāpi tu karmaṇā |
sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhayaṃ śokaḥ prapadyante hi karmabhiḥ || 72 ||
karmaṇā tu divaṃ yāti satyalokaṃ prayāti ca |
karmaṇā tvīśatāṃ yāti harerdāsyaṃ ca karmaṇā || 73 | |
śubhena karmaṇā yāyāt sālokyādi catuṣṭayam |
indratvaṃ vaidhasatvaṃ ca munitvaṃ viprajātitām || 74||
muktatāṃ rājatāṃ rājendratāṃ gurvī tapasvitām |
kṣatriyatāṃ vaiśyatāṃ ca śūdratāṃ cāntyajātitām ||75 ||
mlecchatāṃ jaṃgamatāṃ ca sthāvarātmakatāṃ tathā |
śailatāṃ vṛkṣatāṃ cāpi paśutāṃ pakṣitāṃ tathā ||76 ||
kṛmitāṃ jantutāṃ cāpi gandharvatāṃ ca nāgatām |
rākṣasatāṃ kinnaratāṃ kūṣmāṇḍatāṃ ca yakṣatām || 77||
vetālatāṃ bhūtatāṃ ca pretatāṃ ca piśācatām |
ḍākinītvaṃ ca daityatvaṃ dānavatvaṃ surāritām ||78 ||
prāpnoti karmabhirjanturlokāntarāṇi karmabhiḥ |
karmabhiḥ puṇyavān jīvo pāpavām̐ścāpi karmabhiḥ ||79 ||
sundaraśca surūpaśca nīrogī karmaṇā tathā |
andhaḥ kāṇaḥ kutsitaśca mahārogī ca karmaṇā | |1.366.8 0 ||
satyaṃ ca nirayaṃ svargaṃ karmaṇā prāpyate tathā |
śakralokaṃ sūryalokaṃ candralokaṃ tathā param ||8 1 ||
vahnilokaṃ vāyulokaṃ varuṇālayamityapi |
dhruvalokaṃ ca kauberaṃ padaṃ śivagṛhaṃ tathā ||82 | |
nakṣatralokaṃ ca janalokaṃ tapo mahastathā |
pātālāni ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ golokaṃ cāpi karmabhiḥ ||8 3 ||
kṣaṇajīvitvamatha ca cirajīvitvamityapi |
koṭikalpādijīvitvaṃ kṣīṇāyuṣṭvaṃ ca karmabhiḥ | |84||
jīvasañcāramātrāyurgarbhe mṛtyuḥ svakarmaṇā |
tava bhartustathā mṛtyuḥ karmaṇā samupasthitaḥ ||85||
tasmāt sāvitri manmārgāt parāvṛtya yathāsukham |
tyaktvā bharturabhilāṣāṃ prayāhi svagṛhaṃ prati ||86||
ityuktvā virarāmāsau yamo natvā satīṃ tataḥ |
sāvitrī na parāvṛttā pātivratyaparāyaṇā || 87||
kintu papraccha vijñeyaṃ karmākarmādi sādaram |
śubhaṃ tathāpyaśubhādi lakṣmi karmaphalaṃ tathā ||88||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye madradeśādhipatināśvapatinā sāvitryārādhanena sāvitrī sutā labdhā, sā ca satyavate dattā, satyavato maraṇe sāvitrī pātivratyabalena pretamanuyayau, yamarājasya saṃvādaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭṣaṣṭyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 366 ||

<1.367>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi yamaproktamanādṛtyātibhāvataḥ |
yatpapraccha tu sāvitrī kathayāmi nibodha me || 1 ||
śubhaṃ kiṃ cāśubhaṃ karma kiṃ bījaṃ kaḥ phalapradaḥ |
kena kīdṛgbhavetkarma ko hetustatra sarvathā || 2 ||
ko vā karmaphalaṃ bhuṃkte ko vā nirliṃpta ityapi |
karma nirmūlayantyeva kathaṃ vai sādhavo janāḥ || 3 ||
karmakārakaḥ kaḥ proktaḥ ko deho dehavām̐śca kaḥ |
kiṃ vijñānaṃ manaḥ kiṃ ca buddhiḥ kā prāṇa eva kaḥ || 4 ||
kimindriyaṃ devatāśca bhoktā bhojayitā ca kaḥ |
ko bhogo niṣkṛtiḥ kā ca ka ātmā kaḥ paraḥ prabhuḥ || 5 ||
etatsarvaṃ yamadeva cejjānāsi vadātra me |
yamaḥ śrutvātisaṃhṛṣṭaḥ sāvitrīṃ prāha tattvataḥ || 6 ||
abhyudayapradaṃ śāntipradaṃ vedādidarśitam |
karma śubhaṃ maṃgalakṛd viparītaṃ na vai śubham || 7 ||
vāsanā bhāvanā vāpi karmabījamudīryate |
phalapradaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sarvāntarasthitaḥ || 8 ||
śubhecchayā śubhaṃ karmāśubhayāśubhameva tat |
karmaheturbhaved yatnastaddheturvāñcchanā matā || 9 ||
vāñcchāhetustu vijñānaṃ jīve vastusamāśrayam |
jñānahetustu saṃkalpaḥ pārameśvara āsthitaḥ || 1.367.1 0||
vibhvī śaktistatra yuktā kriyāṃ janiṃ dadāti vai |
hareḥ saṃkalpaśaktibhyāṃ jīve jñānakriye mate || 11 ||
tābhyāṃ paramparājanyaṃ karma sarvaṃ prajāyate |
antataḥ sarvathā hetuḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo mataḥ || 1 2||
jīvaḥ karmaphalaṃ bhuṃkte tadātmā nahi lipyate |
antaryāmī kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo nirlipta eva ha || 13 ||
sādhavaḥ sarvathā karmaphalābhisandhivarjitāḥ |
viṣṇusevātmakaṃ kāryaṃ kurvantyaharniśaṃ śubham || 14||
ahaitukaṃ ca saṃkalpavarjitaṃ harituṣṭaye |
tatsarvaṃ bhaktirūpaṃ vai karmanirmūlanakṣamam || 15||
harerbhaktaḥ sadā mukto muktistasya dvidhā matā |
jīvanmuktirbrahmamuktirnirvāṇapadadāyinī || 16||
jīvanmuktiṃ bhaktirūpāṃ sadā vāñchanti vaiṣṇavāḥ |
brāhmīṃ muktiṃ parāṃ sevāṃ dhāmni vāñcchanti sādhavaḥ || 17||
karmaprayojikā śaktiḥ sā tu kṛṣṇe vyavasthitā |
antaryāmisvarūpasthā kriyāṃ janayati dhruvā || 18||
pañcabhūtātmako dehaḥ sthūla ityabhidhīyate |
tadvān jīvaḥ sadā jñātā cetano jñānavānmataḥ || 1 9||
caturviṃśatitattvānāṃ jīvātmaparamātmanoḥ |
svarūpairguṇakāryaiścāvagamo jñānamucyate || 1.367.20||
sarvavyavahṛtibījaṃ vijñānaṃ tvātmani sthitam |
mūlamāyā sattvarajastamomayī jaḍā sadā || 21 ||
buddhirūpā manorūpā prāṇarūpā prajāyate |
manaḥ saṃkalpakaṃ proktaṃ buddhiradhyavasāyinī ||22||
śvāsaḥ prāṇo jīvanaṃ ca vṛttistattvaiḥ saha sthitiḥ |
indraśaktisamāpannamindriyaṃ tat prakīrtitam || 23||
indra ātmā sadā prokta indriyāṇi bahūni vai |
śrotratvaccakṣūrasanāghrāṇāni jñānadāni hi ||24||
vākpāṇipādapāyūpasthāni karmendriyāṇi hi |
digvātārkapraceto’śvivahnīndropendramitrakāḥ ||25||
devatāśca prakāśārthaṃ nirmitāḥ śaktidāstu tāḥ |
bhoktā dehī bhojayitā tvantarātmā hariḥ svayam ||26||
bhogaḥ sukhasya duḥkhasya sākṣātkāraḥ samucyate |
niṣkṛtiḥ śāntirityuktā nivṛttiḥ karmaṇāṃ tathā ||27||
karmanāśāya karmāṇi niṣkṛtyātmāni vai viduḥ |
prāyaścittāni karmāṇi pūrveṣāṃ śodhakāni vai ||28||
sūkṣmadehādvivikto yo vāsanābalakarṣitaḥ |
jīvatāṃ saṃvidan svasya jīvātmā sukhasaccitaḥ ||29||
antarniyāmakastasyākṣaradhāmni ca yaḥ sthitaḥ |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ so’yaṃ paraprabhuḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||1.367.3 0||
pṛthivī vāyurākāśo jalaṃ tejastvimāni vai |
pañcabhūtāni cāśritya jīvo bhuṃkte phalaṃ bahu ||3 1 ||
yadā bhajati kṛṣṇaṃ sa vāsanāvarjito bhavet |
janmamṛtyujarāvyādhiśokādivarjito bhavet ||32||
bhaktisamaṃ na balavatsādhanaṃ tvanyadasti hi |
sarvaduḥkhapraśamanaṃ sarvasampatpradaṃ param |||33||
svargamokṣapradaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sarvasmṛddhiprapūrṇakam |
paramātmā paraṃbrahma kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ ||34||
kāraṇaṃ kāraṇānāṃ sa rādhālakṣmīprabhāpatiḥ |
pārvatīmāṇikīnātho ramāvṛndāpatiḥ prabhuḥ ||35||
śrīkṛṣṇaḥ sa paraṃbrahma svayaṃ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ |
tasya bhaktiḥ prakartavyā tena mokṣo bhaved dhruvaḥ ||36||
śravaṇaṃ kīrtanaṃ smṛtiḥ kṛṣṇāsyāṅgaprasevanam |
pūjanaṃ stavanaṃ bhṛtyaṃ maitryaṃ sarvasamarpaṇam ||37||
evaṃ tu navadhā yogo bhaktirūpaḥ sumuktidaḥ |
dharmaḥ kāṣṭhauṣadhikvātho vairāgyaṃ tu virecanam ||38||
bodho ramyo’valehaśca bhaktistatra rasāyanam |
sandhāninyauṣadhirdharmo viveko vṛṇahāriṇī ||39||
viśalyakaraṇī bhaktirjīvāturviratistathā |
harau snehānubandho yo bhūrisatkārapūrvakaḥ ||1.367.40 ||
bhaktirbodhyā mokṣadā sā kartavyā sarvadā janaiḥ |
cikkaṇatvayutasvāntaḥsāndrānandapariplutaḥ ||41 ||
bhāvaḥ snehaḥ sa vijñeyo harau kāryo hi sarvadā |
svāntarvṛttiravicchinnā harau snehānubandhinī |||42||
bhaktiḥ prema ratiḥ sevā harau kāryā hi muktidā |
vaidhī vidhivacojanyā śravaṇādinavātmikā ||43 ||
māhātmyajñānasaṃyukto dṛḍhīyān sarvato’dhikaḥ |
rāgaḥ sneho harau bhaktirmokṣadā sarvathā matā ||44||
bhaktavātsalyamarcāyā daṃbhatyāgo’numodanam |
śuddhacittena tatpūjā tatkathāśravaṇādaraḥ ||45||
aṃgakriyā tadarthaṃ ca smṛtistannāmakīrtanam |
ete’ṣṭāvapi bhaktau syurabhinnāḥ phaladāḥ sadā ||46||
gurupādāśrayo dīkṣāsvīkāraḥ sevanaṃ guroḥ |
viśvāsātsatpathe vṛttiḥ saddharmapṛcchanaṃ tathā ||47||
bhogatyāgaśca haryarthaṃ vāsastīrthādibhūmiṣu |
yathāpekṣaṃ vyavahāro vrataṃ haridine tathā ||48||
daivivṛkṣādisatkāro daśaite bhaktivardhanāḥ |
putraśiṣyādyarāgaśca kusaṃgisaṃgavarjanam ||49||
mahāraṃbhādyanudyogo durvivādādivarjanam |
haryarthaṃ dravyadānaṃ ca śokamohādivarjanam ||1.367.50||
anyānudvegakāritvaṃ devagurvādyanindanam |
surāparādhākartṛtvaṃ suranindāsahiṣṇutā |||51 ||
daśaite sādhanīyāḥ syurbhaktairbhaktivivṛddhaye |
atha kṛṣṇacihnadhṛtiḥ kṛṣṇanāmasmṛtirhṛdi ||52||
puṣpamālādisaṃdhṛtirnṛtyaṃ ca daṇḍavannatiḥ |
abhyutthānaṃ hareragre gamane cāpyanuvrajiḥ ||53||
pradakṣiṇaṃ tathā stotraṃ sevanaṃ kīrtanaṃ japaḥ |
vijñānaṃ stotrapāṭhaśca svādo naivedyapajjale ||54||
prasādasaurabhagrāhaḥ sparśanaṃ cekṣaṇe hareḥ |
nīrājanaṃ harerutsavāvalokanamityapi |||55|||
dayāpratīkṣaṇaṃ dhyānaṃ smaraṇaṃ dāsyamuttamam |
sakhitvaṃ cātmadānaṃ ca haryarthaṃ ceṣṭitaṃ tathā ||56 ||
preṣṭhārpaṇaṃ bhaktasevā śaraṇe patanaṃ sadā |
tulasīśāstrasattīrthavaiṣṇavādiprapūjanam ||57||
yathādhanaṃ tathāsevā vārtādi sādhubhiḥ saha |
ārtasevā janmamaho hareścaraṇasevanam |||58||
śraddhayā bhūyasīprītiḥ śāstrārthāsvādanaṃ param |
satsu saṃgaḥ kīrtanaṃ me sadbhiḥ satsu sadā sthitiḥ |||59||
ātmaniṣṭheti ca catuścatvāriṃśadime guṇāḥ |
bhaktyātmakā bhaktipuṣṭikarāḥ snehavivardhanāḥ ||1.367.6 0||
satāṃ saṃsevanaṃ kāryaṃ kṛpā prāpyā satāṃ sadā |
saddharmeṣu parā śraddhā harerguṇaśrutistathā ||61 ||
premāṃkurodbhavaścāpi śrīharyāśraya uttamaḥ |
harau rāgābhivṛddhiśca haryarcāsphuraṇaṃ sadā ||62||
bhakte kṛṣṇaguṇāvāsaḥ sthitirdharme hareḥ sadā |
ete daśaguṇāḥ siddhāstataḥ premātivardhate ||63 ||
sāttvikādiprabhedaiśca mṛdumadhyādhibhedataḥ |
aneke vai bhaktibhedāḥ sūkṣmā bhavanti muktidāḥ ||64||
atha premaparākāṣṭhā vidhiryatra na vidyate |
sā tu sarvapramūrdhanyā bhaktirbhavati śāśvatī ||65||
yāvacchākhaṃ prematattvaṃ yādṛksvabhāvapoṣitam |
dehināṃ prākṛtabhāvaṃ tāvacchākhamanantakam ||66||
prematattvaṃ bhidyate vai yatsaṃkhyā nahi pāryate |
tasmādbhaktirasaṃkhyātabhedā bhavati puṣpitā ||67||
tasyā bhaktimahādevyā bhuktimuktyādisiddhayaḥ |
rājñyāḥ sadānuvartante ceṭikā iva tatparāḥ ||68||
parārdhaguṇito brahmānando bhaktyaṇusadṛśaḥ |
bhaktyānandāmṛtāmbhodhau brāhmāṇyapi sukhāni vai ||69||
magnasya goṣpadāyante premānandāplutasya hi |
yeṣāṃ dṛḍhā bhaved bhaktiḥ premarūpā sadā harau ||1.367.70||
te svapne’pi na paśyanti kīnāśaṃ yamarādgṛham |
koṭijanmakṛtaiḥ puṇyairāpyāṃ bhaktiṃ samācaran ||71 ||
mahāpāpātipāpām̐śca punātyeva yathā hariḥ |
śatravo naiva bādhante grahā yāmyāśca rākṣasāḥ ||72||
bhūtapretapiśācādyā bhaktimantaṃ harerjanam |
bhaja taṃ devapravaraṃ bhagavantaṃ sanātanam || 73 ||
tvatpṛṣṭaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ gaccha vatse yathāsukham |
ityuktvā ca yamo natvā virarāma hi padmaje ||74||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye sāvitrīkṛtaśubhāśubhakarmāditatsambandhipraśnānāṃ yamarājakṛtottarāṇi bhagavadbhaktiprakāratanmāhātmyādi cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptaṣaṣṭyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 367||

<1.368>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
evamuktāpi sāvitrī na nyavartata padmaje |
punarāha yamaṃ nyāyyaṃ pātivratyabharaṃ vacaḥ || 1 ||
tyaktvā kva yāmi kāntaṃ ca tvāṃ ca jñānārṇavaṃ gurum |
jijñāsā jāyate praṣṭuṃ tannivṛttiṃ kuru prabho || 2 ||
kāṃ kāṃ yoniṃ yāti jīvaḥ karmaṇā kena vā yama |
svargaṃ vā narakaṃ vāpi muktirvā kena karmaṇā || 3 ||
rogyarogī dīrghajīvī kenālpāyuśca karmaṇā |
sukhī duḥkhī vikalāṃgaḥ kāṇo’ndho badhirastathā || 4 ||
pramattaḥ kṛpaṇaḥ kṣipto lubdhastathā ca ghātakaḥ |
jāyate karmaṇā kena kena siddhīrhi vindati || 5 ||
svargabhogādikaṃ kena vaikuṇṭhaṃ cāmṛtaṃ tathā |
golokaṃ cākṣaraṃ kena sālokyādicatuṣṭayam || 6 ||
narakaṃ vā katividhaṃ kaḥ kiyantaṃ tu tiṣṭhati |
kena vā karmaṇā kīdṛgvyādhirbhavati mānuṣe || 7 ||
vada sarvaṃ yathā vetsi hyupakāro bhaviṣyati |
iti śrutvā tu sāvitrīṃ yamaḥ prāha taduttaram || 8 ||
vismitaḥ sa yamaḥ prāha kanye ṣoḍaśavatsarā |
vayasā tvaṃ kutastvetajjñānaṃ labdhavatī sute || 9 ||
manye tāṃ brahmaṇaḥ patnīṃ sāvitrīṃ tvāṃ samāgatām |
prāptāṃ tu bhūbhṛtā tvaśvapatinā tapasā purā || 1.368.10 ||
jñānaṃ te pūrvaviduṣāṃ yogināṃ jñānināṃ yathā |
yathā śrīḥ śrīpateraṃke lakṣmīrnārāyaṇorasi || 11 ||
yathā rādhā ca śrīkṛṣṇe bhavānī bhavavāmagā |
dharmorasi yathā mūrtiḥ sāvitrī brahmavakṣasi || 1 2||
kardame devahūtiśca śatarūpā yathā manau |
aditiḥ kaśyape yadvad vaśiṣṭhe’rundhatī yathā || 13 ||
yathā śacī mahendre ca yathāhalyā tu gautame |
yathā ca rohiṇī candre kāmadeve ratiryathā || 14||
hutāśane yathā svāhā yathā svadhā ca pitṛṣu |
yathā divākare saṃjñā yajñe ca dakṣiṇā yathā || 15||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe lakṣmīrmāṇikī pārvatī prabhā |
varuṇānī ca varuṇe varāhe tu dharā yathā || 16||
kārtike devasenā cālakṣmīruddālake yathā |
yathā pativratālakṣmīḥ patnīvrate ca bhūsure || 17||
yathā ca kaṃbharālakṣmīḥ kṛṣṇagopālavakṣasi |
yathā jayā ca lalitākṣarādhīśe harau tathā || 18||
saubhāgyā supriyā tvaṃ ca bhava satyavati priye |
iti tubhya varo dattaḥ prasannamanasā mayā || 1 9||
vṛṇu devi tato’nyaccāparamabhīṣṭamarpaye |
evaṃ lakṣmi yamaṃ dṛṣṭvā prasannaṃ prāha sā satī ||1.368.20||
satyavadaurasenaiva putrāṇāṃ śatakaṃ mama |
bhavediti vṛṇomyatra macchvaśurasya cakṣuṣī ||21 ||
rājyalābho bhaveccāpi me bhrātṛśatakaṃ bhavet |
samatīte lakṣavarṣe tataḥ satyavatā samam || 22||
harerdhāma prayāsyāmi dehīmaṃ sadvaraṃ prabho |
anyajjijñāsitaṃ sarvaṃ śrotumicchāmi tadvad ||23 ||
yamaḥ prāha ca tacchrutvā sāvitrīṃ mānayan bahu |
sarvaṃ tvadīpsitaṃ devi bhaviṣyati tathāstviti ||24||
anyajjijñāsitaṃ vacmi karmapākaṃ niśāmaya |
yathā vedmi ca tatsarvaṃ kathayāmi samāsataḥ || 25 ||
pṛthvyāṃ śubhāśubhaṃ karma bhuṃjate mānavāstviha |
surā daityā dānavāśca gandharvā rākṣasādayaḥ ||26 ||
narāśca karmajanakā na sarve samajīvinaḥ |
viśiṣṭajīvinaḥ sarve bhuṃjate karma yoniṣu || 27||
viśeṣato mānavāśca bhramanti sarvayoniṣu |
śubhena karmaṇā svargaṃ nirayaṃ tvaśubhena vai ||28||
rājasena tu puṇyena jāyate mānavo bhuvi |
sāttvikapuṇyapuñjena devatāḥ saṃbhavanti vai | | 29| |
tāmasena ca pāpena rākṣasādyāḥ piśācakāḥ |
bhūtapretāḥ paśavaśca pakṣiṇo vṛkṣavallayaḥ | | 1.368.30 | |
kīṭāḥ pataṃgāḥ sarpāśca sarīsṛpāśca jantavaḥ |
jāyante duḥkhabahulāścaturaśītiyoniṣu | | 31 | |
ūrdhvaṃ sattvaviśālāśca madhye bhavanti rājasāḥ |
nikṛṣṭayonijāḥ sarve jāyante tāmasā hyadhaḥ | |3 2 | |
puṇyena jāyate svargaṃ narakaṃ pāpamātrataḥ |
muktirbhaktyā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe snehaprasevayā | | 33 ||
rogī kukarmaṇā jīvaścārogī śubhakarmaṇā |
dīrghajīvī ca kṣīṇāyuḥ sukhī duḥkhī śubhāśubhāt | | 34||
andhādayaścāṃgahīnāḥ kutsitena tu karmaṇā |
anyanetravineṣṭāndhaḥ kāṇo bhavati mānavaḥ | | 35 ||
anyanindāśrutilubdho badhiro jāyate dhruvam |
anyodvegakaraścātra pramatto jāyate sadā | | 36 ||
anyadravyāpahartā ca daridro nirdhano bhavet |
atighṛṇastiraskartā kṣipto bhavati sarvathā | | 37| |
aprāptabhogasampattiścānyaddravyādi luṇṭati |
jāyate’yaṃ ghātakaśca lubdhakaścātipāpavān || 38 ||
ṛṇānivartako janma gṛhṇātyeva na saṃśayaḥ |
siddhyādikamavāpnoti sarvotkṛṣṭena karmaṇā || 39 ||
svargabhogādikaṃ sarvaṃ dānena labhate janaḥ |
vipṇubhaktyā tu vaikuṇṭhaṃ vidyayā cāmṛtaṃ padam | |1.368.40 ||
kṛṣṇabhaktyā tu golokaṃ parayā vidyayākṣaram |
hareḥ kṛpayā prāpyeta sālokyādicatuṣṭayam | |41 ||
narakaṃ bahudhā proktaṃ karmaṇā bahuvistarāt |
pāpānāṃ cāpyasaṃkhyānāṃ narakāsaṃkhyatāsti vai | |42 |
yāvatpāpaṃ tatra pāpī tiṣṭhate tallaye tu na |
parāntarapradāhena pareṣāṃ duḥkhadatvataḥ ||43 |
vyādhayo’bhibhavantyenaṃ paraduḥkhapradaṃ janam |
sāmānyaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ viśeṣaṃ śṛṇu sundari | |44||
durlabhā mānavī jātiḥ sarvajātiṣu bhūstare |
vipraḥ sādhuśca sādhvyaśca śreṣṭhāste bhaktimajjanāḥ | |45 ||
sakāmo bhaktimān karmayogī bhavati vai punaḥ |
niṣkāmo bhaktimān brahmamuktaḥ sampadyate pare | |46 ||
punarāgamanaṃ nāsti teṣāṃ niṣkāmakarmiṇām |
kṛṣṇabhaktāstu golokaṃ yānti divyadvihastinaḥ | |47| |
nārāyaṇārcakā yānti vaikuṇṭhaṃ vai catuḥkarāḥ |
bhūmabhaktā amṛtākhyaṃ yānti sahasrabāhavaḥ ||48||
tīrthasthitā janā yānti satyalokaṃ ca tāpasāḥ |
sūryabhaktā raviṃ yānti kailāsaṃ śivabhāvukāḥ ||49||
yajñaniṣṭhāḥ svargaloke śakratvaṃ veṣṭabhāvanāḥ |
tattallokaṃ prayāntyeva punarāyānti karmaṇā ||1.368.50||
haribhaktāstu niṣkāmā harerlokaṃ prayānti hi |
yasmānna punarāvṛttirakṣaraṃ tatpadaṃ param ||51 ||
svadharmarahitā bhraṣṭācārā yāntyadhamāṃ gatim |
nārakīṃ yātanāṃ te ca bhuṃjate tiryagātmasu ||52||
svadharmaniratāḥ sarvaṃ pṛthvyāṃ suphalabhāginaḥ |
svadharmarahitāḥ sarve nirayān yānti dāruṇān ||53||
kanyādātā candralokaṃ yāvadindrāścaturdaśa |
yāti sālaṃkṛtādānād dviguṇaṃ phalamucyate ||54||
gavyaṃ ca rajataṃ bhāryāṃ vastraṃ sasyaṃ phala jalam |
ye dadati te prayānti tattatsmṛddhā divaṃ dhruvām ||55||
kālaṃ tu suciraṃ sthitvā pṛthvīmāyānti vai punaḥ |
suvarṇaṃ gāṃ ca tāmrādi dadatyatra tu ye janāḥ ||56||
vasanti sūryalokaṃ te varṣāṇāmayutaṃ sati |
bhūmiṃ dhānyāni dadati śvetadvīpe vasanti te ||57||
gṛhadānapradātā ca suralokaṃ hi vindati |
gṛhareṇupramāṇābdavāsastatra dhruvo mataḥ ||58||
yasmai yasmai tu devāya yo dadāti gṛhaṃ janaḥ |
sa yāti tasya lokaṃ tu reṇumānābdamuttamam ||59|||
saudhe caturguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ pūrte śataguṇaṃ phalam |
prakṛṣṭe’ṣṭaguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ divye divyaphalaṃ matam ||1.368.6 0||
taḍāgakartā varṣāṇāmayutaṃ janalokagaḥ |
vāpyāṃ phalaṃ śataguṇaṃ setubandhe sahasrakam ||6 1 ||
dhanuścatuḥsahasreṇa dairghyamānena vāpikā |
daśavāpīsamā kanyā phalaṃ dadāti pātrake ||6 2||
dviguṇaṃ ca phalaṃ tatra yadi sālaṃkṛtāṃ dadet |
vāpīkūpataḍāgādeḥ paṃkoddhāre kṛte phalam ||63||
aśvatthavṛkṣasevī ca samāropaka ityapi |
prayāti tapaso loke varṣāṇāmayutaṃ param ||64||
puṣpodyānaprado varṣāyutaṃ dhruve vaset sati |
vimānado viṣṇuloke vasenmanvantaraṃ param ||65||
yānavāhanaśibikārathadātā caturguṇam |
phalaṃ tu labhate pātre vaiṣṇave sukhadaṃ param ||66 ||
dolādyarpayitā yāyād viṣṇulokaṃ manvantaram |
rājamārgaṃ saudhayuktaṃ karoti yaḥ sa aindrakam ||67||
padṃ varṣāyutaṃ bhuktvā pṛthvyāṃ yāti śubhaṃ gṛham |
dattaṃ dātre samāyāti na dattaṃ nopatiṣṭhati ||68||
bhuktvā svargādikaṃ saukhyaṃ punarbhūmau prayānti vai |
labhetottamabhavane janmottamajaneṣviha ||69||
viprāśca rakṣakā yadvopārjakāḥ sevakāśca vā |
yathākarma bhavantyeva bhūmau tadvacca sarvadā ||1.368.70||
atrānyatra kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ bhoktavyaṃ bhavati dhruvam |
iti te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ gaccha sāvitri mā ciram || 71 ||
ityuktvā maunamāsthāya yamaścāgre yayau śanaiḥ |
sāvitryapi śanaiḥ paścāccacāla yamavāṭagā |||72||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye karmānurūpaśubhāśubhasthānagatiḥ, svasyāḥ putraśataṃ śvaśurasya cakṣuṣī, svasyā bhrātṛśatakaṃ satyavato lakṣābdāyuritivaraprāptiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭaṣaṣṭyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ |||368||

<1.369>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
sāvitrīṃ pṛṣṭhamāyāntīṃ dṛṣṭvā yamastu vismitaḥ |
punarnatvā satīṃ prāha kimicchasi vadātra me || 1 ||
iti śrutvā yamavākyaṃ sāvitrī punareva tam |
papraccha taṃ śṛṇu lakṣmi kathayāmi nibodha me || 2 ||
prayānti svargamanyaṃ ca lokaṃ yena viśeṣataḥ |
karmaṇā puṇyavantastu tadvadeti samāsataḥ || 3 ||
kṛtaṃ sāvitrikāpraśnaṃ yamaḥ prāha taduttaram |
annadānapradātānnavarṣāṇyaindre mahīyate || 4 ||
nātra pātraparīkṣā ca na kālaniyamastathā |
āsanasya pradātā ca devaviprādaye janaḥ || 5 ||
varṣāṇāmayutaṃ vahniloke sammodate sukhī |
yāvanti tasya sūtrāṇi tāvadvarṣāyutaṃ divi || 6 ||
devāya gāṃ ca viprāya dadyātpayasvinīṃ tu yaḥ |
vaikuṇṭhe golomasaṃkhyāyugāni sa mahīyate || 7 ||
caturguṇaṃ puṇyadine tīrthe śataguṇaṃ phalam |
dānaṃ nārāyaṇakṣetre phalaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet || 8 ||
viprāya haraye godo yajñakāryārthine tathā |
varṣāṇāmayutaṃ svarge candraloke pramodate || 9 ||
vatsaṃ prasūyamānā gāmubhayatomukhīṃ dadet |
vaikuṇṭhe tallomamānasamāḥ pramodate sukhī || 1.369.1 0||
śālagrāmaṃ sabhūṣādi dadyāt tatpūjakāya vai |
vaikuṇṭhe modate dātā yāvaccandradivākarau || 11 ||
chatradātāyutasamā modate varuṇālaye |
pādukādo’yutasamā vāyuloke mahīyate || 12||
śayyādo modate cāndre loke candrāyureva saḥ |
viprāya haraye dīpadātā tailaghṛtapradaḥ || 1 3||
yāvanmanvantaraṃ sopi brahmaloke mahīyate |
divyadṛṣṭirbhavettasya cāndhatā naiva jāyate || 14||
gajadātā vasedindrasyārdhāsane nirantaram |
aśvadātā vāruṇe vai kalpasthāyī bhavet sati || 15||
śibikādo viṣṇuloke manvantaraṃ mahīyate |
cāmaravyajanaprado vāyuloke mahīyate || 16 ||
varṣāṇāmayutaṃ dhānyapradaḥ kaṇasamā vaset |
viṣṇuloke vasatyeṣaḥ śrīharernāmajāpakaḥ || 17||
palāyate mahāmṛtyuścirajīvī sa jāyate |
āndolayeddhariṃ yastu preṃkhāyāṃ mānavo bhuvi || 18||
saddolā kārayedyastu vratotsavamahotsave |
jīvanmuktaḥ sukhaṃ bhuktvā yātyante viṣṇudhāma saḥ || 1 9||
vaikuṇṭhe nivasettatra śatamanvantarāvadhim |
phalamuttaraphālgunyāṃ tatopi dviguṇaṃ bhavet ||1.369.20||
bhavet kalpāntajīvī saḥ sarvasmṛddhiguṇālayaḥ |
tiladastilavarṣāṇi modate viṣṇumandire ||21 ||
tāmrapātre tiladāne labhedvai dviguṇaṃ phalam |
kanyādātā candraloke kalpamekaṃ vaseddhruvam |||22||
dāsīdātā tu gāndharve’yutavarṣāṇi modate |
janmasahasraṃ saubhāgyayuktāṃ satīṃ ca vindati |||23||
phalidrudaḥ phalasamāḥ śakraloke mahīyate |
pṛthvyāṃ ca sutavān śreṣṭhī sundarīsahito bhavet ||24||
phaladātā ciraṃ svargaṃ vasatyeva sukhāvaham |
dravyasasyagṛhadātā kuberabhavane vaset ||25||
manvantarāvadhi paścāddhanavān jāyate bhuvi |
puṇyakṣetre puṇyapātre sasasyakṣetradaḥ sati ||26||
vaikuṇṭhe modate manvantaraśataṃ śataṃ tataḥ punaḥ |
bhuvi bhūyān bhavatyeva śrīputradhanavāṃstathā ||27||
nārīgomān sukhī syācca janmanāṃ śatakaṃ param |
sapraja śreṣṭhabhūmiṃ ca grāmaṃ dadyāttu śārṅgiṇe ||28||
lakṣamanvantaraṃ dātā vaikuṇṭhe sa mahīyate |
pṛthvyāṃ lakṣagrāmarājā lakṣajanmasu jāyate ||29||
saprajaṃ suprakṛṣṭaṃ ca sasyekṣvādisamanvitam |
vāpīkūpayutaṃ kṣetraṃ nagaraṃ ca dadāti yaḥ || 1.369.3 0||
mahīyate sa vaikuṇṭhe daśalakṣendrajīvanam |
niyutapattanādhīśo rājendro jāyate bhuvi |||3 1 ||
nagarāṇāṃ śatakaṃ ca deśaṃ dadāti viṣṇave |
mahīyate sa vaikuṇṭhe koṭimanvantarāvadhim ||32||
tato jambūdvīpapatirbhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ |
mahī taṃ na jahātyeva janmanāṃ koṭimeva vai ||33||
kalpāntajīvī ca bhavet rājarājeśvaro mahān |
svādhikārapradātā ca phalaṃ caturguṇaṃ labhet ||34||
jambūdvīpapradātā ca phalaṃ daśaguṇaṃ labhet |
saptadvīpamahīdātuḥ sarvatīrthānusevinaḥ || 35||
sarveṣāṃ tapasāṃ kartuḥ sarvopavāsakāriṇaḥ |
sarvānyadānadātuśca sarvasiddhimatastathā | |36 ||
astyeva punarāvṛttirna bhaktasya hareraho |
asaṃkhyabrahmaṇāṃ pātaṃ paśyanti vaiṣṇavāḥ sati ||37||
golokasthāśca vaikuṇṭhavāsino’kṣaradhāmagāḥ |
paradhāmasthitāścāpi paśyantyetāṃ punargatim ||38||
harermantropāsakantu vihāya mānuṣīṃ tanum |
haritulyo divyarūpo bhūtvā yāti hareḥ padam ||39||
golokasthāḥ kṛṣṇabhaktā vaikuṇṭhasthāśca vaiṣṇavāḥ |
labdhvā kṛṣṇasya sārūpyaṃ nārāyaṇasya cāpi te ||1.369.40||
tayoḥ sevāṃ prakurvanti hyasakhyaṃ prākṛtaṃ layam |
devāśceśāśca naśyanti siddhā viśvāni yāni ca ||41 ||
harerbhaktā na naśyanti janmamṛtyujarāharāḥ |
kārtike haraye vṛndātulasīpatradāyakaḥ ||42||
yugaṃ patrapramāṇaṃ tu modate harimandire |
haraye ghṛtadīpaṃ ca kārtike yo dadāti vai ||43||
palapramāṇaṃ varṣaṃ sa modati harimandire |
harīcchayā yadi yāti sṛṣṭau bhāgavato bhavet ||44||
mahādhanāḍhyaścakṣuṣmān dīptimān bhaktikārakaḥ |
ācāryo vāvatāro vā tadaṃśo muktido bhavet ||45||
māghe prātastu gaṃgāditīrthasnāyī harergṛhe |
yugaṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi modate sa harīcchayā ||46 ||
brahmāṇḍeṣu deśikendro bhakto jitendriyo bhavet |
māghasnāyī tu gaṃgāyāṃ prayāge prātareva yaḥ ||47||
vaikuṇṭhe modate sopi lakṣamanvantarāvadhim |
nārāyaṇehayā sṛṣṭau deśikendro bhaveddhi saḥ || 48||
mānavīṃ sa tanuṃ tyaktvā punardhāma prayāti saḥ |
nāsti punarāvṛttiśca harerdhāmagatasya vai ||49||
karoti sa harerdāsyaṃ labdhvā sārūpyamityatha |
nityasnāyī tu gaṃgāyāṃ pade pade’śvamedhajam ||1.369.50||
phalaṃ yāti ca pūtaḥ sa sūryavajjāyate sati |
tasyaiva pādarajasā sadyaḥ pūtā vasundharā ||51 ||
modate sa tu vaikuṇṭhe yāvaccandradivākarau |
nārāyaṇehayā pṛthvyāṃ tapasvī deśiko bhavet| ||52||
grīṣmādau jaladātā tu vaikuṇṭhaṃ yāti kalpakam |
vaiśākhe haraye yastu candanādi dadāti vai ||53||
yugaṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi modate viṣṇumandire |
vaiśākhe saktudātā ca modate viṣṇumandire |||54|||
saktureṇupramāṇābdaṃ tato viṣṇostu vāñchayā |
ācāryo bhavati loke tapasvyuddhārakottamaḥ ||55||
karoti yaḥ kṛṣṇajanmāṣṭamīṃ bhādrāsite dale |
śatajanmakṛtapāpācchuddho bhavati tatkṣaṇāt ||56||
goloke modate kṛṣṇecchayā kārṣṇo bhavettathā |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇajanmāṣṭamīṃ kārtikakṛṣṇake ||57||
dale karoti yo bhaktyā harerdhāma prayāti saḥ |
anantasamayaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya sevakaḥ ||58||
sa cāśrute sarvakāmān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇārpitān |
śivarātrivratakartā bilvapatraṃ dadāti yaḥ ||59||
yuga patrapramāṇaṃ ca modate śivamandire |
vidyāvānputravān śrīmān prajāvān bhūmimām̐stathā ||1.369.6 0||
śivecchayā bhavatyeva saptamanvantarāvadhim |
mahāsṛṣṭau sukhī bhūtvā yāyācca śivamandiram ||6 1 ||
caitre māghe’rcayecchaṃbhuṃ puraḥ kuryāttu nartanam |
māsaṃ vāpyardhamāsaṃ vā daśa saptadināni vā ||62||
dinamānaṃ yugaṃ sopi śivaloke mahīyate |
śrīrāmanavamīṃ bhakto yaḥ karoti vrataṃ vratī ||63||
saptamanvantaraṃ yāvanmodate rāmadhāmani |
punā rāmasya bhakto vai bhūtvācāryapade sthitaḥ ||64||
rāmabhaktyā prayātyeva vaikuṇṭhaṃ sa dvitīyakam |
śaradṛtupūrṇimāyāṃ pūjāṃ harerharasya ca ||65||
bahūpacārasampannāṃ yaḥ karoti prabhaktarāṭ |
naivedyairupahāraiśca dhūpadīpādibhistathā ||66||
nṛtyagītādibhirvādyairnānākautukamaṃgalaiḥ |
hareḥ śaṃbhorvaselloke saptamanvantarāvadhim ||67||
punaḥ sa nirmalo bhakto bhūtvā śriyamavāpnuyāt |
mahāprabhāvayuktaśca gajavājisamanvitaḥ ||6 8| |
rājarājeśvaraḥ putrapautrādimānna saṃśayaḥ |
bhādraśuklāṣṭamīṃ prāpya mahālakṣmīṃ samarcayet ||6 9 ||
ṣoḍaśavastubhirbhaktyā vaikuṇṭhe yāti kalpakam |
punaḥ pṛthvyāṃ rājarājeśvaro bhaveddhi sāttvataḥ ||1.369.70||
kārtikīpūrṇimāyāṃ yo rāsamaṇḍalamācaret |
gopīrgopān śataṃ dvedhā śataṃ kṛtvā suvarṇajam ||71 ||
rādhākṛṣṇaṃ kārayitvā pūjayedupacārakaiḥ |
yathālabdhairbahuvidhairgolokaṃ yāti pūjakaḥ ||72||
brahmaṇo vayasā tatra sthitvā sṛṣṭau prayāti saḥ |
kṛṣṇabhaktiṃ punaḥ kṛtvā labdhvā mantraṃ harestataḥ ||73 ||
kṛṣṇasārūpyamāsādya pārṣado jāyate tu saḥ |
goloke vartate nityaṃ punarāvṛttivarjitaḥ ||74||
ekādaśīvratī yāti yāvadvai vedhaso vayaḥ |
vaikuṇṭhaṃ ca tataḥ kṣmāyāmāgatya punareva saḥ ||75||
haribhaktaḥ punaryāti vaikuṇṭhaṃ na patetpunaḥ |
bhādraśukle dvādaśyāṃ yaḥ śakraṃ saṃpūjayejjanaḥ ||76 ||
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi śakraloke mahīyate |
ravivāre’rkasaṃkrāntyāṃ saptamyāṃ śuklapakṣake ||77||
haviṣyānnapradātārkalokaṃ prayāti kalpakam |
punaḥ pṛthvyāṃ samāgatya nīrogī śrīyuto bhavet ||78||
jyeṣṭhaśuklacaturdaśyāṃ sāvitrīṃ tvāṃ prapūjayet |
modate sa brahmaloke saptamanvantarāvadhim ||79||
punaḥ pṛthvyāṃ śrīsameto jñānasampattiyug bhavet |
māghaśuklasya pañcamyāṃ pūjayed yaḥ sarasvatīm ||1.369.80||
mahīyate sa vaikuṇṭhe kalpamekaṃ punaḥ kaviḥ |
gosuvarṇapradātā golomadviguṇaṃ hareḥ ||8 1 ||
vaikuṇṭhe modate paścād viṣṇubhakto bhavet bhuvi |
rājarājeśvaro gomān vidyājñānasutādimān ||82||
bhojayed yaḥ sataḥ sādhūn sādhvīrviprām̐stathātithīn |
bhoktulomapramāṇābdaṃ modate viṣṇumandire ||83 ||
atrāgatya sukhī śrīmām̐ścirajīvī parākramī |
yo dadāti harernāma viṣṇuloke mahīyate ||84||
nāmakoṭiṃ japan bodhyo jīvanmukto na saṃśayaḥ |
baikuṇṭhe viṣṇusāyujyaṃ prāpnoti śāśvataṃ hiṃ saḥ |||85||
śivārcakaḥ śivaṃ yāti bāṇareṇupramāṇakam |
yugāyutaṃ tu kailāse sthitvā samrāṭ kṣitau bhavet ||86 ||
śālagrāmārcako bhakto prasādasya prabhakṣakaḥ |
mahīyate sa vaikuṇṭhe yāyādvai brahmaṇaḥ śatam ||87||
punaḥ pṛthvyāṃ nṛpo bhūtvā vaikuṇṭhaṃ yāti no patet| |
tapovratādyanuṣṭhātā vaikuṇṭhaṃ yāti kalpakam ||88 ||
bhūtvā pṛthvyāṃ sa rājendrastato mukto bhaveddhi saḥ |
aśvamedhakratukārī śakrasyārdhāsane vaset |||89|||
aśvaromapramāṇābdaṃ rājasūye caturguṇam |
naramedhe’śvamedhārdhaṃ gomedhe tu tathādṛśam ||1.369.90||
putreṣṭau tu tadardhaṃ syāllāṃguleṣṭau gomedhajam |
vipreṣṭau vṛddhiyāge ca phalaṃ gomedhajaṃ bhavet ||9 1 ||
padmeṣṭau tu tadardhaṃ ca viśokeṣṭau viśokajam |
vijayeṣṭau padmasamaṃ prājāpatye’pi tatsamam ||92|
ṛddhiyāge mahaiśvaryaṃ viṣṇuyāge tu vaiṣṇavam |
padaṃ puṇyaṃ labhed bhakto viṣṇulokaṃ ca śāśvatam || 93 ||
viṣṇuyajñaḥ pradhāno’sti sarvayajñeṣu sundari |
viṣṇuyajñātparo yajño nāsti śreṣṭhaphalapradaḥ || 94||
tatkartā bahukalpāntajīvī mukto bhavediha |
jñānena tejasā caiva viṣṇutulyo bhavedapi || 95||
aśvamedhaśatenaiva śakratvaṃ prāpyate divi |
sahasreṇa viṣṇupadaṃ saṃprāpa pṛthubhūpatiḥ || 96 ||
tīrthayajñatapovedavratānāṃ phalato’dhikam |
muktidaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇapādābjasevanam || 97||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyaiva varṇanaṃ dhyānamarcanam |
kīrtanaṃ bhajanaṃ stotraṃ smaraṇaṃ vandanaṃ japaḥ || 98||
tatpādāmṛtanaivedyādanaṃ sarvepsitapradam |
bhaja tvaṃ svāminaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ parātparam ||99||
gṛhāṇa ca patiṃ vatse sukhaṃ gaccha svamandiram |
ityuktvā maunamāsthāya yamastasthau hi padmaje || 1.369.100 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye sāvitrīpṛṣṭhakarmaphalapraśnānāṃ yamakṛtāni bahuvidhaphalottarāṇi cetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikonasaptatyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||369||

<1.370>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
harerbhaktermahimānaṃ śrutvā satī yamaṃ punaḥ |
papraccha kena vidhinā bhajanīyo hariḥ svayam || 1 ||
yamaḥ śrutvā tu sāvitrīṃ prāha rītiṃ sumokṣadām |
śṛṇu lakṣmi kathayāmi yathā prāha satīṃ yamaḥ || 2 ||
prātarutthāya tu kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ hṛdi smaret |
mūrtiṃ dhyāyet saumyarūpāṃ cintayettu punaḥ punaḥ || 3 ||
snāne śauce kriyāyāṃ ca bāhye cāntarakarmaṇi |
bhojye vihāre śayane gṛhakārye hariṃ smaret || 4 ||
śraddhayā parayā tatra harau sarvendriyāṇi vai |
tathāntaḥkaraṇānyevaṃ yojayecchrīharau mudā || 5 ||
pāne niṣadane svapne nidrāyāṃ jāgrati krame |
śubhe’śubhe tathā kārye smaraṇīyo hariḥ sadā || 6 ||
jihvā tatkīrtanaṃ kuryātkarṇastacchravaṇaṃ caret |
netraṃ taddarśanaṃ kuryād ghrāṇaṃ tadgandhamāpnuyāt || 7 ||
carma tatsparśanaṃ kuryātkarastatpādasevanam |
pādastanmandiraṃ gacched vāṇī tadbhajanaṃ caret || 8 ||
malamūtrendriyaṃ vighnanāśārthaṃ guṇatāṃ vrajet |
ānandaṃ śrīharerlabdhvā śrīharermananaṃ caret || 9 ||
nirṇayaṃ mānanaṃ cāpi cintanaṃ śrīhareśca tu |
evaṃ sarvaṃ harereva kuryānnānyasya kasyacit || 1.370.1 0||
na svārthaṃ na parārthaṃ ca kuryāddharyarthameva vai |
tathā kṛtvā nacireṇa harerdhāmagatirbhavet || 11 ||
ityuktā sā tu sāvitrī yamaṃ bhaktavaraṃ param |
jñātvā yamāṣṭakaṃ prāha śṛṇu lakṣmi vadāmi te || 12|
sūryaṃnārāyaṇastīrthe puṣkare tapasā purā |
dharmāśaṃ yaṃ sutaṃ prāpa dharmarājaṃ namāmyaham || 1 3||
sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ karmabhogāntaṃ saṃvidhāya yaḥ |
śāntiṃ karoti yo devaḥ śamanāya tu te namaḥ || 14||
kṛtānāṃ karmaṇāṃ tvantaṃ nyāyarītyā karoti yaḥ |
sarveṣāṃ dehināṃ so’yaṃ taṃ kṛtāntaṃ namāmyaham || 15||
pāpināṃ daṇḍakartā yo daṇḍaṃ bibharti śuddhidam |
śāstre tasmai nītiyuje daṇḍine te namo namaḥ || 16 ||
sarveṣāṃ vastukāryāṇāṃ paricchedaṃ karoti yaḥ |
sarvāyuḥkalanaṃ devaṃ kālarūpaṃ namāmyaham || 17||
jīvān daṇḍapradānairyo yamayatyeva sarvathā |
karmānurūpaphaladastaṃ yamaṃ praṇamāmi vai || 18||
yathā karma tathā dātā na rāgānna ca roṣataḥ |
tasmācchuddhikaraṃ mitraṃ sarvamitraṃ namāmi ca || 1 9||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇamūrteḥ samutpannastu yaḥ purā |
brahmaṇoṃ’śastato jātastaṃ brāhmaṃ praṇamāmi ca ||1.370.20||
ityuktvā taṃ praṇanāma yamastuṣṭo babhūva ha |
yamāṣṭakaṃ paṭhatastu bhavennaiva yamādbhayam ||2 1 ||
kāyavyūhena ca śuddhiḥ karmaṇāṃ tasya jāyate |
mucyate yamapāśācca satīṃ prāheti dharmarāṭ ||22||
yamastasyai kṛṣṇanārāyaṇamantra pradāya ca |
oṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ praṇamāmi trivārakam ||23 ||
karmāśubhavipākaṃ ca tāmuvāca yamaḥ svayam |
kukarmaṇā jano yāti narakān bahudāruṇān |||24||
narakāṇāṃ tu kuṇḍāni santi nānāvidhāni ca |
vistṛtāni gabhīrāṇi bhayakleśakarāṇi hi ||25||
ṣaḍaśītiśca kuṇḍāni ghorāṇi kutsitāni ca |
saṃyamanyāṃ pravidyante tāni nibodha nāmataḥ ||26||
vahnikuṇḍaṃ taptakuṇḍaṃ kṣayakuṇḍaṃ bhayānakam |
viṭkuṇḍaṃ mūtrakuṇḍaṃ ca śleṣmakuṇḍaṃ tu duḥsaham ||27||
garakuṇḍaṃ dāhakuṇḍaṃ vasākuṇḍaṃ tathā mahat |
śukrakuṇḍamasṛkkuṇḍamaśrukuṇḍaṃ ca kutsitam ||28||
malakuṇḍaṃ vīryakuṇḍaṃ rajaḥkuṇḍaṃ vigandhakṛt |
karṇaviṭkuṇḍamugraṃ ca nakhakuṇḍaṃ ca duḥkharam || 203||
majjākuṇḍaṃ māṃsakuṇḍamasthikuṇḍaṃ ca duḥkhadam |
lomakuṇḍaṃ kleśakuṇḍaṃ tāmralohaprakuṇḍakam | |1.370.3 0 ||
tīkṣṇakaṇṭakakuṇḍaṃ ca viṣakuṇḍaṃ ca dāhakam |
gharmakuṇḍaṃ taptasurākuṇḍaṃ vṛścikakuṇḍakam ||3 1 ||
taptatailaprakuṇḍaṃ ca dantakuṇḍaṃ ca vighnadam |
kṛmikuṇḍaṃ pūyakuṇḍaṃ sarpakuṇḍaṃ bhayāvaham | |3 2||
daṃśamaśakakuṇḍaṃ ca vajradaṃṣṭrāprakuṇḍakam |
śarakuṇḍaṃ śūlakuṇḍaṃ khaḍgakuṇḍaṃ tu vaiśasam ||33 ||
godhākuṇḍaṃ nakrakuṇḍaṃ kākakuṇḍaṃ mahābhayam |
ghṛṣṭikuṇḍaṃ cūrṇakuṇḍaṃ bandhakuṇḍaṃ nirāśrayam ||34||
taptapāṣāṇakuṇḍaṃ ca tīkṣṇagrāvāgrakuṇḍakam |
lālākuṇḍamasikuṇḍaṃ cūrṇakuṇḍaṃ ca mardanam ||35||
cakrakuṇḍaṃ vajrakuṇḍaṃ kūrmakuṇḍaṃ maholbaṇam |
jvālākuṇḍaṃ bhasmakuṇḍaṃ pūtikuṇḍaṃ bhayāvaham | |36 ||
taptasūrmīmasipatraṃ kṣuradhāraṃ sucīmukham |
kṛkalāsaprakuṇḍaṃ ca jagadaṃśaṃ cipīṭakam ||37||
kuṃbhīpākaṃ kālasūtramadhaḥkandharamugrakam |
pāṃśubhojyaṃ pāśakaṇṭhaṃ śūlaprotaṃ sukīlakam ||38||
ulkāmukhaṃ tvandhakūpaṃ vedhanaṃ daṇḍatāḍanam |
jālabandhaṃ dehacūrṇaṃ dalanaṃ śoṣaṇaṃkaram ||39||
sarpajvālāmayaṃ kṣveḍadhūmrāndhaṃ nāgapāśanam |
dvaidhībhāvaprakuṇḍaṃ ca lāvaṇaṃ kuṇḍamityapi ||1.370.40||
bhaguprapātanaṃ cāpi vaitaraṇīprapātanam |
carmotkartanakuṇḍaṃ ca bhrāṣṭrakaṭāhamityapi ||41 ||
kuṇḍānyetāni sāvitri pāpānāṃ śodhakāni vai |
pāpināṃ duḥkhadānyeva rakṣitāni yamānugaiḥ ||42||
daṇḍahastaiḥ śūlapāśaśaktitomarahastakaiḥ |
madonmattaistāmasaiśca nirdayaistāmrapiṃgalaiḥ ||43 ||
nānārūpadharaiḥ sarvādhṛṣyairdṛśyaistu pāpinām |
puṇyakṛtāmadṛśyaiśca dhārmikāṇāṃ ca yoginām ||44||
śṛṇu keṣāṃ kutra vāso daṇḍarūpo’sti kuṇḍake |
kaṭuvāṇyā khalatvena dagdhān karoti bāndhavān ||45 ||
gātralomapramāṇābdaṃ vahnikuṇḍaṃ prayāti saḥ |
dagdhvā vahnau pātakāni labhejjanmatrayaṃ paśoḥ ||46 ||
gṛhāgatātithiṃ yo na bhojayet svāśritaṃ tathā |
lomamānasamāstaptakuṇḍe sthitvā tataḥ sa vai ||47||
uṣṇabhūmau marau deśe pakṣī syātsaptajanmasu |
ravivārārkasaṃkrāntyāmamāyāṃ śrāddhavāsare ||48||
vrate kṣāreṇa vastrasthakīṭānāṃ nāśakastu yaḥ |
kṣārakuṇḍaṃ sa vai yāti sūtramānābdameva ha ||49||
vrajecca rājakīṃ yoniṃ saptajanmasu sundari |
svadattāṃ paradattāṃ ca jīvikāṃ tu hareddhi yaḥ ||1.370.50 ||
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi viṭkuṇḍaṃ tu prayāti saḥ |
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi viḍbhojī viṭkṛmistataḥ ||51 ||
taḍāgaṃ nāśayed yastu mūtrakuṇḍaṃ prayāti saḥ |
tadreṇumānavarṣaṃ ca mūtrapāyī tato bhuvi ||52||
saptajanmasu godhā syād bhittivāsakarī gṛhe |
ekākī miṣṭabhug yāti śleṣmakuṇḍaṃ samāśatam |||53 ||
śleṣmābhojī bhavet preto mūtrapūyādipānakṛt |
pitaraṃ mātaraṃ patnīṃ guruṃ putrīṃ sutaṃ sakhīn ||54||
anāthaṃ ca na puṣṇāti kṣveṇakuṇḍaṃ prayāti saḥ |
abdasahasraṃ tadbhojī tataḥ pretaḥ śataṃ samāḥ |||55||
atithiṃ krūrabhāvena draṣṭurjalaṃ ca piṇḍakān |
pitṛdevā na gṛhṇanti kulanāśastato bhavet ||56||
teṣāṃ tu ghātakānāṃ ca malakuṇḍe prapātanam |
śataṃ samā malabhojī tataḥ sa saptajanmasu ||57||
daridro jāyate duḥkhī patitaśca pade pade |
datvā dānaṃ tu caikasmai tvanyasmai dīyate tu tat ||58||
vasākuṇḍaṃ prayātyeva śatavarṣaṃ vasādanaḥ |
janmatrayaṃ sa cāṇḍālaḥ kṛkalāsaśca saptakṛt ||59||
daridraśca bhavedalpajīvī ca pāpakṛttataḥ |
naro nārī svakaṃ śukraṃ rajo vāpi parasparam ||1.370.60||
pāyayatyeva kāmādvā śukrakuṇḍaṃ prayāti saḥ |
śatavarṣaṃ ca tadbhojī yonikīṭaḥ śataṃ samāḥ ||6 1 ||
atha pūjyaṃ tāḍayitvā guruṃ ca pitarau tathā |
raktaṃ pravāhayed yaḥ sa yātyasṛkakuṇḍamulbaṇam ||62||
śatavarṣaṃ raktabhojī tato vyādhaḥ prajāyate |
saptajanmasu pāpāni kṛtvā punastathā vrajet ||63 ||
aśru sravantaṃ gāyantaṃ nṛtyantaṃ bhaktameva yaḥ |
kṛṣṇāgre tu hasan cāśrukuṇḍaṃ prayāti narmakṛt ||64||
śatavarṣaṃ tvaśrubhojī cāṇḍālaḥ syāt trijanmasu |
khalo yāti gātramalakuṇḍaṃ daśābdakaṃ tataḥ ||65||
trijanmasu kharo jambūkastrijanmasu kaṣṭavān |
badhiraṃ yo hasatyeva nindatyapi ca narmakṛt ||66 ||
sa yāti karṇaviṭkuṇḍe tadbhojī śatavatsarān |
tato badhiraḥ saptajanmasvaṃgahīnaśca saptasu ||67||
jīvikādaṃ tu yo hanti majjākuṇḍe sa gacchati |
lakṣavarṣāṇi tadbhojī śaśakaḥ saptajanmasu ||68||
mīnā eṇāḥ sapta sapta tataḥ śuddhaḥ prajāyate |
kanyāvikrayiṇo yānti māṃsakuṇḍe’tidāruṇe ||69||
kanyālomapramāṇābdaṃ māṃsādanā hatā yamaiḥ |
svamāṃsaṃ rudhiraṃ mūrdhnaste khādanti kṣudhārditāḥ ||1.370.70||
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi kanyāviṭsu kṛmistataḥ |
saptajanmasu vyādhaḥ sa varāhaḥ kukkurastataḥ ||71 ||
saptajanmasu maṇḍūko jalaukāḥ kāka ityapi |
kṣauraṃ yatra vidhināptaṃ na kārayettu yo janaḥ ||72 ||
nakhakuṇḍaṃ prayātyeva nakhabhojī nakhābdakam |
romakuṇḍe tathā yāti romabhojī pratāḍitaḥ ||73 ||
sakeśaṃ pārthivaṃ liṃgaṃ pūjayed yo janastu saḥ |
keśakuṇḍe prayātyeva mṛdreṇumānavarṣakam ||74||
tato vai yavano varṣaśataṃ prajāyate bhuvi |
pitṛpiṇḍāpradātāsthikuṇḍe patati colbaṇe ||75 ||
tataḥ khañjaḥ saptajanmasvatinirdhana eva ca |
yaḥ sevate pūrṇamāsāṃ garbhiṇīṃ prasavonmukhām ||76 ||
prataptatāmrakuṇḍe sa śatavarṣāṇi tiṣṭhati |
rajasvalānnaṃ yo bhuṃkte śatābdaṃ lauhakuṇḍake ||77||
patitvā rājakīṃ yoniṃ carmakārī ca saptasu |
mahāvraṇī daridraśca jāyate tatparaṃ śuciḥ ||78||
yaśca gharmasvedahastaṃ devadravye suyojayet |
śatavarṣapramāṇaṃ sa gharmakuṇḍe hi tiṣṭhati ||79||
surāpaśca surākuṇḍe coṣṇaṃ yāti śataṃ samāḥ |
tataḥ śūdraḥ saptajanmasvatinirdhana eva ca ||1.370.80||
kaṭuvāṇyā patiṃ vakti sā kuṇḍe tīkṣṇakaṇṭake |
patitā tāḍyate dūtaiścaturyugaṃ ca tiṣṭhati ||8 1 ||
aśvinī jāyate paścāt pṛthivyāṃ saptajanmasu |
viṣadātā viṣakuṇḍe sahasrābdaṃ hi tiṣṭhati ||82||
viṣabhojī nṛghātī ca vṛṇī syāt saptajanmasu |
saptajanmasu kuṣṭhī ca tataḥ śuddhaḥ prajāyate ||83 ||
vṛṣaṃ bhṛtyaṃ tāḍayed yo daṇḍena tanniyāmakaḥ |
prataptatailakuṇḍe sa tiṣṭhatyeva caturyugam ||84||
tato goromamānābdaṃ vṛṣo bhavati bhūtale |
baḍiśena ca kuntena dantena kīlakena ca ||85||
lauhena hanti vṛṣabhaṃ dehinaṃ prāṇinaṃ ca vā |
kuntakuṇḍe vasetso’pi varṣāṇāmayutaṃ khalu ||86||
tato jalodararogī tvekajanmani jāyate |
abhakṣyabhakṣī manujo kṛmikuṇḍaṃ prayāti vai ||87||
svalomamānavarṣānte bhuvi mlecchastrijanmasu |
pāpānnabhojī vrajati pūyakuṇḍaṃ śata samāḥ ||88||
tataḥ śūdraḥ saptajanmasvatiśūladharo bhavet |
sarpahā sarpakuṇḍaṃ tu yāti sarpeṇa bhakṣitaḥ ||89||
sarpaviḍbhakṣaṇaḥ paścātsarpo vai jāyate bhuvi |
tataḥ svalpāyurevāyaṃ dadrurogī bhavettathā ||1.370.90||
sarpeṇa tasya mṛtyuśca sarpeṇa bhakṣaṇaṃ matam |
jīvān hanti sa daṃśākhye kuṇḍe patati pāpakṛt ||91 ||
āyurdinābdakaṃ sthitvā kṣudrajantusahasrake |
jāyate ca muhuḥ paścādaṃgahīno bhaved dhruvam ||92||
madhuhā makṣikāghātī sagare kuṇḍake patet |
svāyurdinātmakaṃ sthitvā makṣikāyonimāpnuyāt ||93||
adaṇḍyadaṇḍakṛt kuṇḍe vajrakīṭe pateddhruvam |
tallomamānavarṣaṃ ca sthitvā kīṭo bhaved bhuvi ||94||
anyāyadhanalo rājā vṛścike kuṇḍake patet |
romābdaṃ duḥkhamāsādya vṛścikaḥ saptajanmasu ||95||
tato’ṅgavikalo vyādhigrasto bhuvi bhavejjanaḥ |
vipro dharmavihīno vai śarakuṇḍe patatyatha ||96||
śaraviddhaḥ svalomābdaṃ sthitvā śuddho bhavettataḥ |
kārāgāre bandhayati jīvānnirdoṣakān janaḥ ||97||
taptatoye golakuṇḍe patati romavatsarān |
kīṭairviddhastato nīcabhṛtyo vai jāyate bhuvi || 98||
nakramīnaprahantā ca nakrakuṇḍe patatyatha |
nakrakaṇṭakamānābdaṃ sthitvā nakrastato jale ||99||
anyacchidrānveṣakastu kākakuṇḍe patatyatha |
kākaprakṣuṇṇanetraśca romābdaṃ tatra vartate || 1.370.10 0||
saptajanmadaridraḥ sa trijanmāndhaśca jāyate |
svarṇatāmralauhacauro vajrakuṇḍaṃ prayāti vai | | 101 ||
devadravyaprahartāpi romābdaṃ vajrakuṇḍagaḥ |
vajairhato bhavettatra vajrabhug dehadāvavān || 102 ||
gavāṃ śukānāṃ mūrtīnāṃ caurastaptopalābhidhe |
kuṇḍe patati svalomābdaṃ tato vakastrijanmasu || 103 ||
haṃsastataḥ śaṃkhacillastato raktādirogavān |
saptajanmasu cālpāyuḥ kūpyacauro’pi tādṛśaḥ || 1 04||
rītikāṃsyādicauraśca tīkṣṇagrāvāgrakuṇḍake |
svalomābdaṃ vasetpaścādaśvaḥ syāt saptajanmasu | | 1 05||
tato’dhikāṃgakaḥ kubjaḥ pāde rugṇaśca jāyate |
puṃścalyannādatajjīvī lālākuṇḍe pated dhruvam || 106 ||
tallomābdaṃ lālabhojī cakṣūrogī ca śūlavān |
mlecchasevī maṣīsevī maṣīkuṇḍe’titaptake || 1 07||
svalomābdaṃ vaset paścāt kṛṣṇapaśustrijanmasu |
chāgaḥ sarpastālavṛkṣastriṣu triṣu ca janmasu || 1 08||
dhānyatāmbūlatalpārghyāsanasasyādicaurakaḥ |
śatābdaṃ cūrṇakuṇḍe vai tato meṣaśca kukkuṭaḥ || 1 09||
trijanmasu tataḥ kāsavyādhigrastaśca mānavaḥ |
vaṃśahīno daridraścāpyalpāyurduḥkhavān bhavet || 1.370.11 0||
cakraśastrādikartā tu śatābdaṃ cakrakuṇḍake |
trijanmasu tailakāro rogī vaṃśahīnastataḥ || 111 ||
pratispardhī matsarī ca vajrakuṇḍe yugaṃ patet |
saptajanmasu vakrāṃgo bhāryāvaṃśavihīnakaḥ || 112||
kūrmādimāṃsabhuk kūrmakuṇḍe patecchataṃ samāḥ |
sa trijanmasu kūrmaśca sūkaro’pi mayūrakaḥ || 11 3||
mārjāraścāpi pratyekaṃ trijanmasu jāyate |
ghṛtatailādicaurastu jvālākuṇḍe ca bhasmani || 114||
kuṇḍe śatābdaṃ patati tailapaḥ saptajanmasu |
matsyaśca mūṣakaḥ saptajanmasvatha tataḥ śuciḥ || 1 15||
sugandhitailadhātryādidravyacaurastu kuṇḍake |
durgandhe lomamānābdaṃ durgandhī jāyate tataḥ || 1 16||
durgandhikaḥ saptajanau mṛganābhistrijanmasu |
saptajanmasugandhaśca tataḥ śuddho hi mānavaḥ || 1 17||
bhūmihartā taptaśūle taptataile patet tataḥ |
saptamanvantaraṃ paścād viṭkṛmirayutaṃ tu ṣaṭ || 1 18||
bhūmihīno daridraśca tato vai śuddha eva saḥ |
naraghātī cāsipatre vasetkalpaṃ tataḥ punaḥ || 11 9||
brahmahā cecchatamanvantaraṃ khaḍgavane vaset |
chinnāṃgaḥ khaṅgadhāraiśca cāṇḍālaḥ śatajanmasu || 1.370.1 20||
sūkaraḥ kukkuro gomāyūśca vyāghro vṛkastataḥ |
gaṇḍī mahiṣaḥ pratyekaṃ saptajanmasu jāyate || 121 ||
grāmādidāhakaḥ kṣuradhāre yugatrayaṃ patet |
tataḥ preto vahnimukho’medhyabhojī tataḥ punaḥ || 1 22||
khadyotaśca saptajanau mahāśūlī ca tāvatā |
saptajanmagalatkuṣṭhī tataḥ śuddhyati vahnidaḥ || 1 23||
kalaṃkado nindakaśca sūcimukhe yugatrayam |
tato bhaved vṛścikaśca sarpaśca saptajanmasu || 124||
vajrakīṭaḥ saptajano bhasmakīṭastato naraḥ |
gṛhabhedī stenakartā gogodhāmeṣachāgakān || 125||
pratyekaṃ saptajanmāni tato rogī naro’dhuraḥ |
dravyacauro nakramukho yugaṃ paścācca rogavān || 1 26||
gogajāśvanarahantā gajadaṃśe yugatrayam |
tatastattajjātijanmatrayaṃ mlecchastato bhavet || 1 27||
gojātiduḥkhado yāti gomukhe narake dhruvam |
kṛmitaptodake manvantaraṃ sthitvā ca govṛṣaḥ || 1 28||
saptajanau tato rogī daridro’ntyajajātikaḥ |
gobrahmasādhuhatyākṛt strīmitrabhrūṇahā tathā || 1 29||
kuṃbhīpāke patet kalpaṃ cūrṇyate yamadūtakaiḥ |
vahnau kṣaṇaṃ kuṇḍake ca tapte taile jale tathā || 1.370.130 ||
pāṣāṇe taptalauhe ca duḥkhāni paśyati dhruvam |
gṛdhrakoṭisahasrāṇi śatajanmāni sūkaraḥ || 131 ||
kākaśca saptajanmāni sarpaḥ syātsaptajanmasu |
viṭkṛmiśca vṛṣalaśca galatkuṣṭhī tato bhavet || 1 32||
yakṣmagrasto vaṃśahīno bhāryāhīnastataḥ śuciḥ |
śrīharau ca śrīkṛṣṇe ca nārāyaṇe ca bhūmani || 1 33||
vāsudeve śive viṣṇau brahmaṇi bhedabuddhikṛt |
brahmahatyākaro bodhyo bhedo hatyāsamo mataḥ || 1 34||
akṣare rādhikāyāṃ ca lakṣmyāṃ śriyāṃ ramātanau |
pārvatyāṃ ca prabhāyāṃ ca māṇikyāyāṃ ca bhedakṛt || 1 35||
brahmahatyāsamadoṣī lalitājayayorapi |
bhedakṛt sve gurau sveṣṭadeve pitari mātari || 136 ||
haryarcāyāṃ bhedabuddhirbrahmahatyāmadūṣaṇam |
viṣṇornaivedyasalilavarjito’pi tathā mataḥ || 1 37||
pitṛdevagurupūjānindako’pi tathā mataḥ |
śivaṃ viṣṇuṃ śivāṃ lakṣmīṃ nindanti brahmaghātinaḥ || 138 ||
harerjanmatithīn śaivīṃ tithiṃ caikādaśīṃ tathā |
vratāhāni ca nindanti brahmahatyākarā hi te || 139| |
guruṃ ca mātaraṃ tātaṃ sādhvīṃ bhāryāṃ sutaṃ sutām |
āśritān yo na puṣṇāti brahmahatyākaro hi saḥ | | 1.370.140 | |
apūjakaśca devānāṃ govṛṣādeśca tāḍakaḥ |
gocarādiprahartā ca brahmahatyākaro hi saḥ || 141 ||
gavāṃ duḥkhakaraḥ pāpaṃ gohatyājaṃ labhettathā |
gavāṃ vṛttiharo gāśca padā saṃtāḍayettu yaḥ || 142||
yonijīvī trisandhyādivihīno dharmanāśakaḥ |
devapitratithisevāhīno goghātako mataḥ || 143 ||
svabhartari ca kṛṣṇe ca bhedabuddhikarī tu yā |
kaṭūktyā tāḍayet kāntaṃ sā gohatyākarī matā || 144||
gavāṃ vṛttiṃ jīvikāṃ ca jalaṃ gṛhaṃ tathāśrayam |
hanyād yaḥ sa bhaveccāpi gohatyāpātakī dhruvam || 145| |
devapūjākṛte yāni jalānnakusumāni tu |
tāni yo laṃghayetpādairgohatyāpāpakṛddhi saḥ || 146 ||
mithyāvādī gurudveṣī devadveṣī ca pitṛdviṭ |
gohatyāpāpavān sopi vijñeyo nātra saṃśayaḥ || 147| |
pituḥ śataguṇā mātā mātuḥ śataguṇo guruḥ |
vidyāmantrapradātā ca guruḥ pūjyaḥ sadā mataḥ || 148||
guruto gurupatnī ca gaurave ca garīyasī |
yatheṣṭadevapatnī ca pūjyā cābhīṣṭadevatā || 149| |
brāhmaṇastu surāpāṇī viḍbhojī vṛṣalīpatiḥ |
harivāsarabhojī ca kubhīpākaṃ vrajet sati || 1.370.150 ||
gurupatnīṃ rājapatnīṃ sapatnīmātaraṃ prasūm |
sutāṃ putravadhūṃ śvaśrūṃ sagarbhāṃ bhaginīṃ priyām || 151 ||
sodarabhrātṛjāyāṃ ca mātulānīṃ pitṛprasūm |
mātuḥ prasūṃ tatsvasāraṃ bhaginīṃ bhrātṛkanyakām || 152||
śiṣyāṃ ca śiṣyapatnīṃ ca bhāgineyasya kāminīm |
bhrātuḥ putrapriyāṃ caivāpyagamyāmāha padmajaḥ || 153 ||
etāsu gamakaḥ kāmī brahmahatyāśataṃ labhet |
sa yāti kuṃbhīpākaṃ tu mahāpāpī sudustaram || 154||
hareḥ sevāṃ vinā sādhvi na labhet karmakhaṇḍanam |
sarvānnabhogī saṃyāti kālasūtraṃ śataṃ samāḥ || 155||
tataḥ śūdro’tirugṇaḥ syād daridro nirdhanastathā |
prakopavadanā kopāt svāminaṃ yā tu paśyati || 156 ||
kaṭūktiṃ taṃ ca vadati yāti colkāmukhaṃ hi sā |
ulkāṃ dadāti vaktre ca satataṃ yamakiṃkaraḥ || 157||
daṇḍena tāḍayenmūrdhni tallomābdapramāṇakam |
tato bhavenmānavī ca vidhavā saptajanmasu || 158||
yā brāhmaṇī sarvabhogyā sāndhakūpaṃ prayāti vai |
taptaśaucodake taptvā kalpamānaṃ tataḥ param || 159||
kākī sūkarī kukkuṭī śṛgālī ca pārāvatī |
vānarī saptajanmāni cāṇḍālī ca tato bhavet ||1.370.160 ||
rajakī tailakārī ca tataḥ śuddhyati sā sati |
veśyā vased vedhakuṇḍe gaṇikā daṇḍatāḍane || 161 ||
jālabandhe puṃścalī ca kulaṭā dehacūrṇake |
svairiṇī dalane kuṇḍe yāvanmanvantaraṃ vaset || 162||
kare dhṛtvā tu tulasīṃ pratijñāṃ yo na pālayet |
mithyā vā śapathaṃ kuryāt sa tu jvālāmukhe patet || 163||
datvā tu dakṣiṇaṃ hastaṃ pratijñāṃ yo na pālayet |
spṛṣṭvā gāṃ brāhmaṇaṃ devaṃ vahniṃ sādhuṃ satīṃ jalam || 164||
na pālayetpratijñāṃ tu sa vai jvālāmukhe patet |
mitradrohī kṛtaghnaśca tathā viśvāsaghātakaḥ || 165||
mithyāsākṣyapradaścāpi sa vai jvālāmukhaṃ vrajet |
kalpe vaset tato mūko badhiraśca trijanmasu || 166||
mitradrohī nakulaḥ syāt kṛtaghnaścāpi ṣaṇḍhakaḥ |
viśvāsaghātī vyāghraśca mithyāsākṣī tu bhallukaḥ || 167||
vratopavāsahīnaśca sadvākyaparinindakaḥ |
jihmo vasettu haime vai narake tu śataṃ samāḥ || 168||
jalajantuḥ śatajanmakrameṇa matsyako bhavet |
devādidravyahārī ca dhūmrāndhe patito bhavet || 169||
caturyugaṃ vasettatra mūṣakaḥ saptajanmasu |
paśau patatriṇi kṛmau vṛkṣajātiṣu jāyate || 1.370.170||
tato bhāryāvaṃśahīnaḥ śabaro vyādhimān bhavet |
svarṇakāro vaṇig vaidyo vyāpārī rasavikrayī || 171 ||
kūṭamāno nāgaveṣṭaṃ kuṇḍaṃ yātyeva dāruṇam |
tato gopo bhavecceti tataḥ śuddhyati vai sati || 172||
prasiddhāni tu kuṇḍāni kathitāni pativrate |
anyānyapyaprasiddhāni yathākarma bhavanti ve || 173 ||
santi pāpaprakartāraḥ kuṇḍeṣu phalabhoginaḥ |
tato bhramanti saṃsāre kiṃcittubhyaṃ niveditam || 174||
sarveṣṭaṃ sārabhūtaṃ tu maṃgalaṃ kṛṣṇasevanam |
janmamṛtyujarārogaśokasantāpatāraṇam || 175||
bhaktivṛkṣāṃkurakaraṃ karmavṛkṣanikṛntanam |
sālokyasārṣṭisārūpyasāmīpyādipradaṃ śubhe || 176||
kuṇḍāni yamadūtaṃ ca yamaṃ ca yamakiṃkarān |
svapne’pi nahi paśyanti sati śrīkṛṣṇasevakāḥ || 177||
harivrataprakartāro gṛhiṇastyāginastriyaḥ |
ye snānti haritīrthe ca nāśnanti harivāsare || 178||
saṃsmaranti kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ saṃpūjayanti ca |
na yānti te mama ghorāṃ duḥkhāṃ saṃyamanīṃ purīm || 179||
āmnāyanyāyamārgasthāstyāgino gṛhiṇaśca te |
śuddhā dharmaparā yānti kṛṣṇamandiramakṣaram || 1.370.180||
svadūtānpāśahastām̐śca gacchatastān vadāmyaham |
yāsyatheti tu sarvatra haribhaktāśramaṃ vinā || 181 ||
harerbhaktāṃścitraguptaḥ puṣpāṃjaliṃ karoti hi |
madhuparkādikaṃ brahmā teṣāṃ tu kurute sadā || 182||
mama lokaṃ satyalokaṃ vilaṃghya gacchatāṃ satām |
sparśamātreṇa pāpāni naśyanti yāmyadehinām || 183||
pāvanāste bhāgavatāḥ pañcabhūtatanuṃ vinā |
sūkṣmeṇaiva śarīreṇa prayānti cordhvaveginaḥ || 184||
brahmadhāmasamīpe tu snātvā brahmahṛde ca te |
sūkṣmaṃ vimucya māyāyāṃ brāhmyā tanvā tu dhāmani ||185||
ātmātmikayā modante bahuśaktindriyendrakāḥ |
yamalokaṃ gatā ye tu karmaphalāya dehinaḥ || 186||
bibhrati sūkṣmadehaṃ te nāśo yasya na jāyate |
sa deho na bhaved bhasma jvaladagnau yamālaye || 187||
jale naṣṭobhavennaiva prahāre nāpi naśyati |
śastre śāstre kaṇṭake ca śūle taptadrave tathā || 188||
tapte lohe ca pāṣāṇe pratikṛtau na naśyati |
karmaphalaṃ tathā bhuṃkte sukhamātrā na vidyate || 189||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇadhāmni duḥkhamātrā na vidyate |
tameva bhaja sāvitri gaccha kāntena mandiram || 1.370.190||
ityuktvā sā yamenāpi na yayau mandiraṃ svakam |
satyavantaṃ sūkṣmadehaṃ svāyattīkṛtya sve hṛdi ||191 ||
jijñāsamānā papraccha kuṇḍamānādikaṃ tadā |
śṛṇu lakṣmi kathayiṣye yamena yattu bhāṣitam || 192|||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye sāvitrīkṛtayamāṣṭakastotraṃ, ṣaḍaśītinirayakuṇḍāni, yathākarma tatpātaḥ, brahmahatyāgohatyāprakhyapāpāni, bhaktānāṃ yamaparābhavo cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptatyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||370 ||

<1.371>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi priye patni lokānāmupakārakam |
yamaproktaṃ ca sāvitryai kuṇḍamānādikaṃ tu yat || 1 ||
pūrṇendumaṇḍalākāraṃ kuṇḍaṃ pratyekameva vai |
gabhīraṃ nimnamatyugrakaṣṭadaṃ na tu naśvaram || 2 ||
tatrāgnikuṇḍakāyāmaḥ śatahastamito’sti vai |
koṭiśastvagnikuṇḍānāṃ vartulāni bhavanti hi || 3 ||
pratyekakuṇḍabāhulyaṃ bodhyaṃ pāpibahutvataḥ |
taptodakaprakuṇḍaṃ tu krośārdhamānameva ca || 4 ||
taptakṣārodakakuṇḍaṃ krośamātraṃ prakīrtitam |
taptamūtradravakuṇḍaṃ gavyūtimānameva ha || 5 ||
śleṣmakuṇḍaṃ krośamitaṃ krośārdhaṃ garakuṇḍakam |
netramalaprakuṇḍaṃ ca krośārdhaṃ kīṭapūritam || 6 ||
vasākuṇḍaṃ krośaturyaṃ śukrakuṇḍaṃ tathā matam |
durgandhiraktakuṇḍaṃ ca vāpītulyaṃ dhanuḥśatam || 7 ||
netrāśrukuṇḍaṃ vāpyardhaṃ malakuṇḍaṃ tathaiva hi |
karṇaviṭkuṇḍakaṃ vāpīturyapramāṇameva ca || 8 ||
majjākuṇḍaṃ vāpīturyaṃ māṃsakuṇḍaṃ dhanuḥśatam |
nakhakuṇḍaṃ lomakuṇḍaṃ cāsthikuṇḍaṃ ca dantakam || 9 ||
pratyekaṃ vāpikāturyamānaṃ cātibhayānakam |
tāmrakuṇḍaṃ taptatāmrapratimākoṭirājitam || 1.371.10 ||
gavyūtimānakaṃ taptalohakuṇḍaṃ tathāyatam |
gharmakuṇḍaṃ surākuṇḍaṃ vāpyardhaṃ lohakuṇḍakam || 11 ||
adhaḥ śālmalivṛkṣasya tīkṣṇakaṇṭakakuṇḍakam |
lakṣapauruṣanimna ca krośamānaṃ ca vartulam || 1 2||
dhanurmānāḥ kaṇṭakāśca bhittiṣu paritaḥ sthitāḥ |
viṣakuṃḍaṃ krośamānaṃ śastrakuṇḍaṃ tathāyatam || 1 3||
prataptatailakuṇḍaṃ ca dvigavyūtipramāṇakam |
śastratalpaprakuṇḍaṃ ca krośaturyapramāṇakam || 14||
krośārdhaṃ pūyakuṇḍaṃ ca dantakuṇḍaṃ tathāyatam |
dvigavyūtipramāṇaṃ ca himatoyaprakuṇḍakam || 15||
makṣikādaṃśakuṇḍe ca krośārdhaṃ sammataṃ tathā |
vajravṛścikakuṇḍee ca vāpyardhe samatāyate || 16 ||
śarakuṇḍaṃ ca vāpyarthaṃ nakrakuṇḍaṃ tathāyatam |
kākakuṇḍaṃ dhanurlakṣaṃ gṛdhrakuṇḍa tathāyatam || 17||
vājakuṇḍaṃ tathā dīrghaṃ vajrakuṇḍaṃ dhanuḥśatam |
taptapāṣāṇakuṇḍaṃ ca vāpīdviguṇakāyatam || 18||
lālākuṇḍaṃ krośamānaṃ taptatoyaṃ dhanuḥśatam |
cūrṇakuṇḍaṃ krośamānaṃ krośaturyaṃ tu cakrakam || 1 9||
kulālacakravadghūrṇyamānaṃ ṣoḍaśadhārakam |
jvālākuṇḍaṃ kacchapādikuṇḍaṃ ca krośamānakam ||1.371.2 0||
krośamānaṃ taptabhasmakuṇḍaṃ dhvāntaṃ ca krośakam |
dagdhakuṇḍaṃ krośamātraṃ taptakṣāraṃ tathāyatam ||21 ||
taptatoyaprakuṇḍaṃ dvigavyūtimānameva ca |
uttaptasūrmikuṇḍaṃ ca hyasipatravanaṃ tathā ||22||
krośārdhamānameveti raktakuṇḍaṃ tathāyatam |
kṣurāstrakuṇḍakaṃ dhanuḥśatamānaṃ bhayaṃkaram ||23 ||
sūcikuṇḍaṃ tu pañcāśaddhanurmānaṃ vibhedakam |
godhākuṇḍaṃ kuparūpaṃ dhanurviṃśatimānakam || 24||
kuṇḍaṃ naramukhākāraṃ dhanuḥṣoḍaśamānakam |
gajakuṇḍaṃ gajadantairghātakaṃ vai dhanuśśatam ||25||
dhanustriṃśatpramāṇaṃ ca smṛtaṃ gomukhakuṇḍakam |
kālacakraṃ bhramikuṇḍaṃ dvigavyūtipramāṇakam || 26 ||
lakṣamānavakuṇḍaṃ ca tailalohopalānvitam |
taptaṃ ca vahninā caturgavyūtimānakaṃ hi tat ||27||
yāvantaḥ pāpinaḥ santi sarvakuṇḍeṣu sundari |
caturguṇāstataḥ kuṃbhīpāke santi mahattame ||28 ||
sarvakuṇḍapradhānaṃ tu kuṃbhīpākaṃ prakīrtitam |
kālasūtraṃ taptatoyaṃ kuṇḍaṃ kodaṇḍaviṃśatim ||29||
dhanuśśatamavaṭodaṃ vyādhirogaprapūritam |
taptapāṃsuprakuṇḍaṃ ca dhanuḥśataṃ pradāhakam ||1.371.3 0 ||
krośārtanādakuṇḍaṃ ca dhanurviṃśatimānakam |
śūlakuṇḍaṃ tathāmānaṃ krośārdhaṃ himatoyakam ||3 1 ||
dhanurviṃśatimānaṃ tu colkākuṇḍaṃ prakīrtitam |
andhakāraprakuṇḍaṃ ca dhanuśśataṃ mahattaram ||32||
dhanurviṃśatimānaṃ tu vedhanaṃ śastrakuṇḍakam |
dhanuḥṣoḍaśamānaṃ tu daṇḍatāḍanakuṇḍakam ||3 3 ||
dhanustriṃśatpramāṇaṃ ca jālakuṇḍaṃ prakīrtitam |
lauhavedicūrṇakuṇḍaṃ koṭimānavamānakam ||34||
mūrchākuṇḍaṃ dhvāntayuktaṃ dhanurviṃśatimānakam |
dhanuḥṣoḍaśamānaṃ ca dalanaṃ kuṇḍamucyate ||35||
taptavālukikākuṇḍaṃ dhanustriṃśatpramāṇakam |
carmakaṣāyakuṇḍaṃ ca durgandhaṃ vai dhanuḥśatam ||36 ||
śūrpākāramukhaṃ kuṇḍaṃ dhanurdvādaśamānakam |
agniśikhaṃ tathā kuṇḍaṃ dhanurviṃśatimānakam ||37||
jvālāmukhaṃ jihmakuṇḍaṃ vāpyardhaṃ parikīrtitam |
dhūmrakuṇḍaṃ dhanuḥśataṃ viṣadhūmrādisaṃbhṛtam ||38||
dhanuśśataṃ nāgapūrṇaṃ nāgaveṣṭanakuṇḍakam |
ṣaḍaśītiśca kuṇḍāni tānyuktāni mayā sati ||39||
sāvitri vad cānyadvai yadi śrotuṃ samicchasi |
sāvitrī tu tadā prāha santuṣṭā dehidurlabhām ||1.371.40||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktiṃ bhāgavatavṛṣātmikām |
tattvajñānavihīnā ca strījātirvidhinā kṛtā ||41 ||
kiṃ tajjñānaṃ mayā grāhyaṃ sārabhūtaṃ vadātra me |
sarvadānaṃ hyanaśanaṃ tīrthasnānaṃ vrataṃ tapaḥ |||42||
ajñāne jñānadānasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm |
pituḥ śataguṇā mātā mātuḥ śataguṇo guruḥ | |43 | |
iti śrutvā yamaḥ prāha bhaktiste cāstu keśave |
śeṣaḥ sahasravaktraiśca nahi yāṃ vaktumīśvaraḥ ||44||
śaṃbhuḥ pañcamukhaiścāpi brahmā caturmukhaistathā |
kārtikaḥ ṣaṇmukhaiścāpi nahi yāṃ vaktumīśvarāḥ ||45||
sarasvatī gaṇeśaśca sanatkumāra ityapi |
dharmaḥ sanakaḥ sanandaḥ kapilaśca sanātanaḥ ||46||
sūryaḥ patnīvrataścāpi nārado brahmaṇaḥ sutāḥ |
na yāṃ vaktuṃ kṣamāḥ siddhā munīndrā yoginastathā ||47||
ke vānye ca vayaṃ ke ca bhagavadbhaktivarṇane |
kaścit kiñcid vijānāti bhagavadguṇakīrtanam ||48||
tataḥ kiñcid vijānāti brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ |
tataḥ kiñcidvijānāti gaṇeśo jñānināṃ guruḥ ||49||
sarvātiriktaṃ jānāti sarvajñaḥ śaṃbhureva tu |
tato’pyadhikaṃ jānāti lakṣmīreva na saṃśayaḥ ||1.371.50||
rādhā prabhā māṇikī ca pārvatī ca jayādayaḥ |
jānantyeva parāṃ bhaktiṃ muktā jānantyasīmataḥ ||51 ||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇenaiva puruṣottamarūpiṇā |
śrīkṛṣṇe svasvarūpe ca jñānaṃ sarvaṃ surakṣitam ||52||
dattaṃ tu śaṃbhave jñānaṃ kṛṣṇena paramātmanā |
atīva nirjane ramye goloke rāsamaṇḍale ||53||
dharmāya kathayāmāsa śivaloke śivaḥ svayam |
dharmastatkathayāmāsa puṣkare bhāskarāya ca ||54||
sūryo māṃ kathayāmāsa kṛṣṇabhaktyādikīrtanam |
pūrṇaṃ sopi na jānāti tadanyasya tu kā kathā |||55||
sarvāntarātmā bhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ |
sarvasākṣī sarvarūpī sarvakāraṇakāraṇam |||56||
rūpaṃ vidhatte yugalaṃ bhaktānugrahahetave |
kamanīyaṃ sundaraṃ ca kiśoraṃ ghanarūpakam ||57||
koṭikandarpalāvaṇyaṃ śṛṃgārarasasaṃbhṛtam |
padmapatraprabhānetraṃ pārvaṇendusamānanam ||58 ||
bhūṣāratnadharaṃ pītāmbaraṃ rādhādisevitam |
rāsamadhye ratnasiṃhāsanasthaṃ vaṃśikādharam ||59||
vanamālākaustubhādiśobhitaṃ sasmitaṃ varam |
kuṃkumāgurukastūrīcandanādisamarcitam ||1.371.60 ||
cārucampakamālābjamālatīmālyamaṇḍitam |
caṃcatsūkṣmātitejasvicūḍāvaktrimarājitam ||6 1 ||
brahmaviṣṇuśivā aniruddhapradyumnakarṣaṇāḥ |
sṛṣṭiṃ puṣṭiṃ saṃhṛtiṃ ca prakurvanti yadājñayā ||62||
yatprasādād vāti vātastapataḥ sūryacandrakau |
varṣatīndro mahākālaḥ karoti kavalaṃ tathā ||63||
vahniruṣṇo jalaṃ śītaṃ yatkṛtaṃ sarvameva tat |
diśo rakṣanti dikpālā grahā bhramanti yadbhayāt ||64||
vṛkṣāḥ phalanti puṣpyanti ṛtavaḥ kramagrāminaḥ |
sthale jale tathākāśe jīvanti jantavastathā ||65||
yadājñayā yamo nyāyapradātā dharmado vṛṣaḥ |
jvaladagnau patataśca gabhīre ca jalārṇave ||66||
vṛkṣāgre tīkṣṇakhaḍgāgre sarpādīnāṃ mukheṣu ca |
nānāśastrāstrasaṃgrāme raṇeṣu viṣameṣu ca ||67||
yatprasādādbhavedrakṣā yatkopānnāśanaṃ tathā |
dhatte vāyuranalāgnimanalo vārisāgarān ||68||
vāri kūrmaṃ mahākūrmo’nantaṃ sarpaṃ sa medinīm |
sā samudrānparvatām̐śca yatkṛpayā sa gīyatām ||69||
indrāyuścāpi divyānāṃ yugānāmekasaptatiḥ |
aṣṭāviṃśacchakrapāte brahmaṇaḥ syādaharniśam ||1.371.70||
evaṃ triṃśadrātridinairmāso dvābhyāmṛtustathā |
ṛtubhiḥ ṣaḍbhirevābdaṃ śatābdaṃ brahmaṇo vayaḥ ||71||
brahmaṇastu nipāte vai vairājasya dinaṃ bhavet |
vairājaśatavarṣāṇi mahāviṣṇordinaṃ bhavet ||72||
mahāviṣṇoḥ śatavarṣaṃ dinaṃ prādhānapauruṣam |
tasya varṣaśataṃ syāttu dinaṃ prākṛtapauruṣam ||73||
tasya varṣaśate cakṣuḥpakṣmonmelo harerbhavet |
so’yaṃ hariḥ svayaṃ śrīśaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||74||
viṣṇurbrahmā haraḥ sarve kṛṣṇātmakā na saṃśayaḥ |
cakṣurnimīlane tasya layaḥ prākṛtiko bhavet ||75||
prākṛtākṛtayaḥ kṛṣṇe līyante nābhipaṃkaje |
viṣṇuḥ kṣīrodaśāyī ca vaikuṇṭhe yaścaturbhujaḥ ||76||
līyante vāmapārśve te kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ |
śivo jñāne harerlīno durgā buddhau layaṃ vrajet ||77||
skando līno vakṣasi śrīkṛṣṇabāhau gaṇeśvaraḥ |
padmā rādhā ca gopyaśca kṛṣṇaprāṇe layaṃ gatāḥ ||78||
sāvitrī tu sarasvatyāṃ sā jivhāyāṃ parātmanaḥ |
kṛṣṇalomasu gopāśca prāṇeṣu pavanādayaḥ ||79||
hutāśano jaṭharāgnau jalaṃ tadrasanāgrake |
vaiṣṇavāścaraṇāmbhoje bhaktidharmau hṛdantare ||1.371.80||
īśvarā yasya vai mūrteraiśvaryāṇi bhavanti hi |
yasyaiva lomakūpeṣu viśvāni nikhilānyapi ||8 1 ||
yasya cakṣurnimeṣeṇa bhāvakāryalayo bhavet |
cakṣurunmīlane sṛṣṭiryasyaiva paramātmanaḥ ||82||
evaṃ sṛṣṭilayānāṃ tu saṃkhyā nāstyeva suvrate |
tadgaṇotkīrtanaṃ vaktuṃ brahmāṇḍeṣu tu kaḥ kṣamaḥ ||83 ||
pradhānā tu harerbhaktirmukterapi garīyasī |
kartavyā sā layapāraṃ gantumicchasi cet sute ||84||
sālokyadā harerekā cānyā sārūpyadā hareḥ |
sāmīpyadā tato’nyā ca sārṣṭidā ca tato’parā ||85||
ekatvaprāpikā tvanyā bhaktā vātrcchanti naiva tāḥ |
sevanaṃ tu parityajya vāñcchanīyaṃ na vai kvacit ||86 ||
muktistu sevārahitā bhaktiḥ sevāvivardhinī |
bhaktiyuktyorayaṃ bhedo bhaktiḥ kāryā tataḥ sadā ||87||
śarīreṇendriyaiḥ sarvairantaḥkaraṇaiḥ sarvathā |
kriyā buddhyarpaṇaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe hi mokṣakṛt ||88||
nāryā puṃsā samarpyaiva kāryā sevā hareḥ sadā |
snehena sarvathā devi jñānaṃ sārataraṃ tvidam ||89||
gaccha sāvitri patinā sākaṃ ca sukhinī bhava |
ityuktvā sūryaputraśca hyarpayitvā ca tatpatim ||1.371.90||
tasyai śubhāśiṣaṃ datvā gamanaṃ kartumudyataḥ |
dṛṣṭvā yamaṃ tu gacchantaṃ sāvitrī taṃ praṇamya ca ||91 ||
āvile cakṣuṣī kṛtvā dhṛtvā śiraḥ supādayoḥ |
viyogaśokaṃ prāptābhūt sadvicchedo hi duḥkhakṛt ||92||
kṛpālustu yamaḥ prāha mā śokaṃ kuru bhāmini |
lakṣavarṣaṃ sukhaṃ bhuktvā puṇyakṣetre ca sarvathā ||93 ||
naranārāyaṇakhaṇḍe golokaṃ yāsyasi dhruvam |
gatvā gṛhaṃ vrataṃ bhadre sāvitryāstvaṃ tathā kuru ||94||
dvisaptavarṣaparyantaṃ nārīṇāṃ mokṣadaṃ hi tat |
jyeṣṭhe śuklacaturdaśyāṃ sāvitryā hi vrataṃ kuru ||95||
śuklāṣṭamyāṃ bhādrapade mahālakṣmyā vrataṃ kuru |
dvyaṣṭavarṣavrataṃ cedaṃ pratyabdaṃ pakṣameva hi ||96 ||
kārtikakṛṣṇakāṣṭamyāṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇavratam |
kuru bhaktyā parayā tvaṃ yāsyasyante hareḥ padam |||97||
pratimaṃgalavāre ca devīṃ maṃgalacaṇḍikām |
pratimāsaṃ śuklaṣaṣṭhyāṃ ṣaṣṭhīṃ maṃgaladāyinīm ||98||
rādhāṃ cāṣāḍhasaṃkrāntyāṃ pūrṇāyāṃ kārtike’pi tām |
pratimāsaṃ sitāṣṭamyāṃ durgāṃ durgātināśinīm |||95||
yā nārī pūjayed bhaktyā kaṃbharāṃ sukhadāṃ satīm |
śuklāṣṭamyāṃ tathā prītyā sā yāti paramāṃ gatim || 1.371.100 ||
dhanasantānalabdhyarthaṃ patiputravatīṃ satīm |
pativratāsu śuddhāsu yantreṣu pratimāsu ca || 101 ||
pūjayamānā sukhinī bhūtvānte’kṣaramāpnuyāt |
ityuktvā tāṃ satīṃ natvā yamarājo yayau gṛham || 1 02||
gṛhītvā svāminaṃ sūkṣmaṃ sāvitrī svālaye yayau |
satyavānutthito drāgvai jīvito’bhūt suṣuptitaḥ || 103 ||
ānandaḥ sarvathā tatra samabhūt| pattane gṛhe |
sāvitrī satyavantaṃ ca vṛttāntaṃ tu yathākramam || 1 04||
anyām̐śca kathayāmāsa śrutvāścarya yayuśca te |
sāvitrījanakaḥ putraśataṃ prāpa yathākramam || 1 056||
śvaśuraścākṣuṣī rājyaṃ prāpadāridrathanāśakam |
sā ca satyavataḥ putraśataṃ prāpa krameṇa ca || 106 ||
evaṃ lakṣmi pātivratyaprabhāveṇa satīvarā |
mṛtyuparājayaṃ cakre pratyuta prāpa sampadam || 1 07||
pātivratyaṃ pālitaṃ cet kāmadhenusamaṃ hi tat |
kalpavṛkṣasamaṃ cāpi cintāmaṇyadhikaṃ tathā || 1 08||
yogināṃ yogasampatteḥ pātivratyaṃ viśiṣyate |
na caurahāryaṃ na kleśyaṃ na viyojanadharmakam || 1 09||
sadātmani dṛḍhe dharme sthitaṃ nigūḍhameva tat |
sā tu bhuktvā sukhaṃ lakṣavarṣaṃ bhūmau mahāsatī || 1.371.11 0||
jagāma svāminā sārdhaṃ golokaṃ divyarūpiṇī |
vaihāyasā vimānena yayau devaiḥ suvanditā || 111 ||
dvitīyena svarūpeṇa savituścādhidevikā |
vedānāṃ cāpi sāvitrī mantrādhiṣṭhātṛdevatā || 1 12||
saiva jātānantarūpā puruṣottamabhaktitaḥ |
iti te kathita lakṣmi sāvitryākhyānamuttamam || 11 3||
yā cedaṃ śṛṇuyānnārī satītvaṃ tvāpnuyād dhruvam |
pātivratyaṃ vinā tvanyaṃ dharmaṃ mukhyaṃ na vai caret || 1 14||
sarvaṃ patipratimāyāṃ muktirbhaktiśca vidyate |
sarvāśca siddhayaḥ patyurbhaktau tiṣṭhanti dāsikāḥ || 1 15||
aiśvaryāṇi samagrāṇi dhanadhānyāmbarāṇi ca |
svarṇaraupyamaṇiratnābharaṇāni ca sarvathā || 1 16||
patyuḥ pādajale santi patyaṃguṣṭhe samṛddhayaḥ |
patyānane mahadbrahma patyaṃgeṣu sukhāni vai || 1 17||
patyustoṣe mahātoṣaṃ ānandaḥ patikhelane |
patyurhaste mahālakṣmīḥ patyudare svaravyayam || 1 18||
patyurnāḍyāṃ ca tīrthāni patiprāṇe hi mokṣaṇam |
dharmārthakāmamokṣāśca patyurdehe vyavasthitāḥ || 11 9||
tasmāllakṣmi parabrahma patireva satīkṛte |
patiḥ kṛṣṇaḥ patiḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ || 1.371.1 20||
patirviṣṇurvāsudevaḥ patiḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ |
sarve devāstathā vedā yajñā japāśca mālikāḥ || 121 ||
dakṣiṇādānarītayo jñānāni vividhāni ca |
yogāḥ paropakārāśca tathāhiṃsādayaḥ śubhāḥ || 122||
śubhakarmāṇi kāryāṇi pūjā vratāni sarvathā |
snānāni coparāgāśca saṃkrāntayaśca sarvathā || 123 ||
puṇyāhāni ca sarvāṇi tathotsavāḥ śubhāni ca |
vaivāhikāni kāryāṇi daivāni cetarāṇyapi || 1 24||
yātrāśca devayānāni santi lakṣmi patiprabhau |
patireva paraṃbrahma jñātvā bhajetpativratā ||125||
etasya paṭhanāccāpi śravaṇāt kīrtanācca vā |
smaraṇānmānanāccāpi bhuktirmuktiḥ kare sthitā || 126 ||
patyurdharmānnānyadharmaḥ satyāścātra viśiṣyate |
satīdharmaḥ parodharmo hareḥ sevātmako hi saḥ || 127||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye ṣaḍaśītinarakakuṇḍaparimāṇāni, sāvitryai yamaproktaṃ jñānabhaktyādikaṃ, satyavato jīvanaṃ, patidharmaśraiṣṭhyaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikasaptatyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ |||371 | |

<1.372>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi ca padmāyāścaritraṃ pāpanāśakam |
anaraṇyasya putryāstaddharmaśāpātmakaṃ śubham || 1 ||
pātivratyaṃ pālayantyā pitrājñāvartamānayā |
padmayā yugabhedena dharmahrāsaḥ kṛtaḥ purā || 2 ||
jātamātraṃ yauvanaṃ ca tayaiva viphalīkṛtam |
bālyaṃ kumāratā paścād yauvanaṃ vṛddhatā tataḥ || 3 ||
ityādikaṃ tayā loke kṛtaṃ lakṣmi kramāgatam |
manuvaṃśodbhavo rājā so’naraṇyo mahāyaśāḥ || 4 ||
ciraṃjīvī dharmaśīlo vaiṣṇavo vijitendriyaḥ |
maṃgalāraṇyaputraḥ sa indrasāvarṇivaṃśajaḥ || 5 ||
dharāraṇyasya putro’bhūnmaṃgalāraṇya eva ha |
aputrako dharāraṇyastapase puṣkaraṃ gataḥ || 6 ||
suciraṃ ca tapastaptvā varaṃ labdhvā pareśvarāt |
samprāpto vaiṣṇavaṃ putramanaraṇyaṃ jitendriyam || 7 ||
datvā tasmai sa rājyaṃ svaṃ jagāma tapase vanam |
anaraṇyastataścakre bhṛguṇā tu purodhasā || 8 ||
yajñānāṃ śatakaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tasthau vairāgyavṛttikaḥ |
tucchaṃ matvā ca śakratvaṃ na lebhe naśvaraṃ padam || 9 ||
babhūvuḥ śataputrāśca sarve pitṛsamā guṇe |
kanyaikā sundarī ramyā padmā padmālayāsamā || 1.372.1 0||
tasyā yogyavarānveṣaṇārthaṃ yatnaṃ cakāra saḥ |
tāvat tapovane pippalādarṣistatra nirjane || 11 ||
strībhiḥ ramantaṃ gandharvaṃ dṛṣṭvā vai kāmuko’bhavat |
athāyaṃ puṣpabhadrāyāṃ snātuṃ gacchanmunīśvaraḥ || 12||
dadarśa padmāṃ yuvatīṃ padmāvatārarūpiṇīm |
manoramāṃ vilokyaiva dārasaṃgrahabhāvanaḥ || 1 3||
keyaṃ kasyeti papraccha samīpasthām̐stapasvinaḥ |
te ca nivedanaṃ cakruḥ padmānaraṇyajā tviti || 14||
muniḥ snātvābhīṣṭadevaṃ sampūjya puruṣottamam |
jagāma kāmī bhikṣārthamanaraṇyasabhājire || 15||
rājā dṛṣṭvā muniṃ śīghraṃ praṇanāmātibhaktitaḥ |
madhuparkādikaṃ datvā pūjayāmāsa sādaram || 16||
munirvijñāpito rājñā yatheṣṭaṃ varaṇāya vai |
pippalādastadā padmāṃ yayāce kanyakāṃ śubhām || 17||
śrutvā maunī nṛpo jātaḥ kiñcinnirvaktumakṣamaḥ |
muniḥ prāha tadā taṃ vai dehi kanyāṃ nṛpottama || 18||
athavā bhasmasāt sarvaṃ kariṣyāmi kṣaṇena vai |
sarve babhūvurācchannā bhṛtyāśca munitejasā || 1 9||
śuśoca rājā rājñī ca dṛṣṭvā vṛddhaṃ jvarānvitam |
mahiṣyaḥ śuśucuḥ sarvā itikartavyatākṣamāḥ ||1.372.20 ||
kanyāmātā vilalāpa kanyāduḥkhaṃ vicintya vai |
tadvilokya pippalādo bodhayāmāsa bhūmipam ||2 1 ||
mahiṣīṃ nṛpaputrām̐śca bhṛtyām̐śca kanyakāṃ tathā |
adya vānyadivase vā dātavyā kanyakā bhavet ||22||
yasmai kasmai pradātavyā dehi viprāya me nṛpa |
satpātraṃ brāhmaṇādanyanna paśyāmi jagattraye ||23||
parāya viprādanyasmai naiva tvaṃ dātumarhasi |
sutāṃ datvā ca me rājan rakṣasva sarvasampadaḥ ||24||
kanyānimittaṃ sarvasvaṃ mā te bhasmagataṃ bhavet |
ityetadvākyamatyugraṃ śrutvā kanyāpi śobhanā |||25|||
piturhitaṃ cintayānā gauravaṃ tapasāmṛṣeḥ |
sarvasampadavighnatvaṃ prāha rājñe pradehi mām ||26||
tataḥ sālaṃkṛtāṃ padmāṃ rājā rājñī dadau mudā |
kāntāṃ prāpya pippalādo muditastapasā jvalan ||27||
darśayāmāsa rūpaṃ svaṃ yauvanaṃ yogakṛdbalāt |
aṣṭādaśasamāyogyaṃ kanyāyogyaṃ hi kāmadam ||28||
rājādayo’tisaṃhṛṣṭāḥ kanyā tutoṣa cāntare |
yautakaṃ ca tathā kāntāṃ gṛhītvā munirāḍ yayau ||29||
anaraṇyaḥ pūrṇamanā jagāma tapase tataḥ |
mano mokṣe dadhau tatra cintayan rādhikeśvaram ||1.372.3 0 ||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prāpya golokaṃ saṃjagāma ha |
kīrtyaraṇyo jyeṣṭhaputro rājyaṃ tasya cakāra vai ||3 1 ||
athānaraṇyasya kanyā siṣeve bhaktitaḥ ṛṣim |
karmaṇā manasā vācā lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ yathā ||32||
pātivratyaparā nityaṃ sevate śrīhariṃ yathā |
aṃgasaṃmardanaṃ muneḥ pādasaṃvāhanaṃ muhuḥ ||3 3 ||
kāmecchāpūraṇaṃ śaśvaccakre’nuvṛttimāśritā |
snātvā snāpayati bhuṃkte bhojayitvā dvijaṃ patim || 34
svāpayitvā svapityeva cānutiṣṭhati karmasu |
yathā vai tāpaso vṛddho rājaso’tha yuvā muniḥ |||35
prasannaḥ syāttathā sevāṃ karotyaharniśaṃ satī |
manyamānā svakaṃ bhāgyaṃ śreṣṭhācchreṣṭhatamaṃ sadā |||36
yadahaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ prāptāstatrāpi munitāpasam |
pavitraṃ puṇyarūpaṃ ca nārāyaṇasvarūpiṇam |||3 7
yoginaṃ cātmavettāraṃ kānyā dhanyā mayā samā |
pavitrāhaṃ sadā jātā hyarthitā ṛṣiṇā svayam || 38
mama bhāgyasya pāraṃ na puṇyapāraṃ na vidyate |
anekajanmapuṇyaiśca prāpyate bhagavānpatiḥ |||39
so’yaṃ sākṣāt kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo labdhaḥ patirmayā |
tasyaiva sevayā muktistasya toṣe’kṣaraṃ padam ||1.372.40
tasyaiva hṛdaye brahma brahma labdhaṃ mayā tataḥ |
nātra me mokṣaṇe tvanyatsādhanaṃ pariśiṣyate |||41 |
mama pitrā śubhaṃ dattā svastyastu janakasya me |
svastyastu mama mānuśca yāhaṃ jātā sukhānvitā ||42|
sarvaṃ labdhaṃ mayā tvatra pippalāde ṛṣīśvare |
jñānatṛptī ratitṛptirbhogatṛptiśca labhyate |||43 |
yaśastṛptiḥ khyātitṛptiḥ pūjātṛptiśca labhyate |
rājyabhāro duḥkhado’ti mahiṣītvaṃ tato’dhikam ||44|
mahiṣīṇāṃ na vai śāntiḥ pañjarapakṣiṇāṃ yathā |
dharmo’rthaḥ kāmanātraiva bhujyate sukhato mayā ||45 |
na tathā taptacittābhirmahiṣībhiḥ prabhujyate |
śubhaṃ jātaṃ tu yajjātaṃ sarvaṃ daivaṃ mayārjitam ||46 |
madyamāṃsādanṛpatikare na patitāsmyaham |
tadeva puṇyaṃ me cātra prahṛṣṭaṃ rakṣakaṃ mama ||47||
kumārikā na jānanti rājasyo rājapīḍanam |
paścāt patitvā śocanti vayaṃ kva niraye gatāḥ ||48||
sādhuśīlo devaguṇaḥ patiḥ sarvatra durlabhaḥ |
bhogako mārakaḥ śveva patiḥ sarvatra cāpyate ||49 ||
bhogairdehaṃ kṣapayati puṇyaṃ nāśayati tvaghaiḥ |
yamalokaṃ prāpayati sulabhastādṛśaḥ patiḥ ||1.372.5 0 ||
svārthamātraparo yaśca paralokāsahāyakṛt |
na patiḥ sa yathārtho’sti yadyogānnarakaṃ dhruvam ||5 1 ||
tasmādatra paratraiva cārdhāṃgamiva rakṣati |
sṛṣṭau mokṣe sukhe duḥkhe sahagāmī patiḥ patiḥ ||52||
etādṛśaṃ patiṃ prāpya yā na prasevate tu tam |
karmaṇā manasā vācā sā bhaved vañcitā sadā ||53||
kulasya guṇajālasya rūpasya buddhidharmayoḥ |
mānaṃ na sarvathā rakṣyaṃ patyagre kulayoṣitā ||54||
dehaṃ patirmanaḥ svāmī tvabhimānaṃ patirmama |
kāryakāraṇasaṃghātaṃ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ patirmama |||55||
bhojyaṃ bhogobhoktṛvṛttirbhogyaṃ sarvaṃ patirmama |
viśvāso varadānaṃ ca nyāsaścāpi patirmama ||56||
dīnatā śreṣṭhitā sthairyaṃ cānukūlyaṃ patirmama |
vrataṃ dharmastathā puṇyaṃ tīrthaṃ dānaṃ patirmama ||57||
svādhyāyapāṭhapūjāśca sandhyādharmaḥ patirmama |
utsavaśca samājaśca pradarśanaṃ patirmama ||58||
yānaṃ ca nāṭakaṃ ramyaṃ nṛtyaṃ gānaṃ patirmama |
bhavanaṃ rājyasamṛddhirgajavājaṃ patirmama ||59||
gururbrahmā haro viṣṇuḥ sarve devāḥ patirmama |
vaiśvadevo’titheḥ pūjā prāghūrṇikaḥ patirmama ||1.372.6 0 ||
garbhaḥ putro ratiḥ prītirnaiḥśreyasaṃ patirmama |
dhāma kṣetraṃ dharā rājyaṃ yatsarvasvaṃ patirmama ||6 1 ||
niṣedhaśca vidhiścāpi svairiṇītvaṃ patirmama |
iti tṛptiṃ parāṃ matvā sevāṃ karomi vai ṛṣeḥ ||62||
evaṃ nityānandatṛptā lakṣmi sā rājakanyakā |
siṣeve tamṛṣiśreṣṭhaṃ sākṣānnārāyaṇaṃ yathā ||6 3 ||
tasyā dharmaparīkṣārthaṃ dharmadevo hyacintayat ||
kīdṛśīyaṃ pātivratyaparā vartata eva nu ||64||
ekadā svarṇadīṃ snātuṃ prayātāṃ sasmitāṃ satīm |
dadarśa pathi dharmastu māyayā nṛpaliṃgakaḥ ||65||
svarṇaratnarathārūḍhaḥ svarṇaratnādibhūṣitaḥ |
navayauvanarūpāḍhyaḥ kāmadeva ivāparaḥ ||66||
surūpāṃ sundarīṃ dṛṣṭvā padmāmuvāca māyayā |
aho surūpā kānteyaṃ kva ca kva jarjaro muniḥ ||67||
ayi sundari lakṣmīva rājayogye’ti sūjjvale |
prakṛṣṭayauvanasthe ca kāmagarvahare śubhe ||68||
jarādagdhasya vṛddhasya samīpe kiṃ virājase |
kāṣṭhapāṣāṇatulyasyāsthimātraśeṣitasya ca ||69||
rājayogyāsi rājendri rājase rājavakṣasi |
candanāguruliptāṃgā svarṇaratnādibhūṣitā ||1.372.70||
dāsadāsīśatairyuktā sukhinī bhava sundari |
vipraṃ tapaḥkṛśaṃ śuṣkaṃ brahmonmukhaṃ kṣiṇāyuṣam ||71 ||
vihāya paśya rājendraṃ ratau śūraṃ bhuvāṃ patim |
svargasukhasmṛddhaṃ samāvasthaṃ ca mādṛśam ||72||
kiṃ parṇakuṭyāṃ sukhamasti kiṃcit,
kiṃ kaṃdhare pakṣijaṭe’sti saukhyam |
kiṃ cāsthibhastrāmavalambase tvam,
āyāhi cintāmaṇiracyute’tra ||73||
prāpnuhi cinmaṇimacyute mayi,
tvaṃ kalpavallī bhavasīti saṃvṛṇe |
ratnaṃ pinaddhaṃ kanake praśobhate,
na śaṃkhayogye khalu pāśave gale ||74||
prāpnoti sundaraṃ puṇyāt saundaryaṃ pūrvajanmataḥ |
saphalaṃ tadbhavet sarvaṃ rasikāliṃganena tu ||75||
yathā kāntā tathā kāntaṃ kāmakāryaviśāradam |
kiṃkaraṃ kuru māṃ kānte sarvaṃ dāsyāmi te’naghe ||76||
sajalo nirjane ramye vane’raṇye ca parvate |
nadyāṃ nade samudyāne puṣpite gandhaśālini ||77||
yāne vimāne sāmrājye malaye raivate girau |
anye candanavṛkṣāḍhye vihariṣyāmi vai tvayā ||78||
kāmajvarapradagdhāyāḥ śāntiṃ kartumahaṃ kṣamaḥ |
viharasva mayā sārdhaṃ janmedaṃ saphalaṃ kuru ||79||
ityuktavantaṃ rājānaṃ kare gṛhītumutsukam |
nikaṭaṃ tu samāyāntaṃ dharmaṃ prāha pativratā ||1.372.80||
dūraṃ gaccha gaccha dūraṃ pāpacintāparo hyasi |
māṃ cet spṛśasi kāmena sadyo bhasma bhaviṣyasi ||8 1 ||
ahaṃ vivāhitā nārī pippalādarṣibhāminī |
pativratā na paśyāmi hṛdāpi vai narāntaram ||82|||
kathaṃ spṛśāmi pāpāṃśaṃ strījitaṃ lampaṭaṃ nṛpam |
adharmisparśamātreṇa sarvaṃ puṇyaṃ vinaśyati ||83||
paranārīṃ prasahyātra dharṣituṃ tvaṃ samudyataḥ |
na bhūmau pātakī tvādṛganyo bhavati bhūpatiḥ ||84||
ahaṃ brāhmaṇapatnyasmi tatra vṛddhatapasvinaḥ |
tāṃ mātaraṃ strībhāvaṃ kṛtvā yena bravīṣi mām ||85||
bhaviṣyati kṣayaste’tra dharṣiturmama śāpataḥ |
kṣayaṃ yāhi dhruvaṃ rājan hṛdā pāpena karmaṇā ||86||
śrutvā dharmaḥ satīśāpaṃ nṛparūpaṃ vihāya tu |
dharmadevaḥ svayaṃ bhūtvādṛśyata prāha tāṃ ca saḥ ||87||
mātarjānīhi māṃ dharmaṃ dharmajñānāṃ gurorgurum |
parastrīmātṛbuddhiṃ ca kurvantaṃ lokarakṣakam ||88||
ahaṃ tavāntarvijñātuṃ samāgato’smi padmike |
parīkṣituṃ rājarūpaṃ dhṛtavānasmi dhārmike ||89||
tathāpi svakṛtaṃ kiñcidakarmaṃ bhuṃjate janāḥ |
mayā kṛtaṃ cāvamānaṃ tava vākyaistu niṣṭhuraiḥ ||1.372.90||
tatphalaṃ saṃprabhoktavyaṃ mayā nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ |
kṛtaṃ me damanaṃ tvatra na viruddhaṃ yathocitam ||91 ||
sarvathā me mṛtirmāstu sati tatprārthaye sadā |
śāstiḥ samutpathasyānāmīśvareṇa vinirmitā ||92||
śāsanaṃ tvatkṛtaṃ cāstu yathāsahyaṃ tu me sati |
padmovāca tadā dharma sākṣī tvameva dehinām ||93 ||
kathaṃ parīkṣituṃ tvetadrājarūpa dhṛtaṃ tvayā |
yannimittaṃ mayā śaptaścāparādho’bhavannu me ||94||
sādhvīśāpo na vai mithyā jāyate tu kadācana |
tava nāśe sṛṣṭināśo bhavedeva na saṃśayaḥ ||95 ||
tasmād yathā jīvanaṃ te śāpaśca sārthako bhavet |
tathā vadāmi dharmendra śṛṇu mānavabhedataḥ ||96 ||
satye jane catuṣpādo bhava tvaṃ dharma sarvathā |
tretāvyāptajane tvaṃ tripād bhava vṛṣa sarvathā ||97||
dvāparavyāptamanuje dvipādo dharma saṃbhava |
kalivyāptajane tvekapādaḥ śeṣe’stu te layaḥ ||98||
paśuprāye jaḍe dharma tvamācchanno bhaviṣyasi |
sāttvike pūrṇatā te’stu rājasādāvapūrṇatā ||9 9 ||
yadyat sthalaṃ tavādhāraṃ śrūyatāṃ vṛṣa vacmi tat |
haribhakteṣu sarveṣu vaiṣṇaveṣu viśeṣataḥ || 1.372.10 0||
sādhvīṣu sādhuṣu yatimuniṣu brahmacāriṣu |
pativratāsu prājñeṣu vānaprastheṣu bhikṣuṣu || 101 ||
dharmaśīleṣu sarveṣu vaiśyakṣatriyajātiṣu |
dvijaseviṣu śūdreṣu satāṃ saṃge sthiteṣu ca || 1 02||
aśvaḥvaṭabilveṣu tulasīcandaneṣu ca |
dīkṣāparīkṣāśapathagoṣṭhagopadabhūmiṣu || 103 ||
vivāheṣu ca sarvatra puṣpeṣu vṛkṣajātiṣu |
devālayeṣu tīrtheṣu satāṃ geheṣu sarvadā ||1 04||
vedāmnāyavicāreṣu kṛṣṇakīrtanakāriṣu |
vratapūjātathonyāyayajñasākṣisthaleṣu ca || 105 ||
goprāṇiṣvatha haṃseṣu garuḍeṣu satīṣu ca |
kṛśatā tena bhavitā satyasthaleṣu sarvathā || 106 ||
kṛśatā tu tadanyeṣu sthaleṣu bhavitā śṛṇu |
puṃścalīṣu tu sarvāsu naraghātigṛheṣu ca || 1 07||
nīcamūrkhakhalanindāpareṣu ca śaṭheṣu ca |
devatāguruvipreṣṭapālyānāṃ dhanahāriṣu || 1 08|
dhūrteṣvasatsu duṣṭeṣu caureṣu vyavāyiṣu |
durodarasurāmāṃsakalahātikrameṣu ca || 1 09||
śālagrāmasādhutīrthakṣetrasevāpraghātiṣu |
dasyukarmaṇi garviṣṭe maṣījīvyasijīviṣu ||1.372.110 ||
bhartṛninditanārīṣu jīvahiṃsopajīviṣu |
dīkṣāsandhyādharmabhaktihīneṣu ca kalaṃkiṣu || 111 ||
kanyāyoṣitsuragranthavidyāvikrayiṣu nṛṣu |
mitradrohikṛtaghneṣu satyaviśvāsaghātiṣu || 112|
śaraṇāgatadīnāndhāśritaghneṣu mṛṣoktiṣu |
śaśvanmithyoktiśīleṣu tathā sīmāpahāriṣu || 113 ||
mithyāsākṣiṣu ca mithyānyāyadeṣu ca rājasu |
puṇyarodhiṣu sarveṣu na sthātuṃ śakyate tvayā || 1 14||
śuddhasāttvikaśānteṣu catuṣpāt tvaṃ sadā vasa |
sattvamiśrarajovṛddhau tripāt tvaṃ tritako vasa || 1 15 ||
rajomiśratamovṛddhau dvipāt tvaṃ dvāparo vasa |
tamomātrahṛdayeṣu tvekapāt tvaṃ kalirvasa || 116 ||
satyaṃṃ makhastapo dānaṃ catuṣpādāḥ purā tava |
ahiṃsādamanāstikyadānānyadya padāni te || 11 7||
bhāvikāle bhaviṣyanti śīlaṃ śaucaṃ ca sevanam |
kīrtanaṃ ceti pādāste kramāt hrāse tathā vasa || 118 ||
ityuktvā virarāmaināṃ dharma āśiṣa ādadau |
dhanyāsi patibhaktāsi svasti te’stu hi santatam || 119||
yuvā bhavatu bhartā te rūpavān sthirayauvanaḥ |
cirajīvī bhavatveva mārkaṇḍeyādato’dhikam || 1.372.120 ||
dhanaiśvaryavatī tvaṃ ca saṃbhava sthirayauvanā |
mātā tvaṃ daśaputrāṇāṃ bhava saṃcirajīvinām || 121 ||
śrutvā padmā vṛṣaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā praṇamya ca |
yayau svaṃ mandiraṃ sādhvī dharmo’pi svasthalaṃ yayau || 1 22||
prativratāṃ praśaśaṃsa pratisaṃsadi saṃsadi |
pativratāpi sā padmā pātivratyabalāt khalu || 123 ||
śataputravatī jātā sarvasaubhāgyasaṃbhṛtā |
evaṃ pativratā nārī dharmaṃ hantuṃ ca rakṣitum || 1 24||
svayameva samarthāsti ko’nyastāṃ dharṣayejjanaḥ |
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi padmāyā vai kathānakam || 1 25||
dharmapuṣṭikaraṃ śaśvatpātivratyabalapradam |
svargamokṣapradaṃ cāpi sarvadharmapradaṃ tathā || 126 ||

bhaktyā śṛṇuyānnārī pātivratye dṛḍhā bhavet || 1 27||
śroturvaktustathā rakṣāṃ dhruvaṃ dharmo vidhāsyati |
pātivratyaṃ prapattiśca samāno dvau vṛṣau sadā || 1 28||
ekenaivāpnuyātsarvaṃ dvitīyāpekṣaṇaṃ nahi |
yatrobhau tatra vai lakṣmi kimu vaktavyamātmanā || 1 29||

dāsyaṃ snaihyaṃ paraṃ labdhvā bhuktiṃ muktimavāpnuyāt || 1.372.13 0||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasahitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye’naraṇyaputryāḥ pativratāyāḥ padmāyāḥ pippalādena lagnaṃ, dharmakṛtaparīkṣāyāṃ dharmasya śāpaścatuṣpādānāṃ kālakrameṇa hrāsa ityādinirūpaṇanāmā dvāsaptatyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 372 ||

<1.373>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ te’pi pātivratyaparāyaṇām |
vaikuṇṭhe samabhūd yā vai garvanāśāya sarvathā || 1 ||
vaikuṇṭhādhipatiḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ svayam |
rājate sma sabhāmadhye naikapārṣadaveṣṭitaḥ || 2 ||
dāsadāsīvaiṣṇavaiśca sevitaḥ parameśvaraḥ |
akṣarādhipatervakṣaḥ sthalotpannā mahāsatī || 3 ||
sampatkartrī mahecchā śrīhareḥ saṃkalparūpiṇī |
lakṣmīḥ svāṃ muktarūpebhyo vilokyāntarvilakṣaṇām || 4 ||
prārthayāmāsa sarveśaṃ lajjayā śrīhariṃ tadā |
mama vāsasya yogyaṃ vai bhavanaṃ racaya prabho || |5 ||
yathāhaṃ pātivratyena siṣeve tvāṃ pareśvaram |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sākṣāt parātmā parameśvaraḥ || 6 ||
śrutvā yogyāṃ prārthanāṃ ca jñātvā nārīṃ svasevikām |
vaikuṇṭhaṃ racayāmāsa yugalārthaṃ navaṃ śubham || 7 ||
svayaṃ caturbhujo jāto mahālakṣmyabhilāṣayā |
patirūpaḥ parabrahma śaṃkhacakragadādimān || 8 ||
aṣṭādaśavayovarṣaḥ kamanīyo’tikāntimān |
sarvāṃgavīryasampūrṇo lakṣmīḥ ṣoḍaśavatsarā || 9 ||
kamanīyā patisevāyogyā muktātisundarī |
sustanī svānanā ramyā sumadhyā svarṇavarṇikā || 1.373.10 ||
sarvāṃgaśobhāsampūrṇā sarvasiddhisamāśritā |
sarvaiśvaryamahānandā saṃkalparūpadhāriṇī || 11 ||
kāminī ratikuśalā nārāyaṇaparāyaṇā |
sarvābharaṇaśobhāḍhyā divyavastrādibhūṣitā || 1 2||
sarvaśṛṃgārasaddravyacūrṇakajjalamaṇḍitā |
anaṃgaścābhavattasyāṃ dehābhinna iva sthitaḥ || 13 ||
tasyāḥ saṃkalpapūrttyarthaṃ nārāyaṇaścaturbhujaḥ |
caturbhujāṃ svakāṃ patnīṃ lakṣmīṃ nītvā yayau hariḥ || 14||
vaikuṇṭhaṃ svakṛtaṃ dhāma yatra nānyad dvayaṃ vinā |
tṛtīyaṃ vyaktirūpaṃ na yugalaṃ tatra modate || 15||
saṃkalpasiddhayastatra prodgatā vai sahasraśaḥ |
dāsikāstā mahālakṣmyāḥ sarvāḥ pañcadaśābdikāḥ || 16||
tāsāṃ kṛte kṛtāstatra saudhāścandrasamāḥ sukhāḥ |
svakṛte bhavanaṃ divyaṃ mandiraṃ ca kṛtaṃ navam || 17||
prākāro’tiviśālaśca pattanaṃ dīrghavistaram |
jalapuṣkariṇīvṛndaṃ cakāra tatra śrīhariḥ || 18||
nadān nadīstaḍāgāni vāṭikodyānabhūmikāḥ |
vihārāṇi vicitrāṇi rasaśālāśca dīrghikāḥ || 1 9||
bhojyaśālāstathā prasannatāśālā ratisthalīḥ |
sabhāsthale mahaddivyaṃ siṃhāsanaṃ parātparam ||1.373.20 ||
upakaraṇavastvāḍhyabhavanānāṃ tu paṃktikāḥ |
vinirmāya svayaṃ tatra modate yugalaṃ sadā ||21 ||
nārāyaṇo yadā lakṣmyā sākaṃ saṃtiṣṭhate gṛhe |
premamagnastadā dāsyaḥ samāgacchanti bhāvataḥ || 22||
bhagavatpremasampannā rajoratisamāhutāḥ |
vilāsārthaṃ samāgatyāśliṣyanti parameśvaram ||23 ||
haristu bahurūpāṇi dhṛtvā ramate tāsvapi |
mahālakṣmīścāpi tatra ramate bhavane svake ||24||
sahasrāyutasaṃkhyāsu samakāle hariḥ svayam |
ramate bahubhāvena koṭirūpadharaḥ prabhuḥ ||25||
evaṃ vaikuṇṭhabhavane vaikuṇṭhe pūrṇadhāmani |
nārāyaṇaṃ vinā nānyo naraḥ kaścitpravartate ||26 ||
koṭikoṭyastu dāsyaśca vartante sevikāḥ sadā |
tatraikadā hi sarvāsu sarvarūpadharo hariḥ ||27||
cakre vai ramaṇaṃ dāsīkoṭitṛptikaraṃ prabhuḥ |
mahālakṣmīḥ svabhavane nārāyaṇe pravalgitā ||28||
mahānande’timagnāsīt tallīneva tadābhavat |
tatraivāvasare nityā muktāḥ sanatkumārakāḥ ||29||
jñātvā yogabalenāpi vaikuṇṭhaṃ nūtanaṃ kṛtam |

akāladarśane nau vai vighnaṃ tu satataṃ bhavet ||1.373.40||

tadā lakṣmyā punaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ samarthitaḥ ||44||

nānyāṃ ratiṃ prajānāti harervaikuṇṭhavāsinaḥ |

śṛṃgārarasapuṣṭyarthaṃ karotyābhūṣitaṃ harim |

vrataṃ pūjā japo homaḥ paṭhanaṃ stotramityapi ||75||

śādvale puṣpagandhāḍhye mṛdule subhage sthale ||78||

sakhyo nārāyaṇo devaḥ sarveśvaro’pi sarvadā |
mamābhiprāyamāsādya karotyeva kriyāṃ sadā ||1.373.80||
mayā tu sevayā nātho vaśīkṛto’sti mādhavaḥ |

hikkānvitā prapaśyantu māṃ hi smarati keśava |
āyāsyati kṣaṇenātra yadvā gacchāma eva tam ||82||
