guṇināṃ saphalaṃ janma tvādṛśānāṃ nṛpātmaja || 144||
evamuktvā snāpayitvā śṛṃgārayitvā bhāvataḥ |
madhupānādisaṃbhogān dāpayitvādanaṃ tathā || 145||
tarpayitvānnapeyādyairviśrāntiśayanaṃ dadau |
sevārthaṃ nāgakanyāśca preṣayāmāsa nāgarāṭ || 146 ||
pariśrānto’tha nṛpajaḥ suṣvāpa sukhanidrayā |
sevayāmāsuratyarthaṃ kanyāḥ saṃvāhanādibhiḥ || 147||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye śatrujitputrasya ṛtadhvajasya aśvataranāgaputrābhyāṃ mitratā, daivivājiprāptiḥ, gālavāśrame vighnakartāraṃ daityaṃ hantuṃ pātāle praveśaḥ, sa tatra nagare madālasāmapaśyat, pātālaketuṃ daityaṃ jaghāna, madālasāmudvahat, tumburuṃ kuṇḍalāṃ cāpṛcchya svagṛhāgamanam, yamunātaṭe tālaketuṃ kapaṭinaṃ jaghāna, madālasāmaraṇam, kumāratapaścaryā, madālasāyā aśvataragṛhe’vataraṇam, ṛtadhvajamāhūya punarmadālasādānamityādinirūpaṇanāmā dvānavatyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||3 92||

<1.393>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
atha prātarnṛpaputraḥ ṛtadhvajaḥ sumaṃgalaiḥ |
vādyaiśca gītibhiścāpi pātālākhyānakaistathā || 1 ||
nāgakanyābhiratyarthaṃ miṣṭasvaraiḥ prabodhitaḥ |
snāpito’mbaritaḥ śṛṃgārito’rcito vibhūṣitaḥ || 2 ||
bhojitaḥ pāyitaścāpi susparśaiḥ raṃjito muhuḥ |
vijñāpitaśca bahudhā ratnādigrahaṇāya saḥ || 3 ||
rajataṃ vā suvarṇaṃ vā vastraṃ vāhanamāsanam |
yadvābhimatamatyarthaṃ grahaṇārthaṃ niveditaḥ || 4 ||
ṛtadhvajastadā prāhāśvataraṃ nāgayoginam |
tava prasādād bhagavan ratnādyasti gṛhe mama || 5 ||
tāte varṣasahasrāṇi śāsatīmāṃ vasundharām |
na nyūnaṃ vidyate kiñcitsvargamanyad gṛhe’sti me || 6 ||
tatrāpi sāttvatānāṃ tu tṛṇavanmāyikaṃ khalu |
tatra lubdhā janā nūnaṃ dhātṛmāyāsuvaṃcitāḥ || 7 ||
tavānayā sumadhurayā vāṇyā satkṛtiśīlayā |
kṛtakṛtyo’smi bhāvena saphalaṃ jīvanaṃ tu me || 8 ||
pitrā vai jīvanaṃ sārthaṃ mātrā ca jīvanaṃ sukham |
ārogyeṇa ca rājyena vṛddhānāṃ sevayā tathā || 9 ||
tvādṛśānāṃ kṛpābhiśca jīvanaṃ sārthakaṃ mama |
aśvatarastadā prāha gārhasthyaṃ bhāryayā sukham ||1.393.1 0||
tat tavāsti na vā saumya vada kiṃ brahmavānasi |
iti pṛṣṭaḥ samuvāca bhāryā mama pativratā || 11 ||
sutā gandharvarājasya nāmnā khyātā madālasā |
kenāpi kṛtavaireṇa vipralabdhātyajat tanum || 1 2||
tata ārabhya loke me pratijñāṃ kṛtavānaham |
nānyā bhāryā bhavitrī me varjayitvā madālasām || 13 ||
ityārabhya sadā cāsmi brahmacaryavratānvitaḥ |
brahmacaryeṇa vai lokā vairājāḥ santi nirmitāḥ || 14||
muktiloko brahmacaryaparasyāsti vinirmitaḥ |
mānuṣasya janerlābhaḥ saṃhitāyāṃ prapaṭhyate || 15||
sa lābho’sti madarthaṃ vāpyekapatnīvratasya ca |
aśvatarastadā prāha śṛṇu rājakumāraka || 16 ||
bhāgyena vardhase nityaṃ caikapatnīvratena vai |
pātivratyena te patnī saubhāgyena pravardhate || 17||
yā sā madālasā rājñī śrutvā patyurvināśanam |
samādhinā layaṃ prāptā gatā svaryāmyakaṃ puram || 18||
patimanveṣituṃ naijaṃ dharmarājaśca tāṃ jagau |
patiste vartate sādhvi jīvito yamunātaṭe || 1 9||
yogāyāśvatarastasya yatate tiṣṭha vai kṣaṇam |
ityuktā soṣitā tatra mayā taptvā harātkhalu ||1.393.20 ||
varadānaṃ paraṃ prāpya putrīrūpā tava priyā |
āsāditā divyarūpā jātamātrā sukāminī |||21 ||
tādṛśī tava yogyā ca pūrvaṃ yādṛśyabhūddhi sā |
tvadarthaṃ mānasī kanyā madgehe vartate satī ||22||
tubhyaṃ dānāya saumyātra mayāsti niścitaṃ yataḥ |
tasmāt paśyeha vatsa tvaṃ satīṃ ced draṣṭumicchasi ||23||
anugrāhyo bhavān gehaṃ bālo’pyabhyāgato guruḥ |
ityuktvā tvānayāmāsa tasya putrīṃ madālasām ||24||
prāha seyaṃ na vā vatsa bhāryā te yā madālasā |
sa dṛṣṭvā tāṃ sammukhaṃ drāk hṛṣṭaromā babhūva ha ||25||
ruroda pūrvāṃ saṃsmṛtya premapūritamānasaḥ |
aśvatarastadā kāmaphalaṃ baddhvā kare’sya vai ||26 ||
agniṃ prajvālya vidhivat kanyāratnaṃ dadau punaḥ |
prāpya bhāryāṃ satīṃ so’pi yautakaṃ ca dhanaṃ bahu ||27||
nāgakanyāstathānyāśca dāsīrdāsām̐śca sevakān |
maṇīn hiraṇyabhūṣām̐śca madālasāṃ navīkṛtām ||28||
pratilabhya praṇamyātha nāgeśaṃ śvaśuraṃ muhuḥ |
śālakau dvau samāśliṣya śvaśrū natvā tathāparān ||29|||
nirgataḥ svāyayau naijaṃ puraṃ yānena vāyunā |
āgamya svapuraṃ pitrornatvā sarvamaśeṣataḥ ||1.393.3 0 ||
kathayāmāsa tanvaṃgī punaḥ prāptā yathā tathā |
nanāma sā ca caraṇau śvaśrūśvaśurayoḥ satī ||3 1 ||
anyāṃśca pūjayāmāsa yathānyāyaṃ yathāvayaḥ |
tato mahotsavo jātaḥ paurāṇāṃ sarvathā priyaḥ ||32|||
ṛtadhvajaśca suciraṃ tayā reme sumadhyayā |
atha kālena mahatā śatrujinmaraṇaṃ gataḥ |||33 ||
ṛtadhvajo’bhavadrājā patnīvrataḥ sudhārmikaḥ |
madālasābhavad rājñī rājamātā pativratā ||3 4||
śatasāhasradāsīṣu satīṣvapi madālasā |
lakṣmīvat svapatiṃ nityaṃ siṣeve’ṅgakriyādiṣu ||35||
patiṃ matvā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇarūpaṃ hariṃ prabhum |
sampanmokṣakaraṃ nityasambaddhaṃ sevate sma sā || 36||
bhojayitvā sadā bhuṃkte vastu samarpya sevate |
yuṃkte sā ca svake kārye patiprāsādikaṃ sadā ||37||
prātardhyānaṃ hareḥ pūjāṃ dānaṃ cātmavimarśanam |
atitherbhojanaṃ datvā svātmārthaṃ yukta eva sā |||38||
brahmārpaṇaṃ brahmasevāṃ brahmadhyānaṃ tu sāttvatī |
mahābhāgavatī sādhvī niṣpādya vartate pare || 39||
divāniśaṃ harerlīlākīrtanaṃ sā karoti vai |
anyān śrāvayati hareścamatkārān muhurmuhuḥ ||1.393.40||
evaṃ vai vartamānāyāḥ saṃjajñe prathamaḥ sutaḥ |
tasya cakre pitā nāma vikrānta iti dhīmataḥ ||41 ||
tutuṣustena vai sarve jahāsa ca madālasā |
yasyā brahmasvarūpāyāṃ harṣaśokau samau yataḥ ||42||
putraṃ tu vikramaṃ sādhvī bālamuttānaśāyinam |
rudantamabhiśāntyarthamullāpanamiṣeṇa sā ||43||
smṛtvā hariṃ tathātmānaṃ nityaśuddhaṃ nirañjanam |
putraṃ muktaṃ dehadharmahīnaṃ prāha madālasā ||44||
śuddhaḥ svayaṃ brahmasurūpavānasi
prakalpitaṃ nāma ca te’dya kṛtrimam |
apūrvadehādikamāptavānasi
hyaśokano rodiṣi kasya śokavān ||45||
hānau sadā roditi dehadharmavān
sā na tvayi brahmanirañjane’sti vai |
sadāsi pūrṇo nijatṛptisaṃbhṛtaḥ
sadā prataptasya kathe nu rodanam ||46||
āgantukā ye tu guṇāḥ sukhādayo
niyojayantyeva tadiṣṭavedane |
tataḥ pravṛttau ca phale śubhāśubhe
asāracakre hi muhuḥ kṣipanti te ||47||
śāntāśca ghorāśca tathā pramūḍhā
dehā viśeṣāḥ parivarttayanti |
tadvegavegī guṇavegahīno
mamatvabhāk tāpavibharjitaḥ syāt ||48||
nānena dehena tu kiṃcidasti
prāptavyamarthaṃ na ca śāśvataṃ vā |
yenāsti labhyaṃ sa tu nityapūrṇaḥ
kathaṃ prapūrṇasya nu rodanaṃ te ||49||
labdhaṃ gataṃ sarvamanityametad
dṛṣṭaṃ mayā janmani cātra tatra |
gatisvabhāvaṃ puru naśvaraṃ ca
śokāspadaṃ tvaṃ nahi tādṛśo’si ||1.393.50||
āste jalaṃ jāyate vardhate ca
santiṣṭhati kṣīyate nāśameti |
ete tu dharmā hi bhūteṣu santi
na te kathaṃ kasya hānerhi śokaḥ ||51 ||
na te’sti vṛddhirna ca te’sti hānistādṛksvabhāve’tra na kaṃcuke tvam |
śokaṃ vrajethāḥ kuru cātmavittiṃ naisargikānandamayīṃ praśastim ||52||
tāteti kiñcit tanayeti kañcidambeti kāṃcid dayiteti kāṃcit |
mameti kiṃcinna mameti kiṃcid bhūtātmakaṃ mā tvayi mānayethāḥ ||53 ||
bhogaḥ sadā miśrita eva vartate
miṣṭastathāmiṣṭa iti pratītitaḥ |
vijñasya miṣṭe’pi na miṣṭatāsti vai
mūḍhasya duḥkhe’pi na duḥkhatāsti ca ||54||
ahaṃmametyasti kṛtaṃ navaṃ navaṃ
gataṃ gataṃ vakti na te’styahaṃmamaḥ |
vṛthā mataṃ duḥkhakaraṃ hi bālyataḥ
śīrṇe vikāre’pi na tad viyāsyati ||55||
cakṣuśca karṇaśca sunāsikā ca
mukhaṃ radāstvak śravaṇaṃ manaśca |
jihvā karau pat malamūtramārgau
nābhiśca nāmāni na te hi santi ||56||
kṣetrāṇi yadvat khalu mṛttikāyāḥ
sarāṃsi yadvat khalu sajalādyāḥ |
svargāṇi yadvat khalu tejaādyāḥ
prāṇāśca vātā na hi te tvadīyāḥ ||57||
yathātra yāne bahumārgagāmini
sacetanastvaṃ surathī pragacchasi |
tvadātmake divyacidambarānasi
tathaiva yantāsti tamacyutaṃ smara ||58||
idaṃ vapurgatvarameva te ca me pituśca tadvad gatameva tatpituḥ |
yathaivaṃ bhūtaṃ sadṛśaṃ tu bhāvinastatolabhasvāṅga vapustu śāśvatam ||59||
śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa rādhikāpate
ramāpate mādhava pārvatīpate |
lakṣmīpate bhaktapate prabhāpate’
raṭāṃga yacchāśvatamāpyase tanum ||1.393.60||
na te’sti nidrā na ca te’sti tandrā
na te’sti mātā na ca me’stiputraḥ |
na te’sti bālyaṃ na ca me’sti vṛddhiḥ
kramākramau brahmaṇi te na me ca ||6 1 ||
ātmeti jānanparamātmasevako
hṛdācitā vā manasā ca vijñayā |
ānandamagno’nubhave’parokṣake
kārṣṇaṃ rasaṃ cūṣati tṛptimaśnute ||6 2||
pṛthvyāṃ yathā santi sudolanāṃghrayo
doloparistaṃbhagatāḥ paṭāṃghrayaḥ |
paṭāntarāle caraṇau tava sthitau
svadantare yaccaraṇau hi taṃ bhaja ||63||
amūrtake mūrta iva sthitaḥ prabhuḥ
saṃrakṣako mokṣada īśvareśvaraḥ |
sa eva mātā ca pitā viśāladṛga
vikrāntanāmāpi sa eva taṃ bhaja ||64||
ātmāsi mukto’si sadīśvaro’si
brahmāsi divyo’si sadāsukho’si |
naro’si nārāyaṇarakṣito’si
nijasvarūpo’si bhajākṣareśam | |65 ||
vidvijñānamityuktaṃ krāntaṃkriyā matā tataḥ |
jñānakriyāyutaścātmā vikrāntaṃ tvaṃ nijaṃ vada ||66||
vipakṣī tasya vai pakṣau saṃkalpaḥ śaktirityamū |
saṃkalpaśaktipakṣābhyāṃ krāntastvaṃ svaṃ nijaṃ vada ||67||
viśca jñānendriyaṃ proktaṃ kraṃ ca karmendriyaṃ tathā |
tayorantargataścātmā vikrāntaṃ tvaṃ nijaṃ vada ||68||
ātmānaṃ tvaṃ vijānīhi dehagehavilakṣaṇam |
saccidānandameveśaṃ śokastvāṃ na spṛśet tataḥ ||69||
ityevaṃ prathamaṃ putraṃ bodhadānena sā satī |
muktaṃ kṛtavatī bālye yogirājaṃ kṛtārthakam ||1.393.70 ||
vardhamānaṃ sutaṃ nityaṃ navaṃ nūtnaṃ prabodhanam |
ātmajñānamayaṃ mātā dadātyullāpanādiṣu ||71 ||
nirahaṃkāratāṃ prāpto nirmamatvaṃ ca sarvathā |
ātmabalaṃ paraṃ lebhe jñānaṃ lebhe ca sanmayam ||72||
mātā sā jananī saiva yayā bālo’tibodhitaḥ |
muktimārgagataḥ syācca bandhādbhavācca mucyate ||73||
mātṛbhāṣāparibodhe tvātmabodhamavāptavān |
itthaṃ mātrā sa tanayo janmaprabhatibodhitaḥ ||74||
dehasaukhyātigo jāto virāgo viṣayāhataḥ |
yauvane’pi na rāgātmā dveṣaścāsya na kutracit| ||75||
strīpuṃbhāve kuṇape’trānitye duḥkhe vināśini |
bhogabuddhiranutpannā brāhmarūpeṇa vartinaḥ ||76 ||
rūpaṃ rasaṃ tathā gandhaṃ sparśaṃ ca śravaṇaṃ tathā |
anātmīyaṃ paraṃ matvā na babandhāpi tatra vai ||77||
kāye puṣṭe bale jāte balaṃ pāṣāṇavanmatam |
indriyāṇāṃ golakāni koṣṭhalānīva manyate ||78||
evaṃ rāgavihīnaḥ sa nirdvandvaḥ svasvarūpavān |
cakāra na matiṃ prājño gārhasthyaṃ prati nirmamaḥ ||79||
svaśarīre’nahaṃkāro rājye’haṃkāravarjitaḥ |
kṣetre hastini yāne ca vāhane rāṣṭrake tathā ||1.393.80 ||
snehabhāvavihīno’sau bandhanaṃ nāptavān kila |
dāseṣu bhṛtyavargeṣu dāsīṣu nagarīṣvapi ||8 1 ||
bhavaneṣu vastrabhūṣātibhogyavastukeṣvapi |
na vai cakre manaḥ kiñcinmuktavaryo yathābhavat ||82||
bhojane ramaṇe pāne khādye jaihvye’pi sarvathā |
rasāsvādavihīno’sau yatirāḍiva lakṣyate |||83 ||
ratnahārādibhūṣāsu gandhasugandhivastuṣu |
dravadravyeṣu tailādau kajjalādau virāgavān ||84||
pradarśaneṣu mallānāṃ krīḍāsu vārayoṣitām |
gītiṣu nartakīnāṃ ca nṛtyeṣu vimanā iva ||||85|||
rājñāṃ samāje cotsāhe prajotsaveṣu keliṣu |
araṇyādipravāse’pi mṛgayādau virāgavān ||86 ||
daṇḍadāneṣu hiṃsreṣu karmasu vyāhṛtau tathā |
vyavahāreṣu ca krūranirdayeṣu virāgavān ||87||
brahmacarye tathā śauce santoṣe tapasi dhruve |
svādhyāye devapūjāyāṃ sadā protsāhavānabhūt ||88||
satye sarvavidhe maune cāsteye mānase bahiḥ |
aparigrahaṇe cāpi dhairye kāmādivarjane ||89||
guroḥ prasevane pitroḥ sevane vṛddhamānane |
atithisvāgate bhaktadarśane mukta eva saḥ ||1.393.90||
śraddhāluḥ sarvadā cāste sarvathā cāstikaḥ kṛtiḥ |
vivekī ca vimokāḍhyo brahmābhyāsaparaḥ sadā ||91 ||
satāṃ sevāparaścāpi sadā harikriyāparaḥ |
kalyāṇakṛtprāṇināṃ ca harṣodvejanavarjitaḥ ||92||
evaṃ sanakatulyaḥ sa vyajāyata śiśutvataḥ |
dṛṣṭvā sutaṃ mahāmuktaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ paramaṃ samam ||93 ||
mātā cātīva jahṛṣe pitāpyānandavānabhūt |
prajā bhṛtyāstathā cānye menire devameva tam ||94||
aṇimā mahimā tvasya garimā laghimā tathā |
prāptiḥ kāmāvasānā ca vaśiteśitvarūpiṇī ||95||
śabdaūhaścādhyayanaṃ duḥkhanāśāstrayastathā |
suhṛtprāptirjñānadānaṃ tathā tārā sutārikā ||96||
sarvā āsan pādayośca siddhaḥ saḥ paramo hyabhūt| |
apratihatakāmaḥ sa mukto babhau sujātavat ||97||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye pātāle kṛtadhvajasya madālasālagnitasya pitṛrājyaṃ pratyāgamanaṃ, vikramākhyaputrajanma, tasmai madālasākṛtavivekopadeśa ityādinirūpaṇanāmā trinavatyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 393 ||

<1.394>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
atha lakṣmi dvitīyaṃ suṣuve putraṃ madālasā |
abhidhānaṃ pitā tasyākarot subāhurityataḥ || 1 ||
madālasā jahāsāpi nāmarūpavivarjite |
nāmarūpaṃ prasahyaiva svārthalokena ropyate || 2 ||
iyaṃ tu brahmavijñā taṃ bālamullāpanādibhiḥ |
upādideśa nityaṃ vai yathāpūrvaṃ nirañjane || 3 ||
śṛṇu putra śarīraṃ te bālarūpaṃ vyajāyata |
pūrvaṃ nāsīt tvadīyaṃ vai kathaṃ svīyaṃ pramanyase || 4 ||
śīryate taccharīraṃ hi muhuḥ śītoṣṇasaṃbhṛtam |
parādhīnakaraṃ nityaṃ sadā viśvāsaghātakam || 5 ||
pitā pūrvasthitaiḥ klṛptastasya dhātuḥ śarīragaḥ |
vinirgataḥ sa janmābhūd jalātmakasutasya vai || 6 ||
garbhavāse syitastasyāyuṣyaṃ tu daśamāsikam |
yadi tatra na tiṣṭhedvai tadāyuṣyaṃ kṣaṇaṃ matam || 7 ||
māsikaṃ ṣāṇmāsikaṃ vā srāve nyūnāṣṭamāsikam |
janmani labdhavatyeva cāyuṣyaṃ daśamāsikam || 8 ||
tato’syājñānasaṃyuktaṃ cāyuṣyaṃ mūrchanāmayam |
tato daśadināntaṃ ca sūtakātmakamucyate || 9 ||
māsānte varṣataḥ pūrvamāyuṣyaṃ pāravaśyagam |
varṣānte trivarṣapūrvamāyuṣyaṃ mātṛśikṣaṇam || 1.394.1 0||
tataḥ śiśuḥ kumāraścādvādaśābdaṃ sa kīrtyate |
tataḥ saumyastataḥ prauḍho yuvā cintāpradhānakaḥ || 11 ||
vidhuro vā sadhuro bā caikalo dvau tato’dhikaḥ |
śṛgālavat maṇḍalito’haṃmamatvasamāvṛtaḥ || 12||
śatrumitrakuṭumbādiyaśolābhādisaṃbhṛtaḥ |
atasmim̐stadvimantābhūddharṣaśokaparāyaṇaḥ || 13 ||
putrapautrādisambaddhaḥ paśukṣetrādicintanaḥ |
vaṃśavistārapāśena vāsanāmūlaropitaḥ || 14||
jarjaritena dehena vārdhakyaṃ samanuṣṭhitaḥ |
rogāśaktyādisampannaḥ śārīrājñāvivarjitaḥ || 1 5||
vātarogādibandhuścāpathyāvamānasevakaḥ |
tiraskārādisammāno gantukāmo’pi rodhitaḥ || 16 ||
mṛtaḥ prajvālitaḥ pretaḥ kvāsītkutra gataḥ sa vai |
tasmāt svapnaṃ yathā tadvad dehāyuṣyaṃ vivartate || 17||
matvaivaṃ tvaṃ sadā putra nāmarūpavivarjitaḥ |
saccidānandasaṃjño’si nityatṛpto nirāśayaḥ || 18||
vartasvānandamātrāyāṃ mā vartasva vivartane |
asāre nityaśuddhastvaṃ māśuddhiṃ mastake vaha || 1 9||
śuklo’si sarvadā putra mā kṛṣṇatvaṃ vahātmani |
śuddhadarpaṇatulyo’si kalmaṣaṃ mā niveśaya || 1.394.2 0 ||
ambeti kṛṣṇo janaketi kṛṣṇo’grajeti kṛṣṇo’hamameti kṛṣṇaḥ |
bāleti kṛṣṇaḥ svapareti kṛṣṇaḥ sarvasvakṛṣṇaṃ bhaja muktimehi ||26 1 ||
tejaḥ paraṃbrahma tamaḥ parabrahma
jñāna parabrahma cidambare’rpitam |
duḥkha parabrahma sukha parabrahma
svaya parebrahmaṇi vartase’rbhaka ||22||
na me’sti kiñcinna ca testi kiñcijjanūttaraṃ mānavakalpitaṃ hi tat |
asaṃgabālasya na saṃgamāha tīrṇo’si nityaṃ kuru cātmani śramam ||23 ||
śārīrayātrā ca yathā vinirvahet tāvatparigrāhaka eva saṃbhava |
tatrāpyasaṃgo bhava miṣṭayojanairhareḥ prasādāmṛtamiṣṭamāvaha ||24||
śuddhe nije saccidi saukhyasaṃbhṛte
mā duḥkhayogān viniyuṃkṣva bandhadān |
yathāsvarūpo viharasva vṛkṣake
samānake tricchidi yāvadastike ||25||
na te’sti bhāryā na ca te’sti saudho
na cāsti te hastisubhṛtyavāṭyaḥ |
na cāsti sainyaṃ na ca rakṣako’nyo
vinā hariṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaṃ vai || 26 ||
tvaṃ dehasaṃge’va satāṃ prasaṃgaṃ
tathātmasaṃge’va hareḥ prasaṃgam |
iṣṭe’tisaṃge’pi prabhuṃ vidhehi
śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇamābhajasva || 27| |
ityevaṃ sā mahārājñī bālamullāpanādibhiḥ |
aśikṣayaccātmavidyāṃ so’pi mukto babhūva ha || 28 ||
so’pyamanyata govindaṃ rakṣakaṃ bāhumeva ha |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇalabdhyā subāhu sva hi manyate || 29 ||
natu dehasthabāhubhyāṃ subāhuḥ sa viniścitaḥ |
mātāpi taṃ mahāmuktaṃ dṛṣṭvā tutoṣa vai hṛdi || 1.394.30 ||
amanyata mahāsādhvī mātṛtvaṃ sārthakaṃ svakam |
ātmapramāṇaṃ vijñānaṃ dadau yataḥ sutāya sā || 31 ||
pāpāt pāti pitā bodhyo mātā pramāṃ dadāsi yā |
tatsarvaṃ vartate rājñyāṃ madālasāyāṃ tṛptikṛt || 32 ||
atha kālāntare tasyā jajñe putrastṛtīyakaḥ |
rājā prāha ca taṃ putraṃ śatrumardanameva ha || 33 ||
tadā cātiprajāhāsa nāma smṛtvā punaḥ punaḥ |
taṃ cāpi sa satī mātā śikṣayāmāsa ciddhanam || 34||
pālane ca yadā taṃ sā hyāndolayati sādaram |
dugdhaṃ stanyaṃ tathā bhakṣyaṃ cośyaṃ lehyaṃ dadāti sā || 35 ||
tadā tadā prasaṃgena śikṣayati sma prokṣaṇam |
śṛṇu karṇena putra tvaṃ nahi karṇo’sti cetanaḥ || 36 ||
gṛhāṇedaṃ supeyaṃ tvaṃ mukhena jihvayā tathā |
na jihvā na mukhaṃ cāsi tvaṃ sadāsi pracetanaḥ || 37 ||
vada śabdaṃ paśya rūpaṃ kuru hāsyaṃ manoramam |
na tvaṃ śabdo na vai cakṣurna cāntaḥkaraṇaṃ hyasi || 38 ||
paśyedaṃ makṣikādaṃśakṛtaṃ daṃśādikaṃ tu yat |
tad dehe’sti na tvayyasti dehastyadāśrito’sti vai || 39 ||
tatroṣṇaṃ vā paraṃ śītaṃ kharjanaṃ viddhi raktakṛt |
tvaṃ na raktaṃ na vā dadrurna ca carmāsthikharjanam || 1.394.40 ||
tvayā sthitena tatsarvaṃ jāyate ca vilīyate |
na hrāsastena jātena na vā vṛddhirbhavet tvayi ||41 ||
pānaṃ peyaṃ kṣudhā tṛṭ ca bhojyaṃ cośyaṃ na vai tvayi |
tvayā sthitena tatsarvaṃ deho’yaṃ samapekṣate ||42 ||
vinā tvāṃ na tanūrnaiva kṣuttṛḍvyāpta pravartanam |
sarvaṃ layaṃ sameyādvai tasmāt tvaṃ sarvataḥ paraḥ ||43||
parārthaṃ gṛhavāṭyādi parārthaṃ jaladhānyakam |
parārthaṃ cākṣuṣaṃ sarvaṃ yaḥ paraḥ sa tvadātmakaḥ ||44||
jananaṃ maraṇaṃ nityaṃ vyavasthaṃ dehavāsitam |
avasthābhyaḥ parastvaṃ vai paramātmasamāśritaḥ ||45||
dehe tvaṃ ca tvayi kaścid yaḥ sa bodhyaḥ pareśvaraḥ |
pareśvarasamastvaṃ vai nityabuddho nirañjanaḥ ||46 ||
nityaśuddho nityasiddho nityavijño bhavātigaḥ |
idaṃ tu pālanaṃ svapnaṃ lālanaṃ svapnamityapi ||47||
hasanaṃ tarpaṇaṃ svapnaṃ jāgrato bhava sarvathā |
yoganidrā hareryoge sadā śāntipradā tava ||48||
bhoganindātmikā nidrā māyājālaṃ na sā tvayi |
aviśuddhiḥ kṣayaścāpi smṛddhāvatiśayaśca yaḥ ||49||
asūyāmatsarerṣyādikalmaṣāḍhyā na vai tvayi |
mukto nityaścātmasattaḥ pūrṇānando’si putraka ||1.394.50||
yathā vastraṃ navaṃ prāptaṃ tyaktaṃ jīrṇaṃ prasahya vai |
dinaṃ ca nūtanaṃ prāptaṃ gataṃ pūrvaṃ prasahya vai ||51 ||
prātargataṃ gataṃ sāyaṃ gatā cāndramasī niśā |
amāvasyāniśā māyā tāmasī cāpi te gatā ||52||
ghaṭamālānusāreṇa yadi sā te’ntikaṃ bhavet |
ātmavidyunmaye divyaprakāśe’vatarātmavit ||53 ||
kāmaḥ krodhastathā lobho moho mado’bhimānakam |
śatravaste nijabodhe tānpramardaya sarvathā ||54||
gatān vai mānvaśocastvaṃ vartamānān nivartaya |
anāgatāṃśca mā dehyātithyasatkaraṇaṃ manāk ||55||
ātmajñānātikhaḍgena chinnāste cāntarārayaḥ |
anudbhavāśca vāpuṣṭāḥ śuṣkāyante vinā jalam |||56 ||
dehasya śatravo loke na vai cātmani śatravaḥ |
ātmano mokṣaṇe vighnāḥ śatravaste prakīrtitāḥ ||57||
evaṃ tvaṃ cātmaśatrūṇāṃ bhūtvā sammardakaḥ pure |
navadvāre praprākāre vartasva śubhavarjitaḥ ||58||
tataste sārthakaṃ nāma pitroktaṃ śatrumardanam |
ityevaṃ bodhitaḥ so’pi mātrā putrastṛtīyakaḥ ||5 9 ||
bālyādeva sumukto’bhūd dvandvabhītivivarjitaḥ |
yāne ca bhojane ramye bhogye bhoge’pyanātaraḥ ||1.394.60 ||
niṣtṛṣṇo nityatṛptaśca vartate sma nirantaram |
gataṃ vighnaṃ gatā dvandvāḥ saṃsāro nāgataśca ke ||6 1 ||
hṛdye na samāviṣṭaṃ māyājālaṃ ca gatvaram |
udayāstamayau nāsya bādhete muktivartini ||62||
svaprakāśe svakānande svātmatṛptau hi vartate |
sanandanasamāno’yaṃ dṛśyate yogirāḍiva ||6 3||
dṛṣṭvā mātā prasannābhūnmātṛtvaṃ sārthakaṃ kṛtam |
jalena rañjanāṃ naiti nodvegaṃ yāti vahninā ||64||
utsavena śamaṃ naiti viṣeṇa viṣamo na vā |
sukhaduḥkhasamaḥ putraścāhaṃ dhanyā hi putriṇī ||65||
ityānandamayī nityā hariṃ bhajati sā satī |
muktaṃ putraṃ samālokya muktimārgasthitābhavat ||66 ||
evaṃ putratrayaṃ lebhe jīvanmuktaṃ madālasā |
brahmamadena jagati sālasābhūnmadālasā ||67||
evaṃ putratrayaṃ tvātmasattayā brahmatanmayam |
kriyāścakāra niṣkāmaṃ na rājārthopakārakam ||68||
rājāpi bhaktarāṭ dṛṣṭvā putrān kṛṣṇāśritān śubhān |
muktān brahmasvarūpām̐śca teṣu tutoṣa sarvathā ||69||
pativratāyāṃ bhāryāyāṃ tutoṣātyantameva ca |
janmanā kiṃ yadi bandhāḥ putre’pi nihitāstadā ||1.394.70||
yastu bandhairāvṛtaśca kathaṃ pitṝn sa tārayet |
patnī bandhanakartrī yā tayā kiṃ janmanaḥ phalam ||71 ||
uddhārayitrī yā bhāryā sā patnī satyatāriṇī |
kuṭumbatāriṇī saiva tayā gārhasthyamuttamam ||72||
putro’pi tārakaḥ proktaḥ patnī tathaiva tārikā |
satī patnī sutaḥ sādhustau matau bhavatārakau ||73 ||
dhanyo’haṃ dhanyarājyaṃ me dhanyā cāpi prajā mama |
satsaṃgācca satīsaṃgāt tariṣyāmaḥ prajādayaḥ ||74||
yatra rājye bhaveyuśca sādhvyaḥ satyaḥ pativratāḥ |
sutāśca sādhavo muktā vaikuṇṭhaṃ tatra vidyate |||75|||
dhigjanaṃ dhūrtabhāryāyāḥ patiṃ tātaṃ śaṭhasya ca |
dhigrājānaṃ vañcayitryāḥ prajāyāḥ pālakaṃ tathā ||76 ||
jayastasya satībhāryāsvāminaḥ sarvadā bhuvi |
madālasāyāḥ puṇyena vijayo me’sti sarvathā ||77||
svargaṃ svargasamaṃ rājyaṃ putrā devasamā mama |
divyā lakṣmīsamā patnī vaikuṇṭhaṃ me’sti sarvathā ||78||
śrīkṛṣṇaḥ sarvadā tvāste matputreṣu virāgiṣu |
śrīrādhā ca sadā madālasāyāṃ vartate nanu ||79|||
lakṣmīḥ sadā gṛhe cāste mama cāndhasikeṣu vai |
nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ mayi nāsti nyūnaṃ ca me manāk ||1.394.80||
yasya pativratā bhāryā yasya putraśca bhaktarāṭ |
tasya vaiṣṇavayajñānāṃ sahasraṃ nityameva hi ||81 ||
yatra nāsti satī bhāryā yatra putro na bhaktarāṭ |
tasya gṛhaṃ piśācānāṃ pherurājagṛhopamam ||82||
ityevaṃ ṛtamevāsya dhvajavad dṛśyate sadā |
tenārthavānnabhavat sa ṛtadhvajo’pi pārthivaḥ ||83||
athāyaṃ svasutānāha rājyapālanahetave |
putrāḥ prāhuśca pitaraṃ kurmo brāhmaṃ hi rājyakam ||84||
mātuḥ pituḥ kṛpayaiva vayaṃ samuddhṛtā bhavāt |
rājyaṃ tu pārthivaṃ sarvaṃ magnabhāvaṃ karoti vai ||85||
ātmarājyasamaṃ rājyaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati |
brahmānandasamaṃ saukhyaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati ||86 ||
nityatṛptiṃ gatasyātra rājyānando viṣopamaḥ |
vitṛṣṇasyātmanaḥ saukhyātparaṃ saukhyaṃ na vidyate ||87||
ātmani paramātmānaṃ dhyāyante yogino janāḥ |
santastathā prapaśyanti śrīhariṃ hṛdayāntare ||88||
tadyogaṃ tu vayaṃ prāptāḥ pitarmāturdayālavāt |
tato rājyaṃ na cecchāmo bahiṣṭhaṃ naśvaraṃ kṣayam ||89||
śrutvā piteti putrāṇāṃ mumude vai muhurmuhuḥ |
tārito’smi suputraiśca kartavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate ||1.394.90||
ititṛptasya rājñastu kālāntare sutaḥ śubhaḥ |
caturtho’pi madālasārājñyāṃ jajñe guṇālayaḥ ||91 ||
athāsmai sā mahārājñī provāca suśubhaṃ vacaḥ |
putra puṇyena bahunā tava janmātra saṃgatam ||92||
ajanmāsi sajanmā tvaṃ jāto’si rājyakāraṇāt |
arājāsi purupuṇyād rājā bhavasi putraka ||93||
aprajo’si prajāyukto bhavasi rājyakāraṇāt |
nityamukto’si tadapi baddho’si pitṛtoṣaṇāt ||94||
mā sma kleśaṃ prajākārye manyethāḥ mātṛdeśanāt |
mā sma glānimasatyārthe kālakṣepe’pi savraja ||95||
pitroḥ sevā tvayā kāryā jñānaṃ saṃrakṣya vai hṛdi |
vartasvājñākaro bhūtvā nirlepo lepavāniva ||96||
ityuktvā virarāmātha cikīrṣurnāma bhūpatiḥ |
dadarśa tāṃ satīṃ bhāryāmīṣaddhāsāṃ madālasām ||97||
tāmāha rājā hasatīṃ kiñcitkautuhalānvitaḥ |
kriyamāṇe mayā nāmni pratyeke nāmakarmaṇi ||98||
tava saṃjāyate hāsyaṃ vadātra kāraṇaṃ nu kim |
vikrāntaśca subāhuśca tṛtīyaḥ śatrumardanaḥ ||99||
kṛtānyetāni nāmāni manye tāni śubhāni vai |
yadvā te’tra navaṃ kiñcidūhamānaṃ prakāśate || 1.394.1 00||
vad sādhvi santyasanti nāmāni kīdṛśāni hi |
asya caturthaputrasya nāma tvaṃ kuru bhāmini || 101 ||
madālasā patiṃ prāha karomyākhyāṃ sutasya te |
alarka iti dharmajñaḥ khyātaḥ suto bhaviṣyati || 1 02||
laḥ layo raśca vivṛddhiḥ ka utpattirna yatra vai |
alarkaḥ sa tu vijñeyastava putraścaturthakaḥ || 1 03||
ātmā na jāyate kaścinna vardhate na naśyati |
ajanmavṛddhivilayo’larko’yaṃ tava putrakaḥ || 1 04||
ātmano nāsti śatrurvai yena mardanamācaret |
evaṃ śatrumardanaṃ tu nāma nirarthakaṃ bhavet || 1 05||
kāmakrodhādiśatrūṇāṃ mardane sārthakaṃ tataḥ |
bāhurbhujā nātmano’sti subāhuḥ syānnirarthakam || 106 ||
bahuṣu vartate yo’sau bāhuḥ kṛṣṇa udīryate |
su sammato yasyāsti subāhuḥ sārthakaṃ tataḥ || 1 07||
krāntiḥ kriyā gatiryatra viśeṣeti nirarthakam |
vyāpakasyātmano naiva gatistvasti kadācana || 1 08||
athāpi bhagavalloke gatirvidyata ityapi |
vikrāntaḥ sārthakaṃ nāma bhavatyeva sutasya te || 1 09||
evaṃ putrāstava rājan tārakā mokṣadāyakāḥ |
jātā bhāgyavaśānmuktā jīvantu śāśvatīḥ samāḥ || 1.394.11 0||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye dvitīyasutasubāhutṛtīyaśatrumardanacaturthālarkākhyaputrebhyo madālasākṛtopadeśanirūpaṇanāmā caturnavatyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||394||

<1.395>
śrīnārāyāṇa uvāca
atha rājñā yojitā sā madālasā caturthakam |
putraṃ lakṣmi pravṛttestu mārge hyupādideśa yat || 1 ||
putra vardhasva madbharturmano nandaya karmabhiḥ |
devapitratithīn sarvān karmaṇā toṣamāvaha || 2 ||
brahmacaryaṃ vrataṃ putra gṛhāṇa sopanāyakam |
tato vidyāṃ rājayogyāṃ nītiṃ gṛhāṇa sadguroḥ || 3 ||
rājyaṃ pitṛpradattaṃ ca dharmārthaṃ vaha putraka |
prajā rakṣa kratūn śreṣṭhān kuru vahnau ghṛtādikam || 4 ||
juhudhi brāhmaṇasādhudīnebhyo dehi cārthitam |
kṣiteḥ saṃpālanāt saukhyaṃ dharmakāryaṃ bhaviṣyati || 5 ||
tena svargaṃ ca devatvaṃ sukhaṃ prāpsyasi śāśvatam |
parvasu tīrthake gatvā tarpayethāḥ dharāmarān || 6 ||
pūrayethāḥ mano’bhīṣṭaṃ bāndhavānāṃ samīhitam |
cintayethāḥ hṛdi sarvajīvānāṃ hitamuttamam || 7 ||
nivartayethāḥ satataṃ cākāryebhyaścāpi pāpataḥ |
yajñairdānaijapairhomairdevān dvijām̐śca prīṇaya || 8 ||
dharmārthakāmasaṃjñaiśca vijayethāḥ pumarthakaiḥ |
gurun saṃsevayethāśca nandayethāḥ suhṛjanān || 9 ||
sādhūn saṃrakṣayethāśca yajethāḥ suramānavān |
vrajethāstīrthayātrāyāṃ kārayethāḥ svamokṣaṇam || 1.395.10 ||
gṛhadharmān pālayethāstoṣayethāḥ suyoṣitaḥ
putrānutpādayethāśca śrayethāḥ nyāsasādhutām ||11 ||
samarjayethāḥ muktiṃ ca tyajethāḥ pravṛttiṃ tathā |
vilīyethāḥ pare kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe’kṣarādhipe || 12 ||
iti putra tavārthe vai mayā mārgo nideśitaḥ |
tatra śreyaḥ śrayethāstvaṃ rāgatyāgobhayātmakam || 13 ||
evamullāpyamānaḥ so’larko mātrā punaḥ punaḥ |
vavṛdhe vayasā bālaḥ ṛtadhvajasutaḥ śubhaḥ || 14||
kṛtopanayanaḥ prāha mātaraṃ vada me sati |
mama yadatra kartavyamaihikāmuṣmikaṃ ca yat || 15 ||
madālasā punaḥ prāha jñānayogye vayasyatha |
vatsa rājye’bhiṣiktena kartavyaṃ lokarañjanam || 16||
vyasanāni na kāryāṇi rājyanāśyakarāṇi vai |
ātmā rakṣyo ripubhyaśca mantro rakṣyo viśeṣataḥ || 17||
amātyādīn vijānīyādāsanādānabhāṣaṇaiḥ |
cāraiḥ sarvatra saṃdṛṣṭiṃ kārayet satyavedibhiḥ || 18||
kutrāpi bhūbhṛtā viśvasanīyaṃ naiva sarvathā |
kāryasādhakatā rakṣyā viśvāsairapi karhicit || 1 9||
deśakālādivijñena rājñā bhāvya guṇādibhiḥ |
ātmā prākmantriṇaḥ paścād bhṛtyā jeyastataḥ param || 1.395.20 ||
kāmādayo vijetavyāḥ prathamaṃ sarvathā nṛpaiḥ |
kāmaḥ krodho mado lobho mānaścaite vināśakāḥ || 2 1 ||
kākavacceṣṭayā bhāvyaṃ kokilāvat svareṇa ca |
bhṛṃgavat sāragrahaṇe mṛgavadbhramaṇe sadā || 22||
vyālavad roṣakaraṇe mayūravat samādare |
haṃsavattu vivekena kukkuṭavaddhi jāgratau || 23 ||
lohavad dārḍhyabhāvena bhāvyaṃ rājñā hitārthinā |
kīṭavat kaṭhine śatrau praviśettu śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ||24||
sambhūya ca pipīlikāvadāharet paraṃ nṛpaḥ |
agnivisphuliṃgavad vai camatkāraṃ pradarśayet ||25||
candravat sūryavaccāpi nītyarthe niyamaṃ caret |
bandhakī tu yathā syādvai nirlepā paśupakṣiṣu ||26||
padma jale tu nirlepaṃ hyuparyupari tiṣṭhati |
śarabhaḥ siṃhavargaśca phalayukpuruṣārthakaḥ ||27||
śūlī vedhe na viphalā tathā prajñāṃ samarjayet |
dadhipātre prasphuṭite gopālikā na śocati ||28||
gurviṇīstanato dugdhaṃ sravate na kadācana |
evaṃ rājñā vartanīyaṃ kartavyaṃ rājyarakṣaṇam ||29||
indravattoyamādāya dātavyaṃ samayāgame |
sūryavattoyamādāya dātavyaṃ ṛtusaṃgame ||1.395.30||
yamavat suhṛdi śatrau daṇḍakārye samo bhavet| |
candravat śāntamanasā bhāvyaṃ kvacinna sarvadā ||3 1 ||
vāyuvat sarvavarṇeṣu cārairgopyaṃ samāharet |
na lobhe kāmavarge vā kṛṣyate sa sukhī sadā ||32||
dharmaṃ pālayati svargyaṃ sādhvāśramām̐śca rakṣati |
tasya sukhaṃ pretya paratreha ca śāśvatam ||33||
prajāyāṃ dharmasarvasvasthāpanena nṛpasya tu |
bhāgaprāptirbhavatyeva tena svargaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ||34||
karmayajñān jñānayajñān bhaktiyajñān pravartayet |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprītyā labheta śāśvataṃ padam ||35||
satyaṃ śaucamahiṃsā cānasūyā ca tathā kṣamā |
ānṛśaṃsyamakarmaṇyaṃ caite rakṣyā janairbhuvi ||36 ||
vatsa gārhasthyamādāya janaḥ puṣṇāti vai jagat |
tatpuṇyena ca lokān sa sañjayatyabhivāñcchitān ||37||
surā daityā dānavā vā mānuṣāḥ pitararṣayaḥ |
munayaḥ kīṭapataṃgā vayāṃsi paśavo drumāḥ ||38||
gṛhasthamupajīvanti tena tṛptiṃ prayānti ca |
mukhaṃ tvasya nirīkṣante hyapi no dāsyatīti vai ||39||
gārhasthyaṃ poṣakaṃ sarvādhāraṃ gauḥ sā trayīmayī |
yatra pratiṣṭhitaṃ viśvaṃ viśvahetuśca sā matā ||1.395.40||
iṣṭāpūrtādikāryāṇi gṛhasthenaiva sarvathā |
svāhākārasvadhākārau gṛhasthādhārakau matau ||41||
vaṣaṭkāro hantakāraścāhokāro’pi tanmayaḥ |
gārhasthyocchedakartā yaḥ sa tu pāpakaro’sti vai ||42||
gārhasthyaṃ poṣayed vijñaḥ saḥ svargāyopakalpyate |
rājñā vā dhaninā vatsa devarṣipitṛmānavāḥ ||43||
bhūtāni cānudivasaṃ poṣyāṇi svatanuryathā |
pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ śrāddhaṃ kāle kuryātsamāhitaḥ ||44|
sumanogandhapuṣpādyairdeśanabhyarcayet tathā |
dīnānāthadaridrebhyo dadyād bhojyādikaṃ gṛhī ||45||
śvabhyaśca śvapacebhyaśca vayobhyaścāvaped bhuvi |
bubhukṣumāgataṃ śrāntaṃ yācamānamakiṃcanam ||46||
bhojyaṃ peyaṃ pradadyāccātithiṃ matvā hariṃ prabhum |
tasmim̐stṛpte nṛyajñotthādṛṇānmucyeta vai gṛhī ||47||
atithiryasya bhagnāśo gṛhasthasya nivartate |
datvā sa duṣkṛtaṃ tasmai puṇyamādāya gacchati ||48||
apyambuśākadānena satkriyādatithiṃ gṛhī |
bhikṣāṃ ca yācatāṃ dadyād yathāśaktiprabhikṣaṇam ||49||
āśritān bhojayitvaiva sadā bhuṃjyād gṛhādhipaḥ |
evamudvahataḥ putra gārhasthyaṃ copakārakam |||1.395.50||
devāḥ pitaro munayo dīnāścātithibhikṣukāḥ |
ṛṣayo bāndhavāḥ pakṣipaśavaḥ sūkṣmakīṭakāḥ ||51 ||
āśīrvādaparā nityāḥ sukhadāḥ saṃbhavanti vai |
paraloke’pi sukhadā avighnāśca bhavanti te ||52||
evaṃvidhāṃ śubhāṃ gāthāṃ svayamatriragāyata |
vaiśvadevaṃ hi nāmaitad datvā yuṃjyānna cānyathā ||53||
putrajanmani yatkāryaṃ vivāhādau ca yad yathā |
tathā satāṃ tu sevāyāṃ vyayaḥ kāryo harerdine ||54||
annaprakiraṇaṃ yattu manuṣyaiḥ kriyate bhuvi |
tena tṛptiṃ piśācādyāḥ paryuṣitena yāntyapi |||55||
yadambu snānavastrādvai bhūmau patati tena vai |
ye ke ca tarutāṃ prāptāsteṣāṃ tṛptiḥ prajāyate ||56||
ye tu dehāṃgalagnā vai patanti jalabindavaḥ |
bhūgataistaiśca devādau gatāstṛptiṃ prayānti vai ||57||
piṇḍānnakaṇikābhiśca tiryañco yānti toṣaṇam |
ye tu dagdhāstathā bālāḥ kriyāyogyā asaṃskṛtāḥ ||58||
vipannāste’nnavikirasammārjanajalāśinaḥ |
ācullukajalaṃ pītvā tṛptimāyānti te mṛtāḥ ||59||
tasmānmahotsave dadyāt śrāddhe dadyācca dānake |
dadyādeva gṛhasthastu kule kaścinna sīdati ||1.395.6 0||
sadācāro gṛhasthena pālanīyo yathāyatham |
na hyācāravihīnasya sukhamatra paratra ca ||61 ||
durācāro hi puruṣo nehāyurvindati dhruvam |
sarvapāpaniṣedhārthaṃ dharmaḥ kāryo gṛhārthinā ||62||
brāhme muhūrte buddhyeta dharmārthau cāpi cintayet |
snātvā sandhyāṃ tathā dhyānaṃ prakurvīta surārcanam ||63||
asatpralāpamanṛtaṃ vākpāruṣyaṃ ca varjayet |
asadvādaṃ ca nāstikyaṃ naiva kuryātkadācana ||64||
vṛddhebhyo namanaṃ kuryāt pūjyapūjā samācaret |
gurūṇāmāsanaṃ dadyādabhyutthānādi cācaret ||65||
guruṃ ca pitarau śreṣṭhaṃ patiṃ samabhivādayet |
duṣkṛtaṃ na gurorbrūyāt kruddhaṃ tvenaṃ prasādayet ||66||
paranindāṃ na śṛṇuyānna ca kuryātkadācana |
panthā deyo brāhmaṇānāṃ rājño duḥkhāturasya ca ||67||
satāṃ viduṣāṃ gurviṇyā bhārārtasya yavīyasaḥ |
mūkāndhabadhirāṇāṃ ca mattasyonmattakasya ca ||68||
satyāśca vairiṇaścāpi bālasya patitasya ca |
narmābhighātamākrośaṃ paiśunyaṃ ca vivarjayeta ||69||
daṃbhābhimānaśāṭhyāni na kuryādvai kadācana |
paradārā na gantavyā dīrghāyuṣyaṃ samīcchatā ||1.395.70||
rajasvalā sadā varjyā sarvaiḥ rātricatuṣṭayam |
strījanmaparihārārthaṃ pañcamīmapi varjayet ||71 ||
tataḥ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ vrajed rātryāṃ putrecchuko hi sarvathā |
yugmāsu putrā jāyante kanyāstvekāsu rātriṣu ||72||
āṣoḍaśarātraṃ vai garbhādhānabalaṃ matam |
tata ūrdhvaṃ tu kamalaṃ pihitaṃ jāyate’phalam ||73 ||
kuryānmaitrī na cāśīlairna cauryādidūṣitaiḥ |
na cātivyayaśīlaiśca na lubdhairnāpi vairibhiḥ ||74||
na tathā balibhirmaitrī na nyūnairnāpi ninditaiḥ |
na sarvaśaṃkibhiścāpi na vā daivaparaistathā ||75|||
atha maitrīṃ prakurvīta sadācāraiśca sādhubhiḥ |
prājñairapiśunaiḥ śaktaiḥ karmodyogādiśālibhiḥ ||76 ||
patidevagurūn prati naiva pādau prasārayet |
tatra putra na vastavyaṃ yatra nāsti catuṣṭayam ||77||
ṛṇapradātā vaidyaśca śrotrīyaḥ sajalā nadi |
jitāmitro nṛpo yatra dharmarakṣaṇakārakaḥ ||78||
paurāḥ susaṃyatā yatra yatra sasyavatī mahī |
yatrāmatsariṇo lokāstatra vāsaḥ sukhodayaḥ ||79||
tatra putra na vastavyaṃ yatraitat tritayaṃ sadā |
jigīṣuḥ pūrvavairaśca janā udyamavarjitāḥ ||1.395.80||
śaucādikaṃ śṛṇu putra yathā yasyāsti sammatam |
śakhāśmasvarṇarūpyāṇāṃ rajjūnāmatha vāsasām ||81 ||
śākamūlaphalānāṃ ca tathā vidalacarmaṇām |
maṇivajrapravālānāṃ ratnamuktāphalasya ca ||82||
gātrāṇāṃ ca manuṣyāṇāmambunā śaucamiṣyate |
sasnehānāṃ tu bhāṇḍānāṃ śuddhiruṣṇena vāriṇā ||83 ||
śūrpadhānyājinānāṃ ca muśalolūkhalasya ca |
saṃhatānāṃ ca vastrāṇāṃ prokṣaṇāt sacayasya ca ||84||
valkalānāmaroṣāṇāmambunā śuddhiriṣyate |
tṛṇakāṣṭhauṣadhīnāṃ ca prokṣaṇācchuddhiriṣyate ||85||
ūrṇā keśādayaḥ śuddhā vāyunā kiraṇena vā |
śuci bhaikṣaṃ kāruhastaḥ paṇyaṃ yoṣinmukhaṃ tathā ||86 ||
yajñaśālā rasaśālāḥ stanandhayasutāḥ striyaḥ |
śucinyaśca tathā hyāpaḥ sravantyo’gandhabudbudāḥ ||87||
bhūmirviśuddhyati kālāt sekāllepātsumārjanāt |
ullekhanāttathā vṛṣṭermṛttikācchuddhiriṣyate ||88 ||
bhasmāmbugharṣaṇairkāṃsyaśuddhiśca vahninā tathā |
mṛttoyaiścānyapātrāṇāṃ kṣāreṇa trapusīsayoḥ ||89|||
rajo’gniraśvo gauśchāyā raśmayaḥ pavano mahī |
vipruṣo makṣikādyāśca duṣṭasaṃgādadoṣiṇaḥ ||1.395.90 ||
ajāśvau mukhato medhyau na gorvatsasya cānanam |
mātuḥ prasravaṇaṃ medhyaṃ śakuni phalapātane ||91 ||
āsanaṃ śayanaṃ yānaṃ nāvaḥ pathi tṛṇāni ca |
somasūryāṃśupavanaiḥ śuddhyanti nityameva hi ||92 ||
prabhūtopahatādannādagramudbhūpya saṃtyajet |
śeṣasya prokṣaṇaṃ kuryād vāyunā śuddhireva vā |||93 ||
śavaṃ spṛṣṭvā prakuryādvai snānaṃ śuddhistato matā |
malatyāge prakurvīta snānaṃ karādiśodhanam ||94||
apatyajanmani śaucaṃ māsamekaṃ hi pālayet |
mṛtaśaucaṃ dvādaśāhaṃ pālayennyūnavarṣavat |||95||
ityevaṃ tvamalarkātrācāraṃ pālaya sarvathā |
ātmaśuddhiḥ sadā rakṣyā māyābhramavināśanaiḥ |||96 ||
sa evamanuśiṣṭo 3 mātrā tvalarka ādarāt |
pitrādiṣṭaśca saṃcakre dharmadāraparigraham ||97||
rājyaṃ pitrā pradattaṃ ca gṛhāṇālarka aihikam |
madālasā svatanayaṃ prāhedaṃ paścimaṃ vacaḥ || 98||
yadā duḥkhamasahyaṃ te priyabandhuviyogajam |
śatrubādhodbhavaṃ vāpi vittanāśādisaṃbhavam ||99 ||
tadāsmāt putra niṣkṛṣya maddattādaṃgulīyakāt |
vācyaṃ vai śāsanaṃ tvatra paṭṭe’sti likhitaṃ mayā || 1.395.10 0||
ityuktvā pradadau mātā sauvarṇaṃ sāṃgulīyakam |
āśiṣaścāpi yā yogyā dattā mātrā tataḥ param || 101 ||
pitrā dattā āśiṣaśca rājyaṃ cakre hyalarkakaḥ |
madālasāṛtadhvajau tapase kānanaṃ gatau || 1 02||
dhyātvā tau śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ tyaktvā tu bhautikam |
divyaṃ dehaṃ samāsādya yayaturbrahmadhāma vai || 1 03||
evaṃ madālasā lakṣmi vaiṣṇavī vai pativratā |
putrān muktān suniṣpādyākṣaradhāma gatā satī || 1 04||
etasya paṭhanādvāpi śravaṇānmuktirāpyate |
bandhanāni vinaśyeyuḥ sadā saukhyaṃ bhavet priye || 1 05||
alarko’pi yathānyāyaṃ bandhanaṃ na bhaved yathā |
tathākaronnijaṃ rājyaṃ sarvāḥ pramuditāḥ prajāḥ || 1 06||
pālayāmāsa dharmātmā putravad dhārmikīḥ prajāḥ |
putrām̐ścotpādayāmāsa tatheyāja mahāmakhaiḥ || 1 07||
ajāyanta sutāstvasya mahābalaparākramāḥ |
dharmātmāno mahātmāno vimārgaparipanthinaḥ || 1 08||
rājyaṃ kartuṃ samarthebhyo na sutebhyo dadau dhuram |
vairāgyaṃ nāsya saṃjajñe bhuṃjato viṣayān bahūn || 1 09||
taṃ tathā bhogasaṃsaktaṃ bhrāntaṃ cāpyajitendriyam |
bhrātaraṃ rāganāśāya hyupadeṣṭumanā vanī || 1.395.11 0||
subāhunāmako bhrātāgrajaḥ sanyāsavān yatiḥ |
āyayau tadgṛhaṃ śīghramupādideśa mokṣaṇam || 111 ||
ātmavidyāṃ bahuvidyāṃ bhrātrāpi kathitāṃ ca tām |
smāraṃ smāraṃ jagādāsmai bandhanāśārthameva saḥ || 11 2||
tathāpyalarko no mene rājyatyāgaṃ hitaṃkaram |
tadā bubodhayiṣustaṃ tyājayituṃ ca bandhanam || 113 ||
subāhustu ciraṃ dhyātvā śreyo’manyata saṅgaram |
tadvairisaṃśrayaṃ kṛtvā yuddhamutpādya colbaṇam || 1 14||
kārayāmi paraṃ śreyo bhrāturvairāgyamuttamam |
audāsīnyaṃ samutpādayitvā karomi mokṣaṇam || 1 15||
vicāryetthaṃ subāhuḥ saḥ kāśībhūpālamāgamat |
tena cakre balodyogamalarkaṃ prati pārthivaḥ || 1 16||
dūtaṃ ca preṣayāmāsa rājyaṃ bhrātre pradīyatām |
ityuktavantaṃ taṃ dūtaṃ pratyuvāca madānvitaḥ || 1 17||
māmevābhyetya hārdena yācatāṃ rājyamagrajaḥ |
nākrāntyā saṃpradāsyāmi kāśīrājabhayena vai || 1 18||
tataḥ kāśīnṛpeṇāsya yuddhaṃ ghorataraṃ hyabhūt |
cintāṃ sa paramāṃ prāpya tat sasmārāṃgulīyakam || 11 9||
mātrā dattaṃ tatra patraṃ dadṛśe prasphuṭākṣaram |
saṃgaḥ sarvātmanā tyājyaḥ sa cet tyaktaṃ na śakyate || 1.395.120 ||
saḥ sadbhiḥ saha kartavyaḥ satāṃ saṃgo hi bheṣajam |
tṛṣṇā sarvātmanā heyā tyaktuṃ cecchakyate na sā || 121 ||
mumukṣayā parityājyā saiva tasyāstu bheṣajam |
vācayitvā mumukṣāṃ ca gṛhītvālarkabhūpatiḥ || 1 22||
sādhusamparkamanvicchan rātrau mitaparigrahaḥ |
dattātreyaṃ mahābhāgaṃ yayau gurumasaṃginam || 123 ||
praṇipatyābhisaṃpūjya yathāsarvamabhāṣata |
kuru prasādaṃ duḥkhādivināśāyetyayācata || 1 24||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye’larka madālasā pravṛttidharmānupādideśa, sā sapatikā divyagatimavāpa, alarkasyātmajñānārthaṃ subāhoḥ prayāsa ityādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcanavatyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||395 ||

<1.396>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
samākarṇaya vijñānaṃ dattātreyād yathārjitam |
alarkeṇa mahālakṣmi yogināmapi durlabham || 1 ||
guruḥ prāha kimarthaṃ te duḥkhaṃ brūhi yathātatham |
duḥkhāpahāramadyaiva karomi tava pārthiva || 2 ||
śiṣyaḥ prāha subāhurme bhrātā rājyārthameva yat |
kāśīnṛpeṇa sammīlya vai mayā saha yuddhyati || 3 ||
tadduḥkhaṃ paramaṃ śīghraṃ prāk prātareva nāśaya |
guruḥ prāha tadetattu tvayi nāsti kadācana || 4 ||
yasyātmani na cāsti tvaṃ tasyāpasaraṇaṃ kutaḥ |
vicāraṃ kuru rājendra prakāśo’stu ca te hṛdi || 5 ||
matkṛpāto nijaṃ viddhi hyaduḥkhaṃ hyasukhaṃ sadā |
gṛhāṇedaṃ jalaṃ rājan piba gaṇḍūṣamātrakam || 6 ||
dehi netropari tadvanmastake brahmadarśakam |
ityuktaḥ sa tathā kṛtvā hyudghāṭitahṛdantaraḥ || 7 ||
bhūtvā vimṛśya cātmānaṃ prahasyedamathābravīt |
prakṛtistriguṇā sarvā nistraiguṇyo’smyahaṃ sadā || 8 ||
prakṛtermamatā jātā tayā jātāpyahaṃkṛtiḥ |
tayā miṣṭāni mātrāṇi grāhakāṇi mṛdūnyapi || 9 ||
mātrebhyaḥ sthūlabhogyāni tebhyo deho guṇāśritaḥ |
sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ tathā mohaḥ sattvaṃ rajastamaśca te || 1.396.1 0||
tatkāryāṇi tādṛśāni teṣu cāyānti tānyapi |
a tādṛśe hyatasmim̐śca mayi nāyānti tāni vai || 11 ||
tataḥ sukhaṃ tathā duḥkhaṃ mohaḥ santi na te mayi |
nāmurvī na salilaṃ na jyotiranilo na ca || 1 2||
nākāśaṃ ceti gandhādyā dharmā mayi na santi vai |
nāhaṃ pṛthvīrna me gandho nāhaṃ jalaṃ na me rasaḥ || 13 ||
nāhaṃ jyotirna me rūpaṃ nāhaṃ vāyurna me spṛśiḥ |
nāhaṃ vyoma na me śabdastaddharmāṃśca kuto mayi || 14||
pañcabhūtāni yuktāni hāniṃ vṛddhiṃ prayānti ca |
sukhaduḥkhapramohānāṃ hānirvṛddhiśca dṛśyate || 15||
dṛśyavad dṛśyadharmāṃśca ghaṭo rūpādayastathā |
dṛśyante cakṣuṣā yadvat sukhādyā manasāstathā || 16||
dṛśyasyaiva prakṛteste nātmanaḥ santi naśvarāḥ |
anaśvarasya nityasya kathamāgantudharmitā || 17||
evaṃ hastena vai grāhyaṃ phalaṃ cāmrādikaṃ jaḍam |
rūpaṃ tu cakṣuṣā grāhyaṃ raso rasanayā tathā || 18||
gandho nāsikayā grāhyaṃ unmādo manasā tathā |
āsavādau guṇonmādo mattatā dhūsture khalu || 1 9||
takrādau māndyamevetyādayo grāhyā rasottarāḥ |
manasā te tu gṛhyante mano’pi tadrasottaram ||1.396.20||
aṃśo muktasya cāṇīyānmana eva bhavatyatha |
manasyavasthitā dharmo jñānaṃ virāgamīśitā || 21 ||
sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ vimohaste manasyavasthitā yataḥ |
nāhaṃ mano na me duḥkhasukhamohāḥ kathaṃcana ||22||
ahaṃ nāhaṃ, mama nāhaṃ, buddhirnāhaṃ, na vai manaḥ, |
tatra sthitaṃ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ tasyaiva mayi tatkatham ||23||
nāhaṃ pṛthivyādimayaṃ śarīraṃ
na vā manaścāntaramindriyaṃ ca |
nāpi prakarmāśayavāsanāhaṃ
tanmohaduḥkhāni ca kiṃ mamātra ||24||
rājyaṃ dharitrī janatāḥ samastāstacchāsanaṃ buddhikṛtaṃ na tanme |
buddhiḥ samānā triguṇasya putrī tacchāsanaṃ rājyamidaṃ na tanme ||25||
karotu tacchāsanamasya buddhiḥ subāhubuddhiśca karotu yadvā |
nālarkabuddhirna subāhubuddhiryato’bhidhā dehagatā na jīve ||26 ||
na yasya hastādikamasti vaśyaṃ
māṃsaṃ na cāsthīni śirāvibhāgaḥ |
kastasya hastyaśvarathādikoṣaiḥ
svalpo’pi saṃsarga ihāsti puṃsaḥ ||27||
tasmānna me’rirna ca me’sti dukhaṃ
na me sukhaṃ pattanamasti mohaḥ |
na kośanāgāśvadharārthadārā
na tasya nānyasya na me bhavanti |||28||
yadasti tasyaiva sa me’sti śuklo
yadasti me tasya tadeva cāsti |
dvayoryadastyeva sa śukla ātmā
duḥkhe sukhe kena kṛtaṃ vadātra ||29|||
samyak prapaśyataḥ puṃso duḥkhaṃ sukhaṃ na kiñcana |
ātmapradarśinaḥ kvāpi rājyaṃ na harimantarā ||1.396.3 0 ||
buddhistathā sthitisthāpyā bahukālakṛtā sadā |
yatrāsaktā tathā tadvajjāyate guṇarañjitā ||3 1 ||
mārjārabhakṣite duḥkhaṃ yādṛśaṃ gṛhakukkuṭe |
na tādṛṅmatāśūnye cakravāke’tha mūṣike ||32||
rakṣaṇe dehaputrādau yathābuddhiḥ pravartate |
na tathā dehalikṣādāvasti pratyuta māraṇe |||33 ||
ekasyaiva hi dehasya dhātubhirvividhāḥ prajāḥ |
likṣā kīṭā matkuṇā aurasā vyavāyajāḥ sutāḥ ||34||
na sarvatra samā buddhirnakhakeśamaleṣvapi |
tasmād buddhikṛtaṃ naijaṃ pārakyaṃ nātmanā kṛtam |||35||
tasmād guro satyabodhe nāhaṃ duḥkhī na vā sukhī |
na ca mugdho naraḥ kaścid vedmi te’nugrahāt khalu ||36 ||
śrutvaitacchiṣyavākyaṃ tu dattātreya uvāca tam |
evametannaravyāghra jānāsi tu yathātatham ||37||
mūlaṃ mameti duḥkhasya na mameti ca nirvṛteḥ |
matkṛpātaśca te jñānamutpannamidamuttamam ||38||
ādiṣṭaṃ tava mātrā prāṅ smāritaṃ te mayādya vai |
ahamametijāḍyaṃ vai kṣiptaṃ yena vivekataḥ ||39||
tasyaiva sarvathā tṛptirbhavatyeva videhinaḥ |
gṛhakṣetraputradāradhanadhānyasutādayaḥ ||1.396.40||

ātmavṛttiḥ sadā paśyedindriyavṛttibhirnijam |

nābhyāṃ hṛdaye kaṇṭhe ca tālau bhāle ca netrayoḥ ||78||
mūrdhni cātmani śrīkṛṣṇe saṃyamaṃ vidadhīta vai |
evaṃ vai dhāraṇāṃ kurvan prāpnotyakṣarasāmyatām ||79||

sāmarthyaṃ vilayaṃ yāti tasmāttatra nivartayet ||1.396.80 ||
striyaḥ kīrtirvivijñānaṃ rājyaṃ dravyaṃ samarthatā |
devatvaṃ bahuyajñitvaṃ rasāyanaśarīratā ||81 ||
ākāśajalavahnyādāvapratihatayānatā |
ete vighnāḥ prahartavyā manasteṣu na yojayet ||82||

prātibhaṃ sarvavijñānaṃ śrāvaṇaṃ divyakarṇatā ||83 ||

upasargairmahāvighnairāvartante punaḥ punaḥ ||85 ||

cintayetparamaṃ brahma sa yāyātparamāṃ gatim ||86 ||

tejo layettu pavane’nilaṃ layettato’mbare ||87||

akṣaraṃ brahmarūpaṃ svamātmānaṃ paramātmani ||89 ||

bhūteṣu yasya satkārastasyāsti dhruvabandhanam ||1.396.9 0 ||
yasmin yasmim̐śca kurute bhūte rāgaṃ jano yadā |

punarāvartate rājan bhūtayogo vighātakṛt |
bhūteṣu yasya sārvajñyaudāsīnyaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ tu tat ||9 2||
aṇimā laghimā caiva mahimā prāptireva ca |
prākāmyaṃ ca tatheśitvaṃ vaśitvaṃ ca tathāparam || 93 ||
evaṃ kāmāvasāyitvaṃ guṇānetām̐stathaiśvarān |

nirdagdhadoṣastenaikyaṃ prayāti brahmaṇā saha |
so’śnute hi sarvān kāmān saha tena vipaścitā ||9 5 ||
tathātmā sāmyamabhyeti yogīśe paramātmani |
sālokyaṃ cāpi sārūpyaṃ sāyujyaṃ nityameva ca ||96 ||

madāśrayaṃ sadā prāpto’larka vijñānamāptavān ||98||

na tu te bandhanaṃ bhūyād bhūyā nirvāṇabhāk sadā || 99||
ātmanā brahmaṇā nityānandena sukhaśāyinā |
parabrahmaṇi sammīlya śāśvatānandavān bhava || 1.396.100 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye’larkarājño dattātreyapradattajñānayogavattayā muktatādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṇṇavatyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 396 ||

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
evaṃ śubhāśiṣaḥ prāpyālarko brahmasvarūpatām |
svātmanyanubhavanprāha bhagavantaṃ guruṃ harim || 1 ||
bhagavan yoginaścaryāṃ śrotumicchāmi sarvathā |
brahmavartmanyanugacchan lakṣyate kairvilakṣaṇaiḥ || 2 ||
guruḥ prāha śṛṇu kṣmeśa lokacaryāvilakṣaṇāḥ |
caryāstasya bhavantyeva nirmaryādā nirāhatāḥ || 3 ||
mānāpamānau yāvetau prītyudvegakarau nṛṇām |
tāveva viparītārthau yoginastu viṣāmṛte || 4 ||

ātithyayajñayātrādau na gacchennirjanecchukaḥ || 5 ||

aṭeta devayātrārthaṃ yadṛcchālābhatoṣavān || 6 ||
yadvā cājagarīṃ vṛttiṃ samāśritya hi vartate |

tatprayuñjyātsureṣvārpya satāṃ vartma na dūṣayan |
sārabhūtaṃ yathāpekṣaṃ gṛhṇīyānnādhikaṃ kvacit || 8 ||
vāgdaṇḍaḥ karmadaṇḍaśca manodaṇḍaśca te trayaḥ |
yasya vai niyatāḥ sa syāt tridaṇḍī yogirāṭ paraḥ || 9 ||
kṛṣṇamūrtau sadā yuñjan yogaṃ kṛṣṇeti saṃjapan |
vartate nityamagno’sau sthitiṃ śreṣṭhāṃ samudvahan || 1.397.10 ||
tārasvareṇa bhagavannāmaraṭanamācaret |

na yad vedayate yogī jñātvāpi na bhaṇatyapi ||1.397.20||

narma hāsyapradaṃ roṣakaraṃ vā mānadaṃ tathā ||23 ||

devamārgaṃ dhruvaṃ śukraṃ somacchāyāmarundhatīm |
yo na paśyati netreṇa mṛtyustasya samāntare ||71 ||
sūryasya maṇḍalaṃ raśmihīnaṃ vahniṃ saraśmikam |
yastu paśyati netreṇa mṛtyustasya samāntare ||72||
vānte mūtrapurīṣe ca svarṇatulye prapaśyati |
svapne’pi yadi paśyati jīvet sa daśamāsikam ||73 ||
dṛṣṭvā pretapiśācādīn gandharvanagarāṇi ca |
vṛkṣān kanakaraṃgām̐śca navamāsān sa jīvati ||74||
pīnaḥ śuṣkaḥ śuṣkaḥ pīno hyakasmājjāyate muhuḥ |
śirovāyubhramo yasya tasyāyuścāṣṭamāsikam ||75||
pādanyāse bhuvi pārṣṇeryadvā phaṇe prakhaṇḍitā |
rajaḥkardamadhūlyādau saptamāsān sa jīvati ||76 ||
gṛdhraḥ kapotaḥ kākolo vāyaso vāpi mūrdhani |
kravyādo vā khago nīlaḥ ṣaṇmāsāyuḥpradarśakaḥ ||77 ||
hanyate kākapaṃktyā ca pāṃśuvarṣeṇa svapnake |
svacchāyāmanyathā draṣṭā catuḥpañca sa jīvati |||78||
anabhre vidyuto draṣṭā dakṣiṇasyāṃ pravāsakṛt |
rātrāvindradhanurdraṣṭā dvātramāsikajīvanaḥ ||79||
ghṛte taile tathādarśe toye vā nātmanastanum |
yaḥ paśyedaśiraskāṃ vā māsādūrdhvaṃ na jīvati ||1.397.80||
yasya bastasamo gandho gātre śavasamo’pi vā |
tasya vai jīvanaṃ cārdhamāsikaṃ bodhyameva hi ||8 1 ||
yasya tu snātamātrasya hṛdayaṃ karapādakau |
pibataśca gale śoṣo daśāhe sa tu jīvati ||82|||
yasya vegena vāyośca daṇḍabhedaḥ prajāyate |
tasyāntakaḥ samāyāto muhūrte vai mariṣyati ||83 ||
ṛkṣavānarabastoṣṭragardabhajambukādibhiḥ |
dakṣiṇāṃ yo diśaṃ vāhe tiṣṭhan yāti mariṣyati ||84||
raktakṛṣṇāmbaradharā gāyantī hasatī ca yam |
dakṣiṇāśāṃ nayennārī svapne so’pi na jīvati |||85||
nagnaṃ kṣapaṇakaṃ yadvā rākṣasaṃ kālameva vā |
hasamānaṃ pravalgantaṃ dṛṣṭvā mṛtyuṃ vicārayet ||86 ||
ātmānaṃ sarvathā magnaṃ paṃke paśyenmariṣyati |
keśe vahniṃ bhujagaṃ ca bhasma śuṣkāṃ nadīṃ tathā ||87||
svapne dṛṣṭvā daśāhena mariṣyati na saṃśayaḥ |
karālaiḥ puruṣairāyudhādibhiścopalādibhiḥ ||88 ||
māritastāḍitaḥ so’pi mariṣyati na saṃśayaḥ|
dantajāḍyavato mṛtyurbhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ||89||
sūryodaye śivā yasya krośantī yāti sammukham |
viparītaṃ parītaṃ vā sa sadyo mṛtyumṛcchati ||1.397.90||
bhuktamātrasya yasyaiva punaḥ saṃbādhate kṣudhā |
dīpagandhaṃ na yo vetti sa gatāyurna saṃśayaḥ ||91 ||
nātmapratikṛtiṃ tvanyacakṣuṣorvai prapaśyati |
rātrau śakrāyudhadraṣṭā divā grahavilokanaḥ ||92||
nāsikā vakritā yasya karṇau ca nimnakonnatau |
netraṃ vāmaṃ sravatyeva tasyāyurnāsti sarvathā ||93||
mukhaṃ raktaṃ bhavejjihvā śyāmā dantāśca kṛṣṇakāḥ |
nirghoṣāśravaṇaṃ karṇe cakṣurjyotiḥkṣayaṃ tathā ||94||
garte gatasyopalābhirdvāraṃ yasya pidhīyate |
tasya mṛtyuḥ kṣaṇādūrdhvaṃ svapne’gniveśitasya ca ||95||
jalapraveśane bhūtaistāḍane mṛtyurāgataḥ |
svabhāvavaiparītyaṃ ca prakṛteśca viparyayaḥ ||96||
pūjyanindāvamānādi mṛtyorākāriṇo matāḥ |
tasmād yogaṃ tadā yuñjyānmṛtyunāśāya taddine ||97||
yadvā brahmaṇi yuñjītātmānaṃ nānyatsmaretkhalu |
tena kṛṣṇena yukto’sau prayāti tatparaṃ padam ||98||
so’yamātyantiko mokṣo mṛtyurātyantiko hi saḥ |
yogābhyāsaphalaṃ taccākṣare pādārcanaṃ hareḥ ||99||
jananaṃ sārthakaṃ tasya maraṇaṃ sārthakaṃ tathā |
sārthakaṃ rājyakaraṇaṃ prāptiḥ kṛṣṇasya pādayoḥ || 1.397.10 0||
alarka itisaṃśrutvā nanāma gurupādayoḥ |
niśāmadhye muhūrte vai jñānayogau lalābha ca || 101 ||
pūjito vandito dattātreyaśca bhagavān muhuḥ |
uvāca bahusantuṣṭaḥ pulakāṃcitavigrahaḥ || 1 02||
diṣṭyā kāśīpaterbhūribalasainyena tarjitaḥ |
yannimittamihāyātaḥ sa bhavatsaṃgado mama || 1 03||
dhanyo bhrātā subāhuśca yena jñāne suyojitaḥ |
diṣṭyā mātṛkṛtaṃ patra vācitaṃ ca mayā tathā || 1 04||
diṣṭyā tvatpādayugalaṃ sevitaṃ ca mayā tathā |
diṣṭyā tvaduktayaḥ sarvā mama cetasi susthirāḥ || 1 05||
diṣṭyā jñānaṃ mamotpannaṃ tava sādhoḥ samāgamāt |
diṣṭyā bhavatā karuṇā kṛtā bhagavatā mayi || 1 06||
so’haṃ tava prasādāgnirnirdagdhāhaṃmamādikaḥ |
brahmadhāma pragantuṃ vai yatiṣye rājyavartanāt || 1 07||
dattātreyastataḥ śiṣyaṃ prāha gaccha sukhī bhava |
nirmamo nirahaṃkārastathā cara vimuktaye || 1 08||
evamuktaḥ praṇamyainaṃ jagāma niśithe gṛham |
yatra kāśīpatiḥ rājā tathā subāhuragrajaḥ || 1 09||
tatra gatvā samuvāca bhujyatāṃ rājyamūrjitam |
yathā vā rocate tadvat subāhoḥ saṃprayaccha vā || 1.397.110 ||
kāśīrājastadā prāha kiṃ tyaktaṃ yuddhamantarā |
alarkaḥ prāha guruṇā granthayo nāśitā mama || 111 ||
dattātreyaprasādena bhedabhāvo nirākṛtaḥ |
mano brahmaṇi sandhāya tajjaye paramo jayaḥ || 11 2||
subāhuḥ prāha yasyārthaṃ tvāmahaṃ yoddhumāgataḥ |
tanmayā sakalaṃ prāptaṃ na me rājye prayojanam || 11 3||
kāśīrājastathā prāha jñānavairāgyayoḥ kṛte |
alarka tava mokṣārthaṃ mayā yuddhaṃ praghoṣitam || 1 14||
tatte jñānaṃ ca vairāgyaṃ samutpannaṃ vrajāmyaham |
upekṣyate sīdamānaḥ svajano bāndhavaḥ suhṛt || 1 15||
sa na proktaḥ svajanādirvācyaḥ sa tu janairbhavet |
phaladāyī satāṃ saṃgo mātrā te kathitaḥ khalu || 11 6||
tajanyabodhalābhena yatethāḥ śreyase nṛpa |
evamuktvotsavaṃ kṛtvā kāśīrājo yayau tataḥ || 1 17||
subāhurapi siddhārtho yayau svīyavanaṃ punaḥ |
alarkastu samuttīrṇo gāthāmetāmagāyata || 1 18||
aho kaṣṭaṃ mayā kīdṛg rājyaṃ garveṇa vartitam |
guroḥ kṛpayā vijñānaṃ yogānnāsti paraṃ sukham || 11 9||
ityuktvā ca nijaṃ putramabhiṣicya narādhipam |
vanaṃ jagāma santyaktasarvasaṃgaḥ pramuktaye || 1.397.1 20||
tataḥ kālena mahatā brahmanirvāṇamāptavān |
śravaṇātpaṭhanāccāsya brahmasāyujyamāpnuyāt || 121 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye’larkasya dattātreyopadeśe muktacaryā, yogināṃ mṛtyucihnāni, alarkasya vanavāsaḥ evamādinirūpaṇanāmā saptanavatyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||397||

<1.398>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
purā devayuge lakṣmi nārado munisattamaḥ |
sumeruśikhare gatvā dadarśa vedhaso gṛham || 1 ||
tasyottare pippaladruṃ yadadho divyamaṇḍapam |
padmarāgamaṇistaṃbhasahasrairupaśobhitam || 2 ||
kṛtasvastikamāṃgalyaṃ divyatoraṇaśobhitam |
puṣparāgamahādvāraṃ saptabhūmikagopuram || 3 ||
praviśyāsau dadarśāntardivyabhauktikamaṇḍapam |
tanmadhye vedikā tatra tuṃgāṣṭapādarājitam || 4 ||
siṃhāsanaṃ ca yanmadhye padmaṃ sahasrapatrakam |
tatrasamabhyāsīnaṃ ca sundaraṃ puruṣākṛtim || 5 ||
caturbāhuṃ śvetavarṇaṃ varāhāsyaṃ dadarśa saḥ |
śaṃkhacakrābhayavarān bibhrāṇaṃ puruṣottamam || 6 ||
pītāmbaradharaṃ devaṃ puṇḍarīkāyatekṣaṇam |
pūrṇendusaumyavadanaṃ kirīṭojjvalakāntikam || 7 ||
sāmadhvaniṃ yajñamūrtiṃ sruktuṇḍaṃ sruvanāsikam |
śrīvatsavakṣaḥsaṃśubhrayajñasūtravirājitam || 8 ||
kaustubhaśrīsamudyotaṃ svarṇabhūṣāvibhūṣitam |
kaṭakāṃgadakeyūrakuṇḍalojjvalitaṃ harim || 9 ||
nāradastamabhiṣṭūya sthito devasya sannidhau |
etasminnantare lakṣmi dharaṇī tatra cāgatā || 1.398.1 0||
ilāyā vai piṃgalayā sakhībhyāṃ hi samanvitā |
sarvābharaṇaśobhāḍhyā yuvatī tu sakhīyutā || 11 ||
nanāma pādamūle śrīharervikīrya mastake |
puṣpāṇi naikagandhāni kṛtāñjalipuṭā sthitā || 1 2||
tāṃ devīṃ śrīvarāho’pi hyāliṃgyāṃke nidhāya ca |
papraccha kuśalaṃ tasyāstathāgamanakāraṇam || 13 ||
pṛthvī prāha bhagavaṃste kṛpayā kuśalaṃ mama |
śrutaṃ mayā śeṣaśāyinārāyaṇamukhāt khalu || 14||
lakṣmīcchayā bhuvi jale pūrvaṃ vedavatī tu yā |
tatsthānaṃ tanmahattīrthaṃ draṣṭumicchāmi mādhava || 15||
tacchrutvā nāradaḥ prāha satyaṃ tadvai vasundhare |
tadetadahamaśrauṣaṃ satye vai munisaṃsadi || 16 ||
evamuktvā hariṃ natvā nārado badarīṃ yayau |
dharaṇī prāha bhagavam̐stasya sthānasya darśanam || 17| |
padminyā darśanaṃ kartumicchāmi te kṛpā yadi |
tathāstviti varāhastāmuktvā sasmāra pakṣiṇam || 18||
vainateyaḥ samāyāto divyadehena tatpuraḥ |
dharaṇīṃ saha nītvaiva vārāho bhagavān svayam || 19||
samāruroha garuḍaṃ prājagāma janisthalam |
vilokya padminīṃ chāyāṃ viyadrājasya kanyakām ||1.398.20||
nārāyaṇapuraṃ dṛṣṭvā yayau nārāyaṇācalam |
yatra śeṣācalaścādriḥ sarvātiśayapāvanaḥ ||21 ||
aruṇādrirhastiśailaḥ suvarṇamukharī nadī |
tasyāśca hyuttare tīre kamalākhyaṃ sarovaram ||22||
tattīre bhagavānāste śukasya varado hariḥ |
sarasaścottare pārśve haricandanaśobhitaḥ ||23 ||
śrīveṃkaṭācalo nāma vāsudevālayo giriḥ |
yojanadvayavistīrṇaḥ śailo’rdhayojanocchritaḥ || 24||
indrādyā devatāvrātā vaśiṣṭhādyā munīśvarāḥ |
siddhāḥ sādhyāśca maruto vaiṣṇavā bhagavatpriyāḥ ||25||
rambhādyā apsaraḥsaṃghā vasanti niyatāḥ sadā |
tapaścaranti nāgāśca garuḍāḥ kinnarādayaḥ |||26 ||
nārāyaṇagirau lakṣmi svāmipuṣkariṇī śubhā |
asyāstu paścime tīre vārāho dharaṇīyutaḥ | | 27||
garuḍādavatīryaiva nivāsamakaroddhariḥ |
āste’syā dakṣiṇe tīre śrīnivāso jagatpatiḥ | |28||
śrībhūmisahitaścāhaṃ tatra vasāmi padmaje |
kṛteṃ’janādriṃ tretāyāṃ nārāyaṇagiriṃ jaguḥ || 29||
dvāpare sihaśailaṃ ca kalau śrīveṃkaṭācalam |
pravadanti surāstaṃ ca paramātmālayaṃ girim || 1.398.3 0||
svāmipuṣkariṇī tīre paścime lokapūjite |
āste varāhavadano śeṣādrau vṛṣabhācale || 21 ||
tatra viśrāntimāsādya nārāyaṇagirau kṣitiḥ |
varāharūpiṇaṃ devaṃ sakhībhiḥ saṃyutā dharā || 2 2||
papraccha parayā prītyā lakṣmīchāyāṃ vilokya sā |
veṃkaṭākhye mahāśaile śrīnivāso jagatpatiḥ || 23 ||
kadā cakṣuṣpathe yāti śrībhūmisahitaḥ prabhuḥ |
śrīvarāho dharāmāha purāvṛttaṃ śṛṇu priye ||24||
pūrve kṛtayuge tvatra vāyordṛṣṭvā mahattapaḥ |
āgacchacchrīnivāso hi śrībhūmisahitaḥ prabhuḥ || 35||
dakṣiṇe’smin puṇyatame svāmipuṣkariṇītaṭe |
harirvāyoḥ priyakaro hyānandākhyavimānake ||36 ||
ākalpāntamadṛśyo’smin vimāne vartate hariḥ |
yo’sti vaikuṇṭhadhāmā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||37||
dharaṇyāha kadā kṛṣṇaḥ kathaṃ dṛśyo bhavediti |
agastyaṛṣirāṭ taṃ ca yāceta yadi bhāvataḥ || 38||
tadā sarvasya viṣayaścakṣuṣoḥ syāt śriyaḥ patiḥ |
itiśrutvā dharāgastyaṃ sasmāra so’pi cāyayau |||39||
ārādhya paramātmānaṃ prīṇayitvā punaḥ punaḥ |
yayāce lokalābhārthaṃ bhavān dṛśyo bhavatviti ||1.398.40||
evamukto hṛṣīkeśaḥ śrībhūmisahitaḥ prabhuḥ |
sarveṣāṃ netraviṣayo hyabhavat sa kṛpālayaḥ ||41 ||
munistaddarśanaṃ kṛtvā prītaḥ prāyāt svamāśramam |
vimānaṃ vidyamānaṃ ca na tu dṛśyaṃ kadācana ||42||
tataścaturbhujo devaḥ sadā dṛśyo hi vartate |
pṛthvī taddarśanaṃ kṛtvā kṛtakṛtyā vyajāyata ||43||
atha somakulotpanno mitravarmā mahārathaḥ |
tuṇḍīramaṇḍale rājā nārāyaṇapure’bhavat || 44||
tasmin śāsati bhūlokaṃ dharmeṇa mitravarmaṇi |
akṛṣṭapacyā pṛthivī sarvasasyānvitābhavat ||45||
nirītiko’bhavatsarvo jano bhaktisamanvitaḥ |
tasya patnī samabhavat pāṇḍyakanyā manoramā ||46||
tasya jajñe kulottaṃso viyannāmā sutaḥ śubhaḥ |
tasya patnī ca dharaṇī nāmnāsīcchuddhavaṃśajā ||47||
viyati rājyamādhāya mitravarmā tu vaiṣṇavaḥ |
yayau tapovanaṃ puṇyaṃ veṃkaṭādreḥ samīpataḥ ||48||
viyannāmā sārvabhaumaścaikapatnīvrato’bhavat |
dharaṇīlagnacetāḥ sa śodhayāmāsa bhūtalam ||49||
yajñārthaṃ ca kāñcanena halena suviśālakam |
bhūtale kṛṣyamāṇe tu viyatā bhūbhṛtā svayam ||1.398.50 ||
bījamuṣṭiṃ vikiratā dṛṣṭā kanyā dharodgatā |
gahvaraṃ vivaraṃ channaṃ tatrāsīd bhavanātmakam ||5 1 ||
āpyāyanānilajuṣṭaṃ sugandhiprasaracchubham |

śayyāyāṃ rājatī putrī suvarṇanirmitā yathā |
ākāśarājñā saṃdṛṣṭā vismayotphullacakṣuṣā ||55||

abhavat kausumirvṛṣṭirdevoktavijayadhvaniḥ |

devadattāmimāṃ paśya bhūtalādutthitāṃ mama |
āvayostadaputrayoḥ putrīyaṃ bhavitā dhruvam ||1.398.60||
ityuktvā pradadau patnyā haste prītyā viyannṛpaḥ |

kimiyaṃ devamātā vā vedamātā ca vā satī |

prabhā vā māṇikī gaṃgā śacī vā kiṃ sarasvatī |
rādhā vā lalitā sītā jayā vā vijayā kimu ||63 ||
ekādaśī jayantī dyauḥ kimvahalyā pativratā |
kimu brāhmī mahālakṣmīrmadarthaṃ kiṃ samāgatā ||64||

svakarasthāṃ viṣṇupatnīṃ bālāṃ dṛṣṭvā kṣitiḥ svayam |
mumoda tāṃ nicikṣepa pādayormādhavasya vai ||68||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastāṃ tu gṛhītvā yuvatīmayīm |
punardadau dharaṇyai ca jagād bhagavāna svayam ||69||
rakṣayaināmahaṃ tatrāgatya śrīveṃkaṭācalāt |
udvahiṣye vidhipūrvaṃ tāvatsevāṃ karotu vai ||1.398.70 ||
ityuktā sā dharaṇī tāṃ kare kṛtvā pratiṣṭhati |
tāvattejaśca vaikuṇṭhaṃ sarvaṃ tirobabhūva ha ||71 ||
dharaṇistvabhavattuṣṭā jagāda viyate tadā |
viyadrājāpi divyāṃ śrīchāyāṃ jñātvā tutoṣa ha ||72||
mātā putrīṃ śriyaṃ matvā nityaṃ sevāṃ karoti hi |
devatāścāpi muktāścāyānti draṣṭuṃ divāniśam ||73 ||
pūjayanti tathā tāṃ ca natvā natvā prayānti vai |
dharaṇyāśca gṛhaṃ svargādadhikaṃ viśrutaṃ babhau ||74||
kanyālābhe samakāle yajñasaṃkalpapuṇyataḥ |
ākāśarājabhāryā sā dharaṇī garbhamādadhe ||75||
viyannṛpaśca suprīto vīkṣya dauhṛdalakṣaṇām |
uvāca phalitā subhru latā sāntānikī ca me ||76 ||
atha kāle gate patnī dharaṇī suṣuve sutam |
supraśaste muhūrte ca meṣasthe ca divākare ||77| |
sutejaskaṃ svarṇavarṇaṃ devatulyaṃ tu bālakam |
dṛṣṭvā tu dharaṇī rājā mumudāte’ti tāvubhau ||78| |
dadaturbahudānāni ratnahastigavādikam |

apradhṛṣyo’jayya āsīd duḥsaho durnirīkṣyakaḥ |
taṃ tu putraṃ mahābhāgyaṃ dṛṣṭvā rājā tu vaiṣṇavīm ||85||
samantrāṃ kṛṣṇanāmnā vai dīkṣāṃ dadau bhavāpahām |
atha putrīṃ padmatulyāṃ padmāmivāparāṃ śubhām ||86 ||

ārāme viharantīṃ ca kīrakokilanādite |
yadṛcchayāgatastatra nārado sarvavittamaḥ ||88||

nanāma devīṃ papraccha kāsi kasyāsi vai sutā ||89||

gulphau gūḍhau samo cāpyujjvalau vartulasūnnatau ||95 ||

jānunī samasusnigdhe samābūrū kramapṛthū ||96 ||
samau hastikarābhyāṃ vai komalau candraśītalau |
sarvātiśayarūpāḍhyau komalau cikkaṇau tathā ||97||
nitambau pṛthulau pīnau samaghaṭṭanakau yataḥ |
sakthimūle komale ca rūparūpātiśālinī || 98||
jaghanaṃ liṃgarekhāḍhyaṃ madhyaṃ svarṇasamojjvalam |
nābhiḥ samaṇḍalā nimnā trivalīrekhayānvitā ||99||
pārśvau śubhrau medurau ca sthalapadmadalopamau |
udaraṃ trivalīramyaṃ romarājisuśobhitam || 1.398.100 ||
stanau pīnau ghanau snigdhāvunnatau magnacūcukau |
karau te raktapadmābhau padmarekhāsamanvitau || 101 ||
susūkṣmau raktasatparvanirantarasamāṃgulī |
candratulyasuśuklābhau madhyaraktasusaṃbhṛtau || 1 02||
dīrghau ca komalau kanye bhujau te puṣpadaṇḍabhau |

samaṃ kammānikollekhyaṃ sarvabhāgyavirājitam || 1 08||

gaṇḍe tu dakṣiṇe cātha lalāṭe madhyadeśake |

chatracihnamūrdhvarekhā kamalaṃ phaṇake tathā |

nāmnāṃ na me prasaṃkhyānaṃ pāvanānāṃ tu kanyakāḥ |

śaṃkhadhvaniryatkṛto dārayatyarisamūhakān || 145||

so’haṃ veṃkaṭaśailastho mṛgayārthamupāgataḥ |
mayāpyanudrutaḥ śveto gajātmā mṛgayūthapaḥ || 147||

samāgacchaṃ samapaśyaṃ subhagāṃ padminīmimām || 148||
mṛgaṃ tyaktvā mṛgīṃ prāpto mayā kiṃ labhyate nviyam |
iti kṛṣṇavacaḥ śrutvā kruddhāstāḥ prāhuraśvinam || 149||
gaccha śīghraṃ vanādasmānmā vadaivaṃ kadācana |
ākāśarājaḥ śrutvā tvāṃ nigaḍe bandhayiṣyati || 1.398.150 ||
yathānāmaguṇo bhāsi kṛṣṇaścāntarbahiḥ khalu |
yāhi divyāṃ parakanyāṃ yācase kiṃ na lajjase || 151 ||
sarvā militvā cātraiva bandhayiṣyāma eva hi |
tāḍayiṣyāma evātra yenāvocaḥ punarna tat || 152||
tarjitastābhirevaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ |
hayamāruhya sandṛṣṭvā kaṭākṣeṇa yayau girim || 153||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye merau bhūnāradābhyāṃ varāhāvatāradarśanaṃ kṛtam, lakṣmīchāyāyā janmasthalaṃ nārāyaṇapuraṃ garuḍenāgatya dṛṣṭaṃ, pṛthivīgarbhātpadminyā utpattiḥ, viyannāmarājñā sā vardhitā, vasudānaḥ sutaśca jajñe, nāradena cihnairlakṣmīsamāsītyuktaṃ, udyāne’śvārūḍho nārāyaṇa āgatya paricayaṃ datvā veṃkaṭādriṃ yayau cetyādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭanavatyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||398||

<1.399>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ divyāṃ ramyāṃ pūrvabhavāṃ śubhām |
ahaṃ tamaśvamārūḍho gatvā śrīveṃkaṭācalam || 1 ||
hayāttasmādavatīrya viveśa mama maṇḍapam |
śrīnivāsābhidhaścāhaṃ pañca kakṣā atītya ca || 2 ||
muktāgṛhaṃ samāsādya mañce viveśa tāṃ smaran |
ahaṃ sa vivaśo bhūtvā śrīnivāso muhurmuhuḥ || 2 ||
sasmāra padminīṃ patnīṃ pūrvāṃ madarthanirmitām |
śrīnivāsaḥ prabhustatra nidrāṃ lebhe manāṅ na vai || 4 ||
madhyāhnasamaye jāte sakhī bakulamālikā |
bhojyaṃ bhakṣyaṃ pāyasānnaṃ miṣṭaṃ sugandhamodanam || 5 ||
vyañjanāni sūpatakre pūrikā vaṭikā rasān |
apūpān vaṭakān pūrṇapolikā dadhi sarpiṣā || 6 ||
miśritaṃ śarkarābhiśca kadalādirasānakam |
mahatpātre nidhāyaiva devaṃ iṣṭaṃ samāgatā || 7 ||
anyāḥ sakhyaścitrarekhā navaraṃgā ca mālatī |
kamalā kiṃśukī kalpalatā cānyā jalādikam || 8 ||
tāmbūlaṃ vyajanaṃ naktakottamaṃ candanaṃ phalam |
gṛhītvā cāyayuryatra śrīnivāso virājate || 9 ||
bakulamālikā kṛṣṇaṃ vavande bhaktibhāvataḥ |
dhyāyantaṃ cāpūrvarūpaṃ vyājahāra hariṃ sakhī || 1.399.1 0||
uttiṣṭha devadeveśa bhoktumāgaccha mādhava |
kathaṃ vā dṛśyase tvārto yāvadārtiharo hariḥ || 11 ||
vane mṛgayāvyājena dṛṣṭavānasi kiṃ navam |
avasthā cintayānasya sphuṭaṃ vadati hṛdgatam || 1 2||
kā dṛṣṭā devakanyā vā mānuṣī vāhiputrikā |
brūhi no bhagavam̐ścittasthitāṃ tāṃ cittahāriṇīm || 1 3||
ityākarṇya śrīnivāso niḥśvāsaṃ samarecayat |
uvāca tāṃ sakhīṃ tatra vihasya puruṣottamaḥ || 14||
purāyuge mahāduṣṭaṃ rāvaṇaṃ hatavānaham |
tadā vedavatī dāsī sītāsāhāyyadābhavat || 15||
sītārūpābhavallakṣmīrjanakasya mahītalāt |
mayā rāmeṇa labdhā sā tataḥ pañcavaṭīvane || 16 ||
rākṣaso rāvaṇastāṃ tu hartuṃ samāyayau yadā |
tadāgnideva evaināṃ svāhāyāṃ sannivi śya ca || 17||
tasyāḥ sthāne tatsvarūpāṃ kanyāṃ vedavatīṃ nyadhāt |
ninye vedavatīṃ rakṣo rāmastaṃ nijaghāna ca || 18||
agnau vedavatīṃ kṣiptvā prāpya satyāṃ tu jānakīm |
kṛtakṛtyo’bhavaṃstatra tadā vahniruvāca mām ||1 9||
iyaṃ vedavatī kanyā sītāyāḥ priyakāriṇī |
sītārthaṃ rākṣasahaste gatā duḥkhamahārṇave ||1.399.20 ||
tasmādenaṃ vareṇaiva prīṇaya sītayā saha |
iti vahnivacaḥ śrutvā sītāpi māṃ jagāda ha ||21 ||
madarthaṃ duḥkhamāpteyaṃ sakhī vedavatī mama |
tasmātparāṃ bhāgavatīṃ devaināṃ varaya prabho || 22||
tadā mayā pratijñātaṃ variṣye tava vākyataḥ |
ākāśabhūpakanyāṃ vai padminīṃ śrīsvarūpiṇīm || 23||
tāvadeṣā śriyo dāsī sakhīrūpā hi vartatām |

adya nārāyaṇapure saṃbhūtā dharaṇītalāt ||26||
lakṣmīsamā padmanetrī vane puṣpāṇi cinvatī |
mayā vane tu sā dṛṣṭā rūpānurūpasundarī ||27||
cittaṃ tatra ca me lagnaṃ tasyā yogaṃ hi kāraya |
gaccha tatra vilokyaiva yogyāṃ madarthamāvaha ||28||
ityuktā bakulā prāha gacchāmi yatra sāsti hi |

nārāyaṇastadā prāha śrīnṛsiṃhaguhā yataḥ |
tanmārgeṇāvatīryāsmānnārāyaṇagirestataḥ ||1.399.30||
agastyāśramamāsādya suvarṇamukharītaṭe |
agastyeśaṃ prapūjyaiva gaccha kīravanaṃ tataḥ ||3 1 |
agre padmasaro nāma padmaśobhitatattaṭe |

uttamaḥ puruṣaḥ kaścidāgataḥ kanyakāṃ prati |

ityuktaḥ sa nṛpaścāsmān preṣayāmāsa mandiram ||47||
mahāpūjādisaṃbhārānpuṣpādīn cinumo’tra vai |

dharaṇīṃ draṣṭukāmāhaṃ draṣṭuṃ śakyā bhavenna vā ||49 ||
sakhyaḥ prāhuḥ sahāgacchāsmābhirvilokayiṣyase |

vadāmi satyaṃ śṛṇuta bhūtaṃ bhavan bhaviṣyakam ||51 ||
dharaṇī tāṃ tathā śrutvā pṛcchecchukī puraḥsthitā |

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi śrīnivāso veṃkaṭādrau nijāṃ priyām |
śriyaṃ lakṣmīṃ tathānyāśca sakhīrāhūya cāvadat || 1 ||

vyomamārgābhisaṃvyāptāṃ tasthau śrībhagavān kṣaṇam |||36 ||
tāvatā lokarītyaiva puryāḥ pradakṣiṇāya sā |
padminī hastisaṃrūḍhā gatvā cāgatya gopuram || 37||
ābhimukhyena devasya pratīkṣāyuksthitābhavat |
atha vāṭyodyānataḥ śrīnivāso gopuraṃ yayau ||38||
kare mālāṃ samāgṛhṇan garuḍārūḍha īśvaraḥ |
gajasthā padminī haste mālāṃ kṛtvābhyasaṃcarat ||39||
mukhonmukhaṃ militvā tau mālādvayaṃ sumūlyakam |
parasparaṃ dadatuśca kaṇṭhayostau vadhūvarau ||1.400.40||
ālokyākāśarājo’pi jaharṣa saha bandhubhiḥ |
viṣṇurmālāṃ svakaṇṭhasthāṃ mumoca padminīgale ||41 ||
padminīmallikāmālāṃ viṣṇoḥ kaṇṭhe samārpayat |
evaṃ trivāraṃ tau kṛtvā yayaturmaṇḍapagṛham |||42||
sthitvā pīṭhe kṣaṇaṃ paścād gṛhaṃ viviśatuḥ śubham |
viśrāntiṃ jalapānaṃ ca laukikācāramityatha |||43 ||
satkāraṃ pūjanaṃ sākṣatacandrakavibhūṣaṇam |
varārthe kārayitvā ca maṇḍape vedikāntikam ||44||
varaṃ rājānayāmāsa pūjanaṃ pracakāra saḥ |
brahmā tatrābhavanmukhyo vivāhavidhikārakaḥ ||45||
māṃgalyasūtrabandhādisāṃkurārpaṇamityapi |
prakoṣṭhe ca kāmaphalabandhanaṃ pracakāra saḥ ||46 ||
vahniṃ prajvālayāmāsāhavanīyaṃ tu padmajaḥ |
svastivācanamāṃgalyaślokā gīyanta eva ca ||47||
padminīṃ varato labdhairvastrābhūṣaṇahārakaiḥ |
śṛṃgārayitvā tvanayanmaṇḍapaṃ varasannidhau ||48||
varaṃ natvā niṣasāda mālāṃ gale samarpya sā |
vāme sthitvā saha patyā pūjāhomau cakāra ca ||49||
varamālā guruṇā sā dvayoḥ kaṇṭhe tadā kṛtā |
catuḥpradakṣiṇīkṛtya vahniṃ homaṃ pracakratuḥ ||1.400.50||
parasparaṃ kṛtavantau kavalaprāśanaṃ tadā |
raṃgajale suvarṇasyormikāyāḥ khelanaṃ tathā ||51 ||
puṣpagulālayoścāpi kṣepaṇaṃ ca parasparam |
pracakratustato mantrāḥ sahadāmpatyabodhakāḥ ||52||
brāhmaṇairāvṛtāstatra sadrāgairvaidikaiḥ śubhāḥ |
viṣṇoḥ kare karaṃ datvā kanyādānaṃ nṛpo’karot ||53||
viṣṇuḥ priyāṃ navāṃ prāpya pulakāñcitaromavān |
sadyojātastadā kanyāprakoṣṭhaḥ svedavānabhūt ||54||
yautakaṃ tu tadā kanyāpakṣaḥ kanyākare dadau |
varapakṣo varahaste dadau svarṇaṃ dhanaṃ bahu ||55||
ratnāni ca maṇīn hārān mauktikān bhūṣaṇāni ca |
anyānyapi sukauśeyānyambarāṇi rasānapi ||56||
daduścānye yathāśaktirdevarṣimānavādayaḥ |
svasvapradeśaratnāni yānavāhanapātrakam ||57||
divyavastu sugandhādi brahmavallyādikā daduḥ |
evaṃ brahmā sabṛhaspatikastatrāśiṣo dadau ||58||
vaivāhikaṃ kārayitvā lājāhomāntamityatha |
vratādeśaṃ samājñāya śayāte padminīharī ||59||
caturthe divase’samāpayat sarvaṃ caturmukhaḥ |
viyadrājā navaṃ nityaṃ navaṃ pakvānnabhojanam ||1.400.6 0 ||
kārayāmāsa sadbhaktyā vaiṣṇavānprāṇato’dhikān |
yeṣāṃ yeṣāṃ śarīrāṇāṃ yadyad bhojyaṃ nisargajam ||6 1 ||
tebhyastebhyastathā datvā parāṃ tṛtimakārayat |
vividhāni ca peyāni madhurāmblāni saṃdadau ||62||
tāmbūlādimukhaśuddhisādhanāni dadau tathā |
evaṃ sevāprakāraiśca rājñā tu viyatā hariḥ ||63||
harayaḥ koṭisaṃkhyāśca surarṣimunimānavāḥ |
devā devyo rañjitāśca dāsadāsīprasevakaiḥ ||64||
atha brahmā viyadrājamanujñāpya tathā dharām |
śrīlakṣmīpadminīyuktamāropya garuḍe harim ||65||
gantuṃ pracakrame yāvanmahīmānairyutastadā |
viyadrājā dharaṇī ca vasudānaśca netrayoḥ ||66 ||
kanyāviyogajavāriyuktā jātāḥ kṣaṇaṃ tathā |
padminī jananīpādau spṛṣṭvā kiñcid ruroda ha ||67||
āgantavyamiti procya samāśliṣya ca vakṣasi |
yayau punargaruḍe sā tadābhūttu jayadhvaniḥ ||68||
vādyaśabdo mahānāsīt sūtamāgadhabandinaḥ |
jayaśabdān pracakruśca nedurdundubhayo’mbare ||69||
evaṃ varātikā viṣṇoryayau śrīveṃkaṭācalam |
gṛhe viśaśramuḥ sarve tarpitā jalabhojanaiḥ ||1.400.70||
atha gantumanasaste tuṣṭuvuḥ puruṣottamam |
śukādayo munivṛndā brahmādyā devatāgaṇāḥ ||71 ||
viyadrājñā preṣitaṃ ca svarṇasihāsanaṃ varam |
putrīviṣṇvoḥ priyārthaṃ ca svarṇakusūlataṇḍulāḥ ||72||
mudgapātrāṇyanekāni ghṛtakuṃbhāyutāni ca |
divyāni cūtakadalīnālikeraphalāni ca ||73 ||
dhātrīphalāni kūṣmāṇḍarājarambhāphalāni ca |
śarkarāpeṭikā maṇimuktā gāḥ koṭiśastathā ||74||
haṃsenduśuklavājinaścaturdantagajādayaḥ |
antaḥpuracarā nāryaḥ sevikāścāpyanekaśaḥ ||75||
idṃ sarvaṃ maṇḍape yatkanyādānottaraṃ hṛdā |
saṃkalpitaṃ ca tatsarvaṃ preṣitaṃ tena tatkṣaṇam ||76 ||
hṛdā sa varayāmāsa prasannatāṃ hareḥ sadā |
sevāṃ caraṇayorbhaktiṃ nānyallokasukhādikam ||77||
kanyāpakṣāśca ye prāghūrṇikāste bhojitārcitāḥ |
viyadrājño’numatyā ca yayurlokān svakān punaḥ ||78||
atha śrīveṃkaṭanāthaḥ surādikān samarcya vai |
pūjayitvā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhūmnaḥ pareśvarān ||79||
virāḍādyānṛṣīnpitṝnmānavān jaḍacetanān |
svalokagamanāyaivamanumene tataśca te ||1.400.80||
jagmurnatvā hariṃ dāsā dāsyaḥ sarvā hi sṛṣṭayaḥ |
yaśo jagurbhagavataḥ padminībhāgyameva ca ||8 1 ||
vedavatī tu yā chāyā sītāṃ prasevya sā khalu |
apadmāpyabhavatpadmā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapriyā ||82||
yā ye bhaktiṃ prakurvanti prāṇān samarpya sā yathā |
tāste padmeva jāyante kṛṣṇabhaktā hi śāśvatāḥ ||83 ||
gateṣu teṣu sarveṣu padminyā ca śriyā yutaḥ |
lakṣmyā ca ramayā yukto reme śrībhagavān sadā ||84||
āste ca sarvadā kṛṣṇaḥ svāmipuṣkariṇītaṭe |
veṃkaṭādrau kvacit sākṣād divyālaye bhavatyapi ||85||
padminīsahito nāthaḥ kvacicchriyānvitaḥ prabhuḥ |
kvacillakṣmyā ca sahito ramayā sahitaḥ kvacit ||86 ||
bakulamālikādyābhiḥ kvacid veṃkaṭaparvate |
viharatyeva bhagavān svāminārāyaṇo hariḥ ||87||
pativratāśca tāḥ sarvā bhagavatyarpitāḥ sadā |
patnyaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ prasevante hṛdā dehena karmabhiḥ ||88||
padminī padmavāsinyāḥ patiṃ tvāsādya sevate |
prātaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ sadā pūrvaṃ samutthāya prasevate ||89||
pādasaṃvāhanaṃ cāṃgamardanaṃ prakaroti ca |
śayane śrīnivāsaṃ ca toṣayatyeva sevayā ||1.400.90||
āśleṣaṃ cūmbanaṃ kāmaṃ dadātyeva patīṣṭadam |
athotthāya śayanāt saḥ prakṣālya karamānanam ||91 ||
jalamuṣṇaṃ karotyeva bhagavatsnānaśuddhaye |
snātvā dadāti śuddhāpaḥ karānanaviśuddhaye || 92||
dantadhāvanamārdraṃ ca sarasaṃ pāyasaṃ dravam |
datvā sugandhacūrṇaṃ ca dadāti sajalaṃ ghaṭam ||93||
hariḥ śaucādikaṃ kṛtvā prakṣālya ca mṛdā karau |
gaṇḍūṣān sa vinirvartya snāti suvarṇapaṭṭake ||94||
padminī śrīhareraṃgeṣvāmṛdya gandhacūrṇakam |
tilapiṣṭaṃ puṣpasāraṃ sugandhitailaprabhṛti ||95|||
datvāmṛtairjalairdevaṃ patiṃ snāpayati priyā |
mārjayati jalaṃ vastrairdhautraṃ dadāti sundaram || 96||
uttarīyaṃ dadātyeva yajñapaṭṭaṃ ca sūtrakam |
āsanaṃ tvācamanārthaṃ jalaṃ dadāti śārṅgiṇe ||97||
dadāti kajjalaṃ netre bhāle puṣṭaṃ sacandrakam |
karṇayoḥ kuṇḍale binduṃ dadāti daṇḍake tathā ||98||
keśānprasādhya taile ca datvā kṛtvā sucandanam |
mukuṭaṃ pradadātyeva hārān suvarṇaratnajān ||99||
kaṇṭhe dadāti kṛṣṇasya bāhvoḥ prakoṣṭhayostathā |
karayoḥ kaṭakau hārau śṛṃkhale valayau tathā || 1.400.10 0||
pradadātyūrmikā aṃguliṣu kaṭyāṃ suśṛṃkhalām |
pādayornūpure ramye kiṃkiṇīśabdagarjite || 101 ||
vastropānadvarau caraṇayordadāti padminī |
naktakaṃ ca kare yaṣṭiṃ kānakīṃ mālikāṃ śubhām || 1 02||
chatraṃ ca cāmaraṃ caiva tathā śṛṃgāravastukam |
dadāti vyajanaṃ cādarśakaṃ siṃhāsanaṃ tathā || 103 ||
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ tvabīraṃ cākṣatān puṣpāṇi patrakam |
dalaṃ jalaṃ phalaṃ bhojyaṃ naivedyaṃ madhuraṃ bahu || 1 04||
yathāruci payo miṣṭaṃ dadhiṃ madhuṃ ca śarkarām |
tāmbūlaṃ peyamevādibhakṣyaṃ cūrṇādikaṃ śubham || 1 05||
polikāḥ pūrikāścāpi saṃyāvaṃ ghṛtapūrakān |
parpikān granthakām̐ścāpi pūpānapūpakām̐stathā || 1 06||
bharjakān laḍḍukām̐ścāpi sukhadāṃ saktukaṃ tathā |
odanaṃ caṇakām̐ścāpi mudgān sūpaṃ ghṛtādikam ||1 07||
āranālām̐stakradugdhadadhiphalarasām̐stathā |
dadāti bhojanārthaṃ sā śrīnivāsāya nityadā || 1 08||
jalaṃ pānārthamanyacca bhakṣyaṃ kandaphalādikam |
dadāti vastraśuddhyādi karoti kṣālanādikam || 109||
ārārtrikaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ daṇḍavat stavanādikam |
namaskārān karotyeva madhyāhne’pi tathā niśi || 1.400.110 ||
evaṃ sadānuvṛttyā sā sevate śrīḥ ramā yathā |
yathā lakṣmīḥ sevate ca tathā sevāparāyaṇā || 111 ||
nārāyaṇaṃ hariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kāṃbhareyaṃ pumuttamam |
śrīnivāsaṃ veṃkaṭeśaṃ padminīsvāminaṃ prabhum || 112||
svayaṃ prasevate dāsīśateṣu satsvapi priyā |
evaṃ sā janmasāphalyaṃ lebhe padmeva padminī || 11 3||
atha kṛṣṇo bakulāyai varadānamadāt khalu |
padminīvat variṣye tvāṃ tathā śrīveṃkaṭācale || 1 14||
sakhīmadhye kārayitvā vedīṃ sthitvā ca mādhavaḥ |
agnau homaṃ svayaṃ kṛtvā bakulākaramādade || 115||
padminīprāptisatkāryapratilābhaphalaṃ dadau |
patnīṃ cakāra bhagavān sakhīṃ bakulamālikām || 1 16||
sāpi pativratā nityaṃ dāsī ca kiṃkarī priyā |
sevate śrīhariṃ nityānandabhoktrī babhūva ha || 1 17||
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi vedavatyāḥ kathānakam |
pātivratyaparaṃ yā vai padminī dharaṇīsutā || 1 18||
bhūtvā tvavāpa deveśaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ gopālabālakam |
etadākhyānakaṃ śrutvā śrīkṛṣṇaṃ satpatiṃ labhet || 11 9||
sampatputrapatiprāptirdhanadhānyāmbarārjanam |
yaśaḥsattāpratiṣṭhādi śrutvedaṃ prāpyate dhruvam || 1.400.1 20||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye śrīnivāsabhagavatkṛtaḥ padminyā saha vivāhaḥ, vidhiḥ, yautakaṃ, pātivratyādi cetinirūpaṇanāmā catuḥśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||40 0||

<1.401>
śrīlakṣmīruvāca
bhagavan śrāvitaṃ mahyaṃ samākhyānaṃ sukhapradam |
vinā tvāṃ kaḥ samartho’sti bhaktecchāpūraṇāya vai | | 1 ||
pūrvaṃ kena kṛtaṃ te’tra darśanaṃ bhaktibhāvinā |
kena vā dṛśyate kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo dayālayaḥ || 2 ||
vimānaṃ cāpi devārthaṃ kaḥ kariṣyati bhāvini |
tānme sarvāṃścamatkārān śrīśasya vaktumarhasi || 3 ||
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi kathayāmi camatkārān purāgatān |
yacchrutvā ca bhaved bhaktirmayi raṃkasya cāpi vai || 4 ||
rājā dīnaḥ paśuḥ pakṣī naro nārī satī sutā |
yā me bhaktā mahābhāgavatīṃ tāṃ vidadhāmyaham || 5 ||
avaśyaṃ tu bhavitavyaṃ tena madīyakena vai |
matto yenecchanīyaṃ tu sukhaṃ śāśvatikaṃ priye || 6 ||
bhaviṣyantaṃ suvṛttāntaṃ pravadāmi nibodha me |
veṃkaṭādrau vasunāmā niṣādo bhaktimānmama || 7 ||
śyāmākakṣetrapālo’sau śyāmākajīvano’bhavat |
śyāmākataṇḍulān paktvā kṛtvā śarkarayānvitān || 8 ||
nivedya śrīnivāsāya śrībhūmisahitāya saḥ |
bhuṃkte bhāryāsahayutastataḥ kārye pravartate || 9 ||
evaṃ prasādabhakṣyeṇa pavitraḥ sarvadā śuciḥ |
vaiṣṇavaḥ paramo jāto bhāryāpi vaiṣṇavī hyabhūt || 1.401.10 ||
nāmnā citravatī sādhvī pātivratyaparāyaṇā |
devaṃ yadvat patiṃ tadvat sevate tadvaśā sadā || 11 ||
snāti pūjāṃ prakaroti japaṃ karoti śārṅgiṇaḥ |
kṛṣṇaṃ dhyāyati smarati mūrtīḥ śṛṇoti satkathām || 12||
patiṃ devaṃ samaṃ kṛtvā mānayitvā samaṃ sadā |
ubhayoḥ kiṃkarībhūtvā dāsyaṃ karoti sarvathā || 13||
madhyāhne ca niśi sāyaṃ prātarbhojanamīśvare |
samarpitaṃ jalaṃ puṣpaṃ sarvaṃ gṛhṇāti sā satī || 14||
dhanyā niṣādajātīyā brāhmī divyā hi vartate |
viprāṇīva sudharmiṣṭhā kulatrayasya tāriṇī || 15||
prāpte kāle putravatī babhūva bhāminī tataḥ |
vīrarudraitināma cakāra tasya vai pitā || 16 ||
vasuḥ putreṇa sahito bhāryayā bhaktibhaktayā |
modate svasya bhojyādau santuṣṭo devasevayā || 17||
athaikadā svakaṃ putraṃ śyāmākaṃ pālayeti ca |
visṛjya kṣetrarakṣārthaṃ patnīyukto vanaṃ yayau || 18||
madhumārgaṇakāryau tāvubhau bhramata ecchikam |
madhyāhne prāptavantau tau madhu puṣkalameva yat || 1 9||
madhyāhne bālakaḥ pakvaśyāmākaphālikāḥ śubhāḥ |
gṛhītvāgnau nidhāyaiva piṣṭvā vṛkṣatale mudā ||1.401.20||
parṇe nivedayāmāsa haraye bhojanaṃ jalam |
naivedyaṃ tatprasādaṃ ca bhojayitvāsa śāntitaḥ ||21 ||
tāvat tatpitarau miṣṭaṃ madhvādāya samāgatau |
śyāmākān bhakṣitān dṛṣṭvā santarjya sutameva tam ||22||
vasurdaṇḍaṃ samudyamya hantuṃ taṃ hastamuddadhe |
vīrarudrasya hṛdye sthito vai bhagavān svayam ||23||
daṇḍaṃ jagrāha hastena cāvirbhūya vasoḥ puraḥ |
daṇḍo gṛhītaḥ keneti vasuḥ kṛṣṇaṃ dadarśa ha ||24||
śaṃkhacakragadāpāṇiṃ divyatejomayaṃ vibhum |
vasurdaṇḍaṃ parityajya praṇamyovāca taṃ harim ||25||
kimidaṃ bhagavan putrarakṣārthaṃ tvaṃ samāgataḥ |
anena nāśitāḥ paśya pakvaśyāmākaphālikāḥ ||26||
daṇḍapātraṃ bhavatyeva punaḥ kuryānna tattathā |.
itiśrutvā hariḥ prāha putraste bhaktimān mayi |||27||
tvatto’pi me priyatamastasmād rakṣārthamāgataḥ |
śyāmākā bharjitāścūrṇīkṛtāḥ piṣṭāstataḥ param || 28||
naivedyaṃ me’rpayitvā sa bhuktavān bhaktarāṭ mama |
śyāmākānāṃ bījabhāvaṃ gatānāmātmanāṃ mayā ||29||
kṛtā muktistathā te’pi puṇyaṃ dattaṃ hi śāśvatam |
yadarpaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ mahyaṃ tvatkṛṣīyakaṇādikam ||1.401.3 0 ||
atra sarvatra tiṣṭhāmi mama bhaktasya sannidhau |
rakṣāṃ karomi bhaktasya jāgratau ca suṣuptike ||3 1 ||
divāniśaṃ bhaktarakṣākaro’smyeva vaso sadā |
svāmipuṣkariṇītīre ramye vasāmi sarvathā ||32||
ityuktvā bhagavān vasudattaṃ madhu sumiṣṭakam |
citravatyārpitaṃ bṛsyāsanaṃ phalajalādikam ||3 3||
gṛhītvā śrīnivāsaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayam |
prahasan vai tirobhūt te trayo vṛkṣatalaṃ śritāḥ ||34||
ityeva śrībhagavatā bhaktavaśyena padmaje |
sākṣāt svadarśanaṃ dattaṃ niṣādāya mahātmane ||35||
śṛṇu tvanyāṃ kathāṃ tatra yā jātā samaye tadā |
tāvat tatra samāyāto yātrikaḥ śūdravarṇakaḥ ||36||
mārgeṇa nirgato viṣṇubhaktaḥ pāṇḍyapradeśajaḥ |
dvādaśavarṣako bālaḥ papraccha vīrarudrakam ||37||
mārgo’yaṃ śrīnivāsasya tīrthaṃ gacchati kiṃ na vā |
mayā tīrthavidhānārthaṃ gantavyaṃ tatra vidyate ||38||
iti pṛṣṭvā śrīnivāsasthānasya vartmanā tu saḥ |
vīrapradarśitenāsau gatavān bhāvasaṃbhṛtaḥ ||39||
nārāyaṇapurīṃ prāpya śrīvarāhaṃ praṇamya ca |
hṛdi smṛtvā śrīnivāsaṃ veṃkaṭādrinivāsinam ||1.401.40 ||
suvarṇamukharīṃ prāpya snātvā cottīrya tāṃ tataḥ |
kamale sarasi snātvā tattīrasthaṃ hariṃ balam ||41 ||
namaskṛtya vanaṃ prāpya śeṣādriṃ tu yayau hi saḥ |
jalanirjharaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā kapilāpūjitaṃ śivam |||42||
pūjayitvā cakratīrthe snātvā śrīveṃkaṭācalam |
śanaiḥ śanairyayau bālaḥ samāruroha parvatam ||43 | |
svāmipuṣkariṇīṃ snātvā taṭe ciñcātaroradhaḥ |
vaikhānasena muninā gopīnāthena pūjitam ||44||
ākāśasthaṃ pītanīlākṛtiṃ śrībhūmisevitam |
śaṃkhacakragadākhaḍgapadmādihetiśobhitam |||45||

śrutvā bālo raṃgadāsastarormūle’vasat sudhīḥ ||48 ||

nityaṃ vṛkṣān śanaiśchittvā ciñcābhūruhamantarā |
ramāyāścampakataruṃ vihāya pārśvagān sthalīm ||1.401.50 ||
nirvṛkṣāṃ pracakārāsau raṃgadāso’tiśobhitām |

tatrābhitaḥ samudyānaṃ puṣpaphaladrumāśritam ||52 | |
cakāra karṇikāmallikābjamandāramālatī |
kundacampakatulasīḥ kadalīnavaraṃgakāna ||53 | |

ārāmapuṣpamālābhiḥ śrīnivāsamapūjayat |

kanyābhiḥ sundarībhiḥ suyuvatībhiḥ samaṃ tadā ||56| |

tatratthapūjakenoktaṃ kimadya cirakāryasi ||6 1 ||
na vaddhā mālikā mitra pūjākālo’pi nirgataḥ |

mama māyāvimohena mā lajjāṃ vaha bhaktarāṭ |

atraiva kuru sevāṃ tvamāśarīravimokṣaṇāt ||66 ||
ityuktvā śrīnivāsaśca viṣṇurjagrāha mālikām |
raṃgadāsaḥ pūjayitvārāmaṃ punaḥ samāyayau ||67||
sāgraṃ śatābdaṃ saṃjīvya sevitvā śrīnivāsakam |
śarīraṃ tadvihāyaiva jātaḥ somakule nṛpaḥ ||68||
jātismaro divyadṛṣṭistoṇḍamāniti nāmataḥ |
sauvīrākhyanṛpaputro nandinījananībhavaḥ ||6 9||
saḥ pañcavarṣakaścāsīd bhagavadbhaktisaṃbhṛtaḥ |
sarvabhaktipuṣṭidātṛsadguṇādisumaṇḍitaḥ ||1.401.70 ||

suvarṇamukharīṃ tīrtvā śukaṃ natvā ca reṇukām ||73 ||

kaṃcicchukaṃ pañcavarṇaṃ jighṛkṣustamanudrataḥ ||74||

svāmipuṣkariṇītīre sadāste harisannidhau ||78||

suśṛṃgārisanmūrtiṃ śrībhūyuktaṃ dadarśa ha |
valmīkagūḍhapādābjamājānupuruṣottamam ||8 1 ||
kṣetrapo bhūpatiścobhau vavandatuḥ praṇematuḥ |

dadau rājñe ca śiṣṭārdhaṃ tataḥ kṣetraṃ punaryayau |

caitraśuklanavamyāmānarca gatvā sa reṇukām |

māhātmyaṃ padmasarasaḥ śrutavān pāpanāśakam |

itiśrutvā yayau toṇḍī rājadhānīṃ pituḥ purīm | |88 ||
pitrābhiṣikto rājye sve vasunātha vasustataḥ |
vārāhavalmīkayātrākaraṇārthaṃ yayau mudā | |89 ||
tatra vārāhabhagavān rātrau nirgatya tatsthalāt |
śyāmākānatti cādṛśyo divā viśati tatsthale | | 1.401.90 ||
kṣetrapaḥ khanayāmāsa valmīkaṃ valmīkaṃ vīkṣya tattathā |
valmīkād vārāharūpo bhagavānutthito’bhavat | | 91 ||

ciñcāṃ ca campakaṃ cāyaṃ rarakṣa durgamadhyataḥ |
nityaṃ bilena cāgatya devaṃ natvā sa toṇḍamān | | 1.401.10 0||

vimānaṃ divyamevātra prākāre’kārayacchubham |

kāśīprabhṛtitīrthāni kṛtvā yāvannivartaye || 1.401.110 ||

viprasyāgamapūrvaṃ sā mṛtā jvareṇa pīḍitā |

gomatīṃ ceti tīrthāni kṛtvā tu caitrake hi saḥ |

dṛṣṭā rājñā mṛtā sā tu śīghraṃ bilena mandiram |
śrīveṃkaṭeśaṃ gatavān rājā prāha tadā harim || 1 18||

saṃśapsyati sa vipro māṃ kṛpāṃ kuru mamopari || 1 19||
śrīnivāsena saṃproktaṃ dattaṃ jalaṃ prasādajam |
dvādaśyāmasthisarasi snāpayaināṃ tataḥ khalu || 1.401.120||

śavaṃ nītvā nṛpastatrāyayau yatrāsthipalvalam || 121 ||
jalenāplāvya kuṇapaṃ rājā sasmāra tāṃ satīm |
tāvat divyaśarīrā sā nṛparājñyaparā yathā || 1 22||
samutthitā sagarbhā sā prasannā tadavasthikā |
ānīya śīghraṃ viprāya dadau vismayamāpa saḥ || 123 ||
na garbho galitaḥ so’yaṃ pratāpo’sti hareḥ khalu |

rājñā pradattadānādi gṛhītvā svagṛha yayau || 1 25||

atha kṛṣṇaḥ śrīnivāso rājānaṃ punarabravīt || 1 26||

kuru rājan yadyadiṣṭaṃ sarvaṃ te vai bhaviṣyati || 1 27||
