kākī bhavatu viṣṭhādā tena pāpena sā punaḥ |
valgulī bhavatu svasyā viṣṭhādādhomukhī sadā ||55||
tāḍitastu patistena pāpena gardabhī tathā |
pākabhāṇḍe bhojikā viṣṭhādā bhavatu sūkarī ||56||
sadā patyurdveṣakarī biḍālī cāstu vai tataḥ |
ātmaghātaḥ kṛtastasmāt pretāstu marubhūmigā ||57||
tataḥ piśācī bhūtvā ca bahupiśācakāminī |
bhavatvataḥ paraṃ duṣṭā rākṣasī pāpakāriṇī |||58||
evaṃ nyāyaṃ para śrutvā yamarājastu karmabhi |
yojayitvā ca māṃ tattajjanma pradattavān muhuḥ ||59||
tatsarvaṃ pārayitvāhaṃ rākṣasī duḥkhitābhavam |
nāsti me karmanistāro jāyate pāpakaṃ punaḥ ||1.424.60 ||
nityaṃ pāpena saṃliptā bhavāmi rākṣasī vane |
bhakṣayāmi paśūn pakṣivaryāṃśca mānavān vane ||6 1 ||
kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi nānto’sti mama karmaṇām |
iti śokānvitā kṣudhātṛṣābhyāṃ cātipīḍitā ||6 2 ||
vavalge’haṃ vaṇijaṃ vai taccharīre viveśa ha |
tena saha samāyātā deśaṃ vai dakṣiṇaṃ śubham ||63 ||
vaṇik sa tu papau vāri kṛṣṇāveṇyostu saṃgame |
saṃsthitastatra vai śrāntastāvad devāstaṭasthitāḥ ||64||
atāḍayan muhurmāṃ te dūraṃ cāhaṃ palāyitā |
kṣuttṛḍyuktā mārgayāmi pātraṃ vaṇiksamaṃ punaḥ ||65||
tāvad dṛṣṭo’si puṣṭo’si kṣunnivṛttirbhavenmama |
ityarthaṃ satvaraṃ dhartuṃ samāgatāsmi harṣitā ||66 ||
tāvat tvayā śrāvitaṃ vai harernāmātipāvanam |
siñcitaṃ vāri tulasīdalayuktaṃ sutīrthakam ||67||
tvādṛśabhaktavaryasya darśanaṃ pāvanaṃ mama |
tvatpādapadmarajasā pāvitā ca viśeṣataḥ ||68||
me’pi karmāṇi sarvāṇi manye’ntaṃ pragatāni vai |
pāpaṃ sarvaṃ gataṃ nāśaṃ puṇyaṃ me vardhate’dhunā ||6 9||
śāntirme hṛdaye jātā tṛptiśca jalasecanāt |
bhrāntiḥ sarvaḥ pramādaśca vahnirāntarajo gatāḥ ||1.424.7 0 ||
patiduḥkhapradaṃ pāpaṃ tīrthe’tra jaḍacetane |
naṣṭaṃ manye tava yogāt kuru me mokṣaṇaṃ dvija ||7 1 ||
yāhaṃ sāhaṃ kiṃkarī vā cāṇḍālī śvapacī ca vā |
duṣṭā raṇḍā nikṛṣṭā ca kṛpāpātraṃ tavāsmi vai | |72||
kṛpayā tīryate jantunātra pāpaṃ bhayaṃkaram |
satāṃ kṛpā paraṃ puṇyaṃ tanmūlaṃ sarvasukṛtam ||7 2 ||
satāṃ kṛpāṃ vinā tvanyat sukṛtaṃ tattu duṣkṛtam |
kṛpā puṇyaṃ kṛpā mokṣaḥ kṛpā svargaṃ sukhaṃ dhanam | |74| |
satāṃ kṛpā patisevā bahupuṇyena labhyate |
yasyā nāsti kāntasevā santaḥ sevyāḥ sadā tayā | |75||
yasyāḥ sevā satāṃ nāsti tayā sarvaṃ vināśitam |
svāmī sevyaḥ patiḥ sevyaḥ parameśvara eva saḥ ||76 ||
antataḥ prārthanīyaḥ kṣamāpanīyaḥ punaḥ punaḥ |
patireva paraṃbrahma śāśvataṃ puṇyameva saḥ | | 77||
patiḥ prāṇapradaḥ putraprado lokapradaḥ sadā |
svargadaḥ sukhadaścānandasya pradaḥ patirhariḥ ||78 ||
duḥkhaṃ harati nāryāśca svayaṃ sahate tatsthale |
kaṣṭāni dehajātāni puṇyaṃ tvardhaṃ dadāti ca ||79 ||
svārjitaṃ ca dhanaṃ puṇyaṃ balaṃ bījaṃ dadāti ca |
ko’nyastasmātparo bodhyaḥ saṃsāre parameśvaraḥ ||1.424.8 0 ||
patireva hi nārīṇāṃ paramaṃ daivataṃ tataḥ |
patiḥ sevyaḥ patiḥ pūjyaḥ patiḥ prāpyastapo’dhikaiḥ | |8 1 ||
anyathā rākṣasībhāvo nārīṇāṃ syāditi sthitiḥ |
ityuktvāha punaḥ kṛtyā yathoddhāro bhavenmama ||82 ||
avaśiṣṭaprapāpānāṃ vināśo’pi tathā bhavet |
tathā brahman kuru mokṣaṃ kalyāṇaṃ te bhaviṣyati | |8 3 ||
anāthāyāḥ samuddhartuḥ samuddhāro bhaviṣyati |
ityukto dharmadattaḥ sa dayāvān prahvamānasaḥ ||84||
provāca cintayitvā vai kalahāyai sukhapradam |
śṛṇu ramye vratatīrthadānaiḥ pāpālayo bhavet ||85|||
prārabdhasya sañcitānāṃ sukṛtairvilayo bhavet |
tvaṃ cāsi rākṣasī pretā dīnādau nādhikāriṇī ||86 ||
pretasya nādhikāro’sti tīrthadānavratādiṣu |
naivānyai kṣīyate karma rakṣaḥpretatvasaṃpradam ||87||
kintu hareḥ pātivratyaparaṃ vrataṃ kṛtaṃ mayā |
kārtikasya janmato vai tadardhaṃ te dadāmyaham ||88||
hareḥ pātivratyapuṇyaṃ tvapātivratyapāpaham |
ityuktvā jalamādāya dharmadattastu vaiṣṇavaḥ ||89||
tulasījalamiśraṃ tat tasyā upari cākṣipat |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya omiti bruvan ||1.424.90||
tāvat sā puṇyamādāya pretatvarahitā hyabhūt| |
kanyā divyā dvādaśābdā sarvasaundaryaśobhitā ||91 ||
vahnivastrā candrasamā kāntyā śāntyā virājitā |
bhūtvā nanāma vipraṃ ca samuvāca praharṣitā ||92||
tava viprakṛpāleśāt prasāditā ca saṃskṛtā |
tāritā ca tvayā kleśādgacchāmi bhagavatpadam |||93||
ityuktau jāyamānāyāṃ vimānaṃ divyamāgatam |
pārṣadadvayasaṃrājatpārṣadāṇīgaṇānvitam || 94||
pārṣadābhyāṃ samāhūtā kanyāruroha satvaram |
dharmadattena tau kṛṣṇapārṣadau vanditau tadā ||95||
pṛṣṭhau kāviti pratyuktiṃ śreṣṭhastaṃ prajagāda ha |
puṇyaśīlaḥ suśīlenānumataḥ prāgbhavādikam || 96||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasahitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne saurāṣṭre bhikṣupatnyāḥ kalahāyā apātivratyapāpena valgulīgardabhīsūkarībiḍālīpretārākṣasītvaṃ dharmadattavipradvārā nāmajapatulasījalādinā ca pāpanāśe mokṣaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā caturviṃśatyadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 424 ||

<1.425>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi puṇyaśīlo dvayorvṛttāntamāha yam |
viṣṇupātivratyaparaṃ pārṣadatvapradaṃ śubham || 1 ||
vimānastho viṣṇusevāparaḥ pārṣadapuṃgavaḥ |
puṇyaśīlo’smyahaṃ vipra suśīlo’yaṃ dvitīyakaḥ || 2 ||
tvayā yuktaṃ kṛtaṃ vipra tāriteyaṃ supuṇyataḥ |
asyā janmāntaraśatodbhayaṃ pāpaṃ layaṃ gatam || 3 ||
vaikuṇṭhaṃ nīyate sā ca viṣṇudāsī bhaviṣyati |
tvaṃ ca kārtikavratavān bhāryābhyāṃ saha bhūsura || 4 ||
kālāntare harerdhāma prayāsyasi supuṇyataḥ |
harivrataṃ sadā bhaktakṛtaṃ pativratāvratam || 5 ||
bhavatyeva na sandehaḥ puṇyadaṃ mokṣadaṃ vratam |
bahūnyabdasahasrāṇi puṇyaṃ bhuktvātra bhūtale || 6 ||
sūryavaṃśodbhavo rājā daśaratho bhaviṣyasi |
bhāryābhyāṃ sahitaścaiva ye sto vivāhite tava || 7 ||
iyaṃ tṛtīyā kalahā tava puṇyārdhabhāginī |
patnī bhavitā ca tadā viṣṇuryāsyati te gṛham || 8 ||
devakāryakaro bhūtvā prayāsyati svakaṃ padam |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ so’yaṃ rāmanāmā bhaviṣyati || 9 ||
ye tu rāmasya śaraṇaṃ yāsyanti bhūtale janāḥ |
te’pi muktiṃ prayāsyanti vāsudevapratāpataḥ || 1.425.10 ||
bhāvanā prema bhaktiśca snehaścārdratvamityapi |
viśiṣyate harau kriyātmakāt kāṇḍāditi sthitiḥ || 11 ||
karmaṇo jñānamutkṛṣṭaṃ jñānād dhyānaṃ tathottamam |
dhyānācca bhāvanā śreṣṭhā bhāvataḥ sneha uttamaḥ || 3 2||
sakāmasnehataḥ śreṣṭho niṣkāmaḥ sneha eva yat |
snehācchreṣṭhaḥ prahvībhāvastadrūpaṃ tadrasātmatā || 1 3|||
na tato’dhikamevāsti kiñcid vipra harau sadā |
śṛṇu tatra kathāṃ ramyāṃ dānād bhāvo viśiṣyate || 1 4||
kāñcīpuryāṃ purā rājā colanāmābhavad vratī |
vaiṣṇavo dānakṛd rakṣākaraḥ prajāsu vanditaḥ || 1 5||
devapūjākaro nityaṃ yadrājye sukhinī prajā |
tāmraparṇītaṭe yena yajñāśca bahavaḥ kṛtāḥ || 1 6||
vimānena sa nṛpatirlokāntaraṃ prayāti ca |
evaṃ vimānamāruhya yayau śvetākhyadhāma saḥ || 1 7||
tataḥ kṣīrābdhiśayanaṃ dhāma yogena saṃyayau |
anantaśayanaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ tu nidritam || 18||
cakāra daṇḍavattāvannārāyaṇaḥ samutthitaḥ |
śrīpatiṃ pūjyāmāsa maṇiyuktāphalādibhiḥ || 1 9||
supatraiśca suvarṇasya kusumairhīrakādibhiḥ |
dhūpadīpasunaivedyairvastrairvibhūṣaṇaistathā || 1.425.20 ||
divyaiḥ ratnāyutaiścāpi pupūja parameśvaram |
evaṃ sampūjya sannatvopaviṣṭaḥ sannidhau hareḥ ||2 1 ||
tāvattasyaiva rājyasya brāhmaṇo viṣṇudāyakaḥ |
tulasīṃ ca jalaṃ puṣpaṃ nītvā pūjārthamāgataḥ| ||22||
tenāpi śrīhareḥ pūjā kṛtā patrādivastubhiḥ |
hīrakādyāstayā channāḥ patrapuṣpādibhiḥ khalu |||23||
ācchādināṃ svakṛtpūjāṃ vilokya nṛpatistadā |
vipraṃ prāha kathaṃ svarṇamāṇikyādisuśobhitā ||24||
pūjā kṛtā mayā vipra tvayā vai chāditā dalaiḥ |
gauravaṃ naiva jānāsi na jānāsi prapūjanam ||25||
mūlyaṃ nāpi gaṇayasi śraiṣṭhyaṃ karoṣyanuttamam |
patrādikaṃ nikṛṣṭaṃ tu karoṣi tūttamaṃ dvija ||26 ||
ityuktaḥ sa dvijastatra caulaṃ prāha subhāvavān |
rājan viṣṇoḥ sadā pūjā bhāvanāsahitā priyā ||27||
garvayuktāhaṃkṛtisthā na priyā jāyate’nagha |
tvayā tu kriyate pūjā ratnasvarṇādipuṣpakaiḥ ||28||
mayāpi kriyate saiva tulasīdalavāribhiḥ |
mama pūjā tava pūjā bhāvanāto viśiṣyate ||29||
vada rājan nṛpalakṣmyā tvayā kiṃkiṃ kṛtaṃ vratam |
mayā kṛtaṃ na vai kiñcid vad tvaṃ cet kṛtaṃ mahat ||1.425.3 0||
tadā caulaḥ sagarvastu prāha vipraṃ kṛtaṃ tu yat |
mayā kṛtaṃ svarṇadānaṃ ratnahīrakadānakam ||3 1 ||
godānāni hyanantāni yajñāśca bahavaḥ kṛtāḥ |
pūjane śrīharernityaṃ samarpayāmi hīrakān || 32||
nirdhanasya tava bhaktyā mama bhaktirviśiṣyate |
tvayā yajñaḥ kṛto naiva devālayo na vā kṛtaḥ ||33 ||
mayā sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ vipra paśya yajñāntaraṃ punaḥ |
kariṣyāmi gamiṣyāmi sākṣātkāraṃ hareḥ purā ||34||
viprā jñāsyanti ye bhaktiṃ śreṣṭhāṃ tadaiva nānyathā |
pūrvaṃ sākṣātkaraṇārthaṃ viṣṇuyāgaṃ karomyaham ||35||
ityuktvā śrīhariṃ natvā yayau caulapradeśakān |
caulaḥ samārabhad yajñaṃ kṛtvācāryaṃ tu mudgalam ||36 ||
satyalokāttata ūrdhvād vairājā brahmacāriṇaḥ |
munayaḥ ṛṣayo vṛddhāḥ pitaraśca surāstathā ||37||
yajñāśca devagandharvā mānavāścāpi bhūsurāḥ |
nadā nadaśca tīrthāni taravo vallikāstathā ||38||
puryaḥ kṣetrāṇi caityāni pātālabhūgatāni ca |
tārakāṇi prakṛṣṭāni vaiṣṇavā devatāstathā ||39||
devyaḥ sarvāḥ sarvadhāmanivāsā muktanāyakāḥ |
ākāritā nṛpatinā vaiṣṇave svakṛte kratau ||1.425.40||
svarṇaṃ dravyaṃ hīrakādi sarvaṃ tatra samarpitam |
vastrānnapeyabhogyāni samarpitāni sarvaśaḥ ||41 ||
ṛṣīṇāṃ vedasaṃghoṣā hyāsaṃstatra mahādhvare |
viprāṇāṃ mūrtayastatra santuṣṭā hyabhavanmakhe ||42||
vahnayastṛptimāpannā muktā devāḥ pratoṣitāḥ |
muditāścābhavan satyo devyo brahmāṇḍayoṣitaḥ |||43 ||
kṛto yajño mahān sarvalokeṣu khyāta eva saḥ |
kintu garvāt kṛto naiva niṣkāmabhāvataḥ kṛtaḥ ||44||
spardhayā yatkṛtaṃ cāpi matsareṇāpyatherṣyayā |
tatsarvaṃ na phalavat syād yathā niṣkāmajaṃ phalam ||45||
viṣṇudāso harerdevālaye cakāra sevanam |
śarīreṇa ca bhāvena hareḥ saṃsnapanaṃ tathā ||46||
prabodhanaṃ pūjanaṃ ca śṛṃgāraṃ dhūpadīpanam |
tulasīpatradānaṃ ca jalābhiṣekamarcanam ||47||
puṣpapatraphalārghyānāmarpaṇaṃ candanārpaṇam |
akṣatakuṃkumadānaṃ śrīphalādyarpaṇaṃ tathā ||48||
nīrājanaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ stutiṃ daṇḍavadādikam |
kṣamāyācanamevāpi kīrtanaṃ śravaṇaṃ tathā ||49||
mārjanaṃ lepanaṃ guṇapragānaṃ ca nivedanam |
tāmbūlakaṃ jalaṃ sugandhivaddravyārpaṇaṃ tathā ||1.425.50 ||
vyajanena pavanasya dānaṃ cāmaradhāraṇam |
chatrasandhāraṇaṃ cāpi yathartusevanādikam ||51 ||
puṣpavāṭīṃ tathā kṛtvā puṣpahārādikaṃ śubham |
tulasīvāṭikāṃ kṛtvā haryarthaṃ jalasecanam ||52||
evaṃ snehena bhāvena divāniśaṃ hareḥ prabhoḥ |
pātivratyaparāṃ bhaktimakarod viṣṇudāsakaḥ ||53||
ekādaśyādidivasān japayuktān vratāni ca |
saṃyamena mahābhaktyā kṛṣṇasaṃsmaraṇena ca |||54||
pūjayā ṣoḍaśavastukṛtayā nṛtyagītibhiḥ |
bhāvātisevayā sannirgamayatyeva sarvathā ||55||
paśyan śṛṇvan spṛśan jighran rasayan saṃvadannapi |
gṛhṇan gacchan śayānaśca stavan dhyāyan viniścayan ||56 ||
cintayan mānayam̐ścāpyanubhavan bhāvayam̐stathā |
smaran saṃpratyabhijānan saṃśayāno viparyayan ||57 ||
tarkayan cetayan cecchan viṣṇumeva hi vartate |
sarvatrātmakṛtāvāsaṃ vidan viṣṇumacintayat ||58||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya oṃ namonamaḥ |
evaṃ ṣoḍaśavarṇārṇaṃ gṛṇan viṣṇumayo hyabhūt| ||59||
brāhmaṇasya sadā sevāṃ gṛhṇāti bhagavān svayam |
rājño yajñaṃ hutadravyaṃ gṛhṇāti bhagavān svayam ||1.425.6 0||
brāhmaṇasyābhavad dṛśyo rājñastvadṛśya īśvaraḥ |
bhāvābhāvau tathā garvāgarvau tatra hi kāraṇe ||6 1 ||
ekadā viṣṇudāsena nityamiva mahānase |
kṛto miṣṭānnapākaścāhastvaṃ ko’pyalakṣitaḥ ||62||
pūjāvighnaṃ ca madhyāhne punaḥ pāke bhavediti |
vicārya na punaḥ pākaḥ kṛto na bubhuje svayam ||63 ||
phalaṃ jalaṃ ca naivedye’rpitavān śārṅgiṇe hi saḥ |
dvitīye’pi dine tadvat kṛtaṃ pākaṃ jahāra ha ||64||
tṛtīye’pi dine tadvat pākaṃ jahāra mādhavaḥ |
evaṃ saptadinānyeva pākaṃ jahre’rpaṇaṃ vinā ||65||
cintāturo dvijastasthau rakṣārthaṃ pākasannidhau |
pākaṃ kṛtvā gṛhakoṇe kāṣṭhapāṣāṇahastakaḥ ||66||
upoṣitaśca saptāhaṃ dadarśa pākahāriṇam |
cāṇḍālaṃ malinaṃ kaṃcit kṣudhitaṃ śuṣkadehakam ||67||
dvijo dṛṣṭvā dayāyukto jātastasmin hariṃ smaran |
uvāca tiṣṭha mā rūkṣaṃ bhuṃkṣva ghṛtaṃ gṛhāṇa vai ||68||
ityuktavantaṃ taṃ vipra dṛṣṭvā dudrāva bhītitaḥ |
patito mūrchitastatra taṃ gatvā viṣṇudāsakaḥ ||69||
jalaṃ dadau pavanaṃ ca vastrāntena vyamūrchayat |
tāvat sa utthito viṣṇuścaturbhujadharo’bhavat ||1.425.70||
sākṣāt śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ caturbhujaṃ harim |
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmakaustubhādivirājitam ||71 ||
pratyakṣaṃ śrīhariṃ dṛṣṭvā viṣṇudāso’tigadgadaḥ |
babhūva premapūrṇaśca stotuṃ vaktuṃ na cāśakat ||72||
atha yajñe sthitā devāḥ kratuṃ tyaktvā samāyayuḥ |
caularājñā tu te pṛṣṭhāḥ kva gamyate sureśvaraiḥ ||73 ||
te prāhurviṣṇudāsāya kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ |
sākṣātkāraṃ darśanaṃ vai dadau tatra hi sannidhau ||74||
pragacchāmo darśanārthaṃ āyāsyāmaśca satvaram |
ityuktvā te yayustatra yatra caturbhujo hariḥ ||75||
devāścakrustavaṃ tasya gandharvāpsaraso jaguḥ |
nanṛturdevagandharvā āśiṣaḥ ṛṣayo daduḥ ||76 ||
gītavāditramodāḍhyaṃ sthānaṃ tattvabhavattadā |
yajñāḥ sarvadevādyāścaturdaśabhuvāṃ janāḥ ||77||
sarve samāyayustatra tīrthādyā vahnayo’pi ca |
yajñasthānaṃ tadā riktaṃ jātaṃ devairvinā kṣaṇam ||78||
devālayasya nikaṭe viṣṇuḥ prāheśvarādikān |
bhaktyā ca sevayā snehabhāvayā premapūrayā ||79||
tuṣṭo’haṃ viṣṇudāsasyāgarvasya kiṃkarasya me |
sākṣātkāro mama tasya śīghraṃ jāto’sti devatāḥ ||1.425.80 ||
nāhaṃ bahuvidhairdravyaiḥ sagarvasyāntikapragaḥ |
sākṣātsvadarśanaprado bhavāmīti viniścayaḥ ||81 ||
ityuktvā bhagavān viṣṇurāśliṣya viṣṇudāsakam |
samāropya vimāne sve nināya dhāma śāśvatam ||82||
caularājo dadarśainaṃ yāntaṃ śrīviṣṇumandiram |
śīghraṃ tadāhvayāñcakre guruṃ mudgarameva saḥ ||83||
jagāda ca muniṃ tatra yadarthaṃ yajñamārabhe |
yatspardhayā sarvadravyaṃ yajñe mayā samarpitam ||84||
sa tu pūrvaṃ hariṃ prāpya yayau vaikuṇṭhameva ha |
tvayā yajñaḥ karmakāṇḍātmako naiva hi pāryate |||85|||
kartavyasya phalaṃ naiva mayā prāgatra cārjitam |
tasmād dhanaṃ kraturdānaṃ sarvaṃ na toṣayeddharim ||86||
haristu bhāvabhaktyaiva bhajanena japena ca |
smaraṇena prasannaḥ sa bhavatīti viniścitam ||87||
kuru yajñasyetibhāvaṃ gṛhāṇa dakṣiṇāṃ guro |
yāhi gṛhaṃ samāyātān prasthāpya dattadakṣiṇān ||88||
ahaṃ gacchāmi ca paścāt samārādhanahetave |
bhaktyā tuṣyati bhakteśo na yajñairdānavistaraiḥ ||89||
prasādane harereṣo vipro jāto nidarśanam |
ityuktvā rājyabhāraṃ ca bhāgineye visṛjya ca ||1.425.90||
yayau yajñaṃ hariṃ samārādhayituṃ janādhipaḥ |
vahnikuṇḍāgrataḥ sthitvā dadau havanadravyakam ||91 ||
viṣṇo bhaktiṃ sadā dehi manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ |
uccaistrivārametadvai samuccārya hariṃ smaran || 92||
sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ rājā vāhnikuṇḍe’patattadā |
hāhākāro mahān jāto viṣṇuścāvirabhūttadā || 93 ||
nṛpaṃ caturbhujaṃ kṛtvā samādāya vimānake |
vaikuṇṭhamanayadbhūpaṃ pārṣadatvaṃ dadau hariḥ ||94||
pātivratyaparayā ca bhaktyā tuṣṭo hariḥ svayam |
mayi tuṣṭo nṛpe tuṣṭaḥ svayaṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ||95||
dharmadatta sa evāhaṃ viṣṇudāso’smi pārṣadaḥ |
puṇyaśīlābhidhānaśca rājā suśīlanāmakaḥ ||96||
āvāṃ tvatrāgatau netuṃ kalahāṃ rāmakāraṇāt |
vaikuṇṭhaṃ tāṃ tava puṇyānnītvā te rājajanmani ||97|
daśarathābhidhāne ca kalahā kaikayī tadā |
bhaviṣyati tṛtīyā te patnī dharmāṃśabhāginī ||98||
rathacakranābhimadhye hastaṃ nikṣipya yāsyati |
pātivratyaparāṃ dṛṣṭvā tvaṃ tu mohaṃ gamiṣyasi ||99||
varadānāya sā coktā bhaviṣyatkālayogi tat |
yathecchaṃ dānameveyaṃ nyāsavat kārayiṣyati ||1.425.1 00 ||
prāpte rāmasyābhiṣeke rākṣasānāṃ vināśane |
preritā viṣṇunā rāme vanyatvamarthayiṣyati || 101 ||
rāvaṇādivināśaśca sītāchāyāmiṣeṇa vai |
bhaviṣyati tatastvaṃ ca punarvaikuṇṭhameṣyasi || 1 02||
iti te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ bhāvivṛttāntavartanam |
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya vaikuṇṭhe gamanaṃ bhavet || 103 ||
śṛṇu lakṣmi caularājye’bhiṣiktasya nṛpasya tu |
paṭṭarājñyāśca nādyāpi putre rājyābhiṣecanam || 1 04||
svasrīyasyeva tadrājye jāyate nvabhiṣecanam |
kalau prajāyāḥ śāstau ca pradhānaḥ svasṛjo bhavet || 1 05||
athāpi śṛṇu kalyāṇi bhaktaścaulanṛpo yadā |
svasyaiva hananaṃ cakre viprāstadā tu mudgalam || 1 06||
jahasuśca tiraścakrurdhikkāraṃ ca dadustadā |
asāmarthyaṃ jagaduśca rājahatyākaraṃ jaguḥ || 1 07||
śrutvā śrutvā mudgaro’pi kraddhaḥ prajvalitāntaraḥ |
yāvatpravartate kuṇḍe patirtu tāvadeva tu || 1 08||
bhūsuraiḥ sudṛḍhaṃ samyag dhṛto nyāyena vāritaḥ |
rājñyā tadyoṣitā cānyaiḥ ruddho balātprayatnakaiḥ || 1 09||
tadā krodhena hastābhyāṃ svajaṭāmudapāṭayat |
śikhāṃ jaṭāṃ samutpāṭyājuhāva vahnimaṇḍale || 1.425.11 0||
tena cādyāpi tadgotre viśikhāḥ santi bhūsurāḥ |
atha te niṣkṛtiṃ cakruryayuḥ sarve nijālayam || 111 |
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne harau pātivratyena colarājaviṣṇudāsayoḥ suśīlapuṇyaśīlanāmakaviṣṇupārṣadarūpatā, saurāṣṭrīyakalahāyāḥ kaikeyīrūpatā, dharmadattasya daśarathajanmādivṛtāntakathananāmā pañcaviṃśatyadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||425||

<1.426>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
ākarṇaya mahālakṣmi gokule gopakanyakāḥ |
cakrurvrataṃ pātivratyātmakaṃ kṛṣṇasya labdhaye || 1
kumārikā mahādivyā devyo dhāmādhivigrahāḥ |
dṛśyante bhūtale bhūvadvigrahā vāstavaṃ na tat || 2
sarvā rādhāsamā divyāḥ śrīsamā brahmamūrtikāḥ |
nāṇvapi kṛṣṇasārūpyād bhedastāsu hi vidyate || 3 ||
garbho janma ca bālātvaṃ gaurītvaṃ ca tataḥ punaḥ |
rohiṇītvaṃ kanyakātvaṃ kārṣṇīnāṃ divyameva tat || 4 ||
carmanetrāḥ svavat sarve lokayanti na tattathā |
tāsāṃ kṛṣṇapatiprāptikṛdviceṣṭanameva yat || 5 ||
kṛṣṇapativratāḥ sarvāḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapriyāḥ |
kṛṣṇārthakṛtasarvasvāḥ kinnu vai tāsu varṇyate || 6 ||
tābhirjātismarābhiścārthitaḥ kṛṣṇo hi sarvadā |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastāsāṃ svapne prātaradṛśyata || 7 ||
vihasan bhāvamājñāya pātivratyakratuṃ dadau |
tāstu kṛṣṇanideśena cakruḥ pativratākratum || 8 ||
mārgaśīrṣe vṛṣamāse kurvantu matpriyaṃ vratam |
ahaṃ prāpto bhaviṣyāmi pūrayiṣye manorathān || 9 ||
svātmārthaṃ ca yathā sarvaṃ madarthaṃ sarvameva tat |
priyaṃ sarvaṃ prakurvantu tūrṇaṃ bhavāmi vaḥ patiḥ || 1.426.1 0||
ityuktānāṃ tu kanyānāṃ pātivratyasya sarvathā |
kṛṣṇasya kṛpayā prādurbhūtaṃ jñānaṃ tu tādṛśam || 11 ||
cakrurvrataṃ tu tāḥ sarvāḥ sahasraśastu gopikāḥ |
tāsāṃ manāṃsi ca mayi hyāsan kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe || 12||
tāsāṃ buddhirmayā dattā mārgaśīrṣāvagāhane |
prātaḥkāle brāhmayoge militvā saṃghaśastu tāḥ || 1 3||
yamunāyāṃ kṛtasnānā gāyanti kṛṣṇakīrtanam |
kurvanti jaladānaṃ me’kṣatadānaṃ jale tathā || 14||
dravyadānaṃ jale cāpi gṛhṇāmyantaḥsthito’pyaham |
bhojyadānaṃ jale tābhiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ smṛtvā kṛtaṃ prage || 15||
kvacit kṛṣṇaḥ kvacinmatsyo bhūtvā gṛhṇāmi tajjale |
patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ yadyajjale dattaṃ madātmani || 16||
mayā sarvaṃ svīkṛtaṃ tat tāsāṃ bhāvena vāriṇi |
pūjā kṛtā madarthaṃ ca tābhirgatvā gṛhe gṛhe || 17||
haviṣyānnaṃ madarthaṃ ca bhuktaṃ tābhirmadarpitam |
sarvaṃ mama prasādārthaṃ kṛtaṃ samyag vrataṃ tataḥ || 18||
mayā datto varaścātmā tāsāṃ tuṣṭena satpatiḥ |
śṛṇu lakṣmi kathayāmi kṛṣṇapativratāvidhim || 1 9||
prātarbrāhme samutthāya tābhiḥ śrīguravo natāḥ |
smṛtaścāhaṃ kṣaṇaṃ dhyātaḥ kṛṣṇeti kīrtito muhuḥ ||1.426.20 ||
tato yamyāstaṭaṃ gatvā kṛtvā śaucādikaṃ tataḥ |
snātāśca mukhaśuddhyādi kṛtvā yamījale ca tāḥ ||21 ||
tulasīmṛttikāṃ liptvā tulasīpatravāriṇā |
saṃprokṣya svaśarīrāṇi sasnurnadyāṃ ca māṃ hṛdi ||22||
smarantyaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti vyāharantyapi |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye namaḥ || 23||
athākṣatān kusumāni patrāṇi kuṃkumādikam |
dīpaṃ phalādikaṃ mahyaṃ dadustāścārdravastrakāḥ ||24||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye’rpyate |
iti samarpya tāstīraṃ vinirgatyāmbarāṇi ca ||25||
paridhāya tathācamyātarpayan pūrvajām̐stataḥ |
ṛṣīndevānnamaskṛtyākurvan kuṃkumacandrakam ||26||
bhāle ca kaṇṭhamadhye ca hṛdaye candanādinā |
bindvīṃ rekhāṃ yathāyogyaṃ cakruḥ kṛṣṇaratāśca tāḥ ||27||
lalāṭe keśavo dhyāto nārāyaṇastathodare |
vakṣasi mādhavo dhyāto govindaḥ kaṇṭhakūbare ||28||
dhyāto viṣṇurdakṣakukṣau vāmakukṣau tu vāmanaḥ |
dakṣabāhau ca madhuhā vāmabāhau śriyodharaḥ ||29||
trivikramaḥ karṇamūle hṛṣīkeśastu karṇayoḥ |
pṛṣṭhe dhyātaḥ padmanābho dāmodaro hyadhaḥsthale ||1.426.3 0||
sarvāṃge śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ patiḥ sucintitaḥ |
śaṃkhaṃ cakraṃ gadāṃ padmaṃ cakrire bhujayośca tāḥ ||3 1 ||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye namaḥ |
iti ṣoḍaśakṛṣṇānāṃ mudrā dadhyuśca mānase ||32||
tulasīmālikāḥ sūkṣmāḥ kaṇṭhe dadhyuḥ kare tathā |
dhātrīphalakṛtāṃ mālāṃ dadhyuḥ kāścid gale kare ||33||
evaṃkṛtvā vidhiṃ tāśca natvā gurūn gṛhaṃ gatāḥ |
tata ācamya tāḥ sarvāḥ praviviśuśca maṇḍapam ||34||
kuśāsanasthitāḥ padmāsanāḥ pūrvamukhāśca tāḥ |
cakruḥ prāṇasya niyamaṃ madhye tu maṇḍapasya tāḥ ||35||
karṇikāyāṃ bhāskaraṃ ca śaśinaṃ vahnimeva ca |
saṃsthāpyoddeśamātreṇa taṇḍuleṣu dadhuśca tān ||36||
tato’ṣṭapatrakaṃ pa taṇḍulaiścakrurādarāt |
tatra dadhyuśca māṃ divyaṃ svasvayogyaṃ varaṃ patim ||37||
samāsīnaṃ hasantaṃ ca koṭiśītāṃśusannibham |
caturbhujaṃ sāyudhaṃ ca kāścid dvibhujamacyutam ||38||
padmapatraviśālākṣaṃ mahāvīryabalānvitam |
śrīvatsakaustubhoraskaṃ pītavastrānvitaṃ ca mām ||39||
divyābharaṇasaṃśobhaṃ divyamaṇḍanamaṇḍitam |
divyacandanaliptāṃgaṃ divyakusumamālikam ||1.426.40||
tulasīmālikāyuktavanamālādirājitam |
koṭibālārkasadṛśaṃ kāntaṃ kāntamanoharam |||41 ||
yuvatyā tu śriyāśliṣṭatanuṃ cubantameva mām |
dhyātvā tāḥ prajapurmugdhāḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti mām ||42||
tatastāḥ sthāpayāmāsuḥ śaṃkhaṃ gandhodapūritam |
tathā sugandhapuṣpādipātraṃ nyadhuśca dakṣiṇe ||43|||
vāme nyadhurvārikuṃbhaṃ vastrapūtaṃ suvāsitam |
ghaṇṭāṃ nyadhuḥ pradīpāṃśca cakrurdhūpaṃ samantataḥ ||44||
atha pātrāṇi catvāri sannyadhustatra kanyakāḥ |
arghyapādyācamanīyamadhuparkārthakāni ca |||45|||
sarṣapākṣatapuṣpāṇi kuśāgraṃ tilacandanam |
phalaṃ yavānarghyapātre rarakṣustatra kanyakāḥ ||46||
dūrvāṃ gaṃgāṃ yamīṃ padmaṃ pādyapātre nyadhuśca tāḥ |
kaṃkolaṃ ca lavaṃgaṃ ca phalaṃ mālatisaṃbhavam ||47||
ācamanīyapātre tā nyadhustīrthajalaṃ tathā |
gavyaṃ payo dadhi madhu ghṛtaṃ ca śarkarānvitam ||48||
madhuparkasya pātre tā nyadhustato hareḥ pura|
karanyāsān pracakruśca svāṃgeṣu kṛṣṇakāmyayā ||49||
mastake mastakaṃ cāstu kṛṣṇasya mama sarvathā |
lalāṭe śrīkṛṣṇadevalalāṭaṃ cāstu me śubham ||1.426.50||
netrayoḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇanetre’dhitiṣṭhatām |
karṇayorme kṛṣṇakarṇau nāsāyāṃ kṛṣṇanāsikā ||51 ||
kapolayoḥ kapolaṃ me gaṇḍayoḥ kṛṣṇagaṇḍakau |
kaṭākṣayoḥ kaṭākṣau me kṛṣṇasya cādhitiṣṭhatām ||52||
oṣṭhayorme kṛṣṇakāntoṣṭhadvayaṃ vasatu priyam |
cibuke kṛṣṇacibukaṃ kaṇṭhe kaṇṭho’stu me hareḥ ||53 ||
skandhayoḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaskandhau pratiṣṭhatām |
bhujayoḥ śrīhareḥ stāṃ subhujau karau karadvaye |||54||
hṛdaye kṛṣṇahṛdayaṃ nābhau nābhirharermama |
jaghane kṛṣṇajaghanaṃ kaṭyāṃ cāstu hareḥ kaṭiḥ ||55||
gopye kṛṣṇasya gopyaṃ ca sakthnorme sakthinī hareḥ |
jānvorme kṛṣṇajānūstāṃ jaṃghe me jaṃghayorhareḥ ||56||
pādayorme kṛṣṇapādau mayi kṛṣṇo’stu sarvathā |
madindriyeṣu kṛṣṇasyendriyāṇi santu sarvaśaḥ ||57||
santu me’ntaḥkaraṇeṣvantaḥkaraṇāni vai hareḥ |
evaṃ mamānusmaraṇaṃ cakrustā hṛdayaṃgamam ||58||
sasmarustāstadātmānaṃ matsamaṃ matpativratāḥ |
maṃgalaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ kāntaḥ priyaḥ kuru ||59||
prapeṭhuḥ gopakanyānāṃ patistvaṃ maṃgalaṃ kuru |
atha śaṃkhaṃ pupūjuśca puṣpacandanavāribhiḥ ||1.426.6 0||
suvāsitena tailena cakrurudvartanaṃ tu tāḥ |
kastūryā candanenāpi cakrurudvartanaṃ tathā ||61 ||
sugandhavāsitaistoyaistataḥ saṃsnāpito’pyaham |
śaṃkhatoyaṃ prajagrāha snānārthaṃ tu punaḥ punaḥ ||62||
pañcāmṛtāni pradaduḥ snāpayāmāsurādarāt |
tīrthajalaiḥ sukhasparśairabhiṣekaṃ daduśca tāḥ ||63||
candanaṃ gandhasārādi mardayāmāsurādarāt |
vastreṇa mārjayāmāsuḥ śarīraṃ me punaḥ punaḥ ||64||
dadurarghyaṃ saphalaṃ ca pādyamācamanīyakam |
madhuparkaṃ daduścātha dadurdivyāmbarāṇi ca ||65||
divyabhūṣāralaṃkārān gandhādīn saṃdadurmama |
kajjalaṃ keśatailādi puṇḍrārthaṃ candanādikam ||66||
kuṃkumādi dadustāśca dravasārān dadustataḥ |
alaktaraṃgarāgādi pradadustāśca kanyakāḥ ||67||
siṃhāsanaṃ tathā chatraṃ cāmare vyajanaṃ daduḥ |
darpaṇaṃ keśadantaṃ ca śuklacūrṇaṃ daduśca tāḥ ||68||
tulasīmālikāṃ puṣpahārām̐śca śekharān daduḥ |
gucchān svarṇavibhūṣāśca pattrāṇe saṃdadustadā ||6 9||
vaṃśī daduśca tā miṣṭasvarāṃ cāhamavādayam |
dolāyāṃ māṃ samasthāpya dolayāmāsurādarāt ||1.426.70 ||
naivedyaṃ cārpayāmāsuḥ pāyasāpūpamiśritam |
jalaṃ phalaṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ śākaṃ pūgīphalādikam ||71 ||
pradadustā vyajanaiśca sevayāmāsureva ca |
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ punaścakrurdaduḥ puṣpāṇi bhaktitaḥ ||72 ||
bhojayāmāsuratyarthaṃ prītyā tāḥ kavalairmuhuḥ |
tṛpto’haṃ cāpibaṃ vāri tāmbūlakaṃ samādade ||73 ||
tāśca praṇamya saṃcakrurnīrājanaṃ punaḥ punaḥ |
stutiṃ cakrurnamaścakruḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ punastathā ||74||
aparādhakṣamāyāñcāṃ puṣpāñjaliṃ samādadhuḥ |
varaṃ ca yācayāmāsuḥ patirno bhava sarvadā ||75||
śāyayitvā ca paryaṃke paritastasthurādarāt |
pādasaṃvāhanaṃ cakruryatheṣṭaṃ tāḥ siṣevire ||76 ||
mayā tāsāṃ mānasāni pūritāni tadā priye |
sparśanenāśleṣaṇena bhāvenāvarṇyakena ca ||77|||
tatastāḥ sukhamāpannā abhūtapūrvameva vai |
ānandeṣu nimagnastā maṃgalārghyaṃ dadustataḥ ||78||
visṛjya māṃ ca tāścakrurgṛhakāryāṇi vai tataḥ |
prasādaṃ bhakṣayāmāsurmamapūjāniveditam ||79||
mayā dattaṃ mahānandaṃ smṛtvā smṛtvātiharṣitāḥ |
cakruḥ svagṛhakāryāṇi śramaṃ na vividuśca tāḥ ||1.426.80||
jalāharaṇakārye tā dadṛśurmāṃ ghaṭe jale |
kaṇḍanīdhānyaghāte tā dadṛśurmāṃ kaṇeṣu vai ||81 ||
piṣṭārthaṃ peṣaṇīkārye peṣaṇyāṃ dadṛśurhi mām |
mārjanīkāryakāle tā bhūtale dadṛśuśca mām ||82||
pākakāle pākapātre sthālyāṃ bhojanapātrake |
dṛśye śravye tathā spṛśye māmeva dadṛśuśca tāḥ ||83||
ādarśe svamukhe netre taile vastre vibhūṣaṇe |
hṛdaye sarvakāryeṣu māmeva dadṛśuśca tāḥ ||84||
divyadehā babhūvuśca bhittyāvaraṇavarjitāḥ |
dehabhānaprahīṇāśca kṛṣṇarūpaṃ dadhustu tāḥ ||85||
ekā kṛṣṇo dvitīyā tu kṛṣṇā bhūtvā ca rematuḥ |
ekā patnī dvitīyā tu patirbhūtvā nanandatuḥ ||86||
ekā sakhī dvitīyā tu sakhā bhūtvā cucūmbatuḥ |
ekā vadhūdvitīyā tu varo bhūtvā virejatuḥ ||87||
evaṃ kṛṣṇamayaṃ tāsāmāntaraṃ ca mayā kṛtam |
kṛṣṇapātivratyaraṃgaiḥ raktānāṃ bhinnatā na me ||88||
evaṃbhāvaṃ prapannāstāḥ snātuṃ yātā yamījale |
kadambadrumanikaṭe tāsvahaṃ cāpyalakṣitaḥ ||89||
yayau kumārikārūpaṃ dhṛtvā snānāya vai saha |
avateruśca tāstīrthe nyasya vastrāṇi tattaṭe ||1.426.90||
sasmaruśca saha snātuṃ rantuṃ māṃ kanyakā hṛdi |
yathā cānyā na jānāti tathā pratyekayā saha ||91 ||
reme tatra jale bāhyakanyaścāntarapūruṣaḥ |
pratyekaṃ sā vijānāti ramaṇaṃ nāparā tadā ||92||
evaṃ manāṃsi sampūrya tṛptāstāśca tataḥ param |
jale kanyāsvarūpo’pi vanāt kṛṣṇo’hamāgataḥ ||93||
tāsāṃ vastrāṇi cādāya prāruroha kadambakam |
tābhiḥ saṃkalpitaṃ tadvanmayā manaḥ prapūritam ||94||
kṛṣṇaścāsmattanū paśyediti tadvanmayā kṛtam |
vratasthānāṃ varuṇasyāvadhīraṇā kṛtā yataḥ ||95||
bahirnirgatya sūryāya kuruta prāṃjaliṃ priyāḥ |
iti bhāvānusāreṇa tāśca mayā vilokitāḥ ||96||
tāstu tuṣṭāstadā jātā menire kṛtakṛtyatām |
dadau vastrāṇi tābhyaśca varām̐ścāpi dadau muhuḥ ||97||
rāmayiṣye ramayiṣye yatheṣṭaṃ mama vai priyāḥ |
vratasya tu phalaṃ sarvaṃ cārpayiṣye navaṃ navam ||98||
nityaṃ tāḥ kāntabhāvena mayā satyaḥ pratarpitāḥ |
tā eva tu divārātrau madātmikāḥ sadābhavan ||99||
kāmo divyo ratirdivyā bhāvo divyaḥ kṛto mayā |
madīyadivyabhāvena tāsāṃ divyamabhūddhi tat| || 1.426.1 00||
niṣkāma karma tatproktaṃ yanmayi tvarpyate sadā |
bandhaghnaṃ śāntidaṃ mokṣakaraṃ sākṣānmadarpaṇam || 101 ||
yathā tābhiḥ kṛtaṃ tadvannānyā kācit kariṣyati |
ityahaṃ tvabhavaṃ tāsāṃ prasannaḥ kānta ekalaḥ || 1 02||
kāntāstāścābhajan māṃ ca prāpurmāṃ ca pare pade |
tāśca sarvāḥ kṛṣṇakāntāḥ kṛṣṇavratā hareḥ priyāḥ || 1 03||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapatnyaḥ kṛṣṇapativratāḥ striyaḥ |
nityaṃ māṃ pūjayāmāsuḥ ramayāmāsurantike || 1 04||
miṣṭānnāni ca tā nityaṃ bhojayāmāsuracyutam |
dadhyurmāṃ hṛdaye nityaṃ śāśvatānandadāyakam || 1 05||
evaṃ yā pātivratyena patisevāṃ kariṣyati |
patiṃ māṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prāpya pramokṣyate || 1 06||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne gokulakanyānāṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇapātivratyaparāṇāmaṣṭottaraśatopacārairvratapūjādibhiḥ śrīkṛṣṇapatiprāptirityādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍviṃśatyadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 426 ||

<1.427>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ tāsāṃ punaḥprāptisvarūpiṇīm |
yadā kṛṣṇo dvārikāyāṃ samāgatyāvasattadā || 1 ||
śokāturāstu tāḥ sarvāstatyajurvāri bhojanam |
śrīkṛṣṇena mayā tāśca punaḥ punastadantikam || 2 ||
gatvā tvadṛśyarūpeṇa sāntvayitāḥ prasāditāḥ |
āpyāyitā ānanditā yatheṣṭakrīḍanādibhiḥ || 3 ||
adṛśyena svarūpeṇa pratigopīṃ ramāmyaham |
pārśvasthā naiva jānanti yataste carmacakṣuṣaḥ || 4 ||
tāstu divyāḥ prajānanti vadanti yamunātaṭe |
sakhyo milanti vijane māṃ stuvanti hasanti ca || 5 ||

jakruśca niścayaṃ gantuṃ dvārikāṃ kāntasannidhau || 6 ||

ekarūpeṇa tatraiva gokule tasthire sadā || 7 ||
dvitīyena tu divyena militāstu sahasraśaḥ |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapatnyo nītvopadā yathābalam || 8 ||

ghaṭikābhyantare prāpurdivyāṃ puṣkariṇīṃ śubhām || 9 ||

svāgataṃ kṛtavām̐stāsāṃ dadhe rūpasahasrakam || 1.427.1 0||

bhojayāmāsuratyarthamātithyaṃ cakrurādarāt || 18||
raivatyo devatāḥ kanyā gaukulyaḥ kanyakāstathā |
śrīkṛṣṇaṃ koṭirūpasthaṃ bhojayāmāsurīśvaram || 19 ||
kārtike yāni bhojyāni cānnakūṭe’rhaṇāni vai |
mārgaśīrṣe ca deyāni tānyājahrurhareḥ kṛte || 1.427.20||
sarvāṇi bhojayāmāsurnārāyaṇahradāntike |
śṛṇu lakṣmi ca nāmāni yānyahaṃ bhuktavām̐stadā || 21 ||

hiraṇmayāni pātrāṇi rājatāni sahasraśaḥ ||22||

śataśo vyañjanabhedā nihitāḥ pātrikāsu vai ||27||

pātrīṣu nihitāstābhiruṣṇabhāvāḥ samuttamāḥ ||1.427.3 0 ||
śarkarādugdhayuktāśca maṇḍakā vartulāḥ śubhāḥ |

gālitaṃ kvāthitaṃ tābhirdattaṃ pānottaraṃ tu me |

sukṣaṇamātrakālo vai satyaloke gamiṣyati |

ebhirdivyaśarīrairvai bhaktimatyo bhavantu me |

satāṃ madhyagataścihnairjñātavyaḥ kṛṣṇa eva hi |

bhavatīnāṃ susatsaṃgāt narā nāryo’pi koṭiśaḥ || 1 07||

ācāryo’haṃ gūḍharūpo vicariṣyāmi sādhuvat || 1 08||

oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye namaḥ || 1 09||
iti jāpaṃ kariṣyanti yāsyanti matpadaṃ hi te |
mama sevāṃ mama pūjāṃ mama nāmānukīrtanam || 1.427.11 0||
matkathāśravaṇaṃ ye vai kariṣyanti tu te janāḥ |
yāsyanti paramaṃ dhāma śāśvataṃ śrīniṣevitam || 111 ||
ityuktāstāḥ prasannāśca bhūtvā ca brahmaṇā saha |
yayuḥ satyaṃ brahmalokaṃ śrīkṛṣṇo dvārikāṃ yayau || 11 2||
ityuktā matkathāṃ tubhyaṃ pāpatāpapraṇāśinī |
mayā pūrvaṃ hi yajjātaṃ saṃsmṛtyātra niveditam || 113 ||
tāśca sarvā mama patnyo vartante mayi cārpitāḥ |
madarthaṃ tyaktasarvasvāḥ sarvā mama pativratāḥ || 1 14||
tāsāṃ vai darśanātsparśāt lokā yāsyanti mokṣaṇam |
kiṃ punarmama yogena sākṣāt divyaprasevayā || 1 15||
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi vṛttaṃ purābhavaṃ śubham |
yuge yuge bhaviṣyāmi kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hyaham || 116 ||
bahuvāraṃ pratiyugaṃ bhavāmi prabhavāmi ca |
kṣatratejāḥ sādhutejāstapastejā munīśvaraḥ || 1 17||
śāstratejā jñānatejā dharmatejā gurorguruḥ |
dharmapoṣṭā bhaktipoṣṭā bhaktapātā ca śāsakaḥ || 1 18||
satītrātā priyābhartā ratidātā ramāpatiḥ |
rājyadātā yajñapātā daityahartā ca bhikṣukaḥ || 11 9||
duḥkhahartā sukhadātā śaraṇyaśca caturbhujaḥ |
prabhāvān pāravāṃścāpi kaṇasthalaśarīravān || 1.427.1 20||
kṛṣṇapātivratyaniṣṭhāstariṣyanti sadā priye |
iti te kathitaṃ hārdaṃ patiḥ kṛṣṇo na cāparaḥ || 121 ||
rakṣayiṣye rakṣayāmi rarakṣāpi dine dine |
bhaktiyuktān mañjuhaṃsāna pātivratyaparāyaṇān || 1 22||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne gokulīyagopīnāṃ dvārikāgamottaraṃ raivatādrau śrīkṛṣṇāya dvādaśottaraśatavidhabhojanabhogadānaṃ saurāṣṭrādau sarvatra prākaṭyavacanaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya pātivratyena punaḥ prāptiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptaviṃśatyadhikacatuḥśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||427||

<1.428>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ ramyāṃ vīrabāhoḥ satīstriyāḥ |
kāmpilyanagarasyāsīd vīrabāhuriti pradhīḥ || 1 ||
satyavādī ca nṛpatirbrāhmaṇo mama bhaktarāṭa |
bhakto bhāgavatānāṃ ca matkathāyāṃ ruciṃgataḥ 2 ||
dātānāthāśrayapradaḥ patnīvrataśca putravān |
tasya kāntā kāntimatī mahāsādhvī pativratā || 3 ||
muktvaikaṃ māṃ vīrabāhurnānyajjānāti daivatam |
ekadā tadgṛhaṃ yāto bhāradvājo mahāmuniḥ || 4 ||
rājā cakāra cātithyaṃ svāgataṃ cārghyamāsanam |
praṇanāma ca taṃ bhaktyā hyuvāca supramoditaḥ || 5 ||
adya me saphalaṃ janma tvadya me saphalaṃ dinam |
adya me saphalaṃ rājyamadya me saphalaṃ gṛham || 6 ||
saphalaścāśramaścāpi saphalā dhanabāndhavāḥ |
yasya me brahmavijñasya darśanaṃ caraṇaṃ gṛhe || 7 ||
yasya hariḥ prasanno’sti tadgṛhaṃ yānti sādhavaḥ |
harerbhaktā gṛhe yasya tasya koṭyaghasaṃkṣayaḥ || 8 ||
tīrthaṃ bhavati bhavanaṃ yatpādarajasā divam |
rājyaṃ lakṣmīrgajāśvādi sarvaṃ mune tvadarthakam || 9 ||
bhavaddarśanalābhena jīvanmukto’smi vartitaḥ |
mahābhāgavataścāsi nādeyaṃ te mamāsti yat || 1.428.1 0||
vaiṣṇavāyārpitaṃ svalpaṃ merutulyaṃ phalaṃ bhavet |
yadgṛhe nāsti caraṇaṃ satāṃ kṛṣṇasya yoginaḥ || 11 ||
tadgṛhaṃ śavavāsārh din ca viphalaṃ bhavet |
yadgṛhaṃ ca dinaṃ cāpi satāṃ prāptivivarjitam || 12||
vada me sarvadharmajña gārhasthyavartināṃ ca yat |
tārakaṃ sādhan śreṣṭhaṃ bandhanaṃ haridhāmadam || 13 ||
bhāradvājaḥ prasannaḥ san smṛtvā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam |
uvāca rājan bhadraṃ te yo’si bhaktajanapriyaḥ || 14||
smṛddhistu sulabhā rājan hṛdbhāvo durlabhaḥ khalu |
yā tvayi bhāvanā bhakte naikajanmārjitā hi sā || 15||
yasya kṛpāluḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śriyaḥ patiḥ |
tasya vai bhāvanā satsu sudivyā mokṣadā hi sā || 16||
śrīharirhi sadā sevyaḥ sevyāśca sādhavaḥ sadā |
sādhvyaḥ sevyāśca nārībhiryāśca kṛṣṇapativratāḥ || 17||
dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ sutaḥ kīrtiḥ rājyaṃ saubhāgyamarhaṇam |
ārogyaṃ kāntiraiśvaryaṃ tvāśīrbhirlabhyate satām || 18||
sādhavastoṣitā yena tena kṛṣṇaḥ pratoṣitaḥ |
kṛṣṇe tuṣṭe jagat tuṣṭaṃ sadevamunimānavam || 1 9||
atuṣṭe tu harau sarvaṃ tuṣṭaṃ cāpi nirarthakam |
dhanyo’si tvaṃ mahārāja rājase vaiṣṇavo mahān ||1.428.20||
dhanyo’syadhiko rājase yatte patnī pativratā |
pātivratyaṃ dvayaṃ yasyāścobhayaṃ sādhitaṃ tayā || 21 ||
svāmini śrīharau kṛṣṇo tathā kānte vivāhite |
etallokaṃ sukhaṃ prāptaṃ prāpsyate dhāma vai tathā || 22||
nedṛśaṃ sādhanaṃ loke gārhasthyasya tu tārakam |
gṛhe pativratānārī kṛṣṇe bhaktiśca śāśvatī ||23||
rājye prajā bhāgavatī vaiṣṇavī dhārmikī satī |
tatra sadā pravastavyaṃ na tvavaiṣṇavarājake ||24||
varaṃ vāso vane tīrthe na tu rāṣṭre hyavaiṣṇave |
yatra bhāgavato rājā praśāsti ca vasundharām ||25||
vaikuṇṭhaṃ taddhi mantavyaṃ phalaṃ vaikuṇṭhameva yat |
rājā bhakto yathārtho’sti satāṃ pātraṃ sa āśiṣām || 26 ||
tadrājyaṃ vardhate nityaṃ dampatyoḥ pātivratyataḥ |
rājannetraṃ saphalaṃ me paśyāmi tvāṃ hi vaiṣṇavam || 27||
saphalau ca tathā karṇau yacchṛṇomi pativratām |
pativratā svayaṃ lakṣmīsvarūpā brahmaṇā kṛtā ||28||
patnīvrato vaiṣṇavaścoddhārako brahmaṇā kṛtaḥ |
vaiṣṇavānāṃ darśanaṃ vai śāntidaṃ mokṣadaṃ tathā || 29||
labdhaṃ ca darśanaṃ te’tra tava śrīsamayoṣitaḥ |
svasti te’stu gamiṣyāmi sukhī bhava janādhipa ||1.428.3 0||
avaidhavyaṃ ca te patnyāḥ kāntimatyāḥ sadā śubham |
patyau bhaktiḥ keśave ca niścalā bhaktirastu vām || 31 ||
patyau kṛṣṇe tvaikyabuddhiḥ kāntimati sadāstu te |
pūrvaṃ tvayā pātivratyaṃ pālitaṃ tvatiyatnataḥ || 32||
patistavāyaṃ pūrvasmin janmanyāsīt prahiṃsakaḥ |
nāstiko duṣṭacāritraḥ śūdraḥ parapriyārataḥ ||33 ||
kṛtaghno durvinītaśca sadācāravivarjitaḥ |
karmaṇā manasā vācā tvayā nityaṃ hi devavat ||34||
sevitaḥ kṛṣṇabuddhyā ca pātivratyavṛṣeṇa ca |
śūdrītve’pi tvayā kaścinnānyo naraḥ prakalpitaḥ || 35||
pativratā mahāsādhvī parasparśavivarjitā |
duṣṭabhāvādihīnā ca siṣeviṣe patiṃ harim || 36 ||
kadācid dravyahīno’yaṃ patiste’raṇyamāgataḥ |
kṣīyamāṇāpi bhāryā tvaṃ nātyajaḥ svaṃ patiṃ harim || 37||
śaśādibhirvartayantau dampatī vanavāsinau |
dadṛśathuḥ kadācidvai vane bhraṣṭapathaṃ munim || 38||
brāhmaṇaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktaṃ suvaiṣṇavam |
madhyāhne tṛṣitaṃ cāpi patitaṃ mūrcchitaṃ tathā || 39||
hṛdi kṛṣṇaṃ smarantaṃ ca devaśarmābhidhānakam |
brāhmaṇaṃ taṃ siṣevāthe jalena pavanena ca ||1.428.40||
pādayormardanenāpi phalādibhojanena ca |
viṣṇuṃ kṛṣṇaṃ hariṃ matvā vaiṣṇavaṃ tārakaṃ dvijam || 41 ||
āśrame chāyayā vyāpte ramye ninyathurādarāt |
yuvābhyāṃ sevitaḥ samyak snāpito bhojitastathā || 42||
sāṣṭāṃgaḥ sannataścokto bhāvabhaktyā sa vaiṣṇavaḥ |
āvayostāraṇārthāyātithirviṣṇustvamāgataḥ || 43 ||
darśanāttava viprarṣe jāto’smatpāpasaṃkṣayaḥ |
vada vipra vane kiñcitsāhāyyaṃ cedapekṣyate || 44||
brāhmaṇastu tadā prāha puṇyayogena vai vane |
bhavadyogo mama jāto jīvito vai vanāntare || 45||
karavāṇi yuvayoḥ kiṃ brūta kiñcidabhīpsitam |
śūdraḥ prāha yathā saurilokadarśanaṃ mā bhavet || 46||
patnyā saha pragacchāmi kṛṣṇadhāma hi śāśvatam |
upadeśapradānena prasādaṃ kartumarhasi ||47||
devaśarmā tadā prāha śṛṇu prākcaritaṃ tava |
pūrvajanmani viprastvamavantyāṃ dhārmiko hyabhūḥ ||48||
tava patnī tadā ceyaṃ pātivratyaparā satī |
āsīddharmaparā nityaṃ hyatithīnāṃ prasevikā ||49||
tavājñayānayā tvannaṃ hyekādaśyāṃ supācitam |
brāhmaṇebhyaścātithibhyo bhojanārthaṃ samarpitam ||1.428.50||
jātaṃ puṇyaṃ tvannadānād bhojanātpāpamityapi |
puṇyapāpapratāpena yamādiṣṭena vai pathā ||51 ||
yuvāṃ śūdrakule janmāvāpathuḥ puṇyamiśritam |
yāvatpuṇyamabhūt tāvaddhanadhānyādyabhūcca vām ||52||
puṇyaṃ naṣṭaṃ tato vanyo vāso’yaṃ samupāgataḥ |
kintu vidarbhanagare vartate te sutāsutaḥ |||53||
kṛtaṃ tena vidhānena harerekādaśīvratam |
pradattaṃ tena tatpuṇyaṃ yuvābhyāṃ yadbalācca vām ||54||
dharmopari gatirnityaṃ vartate yuvayoḥ śubhā |
kāntimatyāḥ pātivratye sadā tvāsīnmatistadā ||55||
tena puṇyaprabhāveṇa yuvayoḥ saṃgatiḥ sadā |
viyogo jāyate naiva na bhūto na bhaviṣyati ||56||
svalpenaiva prakālena yūyaṃ svargaṃ gamiṣyathaḥ |
tatra pativratādharmabalena suciraṃ sukham ||57||
samanubhūya bhūloke śūdrajanma hyavāpsyathaḥ |
tāvubhau ca yuvāṃ jātau viṣṇubhaktiparāyaṇau ||58||
athottaraṃ śubhaṃ janma mama sevāprabhāvataḥ |
pātivratyaprabhāveṇa dīrghaṃ rājyamavāpsyathaḥ ||59||
ityuktvā sa yayau viprastīrthārthaṃ ca yuvāmubhau |
kāladharmaṃ samāpannau rājñī rājā ca vaiṣṇavau ||1.428.60||
jātau sthaḥ punarevātra satī bhāryā tavāsti ca |
tvaṃ tu patnīvrataścāsi sevase mādṛśān sadā ||61 ||
viṣṇuṃ nārāyaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ śrīpatiṃ kamalāpatim |
lakṣmīpatiṃ satāṃ nāthaṃ sevase pātivratyataḥ ||62||
iyaṃ sādhvī tava bhāryā kṛṣṇaṃ tvāṃ sevate sadā |
tatphalaṃ dīrgharājyaṃ ca putraste’sti suvaiṣṇavaḥ ||63||
prajāste sarvadā nārāyaṇe pativratāstathā |
vaiṣṇavyaḥ santi tenātra jayase mokṣaṇaṃ prati ||64||
kuru bhaktirharernityaṃ prasevaya gurūn yatīn |
patnīvrataṃ sadā rakṣa pātivratyaṃ sati hyava ||65||
evaṃ vai vartane svargaṃ śāśvataṃ tvatra te’sti hi |
ante dhāma paraṃ divyaṃ golokaṃ yāsyatho ghruvam ||66||
samprāptaikādaśīpuṇyād viprasyātithyasevanāt |
pātivratyācca bhāryāyāḥ prāptaṃ rājyādikaṃ tvayā ||67||
bhaja viṣṇuṃ sadā tvaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum |
bhaja sādhvi svāminaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ patim ||68||
ityuktvā prayayau badrīṃ bhāradvājo mahāmuniḥ |
cakrāte tāvubhau bhaktiṃ yayaturdhāma me hyubhau ||69||
śṛṇu lakṣmi kṛṣṇapātivratyena nāma me japet |
tasmai dadāmi vaikuṇṭhaṃ golokaṃ vākṣaraṃ padam ||1.428.70||
mama nāma pravaktavyaṃ kṣaṇe kṣaṇe viśeṣataḥ |
rādhākṛṣṇeti vaktavyaṃ prabhākṛṣṇeti prītidam ||71 ||
harikṛṣṇeti vaktavyaṃ duḥkhahṛn mokṣadaṃ param |
pratijñaiṣā tu me lakṣmi sarvathā śaraṇāgataḥ ||72||
sarvecchāṃ samavāpnoti vaikuṇṭhaṃ kamalāmapi |
madbhaktāya dadāmyeva tatsarvaṃ yanmamāsti vai ||73 ||
vadati śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti saṃsmaratyapi |
yathākathaṃcidbhajate tamahaṃ tārayāmi ha ||74||
lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ ye tu vadanti mṛtyusannidhau |
mṛtyuryamaśca taddūtāstyaktvā yānti hi taṃ priye ||75||
antakāle yasya karṇe rāmarāmeti cāgatam |
vaikuṇṭhe nīyate rāmapārṣadaiḥ sa na saṃśayaḥ ||76 ||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye namaḥ |
ityevaṃ gṛṇato mantraṃ nayāmi mama cākṣaram ||77||
pātivratyaparā patnī yatrāsti tulasīdalam |
mahābhāgavataḥ sādhuryatrāsti tatra cāsmyaham ||78||
ahaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ patiḥ kṛṣṇaḥ svāmī kṛṣṇaḥ priyaḥ sa hi |
ramāprabhāmāṇikīpārvatīnāthaḥ striyāḥ patiḥ ||79||
jayālalitākāntaḥ sa nārīṇāṃ kānta eva saḥ |
pativratā yataḥ sarvā lakṣāṃśasaṃbhavāḥ sati ||1.428.80 ||
iti te kathitaṃ sevākaraṇaṃ tvaikyabhāvataḥ |
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya pātivratyaphalaṃ labhet ||81 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pātivratye vīrabāhoḥ kāntimatyāśca dampatyorbhāradvājena vipraśūdranṛpajanmatrayottaraṃ muktiḥ kṛtetyādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭāviṃśatyadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||428||

<1.429>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi sūryaputryā mama patnyāḥ kathānakam |
yābhūd golokamadhyasthā sakhīśreṣṭhātihāsinī || 1 ||
yadā yadā sakhīnāṃ vai samudyāne sukrīḍanam |
militvā jāyate tatra hasatīyaṃ muhurmuhuḥ || 2 ||
ekadā rādhikāyuktā gopyaśca koṭiśaḥ striyaḥ |
jagmuḥ snānāya sarasi divye madarthanirmite || 3 ||
śaivāle rādhikā padbhyāṃ saṃsṛpya patitā tadā |
yamunā rādhikāṃ dhartuṃ pradudrāva jahāsa ca || 4 ||
rādhā prāha yamune kiṃ sthāne hasasi narmaṇi |
asthāne hasane naiva śobhate hāsyasaṃbhṛte || 5 ||
patitāhaṃ kardamena vyāptā pṛṣṭho śilāhatā |
jalaṃ nasi mukhe netre praviṣṭaṃ narma mā kuru || 6 ||
evaṃ prabodhitā sāpi dhṛtvā rādhāṃ pragṛhya ca |
vastrādīni tadānyāni dadau sandhāraṇāya vai || 7 ||
mukhaṃ keśāḥ pṛṣṭhabhāgaḥ prakṣālitāḥ susaṃskṛtāḥ |
tadā rādhāṃ punardṛṣṭvā pajahāsāti sā muhuḥ || 8 ||
rādhā ruṣṭā tu yamunāṃ prāyaśaḥ sevikāṃ prati |
prāha śaivālakeśā tvaṃ bhava kardamaśālinī || 9 ||
yamunā tu tadā ruṣṭā rādhāṃ prāha punaḥ punaḥ |
tvaṃ priye kardame śaivāle’pi vihara madyutā || 1.429.1 0||
tvāṃ parityajya naivāhaṃ viharāmi kadācana |
kṛṣṇo jñātvā hyubhe prāha maivaṃ maivaṃ priye mama || 11 ||
yuvābhyāṃ tu vihīno’haṃ kathaṃ sthāsyāmi śobhane |
āgamiṣyāmyahaṃ tatra yatra yamunārādhike || 1 2||
yamunā sūryaputrī saṃbhūtvā nadī tu bhūtale |
himādriṃ prathamaṃ sṛṣṭvā yayau vṛndāvanaṃ satī || 13 ||
rādhāpi gopikā bhūtvā rāpāṇasya sutāniśam |
yamunāyāstaṭe tacchaivālakardamacāriṇī || 14||
jātā kṛṣṇapriyā kṛṣṇasaṃketānuprasārataḥ |
yamunā kanyakārūpā sevate tu patiṃ harim || 15||
ekadā kṛṣṇapatnyo vai kṛṣṇena saha tadvane |
kumārikāḥ prakrīḍanti yamunā tad dadarśa ha ||16||
sā kṛṣṇaṃ saṃvilokyaiva cakame kāntakāminī |
kṛṣṇastāṃ prāha yamune bhava kanyā tataḥ param || 17||
kariṣye’haṃ vivāhaṃ te kalindarājakanyakā |
bhava śīghraṃ mama patnī bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ || 18||
sā tu kalindarājasya dvitīyena svavarṣmaṇā |
jātā vai kanyakā śrīkṛṣṇena sāpi vivāhitā || 1 9||
ekadā kṛṣṇapatnyastu śrīkṛṣṇavirahāturāḥ |
kālindīṃ muditāṃ vīkṣya papracchurgatamatsarāḥ ||1.429.20||
yathā vayaṃ kṛṣṇapatnyastathā tvamapi sūryaje |
vayaṃ virahadagdhāḥ sma kathaṃ tvaṃ virahaṃ vinā ||21 ||
tacchrutvāha raveḥ putrī kālindī kṛṣṇasevikā |
divyaṃ vai śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prāpnomi sarvadā |||22||
na māṃ vihāya bhagavān kadācid yāti dūrataḥ |
rādhikāsti mahārājñī kṛṣṇātmā kṛṣṇarūpiṇī || 23 ||
asmyahaṃ rādhikāṃśā vai na bhidye kṛṣṇarūpataḥ |
rādhāṃ vinā na vai kṛṣṇo nāhaṃ ca rādhikāṃ vinā ||24||
kṛṣṇaśca māṃ vinā naiva jānītaikātmyameva yat |
evaṃ satyapi dāsyaṃ vai rādhāyāstu viśiṣyate || 25||
tadānandena muditā vindāmi virahaṃ na vai |
pativratā satī nārī patiṃ garbhe hṛdi vrate ||26 ||
pārśve cātmani vijñāne rakṣatyeva na saṃśayaḥ |
svapne jāgrati nidrāyāṃ ramate svāminā saha || 27||
bhedo na dehayorasti vyavasthā patimiśritā |
yadecchati tadā satyāḥ patirnārāyaṇātmakaḥ ||28||
āgatyānandadātāsti viyogo nāsti karhicit |
satī pativratā patnī yadyat sukhaṃ pravāñcchati || 29||
tattatsukhapradānārthaṃ patirūpaṃ dadhan hariḥ |
pativratāmanaḥkāmān pūrayatyeva sarvathā ||1.429.3 0 ||
tasmātpativratānāryā viyogaḥ svāmino na vai |
sa evāyaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścāsmatpatiḥ prabhuḥ ||3 1 ||
sarvakāmapūrako’sti viyogo nāsti me kvacit |
śrutvā tā yoṣitaḥ prāhuryadi kālindi vai tvayā || 32||
sākaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ sadā tvāste naḥ pradarśaya sāmpratam |
ityuktā sā prahasyaiva śāṭikāṃ svāṃ kareṇa vai || 33 ||
dakṣapārśvāddhastamātraṃ viyuktāṃ pracakāra ha |
tāvattatra sthitaḥ pārśve samāśliṣya yamīṃ hasan || 34||
tābhiśca lokitaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kālindīṃ ramayan muhuḥ |
mugdhāḥ sarvāstadā jātāḥ kṣaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā patiṃ harim ||35||
śaśaṃsuḥ sūryaputryāstu pātivratyaṃ hi tāstadā |
tadeva pātivratyaṃ yat patirnārāyaṇaḥ svayam || 36 ||
nārāyaṇasvarūpo’sti cāntarātmāsti sarvathā |
na vimuktaḥ kadācitsa yathātmā na viyujyate || 37||
iti bhaktimatī nārī paṇḍitā vai pativratā |
karmaṇā vidyate kācit satī na manasā hi sā ||38||
manasā vidyate kācit satī na karmaṇā hi sā |
buddhyā kācit satī sā na manasā na ca karmaṇā || 3 9||
trībhiryā vidyate kācitsā cennaivātmanā satī |
sarvaṃ tadvirahāyaiva jāyate cātmavarjitam ||1.429.40 ||
pātivratyaṃ tvātmanā yat tatpātivratyamuttamam |
mayā tādṛk sadā prāptaṃ rādhāyāḥ kṛpayā dhruvam |||41 ||
dāsyaṃ svāmyaṃ pātivratyaṃ tasmāt kṛṣṇo mayi sthitaḥ |
rādhākṛṣṇasyāṃśarūpā vayaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanāyikāḥ ||42||
tasyānvayena cāsmāsu nityabhogo’pi vidyate |
sa eva sā saiva so’sti rādhā vai premaśevadhiḥ ||43||
tayoḥ prema sumūrte sad vaṃśīrūpaṃ dadhāra ha |
rukmiṇyādisamāveśo rādhāyāṃ lokito mayā ||44||
yūyaṃ sarvāśca rādhāyāṃ śrīkṛṣṇe stha samanvitāḥ |
nityānandamahāvārdhiyojitā na viyojitāḥ ||45||
kintu hyevaṃ na jānītha tasmād vyākulatāṃ gatāḥ |
ātmanāṃ pātivratye tu naivaṃ vyākulatā bhavet ||46||
pātivratye’pi gopīnāṃ bhavatīnāmiva bhramaḥ |
virahābhāsarūpaḥ sa āsīduddhavanāśitaḥ ||47||
uddhavasya bhavatīnāṃ bhaveccet susamāgamaḥ |
virahābhāsanāśaḥ syāt kāntānandaṃ sulapsyatha ||48||
govardhanagirerbhūmau gopīnāṃ pādareṇubhiḥ |
pavitratāṃ sadā vāñcchannuddhavo vallikātmakaḥ ||49||
vartate tu sadānandaḥ pātivratyaparāyaṇaḥ |
yadi sumūrtaḥ prāptavyastadā saṃbhūya tatsthale ||1.429.5 0||
patnībhiḥ kīrtanagītisaṃgītairutsavo mahān |
ārabdhavyastatra tasya darśanaṃ bhavitā dhruvam |||51 ||
tathā cātmasamīhānāṃ siddhiravaśyabhāvinī |
ityuktāstāḥ kṛṣṇapatnyo gatvā vallīvane drutam ||52||
govardhanādadūreṇārebhire kīrtanotsavam |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇagītirase’nanyadhiyo’bhavan |||53 ||
tāvatpremabharo bhaktastṛṇagulmalatācayāt |
ājagāmoddhavaḥ sragvī divyaḥ pītāmbarānvitaḥ ||54||
pragāyan śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ nṛtyan naman hasan |
kṛṣṇarūpaṃ dadhat taṃ tu dṛṣṭvā nāryaḥ suvismitāḥ ||55||
uddhavaṃ pūjayāṃcakrustāḥ śrīkṛṣṇasvarūpiṇam |
śrīkṛṣṇarūpiṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā mumuhuḥ ruruduḥ striyaḥ ||56||
uddhavena tadā jñātvā virahāgniṃ tu yoṣitām |
niṣkāsya svahṛdaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ tābhyaścārpitavān kṣaṇam ||57||
kṛṣṇaḥ sahasradhā tatra saṃbhūto yogamāyayā |
kāntaḥ kāmaprapūro’bhūt pratikuṃjaṃ pratipriyām ||58||
āśleṣaṇaṃ cūmbanaṃ ca ramaṇaṃ snehapūritam |
dadau pratipriyāyai sa nirvṛttiṃ paramāṃ dadau ||59||
śāntaṃ cakāra vai tāsāṃ virahānalamulbaṇam |
ātmaśāntiṃ dadau tābhyaḥ kṛṣṇaścoddhavavat tathāḥ ||1.429.6 0 ||
pātivratyaṃ dadau tābhyaḥ kālindyā iva sarvadā |
tāsāṃ pārśve vilīnaśca śāśvatātmasukhapradaḥ ||6 1 ||
vartate sma yathākāntastryavasthātmavratārthitaḥ |
evaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ śāṭikāsu pārśve nītvā yayurgṛham ||62||
uddhavo’pi hariṃ nītvā vallīṣu saṃjagāma ha |
etadātmakṛtaṃ pātivratyaṃ proktaṃ hi padmaje ||63 ||
śravaṇātpaṭhanāścāsya tādṛśaṃ tadvrataṃ labhet |
kṛṣṇaṃ pārśve labhennityaṃ śāṭyāṃ hṛdi na saṃśayaḥ ||64| |
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pātivratye kālindyāḥ uddhavasya pātivratyenānyāsāṃ kṛṣṇapatnīnāmātmapātivratyadārḍhyaprāptirityādinirūpaṇanāmā ekonatriṃśadadhikacatuḥśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||429 ||

<1.430>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
yadā viṣṇurahaṃ vaktā lakṣmīstvaṃ śravaṇe ratā |
saṃhitāyāstadā śrāvo dvimāsābhyāṃ pramokṣadaḥ || 1 ||
yadā lakṣmīrhi saṃvaktrī viṣṇuḥ śrotā bhavāmi ca |
saṃhitāyāstadā śrāvo vedamāsaiḥ pramokṣadaḥ || 2 ||
prāpyate śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitayā dhruvaḥ |
ātmapātivratyadharmaḥ prāptastvayā mukhānmama || 3 ||
rādhayā śrīkṛṣṇamukhāt saṃhitāśravaṇena vai |
tathānyābhirgopikābhiḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇānanāt || 4 ||
kāśyāṃ kuṃkumavāpyāṃ ca badaryāṃ divyadhāmasu |
sarvasṛṣṭau yathāyogyamasyā bhāgena vai dhruvam || 5 ||
pātivratyaṃ paraṃ prāptā narā nāryo narāyaṇe |
muktiṃ ca śāśvatīṃ jagmurmama dhāmni ca śāśvatīm || 6 ||
śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ ramyāṃ bhavabandhananāśinīm |
pāñcāladeśe rājābhūd vaiṣṇavo dhārmikaḥ śuciḥ || 7 ||
nirbhayavarmā nṛpatirnārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ |
tulasīmālayā nityaṃ bhajate śrīnarāyaṇam || 8 ||
dhyānaṃ pūjāṃ kriyākāṇḍaṃ mudā nārāyaṇārpaṇam |
cakre sarvaṃ harau nityaṃ sarvasvārpaṇapūrvakam || 9 ||
eko dānakasaṃjñaśca kumārastasya dhārmikaḥ |
navadhā bhaktimān kṛṣṇe gopīnāthaparāyaṇaḥ || 1.430.10 ||
nirbhayastu tapastepe bhaktiyuktaṃ sudāruṇam |
tadgṛhe tu sute jāte rādhālakṣmīkalānvite || 11 ||
jīvantī lāvaṇyavatī brahmacaryaparāyaṇe |
nārāyaṇaṃ svāminaṃ te sevāte pātivratyataḥ || 12||
sākṣādbhaktyā hariḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sevāṃ gṛhṇāti tatkṛtām |
te hyubhe śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmiparāyaṇe || 13||
vratasthe tapasā yukte devakāryaparāyaṇe |
yadgṛhe bhagavān kṛṣṇo virājate nirantaram || 14||
unmattā ca savid yatra kṛṣṇadāsī virājate |
kumāraḥ paścime vyāghrāraṇye talasya rakṣasaḥ || 15||
vanaṃ saṃprāviśat tīrthaṃ kartuṃ śyāmasya darśanam |
tatrāraṇyaṃ yoginaśca raivatācalavāsinaḥ || 16||
vyāghrasiṃhādirūpaiḥ saṃvicaranti sma ca kvacit |
kumāreṇa pathi dṛṣṭāḥ siṃhā vyāghrāḥ śataṃ param || 17||
bhayena trasto vṛkṣaṃ sa samāruroha satvaram |
siṃhāstu drumasānnidhye niṣedurnirbhayā yathā || 18||
tān dṛṣṭvā niścalān siṃhān kruddho hantuṃ mano dadhe |
krodhena tejasā dānī vyamuñcad dāruṇān śarān || 1 9||
eko bāṇena viddhaśca prāpa mṛtyuṃ tadāpare |
ṛṣirūpāstāpasāste babhūvurmānavā drutam ||1.430.20 ||
rājānamāhuḥ ṛṣayo vayaṃ raivatavāsinaḥ |
yoginaḥ sma samāyātā yātrārthaṃ śyāmaśārṅgiṇaḥ ||21 ||
mā hindhi krūrarūpāṃśca paśūn jñātvā nṛpottama |
iti śrutvā munīn dṛṣṭvā kumāraḥ śokamāptavān ||22||
aho mayā hato yogī vipro hyajānatā vane |
tīrthapuṇyasthale pāpaṃ kṛtaṃ hatyātmakaṃ mayā ||23||
kathaṃ vai niṣkṛtistvasya bhavenme hananasya vai |
vicāryāvatatāra droḥ papāta caraṇe tadā ||24||
prāharṣīn pāpanāśārthaṃ vidhyantu māṃ śarairmuhuḥ |
hatyātmakaṃ pāpaṃ mama naśyenmaharṣayaḥ ||25||
dayālavastu ṛṣayaḥ śaraṇāgatameva tam |
vaiṣṇavaṃ chatradharmāṇaṃ procuḥ kṛpāparaṃ vacaḥ ||26||
vayaṃ tu sādhavo dvandvasahā raivatayoginaḥ |
siddhā divyā divyadehāḥ saṃkalpādhīnacāriṇaḥ ||27||
jīvayituṃ mṛtaṃ sarvaṃ samarthāḥ sma ca mā śucaḥ |
ityuktvā talaśyāmasya tīrthasyoṣṇodakaṃ śave ||28||
dhārayā saṃdaduḥ sarve sajīvo bhava cocire |
tāvadṛṣiḥ samutthāya nanāma tān gurūnmuhu_ ||29||
dānī cātiprasanno’bhūt pupūja tān hṛdā muhuḥ |
ṛṣayastu tadādṛśyabhāvaṃ prāpto vanāntare ||1.430.30 ||
kintu hatyodbhavaṃ pāpaṃ vavalge dāninaṃ tu yat |
tenātivihvalastatra hatyayā pīḍito vane ||3 1 ||
babhrāma hatyayā lagno vyādhadharmamupāśritaḥ |
na kvāpi sthitimāpede hatyayābhidruto bhṛśam ||32||
sa vai bhraman yayau siṃhāraṇyaṃ yatra sarasvatī |
vaḍavāgniṃ samudre sā pracikṣepa purā kṛte ||33||
tataḥ saḥ somanāthaṃ satkṣetraṃ prāpa kumārakaḥ |
prācīṃ sarasvatīṃ cāpi yayau yatra mahāmuniḥ ||34||
tritonāmā divyadehaḥ parṇakuṭyāṃ virājate |
tenāyaṃ satkṛtastasya pādayoḥ patito bhuvi || 35||
pādāvanejanaṃ cakre pādasaṃvāhanādikam |
jalāharaṇaṃ dāsyaṃ ca phalāhārādikaṃ tathā ||36||
kuṭyāśramasya mārjanyā mārjanaṃ nirvikaccaram |
patrāvalīkaraṇaṃ ca brahmavṛkṣadalādibhiḥ || 37||
cakāra sevanaṃ tasya tritasya yoginaḥ sa vai |
yogyaṃ lakṣmi sādhusevā pāpaṃ dahati janmanaḥ ||38||
sādhūnāṃ darśanaṃ puṇyaṃ vandanaṃ pāpanāśanam |
prasannatā bhāgyadā ca tṛptiḥ putrādivaṃśadā ||3 9||
pādasevā śrīpradā ca mokṣadā tu prapannatā |
santoṣaṇaṃ sarvadaṃ hi santoṣaṇīyāḥ sādhavaḥ ||1.430.40 ||
yeṣāṃ caraṇavāryatra brahmahatyādināśakam |
yoṣāṃ pādarajaḥ pāpipāpapradhvaṃsanaṃ śubham ||41 ||
yeṣāṃ pūjā bhojanādi sarvaṃ rakṣati sarvadā |
yadāśiṣaḥ sumūrtāśca rakṣanti deśakālayoḥ ||42||
yathāśakti yathādravyaṃ yathābhāvastathā tathā |
sevanīyāḥ sadā santo divyāste harimūrtayaḥ ||43 ||
nirguṇā bandhanairhīnāḥ sevakām̐stārayanti vai |
tritasya sevayā lakṣmi brahmahatyā layaṃ gatā ||44||
tato vismayamāpannaḥ kumāro dānako muhuḥ |
sādhusamāgamastasyā vināśe veda kāraṇam ||45||
tāvattatra samāyātā netumenaṃ yamānugāḥ |
yamadūtānmahāghorān dadarśa dānakastadā ||46 ||
sevāpuṇyena sasmāra kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum |
gopīnāthaṃ hariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ svāminaṃ jagatāṃ patim ||47||
nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ svasya pārṣadānāha satvaram |
gacchantu dānirakṣārthaṃ vārayantu yamānugān ||48||
ityādiṣṭāḥ pārṣadāste samāyayustritāśramam |
dūraṃ vai vṛkṣamadhye tān dṛṣṭvā dūtān hi dāruṇān ||49||
ākrośena parābhāvya vidrāvya bhaktasevakam |
dāninaṃ ninyurete vaimānikena pathā harim ||1.430.50 ||
hariḥ prāha muneḥ sevā kṛtānena supuṇyadā |
bhakto’sti me mahāśānto dāntaścāpi cirāyuṣaḥ ||51 ||
tasmādenaṃ rājyabhāre sthāpayantu mahābalam |
sādhūnāṃ sevako bhāvī vartate vaiṣṇavo mahān ||52||
mahābhāgavato bhāvī madarthārpitanaijakaḥ |
ityuktaśca tadā dānī prāha taṃ parameśvaram ||53||
na kāṃkṣyate bhuvo rājyaṃ na janma na ca vai divam |
kāṃkṣyate te sadā sevā rādhālakṣmyanvitasya vai ||54||
hariḥ prāha tathāstvetad gaccha vatsa yathāsukham |
tava svasrormama rādhālakṣmyau nivatsyataḥ śubhe ||55||
ahaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ svāmī nivatsyāmi tava gṛhe |
sukhayiṣye mokṣayiṣye gaccha tvaṃ pārṣadaiḥ saha ||56||
tava dūrge nivatsyāmi svastyastu te’nu sevaka |
ityādiṣṭo bhagavatā yayau svanagaraṃ prati ||57||
kṛṣṇapātivratyaparān dharmāṃścakāra dādakaḥ |
sādhusevāparaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprasevakaḥ ||58||
sarvotsavakaraḥ kṛṣṇārpitasarvasvadakṣiṇaḥ |
pravṛddhaḥ sarvasampadbhirgolokasadṛśaṃ gṛham ||59||
kārayitvā gopikāyukkṛṣṇaṃ saṃsthāpya tatra ca |
bhuktvā bhogān samastāṃśca jīvanmukto’bhavatsadā ||1.430.6 0||
satāṃ patiḥ prabhurnārāyaṇaḥ svāmī janārdanaḥ |
tasya gṛhe yathoktaṃ ca nivāsaṃ pracakāra ha ||6 1 ||
taduttaraṃ hareḥ pātivratyayukte satī hyubhe |
jīvantī lāvaṇyavatī divyaiśvarye babhūvatuḥ ||62||
jīvantyāṃ śrīrādhikāyāḥ kalāveśo babhūva ha |
lāvaṇyavatyāṃ lakṣmyāśca kalāveśo babhūva ha ||63||
jīvantyā lāvaṇyavatyā dādakena nirantaram |
pātivratyaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe gopīśvare kṛtam ||64||
trayasya bhagavān dhārmiḥ pratyakṣo vartate’nvaham |
bhojane śayane vāṭyāṃ vihāre ca samutsave ||65||
vimānena sadā yāti lokāntareṣu taiḥ saha |
muktairdevaiḥ pūjitaśca samāyātyanu tadgṛham ||66||
jīvantyā lāvaṇyavatyārpitaṃ bhuṃkte hariḥ svayam |
śrīhariṇā tu jīvantyai lāvaṇyāyai ca dānine ||67||
svasya mantraḥ pradattaśca saṃsārabhavanāśakaḥ |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ ||68||
iti mantraṃ samāsādya cakrustatkīrtanaṃ muhuḥ |
tacchrutvā prāṇinaḥ sarve vaikuṇṭhaṃ paramaṃ yayuḥ ||69||
ekadā dādako gatvā yamamārge’tidāruṇe |
mantraṃ japan sthito dvāri śrāvayāmāsa nārakān ||1.430.70 ||
sarve’pi nārakāḥ pūtā yayurdhāmākṣaraṃ hareḥ |
yamakṣetramabhūd riktaṃ kṛṣṇakīrtanasaṃśravāt ||71 ||
gacchadbhirvaiṣṇavaṃ dhāma svakarmasthairjanaiḥ kṣaṇāt |
śūnyāstu narakāḥ sarve pāpiprāṇivivarjitāḥ ||72||
vaikuṇṭhe nārado dṛṣṭvā hyakasmādvaiṣṇavāgamam |
papraccha tān kutaḥ sarve samāyānti hi vaiṣṇavāḥ ||73 ||
te prāhuryamalokādvai tatra dādakanāmakaḥ |
śrāvayitvā harermantraṃ pāyayāmāsa nārakān ||74||
āyayuste nārakā ye vayaṃ sma eva te mune |
śrutvaitannāradastūrṇaṃ yamakṣetraṃ tu vīkṣitum ||75|||
samāyayau dharmalokaṃ yamena pūjito muniḥ |
papraccha dharmarājaṃ sa riktaṃ kṣetraṃ hi te katham ||76 ||
dharmarājastadā prāha dādako bhaktarāḍayam |
atibhakto hṛṣīkeśe purāṇapuruṣottame ||77||
prabodhayati kṛṣṇasya nāmamantraṃ hi nārakān |
te sarve tu gatā viṣṇorlokaṃ brahma tu śāśvatam ||78||
ayaṃ bhakto mayā yadvā tvayā yamasya maṇḍalāt |
vinayena ca satkṛtyā dūrayitavya eva yat ||79||
iti vicārya devarṣiyamarṣī procatustu tam |
bho bhaktarāṭ pāpino vai tava kīrtanasaṃśravāt ||1.430.80||
daṇḍyāṃ sthalīṃ vihāyaiva gacchanti viṣṇudhāma te |
anyāyo bhavate tvatra mā kartavyaṃ tathānagha ||81 ||
dharmalopo bhavennaiva karmalopo bhavenna ca |
tathā kāryaṃ tvayā bhakta yāhi svanagaraṃ prati ||82||
dānakaḥ saḥ tadā prāha muktirdeyā vrataṃ mama |
pātivratyaṃ paro dharmaḥ kṛṣṇasarvasvameva yat ||83||
tatprāptyarthaṃ hi jīvānāṃ pāpināṃ pāpanāśanam |
tannāmasmaraṇaṃ cātra karomi dharmameva me ||84||
na gamiṣye mama sthānaṃ vāso’tra rocate mama |
nārakāṇāṃ praduḥkhānāṃ duḥkhamocanahetave ||85||
ityuktau niścayaṃ nāyaṃ gamiṣyati gṛhe svakam |
vicārya tau vimānena yayaturyamanāradau ||86||
brahmākhyaṃ śrīharerdhāma lebhāte svāgataṃ hareḥ |
pupūjaturnematuśca niṣedaturhareḥ puraḥ ||87||
tadā yamo jagādainaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ jagatpatim |
nātha pāpamaye kṣetre tava bhakto hi dānakaḥ ||88||
samāgatya tava nāmnāṃ karoti kīrtanaṃ muhuḥ |
yamakṣetraṃ tena jātaṃ riktaṃ sarvaṃ hi nirjanam ||89 ||
adhikāro nirartho me kṛtastenātikīrtanāt |
karmadaṇḍasya paṭṭaste jāyate sma nirarthakaḥ ||1.430.90||
niyogi na niyogaṃ hi karoti kāryayojitaḥ |
prabhorvittaṃ samaśnāti sa bhavet kāṣṭhakīṭakaḥ || 91 ||
lobhād vittasya hartā ca kāryasyāvinivartakaḥ |
tiryagyonimavāpnoti kalpaparyantameva saḥ||92||
vetanaṃ tvarjayan kāryamālasyena karoti na |
sa jāyate vanamadhye vāyasaḥ śatavatsarān ||93 ||
svārthī svāmikāryaloptā mūṣako jāyate vane |
so’haṃ nirarthakaścāsmi dānī yāvanmama sthale ||94||
taṃ tva tasmānmama kṣetrād dūrīkuru janārdana |
nigrāhyo jagatāṃ nātha bhavatā dānakaḥ śuciḥ || 95||
anyathā te daṇḍapaṭastava padbhyāṃ nivedyate |
kiṃ vṛthā dhāraṇenāsya vṛthā vai vetanena ca ||96||
ityuktvā virarāmāsau hariḥ prāha yamaṃ tadā |
kimāścaryaṃ bhavedatra mannāmnāmanukīrtanam || 97||
pāpināṃ sarvapāpaghnaṃ svargadaṃ mokṣadaṃ tathā |
jihvāgre vartate yasya harirityakṣaradvayam ||98||
karṇayo patitaṃ yasya kṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti ca |
prayāti kṛṣṇasāyujyaṃ pāpyuddhārakaro hariḥ ||99||
bhaktā me pāpijīvānāmuddhārārthaṃ sthale sthale |
vicaranti yatheṣṭaṃ te tārayanti prapattitaḥ || 1.430.10 0||
teṣāmahaṃ sadā tuṣṭo ye gṛṇanti mamābhidhām |
tārayanti pāpinaśca kīrtayanti kathāṃ mama || 101 ||
pātivratyaṃ pālayanti dhārayanti ca māṃ hṛdi |
vartayanti madarthe ca narā nāryaśca me matāḥ || 1 02||
matkāryaṃ te hi kurvanti madarthe tyaktajīvanāḥ |
teṣāṃ cāhaṃ prasannātmā sahāye sarvadā sthitaḥ || 1 03||
yatkaroti karotyeva śreṣṭhaṃ tanmuktikṛd yama |
niyogī svāmikāryeṣu yāvacchakti samīhate || 1 04||
tāvatā sa kṛtārthaḥ syānnarakānnaiva gacchati |
kārye śaktiviniṣkānte svāmine vai nivedayet || 1 05||
anṛṇastāvatā bhṛtyo niyogī sukhamaśnute |
smānniveditārthasya na ṛṇaṃ na ca pātakam || 1 06||
yatne kṛte svakartavye nāparādho’sti dehinaḥ |
tasmādaśakyakāryesminna viśocitumarhasi || 1 07||
lakṣmīṃ vāpi parityakṣye prāṇān dehamathāpi vāṃ |
śrīvatsaṃ kaustubhaṃ mālāṃ vaijayantīmathāpi vā || 1 08||
śvetadvīpaṃ ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ kṣīrasāgarameva ca |
śoṣaṃ ca garuḍaṃ caiva na bhakta tyaktumutsahe || 1 09||
visṛjya sakalān bhogān madarthe tyaktajīvitān |
madātmakān mahābhāgān kathaṃ tostyaktumutsahe || 1.430.11 0||
tasmād rājan dānakaṃ te bhaktavarye svayaṃ hariḥ |
dātuṃ vai darśanaṃ yāmi netuṃ yānena vai punaḥ || 111 ||
gaccha tvaṃ yamalokaṃ ca paścādāyāmyahaṃ yama |
vada tasmai mamāyaṃ tvaṃ sa matpreṣṇāplutastadā || 11 2||
kīrtanaṃ me vihāyaiva hāsyanṛtye kariṣyati |
tāvattasmai darśanaṃ me datvā dhṛtvā vimānake || 11 3||
gamiṣyāmi tava kārya kṛtvā yāmyasya maṇḍalāt |
ityuktaśca yamastatra prajagāmātiharṣitaḥ || 1 14||
śrāvayāmāsa kṛṣṇasyāgamaṃ tasmai hiṃ dānine |
so’pi cakāra nṛtyādi bhagavatpremapūritaḥ || 1 15||
tāvad divyaṃ vimānaṃ vai nārāyaṇahareriyāt |
caturbhujaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā tu dānakaḥ || 1 16||
kṛṣṇājñayā vimānaṃ tu samāruhya raṭan muhuḥ |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ || 1 17||
nṛtyan dhyāyannamana kṛṣṇaṃ premamagno’bhavattadā |
dharmarājakṛtāṃ pūjāṃ saṃgṛhya bhagavān hariḥ || 1 18||
rādhāramāsamāyukto durge dānigṛhaṃ yayau |
avatārya paraṃ bhaktaṃ svayaṃ sthitvā niśāṃ prabhuḥ || 1 19||
jīvantyā lāvaṇyavatyāḥ sevāṃ pativratāmayīm |
svīkṛtya bhojanaṃ labdhvā datvā divyaṃ svadarśanam || 1.430.1 20||
abhayasya kuṭumbāya pātivratyāyanāya ca |
jīvantyāṃ kalayā rādhāṃ lāvaṇyāyāṃ śriyaṃ tathā || 121 ||
kalayā vasituṃ tvājñāṃ datvā chāyātmake yathā |
tathā te kanyake kṛtvā pāvayitvā gṛhāṇi ca || 1 22||
unmattāyā jale snātvā pītvāmbhastatra pāvanam |
vaihāyasena divyena yānena svapadaṃ yayau ||1 23||
gopyo jñātvā tu tadvrattaṃ mathurāmaṇḍalāttathā |
dvārikātaḥ kṛṣṇapalayo jagmuśca divyavigrahāḥ || 124||
rādhālakṣmīnivāsena gopīnāṃ kṛṣṇayoṣitām |
vāsarūpaṃ babhūvaitat kṣetraṃ durgātmakaṃ puram | | 1 25||
śrīharestatra vāsena golokasadṛśaṃ hi tat |
brahmadhāmasamaṃ divyaṃ mokṣadaṃ jātamuttamam || 1 26||
darśanātsparśanānnadyā jalapānāvagāhanāt |
dhūlyāstu dhāraṇād dehe pāpakṣayaśca mokṣaṇam || 1 27||
rādhālakṣmīpratāpena prātivratyavṛṣeṇa ca |
asaṃkhyānāṃ tu dāsīnāṃ sāṃkhyayogavratena ca || 1 28||
koṭiyajñaphaladātṛ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāśritam |
śroturvaktustīrthayātuḥ parākṣarapadapradam || 1 29||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pātivratye saurāṣṭrapañcāladeśīyadādaka(dānaka)nṛpatestalaśyāmayātrāyāṃ siṃharūparṣighāte jātabrahmahatyāyāstritamunisevayā nāśottaramāgatayamadūtānāṃ bhagavatpārṣadairnivāraṇaṃ, haribhajanena yamanārakāṇāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ, dāna(da)kasya rādhālakṣmīnārāyaṇāśīrvādo durge jīvantīlāvaṇyavatyoraṃśatayā rādhālakṣmyornivāso harerapi durgakṣetre nivāsaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā triṃśatyadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||430 ||

<1.431>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi kathayāmi śreṣṭhaṃ pativratāvṛṣam |
patirnārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇastadvrataṃ tat pativratam || 1 ||
patyarthaṃ vṛtyate yāvad buddhisādhanakarmabhiḥ |
patiryathā praśasyeta tathā patnyā vidhīyate || 2 ||
aguṇo vā saguṇo vā durguṇo’pi praśaṃsyate |
īśavat sarvathā nāryā gīyate jihvayā dhiyā || 3 ||
tadvrataṃ prathamaṃ lakṣmi pātivratyottamaṃ matam |
praśaṃsā sarvathā sarvaprāṇināṃ śarkarāsamā || 4 ||
atimiṣṭā miṣṭatamā sarvatrāpyanubhūyate |
putrapraśaṃsayā pramodate tatpitarau yathā || 5 ||
pitṛpraśaṃsayā putrāḥ pramodante’tiharṣitāḥ |
patnīpraśaṃsayā svāmī pramodate’ti cāntare || 6 ||
śreṣṭhipraśaṃsayā bhṛtyo rājñaḥ praśaṃsayā prajāḥ |
vṛṣapraśaṃsayā vṛṣavāhako’pi pramodate || 7 ||
śiṣyapraśaṃsayā gururguroḥ praśaṃsayānugaḥ |
deśapraśaṃsayā deśī śāstrapraśaṃsayāstikaḥ || 8 ||
yatprati yasya sadbhāvastatpraśaṃsā tu bhāvinaḥ |
modapramodasaṃsthānaṃ samutsāhotsavāvahā || 9 ||
bhavatyeva sadā lakṣmi patikīrtisugarbhitā |
videśasthasya kāntasya vārtā śrutvā pativratā || 1.431.1 0||
putrotsavādhikānandavatī bhavati tatkṣaṇam |
tadvrataṃ mānasagamyaṃ pātivratyaṃ mudāvaham || 11 ||
hārdaṃ snehaṃ na cānye vai prajānanti parātmanaḥ |
parātmano guṇā naiva sākṣād bhavanti sarvathā || 12||
svātmamanaḥsaṃyogasya hetostatrānupasthiteḥ |
āveśādikriyāyoge paramparābhiyogataḥ || 13|
pratyakṣamiva cānyeṣāmābhāsante na vāstavam |
pātivratyaṃ sadā snigdhaṃ hyakāraṇaṃ sakāraṇam || 14||
svārthaṃ yadvā parārthaṃ vā svārthamevānubhūyate |
mama svāmī kathaṃ khyāto bhavedityāgrahaḥ striyāḥ || 15||
pātivratyānvayitvaṃ vai satataṃ bodhyameva hi |
patyuḥ kathāśrave yadvat te’sti pramoda āgrahaḥ || 16||
tadvat kṛṣṇakathābodhe yasyāstyāgraha utkaṭaḥ |
kathāyāḥ śravaṇe vāpi kīrtane ca praśaṃsane || 17||
puṃso bhaktasya nāryāśca bhaktimatyāḥ sadā hareḥ |
sataḥ satyāstato nityaṃ pātivratyaṃ prakāśate || 18||
dāsyaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ pātivratyaṃ śubhaṃ prasannatāpradam |
kathāyāḥ śravaṇaṃ pātivratyaṃ tato’dhikaṃ matam || 1 9||
kathāyāḥ kīrtanaṃ pātivratyaṃ tato’pi cottamam |
patyuḥ svasvāminaḥ kīrtergānaṃ nityaṃ hi durlabham ||1.431.20||
patyuśca śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyābhedabhāvataḥ |
sarvadā guṇagānaṃ tatpātivratyaṃ paraṃ striyāḥ ||21 ||
hareḥ kathātmakaṃ pātivratyaṃ satpatilokadam |
śroturvakturna sandehaḥ santuṣṭo’haṃ janārdanaḥ ||22||
nayāmi taṃ mahatsvargaṃ satīlokaṃ satīṃ tathā |
niṣkāmānāṃ ca maddhāma matpadaṃ preṣayāmi vai ||23||
matkathābhirhi lokānāṃ hṛdayeṣu nirantaram |
madbhaktirnihitā yena lakṣāṇāṃ koṭidehinām ||24||
mama dāsyaṃ kathādvāṅkuritaṃ yena dehiṣu |
mama vrataṃ mama sevā mama pūjā mamārhaṇam || 25||
mama jāpo mama bhaktirmama smṛtirmamāśrayaḥ |
mamecchā mama vijñānaṃ mama dhyānaṃ mamehanam ||26||
mama yogo mama vāñcchā mamārpaṇaṃ mama grahaḥ |
maddhāraṇā mayi nyāso mayi vāso mamārthanā ||27||
mayyabhedo mayi sneho mayi kāmo ratirmayi |
mama sarvasvadānaṃ ca madarthaṃ jīvanaṃ mṛtiḥ ||28||
upārjanaṃ madarthaṃ ca madarthamupakāritā |
paropakārādi dānaṃ vrataṃ puṇyaṃ madarthakam ||29||
matpade gamanaṃ tvante matsevāgrahaṇaṃ sadā |
kathābhiḥ kāritaṃ yena lokānāṃ hṛdayeṣu vai ||1.431.3 0||
tādṛśo me kathāvaktā śāstrajñānapradaśca me |
manmahimnaḥ puṣṭikartā madbhaktipoṣakaśca yaḥ ||3 1 ||
tasya lakṣmi pātivratyaṃ mayi koṭiguṇaṃ matam |
śreṣṭhācchreṣṭhatamaṃ pātivratyaṃ vakturhi śāśvatam ||32||
kathāvācanapuṇyasya pāraṃ prāpnomi nāpyaham |
asaṃkhyajīvajātānāṃ kulānāṃ vaiṣṇavīdhiyā ||3 3 ||
uddhārako bhavatyeva kathāyā vācako guruḥ |
matsyarūpo na sandehastvattaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ sa padmaje || 34||
piturdaśaguṇī mātā māturdaśaguṇo guruḥ |
pitā bījapradatvena jananī janmadatvataḥ ||35||
gururmokṣapradatvena śreṣṭhaḥ sarvebhya ucyate |
patiḥ śreṣṭho guruḥ śreṣṭhastayoḥ śreṣṭhataro guruḥ ||36||
pitā patirguruḥ śreṣṭhāsteṣāṃ śreṣṭhatamo guruḥ |
ātmā śreṣṭho hariḥ śreṣṭhastayoḥ śreṣṭhatamo hariḥ ||37||
ātmā harirguruḥ śreṣṭhāsteṣāṃ śreṣṭhatamo guruḥ |
yadāśrayāddhareḥ prāptiryaṃ vinā durlabho hariḥ ||38||
pṛthvīdātā vṛttidātā jīvadātā sadottamāḥ |
teṣāmapekṣayā mokṣadātā jñānad uttamaḥ ||39||
kṛṣṇajñānaṃ pātivratyaṃ tatpradaḥ supatiḥ smṛtaḥ |
kṛṣṇabhaktiḥ svāmidharmastatpradaḥ supatiḥ sadā ||1.431.40||
nāmadhāraḥ patistvanyo yathārtho bhaktidaḥ patiḥ |
evaṃ jñātvā hareḥ pātivratyaṃ dhāryaṃ sadā priye ||41 ||
harerguṇānāṃ gānaṃ ca harermūrteśca cintanam |
hareḥ kathāyā vyākhyānaṃ pātivratyaṃ taduttamam ||42||
yatra kathā tatra bhaktā devāstīrthāni cācyutaḥ |
devyaḥ ṛṣayaḥ pitaro muktirbhaktirvṛṣādayaḥ ||43||
siddhā yatayaḥ satyaśca sādhavo yoginastathā |
yugāḥ śāstrāṇi vedāśca kṣetrāṇi ca vanāni ca ||44||
vyāsāstattvāni muktāśca kathāpātrāṇi yāni ca |
āgatya tāṃ kathāṃ bhāvaplutāḥ śṛṇvanti sarvadā ||45|||
kecinmūrtā amūrtāścādṛśyā dṛśyāstathāpare |
pātivratyaparāḥ sarve kathāṃ śṛṇvanti vai hareḥ ||46||
svasvayaśo hareḥ kīrtiṃ bhaktānāṃ ca kathānakam |
śrutvā śrutvā pramodante dadatyāśiṣa eva te ||47||
vācakāya gurave te namaskurvanti vai tathā |
śrotāraḥ śiṣyavargā vai namaskurvanti vācakam ||48||
tasmācchrāvayitā śreṣṭhaḥ sarvebhyo gurubhaktidaḥ |
nārāyaṇasamo bodhyaḥ pātivratyasya bodhakaḥ ||49||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ natvā kathāṃ śrutvā hareḥ śubhām |
sarvapāpavinirmukto yāti kṛṣṇapadaṃ param ||1.431.50||
purā godāvarītīre sampannaṃ sukathānakam |
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ pārāyaṇaṃ hyabhūt| ||51 ||
pāpaghnaṃ pāvanaṃ svargapradaṃ jñānadamokṣadam |
durvāsaso muneḥ śiṣyo yatiḥ satyavratābhidhaḥ ||52||
brahmaniṣṭho nirapekṣo bhikṣāmātraprajīvanaḥ |
guhāvāsakarastatrāparigrahavratānvitaḥ ||53||
tulasīmālikāyuktaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ japan |
karotisma kathāṃ nityaṃ sāyaṃ pratidinaṃ priye ||54||
dhyātvā smṛtvā smārayitvā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ patim |
namaḥ kṛtvā kārayitvā kṛṣṇakathāṃ karoti saḥ ||55||
śrotṝṇāmapyabhāve ca vyākhyātṛṇāmanāgame |
satyavratastu satataṃ karoti śrīhareḥ kathām ||56||
nityakarma svakaṃ kṛtvā karotyeva hareḥ kathām |
śrotā cedasti yaḥ kaścit tasmai vyākhyātyaharniśam |||57||
yadi nāsti sthale śrotā rikte’pi kurute kathām |
anyo vyākhyāti kaścidvā hareḥ puṇyāṃ kathāṃ tadā ||58||
svakarmāṇi parityajya śṛṇoti śrīhareḥ kathām |
hareḥ pātivratyaparaḥ kathāyāḥ śravaṇe rataḥ ||59||
tīrthāni devatānāṃ cāgārāṇyapi vihāya saḥ |
kathāvirodhakānyanyakarmāṇyapi vihāya saḥ ||1.431.6 0||
kathāṃ divyā saṃśṛṇoti sati vaktari sarvadā |
vaktaryasati svayaṃ ca vyākhyāti kṛṣṇasatkathām ||6 1 ||
kathāṃ vinā na jānāti pātivratyaṃ paraṃ vṛṣam |
catvare ca gṛhe naije svayaṃ vyākhyāti bhāvataḥ ||62||
āvaśyakāni kāryāṇi kathāto nādhikāni vai |
āvaśyakottamaṃ kārya kathārūpaṃ pradhānakam ||63||
kathāyā viratau cānyakāryaprādhānyameva ha |
kathāṃ lakṣmi śyāvatastu karmabandho na vidyate ||64||
jñānadīpaḥ pradīptaḥ syād viratiśca vivardhate |
sattvaśuddhistathā śāntiḥ śṛṇvataḥ saṃpravartate ||65||
harau prītiḥ sadā śṛṇvatā kathāṃ dārḍhyamāpyate |
kṛṣṇe prītyā mahāratyā kṛṣṇohṛdyavarudhyate ||66||
yeṣu kṛṣṇasteṣu cāsya sauhārdaṃ satsu jāyate |
sādhurūpo haristvasya pratyakṣo bhavati dhruvam ||67||
tato divyaḥ svayaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śriyaḥ patiḥ |
pātivratyaṃ paraṃ jñātvā divyadarśanado bhavet ||68||
puṃsā nāryā tataḥ kṛṣṇakathā śravyā yathābalam |
kathāṃ vinā na vai jñānaṃ tadvinā śāntireva na ||69||
duḥkhāvartte bhave tvasmin śāntikṛt kṛṣṇakīrtanam |
kathāyāḥ śravaṇaṃ caiva kṛṣṇasya smārakaṃ param ||1.431.70||
sattvaśuddhikaraṃ cāpi śuddhyā dhyānaṃ prajāyate |
bahudhā śravaṇaṃ tasya mananaṃ dhyānamuttamam ||71||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmipatiprāptikaraṃ matam |
yatra kṛṣṇakathā naiva yatra santi na sādhavaḥ ||72||
gaṃgātaṭamapi tyājyaṃ vinā patiṃ na tat priyam |
yatra vai tulasī nāsti na yatra harimandiram ||73||
yatra hare pātivratyaparo bhakto na vartate |
yatra viṣṇoḥ kathā nāsti grāmaḥ śmaśānasadṛśaḥ ||74||
tatra mṛto jano yāti yamarājatamaḥsthalīm |
iti vicārya munirāṭ satyavrataḥ sa vaiṣṇavaḥ ||75||
brahmavidyāparo viṣṇusmṛtimātraparāyaṇaḥ |
hareḥ kathāparo nityaṃ manute cātmakarma tat ||76||
na kiñcidadhikaṃ jātu manute śravaṇātparam |
kathāyāḥ kathanādvāpi paraṃ dharmo na tasya vai ||77||
nityaṃ sāyaṃ niścite vai samaye vyāsapaṭṭikām |
samāgatya niyamena kathāṃ karoti yatra vai ||78||
ekadā tatra rājñaśca sainyaṃ vai pārśvato gatam |
janāḥ sarve niruddhāśca vyāso’pi ruddha eva ha ||79||
mārge kenāpi naivātra gantavyaṃ sainyamadhyataḥ |
iti mārge niruddhaḥ sa kathārodho’pi tena vai ||1.431.80||
devādyā ye śravaṇārthaṃṃ tvāyātāstatsthale ca te |
pratīkṣante sma vaktuścāgamanaṃ taddiśādṛśaḥ ||81||
satyavrato na cāyāto vyatyeti samayastadā |
satyavratasvarūpaṃ ca dhṛtvā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ||82||
svayaṃ kathāṃ śrāvayituṃ niṣasādāsane tadā |
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitākathāmakaroddhariḥ ||83||
devāḥ śṛṇvanti bhāvena sainyaṃ krāntaṃ pathastadā |
satyavrataḥ samāyāto dṛṣṭvā vyāsaṃ svarūpiṇam ||84||
mahadāścaryamāpanno vijñāya smarato harim |
nanāmānyairyathā dṛśyo na bhaved viṣṇunā kṛtaḥ ||85||
āgatya tvāsane viṣṇormūrtau līno’bhavattadā |
kathā vicchedarahitā yathā tatra pravartate ||86||
viṣṇunā sandhitastatra svasmin satyavrataḥ priyaḥ |
kṛṣṇastvadṛśyatāṃ prāptaḥ kathā tadvatpravartate ||87||
satyavrataḥ samuvāca ślokaṃ viṣṇuvirāmitam |
tāvatsvarasya śravaṇe mādhuryaṃ bhinnatāṃ gatam ||88||
ākarṣaṇaṃ divyatā ca pūrvato’nyavidhāṃ gatā |
devādibhistadā jñātaṃ dhyānibhiryogavṛttibhiḥ ||89||
svayaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ kathāṃ cakre satyavratānupasthitau |
aho dhanyā vayaṃ kṛṣṇamukhātkathāśravaṃ gatāḥ ||1.431.90||
ityāścaryaṃ gatāḥ sarve śṛṇvanti ca kathāṃ punaḥ |
tāvat tatra samāyātaḥ śiṣyo durvāsaso’paraḥ ||91 ||
tapovratākhyaḥ karmaṭhaḥ kathānādarakṛt sadā |
kathāṃ mṛṣāṃ manyamānaḥ śrotṝn vaktṛm̐śca narmakṛt ||92||
prajahāsa kathāṃ śrutvā vitaṇḍāṃ pracakāra ha |
jalpayitvā kathañcicca vyājahāra durāgrahī ||93||
vaktā pratārayatīmānime tu paśavo yathā |
pratāraṇājālabaddhāḥ kathayā mṛṣayā muhuḥ ||94||
ityuktvā prayayau hitvā vācyamānāṃ kathāṃ tadā |
na vyākhyāti svayaṃ kvāpi na śṛṇoti kadāpi ca ||95||
tapaḥ kāryaṃ paraṃ matvā gṛhakāryādikaṃ śubham |
karotyeva sadā tadvai kathānindāṃ karoti vai ||96||
evaṃ tvāyuḥkṣaye prāpte nindāpāpena vai vane |
piśāco’bhūcchamīvṛkṣe nirjale chinnakarṇakaḥ ||97||
nirāhāro mahāduḥkhī śuṣkakaṇṭhauṣṭhatālukaḥ |
svakṛtaṃ cintayānaḥ sa mattonmatta ivābhramat ||98||
prāptaṃ jalaṃ vahnitulyaṃ phalapuṣpādikaṃ viṣam |
vāyurvahnisamastvasya jāyate pāpakarmaṇaḥ ||99||
na nirvṛttiṃ na vā tṛptiṃ labhate karmaṭho vane |
sādhuśūnye kathāśūnye’raṇye kṣudhākulo rudan || 1.431.1 00||
satyavratena daivādvai dṛṣṭo mārgeṇa gacchatā |
pṛṣṭhaḥ kosīdṛśīṃ kasmād daśāṃ prāpto’si me vada || 101 ||
iti pṛṣṭhaśchinnakarṇastapovrata uvāca tam |
durvāsasaḥ suśiṣyo’haṃ tapovratasunāmadhṛk || 1 02||
kathānindotthapāpena piśāco’smi suduḥkhitaḥ |
adya te darśanānmokṣo bhaviṣyati mamātra vai || 103 ||
kṣamasva tvaṃ cāparādhān mama vaitaṇḍikādikān |
ityuktvā sa rudan mokṣaṃ samicchan pṛthivīṃ spṛśan || 1 04||
papāta pādayoḥ satyavratasya trāhi māṃ gṛṇan |
satyavrataḥ salilaṃ svakare dhṛtvā hariṃ smaran || 1 05||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ |
iti mantraṃ dadau karṇe jalaṃ cikṣepa mastake || 1 06||
datvā pādaṃ tasya pṛṣṭhe pāpaṃ prajvālya śaktitaḥ |
samarpyaikadivasīyakathāyāḥ puṇyamuttamam || 1 07||
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitādhyāyasya kathodbhavam |
jñānaṃ pradāya ca kṛtvā muktaṃ piśācadehataḥ || 1 08||
divyadehadharaṃ kṛtvā sasmāra śrīhariṃ prabhum |
tāvat kṛṣṇaḥ samāyāto rādhālakṣmīprabhānvitaḥ ||1 09||
pārvatīmāṇikīnāthaḥ padmāramājayāpatiḥ |
lalitāśrīpatiḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sapārṣadaḥ || 1.431.11 0||
koṭisūryātisaṃśobhivimānavarasaṃsthitaḥ |
satyavratena bhagavān nato’rcitaḥ stuto muhuḥ || 111 ||
tapovrataṃ vimāne sve netuṃ samprārthito muhuḥ |
prajahāsa haristatra bhaktecchāpūrakaḥ prabhuḥ || 11 2||
prāha golokavāsārhaṃ puṇyaṃ vai nāsya vidyate |
satyavratastadā prāha gurumantreṇa dīkṣitaḥ ||1 13||
vaiṣṇavo’sti mayā tvatra kṛto’yaṃ puṇyavān kṛtaḥ |
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitaikādhyāyasya sukṛtam || 1 14||
dattamasmai mayā kṛṣṇa dadāmi tulasīsrajam |
tava pādajalaṃ cāsmai punardadāmi keśava || 1 15||
tava prasādaṃ naivedyaṃ dadāmyasmai kṣaṇena ca |
tena puṇyena bhakto’yaṃ tavānugrahamātrataḥ ||1 16||
golokaṃ te yātu dhāma bhaktecchāpūrako bhavān |
ityuktaḥ sa hariḥ satyavrataṃ tathāstu cāha yat || 1 17||
tapovrato muniṃ natvā vimānaṃ tvacyutājñayā |
samāruroha prayayau golokaṃ viṣṇunā saha || 1 18||
durvāsāśca tadā tatrājagāma divyadṛṣṭimān |
praśaśaṃsa svakaṃ śiṣyaṃ satyavrataṃ kathākaram ||1 1 9||
satīrthyamokṣadaṃ śāntaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ bhavatārakam |
punaḥ punastadovāca durvāsā hṛṣṭamānasaḥ ||1.431.1 20||
aho hyekena śiṣyeṇa tāritaḥ karmaṭho’paraḥ |
aho hyekena śiṣyeṇa tāritaṃ sakalaṃ jagat || 121||
aho hyekena śiṣyeṇa tārito’haṃ gurustathā |
ayo hyekena śiṣyeṇa śiṣyavānasmi sāmpratam || 122||
satsu daśasahasreṣu śiṣyeṣvapi suśiṣyavān |
satyavratena jāto’smi kṛṣṇakathāprasevinā || 1 23||
yatra kṛṣṇakathāpūrapravāho vahate sadā |
tatra vāsakṛtāṃ muktirdāsīva karapātragā || 124||
iti te śrāvito lakṣmi kathāpativratāvṛṣaḥ |
śravaṇātpaṭhanāccāsya kṛṣṇadhāmapadaṃ labhet || 125||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne durvāsasaḥ śiṣyasya pātivratyaparāyaṇasya satyavratanāmakasyaikadivasīyakathāpuṇyadānena tapovratasya piśācatvamokṣaṇaṃ dhāmaprāptiśca, satyavratasya kathākāle’nupasthitau bhagavān satyavratarūpadhṛk kathāmavācayadityādinirūpaṇanāmaikatriṃśadadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||43 1 ||

<1.432>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śrūyatāṃ ca tvayā lakṣmi pātivratyaparāyaṇām |
divyāṃ camatkṛtiṃ vakṣye pāpatāpavināśinīm || 1 |
pāñcāladeśe saurāṣṭre hemantākhyo’bhavannṛpaḥ |
śaśāsa rājyaṃ dharmeṇa paścime puṇyalālasaḥ || 2 ||
pūrvaṃ dānaṃ kṛtaṃ tena ratnānāṃ kanakasya ca |
jalaṃ mūlyātmakaṃ nāsti jaladānaṃ tu nākarot || 3 ||
tena doṣeṇa rājño vai liptasya ca śanaiḥ śanaiḥ |
sampaddhānirjāyate sma gajāśvā rogapīḍitāḥ || 4 ||
gomahiṣyādi yacchreṣṭhaṃ naṣṭaṃ paśudhanaṃ hi tat |
ajāvikaṃ samastaṃ ca vanyaṃ mṛgādikaṃ tathā || 5 ||
rogaprapīḍitaṃ sarvaṃ vināśamagamacchanaiḥ |
anāvṛṣṭirabhūttasya nirmānuṣyavidhāyinī || 6 ||
deśaḥ śuṣkastato jātaḥ prajā deśāntaraṃ yayuḥ |
rājyakośādikaṃ jātaṃ śūnyaṃ riktaṃ ca nirbalam || 7 ||
jñātvā tvanye nṛpāḥ pañca militvā yānamācaran |
taṃ jetuṃ sulabhaṃ matvā samājagmuḥ samantataḥ || 8 ||
pāñcālarājaṃ yuddhena jigyurninyuśca sampadaḥ |
hemantaḥ svapativratāpatnyā yuktastu raivate || 9 ||
dhātrībhṛtyādisahito viveśa girigahvaram |
māninyā bhāryayā yukto vanyairyātrāṃ carannṛpaḥ ||1.432.1 0||
cintayāmāsa bahudhā badarījambvaraṇyake |
phalakandakṛtāhāraḥ kimetad dukhaḥmāgatam || 11 ||
mayā dānaṃ pradattaṃ vai bahudhā pratiparvaṇi |
mātṛpitṛhitaṃ sarvaṃ kṛtavānasmi sevakaḥ || 12||
guravastoṣitā nityaṃ brāhmaṇāścāpi rakṣitāḥ |
dharmaḥ surakṣitaḥ śaśvad devāścāpi prapūjitāḥ || 13||
indriyāṇāṃ vaśe nāhaṃ nāhaṃ vyasanalampaṭaḥ |
na cauryapāradāryādikartṛsaṃgī kadācana ||14||
tathāpi vai kathaṃ cedaṃ dāridryaṃ samupāgatam |
parājayo mahān jāto viruddhā bāndhavādayaḥ || 15||
ye’nukūlāstu te sarve’dhunāptāḥ pratikūlatām |
kasya vā karmaṇaścedaṃ phalamāptaṃ mayā prabho || 16||
evaṃ cintayatastasya raivatādrivane’niśam |
yātrārthaṃ tvāgatastatra tadgururyājakābhidhaḥ || 17||
prāptaśca satkṛto vanyaistṛpto nataśca pādayoḥ |
papraccha duḥkhaprāpteḥ sa pāñcāleśastu kāraṇam || 18||
dāridryaṃ kośanāśaśca śatrubhiḥ saṃparājayaḥ |
rājyanāśo vane vāso bāndhavā vimukhāḥ katham || 19||
mama deśe’pyanāvṛṣṭiḥ kathametad guro vad |
iti pṛṣṭo gururdhyātvā vijñāya pūrvajanmajam ||1.432.20||
karma tatkāraṇaṃ sarvaṃ tasmai cāha śṛṇu nṛpa |
purāraṇyanivāsī tvaṃ vyādhaḥ prāṇivihiṃsakaḥ ||21 ||
niṣṭhuraścauryakuśalo dharmakarmavivarjitaḥ |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇanāmno japakāryavirodhyapi ||22||
kṛṣṇasmaraṇahīnaśca praṇāmavarjitaḥ sadā |
śastrajīvī mārgalabdhaprajāpīḍākaraḥ śaṭhaḥ ||23||
bālāpatyamṛgāṇāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ hatyākarasya te |
apatyāni na jāyante jātasya garbhapātatā ||24||
viśvāsaghātakatvena bāndhavā naiva sodarāḥ |
mārgapīḍākaratvena mitrasuhṛdvivarjitaḥ |||25||
sādhūnāṃ ca tiraskārāt śatrubhiste parābhavaḥ |
kadāpyadattadoṣeṇa dāridryaṃ te hyupasthitam ||26 ||
pravāsināṃ kaṣṭadastvaṃ kaṣṭamudvejanaṃ tava |
sarvāvamānakartā tvaṃ cāvamānaṃ gato mahat ||27||
jalādīnāmadānena vane tvaṃ jalapīḍitaḥ |
nirāhāro bhavasyeva pūrvakarmavipākataḥ ||28||
atha rājam̐tvayāraṇye sukṛtaṃ rājyadaṃ kṛtam |
śṛṇu kaścinmunistatra karṣaṇākhyaḥ samāgataḥ ||29||
brahmacaryavratī kṛṣṇapātivratyaparāyaṇaḥ |
tadā tvaṃ dhanurādāya mārgaṃ ruddhvā puraḥ sthitaḥ ||1.432.3 0 ||
pṛṣṭavān ceddravyamasti dīyatāṃ me vanecara |
muniḥ prāhāvyayaṃ dravyaṃ madagre vartate śaṭha ||3 1 ||
yadīcchasi pradāsye’haṃ pātraṃ gṛhāṇa cedasi |
śrutvā taṃ viḥsmitastatra kīdṛk pātraṃ dhanaṃ ca kim |||32|||
vicāryaṃ proktavānenaṃ dehi cedasmi pātrakam |
karṣaṇastasya vacasā tutoṣa prāha re śaṭha ||33 ||

paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaścānye svalpā vai mānavā api |
karṣaṇaḥ prāha pāpī tvaṃ pāpakṣālanamicchasi ||35||
tadā pāpānyahaṃ te’tra kṣālayāmi yadīcchasi |
vyādhaḥ prāha samicchāmi pāpānāṃ kṣālanaṃ mama ||36||

vyādhaḥ snātvāyayau paścāt tulasīdalamiśratam |||37||
kṛṣṇaprāsādikaṃ vāri tasmai pānārthamarpitam |
apibat sa jalaṃ śiṣṭaṃ mastake dhṛtavām̐stataḥ ||38||

oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ |
vāratrayaṃ mahāmantraḥ śrāvitastāvadeva tu ||1.432.40||
taccharīrālomakūpebhyaśca pāpāni sarvaśaḥ |
nirgatāni mūrtimanti hatyādīni sahasraśaḥ ||41 ||
rurudustāni sarvāṇi dīnāni vikṛtāni ca |
bhayaṃkarāṇi sarvāṇi prāhustaṃ karṣaṇaṃ tadā ||42||
asmākaṃ ko’styaparādhaḥ kathaṃ ca muninā tvayā |

dehi vāsaṃ tvayi yadvā tasmin yadvā sthalāntare |
avaśyameva bhoktavyaṃ kṛtaṃ tena vanāntare ||44||
karṣaṇastu tadā prāha kṛṣṇanāmnā tvaghāni vai |
prajvalantyājanmajāni yuṣmākaṃ tādṛśī gatim ||45||

dāmodarasya tīrthasya parvate saṃbhramanti hi ||47||

sarojalaṃ samānīya tṛṣā tasya nivāritā ||48||

kṛtaṃ vyajanapavanaḥ śītalo vījitastadā ||1.432.50||
evaṃ sādhoḥ kṛtā pūjā karṣaṇarṣerhi bhāvataḥ |

evaṃ vyādhena bhaktena paricaryā kṛtā tadā ||52||

oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ ||88||
evaṃ japaṃ kuru rājannaṣṭottaraśataṃ dine |
tena muktiṃ paraprāptisvarūpāṃ tvaṃ labhiṣyasi ||89||
satāṃ divyajanānāṃ tvaṃ kuru saṃgaṃ supuṇyadam |
sādhvīnāṃ ca satīnāṃ ca darśanaṃ kuru vai satām ||1.432.90||
sevāṃ pūjāṃ pādacaryāṃ kaiṃkaryaṃ dāsavat kuru |
vaha teṣāṃ pādarajāṃsyapi svaśirasā sadā ||91 ||
caraṇāmṛtameteṣāṃ piba snāne niyojaya |
satyaśca sādhavo rājannānakhādāśiro’vadhim ||92||

tena te sakalā lokā bhaviṣyanti vaśānugāḥ ||94||

dhūpadīpasunaivedyajalapuṣpaphalādibhiḥ ||97||

dāsyatyabhīṣṭamevāsyai pātivratyena sevayā ||98||
