teṣāṃ madhye samāsīnaḥ svavṛttāntamaśeṣataḥ ||72||
rājñe nivedayāmāsa takṣakasya sumitratām |
dattaṃ ratnādikaṃ sarvaṃ divyaṃ rājñe nyavedayat ||73||
saumāṃgalyamayī vārtā patnīrāṣṭre’bhavattadā |
tathā svasya pituḥ rāṣṭre mānavaiḥ kathitā kathā ||74||
pitarau ca prajāḥ sarvā niṣadhasyātiharṣitāḥ |
tadutsavo mahānāsīd rāṣṭragrāmapurādiṣu ||75||
sīmantinī patiṃ prāpya tyaktavaidhavyalakṣaṇā |
vahniṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya saubhāgyamaṃgalābhavat ||76||
candrāṃgadaḥ svahastena sindūrādi samārpayat |
binduṃ parasparaṃ tau tu cakrāte sākṣataṃ śubham ||77||
mālāṃ parasparaṃ tau cārpayāmāsaturaiśvarīm |
tāmbūlakaṃ dadatuśca dānāni vividhānyapi ||78||
athāyaṃ śvaśurau natvā patnīyuto nijaṃ gṛham |
niṣadhaṃ saṃyayau pitroḥ pādayorapatat tataḥ ||79||
daśavarṣasahasrāṇi sīmantinyā svabhāryayā |
sārdhaṃ candrāṃgado rājā bubhuje viṣayān bahūn ||1.448.8 0||
prāsūta tanayānaṣṭau kanyāmekāṃ varānanām |
reme sīmantinī bhartrā dhyāyamānā hariṃ haram ||8 1 ||
dine dine tu saubhāgyaṃ prāpa caivenduvāsarāt |
evaṃ lakṣmi sadā pātivratyaṃ vijayate bhuvi ||82||
svarge satye brahmaloke pātāle pramadājane |
pātivratyaṃ rakṣitaṃ cet sarvasiddhikaraṃ bhavet ||83 ||
patiṃ kṛṣṇasvarūpaṃ tu matvā dhyātvā sadā satī |
kalpavṛkṣasamaṃ dharmaṃ pātivratyaṃ samācaret ||84||
parādhīnābalānāṃ vai kāmapratimayoṣitām |
dehāḥ pāpāśrayāḥ santi tato’pyadhikapuṇyadāḥ ||85||
pāpaṃ tu kāmātiśayaḥ, puṇyaṃ sevā pade pade |
patisevā kṛṣṇasevā vratadānādisevanam ||86 ||
atitheśca satāṃ sevā gavāṃ sevā pade pade |
niṣpāpānāmapatyānāṃ sevā brahmasvarūpiṇām ||87||
gṛhasaṃrakṣaṇaṃ sevā vahnāvannādipācanam |
vaiśvadevātmikā sevā hyanāthaśvādibhojanam ||88||
annasatrātmikā sevā bālasya kalabhāṣaṇam |
vidyādānātmikā sevā sahanaṃ sādhubhūṣaṇam ||89||
patyadhīnā nirīhā ca sadgaṇādisuśobhanam |
ityeva sevayā puṇyamanantakaṃ striyāḥ sadā ||1.448.90 ||
bhuktimuktipradaṃ tasmāt pātivratyaṃ samācaret |
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya svargo mokṣaḥ kare sthitau ||91 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne candrāṃgadasya kṛṣṇapativratayā sīmantinīnāmnyā patnyā pātivratyabalacamatkārairyamunāmagnaḥ patiḥ pātāle nāgakanyābhirnīto’pi punaḥ prāpta ityādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭacatvāriṃśadadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 448 ||

<1.449>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
atha sīmantinīsatyāścamatkāraṃ vadāmi te |
śṛṇu lakṣmi kṛṣṇabhaktiparāyāḥ patiyoṣitaḥ || 1 ||
pātivratyena dharmeṇa sadā kṛṣṇaḥ pratuṣyati |
patnī lakṣmīsvarūpāsti patirnārāyaṇātmakaḥ || 2 ||
iti buddhyā praseveta parasparaṃ pramucyate |
dampatyoḥ kṛtasakalpāḥ siddhyanti nahi niṣphalāḥ || 3 ||
vidarbhaviṣaye vipro vedamitro’bhavat sudhīḥ |
tasya putraḥ sumedho’bhūddharmācāraparāyaṇaḥ || 4 ||
anyaḥ sārasvatākhyaśca vipro’bhūttasya pattane |
tasya putraḥ somavām̐ścābhavaddharmaparāyaṇaḥ || 5 ||
sumedhaḥ somavām̐ścobhau mitravaryau samākṛtī |
sarvavidyākuśalinau samavidyau babhūvatuḥ || 6 ||
tāvekadā svatanayau dvijāvavocatāṃ hitam |
he putrakau yuvāṃ bālye kṛtavidyau suvarcasau || 7 ||
vaivāhiko’yaṃ samayo vartate yuvayoḥ samam |
imaṃ vidarbharājānaṃ prasādya prāpya vai dhanam || 8 ||
śreṣṭhakulajakanyābhyāṃ kṛtodvāhau bhaviṣyathaḥ |
evamuktau sutau gatvā samatoṣayatāṃ nṛpam || 9 ||
dhanārthamarthito rājā prāha tau daivanoditaḥ |
mama putrī niṣadheśapatnī sīmantinī satī || 1.449.1 0||
somavāre pūjayitvā śrīpatiṃ pārvatīpatim |
patnīyuktān dvijān vedavido dhanaṃ dadātyalam || 11 ||
ato’tra yuvayoreko nārīvibhramaveṣadhṛk |
ekastasyāḥ patiśceti jāyethāṃ vipradampatī || 12||
gatvā tatra dhanaṃ labdhvā punaryātaṃ mamāntikam |
yadi nyūnaṃ bhaveccet tad dāsye’haṃ tvadhikaṃ dhanam || 1 3||
ityuktau prāhatuḥ rājan kartuṃ tajjāyate bhayam |
devatāsu gurau pitroḥ siddhe yogini bhūbhṛti ||14||
kauṭilyamācaran sadyo daṇḍapātraṃ vinaśyati |
gopyamānaṃ tu nau chadma kadācit khyātimeṣyati || 15||
tadārjitā guṇāḥ sarve naśiśyanti kṣaṇānnṛpa |
pāpaṃ nindā bhayaṃ vairaṃ tiṣṭhanti chadmani dhruvam || 16||
ato dhūrtajanācāraṃ nāśrayāvaḥ kadācana |
śrutvaitannṛpatiḥ prāha devatāpitṛyoginām || 17||
nollaṃghyaṃ śāsanaṃ pālyaṃ sadgurusiddhabhūbhṛtām |
śubhāśubhaṃ tadādiṣṭaṃ kartavyaṃ śreyase bhavet || 18||
ityuktau tau tathetyuktvā sāmavān rūpavām̐stadā |
strīveṣaṃ śāṭikāṃ bhūṣā añjanaṃ keśasādhanam || 1 9||
aṃgarāgaṃ spṛhaṇīyaṃ dadhāra yuvatī yathā |
evaṃ tau dampatī bhūtvā jagmatustāṃ sīmantinīm ||1.449.20||
sā rājñī tvarcayāṃcakre patnīyuktān yathāvratam |
tau tu viprasutau dṛṣṭvā prāptau kṛtakadampatī ||2 1 ||
pātivratyena dharmeṇa tathā kṛṣṇasya sevayā |
harabhaktyā vivedainaṃ kumāraṃ kanyakākṛtam |||22||
jñātvā kiṃcid vihasyātha pitrā saṃpreṣitāviti |
mene gaurīmaheśau ca lakṣmīnārāyaṇāviti ||23||
śivakṛṣṇātmakān viprān gaurīśrīrūpayoṣitaḥ |
āvāhya gandhamālyādyairdhūpadīpairapūjayat ||24||
pāyasaṃ modakān miṣṭapolikāḥ śaṣkulīstathā |
śākāni bhakṣyabhojyāni viprānabhojayat satī ||25||
tāmbūlaṃ dakṣiṇā dhenūrhiraṇyaṃ ratnalakṣakam |
pratyekaṃ vastrabāhulyaṃ datvā natvā vyasarjayat ||26 ||
sīmantinyā śivāṃ lakṣmīṃ tvāvāhya sāmavān dvijaḥ |
pūjitaḥ kalpitā kanyā satyaṃ kanyā vyajāyata ||27||
nārīcihnāni sarvāṇi paryavartanta varṣmaṇi |
tau tu dhanaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ vai prāpya yayatuḥ svaṃ gṛham ||28||
sā tu vismṛtapuṃbhāvā mitre jātaspṛhābhavat |
karābhyāṃ vipramābaddhya kandarpavivaśābravīt ||29||
ayi kānta kṣaṇaṃ tiṣṭha vane ramye supuṣpite |
tvayā vihartumicchāmi priyā te’smi gṛhāṇa mām ||1.449.3 0||
pariṣvajasva māṃ kāntāṃ pāyayasva navādharam |
nāhaṃ gantuṃ samarthāsmi smarāvegaprapīḍitā ||3 1 ||
itthamaśrutapūrvāṃ tāṃ dṛṣṭvā niśamya śaṃkitaḥ |
papraccha stanayuktāṃ tāṃ kimevaṃ bhāṣase sakhe ||32||
narmavākyaṃ vṛthā naivaṃ vaktavyaṃ kṛtrimābale |
kanyāveṣaṃ parityajya kumāraveṣamāvaha ||33||
ityājñaptā prasannā sā vastrāṇi dūrato’karot |
tāvat sā satyadhammilā jaghanastanaśobhinī ||34||
yoniyuktā liṃgahīnā dṛṣṭā sumedhasā priyā |
sā tu jagrāha vipraṃ taṃ suratāya navapriyā ||35||
sumedhāḥ prāha tāṃ kanyāṃ śāṭikādīni dhāraya |
na praśastaṃ viduṣorvaiṃ jāradharmaniṣevaṇam ||36||
vañcayitvātmapitarau dhūrtarājānuśāsanāt |
ayaṃ svayaṃkṛto’nartha āvābhyāṃ yadviceṣṭitam ||37||
yastvaṃ viprātmajo bālaḥ prāptaḥ strītvaṃ vigarhitam |
kāmabhogo hyanarthāya kumārayorviṣaṃ phalam ||38||
evaṃ vivekamāśritya tūṣṇīmehi svayaṃ gṛham |
devadvijaprasādena strītvaṃ nāśaṃ sameṣyati ||39||
athavā daivayogena strītvameva bhavettava |
pitrā dattā mayā sākaṃ raṃsyase varavarṇini ||1.449.40 ||
ityuktāpi kāmadāvānalavyāptā vadhūstadā |
balena taṃ samāliṃgya cucumbādharapallavam ||41 ||
dharṣito’pi tayā dhīraḥ sumedhāḥ sparśamātrataḥ |
śāntiṃ tasyāścakāraiva bahiḥ sparśaḥ pradāya ca ||42||
akṣatā kanyakā tṛptā kāmadāho nivavṛte |
śuddhiṃ kṛtvā jalādyaiśca yayaturnṛpamandiram ||43||
rājā jñātvātha tadvṛttamavāpa vismayaṃ tataḥ |
āhūya pitarau viprau jagāda svaviceṣṭitam ||44||
śrutvā sārasvataḥ prāha rājānaṃ dhūrtaceṣṭitam |
are rājan mama putrastavājñayā tu kānyakam ||45 ||
veṣaṃ dhṛtvābhavat kanyā strītvaṃ bhuṃkte jugupsitam |
adya mamaikaputrasya vaṃśo naṣṭastathā mama ||46 ||
nirāśāḥ pitaraḥ sarve luptapiṇḍodakakriyāḥ |
vadātra kiṃ mayā kāryaṃ daṇḍyo’styadya bhavān khalu ||47||
rājā sarvān samāhūya maharṣīnāha dīnavat |
asyāḥ puṃstvaṃ yathā syāt kurvantu mayi prasādanam ||48||
te’bruvan śrīpateḥ satīpaterlabhyaṃ prasādanam |
tadbhaktānāṃ prasādaśca labhyasteneṣṭamāpnuyāt ||49 ||
atha rājā bharadvājaṃ samāhūya mahāmunim |
pūjanaṃ kārayāmāsa śrīpateḥ pārvatīpateḥ ||1.449.5 0||
viprā rājā tathā kanyāścaite sarve hyupoṣitāḥ |
trirātraṃ pūjanaṃ cakruḥ ṣoḍaśādisuvastubhiḥ ||5 1 ||
akhaṇḍaṃ bhajanaṃ cakrurmahotsavamakārayan |
jaya lakṣmi jaya cāmbe śrīpate pārvatīpate ||52||
iti tadbhajanaṃ cākhaṇḍitaṃ bādyasamanvitam |
cakrustena susantuṣṭau śrīpatiḥ pārvatīpatiḥ ||53||
āyayaturvāhanasthau patnī yuktau kṛpālayau |
tau cāhatuśca rājānaṃ kiṃ te brūhi samīhitam ||54||
so’pyāha puṃstvametasya dīyetāṃ kṛpayā mayi |
tāvāhatustadā rājannasmadbhaktaistu yat kṛtam ||55||
śakyate nānyathākartuṃ varṣāyutaśatairapi |
sīmantinī mahābhaktā satī kṛṣṇapativratā ||56|||
naikasiddhiyutā devī yamunājalapāyinī |
svabharturjīvarakṣāyāḥ kartrī yogasamādhinā ||57||
yathā saṃkalpayet sādhvī satī kṛṣṇāpativratā |
tathā tatkalpanārūpaṃ vastu pariṇataṃ bhavet ||58||
kanyāveṣo’bhavad bālastayārcitā tu kanyakā |
kanyeyaṃ pārvatī lakṣmīriti saṃkalpya pūjitā ||59||
sumedhasaḥ supatnīyamiti saṃkalpya sādaram |
sumedhāśca patirasyāḥ somavatyāśca kalpitaḥ ||1.449.6 0||
tat tathaiva hi sañjātaṃ yogināṃ sabalā gatiḥ |
nānyathā kriyate kaiściditi rājan nibodha vai ||6 1 ||
vayaṃ bhaktavaśāḥ sarve bhaktakṛtaṃ mataṃ hi naḥ |
gacchantu ca bhavanto vai sīmantinyāḥ prapannatām ||62||
yadi kṛpāyutā rājñī yuṣmadiṣṭaṃ vidhāsyati |
kanyeyaṃ kṛpayā tasyāḥ punaḥ puṃstvamavāpsyati ||6 3 ||
ityuktā vimanasaste yayuḥ sīmantinīgṛham |
puṃstvārthaṃ prārthayāmāsuḥ prāha sīmantinī tu tān ||64||
kṛtaṃ karmaphalaṃ bhuṃkte mānavo bhuvi sarvathā |
asyā mātrā vrataṃ puṇyakākhyaṃ kṛtaṃ purā yadā ||6 5||
putrecchayā kṛtaṃ cāpi varṣānte dakṣiṇāvidhau |
putrī syānme tadā śreṣṭhamiti vai kalpitaṃ phale ||66 ||
evaṃ dvedhā vratapūrṇāhūtau saṃkalpitaṃ yataḥ |
tataḥ putraḥ samutpannaḥ sa eva yauvanaṃ gate ||67||
kanyārūpā prajātāsti vratena karmaṇāpi ca |
tasmānneyaṃ punaḥ puṃstvaṃ gamiṣyati kadācana ||68||
kintu punastatsvarūpastatpitroḥ susutaḥ śubhaḥ |
sarvalakṣaṇasampanno dīrghajīvī ca vaiṣṇavaḥ ||69||
mameṣṭadevasaṃkalpād bhaviṣyati hi niścitaḥ |
eṣā sāmavatī nāma sutā tasya dvijanmanaḥ ||1.449.70||
bhūtvā sumedhasaḥ patnī kāmabhogena yujyatām |
yatsaṃkalpena yajjātaṃ prāgbhave cātra vā bhave ||71 ||
phalaṃ saṃskārajanyaṃ tat samāpatati kālataḥ |
asminneva bhave tveṣā nārīveṣadharā satī ||72||
patiṃ matvā sumedhaṃ taṃ vāmapārśve sthitābhavat |
pativratāyā hastena pūjanaṃ sarvasākṣikam ||73||
sañjātaṃ devatulyena rājñā samanumoditam |
satsarvaṃ tīvrasaṃvegaṃ karma tvasyāḥ phalātmakam ||74||
pākaṃ prāptaṃ śakyate nānyathākartuṃ tu kenacit |
kaṇvasya vacanāt kṛṣṇakuṭumbasya vināśakam ||75||
sāmbagarbhasamābaddhaṃ mūśalaṃ suvyajāyata |
tasmācchoko na kartavyaḥ prāpte phale tu karmaṇaḥ ||76||
kanyātve’pi parau lābhaḥ putraste syād dvitīyakaḥ |
evaṃ matvā sukhaṃ yāntu sarve santu nirāmayāḥ ||77||
ityuktvā sā satī putrīṃ sīmantinī śubhāśiṣā |
yojayāmāsa bahudhā yayuḥ svaṃ svaṃ gṛhaṃ tu te ||78||
sārasvato dvijaḥ putrīṃ dadau tasmai sumedhase |
alabhad dvitīyaṃ putraṃ sutābhūtasutottamam ||79||
evaṃ satīpratāpena tvatarkyamapi jāyate |
tatrāpi kṛṣṇabhaktāyā iṣṭaṃ drutaṃ vivartate ||1.449.80||
etatte kathitaṃ lakṣmi sarvaṃ tapaḥprabhāvanam |
paṭhanācchravaṇāttvasya yatheṣṭaṃ labhate janaḥ ||81||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne sārasvataviprasya sāmavānnāmakasutasya vivāhavyayārthaṃ vidarbharājato dhanecchayā gatasya kanyāveṣeṇa bhikṣukasya sāmavataḥ pativratayā sīmantinyā kanyāṃ matvā pūjitasya sāmavatīkanyātvaṃ tatpituḥ putrāntaraprāptiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikonapañcāśadadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||449||

<1.450>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi sutārthaṃ vai pārvatyāḥ pātivratyakam |
satyā svayaṃ suramadhye vratānte samprakāśitam || 1 ||
himālayo dadau kanyāṃ pārvatīṃ śaṃkarāya tu |
saṃreme narmadātīre śayyāyāṃ śivayā haraḥ || 2 ||
tayorbabhūva śṛṃgāro yoginorbahuvāsarān |
devā daityārditāḥ śaṃbhuputraṃ daityavināśakam || 3 ||
ayonijaṃ samicchanto yayustayoḥ ratergṛham |
vīryasrāvasya nikaṭe prākkṣaṇe dvāri te sthitāḥ || 4 ||
ājuhuvurmahādevaṃ devāste ratibhaṃjakāḥ |
uttiṣṭhato maheśasya bhūmau vīryaṃ papāta ha || 5 ||
tadvai tatra suvarṇaṃ ca rajataṃ ca vyajāyata |
atha vīryaṃ na vai garbhe prāptaṃ satyāḥ śuśoca sā || 6 ||
yato devaiḥ kṛtaṃ vighnaṃ tato devā api sadā |
rati bhaṃgakarāḥ sarve vyarthavīryā bhavantviti || 7 ||
ityuktvā śaṃkaraṃ prāha rativicchedaduḥkhitā |
ratibhaṃgo duḥkhamekaṃ dvitīyaṃ vīryapātanam || 8 ||
duḥkhātirekiduḥkhaṃ tu tṛtīyamanapatyatā |
tataḥ putrauo yathā me syāttathā kurvatra śaṃkara || 9 ||
śrutvā tāṃ śaṃkaraḥ prāha harerbhaktyanvitā sadā |
vrataṃ tu puṇyakaṃ nāma varṣamekaṃ kuru priye || 1.450.1 0||
tena putraphalaṃ te’tra niścitaṃ vai bhaviṣyati |
vrataṃ tat sukhadaṃ puṇyaṃ vāñcchākalpadrumātmakam || 11 ||
jāhnavī saritāṃ madhye surāṇāṃ śrīhariryathā |
ahaṃ vaiṣṇavabhaktānāṃ yathā tvaṃ devayoṣitām || 12||
lakṣmīśca sampadāṃ yadvat suvarṇaṃ dravyanāminām |
śīlavrataṃ vratānāṃ ca tadvat puṇyavrataṃ tvidam || 13 ||
varṇānāṃ brāhmaṇo yadvat tīrthānāṃ badarīvanam |
pārijātaṃ kusumānāṃ dalānāṃ tulasīdalam || 14||
ekādaśī tithīnāṃ ca vārāṇāṃ tu yathā raviḥ |
mārgaśīrṣaśca māsānāmṛtūnāṃ ca vasantakaḥ || 15||
samvatsaraśca varṣāṇāṃ yugānāṃ ca kṛtaṃ yathā |
vidyāguruśca pūjyānāṃ gurūṇāṃ jananī yathā || 16 ||
satī patnī yathāptānāṃ viśvastānāṃ tu hṛd yathā |
yathā ratnaṃ dhanānāṃ ca priyāṇāṃ ca yathā patiḥ || 17||
yathā sutaśca bandhūnāṃ kalpadruḥ śākhināṃ yathā |
āmraphalaṃ phalānāṃ deśānāṃ saurāṣṭrako yathā || 18||
vṛndāvanaṃ vanānāṃ ca rādhikā yoṣitāṃ yathā |
purīṇāṃ ca yathā kāśī lakṣmīnāṃ kaṃbharā yathā || 1 9||
tejasvināṃ yathā tvarkaḥ khaṇḍānāṃ tvajanābhakam |
rātrīśānāṃ yathā candro mohakānāṃ ca manmathaḥ ||1.450.20||
vidyānāṃ tu yathā vedāḥ sādhūnāṃ kapilo yathā |
vānarāṇāṃ hanūmām̐śca kṣetrāṇāṃ ca satāṃmukham ||21 ||
netrāṇāṃ ca yathā vidyā vāsanā balināṃ yathā |
manoharāṇāṃ kāvyaṃ ca vyāpakānāṃ viyad yathā ||22||
aṃgānāṃ locanaṃ yadvat sādhyānāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ yathā |
vaibhavānāṃ kṛṣṇakathā sukhānāṃ tṛṣṇikālayaḥ ||23||
sparśānāṃ putrasaṃsparśo hiṃsakānāṃ khalo yathā |
yathā mithyā ca pāpānāṃ pāpināṃ mātṛgo yathā ||24||
puṇyānāṃ svārpaṇaṃ yadvat kāryāṇāṃ sādhusevanam |
aikāgryaṃ tapasāṃ yadvallābhānāṃ harisevanam ||25||
gavyānāṃ ca ghṛtaṃ yathā vṛkṣastapasvinām |
amṛtaṃ bhojyavastūnāṃ sasyānāṃ vrīhayo yathā ||26 ||
pavitrāṇāṃ yathā vāri śodhakānāṃ yathānalaḥ |
strīrūpaṃ sarvarūpāṇāṃ miṣṭānāṃ supriyaṃ vacaḥ ||27||
vainateyaḥ pakṣiṇāṃ ca airāvataśca dantinām |
sanatkumāro yogināṃ devarṣīṇāṃ ca nāradaḥ ||28||
gandharvāṇāṃ citraratho gururbuddhimatāṃ yathā |
kavīnāṃ tu yathā śukraḥ kāvyānāṃ saṃhitā yathā ||29||
srotasvatāṃ yathā tvabdhiḥ kṣamiṇāṃ ca kṣitiryathā |
phalānāṃ ca yathā muktiḥ śāntiśca sampadāṃ yathā ||1.450.30||
pāvanānāṃ vaiṣṇāvāśca varṇānāṃ praṇavo yathā |
kṛṣṇamantraśca mantrāṇāṃ poṣṭṝṇāṃ prakṛtiryathā ||3 1 ||
sarasvatī viduṣīṇāṃ gāyatrī chandasāṃ yathā |
yathā kuberaḥ śreṣṭhistho nāgānāṃ vāsukiryathā ||32||
śayyānāṃ ca yathā śeṣo layānāṃ nidrikā yathā |
niṣkriyāṇāṃ yathālasyaṃ śailānāṃ meruparvataḥ ||33||
gavāṃ ca surabhiryadvat tṛṇānāṃ ca yathā kuśaḥ |
vedānāṃ sāmavedaśca mano vai vegināṃ yathā ||34||
sukhadānāṃ yathā lakṣmīrakṣarāṇāmavarṇakaḥ |
hitārthināṃ yathā tāto hetīnāṃ kavacaṃ yathā ||35||
śālagrāmaśca mūrtīnāṃ paśūnāṃ kesarī yathā |
dehināṃ mānavo yadvadindriyāṇāṃ tu hṛd yathā ||36||
mandāgniśca rujāṃ yadvacchaktiḥ śaktimatāṃ yathā |
sthūlānāṃ ca virāḍ yadvat sūkṣmāṇāṃ paramāṇukaḥ ||37||
ādityānāṃ yathā viṣṇurdevānāmindra eva ca |
daityānāṃ ca baliryadvad dātṝṇāṃ ca dadhīcikaḥ ||38||
prahlādaścaiva sādhūnāṃ cakrāṇāṃ ca sudarśanam |
brahmāstraṃ ca yathāstrāṇāṃ rāmādityaśca bhūbhṛtām ||39||
dhanvināṃ ca naro yadvat kṛṣṇo hṛdayavāsinām |
prasevyānāṃ gururyadvad vratānāṃ puṇyakaṃ tathā ||1.450.40 ||
kartavyaṃ sevanīyaṃ ca pālanīyaṃ suputradam |
harermantraṃ gṛhītvā tvaṃ vrataṃ putrapradaṃ kuru ||41 ||
māghaśuklatrayodaśyāṃ vratāraṃbhaḥ śubhaḥ priye |
upoṣya pūrvadivase dvitīye vratamācaret ||42||
śrīkṛṣṇaṃ ṣoḍaśavastusūpacāraiḥ prapūjayet |
āsanaṃ svāgataṃ pādyamarghyamācamanīyakam ||43||
snānīyaṃ madhuparkaṃ ca vastrāṇyābharaṇāni ca |
sugandhi puṣpadhūpaṃ ca dīpaṃ naivedyacandanam ||44||
yajñasūtraṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ dravyāṇyetāni ṣoḍaśa |
puṣpāṃjaliṃ praṇāmādīn kṣamā cātha visarjanam ||45||
nityaṃ kuryād vrataṃ sāṃvatsaraṃ putraphalapradam |
ṣaṇmāsām̐śca haviṣyānnaṃ māsān pañca phalādikam ||46||
haviḥ pakṣaṃ jalaṃ pakṣaṃ vratameva samāpayet |
deyā vratasamāptī ca dakṣiṇā homapūrvikā ||47||
kṛṣṇāṃśo vai bhavetputro vratakartryā na saṃśayaḥ |
priyavratottānapādau lebhe śatarūpā vratāt ||48||
devahūtirvratāllebhe kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ kapilaṃ sutam |
arundhatī vratāllebhe kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ śaktikaṃ sutam ||49||
sāvitrī ca vrataṃ kṛtvā lebhe vedān suputrakān |
śaktikāntā vrataṃ kṛtvā lebhe putraṃ parāśaram ||1.450.50||
satyavatī vrataṃ kṛtvā lebhe vyāsaṃ sutaṃ harim |
vratena kaṃbharā prāpa sutaṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ||51 ||
aditiśca vrataṃ kṛtvā lebhe vāmanakaṃ sutam |
mahendrāṇī vrataṃ kṛtvā lebhe jayantakaṃ sutam ||52||
uttānapādapatnī ca lebhe dhruvaṃ vratāt sutam |
kuberāṇī vrataṃ kṛtvā lalābha nalakūbaram ||53||
sūryapatnī śrāddhadevaṃ manuṃ lebhe ca raivatam |
anasūyā vrataṃ kṛtvā lebhe candraṃ śubhaṃ sutam ||54||
lebhe cāṃgirasaḥ patnī vratāt| sutaṃ bṛhaspatim |
khyātirlebhe vrataṃ kṛtvā śukrācāryaṃ sutaṃ kavim |||55||
ete nārāyaṇāṃśā vai jātā vrataprabhāvataḥ |
vratasyāsya prabhāveṇa svayaṃ gopīpatiḥ prabhuḥ ||56||
īśvaraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ tava putro bhaviṣyati |
ityuktvā prayayau śaṃbhuḥ pārvatyā saha jāhnavīm ||57||
tasyai dadau harermantraṃ śrīkṛṣṇāya namaḥ śubham |
snātvā vratasya saṃkalpaṃ kṛtvā yayā gṛhaṃ nijam ||58||
ānīya sarvadravyāṇi samārebhe vrataṃ tataḥ |
sanatkumāro bhagavānabhūt tatra purohitaḥ || 59||
brahmādyā devatāḥ sarve manavo yatayastathā |
ṛṣayo vālakhilyāśca dakṣādyā bhūbhṛtastathā ||1.450.60||
dikpālā lokapālāśca cirajīvina āyayuḥ |
pūjitāḥ śaṃbhunā prāhuḥ karotu puṇyakaṃ śivā ||61 ||
śrīkṛṣṇaśca sutastasyā bhaviṣyati purā yathā |
evaṃ kramo mahādeva kalpe kalpe’sti sarvathā ||62||
ityuktaḥ śaṃkaraḥ sanatkumāreṇa niveditām |
pārvatīdvārikāṃ kṛṣṇapūjāṃ śreṣṭhāmakārayat ||63||
saṃsthāpya ratnakalaśaṃ śukladhānyopari sthitam |
āmrapallavasaṃyuktaṃ phalākṣatasuśobhitam ||64||
candanāgurukastūrīkuṃkumādisamarcitam |
munīn satī pūjayitvā saṃpūjya svapurohitam ||65||
puraḥ saṃsthāpya dikpālān devān samarcya vai tataḥ |
svastivācaṃ vācayitvāvāhya kṛṣṇaṃ ghaṭe tataḥ ||66 ||
sampūjya ṣoḍaśadravyairupahāraṃ cakāra sā |
tilasarpiṣā havanaṃ trilakṣaṃ pracakāra sā ||67||
brāhmaṇān bhojayāmāsa pradadau dakṣiṇāṃ parām |
purohitaḥ śivāṃ prāha dehi me patidakṣiṇām ||68||
patirūpāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ tu śrutvā śuśoca pārvatī |
śivaḥ prāha śive dakṣiṇayā karmaphalaṃ bhavet ||69||
yatkarma dakṣiṇāhīnaṃ tatsarvaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavet |
tanmuhūrte vyatīte tu dakṣiṇā dviguṇā bhavet ||1.450.70||
caturguṇā dinātīte pakṣe śataguṇā bhavet |
māse pañcaśataguṇā ṣaṇmāse taccaturguṇā ||71 ||
samvatsare vyatīte tu karma tanniṣphalaṃ bhavet |
putrapautradhanaiśvaryakṣayaḥ syāttu tataḥ param ||72||
dharmo naṣṭo bhavettasya dharmahīne tu karmaṇi |
viṣṇuḥ prāha sati rakṣa phaladaṃ rakṣakaṃ vṛṣam ||73 ||
brahmā prāha sati dharme naṣṭe kartā vinaśyati |
dharmaḥ prāha śive kāntaṃ datvā māṃ rakṣa yatnataḥ ||74||
rakṣite ca mayi sādhvi sarvaṃ bhadraṃ bhaviṣyati |
devā ūcuḥ rakṣa dharmaṃ kuru pūrṇaṃ vrataṃ sati ||75||
vayaṃ tava vrate pūrṇe kurmastvāṃ pūrṇamānasām |
ūcustāṃ munayaḥ śaṃbhuṃ dehi viprāya dakṣiṇām ||76 ||
sthiteṣvatmatsu dharmajñe nābhadraṃ te bhaviṣyati |
prāha sanatkumārastvaṃ me śivaṃ dehi dakṣiṇām ||77||
no ced vrataphalaṃ sarvaṃ tyaja prāpsyāmyahaṃ phalam |
śivā prāha patiryatra hriyate tu purodhasā ||78||
kiṃ me syāt tadvratenāpi kiṃ me dakṣiṇayā surāḥ |
kiṃ putreṇa ca dharmeṇa sarvasvaṃ yatra nīyate ||79||
kutaḥ phalaṃ kuto vṛkṣo yadi bījaṃ na vidyate |
bhūmiḥ sā niṣphalā bījaṃ vinā sasyapradā na vai ||1.450.80||
kṛṣiśca viphalā sarvā bījaṃ vinā tu vārṣikī |
prāṇaṃ tyaktvā prayatnena varṣmaṇā kiṃ prayojanam ||81 ||
dṛṣṭiśaktivihīnena cakṣuṣā kiṃ prayojanam |
śataputrādhikaḥ svāmī sādhvīnāṃ tu sureśvarāḥ ||82||
yadi bhartā vrate deyaḥ kiṃ vratena sutena vā |
bharturvaṃśo hi tanayo bhartumūlo bhavetsadā ||83||
yatra mūlaṃ bhaved bhraṣṭaṃ tadvyāpārastu hānidaḥ |
viṣṇuḥ prāha satīṃ tatra putrāt svāmī paraḥ sadā ||84||
svāminaśca paro dharmastannāśe svāmināpi kim |
brahmā prāha sati putri dharmo vai svāminaḥ paraḥ ||85||
dharmātparaṃ satyakāryaṃ vrataṃ satyaṃ paraṃ matam |
satyaṃ sadakṣiṇaṃ karma na tu bhraṣṭaṃ kuru vratam ||86||
śivā prāha ca vedeṣu svaśabdo dhanavācakaḥ |
tad yasyāstīti sa svāmī dhanavān sa samucyate ||87||
dhanitaḥ śreṣṭha evātra dharmastato vrataṃ ṛtam |
tebhyo’dhikaḥ patiḥ svāmī svāmitvaṃ tatra śāśvatam ||88||
āgantukaṃ dhanavatāṃ tasmāt| svāmī patiḥ paraḥ |
tasyāhaṃ dhanamevāsmi pitrāhaṃ cārpitā purā ||89||
dānarūpā śivasvatvavatī cāhaṃ na me śivaḥ |
svatvaṃ vinā kathaṃ dānaṃ vadantyatra surādayaḥ ||1.450.90||
dharmaḥ prāha sadā patnī svāmino’rdhāṃganā matā |
dampatīmūrtirekaiva svena svaṃ śakyate’rpitum || 91 ||
satī prāha mayi svāmyaṃ svāmitvaṃ ceti cāgatam |
svāmitvavigamaṃ svāmyaṃ vinivogakṣamaṃ bhavet ||92||
tato yogyā na varte’trārpayituṃ tu patiṃ mama |
patirdāne striyā datta iti sṛṣṭau na vai śrutam || 93||
kanyādānaṃ śrutāvuktaṃ jāmātre jagatāṃ kramaḥ |
varadānaṃ varārthinyai jyeṣṭhapitre kutaḥ kramaḥ ||14||
devāḥ prāhuḥ sati naiva buddhimanto vayaṃ tvayi |
puṇyake kalpitāṃ svāmidakṣiṇāṃ dharmamācara ||95||
śrutau śrutaḥ sa vai dharmo viparīto hyadharmakaḥ |
satī prāha vinā lokācāraṃ vedo’tinirbalaḥ ||96 ||
vede prakṛtipuṃsostu garīyān puruṣo’dhipaḥ |
adhipaṃ nu kathaṃ dāsye bālāhaṃ kathayāmi kim ||97||
bṛhaspatistadā prāha sargaścobhayanirmitaḥ |
śrīkṛṣṇaścobhayasraṣṭā samau prakṛtipūruṣau ||98||
satī prāha pumān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāṃśa eva saḥ |
nāryastu mūlaprakṛteraṃśāstataḥ pumān guruḥ ||99||
pumām̐stvatra parabrahma sadāśivaḥ patirmama |
mayā kathaṃ patirdeyo vadantvatra hi devatāḥ || 1.450.10 0||
itivāde pravṛtte’tra vimānaṃ svarṇabhāsvaram |
āgataṃ śrīpatirnārāyaṇaścaturbhujastataḥ || 10 1||
avatīrya sabhāmadhye sthitaḥ sarvaiḥ prapūjitaḥ |
prāha gaurīṃ sati tvayā nyāyyameva samucyate || 1 02||
dakṣiṇā yajñapatnī ca yajamānena dīyate |
viprāya tatra mūlyaṃ vai dīyate na kratupriyā || 1 03||
parapatnī pareṇa dīyate parāya na kvacit |
tannimittaṃ svarṇaraupyaṃ dīyate dhanameva yat ||1 04||
patnīdāne putradāne svasya dāne patyarpaṇe |
gopradānaṃ vidhāyaiva karma pūrṇ prajāyate || 105||
viṣṇudehā yathā gāvo viṣṇudehastathā śivaḥ |
viṣṇudehā dakṣiṇā ca mūlyātmikā pradīyate || 1 06||
vrataṃ pūrṇe kuru śive śivaṃ datvā tu dakṣiṇām |
punaḥ samucitaṃ mūlyaṃ datvā nāthaṃ grahīṣyasi || 1 07||
ityuktā sā havanānte śivaṃ 3 dakṣiṇāṃ dadau |
svastītyuktvā tu jagrāha kumāro devasaṃsadi || 108||
satī prāha gṛhāṇaitad gavāṃ lakṣaṃ dhanaṃ ca vā |
dehi matsvāminaṃ vipra dāsye dānāni vai tataḥ || 1 09||
patiṃ vinā na vai karma tvanyat kartu kṣamā yataḥ |
sanatkumāraścovāca me gavāṃ na prayojanam ||1.450.1 1 0||
ratnānāṃ ca dhanānāṃ ca sādhorme kiṃ prayojanam |
prayojanaṃ me śiṣyasya tyāgino’vadhūtasya ca || 111 ||
sa tu prāpto mayā tvatto na dāsye śaṃkaraṃ tava |
karturevepsitaṃ karma svasya dravye svatantratā ||1 12||
anye vadantu yatkiñcid gobhirna me prayojanam |
digambaraṃ puraḥ kṛtvā bhramiṣyāmi jagattrayam || 11 3||
bālakānāṃ bālikānāṃ samūhasmitakāraṇam |
ityuktvā tu śivaṃ pārśve vāsayāmāsa vai sanat || 1 14||
pārvatī tu tadottasthau jagāda śokavihvalā |
punarlabdhaḥ patirnaiva na prāptaṃ tu phalaṃ vrate ||1 15||
eṣā satī bhavāmyatra vahnimutpādya dehataḥ |
hāhākāro’bhavat tatra śrīkṛṣṇo bhagavān svayam || 1 16||
jhaṭityenāṃ samāśliṣya vārayāmāsa mūrtimān |
satyā dṛṣṭaśca bhagavān vimānādavatīrya saḥ || 1 17||
rarāja vinivāryaiva sabhāmadhye vilokitaḥ |
devauḥ supūjite kṛṣṇaṃ pārvatī tuṣṭuve hṛdā || 1 18||
tvayāhaṃ jīvitā kṛṣṇa punarjīvaya śaṃbhunā
śaṃbhuṃ dehi phalaṃ dehi putraṃ bhavādṛśaṃ prabho ||1 1 9||
ityuktaḥ śrīhariḥ satyai dāpayāmāsa śaṃkaram |
purodhase dadau dravyaṃ viprebhyo dakṣiṇāstathā || 1.450.1 20|||
vrataṃ samāpya sā sarvān bhojayitvā tataḥ param |
bubhuje svāminā sārdhaṃ tāmbūlaṃ ca dadau tataḥ || 121 ||
devādyāḥ pūjitāḥ sarve yayuḥ svargaṃ tataḥ satī |
śayyāyāṃ śaṃbhunā reme tāvad brāhmaṇarūpadhṛk || 1 22||
kṛṣṇastatra samāyāto vṛddho bhikṣuka āha ca |
mātarbhikṣāṃ tu me dehi punaḥ punaruvāca ha ||123||
śaṃbhurutthāya tu śīghraṃ vīryamutsṛjya śāyane |
bahiḥ śīghraṃ tvājagāma tat satyāḥ śarīre’lagat || 124||
vīryaṃ yattatkṛtaḥ piṇḍaḥ kṛṣṇastasmin vyalīyata |
tūrṇaṃ bālo’bhavat satyā kṛṣṇatulyo vilokitaḥ || 125||
evaṃ prāpto gaṇeśaḥ saḥ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ svayameva tu |
pātivratyena sā durgā patiṃ tatyāja na kvacit || 1 26||
patirdevaḥ patiḥ poṣṭā paralokapradāyakaḥ |
putrapautrādivaṃśasya mūlaṃ patiḥ paraḥ prabhuḥ || 127||
prāṇānāṃ vigame cāpi na tyājyaḥ svapatiḥ priyaḥ |
dakṣiṇārthaṃ gṛhīto’pi gṛhīto na visarjitaḥ || 1 28||
evaṃ patipriyā sādhvī labhate kṛṣṇasadṛśam |
suputraṃ kṛpayā patyuḥ kimu vācyaṃ nu padmaje || 129||
satīvratasamākhyānaṃ patidānasamāgraham |
śṛṇuyādvā paṭhedvāpi putraṃ saubhāgyamāpnuyāt || 1.450.1 30||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pārvatyāḥ puṇyakavrate śaṃbhudakṣiṇānimittapātivratyabalaṃ saṃvādo gaṇeśaputraprāptiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcāśadadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||450||

<1.451>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi śabaryāstu pativratam |
camatkārabharaṃ sarvaṃ patyarthaṃ kiṃ na jāyate || 1 ||
yā satī sarvathā svāmisantoṣādiparāyaṇā |
jayatyeva sadā loke dharmo rakṣati rakṣitaḥ || 2 ||
āsīt pāñcālarājasya siṃhaketostu kiṃkaraḥ |
caṇḍakākhyastu śabaro yasya gehe pativratā || 3 ||
śabarī patibhaktāsīt patiṃ matvā paraṃ prabhum |
patiṃ bheje sadā bhaktyā yathā santoṣamāpnuyāt || 4 ||
bhojanādau vihārādau vyavasāyādikarmasu |
kaiṃkarye vā gṛhakārye kleśaṃ naiva karoti sā || |9 ||
sarvadā suprasannāste smitānanā ca kiṃkarī |
śuṣkaṃ rūkṣaṃ paryuṣitaṃ snigdhaṃ miṣṭaṃ ca vātulam || 6 ||
tiktaṃ dagdhamapakvaṃ vā bharjitaṃ pācitaṃ ca vā |
saṃskṛtaṃ bāṣpitaṃ yadvā yādṛk tādṛg bhavedapi || 7 ||
śabaro na ruṣaṃ yāti śabarī na vidūyate |
śabaro nityamevāsyāḥ premapātraṃ suśāntidaḥ || 8 ||
śabarī svāmivaśagā datvā kāntāya khādati |
kāntaṃ viṣṇuṃ sadā matvā karoti sevanaṃ satī || 9 ||
śūdradharmaṃ puraskṛtya vartete dampatī sadā |
niṣkapaṭau śāṭyahīnau satyamārgaparāyaṇau ||1.451.1 0||
sādhūnāṃ sevakau nyāyamārgalabdhasujīvanau |
kaiṃkaryeṇa ca yallabdhamannādyaṃ tatra tuṣyataḥ || 11 ||
kārye prāpte śabaraśca pṛṣṭvā bhāryāṃ karoti tat |
śabaryapi patiṃ pṛṣṭvā kāryaṃ yogyaṃ karoti sā || 12||
yadyapi syātprāṇanāśaḥ pativākyaṃ na muñcati |
śabaro’pi niṣiddhaṃ yacchabaryā na karoti tat || 1 3||
śabaryapi niṣiddhaṃ yat svāminā na karoti tat |
yatra vai manasoraikyaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ svargameva tat || 14||
yatra satyaṃ niṣkāpaṭyaṃ parasparaṃ sumānanam |
tatra nārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇo viṣṇu śivaḥ śivā śriyāḥ ||15||
smṛddhayaśca śubho lābhaḥ siddhiḥ rakṣā nirāmayam |
ekadā siṃhaketuḥ saḥ kṣātradharmaṃ samāśritaḥ || 16||
jagāma mṛgayārthaṃ sabhṛtyo vanaṃ mṛgānvitam |
śabaraḥ sa vane jīrṇaṃ dadarśa devatālayam || 17||
tatra liṃgaṃ bhagnapīṭhe viyuktaṃ svalpamityapi |
dṛṣṭvādāya nṛpaṃ prāha paśyainaṃ ruciraṃ śivam || 18||
tamenaṃ pūjayiṣyāmi yathāvibhavamādarāt |
pūjārītiṃ mama brūhi prītaḥ syācchaṃkaro yathā || 19||
iti pṛṣṭho nṛpaḥ prāha prahasyainaṃ yathātatham |
kaṭhinaṃ pūjanaṃ tvasya tvayā tannahi pāryate |||1.451.20||
saṃkalpena sadā kuryādabhiṣekaṃ navāmbhasā |
upaveśyāsane śuddhe śubhairgandhākṣatairnavaiḥ ||21 ||
vanyaiḥ patraiśca kusumairdhūpairdīpaiśca pūjayet |
citābhasmopahāraṃ ca prathamaṃ parikalpayet ||22||
ātmopabhogyenānnena naivedyaṃ kalpayet sadā |
punaśca dhūpadīpādīnupacārānprakalpayet ||23||
nṛtyavāditragītādīn thathāvat parikalpayet |
namaskāraṃ prakuryācca prasādaṃ dhārayet tataḥ ||24||
eṣa sādhāraṇaḥ proktaḥ śivapūjāvidhistava |
citābhasmopahāreṇa sadyastuṣyati śaṃkaraḥ ||25||
namaḥ śivāya ca vadet pārvatīpataye namaḥ |
evamuccārayan devaṃ pūjayet sakuṭumbakaḥ ||26||
ityuktaścaṇḍako bhīlo mūrdhnā jagrāha tadvacaḥ |
atha svabhavanaṃ prāpya liṅgarūpaṃ sadāśivam || 27||
catuṣke pippalamūle saṃsthāpya vaidikopari |
pratyahaṃ pūjayāmāsa citābhasmopahārakṛt ||28||
yattvātmanaḥ priyaṃ vastu patnyāścāpi priyaṃ tu yat |
gandhapuṣpākṣatādyaṃ ca miṣṭānnaṃ kaṇameva vā ||29||
nivedya śaṃbhave nityamupāyuṃkta tataḥ svayam |
evaṃ sadāśivaṃ bhaktyā saha patnyābhyapūjayat ||1.451.30||
āśutoṣastutoṣāsmai dadau sukhaṃ dhanādikam |
annaṃ vastraṃ gṛhaṃ dravyaṃ gauśca dogdhrī yaśastathā ||3 1 ||
rājyataḥ prāpyate sarvaṃ vetanaṃ dāsyadharmataḥ |
satyādhāraṃ śivādhāraṃ sukhaṃ prāptaṃ kuṭumbinā ||32||
yathā yathābhavad bhīlaḥ sukhī sādhanavām̐stathā |
pūjanaṃ prākaronnityaṃ niyamenārhaṇaṃ muhuḥ ||33||
svayaṃ gatvā śmaśānādāvādāya śavabhasma saḥ |
śivasya pūjanaṃ cakre vṛṣṭyādāvapi nityadā ||34||
ekadā śivapūjāyai pravṛttaḥ śabarottamaḥ |
na dadarśa citābhasma pātre yad rakṣitaṃ ca tat ||35||
vṛṣṭyā rātrau jaladhārā pātre papāta chidrataḥ |
bhasma prakṣālitaṃ sarvaṃ pravāheṇa samaṃ gatam ||36||
iti vilokya riktaṃ tatpātraṃ yatra ca nāṇvapi |
bhasma lebhe tato dūraṃ śmaśānaṃ prayayāvapi ||37||
vṛṣṭyā prakṣālitatvāttu citābhūmermanāgapi |
bhasma lebhe na vai tatra paritaḥ saṃbhramannapi ||38||
tataḥ śrānto riktahasto gṛhamāgānnirāśakaḥ |
kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi bhasmārtha cādya bhūtale ||39||
vṛṣṭiḥ sarvatra bahulā jātā prajāyate’tigā |
grāmāntare’pi sarvatra kṣālitā pherurāṭkṣitiḥ ||1.451.40||
bhasma prāpyeta naivādya pūjā jāyeta naiva ca |
bhojanādyaṃ tataḥ sarvaṃ bhavennādya tu me khalu ||41 ||
vṛṣṭervirāme saṃjāte kasyacinmaraṇottaram |
māsānte vā miled bhasma tadā nītvā haraṃ prabhum ||42|||
pūjayiṣye tato bhakṣyaṃ gṛhīṣyāmi kuṭumbayuk |
itivicārya cāhūya patnīṃ bhīlo’bravīt priye ||43||
na prāpāhaṃ citābhasma kiṃ karomi vada priye |
harapūjāmahāvighnaṃ jātaṃ me tvadya dustaram ||44||
prāptavānna citābhasma vṛṣṭyā dhautaṃ śmaśānakam |
upāyaṃ nātra paśyāmi pūjopakaraṇārjane ||45||
pūjāṃ vinā kṣaṇārdhaṃ vā nāhaṃ jīvitumutsahe |
upavāsā bhaveyurme vinā bhasmaprapūjanam ||46||
itivyākulitaṃ dṛṣṭvā sā satī śabarāṃganā |
cintayāmāsa satataṃ śivena sukhino vayam ||47||
śivaḥ sukhaprado lakṣmīprado mokṣapradastathā |
nahi śivasya bhaktānāmaśivaṃ saṃbhavet kvacit ||48||
śivārthaṃ kriyate yadyat tatsarvaṃ śivadaṃ bhavet |
dhanaṃ gṛhaṃ yaśo vastraṃ bhojanaṃ jalamityapi ||49||
śivārthaṃ kalpitaṃ sarvaṃ divyaṃ śivakaraṃ bhavet |
śivena sundaro dehaḥ pradattastena poṣitaḥ ||1.451.50||
patyarthaṃ ca śivārthaṃ me nārīdeho bhavecchubhaḥ |
ko lābhastatparaścātra yena mokṣo bhavenmama ||51||
evaṃ vicārya śabarī mā bhaiḥ kāntamuvāca ha |
idameva gṛhaṃ dagdhvā jīrṇakāṣṭhopabṛṃhitam ||52||
ahamagniṃ pravekṣyāmi citābhasma bhavet tataḥ |
pūjāṃ tena kuru kānta nārī kāryāparā tvayā ||53||
ahaṃ prāpsye ca kailāsaṃ tava dehaviyojane |
netuṃ cāhaṃ tvāgamiṣye śaṃbhunā saha mā śucaḥ ||54||
priyāvākyaṃ samākarṇya śabarastāmuvāca ha |
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ dehaḥ paramasādhanam ||55 ||
kathaṃ tyajasi taṃ dehaṃ sukhadaṃ navayauvanam |
adhunā tvanapatyā tvaṃ bhogayogyā punaḥ punaḥ ||56||
dṛḍhā puṣṭā baliṣṭhā ca kathaṃ dagdhumihecchasi |
śabarī prāha re kānta sāphalyaṃ jīvitasya me ||57||
prāṇatyajanaṃ patyarthe śivārthaṃ kimuta svayam |
kinnu taptaṃ tapo ghoraṃ kiṃ vā dattaṃ mayā purā ||58||
kiṃ vārcanaṃ kṛtaṃ śaṃbhoḥ pūrvajanmaśatāntare |
kiṃ vā puṇyaṃ mama pituḥ kā vā mātuḥ kṛtārthatā ||59||
yacchivārthe samiddhāgnau tyajāmyetatkalevaram |
śabaryā me prāptakālo mokṣasyāyaṃ pravartate ||1.451.60||
anekajanmabhiryo na prāpyate bhīlayoṣitā |
kathaṃ taṃ niṣphalaṃ kartuṃ mohe patāmi śūdrikā ||61 ||
sarve yajñāḥ pradānāni tīrthāni ca tapāṃsi ca |
mama jātāni manye’haṃ madbhasma śaṃkare’rpitam ||62||
itthaṃ sthirāṃ matiṃ dṛṣṭvā tasyā bhaktiṃ ca śaṃkare |
śabaro’pi svasya bhasma kartuṃ dātuṃ mano dadhe ||63||
uvāca śabarīṃ patnīṃ jīva kānte śataṃ samāḥ |
mama bhasma vidhāyaiva mokṣaṃ yāsye’tidurlabham ||64||
naikajanmanāṃ pāpena śabaro’haṃ mahādhamaḥ |
prāptaṃ mokṣasya saddvāraṃ kathaṃ tyaktuṃ samutsahe ||65||
tvayā śaṃbhuḥ pūjanīyo sadā madbhasmanā priye |
yadvā satī priyaṃ kāntaṃ jīvayapyeva bhasmataḥ ||66||
sāvitrī satyavantaṃ saṃjīvayāmāsa vai purā |
yadvā satī svayaṃ vahnimutpādya svāminā saha ||67||
divaṃ vrajet tathā kāryaṃ tvayā me priyayā priye |
ityuktā sā patiṃ prāha nātha te maraṇottaram ||68||
niścitaṃ maraṇaṃ me’sti satīrītyā hi sarvathā |
dvayormṛtyvapekṣayātra mamaiva maraṇaṃ varam ||69||
patidṛṣṭyā satī nārī patihastena yā mṛtā |
patyarthaṃ ca śivārthaṃ ca janmasāphalyamṛcchati ||1.451.70 ||
ekottaraśatavaṃśoddhārayitrī tu sā bhavet |
tallābho me’tra saṃprāpto bhavatvevaṃ mayi kṛpā ||71 ||
itthaṃ sthirāṃ matiṃ dṛṣṭvā nyāyyaṃ tasyā hitaṃ vacaḥ |
tatheti dṛḍhasaṃkalpaḥ śabaraḥ pratyapūjayat| ||72||
sā bhartāramanujñāpya snātvā śuciralaṃkṛtā |
gṛhamādīpya taṃ vahniṃ bhaktyā cakre pradakṣiṇam ||73||
namaskṛtvātmagurave dhyātvā patiṃ tathā śivam |
agnipraveśābhimukhī kṛtāṃjaliridaṃ jagau ||74||
mamendriyāṇi puṣpāṇi santu dhūpo’gururvapuḥ |
hṛdayaṃ supradīpo’stu prāṇā havīṃṣi santu ca ||75||
karaṇānyakṣatāḥ santu śaṃbho tvāṃ pūjayāmyaham |
na vāñcchāmi mahārājyaṃ svargaṃ vā paramaṃ padam ||76||
tava sevāṃ saha patyā saṭā tvicchāmi śaṃkara |
cittaṃ tvayi sadā tvastu hṛdayeśa namo’stu te ||77||
itiprasādya deveśaṃ śabarī muditānanā |
viveśa jvalitaṃ vahniṃ bhasmasādabhavatkṣaṇāt ||78||
śabaro’pi tu tadbhasma yatnena parigṛhya ca |
cakre dagdhagṛhopānte harapūjāṃ samāhitaḥ ||79||
atha sasmāra pūjānte prasādagrahaṇocitām |
dayitāṃ nityamāyāntīṃ prāṃjaliṃ vinayānvitām ||1.451.80||
smṛtamātrāṃ tadāpaśyadāgatāṃ pṛṣṭhataḥ sthitām |
pūrvarūpāṃ yathāyogyāṃ bhaktinamrāṃ surūpiṇīm ||81 ||
tāṃ vīkṣya śabaraḥ patnīṃ hāsyayuktāṃ kṛtāṃjalim |
tathā bhasmīkṛtaṃ dehaṃ yathāpūrvamavasthitam ||82||
kṣaṇamāścaryamāpannastarkayāmāsa vai hṛdi |
agnirdahati tejobhiḥ sūryo dahati raśmibhiḥ ||83||
rājā dahati daṇḍena brāhmaṇo manasā dahet |
śatrurdahati hānyādyaiḥ kulaṭā vākpratāḍanaiḥ ||84||
viṣaṃ dahati coṣṇatvād duṣṭā dahanti darśanāt |
cintā dahati phalgutvāddhimaṃ dahati śaityataḥ ||85||
tṛṣṇā dahati cātṛpteḥ satī dahati śāpataḥ |
sādhurdahati pāpāni sparśamātrānna saṃśayaḥ ||86||
kathaṃ ceyaṃ na vai dagdhā dṛśyate’tra yathāyatham |
kimayaṃ svapna āhosvit kiṃvā māyendrajālikā ||87||
iti vismayasaṃbhrāntastāṃ patnīṃ samapṛcchata |
ayi tvaṃ tu kathaṃ cāsse bhasmībhūtāpi javasi ||88||
pradagdhaṃ bhavanaṃ bhūyaḥ kathaṃ pūrvavadāsthitam |
śrutvā prasannasumukhī pativratāha taṃ priyam ||89||
yadā gṛhaṃ samuddīpya praviṣṭāhaṃ hutāśane |
tadātmānaṃ na jānāmi na paśyāmi hutāśanam ||1.451.90 ||
tadā paśyāmi pīṣūṣāktaṃ śaṃbhuṃ mama pārśvagam |
pāyayantaṃ sudhāṃ me saṃspṛśantaṃ svakareṇa mām ||9 1 ||
na tāpaleśo’pyāsīnme praviṣṭāyā ivodakam |
suṣupteva kṣaṇārdhena prabuddhāsmi punaḥ kṣaṇāt ||92||
tāvad bhavanamadrākṣamadagdhamiva susthitam |
adhunā devapūjānte prasādaṃ labdhumāgatā ||93||
dehi prasādaṃ me kānta tvānayāmi suvastu kim |
ityuktā jalamādāya dadau phalaṃ tathākṣatān ||94||
evaṃ pratidinaṃ tau tu pūjayāmāsurādarāt |
lakṣaśo manujāḥ śrutvā camatkāraṃ tathādbhutam ||95||
darśanārthaṃ samājagmustayośca śaṃkarasya ca |
evaṃ parasparaṃ premṇā dampatyorvartamānayoḥ ||96||
śaṃkarasya kṛpaleśāt sukhaṃ lakṣasamā gatāḥ |
putrapautradhanāgārakṣetragodāsayoṣitaḥ ||97||
vaiṣṇavāḥ śaṃkarānmantraṃ prāpya jātāḥ kuṭumbinaḥ |
dehānte tu tayorbhaktadampatyordivyamadbhutam ||98||
prādurāsīdvimānaṃ ca tatra sthitvā tu dampatī |
śivadūtakarasparśād divyadehau sarūpiṇau ||99||
bhūtvā śivālayaṃ dhāma yayaturvai parātparam |
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi pātivratyaṃ paraṃ vratam || 1.451.100 ||
patnīvrataṃ tathā śreṣṭhaṃ vrataṃ śaṃbhvārpaṇaṃ vratam |
ātmārpaṇaṃ vrataṃ sarvavratebhyo vai viśiṣyate || 101 ||
yo’pi śūdraḥ paṭhedvāpi śṛṇuyādvā kathāmimām |
śivalokaṃ viṣṇulokaṃ bhaktyā yāyānna saṃśayaḥ ||1 02||
patnīvrataṃ pātivratyaṃ vijñāyāpi tathācaret |
tato’pi sarvathā bhuktiṃ muktiṃ cānte labhet priye || 10 3|||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne śabaradampatīkṛtaśivapūjārthaṃ pativratāśabarīcitābhasmārpaṇe śabaryāḥ punarjīvanamityādipātivratyacamatkāranirūpaṇanāmaikapañcāśadadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||451 ||

<1.452>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi camatkāraṃ pātivratyasya vai punaḥ |
patirdevo gururdevaḥ śivo devastrayo yayā || 1 ||
pūjitāḥ sevitā nityaṃ vanditāḥ kṛṣṇakāntayā |
tasyā mṛṣāpi satyaṃ syād viparītaṃ ca satphalam || 2 ||
duḥkhaṃ cāpi bhavet saukhyaṃ vandhyātvaṃ ca sāpatyakam |
vaidhavyaṃ sadhavātvaṃ durbhāgyaṃ śreṣṭhabhāgyakam || 3 ||
adaivaṃ cāpi saubhāgyaṃ viruddhaṃ sānukūlakam |
vipat samyatsvarūpā syāt tuṣṭe patyau gurau śive || 4 ||
ānartaviṣaye kaścinnāmnā vedaratho dvijaḥ |
camatkārapure tvāsīt sutadārakuṭumbavān || 5 ||
tasya kanyā śāradākhyā kamaleva satī sadā |
janmataḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ || 6 ||
iti prāgbhavasaṃskārāt sadā vadati vai sphuṭam |
śrutvā janā mahāścaryaṃ prāptā vavandire satīm || 7 ||
kṛṣṇaṃ śivaṃ hāṭakeśaṃ guruṃ ca pitarau satī |
nitya prātarnamaskṛtya tato’nyat prākarot sadā || 8 ||
evaṃ sā bhajanānandābhavad dvādaśahāyanā |
tāṃ yayāce padmanābho brāhmaṇo nṛpamānitaḥ || 9 ||
mahādhanasya śāntasya tāṃ kanyāṃ pradadau pitā |
kṛtodvāho dvijaḥ sāyaṃ sandhyāṃ kartuṃ yayau nadīm || 1.452.1 0||
mārge daṣṭo bhujaṃgena sa mamāra dvijastataḥ |
cukruśurbāndhavā kṛtvā śvaśurāvasya kāminī || 11 ||
kṛtaṃ tu bāndhavairaurdhvadaihikaṃ śāradā tataḥ |
brāhmaṇī prāptavaidhavyā piturevālaye sthitā || 12||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ |
vadatyeva sadā bālā namaḥ kṛṣṇāya cājapat ||13||
kṛṣṇa eva patirnānyo jñātvārcayāte mādhavam |
pitarau sevate nityaṃ śivāśivasvarūpiṇau | 14||
lakṣmīṃ nārāyaṇaṃ nāryāṃ nare paśyati yoginī |
śivaḥ svāmī patiḥ kṛṣṇo gururdevaḥ pitā hariḥ || 15||
mātā lakṣmīḥ sakhī devī kuṭumbaṃ sādhumaṇḍalam |
bhaktiḥ śayyā ratiḥ kṛṣṇe dhyānaṃ mūrtau śivā sukham ||16||
bhāgyaṃ dharmaḥ kṛtiḥ sevā viśrāntirbhagavatsmṛtau |
yasyā bhāgavatī sarvā kriyā divyā satīmayī || 17||
vaidhavye’pyabhavatpūrvārjitapuṇyabalācchubhā |
kṛṣṇaḥ kānto dhavo yasyāḥ sevā satāṃ ca mātṛkā ||18||
tatra saubhāgyamevāsti vaidhavyaṃ parivartate |
evaṃ vai vartamānāyāstasyāḥ pituśca mandire || 1 9||
ekadā naidhruvo nāma sādhurvṛddhaḥ samāgataḥ |
andhaḥ śiṣyakaragrāhī bhikṣāṃ dehīti cāvadat ||1.452.20||
sādhuṃ dṛṣṭvā yathā viṣṇuṃ dadau sāsanamuttamam |
svāgataṃ te mahāpūjya pīṭhe’sminnu hyupāviśa ||21||
ityuktvā bhaktimāsthāya kṛtvā pādāvanejanam |
vījayitvā jalaṃ datvāpūjayat puṣpacandanaiḥ ||22||
śreṣṭhamiṣṭavarānnaiśca bhojayāmāsa sādaram |
tṛptastvandhamunistasyai suprītaḥ paramāśiṣam ||23||
vihṛtya bhartrā sukhinī labdhvā sutaṃ guṇādhikam |
kīrtiṃ ca mahatīṃ prāpya bhava devakṛpāvatī |||2|||
sādhūktaṃ sā samākarṇya vismitā pratyuvāca tam |
sādho tvadvacanaṃ satyaṃ mandāyā me katham ṛtam ||25||
śilāgryāmiva sadvṛṣṭiḥ śunakyāmiva satkriyā |
viphalā vidhavāyāṃ vai śubhāśīḥ sādhudāpi tu ||26||
ahaṃ vidhavā jātāsmi tvadāśīḥpātratā katham |
sādhuḥ prāha ca tāṃ devīṃ mayoktaṃ saphalaṃ bhavet ||27||
sādhūnāṃ vacane kṛṣṇaḥ svayameva virājate |
śaṃbhurdevāḥ sahāyāśca bhavanti vacane satām ||28||
balāllakṣmyā ca śivayā prerito’haṃ samāgataḥ |
tava bhaktyā sati putri saubhāgyaṃ te bhaviṣyati ||29||
nahi bhaktimatī bālā duḥkhinī syāditi prabhuḥ |
viṣṇuścāhaṃ sādhurūpastvadarthaṃ vai samāgataḥ ||1.452.30||
bhaja kṛṣṇaṃ śivaṃ lakṣmīṃ śivāṃ ca pitarau sadā |
kuru tvekavrataṃ putri hyumāmāheśvarābhidham ||3 1 ||
yathoktaṃ tu mayā sarvaṃ saubhāgyaṃ te bhaviṣyati |
vaidhavyaṃ mama bhaktāyāḥ kathaṃ sahe suputrike ||12|
āgaccha tava pitarau kathayāmi yathātatham |
ityuktvā sādhuviṣṇustāmānayat pitṛsannidhau || 33||
dattāśīrvādavṛttāntaṃ saubhāgyaṃ ca vrataṃ hariḥ |
jagāda bhāvi yatsarvaṃ tataścāntaradhīyata ||34||
śṛṇu lakṣmi vrataṃ comāmāheśvaraṃ subhāgyadam |
mayā tadā śāradāyai kathitaṃ cākarot tu sā ||35||
caitre vā mārgaśīrṣe vā śuklapakṣe śubhe dine |
aṣṭamyāṃ vā caturdaśyāmubhayoḥ parvaṇorapi ||36||
gurvājñayā vratāraṃbhaṃ prakurvīta satī śubhā |
saṃkalpaṃ vidhivat kṛtvā prātaḥ snānaṃ samācaret ||37||
santarpya pitṛdevādīn maṇḍapaṃ racayecchubham |
tanmadhye paṃcaraṃgānāṃ cūrṇaiḥ padmaṃ samullikhet ||38||
caturdaśadalairbāhyairdvāviṃśadbhistadantare |
tadantare ṣoḍaśabhiraṣṭabhiśca tadantare ||39|||
caturasraṃ tataḥ kuryādantarvartulamityapi |
madhye kūrcaṃ tatparito vrīhitaṇḍularāśikama ||1.452.40||
kṛtvā kūrce vāripūrṇaṃ kalaśaṃ sthāpayettataḥ |
vastraṃ citraṃ kalaśe ca tatra vinyasya vai śivam ||41 ||
śivāṃ ca sthāpayed dravyaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ prapūjayet |
paṃcāmṛtaiḥ snāpayecca jalena snāpayettataḥ ||42||
rudraṃ tvekādaśavāraṃ samuccārya śatāṣṭakam |
śivāya nama ityuktvā pīṭhe mūrtiṃ samarcayet ||43||
prāṇāyāmān yathāśakti kṛtvā saṃkalpayet tataḥ |
pūrvajanmīyapāpānāṃ nāśārthaṃ tvāṃ samarthaye ||44||
saubhāgyavijayārogyadharmaiśvaryābhivṛddhaye |
putrasampatsvargamokṣasiddhyarthaṃ vāṃ prapūjaye ||45||
aṃganyāsām̐stataḥ kṛtvā dhyāyedīśaṃ ca pārvatīm |
yoginaṃ śaṃkaraṃ dhyāye satīṃ dhyāye pativratām ||46||
sajaṭaṃ ca sakeśāṃ ca tryambakaṃ tryambikāṃ tathā |
sasarpabhūṣaṇaṃ kāntaṃ svarṇabhūṣānvitāṃ satīm ||47||
nīlakaṇṭhaṃ miṣṭakaṇṭhāṃ dvibhujaṃ dordaśāṣṭakām |
dhyānamagnaṃ tvaṃkamagnāṃ śvetaṃ raktāṃ vicintaye ||48||
iti dhyātvā pratimāyāmāvāhanādi cārabhet |
āvāhanaṃ tathārghyaṃ ca gandhaṃ puṣpāṇi cākṣatān ||49||
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ jalaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ dadet |
śivāya namo mantreṇa juhuyādaṣṭakaṃ śatam ||1.452.50||
tato nīrājanaṃ kuryānnamaskāraṃ kṣamāpanam |
athābhyarcyopacāreṇa bhojayed bhaktadampatīm ||51||
evaṃ sāyaṃ prakuryācca pūjāṃ bhuñjīta pāyasam |
evaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ kuryāt tata udyāpanaṃ caret ||52||
śatarudrādhyāyapāṭhaṃ kārayitvā prapūjayet |
vastraṃ suvarṇaṃ kalaśaṃ pratimāṃ gurave’rpayet ||53||
sādhūn viprān bhojayecca dadyācca svarṇadakṣiṇām |
tataḥ prasādaṃ gṛhṇīyād godānādikamācaret ||94||
evaṃ vratasya kartā vā kartrī sveṣṭasukhaṃ labhet |
vaṃśaṃ saubhāgyamarthaṃ ca sampadaṃ muktimāpnuyāt ||55||
ante mokṣaṃ śivapadaṃ kṛṣṇapadaṃ prapadyate |
mahāvratamidaṃ tena sādhunoktaṃ kṛtaṃ tayā ||56||
sādhvyā saṃvatsarasyānte tadudyāpanamarjitam |
upoṣitā tu sā bālā jajāpa mantramanvaham ||57||
śivā śivaḥ samāyātau divyarūpadharau śubhau |
viṣṇunā kathitaṃ yadvat sarvaṃ saubhāgyameva tat ||58||
bhavatvatraiva dehe te patisaukhyaṃ labhasva ca |
ityāśīrvacanairbālāṃ samarañjayatāṃ hyubhau ||59||
śaṃbhuḥ prāha priye bāle pitarau bāndhavādikān |
samāhvayātra tān vaktumicchāmi te purābhavam ||1.452.60||
ityuktā śāradā sarvānāhvayat śivasannidhau |
sarveṣāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ śaṃbhuḥ śāradāmāha putrike ||6 1 ||
drāviḍe prāgbhave viprapatnyau tvaṃ cāparā hyubhe |
āstāṃ tatra tvayā nityaṃ patistvayi pramohitaḥ ||62||
jyeṣṭhāyai te sapatnyai ca tvayā kāntakṛtaṃ sukham |
kadācinnārpitaṃ tena jyeṣṭhā duḥkhena vai mṛtā ||63 ||
tena pāpena vidhavā tvaṃ tvidānīṃ pravidyase |
yāḥ kurvanti striyo loke jāyāpatyostu vipriyam ||64||
tāsāṃ kaumāravaidhavyaṃ bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ |
tvayā tvārādhitaḥ kṛṣṇo vrataṃ cāpi kṛtaṃ śubham ||65||
tena puṇyaṃ mahajjātaṃ tena puṇyena te patiḥ |
pūrvabhavīyavipro’sau svapne ratiṃ pradāsyati ||66||
tena putro viṣṇutulyaścātraiva saṃbhaviṣyati |
eṣaḥ sa vipravaryo’sti śaṃbhuryāvajjagāda tām ||67||
tāvat tatra prākpatiḥ saḥ samadṛśyata vai yuvā |
sarvairdṛṣṭaḥ śivavākyāt tayā mālā samarpitā ||68||
kāntena cārpito bhāle keśe sindūracūrṇakaḥ |
prakoṣṭhayoḥ pradatte ca kaṃkaṇe netrakajjalam ||69||
sarvasaubhāgyadravyāṇi datvā prāgbrāhmaṇaḥ patiḥ |
pāṇinā tacchirastatra pasparśa yāvadeva tu ||1.452.70||
tāvat keśāḥ kṛṣṇarūpāḥ prarohitāḥ prasādhitāḥ |
dhammilaśca kṛtastena śāṭikā svarṇatārikā ||71 ||
kṛtā tatraiva hastasya sparśenāśīḥ prayuñjitā |
evaṃ hasan kṣaṇaṃ tasthau śaṃbhurdatvā śubhāśiṣaḥ ||72||
adṛśyaścābhavatso’pi patiścādṛśyatāṃ gataḥ |
utsavaḥ samabhūttasyāḥ kanyāyā vratapuṇyataḥ ||73||
śṛṇu lakṣmi vratadātā sādhurviṣṇurabhūt svayam |
sa eva śaṃbhunā cātrāhūto viṣṇurvaro’bhavat ||74||
kanyāyāḥ pratyayārthaṃ ca tadvat kuṭumbināṃ tathā |
prāgbhavīyasya kāntasya rūpaṃ dadhāra mādhavaḥ ||75||
sa eva bhagavān kṛṣṇaḥ patirbhūtvā sadā niśi |
bhaktāyā mānase nityaṃ kāmatṛptiṃ dadāti saḥ ||76||
kvacit kṛṣṇasvarūpaṃ ca kvacid viprasvarūpakam |
kvacicchivasvarūpaṃ ca kvacitsādhusvarūpakam ||77||
gṛhṇāti bhagavānasyā bhavane ramate sadā |
sāpi śrīriva saubhāgyatejobhirdīvyatāṃ yayau ||78||
ātmānaṃ muktigaṃ mene prakāśaṃ nākarot satī |
evaṃ dineṣu gacchatsu sā bālā tu pratikṣaṇam ||79||
bhartuḥ samāgamaṃ lebhe rātrau sukhavivardhanam |
śivayorvaradānena śāradā viśadavratā ||1.452.80||
dadhāra garbhaṃ svapne’pi kṛṣṇasaṃgānubhāvataḥ |
ajñātāstu janāḥ kanyāṃ garbhiṇīṃ jāriṇīṃ jaguḥ ||8 1 ||
tairajñātaiḥ kṛtastatra samājo grāmavāsinām |
daṇḍadānāya vidvāṃsaḥ pṛṣṭāstatra samāgatāḥ ||82||
teṣu madhye svayaṃ kṛṣṇo vipro bhūtvāpi cāyayau |
śivastatra supaṇḍito bhūtvā kāśyāṃ samāgataḥ ||83||
śṛṇu lakṣmi śāradāyāḥ kṛte kiṃ kimabhūttadā |
antarvatnīṃ samāhūya śāradāṃ vṛddhamānavāḥ ||84||
papracchuśca kuto garbhaḥ śāradāpitarau tadā |
pratyūcatuḥ prāgbhavīyakāntayogād vratārjitāt ||85||
svapne bījasya lābhena garbho’yaṃ nahi doṣavān |
jahasuśca tadā sarve tiraskṛtya kuṭumbakam ||86||
atarjayan susaṃkruddhāḥ kecidāsan parāṅmukhāḥ |
sarve sammantrayāmāsuḥ kiṃ kurma itibhāṣiṇaḥ ||87||
kecidāhuḥ pāpinīyaṃ kuladvayavināśinī |
kṛtvāsyāḥ keśavapanaṃ chitvā karṇau ca nāsikām ||88||
nirvāsayantu ca bahirgrāmāt svagotrato bahiḥ |
atha viṣṇuḥ paṇḍitastu tatrāha sarvamānavān ||89||
mayā pūrvaṃ śrutaṃ comāmāheśvaraṃ vrataṃ kṛtam |
anayā tena puṇyena prāptaḥ svāpnaḥ patiḥ sadā ||1.452.90||
svapne garbho na bhavati saṃśayo garbhiṇīkṛte |
nāsyai daṇḍaḥ pradātavyaḥ sucaritreyamaṃganā ||91 ||
kucāritryaṃ tu vadatāṃ jihvā dvedhā bhaviṣyati |
śrutvā prajahṛṣustasyā jananījanakādayaḥ ||92||
tataḥ kṣaṇaṃ grāmavṛddhā maunaṃ bhayāt prajagṛhuḥ |
tatra kecidaviśvastā mithyā svapnamavādiṣuḥ ||93||
teṣāṃ jihvā dvidhā bhinnā vavamuste tu raktakam |
bhītāḥ sarve na cocurvai viparītaṃ tataśca te ||94||
atha śaṃbhuḥ paṇḍitaśca tadāha viṣṇupaṇḍitam |
svapne garbho’pi bhavati daivānāmīdṛśī gatiḥ ||95||
māyāmayamidaṃ viśvaṃ dṛśyate śrūyate ca yat |
kiṃ bhāvyaṃ kimabhāvyaṃ vā saṃsāre kṛṣṇanirmite ||96||
anirūpyamabhūtārthaṃ kadācijjāyate ṛtam |
śrīkṛṣṇasya vaśe sarvaṃ tasya ko veda ceṣṭitam ||97||
yūpaketostu rājarṣeḥ śukraṃ nipatitaṃ jale |
saśukraṃ tajjalaṃ pītvā dāsī garbhaṃ dadhau kila ||98||
munervibhāṇḍakasyāpi śukraṃ pītvā sahāmbhasā |
hariṇī garbhiṇī bhūtvā ṛṣyaśṛṃgamasūyata ||99||
saurāṣṭrasya tathā rājñaḥ karaṃ spṛṣṭvā mṛgāganā |
tatkṣaṇād garbhiṇī bhūtvā muniṃ prāsūta tāpasam || 1.452.1 00||
tathā satyavatīnārī śapharīgarbhasaṃbhavā |
tathaiva mahiṣīgarbho jāto vai mahiṣāsuraḥ || 101 ||
phalasya bhojanenāpi garbhavatyaḥ striyaḥ purā |
manasā kalpitā nāryo babhūvuḥ putramātaraḥ || 1 02||
sāmbasya jaṭharājjātaṃ musalaṃ muniśāpataḥ |
yuvanāśvasya garbho’bhūnmunīnāṃ mantragauravāt || 1 03||
bījaṃ nāryāṃ nare vāpi vidyate sarvathā janāḥ |
pariṇāmo yogināṃ tu vacanena vijāyate || 1 04||
ahalyā copalā jātā gautamasyaiva vākyataḥ |
rāmasparśena sā jātā yuvatī ceti dṛśyate || 1 05||
indrahetikṛtā jātā maruto bahavastathā |
rādhāyā vacanād gaṃgā jalarūpā vyajāyata || 1 06||
samudramathanāllakṣmīḥ kṣiteḥ sītā hyajāyata |
evaṃ vai bahudhā sṛṣṭiryogināṃ vai prajāyate || 1 07||
vasudevasya kṛpayā rohiṇyāṃ garbha āsthitaḥ |
śaṃkarasya jaṭātaśca vīrabhadro’pyajāyata || 1 08||
nūnameṣāpi kalyāṇī vratasya balatastathā |
sādhoḥ sevāpratāpena kṛṣṇasya śaraṇāgateḥ || 10 9||
āśīrvādātmakaṃ bījaṃ dhatte garbhamaninditā |
ityuktastu sabhāśreṣṭhāḥ śaśaṃsurjñātibāndhavāḥ || 1.452.11 0||
sādhusādhviti jagadurmumucurnetrato jalam |
kulastriyaḥ pramuditāstāmuddiśya samāśvasan || 111 ||
tathāpi mānavānāṃ vai sandehasya nivṛttaye |
viprau tau tatra sañjāto kṣaṇamātraṃ śivo hariḥ || 11 2||
viṣṇurviprasvarūpo’bhūt kroḍe kṛtvā tu śāradām |
tān sarvān darśayāmāsa kāntaṃ svaṃ śāradāṃ priyām || 1 13||
dampatīrūpiṇau dṛṣṭvāvāpurvismayamuttamam |
tato vyalīyata kṛṣṇaḥ śivo’pyantaradhīyata || 1 14||
satī tāṃ pūjayāmāsuḥ śrīrūpiṇīṃ tadā janāḥ |
camatkārapurāvāsā yayuḥ svaṃ svaṃ niketanam || 1 15||
atha kāle śubhe putramasūta śāradā satī |
śāradeyābhidhaḥ so’pi vidvān kṛṣṇasamo’bhavat || 1 16||
śāradā bahuvarṣāṇi kṛṣṇasevāṃ vidhāya ca |
vaṃśaṃ loke sthāpayitvā śrīkṛṣṇena samaṃ satī || 1 17||
divyayānena golokaṃ yayau padaṃ hi śāśvatam |
ityetat puṇyamākhyānaṃ śāradāyāḥ pravarṇitam || 118||
paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ samyag bhuktimuktiphalapradam |
strīṇāṃ maṃgalasaubhāgyasantānarddhyāyuṣā pradam || 11 9||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne ānartadeśe camatkārapurīyaśāradāyā vaidhavye sādhorāśīrvādena punaḥ kṛṣṇātmakaviprarūpapatitaḥ saubhāgyaṃ putralābho janānāṃ viśvāsārthaṃ viprarūpakṛṣṇadarśanaṃ golokaprāptiścetyādipātivratyacamatkāranirūpaṇanāmā dvipañcāśadadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 452 ||

<1.453>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi bhaktāyā vārayoṣitaḥ |
nārāyaṇamanaskāyāścamatkāramayīṃ kathām || 1 ||
nandigrāme purā tvāsīnmahānandābhidhā hare |
bhaktimatī tu vanitā śṛṃgāralalitākṛtiḥ || 2 ||
kuṭumbarahitā svecchātantrā śivasya kiṃkarī |
yadyapi vāravanitā kintu kṛṣṇamayī satī || 3 ||
nityaṃ snāti hare viṣṇuṃ pūjayatyatibhāvataḥ |
nartanaṃ gāyanaṃ cāpi karoti devasannidhau || 4 ||
nṛtyagāyanatālādau ye tvāyānti tu darśakāḥ |
tebhyaḥ prāsādikaṃ vāri phalaṃ tulasīmiśritam || 5 ||
pāvitryārthaṃ dadātyeva kṛṣṇārthasarvasaṃbhavā |
nityaṃ bhajati govindaṃ kṛṣṇabhāvanayā naram || 6 ||
kṛṣṇārpaṇaṃ vidhāyaiva dehakāryaṃ karoti sā |
chatraṃ pūrṇendusaṃkāśaṃ yānaṃ svarṇavirājitam || 7 ||
cāmarāṇi sudaṇḍāni pāduke tu hiraṇmaye |
ambarāṇi vicitrāṇi paryaṃkaśca hiraṇmayaḥ || 8 ||
candraraśminibhāṃ śayyāṃ kṛṣṇārthaṃ parirakṣati |
gāvo mahiṣyo dogdhryaśca dīpāṃgadāsadāsikāḥ || 9 ||
tasyā vacanaviśvastāḥ pūjayanti haraṃ harim |
bhūṣaṇāni parārdhyāṇi navaratnojjvalāni ca || 1.453.1 0||
gandhakuṃkumakastūrīkarpūrāgurulepanam |
citramālyāvataṃsaśca yatheṣṭaṃ mṛṣṭabhojanam || 11 ||
nānācitravitānākhyaṃ nānādhānyabhṛtaṃ gṛham |
bahuratnasahasrāḍhyaṃ svarṇarūpyādikaṃ dhanam || 12||
sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ harārthaṃ ca haryarthaṃ ca tayā sadā |
evaṃ savibhavā vāravanitā satyadharmiṇī || 1 3||
bhaktasevāparā kṛṣṇaśivapūjāparāyaṇā |
sadā śāstrakathāśrotrī nāmajāpaparāyaṇā || 14||
vinodahetordevāgre nāṭyamaṇḍapamadhyataḥ |
rudrākṣairbhūṣayitvaikaṃ markaṭaṃ caikakukkuṭam || 15||
karatālaiśca gītaiśca sadā nartayati svayam |
rudrākṣaiḥ kṛtakeyūrakarṇābharaṇabhūṣaṇaḥ || 16||
markaṭaḥ śikṣayā tasyāḥ sadā nṛtyati bālavat |
śikhāyāṃ baddharudrākṣaḥ kukkuṭaḥ kapinā saha || 17||
ciraṃ nṛtyati nṛtyajñaḥ paśyatāṃ citramāvahan |
ekadā bhavanaṃ tasyāḥ kaścid vaṇik sabhṛtyakaḥ || 18||
nṛtyasya darśanārthaṃ sadbhaktaḥ sakarakaṃkaṇaḥ |
tatprakoṣṭhasthitaṃ ratnakaṃkaṇaṃ vīkṣya cāha tam || 1 9||
mahāratnakhacito’yaṃ kaṃkaṇaste karasthitaḥ |
mano harati me bhakta divyastrībhūṣaṇocitaḥ ||1.453.20 ||
iti tāṃ saspṛhāṃ vīkṣya vaṇik prāha ca tāṃ tadā |
yadi te rocate cāyaṃ kaṃkaṇo mama bhūṣaṇam ||21 ||
bhadramādatsva madbhūṣāṃ mūlyamasya dadāsi kim |
tadā vihasya sā vāravanitā sphuṭamāha tam ||22||
āgantukasya dehena sevādharmo’sti me sadā |
nārāyaṇasvarūpaṃ tvāṃ matvā sevāṃ karomi vai ||23 ||
yadyetadratnakhacitaṃ dadāsi karabhūṣaṇam |
dinatrayamahorātraṃ tava patnī bhavāmyaham |||24||
niyatasya na patnītvaṃ sarvadā vārayoṣitām |
ekaniyatapatnītvaṃ yathā nāpsarasāṃ divi || 25||
tathāstviti vaṇik prāha pramāṇaṃ śaśibhāskarau |
kṛtvā satyaṃ trivāraṃ ca spṛṣṭvānyonyasya vakṣasi ||26||
dinatrayamahorātraṃ bhūtvāvāṃ dampatī hyubhau |
sahadharmaṃ carāvaścetyāhaturhadayaspṛśau ||27||
atha tasyai vaṇikśreṣṭhī pradadau ratnakaṃkaṇam |
ninyatustau sukhaṃ rātriṃ kāmadharmeṇa dampatī || 28||
dvitīyāyāmatha rātrau nāṭyamaṇḍapikāntare |
akasmādutthito vahnirdīpavarttiprasaṃgataḥ ||29||
markaṭakukkuṭau muktau bandhanānnirmatāvubhau |
anye dāsāśca dāsyaśca gomahiṣyādayo’pi ca ||1.453.30||
nirbandhanā vinirgatā tau cāpi nirgatau tataḥ |
śivaliṃgaṃ harimūrtirvahnau bhasmābhavat tadā ||3 1 ||
smṛtvā tad dampatī tau ca durantaṃ duḥkhamāpatuḥ |
vaṇik prāha mama yoge sarvaṃ te jvalitaṃ priye ||32||
śivo viṣṇurmūrtirūpo jvalito mama cāgamāt |
mahatpāpaṃ mayā cātrāgatyārjitaṃ durantakam || 33 ||
na vai śarma labhe sādhvi mriye duḥkhāsahāt priye |
ityuktvā prāṇamāhṛtya papāta dharaṇau vaṇik || 34||
yuvatī tridinaṃ tasya dharmapatnī hyabhūd yataḥ |
atīva duḥkhitā bhūtvā smṛtvā dharmaṃ susākṣikam || 25||
sarvānāhūya sā tatra babhāṣe karuṇaṃ vacaḥ |
ratnakaṃkaṇamādāya sākṣye ca śaśisūryayoḥ ||36||
dinatrayamahamasya patnī jātāsmi dharmataḥ |
yayā tasya citāyāṃ vai praveṣṭavyaṃ hi dharmataḥ ||37||
iti tasyā vacaḥ śrutvā vaṇigbhṛtya uvāca tām |
maivaṃ maivaṃ vada saumye patirnāyaṃ vivāhitaḥ ||38||
vivāhitena patinā vahninā sākṣiṇā ca yā |
gṛhītā karagrāhā ca sā patnīti prakīrtyate ||3 9||
tvaṃ tu naitādṛśī patnī vyabhicāraparāyaṇā |
kaṃkaṇārthaṃ mahālobhāt patnīnāmnā prakatthase ||1.453.40||
tvayā sahāsya dahane narakaṃ jīvato yathā |
vyavāyasya gṛhe naṣṭo vyavāyinīkareṇa ca ||41 ||
vyavāyinyā samaṃ dāhaḥ śreyasāṃ na pradāyakaḥ |
gaccha dūraṃ sadā dhūrte puṃścali saṃpratārike |||42||
mama svāmiśavasyāhaṃ kariṣye dahanaṃ tathā |
pravekṣye svāmicitāyāṃ mariṣye bhṛtyadharmataḥ ||43||
bhṛtyo’haṃ bahukālīnaḥ sevayāmi nirantaram |
vinā vai svāminaṃ prāṇāḥ sthātuṃ śaktā na me’tra vai ||44||
annadātā vṛttidātā rakṣako jñānadāyakaḥ |
niṣekī mantrado vipannāśakaḥ pitaraḥ smṛtāḥ ||45||
vinā pitaraṃ loke’smin bhṛtyo mṛta iva smṛtaḥ |
svāminaṃ nāśayitvāhaṃ darśayiṣye kathaṃ mukham ||46 ||
bhṛtyo’haṃ putratulyo’haṃ poṣyo’haṃ dharmataḥ sadā |
dāhaṃ dāsye hyahaṃ paścātpravekṣyāmi hutāśanam ||47||
mama lokā bhaviṣyanti śāśvatāḥ svāminā saha |
ityuktvā sa citāṃ cakre kāṣṭhānyādāya sarvathā ||48||
vaṇijastu dhanaṃ kiñcittathānyacchṛṃkhalādikam |
dadau dānaṃ supātrebhyaḥ śavaṃ nyasya citānale ||49||
praveṣṭuṃ yāti yāvaddhi tāvat sā vārakāminī |
pradhāvya jagṛhe hastaṃ mā mā meti jagāda tam ||1.453.50||
maivaṃ bhṛtya tvayā kāryaṃ putra jīva sadā bhuvi |
ityukto’pi janaiḥ sarvairvārito’pi viveśa ha ||51 ||
citāyāṃ patite bhṛtye tato nikaṭadharmiṇī |
satī tvāha samājasya śṛṇvato’sya gṛhiṇyaham ||52||
sadharmacāriṇī tvasya dinatrayaṃ susammatā |
madgehe mama yogena mṛto’yaṃ vai patiḥ kṛtaḥ ||53||
tasmādahaṃ pravekṣyāmi sahānena hutāśanam |
satyena prītimāyānti devāstribhuvaneśvarāḥ ||54||
satyātmā vai paro dharmaḥ satye sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam |
satyena svargamokṣau ca nāsatyena parā gatiḥ ||55||
tasmāt satyaṃ samāśritya pravekṣyāmi hutāśanam |
bhaktayogena pūtāhaṃ bhaviṣyāmi ca pāvanī ||56||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaviṣṇo śiva maṃgalakṛdbhava |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ ||57||
namaḥ śivāya kṛṣṇāya śrīrādhāpataye namaḥ |
iti śrīkṛṣṇabhajanaṃ cakre dānaṃ dadau bahu ||58||
sarvasvaṃ sādhubhaktebhyo datvā dhyātvā haraṃ harim |
natvā sarvān patiṃ dhyātvā patyuścitānalaṃ satī ||59||
tadbhaktā triḥ parikramya praveśābhimukhī sthitā |
tāṃ patantīṃ samiddhāgnau svapadārpitamānasām ||1.453.6 0||
vārayāmāsaturdevau prādurbhūtau śivācyutau |
vīkṣya sā tau devadevau koṭisūryādhikaprabhau ||6 1 ||
stabdheva jāyamānā sā bhīteva jaḍavat sthitā |
tāmūcatuḥ samāśvāsya bhagavantau kṛpānidhī ||62||
satyaṃ dharmaṃ ca te dhairyaṃ bhaktiṃ narātmake prabhau |
śivakṛṣṇapratimāyāṃ draṣṭuṃ śivācyutāvubhau ||63||
māyayāgniṃ samutpādya dagdhavantau sumaṇḍapam |
dagdhaṃ kṛtvobhapratime bhṛtyaḥ śivaḥ svayaṃ mudā ||64||
bhṛtyabhaktiṃ darśayituṃ praviṣṭo’tra hutāśanam |
vaṇigrūpo’pyahaṃ nārāyaṇakṛṣṇa patistava ||65||
parīkṣituṃ samāyātaścāntimaṃ sevanaṃ tava |
veśyāḥ kaitavakāriṇyaḥ svairiṇyo janavañcakāḥ ||66||
sā tvaṃ satyamanusmṛtya praviṣṭāgniṃ sahānugā |
ataste vāñcchitaṃ dāsye vada śreṣṭhottamottamam ||67||
śrutvā sāha na me vāñchā bhoge tvatpādavarjite |
ete bhṛtyāśca dāsyaśca ye tvanye mama bāndhavāḥ ||68||
sarve tvadarcanaparāstvayi sannyastavṛttayaḥ |
sarvānetān mayā sārdhaṃ nītvā tavākṣaraṃ padam ||69||
śāśvatānandasampūrṇasevāyāṃ rakṣa sarvadā |
tatheti tasyā vacanaṃ pratinandya narāyaṇaḥ ||1.453.70|||
tān sarvāṃśca tayā sārdhaṃ nināya padamavyam |
kālena nidhanaṃ prāptau yau tu kukkuṭamarkaṭau ||71 ||
kukkuraḥ kāśmīrarājyakumāraḥ puṇyato’bhavat |
markaṭastatpradhānasya kumāraścābhavat tadā ||72||
śivaviṣṇumahābhaktau kṛtvā rājyaṃ ciraṃ ca tau |
dehānte cākṣaraṃ dhāma yayaturyatra sā satī ||73||
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi mahāpāpāpramokṣaṇam |
paṭhanācchravaṇāttvasya pāpapradhvaṃsanaṃ bhavet ||74||
pāpinyapi vāranārī śravaṇāt karaṇāttathā |
sādhusaṃsevanāt sadyo muktānyā mucyate tathā ||75||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vāravanitāyāḥ sarvasvārpaṇabhaktyā śivācyutau bhṛtyavaṇijau bhūtvā pātivratyānalaparīkṣāṃ cakraturmokṣaṃ pradadatuścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā tripaṃcāśadadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 453 ||

<1.454>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu priye mahālakṣmi pātivratyaṃ janātigam |
dharmādharmau svāmivaco mukhyaṃ nānyaditi dhruvam || 1 ||
patyurvacasi cenmāndyaṃ satī kuryāt sudhānibham |
svāmivākyaṃ bhavet hiṃsraṃ kuryāt puṇyanibhaṃ satī || 2 ||
kāntokte ced bhavet| stainyaṃ nyāyyaṃ matvācaret satī |
bhartrājñaptaṃ vyavāyaṃ ca dharmaṃ matvācaret satī || 3 ||
patireva parabrahma kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayam |
śubhaṃ samādiśed yadvāśubhaṃ satī samācaret || 4 ||
satī tasya vacovaśyā pātivratyaphalaṃ labhet |
patiścedaśubhaṃ samādiśet sa phalabhāg bhavet || 5 ||
nātrāśubhe vaco’dhīne kārye tadbhāginī satī |
pratyutāśubhakāryaṃ sā sāmarthyāt śubhadaṃ caret || 6 ||
aniṣṭaṃ duḥkhadaṃ sā tu sukhadaṃ parivartayet |
satyāḥ saṃkalpamātreṇa mṛtyuḥ kālo yamo bhayam || 7 ||
adharmaḥ kleśadāḥ sarve sukhadāḥ saṃbhavanti vai |
pātivratyaṃ paro dharmaḥ pātivratyaṃ paraṃ balam || 8 ||
pātivratyavṛṣāgre tu pāpaṃ puṇyapradaṃ bhavet |
duḥkhaṃ sukhasvarūpaṃ syāt patikṛṣṇapratoṣaṇāt || 9 ||
atrārthe tu purā vṛttaṃ kathayāmi śṛṇu priye |
pativākyaṃ samādṛtya vyavāyasthasvayoṣitaḥ || 1.454.1 0||
sarvaṃ puṇyātmakaṃ jātaṃ devatoṣakaraṃ yathā |
dakṣiṇāpathamadhye vai grāme bāṣkalanāmake || 11 ||
prajā asaṃskṛtā āsan jñānavairāgyavarjitāḥ |
narā nāryaḥ kṛṣikāryā āraṇyakaprajīvanāḥ || 1 2||
tatraiko viduro nāma dharmācāravivarjitaḥ |
dvija āsīt kṛṣigoptā śūdrādimitratāṃgataḥ || 13 ||
kṛṣikārye karmacāriṇībhiḥ pravartate’niśam |
paranārīprasaṃgādidoṣaṃ jānāti naiva saḥ || 14||
śūdrayā saha kāryādau kāmena saṃgataḥ kvacit |
viduraṃ kṛpaṇā sā ca yācate bhojanaṃ dhanam || 15 ||
viduraḥ kṛpayāviṣṭaḥ kāmabhāvanayā tathā |
nirvāhārthaṃ tu śūdrāyai dadātyeva kvacitkvacit || 16 ||
sadāro’pi satīṃ bhāryāṃ bandulāṃ nātimanyate |
gṛhasthitaṃ dhanaṃ cānnaṃ śūdrāyai pradadāti saḥ || 17||
bandulā sahate sarvaṃ patyarthaṃ navayauvanā |
dhanaṃ cānnaṃ kṣayaṃ prāptaṃ śūdrāyai svāminārpitam || 18||
vidurastu satīṃ patnīṃ yācate dehi me dhanam |
annaṃ dehyambaraṃ dehi śūdryartha dehi me priye || 1 9||
ityuktā sā satī prāha gṛhe yadyaddhi vidyate |
tatsarvaṃ nīyatāṃ nātha tvadadhīnaṃ gṛhaṃ sadā ||1.454.20||
tvayi nāthe prasanne ca sarvaṃ me sukhadaṃ bhavet |
madagre tu dhanaṃ nāsti yadāttha tatkaromyaham ||21 ||
vidurastāṃ satīmāha gacchānyasevanaṃ kuru |
narān dhaninaḥ saṃsevya dhanamānaya dehi me |||22||
satī tvājñākarī patyau viśvastā ceśvare yathā |
kaiṃkarya kasyacit kṛtvā dāsyaṃ patītvameva vā ||23||
dhanamānayati patyājñayā tasmai dadāti ca |
patireva paro dharmaḥ pativākyaṃ sukhāvaham || 24||
itimatvā parapuṃsāṃ kāmasevāparābhavat |
evaṃ tayostu dampatyordurācārapravṛttayoḥ || 25||
grāme kaścit kathākāro brāhmaṇo daivayogataḥ |
samāyayau saṃhitāyāḥ kathāṃ cakāra dharmataḥ ||26||
grāmīṇā śuśruvuḥ sarve prācīnāṃ dharmasaṃhitām |
kumārgaṃ saṃparityajya dharmamārgaṃ samāśritāḥ || 27||
jagṛhurvaiṣṇavaṃ mantraṃ pūjayāmāsuracyutam |
brāhmaṇaṃ tvarcayāmāsurvihāyāsatkriyāṃ janāḥ || 28||
paścāttāpaṃ svakṛtyānāṃ cakruste sasmarurharim |
vidureṇa parityaktaḥ śūdrāsaṃgastataḥ param ||29||
atīva dhārmiko jātaścaikabhuktaṃ karoti ca |
snānaṃ sandhyāṃ japaṃ pūjāṃ naivedyaṃ devadarśanam ||1.454.3 0||
kṛtvā bhuṃkte sadā tvevaṃ patnī cāpi tathākarot |
evaṃ vai vartamānasya vidurasyāyuṣaḥ kṣaye ||3 1 ||
āyātā yamadūtāstaṃ netuṃ yamapuraṃ tadā |
cukrośa dṛṣṭvā tāndūtān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti saḥ ||32||
patnī prāha ca taṃ śrutvā kathamākrośanaṃ priya |
sa cāha tāṃ yamadūtā netuṃ māṃ vai samāgatāḥ ||33 ||
patnī jalaṃ kare kṛtvā samuvāca satī tadā |
yadi patyuḥ priyā bhāryā patyuḥ priyakarī sadā || 34||
patyājñāyāṃ vartamānā patikṛṣṇaparāyaṇā |
tena satyena dūtāste dūraṃ yāntu yamālayam || 35||
ityuktvā tajjalaṃ patyuḥ pārśve cikṣepa tāvatā |
dūrātpalāyitā dūtā avaplutya sthalāttataḥ ||36 ||
patiḥ svasthastadā jāto vṛttāntamāha tattathā |
patnī prāha punaḥ kāntaṃ svāmisevākṛtaṃ phalam ||37||
tubhyaṃ dadāmi me kānta sadgatirastu tena te |
tāvadvai vaiṣṇavā viṣṇoḥ pārṣadāstvāyayurmudā ||38||
patnyā dṛṣṭā pātivratyadharmaphalena tatkṣaṇam |
pūjitā vanditāścāpi patiṃ ninyuḥ paraṃ padam ||39||
bandulā tu patiṃ kṛtvā kroḍe ruroda vai kṣaṇam |
atha saṃcintayāmāsa yadyahaṃ kāntarañjinī ||1.454.40||
tadā kāntena sākaṃ me prāṇāḥ prayāntu tatkṣaṇam |
tāvanmūrchāṃ gatvā sādhvī prāṇām̐styaktvā tu tatkṣaṇam ||41 ||
svāminā divyadehena saha yātā surūpiṇī |
divyadehā vimānasthā viṣṇupārṣadasatkṛtā ||42||
tattejaśca vimānaṃ ca dṛṣṭaṃ śrotṛbhirujjvalam |
brāhmaṇaḥ sa tu sadbhaktaistayorvai cordhvadaihikam ||43||
kārayāmāsa vidhinā bhojayāmāsa vaiṣṇavān |
dadau kṛṣṇopadeśaṃ ca dharmaṃ patnīvrataṃ dadau ||44||
pātivratyaṃ tathā dharmaṃ dadau prajāḥ svayaṃ dvijaḥ |
sarve’pi vaiṣṇavāstvāsan narā nāryaḥ samantataḥ ||45||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ |
iti mantraṃ tu te labdhvā bhejire kṛṣṇamacyutam ||46||
kathāṃ śuśukarīśasya cakruśca bhajanaṃ sadā |
kathāyā vācako vipraḥ svapne svadarśanaṃ dadau |||47||
narebhyo vanitābhyaśca nārāyaṇaścaturbhujaḥ |
hārakeyūramukuṭapītāmbarasudarśanaiḥ ||48||
sahitaḥ sevito lakṣmyādṛśyata vai manoharaḥ |
kathānte pūjitaḥ sarvaiḥ svīkṛtya pūjanaṃ tataḥ ||49||
upādideśa tān sarvān bhaktānugrahavigrahaḥ |
pātivratyaṃ paraṃ dharmaṃ bandulāyā vilokya tu ||1.454.50||
ahaṃ nārāyaṇastasyāḥ kalyāṇārthaṃ dvijātmakaḥ |
samāyātaḥ kathākāraścoddhṛtā yūyamityapi ||51 ||
kathāṃ śrutvā vaiṣṇavāśca jātāstatsevanaṃ mama |
pūjayadhvaṃ ca māṃ nityaṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ ca kathāṃ hareḥ ||52||
naraiḥ patnīvrataṃ pālyaṃ nārībhiśca pativratam |
ubhābhyāṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇavrataṃ ca tārakam ||53||
satkathāśravaṇaṃ nityaṃ kartavyaṃ mokṣadaṃ param |
kṛṣṇasya kathayā ceto viśuddhiṃ paramāṃ vrajet ||54||
kathayā siddhyati dhyānaṃ dhyānāt kaivalyamuttamam |
sarveṣāṃ śreyasāṃ bījaṃ satkathāśravaṇaṃ matam ||55||
kāmaḥ krodhaśca lobhaśca madamānādayaḥ pare |
adharmasya sutā yānti dūraṃ kathāśravāddhareḥ ||56||
gurutalpaḥ surāpānaṃ tathākāmāprasaṃgakaḥ |
kāmasya tanayāstvete yānti dūraṃ kathāśravāt ||57||
pitṛvadho mātṛvadho brahmahatyā ca nāśanam |
krodhasya tanayāścaite dūraṃ yānti kathāśravāt ||28||
devasvaharaṇaṃ viprasvahāraḥ svarṇamoṣaṇam |
lobhasya tanayāstvete dūraṃ yānti kathāśravāt ||29||
aśraddhā cāpi durmedhā avidyāyāḥ sute hyubhe |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇakathāśravād dūraṃ pragacchataḥ ||1.454.60||
kathā saṃsṛtibaddhānāṃ sadyo muktipradā śubhā |
strīṇāṃ pāṃsulapādānāṃ dāsānāṃ dāsayoṣitām ||61 ||
ajñānatimirāndhānāṃ dīparūpā hareḥ kathā |
bhavarogābhibhūtānāṃ susevyaṃ paramauṣadham ||62||
mahāpātakaśailānāṃ kathā vajranibhā matā |
bharjanaṃ karmabījānāṃ sādhanaṃ sarvasampadām ||63||
śṛṇvatāṃ śrīharergāthāṃ tathā kīrtayatāṃ satām |
teṣāṃ pādarajāṃsyaiva tīrthāni munayo jaguḥ ||64||
muhūrtamapi śṛṇuyādaśakto’pi dine dine |
ghaṭikāṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā kṣaṇaṃ vā pāvanīṃ kathām ||65||
sthūlakāryaprasaktānāṃ sthūlabuddhimatāṃ kathā |
kalpavṛkṣasamo nānyaḥ panthāḥ kathetaraḥ sukhaḥ ||66||
pibannevāmṛtaṃ yatnādekaḥ syādajarāmaraḥ |
pītaṃ kathāmṛtaṃ kuryāt kulamevājarāmaram ||67|||
kathāvaktā hariḥ sākṣād gurūṇāṃ yāvatāṃ guruḥ |
mokṣadaḥ puṇyado jñānapradīpaḥ paro guruḥ ||68||
ye kathāṃ tatpravaktāraṃ praśaṃsanti janā api |
aśṛṇvanto’pi te yānti śāśvataṃ paramaṃ padam ||69||
kathāśravaṇasāhāyyaṃ ye kurvanti janā bhuvi |
kalpakoṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ tiṣṭhanti brahmaṇaḥ padam ||1.454.70||
satkathābodhalābhena smaraṇaṃ me harerbhavet |
sadāsmaraṇayogena vāsanānāṃ kṣayo bhavet ||71 ||
tathā satī virāgaḥ syād rāgābhāve paraṃ sukham |
tṛṣṇākṣayasukhaṃ tvātmānandodbhave sahāyakṛt ||72||
rāge naṣṭe pratidvandvī dveṣo’pi naśyati dhruvam |
rāgadveṣau yasya naṣṭau doṣau tasya pravartanam |||73 ||
śubhāśubhaṃ na vai janmamṛtyupradaṃ prajāyate |
pravṛtterapyabhāvena bhogābhāvo bhavet sadā ||74||
nityānandaṃ cidānandaṃ sadānandaṃ nijātmakam |
bhuṃkte bhaktirase magnaḥ śrīkṛṣṇātmakabhāvataḥ ||75||
nityatṛpto mama mūrtau nityamagno madātmani |
brahmānandamayo dhāmni mamo’śrute’kṛtaṃ sukham ||76||
evaṃ kathāśruteḥ puṇyaṃ phalaṃ mokṣapradaṃ bhavet |
ahaṃ tuṣṭo bhavāmyeva yatra me’sti kathāmṛtam ||77||
vajralepādipāpāni kathātmamatprayogataḥ |
madārādhanavijñānāt bhasmībhavanti sarvaśaḥ ||78||
satyā patiguṇāḥ śravyā eṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ |
patiścāhaṃ parabrahma matkathāṃ śṛṇuyācchubhām ||79||
dānaṃ yajñaṃ tathā tīrthaṃ dravyaṃ vyayaiḥ samutsavam |
kartumaśaktabhaktena kathā śravyā mama dhruvam ||1.454.80||
kīrtanaṃ me svāminaśca nityaṃ kāryaṃ prage niśi |
pūjā kāryā madarthe ca grasitanyaṃ niveditam ||81 ||
patraṃ puṣpaṃ jalaṃ khādyaṃ sarvaṃ prāsādikaṃ graset |
tena sattvapraśuddhiḥ syātsmṛtirdevasya śāśvatī ||82||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasmṛtyā dhruvo mokṣo’pyavāpyate |
smṛtau tu sarvathā hetuḥ śrīkṛṣṇayaśasāṃ śravaḥ ||83||
kṣitedanijapuṇyena svargaprāptirna vai dhruvā |
kathāśravaṇabhaktyā tu śāśvat dhāma gamyate ||84||
svarṇakoṭisahasrāṇāṃ dānāccāpyadhikā kathā |
rājasūyasahasrebhyaścottamā śrīhareḥ kathā ||85||
vratebhyo niyamebhyaśca japebhyaḥ śreyasī kathā |
yatra me mama sādhūnāṃ bhaktānāṃ yogayoṣitām ||86 ||
sādhvīnāṃ ca satīnāṃ ca camatkārā nirūpitāḥ |
caritrāṇi sudivyāni dyumanti varṇitāni ca ||87||
tāni sarvāṇi dātṝṇi sampadāṃ mokṣaṇasya ca |
bhavatāṃ mokṣaṇārthāya satyāḥ sadbhāvasevayā ||88||
yuṣmākaṃ tāraṇārthaṃ vai viprarūpo bhavāmyaham |
athāhaṃ yāmi vaikuṇṭhaṃ bhavantaḥ sādhusevanam ||89||
kathāyāḥ śravaṇaṃ nityaṃ kurvantu dhyānameva me |
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ mama sevāṃ yūyaṃ sarve gamiṣyatha ||1.454.90||
ityuktvā vācako vipro vimānena sutejasā |
yayau nārāyaṇo bhūtvā vaikuṇṭhaṃ bhaktasevitaḥ || 91 ||
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ lakṣmi kāntājñāpālane phalam |
śravaṇātpaṭhanāccāsya bhuktirmuktirbhaved dhruvam ||9 2||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pātivratyaparāyā bandulāyā vidurākhyaviprasya svasvāminaḥ ājñāpālane vyavāyasyādoṣatve bhagavatkathāprāptilābhena bhagavaddhāmaprāptirityādinirūpaṇanāmā catuḥpañcāśadadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 454 ||

<1.455>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
agastyasya priyapatnyāḥ pratāpaṃ tvaṃ śṛṇu priye |
pativratottamālopāmudrāyā divyayoṣitaḥ || 1 ||
kadācinnārado lakṣmi snātvā śrīnarmadāmbhasi |
vindhyaṃ vilokayāñcakre vrajan śrībadarīśvaram || 2 ||
rasālayaṃ drumavallīstambasasyādiśobhitam |
vardhamānaṃ mahākāśe lokayantaṃ samantataḥ || 3 ||
dṛṣṭvā kṣaṇaṃ nāradaḥ sa tasthau vyomnyeva kautukāt |
vindhyo’pi sūryasaṃkāśaṃ nabhasi dyotitāmbaram || 4 ||
nāradaṃ dṛṣṭavān premṇā dūrāt pratyujjagāma tam |
santaṃ dṛṣṭvā kaṭhino’pi dhatte mṛdulatāṃ yataḥ || 5 ||
natvā muniṃ dadau pādyamarghyaṃ cāsanamarhaṇam |
pādasaṃvāhanaṃ cakre babhāṣe’vanato giriḥ || 6 ||
adya te pādarajasā naṣṭaṃ rajastamo mama |
dharādharatvaṃ kuliṣu mānyaṃ me syāttavāgamāt || 7 ||

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
dhyāne sarvaṃ samālocyāgastiḥ svasya pativratām |

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
datrātreyasya sacchiṣyaḥ kārtavīryārjuno nṛpaḥ |
pativratayā tatpatnyā manoramākhyayā muhuḥ || 1 ||
rakṣito’pi bodhito’pi na mene svapriyāvacaḥ |
anādṛtya gato yuddhe jāmadagnyasya sannidhau || 2 ||
tadā dehaḥ parityakto manoramākhyayoṣitā |
tato mṛtaḥ kārtavīryaḥ śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ tu tām || 3 ||
māhiṣmatyā nagaryāḥ sa rājābhūdarjuno mahān |
ekadā kārtavīryaḥ sa jagāma mṛgayāṃ vane || 4 ||

kāmadhenupratāpena sasainyo bhojito nṛpaḥ || 5 ||

yayāvanu satī vahnau praviśya reṇukā patim || 6 ||

brāhmaṇebhyo dhanaṃ datvā brahmalokaṃ jagāma ha |
pratijñāṃ kathayāmāsa brahmaṇe’tha tamāha saḥ || 8 ||
śivalokaṃ gaccha vatsa śaṃkaraṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja |
śrīkṛṣṇamantrakavacagrahaṇaṃ kuru śaṃkarāt || 9 ||
durlabhaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tejaḥ śaivaṃ śāktaṃ vijeṣyati |
śrutvā natvā vedhasaṃ saḥ śivalokaṃ jagāma ha || 1.457.10 ||

siddhaḥ syāt pañcalakṣaistu mantraḥ saptadaśākṣaraḥ ||37||
