raṇatūryāṇyavādyanta sannāho’bhūcca sainyayoḥ |
parśurāmo’rjunamāha nyāyyaṃ yat sarvaśpṛṇvatām || 155||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne kāmadhenuharaṇamiṣegā jamadagnināśaḥ, reṇukāyāḥ satītvaṃ, parśurāmasya śakarāt śrīkṛṣṇamantrakavacastotralābhaḥ, svapne jāgaraṇe parśurāmasya śakunāni, sahasrārjunasyāpaśakunāni, pativratāyāḥ manoramāyāḥ pātivratyena satītvaṃ, raṇāgamaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptapañcāśadadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||457||

<1.458>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi mādhavāṃśaḥ parśurāma uvāca tam |
kārtavīrya raṇamadhye dharmabhṛtaṃ vaco yathā || 1 ||
śṛṇu rājendra dharmiṣṭha candravaṃśasamudbhava |
viṣṇoraṃśasya śiṣyastvaṃ dattātreyasya dhīmataḥ || 2 ||
kathe durbuddhimāptastvamahano vṛddhabhūsuram |
brāhmaṇī śokasantaptā bhartrā sārdhe gatā satī || 3 ||
kiṃ bhaviṣyati te bhūpa paratraivānayorvadhāt |
kva gatā kapilā sā te kīdṛk kūlaṃ bhaviṣyati || 4 ||
yat kṛtaṃ tu tvayā rājan hāliko na kariṣyati |
satkīrtiścātha duṣkīrtiḥ kathāmātrāvaśeṣitā || 5 ||
tvayā kṛto ghoratarastvanyāyastatphalaṃ labha |
uttaraṃ dehi rājendra samāje raṇamūrdhani || 6 ||
kārtavīryārjunaḥ śrutvā pravaktumupacakrame |
śṛṇu rāma hareraṃśastvamapyasi na saṃśayaḥ || 7 ||
sadbuddhyā karmaṇā brahmabhāvanāṃ karoti yaḥ |
svadharmanirataḥ śuddho brāhmaṇaḥ sa prakīrtyate || 8 ||
antarbahiśca mananāt kurute phaladāṃ kriyām |
maunī śaśvad vadet kāle hitakṛnmunirucyate || 9 ||
svarṇe loṣṭe gṛhe’raṇye paṃke susnigdhacandane |
rāmavṛttiḥ samabhāvo yogī yathārtha ucyate || 1.458.1 0||
sarvajīveṣu yo viṣṇuṃ bhāvayet samatādhiyā |
harau karoti bhaktiṃ ca haribhaktaḥ sa ucyate || 11 ||
tapodhanaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ munīnāṃ yogināṃ tathā |
haribhaktasya viprasya tapasyāḥ kāmadhenavaḥ || 1 2||
kṣatriyāṇāṃ sadaiśvarye spṛhā ratneṣu sarvadā |
kṣatriyāṇāṃ tu tapasi spṛhātīvāpraśaṃsitā || 13 ||
brāhmaṇānāṃ vivāde ca spṛhātīva vininditā |
rāgī rājasikaṃ kāryaṃ kurute karmarāgataḥ || 14||
rāgāndho yo rājasikastena rājā prakīrtyate |
rāgataḥ kāmadhenustu mayā vai yācitā mune || 15||
tava pitrā tu sainyāni kṛtānyayaṃ vyatikramaḥ |
kṛta eva vada vipra ko doṣo rāgiṇo’tra me || 16 ||
triṃśadakṣauhiṇīsenā hatyā nāśayituṃ ca mām |
udyatasya tu hanane na doṣo hyātatāyinaḥ || 17||
tvaṃ cāpi tāpaso bhūtvā vipradharmavivarjitām |
pratijñāṃ kṛtavān so’yamanyāyaḥ kiṃ na me vada || 18||
pitrordvayoḥ kṛte tvaṃ tu kartuṃ pṛthvīṃ niḥkṣatriyām |
triḥsaptakṛtvo yattat kiṃ nyāyyaṃ vada bhūsuraḥ || 1 9||
iti śrutvā garvavākyaṃ parśurāmātiruḍbharaḥ |
kṣaṇāt ṭaṃkārayitvā svaṃ dhanurmumoca sāyakān || 1.458.20||
bāṇaughaiśchādayāmāsārjunaṃ rathaṃ tathāmbaram |
manoramā sthitā divyā rathe pativratā satī ||2 1 ||
mahālakṣmīyutā devī rarakṣa svapatiṃ tadā |
tāvad rājāpi bāṇaughām̐ściccheda nijasāyakaiḥ ||22||
rāmasya bhrātaraḥ sarve catvāro’nye praśiṣyakāḥ |
nijaghnurarjunasainyaṃ tīkṣṇaśastrāsipāṇayaḥ ||23 ||
śarajālena rājendro vārayāmāsa tānapi |
cicchiduḥ śarajālaṃ ca jamadagnisutāstadā ||24||
rājā cikṣepa divyāstraṃ munayaścicchidustu tat |
divyāstreṇaiva munayaścicchiduḥ saśaraṃ dhanuḥ ||25||
rathaṃ ca sārathiṃ caiva rājñaḥ sannāhamityapi |
manoramā divyarūpā rarakṣa svapatiṃ satī ||26||
nyastraśastraṃ nṛpaṃ dṛṣṭvā munayo harṣavihvalāḥ |
jagṛhuḥ śūlinaḥ śūlaṃ matsyarājajighāṃsayā ||27||
śūlanikṣepasamaye vāgbabhūvāśarīriṇī |
śūlaṃ tyajata viprendrā śivasyāvyarthameva tat ||28||
śivasya kavacaṃ divyaṃ sarvāvayavarakṣakam |
matsyarājagale’styetat kavacaṃ yācata nṛpam ||29||
śrutvā rāmo yatirbhūtvā yayāce kavacaṃ nṛpam |
rājā dadau tu kavacaṃ brahmāṇḍavijaye tataḥ |||1.458.3 0||
rāmo jaghāna śūlena mūrchāṃ jagāma cārjunaḥ |
manoramā satī satyavratena yogasiddhibhiḥ |||3 1 ||
svasvāmihastadā prāṇān mūrghni rarakṣa bhāminī |
sā tadākāśavat sādhvī samuvāca nṛpān satī |||32||
bṛhadbalaṃ somadattaṃ vidarbhaṃ mithileśvaram |
niṣadhādhipatiṃ cāpi magadhādhipatiṃ tathā ||33||
praśṛṇvantu prāṇatulyāḥ prāṇasya me’vanaṃ tvaham |
karomi yātu bhavanto raṇaṃ kurvantu colbaṇam ||34||
kṣatriyāṇāṃ raṇo dharmo raṇe mṛtyurna garhitaḥ |
raṇe svāhā brāhmaṇānāṃ loke vede viḍambanā ||35||
kṣatriyāṇāṃ balaṃ śastraṃ vyāpārastu balaṃ viśām |
bhikṣābalaṃ bhikṣukāṇāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ sevanaṃ balam ||36||
bhaktirdāsyaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe bhaktabalaṃ hariḥ |
tapo balaṃ tāpasānāṃ duṣṭānāṃ hiṃsanaṃ balam ||37||
balaṃ veṣastu nārīṇāṃ yauvanaṃ gṛhayoṣitām |
balaṃ sainyaṃ nṛpāṇāṃ vai vālānāṃ rodanaṃ balam ||38||
satāṃ satyaṃ balaṃ bhaktiḥ sādhūnāṃ tu balaṃ kṣamā |
mithyā balaṃ cāsatāṃ tu dhairyaṃ sāhasināṃ balam ||39||
vidyā balaṃ paṇḍitānāṃ dhanaṃ tu dhanināṃ balam |
balaṃ vivekaḥ śreṣṭhānāṃ prajānāṃ balamekatā ||1.458.40||
guṇo balaṃ tu guṇināṃ satīnāṃ patisevanam |
pūjā devabalaṃ proktaṃ śiṣyāṇāṃ gurusevanam ||41 ||
balaṃ patnī gṛhasthānāṃ bhṛtyānāṃ svāmitoṣaṇam |
tyāgināṃ nispṛhatvaṃ tu balaṃ brahmavrataṃ mahat ||42||
puṇyaṃ balaṃ sukṛtīnāṃ jalajānāṃ jalaṃ balam |
śāntirbalaṃ tu viprāṇāṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ balaṃ balam ||43||
sasainyāḥ kṣatriyāḥ sarve yuddhaṃ kurvantu bhūsuraiḥ |
ityuktvā sā satī manoramārjunaṃ vimūrchitam ||44||
paricacāra vividhairupacāraiḥ suśaktidaiḥ |
yadyahaṃ prāṇanāthasya pativratāsmi sarvathā ||45||
prāpnotu cetanāṃ svāmī samuvāca pativratā |
tāvat sa cetanāṃ prāptaḥ samutthito raṇāya ca ||46||
atha rāmastriśūlena somadattaṃ jaghāna ha |
bṛhadbālaṃ tu gadayā vidarbhaṃ tomareṇa ca ||47||
maithilāṃ mudgareṇāpi śaktyā tu naiṣadhaṃ tathā |
māgadhaṃ tīkṣṇanārācairastrajālaiśca sainyakān ||48||
nihatya nikhilān bhūpān dudrāva cārjunaṃ prati |
tāvat satī samīpasthā manoramā vyavasthitā ||49||
rāmarāmādhamavipra bhasmībhūto bhaviṣyasi |
yadi tvanyāyamālambya mannāthaṃ mārayiṣyasi ||1.458.50 ||
śrutvā satīṃ puro dṛṣṭvā bhayād rāmo nyavartata |
kānyakubjāḥ śataśastu saurāṣṭrāḥ śataśastathā ||51 ||
rāṣṭrīyāḥ śataśaścāpi mahārāṣṭrāśca vaṃgajāḥ |
gaurjarāśca kaliṃgāśca rāmeṇa vyasavaḥ kṛtāḥ ||52||
dvādaśākṣauhiṇīḥ rāmo jaghāna tridivāniśam |
tāvadrājā kārtavīryaḥ śrīlakṣmīkavacaṃ kare ||53||
baddhvā śastrāstrasampanno rathamāruhya cāyayau |
yuyudhe vividhairastrairjaghāna brāhmaṇān bahūn ||54|||
parśurāmaḥ saparaśurdadhāva kālarūpadhṛk |
śiro nikṛntituṃ tāvad viṣṇurviprasvarūpadhṛk ||55||
mā yāhīti karaṃ dhṛtvā rurodha prāha tatkṣaṇam |
kavacaṃ śrīmahālakṣmyā bāhau tena dhṛtaṃ yataḥ ||56||
na mariṣyati bhūpālo yayāce taṃ sthiro bhava |
viṣṇurviprasvarūpastad yācituṃ nṛpamāyayau ||57||
vipro bhūtvā ca kavacaṃ yayāce bhagavān svayam |
manoramā tadā trāsaprāpede patipakṣiṇī ||58||
arjuno ditsati tāvanmanoramā nyavārayat |
rājan lakṣmīkavacaṃ te bāhau yāvaddhi vartate |||59||
tāvallakṣmīsvarūpāhaṃ śaknomi tvāṃ prarakṣitum |
mā dehīti muhuḥ proktastathāpi pradadau nṛpaḥ ||1.458.60||
kṣaṇaṃ manoramālakṣmīḥ patiṃ natvā ruroda vai |
athāśaktā kavacena samaṃ yātuṃ ca tatparā ||6 1 ||
abhūd viṣṇuparīkṣāṃ ca karoti sma tadā satī |
viṣṇuḥ kavacamādāya rāmaṃ prati samāyayau ||62||
dadau samantraṃ paraśurāmāya tacchṛṇu priye |
oṃ śrīkamalavāsinyai svāhā mantraṃ dadau tataḥ ||6 3 ||
prajāpatiḥ ṛṣiryasya chandaśca bṛhatī tathā |
devī padmālayā yasya caturvargaṃ niyojanam ||64||
oṃ śrīkamalavāsinyai svāhā me pātu mastakam |
oṃ śrī kapālaṃ me pātu locane śrīṃśriyai namaḥ ||65||
oṃ śrīṃśriyai svāheti vai karṇayugmaṃ sadāvatu |
oṃ śrīṃ klīṃ mahālakṣmyai svāhā me pātu nāsikām ||66||
oṃ śrīṃ padmālayāyai ca svāhā dantān sadāvatu |
auśrīṃ kṛṣṇapriyāyai ca dantarandhrān sadāvatu ||67||
oṃ śrīnārāyaṇeśāyai mama kaṇṭhaṃ sadāvatu |
oṃ śrīṃ keśavakāntāyai mama skandhaṃ sadāvatu ||68||
oṃ śrīṃ padmanivāsinyai svāhā nābhiṃ sadāvatu |
oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ saṃsāramātre mama vakṣaḥ sadāvatu ||69||
oṃ śrīṃmo kṛṣṇakāntāyai svāhā pṛṣṭhaṃ sadāvatu |
oṃ hrīṃśrīṃśriyai svāhā ca mama hasto sadāvatu ||1.458.70||
oṃ śrīnivāsakāntāyai mama pādau sadāvatu |
oṃ śrīṃhrīṃklīṃ śriyai svāhā sarvāṃgaṃ me sadāvatu ||71 ||
prācyāṃ pātu mahālakṣmīrāgneyyāṃ kamalālayā |
padmā māṃ dakṣiṇe pātu nairṛtyāṃ śrīharipriyā ||72||
padmālayā paścime māṃ vāyavyāṃ pātu mā svayam |
uttare kamalā pātu caiśānyāṃ sindhukanyakā ||73||
nārāyaṇī ca pātūrdhvamadho viṣṇupriyāvatu |
santataṃ sarvataḥ pātu viṣṇuprāṇādhikā mama ||74||
itisarvaiśvaryapradaṃ varma bāhau sudhāraya |
devendraiścāsurendraiścāvadhyo bhavasi niścitam ||75||
ityuktvā kavacaṃ datvā yayau vaikuṇṭhamacyutaḥ |
tāvanmanoramā lakṣmīkalārjunaṃ vihāya vai ||76||
yayau tu viṣṇunā sārdhaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ viṣṇunā hṛtā |
arjunaḥ prāha re patni tyaktvā māṃ yāhi mā priye ||77||
manoramā tu taṃ prāha sambandhaḥ sāntatāṃ gataḥ |
paraśurāmaśastreṇa hato māmanuyāsyasi ||78||
śīghraṃ brāhmaṇahastena hataḥ prāpsyasi mokṣaṇam |
vaikuṇṭhaṃ tvatkṛte rājan niścitaṃ yatra me sthitiḥ ||79||
ityuktvā sā yayau devī rājā yuyodha dāruṇam |
dvilakṣasainyaṃ yuyudhe brāhmaṇaiḥ saha padmaje ||1.458.80||
rājā cikṣepa śastrāṇi rāmaśiṣyāḥ palāyitāḥ |
cikṣepa rāmastvāgneyaṃ babhūvāgnimayaṃ raṇe ||81 ||
nirvāpayāmāsa rājā vāruṇena mahaujasā |
cikṣepa rāmo gāndharvaṃ śailasarpādikoṭikam ||82||
vāyavenārjunastadvai vārayāmāsa dāruṇam |
cikṣepa rāmo nāgāstraṃ rājā cikṣepa gāruḍam ||83||
rāmaścikṣepa māheśaṃ rājā cikṣepa vaiṣṇavam |
brahmāstraṃ cikṣipe rāmo rājā brahmāstramākṣipat ||84||
tāvat dhyāto’rjunagururdattātreyaḥ samāgataḥ |
dadau śūlaṃ hi rāmasya nāśārthaṃ kṛṣṇavarma ca ||85||
jagrāha rājā śūlaṃ taścikṣepa rāmakandhare |
mūrchāmavāpa rāmaḥ saḥ papāta śrīhariṃ smaran ||86||
brāhmaṇaṃ jīvayāmāsa śaṃbhurnārāyaṇājñayā |
cetanāṃ prāpya ca rāmo’grahīt pāśupataṃ yadā ||87||
dattātreyeṇa dattena siddhāstreṇārjunastu tam |
jaḍīcakāra tatraiva stambhito rāma eva vai ||88||
śrīkṛṣṇarakṣitaṃ bhūpaṃ dadarśa kṛṣṇavarma ca |
dadarśāpi bhramatsudarśanaṃ rakṣākaraṃ ripoḥ ||89||
etasminnantare tatra vāgbabhūvāśarīriṇī |
kṛṣṇasya kavacaṃ rājño bāhāvasti taduttamam ||1.458.90||
rakṣati tannṛpaṃ śaṃbhuryācatu bhikṣayā tu tat |
tadā hantuṃ nṛpaṃ śakto bhārgavo’yaṃ bhaviṣyati ||91 ||
atha śaṃbhuḥ siddhamantrairdatvā cetanameva tu |
apohya staṃbhanaṃ rāmo jagrāha paraśuṃ svakam ||92||
pāśupataṃ kare dhṛtvā paraśuṃ ca tathā kare |
sasmāra śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ tāvat sa āyayau ||93||
śaṃbhurvipraḥ svayaṃ bhūtvā yayāce’rjunameva tat |
kavacaṃ nṛpasaṃdattaṃ rāmāya śaṃbhurārpayat ||94||
sudarśanaṃ ca kavacaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastrayaḥ |
rāmapārśve samāgatya prāhurjeṣyasi sāmpratam ||95||
śaṃbhoḥ pāśupataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ harereva sudarśanam |
ete pradhāne sarveṣāmastrāṇāṃ tu jagattraye ||96 ||
kavacaṃ rakṣakaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ dhārayitvāha taṃ dvijaḥ |
rājan kuru raṇaṃ śīghraṃ kālabhede jayājayau ||97||
tvayādhītaṃ bahudattaṃ śāsitā ca vasundharā |
saṃgrāme’haṃ tvayā jaḍīkṛto’traiva sumūrchitaḥ ||98||
jitāḥ sarve’pi bhūpālā rāvaṇo līlayā jitaḥ |
jito’haṃ dattaśūlena śaṃbhunā jīvito’smyaham ||99||
śīghraṃ kuru kṣaṇaste’yaṃ śrutvaivaṃ pratyuvāca saḥ |
aho rāma kimadhītaṃ ki dattaṃ kā ca śāsitā || 1.458.1 00||
gatāḥ katividhā bhūpā macchreṣṭhāḥ kālabhakṣitāḥ |
buddhistejo vikramaśca jayaśca vijayastathā ||1 01|
śrīraiśvaryaṃ matirdānaṃ pratiṣṭhā paramaṃ tapaḥ |
vidyā garvastathā mānyaṃ sārvabhaumatvamityapi || 1 02||
sarvaṃ manoramāsaṃge gatameva mama kṣaṇāt |
sā ca lakṣmī kalā sādhvī pātivratyaparāyaṇā || 1 03||
mṛtā yāvad rakṣikā me tayā sārdhaṃ gataṃ mama |
tvaṃ kiṃ vipra prathamaṃ vai yuddhaṃ paśyasi kevalam || 1 04||
mama yuddhāni pūrvāṇi nekṣitānīti śocanā |
prathamātha dvitīyāpi maraṇaṃ brāhmaṇena me || 1 05||
vṛddhadampatīnāśena śocanā cātiniṣṭhurā |
kāle siṃhaḥ śṛgālaṃ ca sṛgālaḥ siṃhameva vā || 1 06||
kāle vyāghraṃ hanti mṛgo gajendraṃ hariṇastathā |
mahiṣaṃ makṣikā kāle garuḍaṃ ca tathoragaḥ || 1 07||
nṛpaśca kiṃkaraṃ stauti mahendro mānavaṃ tathā |
sarvaṃ kālakṛtaṃ vipra kālo hi duratikramaḥ || 1 08||
brāhmaṇasya ca hananaṃ sarvaṃ nāśakaraṃ mama |
pativratāyā maraṇaṃ brāhmaṇīnāśakṛtphalam || 1 09||
pativratāyā maraṇe mṛto’haṃ sarvathā dvija |
lakṣmīrūpā mṛtā prāgvai saṃketo’cyutakṛddhi saḥ || 1.458.110 ||
yāce tvāṃ ca tathā devān gurūn sarvāṃśca bhāvataḥ |
kṣamadhvaṃ cāparādhānye mā bhūnme nārakaṃ puraḥ || 111 ||
ityuktvā ca dhanuṣṭaṃkārayitvā sāyakān muhuḥ |
kālakāla iva bhūtvā vavarṣa lakṣaśo bahūn || 11 2||
kṛṣṇakṛṣṇavadan rājā manorameti saṃvadan |
ardhacandrām̐stathā śaktīrbhallān khaḍgān sahasraśaḥ || 113|
cikṣepa dhanuṣā tatra brāhmaṇeṣvāyuṣaḥkṣaye |
rāmo rūpadvayaṃ kṛtvā yuyudhe tena bhūbhṛtā || 1 14||
kṛtrimeṇa tu rūpeṇa dhṛtvā kuṭhārakaṃ kare |
dadhāva taṃ puro gatvā ciccheda bhujamaṇḍalam || 1 15||
dvitīyena svarūpeṇa jagrāhāstraṃ maholbaṇam |
pāśupataṃ samantraṃ ca cikṣepa līlayā nṛpe || 1 16||
hāhākāro mahānāsīt kārtavīryārjuno hataḥ |
anye ye jīvasaṃgrāhāste’pa viprairhatā raṇe || 1 17||
vidudruvustathā cānye svasvarājyāni cakrire |
māhiṣmatīṃ tadā rāmo dadau viprāya dakṣiṇām || 1 18||
anyeṣāṃ cāpi rājyāni dadau viprāya dakṣiṇāḥ |
devāśca munayo devyaḥ siddhagandharvakinnarāḥ || 11 9||
sarve cakruḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ rāmamūrdhni ca padmaje |
svarge dundubhayo nedurharṣaśabdo babhūva ha ||1.458.1 20||
evaṃ triḥsaptakṛtvaśca cakre pṛthvīṃ niḥkṣatriyām |
yaśasā cāpi paraśurāmasyāpūritaṃ jagat || 121 ||
brāhmaṇebhyo dadau rāmo rājyāni virarāma ca |
hatāstu kṣatriyāḥ sarve garbhasthā bālakāstathā || 1 22||
yuvāno jaraṭhā vṛddhāḥ stanaṃdhayā api priye |
kāścana kṣatriyanāryaḥ pātivratyaparāyaṇāḥ || 123 ||

dadarśa śaṃkaraṃ prāpyāśīrvādaṃ cāpyanugraham |

sarvaprasādāt sarvatra jayo’stu tava santatam |
sarvāntarātmā bhagavām̐stuṣṭaḥ syāt santataṃ hariḥ || 1 39||

śaṃbhuḥ prāha sadā śiṣya ciraṃjīvo bhava dhruvaḥ || 1.458.140 ||

bhuktiṃ muktiṃ kṛṣṇasevāṃ labhet kṛṣṇaprasādataḥ || 143 ||

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi camatkāraṃ jñānodasya vadāmi te |
anādisiddhe saṃsāre purā devayuge sati || 1 ||
īśānākhyo diśāpālaścaran bhūmiṃ samāyayau |
tadā saṃkalpamātreṇa satyadharmāḥ kṛte yuge || 2 ||
na varṣanti yadābhrāṇi na prāvartanta nimnagāḥ |
yadā jalābhilāṣā na snānapānādikarmasu || 3 ||
pṛthivyāṃ munisañcāre vartamāne kvacit kvacit| |
ānandakānanaṃ kṣetramūṣaraṃ praviveśa saḥ || 4 ||
āluloke brahmatejomayaṃ liṃgaṃ yadakṣarāt |
kiraṇākhyaṃ samāyātaṃ yadā viṣṇośca vedhasaḥ || 5 ||
ahamahamiko bhāvaḥ śreṣṭhatvetvabhavattadā |
īśānena tadā svalpamūṣare tvavalokitam || ||
svarṇasamaṃ surūpaṃ projjvalaṃ divyaṃ sumohakam |
īśānasyābhavadicchā snāpayāmi jalaistu tat || 7 ||
cakhāna ca triśūlena dakṣiṇāśopakaṇṭhataḥ |
kuṇḍe tatra jalaṃ divyaṃ tadā nārāyaṇāṃgajam || 8 ||
jalāvaraṇasambaddhaṃ prāvirāsātipāvanam |
tairjalaiḥ snāpayāñcakre liṃgaṃ suvarṇasadṛśam || 9 ||
pīyūṣavat svādutarairaspṛṣṭairanyadehibhiḥ |
adṛṣṭapūrvalokānāṃ manonayanahāribhiḥ || 1.460.1 0||
sahasradhāraiḥ kalaśaiḥ sa īśāno digīśvaraḥ |
sahasrakṛtvaḥ snapayāmāsa tuṣṭastato haraḥ || 11 ||
proce vṛṇu varaṃ matto dadāmi te’tidurlabham |
īśānaḥ prāha viśveśaṃ tvannāmnā tīrthamastviti || 12 ||
viśveśvarastadā prāha tathāstviti sumūrtimān |
bhūtvā liṃgasvarūpaḥ sa varivarti maheśvaraḥ || 13 ||
līnamarthaṃ gamayati liṃgaṃ jñānapradaṃ tu tat |
raśmiṃ vinā tadādhāraṃ saṃbhavenna kadācana || 14||
ādhārastu parabrahma bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ |
tasya jñānapradaṃ cihnaṃ liṃgaṃ tat kiraṇaṃ matam || 15 ||
tasya suvarṇarūpasya vāpī snānārthameva yā |
jñānavāpī jñānajalaṃ jñānodaṃ tīrthameva tat || 16 ||
jñānaṃ dravasvarūpaṃ ca jñānodaṃ śaṃkarālayam |
asya sparśanapānācamanasnānokṣaṇādibhiḥ || 1 7||
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ pitṛtṛptiṃ yatheṣṭaṃ ca phalaṃ labhet |
jñānarūpo’hamevātra dravamūrti vidhāya ca || 18||
jāḍyavidhvaṃsanaṃ kuryāṃ kuryāṃ jñānopadeśanam |
iti datvā varaṃ śaṃbhurliṃge cāntaradhīyata || 19||
īśānaśca gato natvā svadiśāṃ prati padmaje |
athānandavane tatra harisvāmīti bhūsuraḥ ||1.460.20||
āsīttasyābhavatputrī śīlarūpaguṇānvitā |
kalākalāpakuśalā miṣṭasvarātisundarī ||21 ||
kṛṣṇabhaktā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmipradevatā |
suśīlā nāma sā nityaṃ snātvā jñānodatīrthake ||22||
viśveśvarālaye saṃmārjanādi kurute satī |
kṛṣṇakṛṣṇetikṛṣṇeti śivaśaṃbho jagau mudā ||23|||
sulocanāpi sā kanyā paśyatyāsyaṃ na kasyacit |
suśravā hyapi sā bālā nādatte kasyacid vacaḥ ||24||
suśīlā śīlasampannā rahastadgatamānasaiḥ |
prārthitāpi kṛṣṇavratā nābhilāṣāṃ babandha sā ||25||
dhanaistasyāstu janako yuvabhiḥ prārthito bahuḥ |
nāśakattāṃ suśīlāṃ sa dātuṃ śolorjitaśriyam ||26||
jñānodatīrthabhajanāt suśīlā sā kumārikā |
bahirantastadādrākṣīt sarvaṃ kṛṣṇamayaṃ jagat ||27||
atha vidyādharastatra śaṃbhordidṛkṣayāgataḥ |
rūpalāvaṇyasampannāṃ dṛṣṭvā tāṃ cakame tu saḥ ||28||
gāndharveṇa vivāhena gṛhītvā sa yayau satīm |
sāpi prasevate nityaṃ malayādrau tu taṃ patim ||29||
pātivratyaparā sādhvī kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ patim |
sasmāra sarvadā tatra svāmini tviṣṭadevatām ||1.460.3 0 ||
atha kadācinmalaye bhramantaṃ ta patiṃ mahān |
nijaghāna triśūlena hyakasmād vyomamārgataḥ ||3 1 ||
pativratayā ca tayā śīghraṃ jalaṃ dhṛtaṃ mukhe |
tatyājāsūn rākṣasaṃ ca bhasmīcakāra sā satī ||32||
athāsya śavamādāya kṛtvā citāṃ tu sundarī |
kṛṣṇaṃ patiṃ tadā dhyātvā cakre citāgnisāt tanum ||3 3 ||
dampatī tau svargalokaṃ bhuktvā vai lakṣavatsarān |
vidyādhraḥ sa januḥ prāpa rājño malayaketutaḥ ||34||
vaiṣṇavaḥ paramodāraḥ satāṃ sevāparāyaṇaḥ |
suśīlā sā janurlebhe karṇāṭe nagare satī || 35||
suto malayaketostāṃ kālena pariṇītavān |
jātismarau dampatī tau kṛṣṇabhaktiparāyaṇau ||36||
nāmnā tau samavikhyātau mālyaketuḥ kalāvatī |
kalāvatī mālyaketuṃ patiṃ prāpya pativratā ||37||
apatyatritayaṃ lebhe divyabhogasamṛddhibhāk |
ekadā kaścidaudīcyo mālyaketuṃ nareśvaram ||38||
citrakṛccitrapaṭikāṃ citrāṃ darśitavānatha |
tāṃ tu citrapaṭīṃ rājā kalāvatyai samārpayat ||3 9||
sāṅgulyā prāṅnivāsasya sthānaṃ smṛtvā viveda tat |
gaṃgāmudagvahāṃ smṛtvā smṛtvā ca maṇikarṇikām ||1.460.40 ||
pañcagaṃgāṃ ca goghāṭaṃ tathā prahlādakeśavam |
balikeśavanāmānaṃ viṣṇuṃ nāradakeśavam ||41 ||
ādikeśavanāmānaṃ kṛṣṇamādityakeśavam |
bhīṣmakeśavanāmānaṃ tathā vāmanakeśavam |||42||
bhṛgukeśavanāmānaṃ naranārāyaṇau tathā |
gopīgovindanāmānaṃ yajñavārāhakeśavam ||||43||
lakṣmīnṛsiṃhanāmānaṃ śeṣamādhavanāmakam |
śaṃkhamādhavanāmānaṃ sasmāra sā pativratā || 44||
śrībindumādhavaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ sākṣāllakṣmīpatiṃ patim |
tathā śrīmaṃgalāgaurīṃ sasmāra dharmakūpakam ||45||
daśāśvamedhikaṃ tīrthaṃ jñānavāpīṃ priyāṃ parām |
viśveśvaraṃ tathā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇeśvaraṃ harim ||46||
kalāvatī citrapaṭīṃ paśyantītthaṃ muhurmuhuḥ |
punardadarśa jñānodaṃ śrīviśveśvarabhūtale ||47||
harṣavāṣpāmbukalile jāte tasyāḥ sulocane |
tastambha gātralatikā mukhaṃ praphullatāṃ gatam ||48||
svaro’tha gadgado jāto jñānavāpīṃ vilokya vai |
dṛṣṭvā rājā satīṃ prāha kiṃ priye smarasi sthalam ||49||
sā tu namrābhavat kṣipraṃ lajjayovāca vai tataḥ |
nātha dharmārthakāmāśca mokṣaśceti pumarthakāḥ ||1.460.50||
sādhanīyā manuṣyeṇa mokṣo mukhyaḥ pumarthakaḥ |
tadvihīnā janirapi jalabudbudavanmatā ||51 ||
yatrānukūlyaṃ dampatyostrivargastatra vardhate |
madvidhānāṃ tu dāsīnāṃ bāhulyaṃ te’sti mandire ||52 ||
tathāpi nitarāṃ prema svāmino mayi dṛśyate |
tava dāsyapi bhogāḍhyā kimutāṅkasthalīcarī ||53||
tatrāpyananyasampattistatra svādhīnabhartṛtā |
vipaścitsaṃcayedarthāniṣṭāpūrtāya karmaṇe ||54||
tapo’rthamāyurnirvighnaṃ dārām̐ścāpatyalabdhaye |
sarvaṃ te nṛpa saṃbhūtaṃ vairāgye’tha manaḥ kuru ||55||
bhakṣyavikārakāmānāṃ nāntosti maraṇaṃ vinā |
jñānena maraṇaṃ kāryaṃ dehasya maraṇaṃ na tat ||56||
ānandakānanayātrāṃ kartumicchāmi mokṣadām |
pūraṇīyo’bhilāṣo me mānuṣyaṃ saphalaṃ bhavet ||57||
śrutvā rājā ca tāmāha yogyaṃ kāle susmāritam |
saiva patnī satī sādhvī lakṣmīḥ śrīḥ sā hareḥ priyā ||58||
pativratāpi sā yā smārayedante hariṃ patim |
na rājyaṃ rājyamityohuḥ rājyaśrīryā pativratā ||59||
saptāṃgamapi sāmrājyaṃ tayā hīnaṃ tṛṇāyate |
yadi patnī svayaṃ bhūtvā patiṃ pātayati vṛṣāt ||1.460.60 ||
mokṣācca sā na vai patnī kṛtyā māyā tu rākṣasī |
svayaṃ yātyeva nirayaṃ nayatyapi patiṃ sutān ||61 ||
kulānyapi tu pāpādyaiḥ pātayatyeva sā divaḥ |
yā na smārayati bhaktiṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai ||62||
sādhvī nārī tu sā proktā sati dravye ca sampadi |
dharmaṃ tīrthaṃ vrataṃ puṇyaṃ dānaṃ saṃsmārayeddharim ||63 ||
tīrthaṃ samutsavaṃ pūjāṃ guroḥ pitrośca śārṅgiṇaḥ |
satāṃ sevāṃ harerdāsyaṃ kārayatyeva sā priyā ||64||
priyāt priyatarastvātmā tasya priyatamo’cyutaḥ |
mokṣaḥ priyatamaścāti smārayettaṃ pativratā ||65||
tava balānmayā sādhvi bhuktaṃ rājyamakaṇṭakam |
hṛṣīkārthāḥ kṛtārthāśca dharmaścāpi kṛto’tulaḥ ||66||
apatyānyapi jātāni kiṃ kartavyamihāsti me |
avaśyameva gantavyāvābhyāṃ vārāṇasī purī ||67||
iti niścitya rājā svaṃ putre rājyaṃ nidhāya ca |
datvā dānāni bahūni kāśīṃ prati pratasthivān ||68||
dṛṣṭvā viśveśvaraṃ jñānavāpīṃ nijapurābhuvam |
jahṛṣatuśca tau kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapadārthinau ||69||
snātvā dadau vividhāni dānāni kanakāni ca |
suvarṇarūpyakalaśān gāśca dogdhrīrdadau mudā ||1.460.70 ||
dukūlāni vicitrāṇi pūjopakaraṇāni ca |
yayau bhāryāyuto muktimaṇḍapaṃ tatra vā citām ||7 1||
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ śuśrāva satkathām |
dakṣiṇāṃ saddhanaṃ datvā pūjāṃ sāyaṃ śivasya saḥ ||72 ||
kārayāmāsa vidhinā jñānavāpīṃ yayau tataḥ |
nṛpaḥ sārdhaṃ kalāvatyā tatra sasnau prahṛṣṭavat ||73 ||
tatra piṇḍān sa nirvāpya santarpya śraddhayā pitṝn |
dīnānāthasatīsādhūn datvā dānāni vai tataḥ ||74||
bubhujāte dampatī ca bhojanaṃ pravibhajya tu |
tataḥ kalāvatī kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ mudā muhuḥ ||75||
jajāpa parayā bhaktyā tapaścakre tapasvinī |
ekāntaropavāsaiśca kadācittu tryahovrataiḥ ||76 ||
ṣaḍahobhojanaiścāpi pakṣārdhaniyamairatha |
pakṣāntaropavāsaiśca māsopavasanādibhiḥ || 77 ||
cāndrāyaṇavrataiḥ kṛcchrairbhartuḥ śuśruṣaṇairapi |
nināya kṣaṇavatkālamāyuḥśeṣasya sā satī ||78 ||
ekadā jñānavāpyāṃ tu prātaḥ snātvopaviṣṭayoḥ |
āgatya jaṭilaḥ kaścidāśīrbhirabhinandya ca ||79 ||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ |
mantraṃ datvā prasannāsyastulasīmālikādharaḥ ||1.460.80 ||
uttiṣṭhataṃ prakurutaṃ mokṣārthaṃ mānasaṃ param |
tāvad vimānamāpannaṃ sukvaṇatkiṃkiṇīgaṇam ||8 1 ||
caturbhujairharerbhaktairdivyaiḥ sappārṣadairyutam |
lakṣmīnārāyaṇamūrtitaijovyāptaṃ suśobhitam ||8 2 ||
svayaṃ lakṣmīstvavatīrya datvā jñānaṃ parātparam |
tārakaṃ mokṣadaṃ tau ca nināya divyavigrahau ||8 3 ||
vimānena mahālakṣmyā saha nārāyaṇena tau |
caturbhujau divyadehau kṛṣṇadhāma gatau priye ||84 ||
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi kalāvatyāvrataṃ śubham |
mokṣadaṃ paṭhanādvāpi śravaṇātsarvathā sati ||85||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne ānandavanakṣetre jñānodamahimani suśīlāyāḥ sādhvīvratasthāyāḥ gāndharvavivāhottaraṃ dampatyorjanmāntare rājyaprāptiḥ pātivratyaprabhāveṇa mokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṣṭyadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 460 ||

<1.461>
śrīlakṣmīruvāca
pātivratyaṃ paro dharmaḥ śruto jñātaśca te mukhāt| |
nārīdehasya pāvitryaṃ śāśvataṃ kṛtrimaṃ ca vā || 1 ||
yadvā saṃskārasamprāpyaṃ yadvā vaivāhikaṃ matam |
yathārthaṃ vada me kānta dharmakāryādipuṣṭikṛt || 2 ||
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
striyaḥ pavitrāḥ satataṃ naitā duṣyanti kenacit| |
māsi māsi rajastāsāṃ duṣkṛtānyapakarṣati || 3 ||
pūrvaṃ striyaḥ surairbhuktāḥ somagandharvavahnibhiḥ |
bhuṃjate mānuṣāḥ paścānnaitā duṣyanti kenacit || 4 ||
strīṇāṃ śaucaṃ dadau somaḥ pāvakaḥ sarvamedhyatām |
kalyāṇavāṇīṃ gandharvāstena medhyāḥ sadā striyaḥ | | 5 | |
kanyāṃ bhuṃkte rajaḥkāle’gniḥ śaśī lomadarśane |
stanodbhedeṣu gandharvāstatprāgeva pradīyate | | 6 | |
kanyāmabhuktāṃ somādyairdadaddānaphalaṃ bahu |
kanyādānaphalaprepsustasmāddadyādayauvanām | | 7 ||
rajoromastanodbhedā yauvanasya pradarśakāḥ |
aṣṭavarṣā bhaved gaurī navavarṣā tu rohiṇī || 8 ||
daśavarṣā bhavet kanyā hyata ūrdhvaṃ rajo’nvitā |
kanyādānaṃ śubhaṃ proktaṃ caturdaśasamāya vai | | 9 ||
śayanāsanayānāni kuṇapaṃ strīmukhaṃ kuśāḥ |
yajñapātrāṇi sarvāṇi na praduṣyanti vai kvacit || 1.461.10 | |
vatsaḥ prasravaṇe medhyaḥ śakuniḥ phalapātane |
nāryo ratiprayogeṣu śvā mṛgagrahaṇe śuciḥ | | 11 | |
ajāśvayormukhaṃ medhyaṃ gāvo medhyāstu pṛṣṭhataḥ |
brahmajñāḥ pādato medhyāḥ striyo medhyāstu sarvataḥ | | 12 | |
balātkāropabhuktā vā corahastagatāpi vā |
na tyājyā dayitā nārī medhyājena vinirmitā | | 13 ||
sādhavo gairikāpūtā rajaḥpūtāśca yoṣitaḥ |
kṛṣṇapūtaṃ jagatsarvaṃ dampatyudvāhapāvanau || 1 4||
garbhapūtaṃ sadā vīryaṃ janmapūtaṃ tu bālakam |
mantrapūtāḥ sadā śiṣyā dīkṣāpūtāḥ śarīriṇaḥ | | 19 | |
vratapūtāḥ sadā santaḥ patipūto vadhūjanaḥ |
jīvapūtaṃ sadā dugdhaṃ sthānapūtā radādayaḥ | | 16 ||
bhāvapūtā sadā kanyā yuvatī jaraṭhāthavā |
āpaḥ svabhāvato medhyā medhyo vahniḥ svabhāvataḥ | | 17 | |
vahnirāpo’nilo nārī medhyā vaṃśodbhavāḥ sadā |
tadabhyarcyāḥ suvāsinyo bhūṣaṇācchādanāśanaiḥ || 18 | |
bhūtikāmairnarairnityaṃ satkāryeṣūtsaveṣu ca |
ramante devatāstatra syustatra saphalāḥ kriyāḥ || 19 ||
yatra tuṣyati bhartrā strī striyā bhartā ca tuṣyati |
tatra veśmani kalyāṇaṃ sampadyeta pade pade | | 1.461.20 ||
prātikūlye kalatraṃ cennarakeṇāpi kiṃ tataḥ |
dakṣā prajāvatī sādhvī priyavāṇī vaśaṃvadā | | 21 ||
patiprāṇā bhāgavatī sā śrīḥ strīrūpadhāriṇī |
sadā gṛhī sukhaṃ bhuṃkte strī lakṣaṇavatī yadi || 22 ||
vapurāvartagandhāśca chāyā sattvaṃ svaro gatiḥ |
varṇaścetyaṣṭadhā bodhyā nārīlakṣaṇabhūmayaḥ || 23 ||
ṣaṣṭiḥ ṣaḍuttarā yoṣidaṃgalakṣaṇasatkhaniḥ |
ādau pādatalaṃ rekhāstato’ṅguṣṭhāṃgulīnakhāḥ || 24 | |
pṛṣṭhaṃ gulmadvayaṃ pārṣṇī jaṃghe romāṇi jānunī |
ūrū kaṭirnitambasphigbhago jaghanabastike || 25 ||
nābhiḥ kukṣidvayaṃ pārśvodaramadhyavalitrayam |
romālī hṛdyaṃ vakṣo vakṣojadvayacūcukam | | 26 | |
jatruskandhāṃsakakṣādormaṇibandhakaradvayam |
pāṇipṛṣṭhaṃ pāṇitalaṃ rekhāṅguṣṭhāṃgulīnakhāḥ || 27 | |
pṛṣṭhiḥ kṛkāṭikā kaṇṭhe cibukaṃ ca hanudvayam |
kapolo vaktramadharottarauṣṭhau dvijajihvikāḥ | | 28 ||
ghaṇṭikātāluhasitaṃ nāsikā kṣutamakṣiṇī |
pakṣmabhrūkarṇabhālāni maulisīmantamaulijāḥ || 29 | |
eteṣvaṃgeṣu nāryo vai parīkṣyante śṛṇu priye |
strīṇāṃ pādatalaṃ snigdhaṃ māṃsalaṃ mṛdulaṃ samam | | 1.461.30 ||
asvedamuṣṇamaruṇaṃ bahubhogocitaṃ smṛtam |
rūkṣaṃ vivarṇaṃ paruṣaṃ khaṇḍitapratibimbakam | | 31 | |
śūrpākāraṃ viśuṣkaṃ ca duḥkhadaurbhāgyasūcakam |
cakrasvastikaśaṃkhābjadhvajamīnātapatravat || 32 ||
yasyāḥ pādatale rekhāḥ sā bhavedvai nṛpāṃganā |
madhyāṃgulīgatācordhvarekhā bhogātibhogadā | | 33 | |
sarpamūṣakarekhāstu dāridryaduḥkhadāyikāḥ |
puṣṭonnataḥ śubho’ṅguṣṭho vartulo bahubhogadaḥ | | 3 4||
hrasvavakracipiṭastvaṃguṣṭhaḥ saubhāgyanāśakaḥ |
vidhavā vipulāṃguṣṭhā dīrghāṃguṣṭhā tu durbhagā || 35 | |
mṛdūnnataghanavṛttāṃgulayaḥ sampadāṃ pradāḥ |
dīrghāṃgulayaḥ kulaṭā kṛśāṃgulayo nirdhanāḥ | | 36 ||
hrasvāṃgulyo hasvajīvā bhugnāṃgulyaḥ śaṭhā matāḥ |
cipiṭāṃgulayo dāsyo daridrā viralāṃguliḥ || 37 | |
parasparasamārūḍhapādāṃgulyastu yoṣitaḥ |
anekavāraṃ vidhavāḥ paranāryaśca tā matāḥ | | 38 | |
yasyāḥ pathi calantyāstu pṛṣṭhe dhūlī samucchalet |
sā pitrośca tathā patyuḥ kulanāśakarī bhavet | | 39 | |
yasyāḥ kaniṣṭhikā bhūmiṃ gacchantyā na parispṛśet |
sā nihatya patiṃ yoṣā dvitīyaṃ kurute patim | | 1.461.40 ||
anāmikā tu gacchantyā yasyā bhūmiṃ tu na spṛśet |
patidvayaṃ nihatyaiva tṛtīyaṃ kurute patim || 41 | |
madhyamāṃgulikā yasyā yāntyā bhūmiṃ na vai spṛśet |
patitrayaṃ nihatyaiva caturthaṃ kurute patim ||40 ||
anāmikā madhyamātihrasvā pativiyoginī |
pradeśinī sadāṃguṣṭhasaṃyuktā kulaṭākarī |||43||

lakṣaṇāni mayoktāni sukhāya gṛhiṇāṃ priye |
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya svajñānaṃ sukhadaṃ bhavet || 1.461.170 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne strīpāvitryastrītanusthaśubhāśubhādisūcakacihnarekhāṅgapratyaṃgādiphalanirūpaṇanāmaikaṣaṣṭyadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||46 1 ||

<1.462>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi bhaviṣyatkālikīṃ kathāṃ vadāmi te |
sahitā bhagavatproktā brūte traikālikīṃ kathām || 1 ||
bhagavadgocaraṃ sarvaṃ yathārthaṃ cāpyabādhitam |
kalpe kalpe vibhinnā ca kācit sajātisadṛśī || 2 ||
kathā saṃjāyate viṣṇormama te cāpi sundari |
ākarṇaya priye lakṣmi pañcavaktro haraḥ svayam || 3 ||
pṛthivyāṃ pañcadhā bhūtvā yajñe saṃhārakṛcchivaḥ |
umāpi ca jagaddhātrī drupadasya mahībhujaḥ || 4 ||
yajato vahnikuṇḍāt sā prādurāsa sukanyakā |
pañcāpi pāṇḍutanayāḥ sākṣādindrasvarūpiṇaḥ || 5 ||
avateruriha svargāt kṣiterbhārāpanuttaye |
saṃjajñe śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’pi tatsahāyakṛt || 6 ||
sampadvipadbhramāvartā naisargikā jagadbhuvi |
jagadbhuvāṃ prajāyante hyudayānudayādayaḥ || 7 ||
kadācitte mahāvīrā bhrātṛvyaiḥ samayojitām |
vanavāsiprathārītiṃ śiśriyire vipatsamām || 8 ||
pañcālaputrī sā devī yayau vanasthalīṃ tu taiḥ |
bhaktā pativratā sādhvī pūjayatyeva tān sadā || 9 ||
patibhaktā satī sādhvī kṛṣṇabhaktā hareḥ sakhī |
indrapatnī tāpasī sārādhayāmāsa bhāskaram || 1.462.10 ||
brahmacaryaparā vanyāhārā saṃsevya tānpatīn |
śeṣakāle hyaniruddhya sūryadhyānaparābhavat || 11 ||
dhyātvā cānakhakeśāntaṃ samāvāhyārkapādape |
bahuvastupradānena pūjayatyeva bhāvataḥ || 12||
jalaṃ puṣpaṃ dalaṃ vanyaṃ phalaṃ bhojyaṃ sugandhikam |
nīrājanaṃ pradīpaṃ ca bhaktyārpayati sā satī || 13 ||
namanaṃ smaraṇaṃ stotraṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṣamāpanam |
puṣpāñjaliṃ parihāraṃ sā karoti pativratā || 14 ||
ārādhito’tha savitā dadau svadarśanaṃ raviḥ |
uvāca tāṃ mahādevīṃ vada kiṃ te’styabhīpsitam || 1 5||
ahaṃ sūryaḥ kuṣṇatanustvaṃ kṛṣṇā yajñasaṃbhavā |
tanvoraikyaṃ vijānāmi yanmadīyaṃ tavāpi tat || 16||
draupadī prāha deveśa vane vai sādhanaṃ vinā |
bahūnāṃ bhojanādyaṃ ca paryāptaṃ naiva pāryate || 17||
sahasrāṇāmatithīnāmāgamo bhavati kvacit |
śrutvā hi pāṇḍavānāṃ tu vanavāsaṃ vane rave || 18||
tadā teṣāṃ kṛte yogyaṃ yathāpūrṇā tu satkṛtiḥ |
jāyeta bhagavam̐stadvai dehi nirvyādhikaṃ dhanam || 1 9||
pātivratyaṃ patikīrtiryathā na syāttu nimnagā |
tathā sahāyatāṃ dehi vanavāsakṛte’rthadām || 1.462.20 ||
āsanaṃ ca jalaṃ vanyaphalānnaṃ madhurā ca vāk |
netrasnehastvatithīnāṃ prasādasya prayojakāḥ ||21 ||
āśīrvādāḥ prajāyante prasannahṛdayotthitāḥ |
dūyamānahṛdutthāstu śāpā bhasmakarā matāḥ ||22||
patisevā vane lābhaḥ paramo me’tra vartate |
patitulyātithisevānnādyaiḥ saṃśayitā prabho ||23 ||
iti śrutvā tu pāñcālyāḥ prasanno bhāskaraḥ prabhuḥ |
sadarvīṃ sapidhānāṃ ca sthālikāmakṣayāṃ dadau ||24||
uvāca sa prasannātmā svātmikāṃ tāṃ satīṃ tanum |
sthālyaitayā mahāpuṇye yāvanto’nnārthino janāḥ ||25 ||
tāvantastṛptimāpsyanti yāvacca tvaṃ na bhokṣyase |
bhuktāyāṃ tvayi riktaiṣā pūrṇabhaktā bhaviṣyati ||26 ||
rasavadvyañjananidhiricchābhakṣyapradāyinī |
yāvadvane nivāsaste tāvat sthāsyati te vaśe ||27||
prasevaya patīn nityaṃ lakṣaśo vanavāsinaḥ |
puṇyamarjaya deveśi sarvaṃ bhadraṃ sadāstu te ||28||
tvaṃ lakṣmīstvaṃ satī śrīśca tvaṃ prabhā tvaṃ ca māṇikī |
tvaṃ pārvatī jayā rādhā ramā padmā ca mohinī ||29||
padmāvatī ca rudrāṇī campā tvaṃ śāradā śivā |
tulasī tvaṃ mahālakṣmīrvṛndā sītā ca rukmiṇī ||1.462.3 0||
tvaṃ na jānāsi deveśi mānuṣalīlayānvitā |
jānāmyahaṃ sati tvāṃ vai kṛṣṇakāntāsi sarvathā ||3 1 ||
nararūpo’rjunaste 3 patiḥ kṛṣṇārdhakastava |
kṛṣṇe pativrataṃ te’sti kṛṣṇā tvaṃ kṛṣṇakāminī ||32||
tvāmekāṃ nimittīkṛtya pañcavīrairvasundharām |
kṛṣṇo nirdaityabhārā vai kartumicchati yajñaje ||33 ||
tvatsvarūpaṃ mama pātre cobhe tvakṣayapūrtide |
tvataḥ sarvāḥ kalāḥ satyo mama pātrāttu sanmakhāḥ ||34||
bhavantyeva bhaviṣyanti kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāśritāḥ |
nahi kṛṣṇavacaḥkartrī tvādṛśī komalā satī ||35||
sāttvikī kṣamayā vyāptā vinā lakṣmīṃ bhaviṣyati |
kṛṣṇavacastadevāsti vrataṃ pativrataṃ tava ||36 ||
dharmādharmau kṛṣṇavākye bandhamokṣāvapi prabhau |
sukhaduḥkhe kṛṣṇamūrtau pāṇḍavāḥ kṛṣṇamūrtayaḥ ||37||
mātaste’stu sadā svasti mā duḥkhaṃ vanavāsakṛt |
manyethāḥ sukharūpāsi smara kaṣṭe hariṃ ca mām ||38||
kariṣye sevanaṃ kāle dāsye sāhāyyamityapi |
mahatīnāṃ bhavetkaṣṭaṃ kṣudrīṇāṃ kiṃ bhavet satī ||3 9||
khaḍgadhārasahā rājyaṃ kurvanti kṣatriyā bhuvi |
nahi śṛgālatulyānāṃ kṣetraṃ svalpaṃ svakaṃ bhavet ||1.462.40||
agnikaṣṭaṃ saheta yā sāgnivarcaskabhūṣaṇā |
bhavatyeva hi sāgnestu jāyā koṭyarkavarcalā ||41 ||
nahi bhekī siṃhapatnī nahi kākī prahaṃsikā |
nahi dāsī rājapatnī na raṃkā dhanadādhipā ||42||
tvayā sarvaṃ jagat smṛddhaṃ tvāṃ vinā niṣprabhāyate |
draupadi smara govindaṃ hṛtsthaṃ svāmisthitaṃ ca tam ||43 ||
ityuktvā prayayau sūryo natvā tāṃ sa tayā nataḥ |
draupadī vanamadhye saṃsevate śrīhariṃ patīn ||44||
dhārtarāṣṭreṇa durvāsā ayutaśiṣyasevitaḥ |
preṣitaḥ pāṇḍavānāṃ tu vināśamiṣahetave ||45||
ātithyabhojanaṃ na syādayutānāṃ tataḥ ṛṣiḥ |
praśapsyati pāṇḍavām̐śca nāśameṣyanti te tataḥ ||46||
ityabhipretya vihito durvāsāstadvanaṃ yayau |
pāṇḍubhiḥ satkṛtaścāpi bhojanārthaṃ niveditaḥ ||47||
snānārthaṃ sa yayau yāvat sūryapātraṃ tu tattadā |
prakṣālya sthāpitaṃ satyā naiva dāsyati bhojanam ||48||
niyamottarakāle tu kṣīṇamannaṃ na vardhayet |
vinānnaṃ ṛṣirāṭ kruddhaḥ praśapsyati dhruvaṃ yataḥ ||49||
tadā satyā smṛtaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇapriyayā yoṣitā |
divyarūpaḥ svayaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ samāyātaḥ kṛpālayaḥ ||1.462.50||
vada devi smṛtaḥ kasmādāha kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ |
satī prāhātriputrasya bhojanaṃ kiṃ dadāmyaham |||51 ||
sarvaṃ riktaṃ tu saṃjātaṃ bhuktaṃ mayāpi pātrakam |
prakṣālya rakṣitaṃ sthāne nāstyannaṃ kṛṣṇa mādhava ||52 ||
kṛṣṇaḥ prāha sati pātraṃ samānaya vilokaye |
ānītaṃ tatra pārśve saṃlagnaṃ tāndūlapatrakam ||53 ||
dṛṣṭaṃ kṛṣṇena tatpatraṃ nihitaṃ svamukhe tu tad |
priyatāṃ śrīviśvabhartā brahmāṇḍaṃ priyatāṃ tathā ||54||
ityuktvā bhagavān kṛṣṇaścakhāda taddalaṃ śubham |
papau jalaṃ tataścakre samudgāraṃ punaḥ punaḥ ||55 ||
aho tṛptistu me jātā trailokyaṃ tṛptameva ca |
durvāsāstadayutaṃ ca śiṣyāṇāṃ tṛptameva ca |||56||
udarāṇi prapūrṇāni jātānyeva hareḥ kṛteḥ |
yasya gehe harirbhuṃkte tasya bhuṃkte jagattrayam ||57||
yasya gehe haristṛptastasyāstṛptaṃ jagattrayam |
durvāsāḥ śiṣyasahito bhayaṃ prāpto’ti tṛptimān ||58||
kiṃ bhavenneva bhokṣyāmastadā śaptāstu yoṣitā |
vinaṃkṣyāmastatastatra gantavyameva no tvitaḥ ||59||
iti vicintya sahasā snānasthānād yayurdrutam |
palāyanaparāḥ sarve śiṣyāśca krodhano muniḥ ||1.462.60||
pāṇḍavāścābhavan svasthā draupadyapi vicintanā |
kṛṣṇaśca sevitaḥ sarvaiḥ rakṣākaraharirvane ||6 1 ||
yadāpat syāt susmartavya ityuktvā prayayau prabhuḥ |
eṣa pativratādharmaḥ kṛṣṇapatyātmakaḥ sati ||62||
sarvā vāñchanti subhagaṃ surūpaṃ yauvanānvitam |
dhanāḍhyaṃ smṛddhamaiśvaryānvitaṃ kīrtikaraṃ patim ||63||
tādṛśaṃ kṛṣṇamāsādya kā na seveta kiṃkarī |
kā na kuryāt svīyajanmasāphalyaṃ vai pativratā ||64||
devyo gāndharvya āsuryo nāgapatnyo munipriyāḥ |
vallyo nadyaḥ kṣamādyāśca kṣmādyāśca kinnarastriyaḥ ||65||
mānavyaśca kiṃpuṃpatnyo vidyādharyastathāparāḥ |
yā yā mumuhuḥ kṛṣṇe tāḥ sarvāḥ prāpuḥ paraṃ padam ||66||
tāsāṃ sukhakaraḥ kṛṣṇo loke jāyate janmanā |
janma karma ca divyaṃ tad dṛśyate na vidhīyate ||67||
śrīharerharikṛṣṇasya kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai |
rādhādīnāṃ ramādīnāṃ janmāni yonijāni na ||68||
yadā yadā svayaṃ kṛṣṇaścāvataritumicchati |
dadātyājñāṃ vāyudevaṃ vasa garbhapuṭe sthiraḥ ||69||
yathā dṛśyaṃ bhavenmātrudaraṃ garbhayutaṃ śubham |
navamāsān sthiro bhūtvā daśame māsi cāgate ||1.462.70||
janmakāle tvayā garbhānniḥsaraṇīyaṃ bālavat |
ahaṃ tadāpatyarūpaṃ bālakaṃ māṃ vidhāya ca ||71 ||
patiṣyāmi bhuvo bhāge jānīyurmāṃ hi janmitam |
ayonijaṃ mama janma tathā bhavati sarvathā ||72||
sarveṣāmavatārāṇāmayonijaṃ janurmama |
rādhālakṣmīramāpadmāśrīprabhākāntiśāradāḥ ||73||
māṇikīpārvatīdurgāsarasvatīsatījayāḥ |
padmāvatīlalitākambharādyāstā ayonijāḥ ||74||
yadā yadā hi jāyante vāyurgarbhe pratiṣṭhati |
daśame māsi cāyāte prāpte kāle’nilaḥ svayam ||75||
kṣaṇaṃ bālasvarūpo vai bhūtvā yonerbahistataḥ |
āyātyeva tadā devyo bhavanti bālikātmikāḥ ||76 ||
anye yathā na jānīyustathā bālā bhavanti tāḥ |
kathayanti janā ajñā yonijā iti tāstadā ||77||
divyadṛṣṭiparāstāstu paśyantyayonibālikāḥ |
idaṃ divyajanustasya kṛṣṇasya tasya yoṣitām ||78||
saṃkalpasṛṣṭivat sṛṣṭiḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai |
kāmo vīryaṃ ratirgarbhaḥ sarvaṃ darśanamātrakam |||79||
lokavattu tasya līlāṃ kaivalyaṃ cāpi lokavat |
lokāḥ paśyanti devāstu devavad divyacakṣuṣaḥ ||1.462.80||
īśvarā īśavattadvai muktāḥ paśyanti muktavat |
svaḥ vilokayati svīyaṃ svavacchrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||8 1 ||
tasmāt sarvāḥ kriyāḥ kṛṣṇe divyā divyatvadāyikāḥ |
itidharmān kṛṣṇadharmān kṛṣṇapatiparāyaṇān ||82||
patirūpān kṛṣṇabhaktān saṃprāpya ca pativratāḥ |
svargaṃ mokṣaṃ vṛṣaṃ kāmaṃ cārthaṃ samarjayanti tāḥ ||83 ||
putraṃ putrīṃ sukhaṃ divyānandaṃ samarjayanti tāḥ |
kṛṣṇārthaṃ sarvamevāpi kṛtvārcayanti mādhavam ||84||
kṛṣṇavrataṃ sadā kṛtvā saṃsevya patimādhavam |
dehaṃ svaṃ patisātkṛtvā cāpnuvanti hareḥ padam ||85||
kiṃ vaktavyaṃ priye lakṣmi jānātyevedṛśaṃ vratam |
madvrataṃ tvadvrataṃ sarvaṃ śubhaṃ dāmpatyadharmakam ||86||
nirguṇaṃ ca paranirvāṇadaṃ matpadanāyakam |
śreṣṭhācchreṣṭhataraṃ tubhyaṃ kathitaṃ matpriye sati ||87||
yā kāpi nīcagā coccakulajā vā tu bhāminī |
madratirmatkṛtaprāṇā madarthārpitajīvanā ||88||
mayoktabhāvasaṃbhinnā sevate māṃ pativratā |
harivratā ca sā tvante prāpsyatyeva pativratā ||89||
asyādhyāyasya saṃśrotrī kartrī darśitasadvidheḥ |
arcayitrī ca me nityaṃ prāpsyatyeva satī hi mām ||1.462.90||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne draupadyāḥ satītvena pātivratyabalena vane’bhojanakālāgatasaśiṣyadurvāsaso dropadyādirakṣaṇaṃ tāndūlapatrādanaṃ kṛṣṇakṛtamiti nirūpaṇanāmā dvāṣaṣṭyadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 462 ||

<1.463>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
ākarṇaya mahālakṣmi prabhe pārvati padmaje |
sarasvati rame kṛṣṇe māṇiki | kambhare sati || 1 ||
durge rādhe śārade ca vṛnde tulasi cābdhije |
padmāvati pāṇḍaveśi sāvitri rukmiṇī priye || 2 ||
vinatāyāstathā kadrvāḥ kathāṃ pūrvabhavāṃ paṇe |
dakṣadatte kaśyapāya kadrūśca vinatā tathā || 3 ||
pativrate mahāsādhvyau svāmisevāparāyaṇe |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhakte kāmarūpadhare śubhe || 4 ||
kṛṣṇārthaṃ ca tapasyantyāvāstāmapatyavāñcchane |
kadrvāḥ sarpāḥ sutā jātāḥ kāmarūpadharāḥ śubhāḥ || 5 ||
kādraveyā gaṇāste vai kṛṣṇā raktā haridguṇāḥ |
piśaṃgāḥ pītaraktāśca kapiśāścitrakāstathā || 6 ||
śvetā nīlāstathā sūkṣmā madhyā dīrghāḥ pradīrghakāḥ |
nāgāḥ sarīsṛpāḥ kadrūsutāḥ kadrūpiṇo’bhavan || 7 ||
śyāmāśca śabalāścāpi tathārjunāśca dhūmrakāḥ |
miśravarṇāstulālābvaḥ koṭiśo nāgajātayaḥ || 8 ||
athāsūtolūkatārkṣyāruṇādīn vinatā sutān |
ulūko rājyamāpyāpi jyeṣṭhatvāt pakṣiṇāṃ tataḥ || 9 ||
nirguṇatvācca taiḥ sarvaiḥ sa rājyādavaropitaḥ |
krūrākṣaśca divāndhaśca sadā vakranakho’śubhaḥ || 1.463.1 0||
vāṇī tvasyodvejiketi nāyaṃ rājyasamarhaṇaḥ |
atha tvarājake rājye vartante svairacāriṇaḥ || 11 ||
pakṣiṇaśceti rājārthe putravīkṣaṇalālasā |
aṇḍaṃ prāsphoṭayāmāsa madhyamaṃ vinatā tadā || 1 2||
yadvai pakvaṃ bhaved varṣasahasre pūrṇatāṃ gate |
tadabhedi tayautsukyādaṇḍamaṣṭamake śate || 13||
tāvat sarvāṇi gātrāṇi santi pūrṇāni naiva hi || 14||
sa tu garbho’bhavat kruddho’rdhavarṣmasiddhibhedane |
krodhena śiśunā mātā śāpitā tvavicārya yat || 15||
mātṛsvayārdhadehāntargatamaṇḍaṃ vibheditam |
radaniṣpannasarvāṃgaḥ śapāmi tvāṃ sutāhitām || 1 6||
yato dṛṣṭvā kādraveyān tanmāturaṃkalālitān |
adhairyeṇāṇḍametanme sphoṭitaṃ tanmiṣāttvayā || 17||
putraṃ prāpya drutaṃ tvaṃke lālayāmīti cehayā |
tatastvamedhi dāsītvaṃ sapatnyā vai vihaṃgame || 18||
iti śrutvā sutadattaṃ śāpaṃ mātā śucānvitā |
prāhānūro brūhi śāpasyāntaṃ putra śubhaṃ kuru || 1 9||
anūruḥ prāha mā bhindhi tṛtīyāṇḍamapūrṇakam |
tṛtīye’ṇḍe bhaviṣyan yaḥ sa śāp vārayiṣyati ||1.463.20||
ityuktvā mātaraṃ natvoḍḍīyānūruryayau vanam |
sūryamārādhya tapasā varaṃ labdhvā prabhākarān ||21 ||
sūryeṇa rakṣito yantre ravyaśvān vāhayatyayam |
aruṇasyodayaḥ pūrvaṃ paścāt sūryodayaḥ kṛtaḥ ||22||
atha varṣasahasre tu pūrṇe’ṇḍaṃ tu tṛtīyakam |
svayaṃ bhinnaṃ tato jāto garuḍaḥ sūryasadṛśaḥ | | 23 ||
pataṃgo’pi bahiḥ sākṣādaṇḍānniḥsṛtya śāvakaḥ |
kṣudhārthī mātaraṃ prāha bhakṣyaṃ me dīyatāmiti | | 24||
hṛṣṭāha mātā kṣudhitaṃ garuḍaṃ tu mahābalam |
kṣudhāṃ śamayituṃ putra na śaknomi tadantataḥ || 25 ||
tava tātaḥ kaśyapo’sti merau tiṣṭhati taṃ vraja |
sa dāsyati bhojanaṃ te kṣudhā te śamameṣyati | | 26 ||
māturvacaḥ samākarṇya yayau yatra sa kaśyapaḥ |
praṇamya śirasā vākyamuvāca pitaraṃ khagaḥ || 27 ||
sutaste garuḍaścāhaṃ mātrā vinatayeritaḥ |
kṣudhayā pīḍitastāta bhakṣyaṃ me dīyatāṃ prabho || 28 ||
jñātvā sutaṃ tamuvāca kaśyapaḥ snehaprahvaṇaḥ |
anekaśatasāhasrā niṣādāḥ payasāṃ nidheḥ || 29 ||
tīre vasanti matsyādāstām̐stvaṃ bhakṣa sukhī bhava |
vinā vipraṃ niṣādeṣu dehayātrāṃ pravartaya || 1.463.30 ||
ityuktaḥ prayayau tatra gatvā cakhāda tām̐stataḥ |
alakṣyabhāvo vipro’pi gilitastena pakṣiṇā || 31 ||
atha jāto gale vahnirjajvāla kaṇṭhamadhyamam |
vamituṃ gilituṃ vāpi na śaśāka sa pakṣirāṭ || 32 ||
gatvātha pitaraṃ prāha kaṇṭhāntarme’nalaḥ pitaḥ |
karoti dahanaṃ śaśvallagnaḥ kaścijjano’ntakṛt || 23 ||
kaśyapaḥ prāha bho putra bhaved vipro’nyathā na tat |
ityuktvā kaśyapo vipraṃ samājuhāva vai bahiḥ || 34||
vipraḥ prāha vihāyaitānna nirgacchāmi bho pitaḥ |
gilitāḥ suhṛdaḥ kecit priyāḥ sambandhinastathā || 3 5 ||
etaiḥ saha prayāsyāmi nirayaṃ vā sukhaṃ harim |
śrutvā tu vismitaḥ prāha kaśyapaḥ patitaṃ dvijam || 36 ||
niṣādaiḥ saha sambandhaṃ cāpāvānasi tattataḥ |
nirayaṃ tveva gantāsi pāpiyogāddhi pāpavān || 37 ||
ajñānād yadi vā mohātkṛtvā pāpaṃ sudāruṇam |
tato dharmaṃ careccet sa yāyādvai paramāṃ gatim || 38 ||
pāpakṛnna vṛṣaṃ kuryāt kuryātpāpaṃ punastadā |
nimajjati mahāghore niraye te gatistathā || 39 ||
nirgaccha vā mṛtiṃ yāhi kaṇṭhe mā tiṣṭha bhūsura |
śrutvā kaśyapavākyaṃ sa sambandhivratavān dvijaḥ || 1.463.40 ||
uvāca kaśyapaṃ spaṣṭaṃ śṛṇu tāta hitaṃ mama |
yadyapyasmi dvijo jātyā niṣādī me’sti kāminī ||41 ||
niṣādā me śyālakāśca śvaśuraścāpare tathā |
nigilitā garuḍena mṛtāste tvasya jāṭhare ||2||
pāvanasya tu yogenāpāvanaṃ pāvitaṃ bhavet |
viprayogena te sarve tava yogāttu pāvanāḥ ||43||
garuḍagarbhayogena pāvitāste viśeṣataḥ |
sambandhivratavām̐ścāhaṃ pātivratyaparāyaṇaḥ ||44||
nirmuktāḥ syuśca te sarve jīvitāḥ syuḥ pitarmama |
nirgacchāmi tadā kaṇṭhādanyathā maraṇaṃ dhruvam ||45||
bandhujīvaḥ prāṇānto vā pratijñā sudṛḍhā mama |
kaśyapastatsamākarṇya śreyo’rthaṃ tvāha pakṣiṇam ||46||
udvamaitān saviprām̐śca niṣādānapi sarvaśaḥ |
ityukto garuḍaścaitānudvavāma niṣādakān ||47||
te vai dikṣu vidikṣu samvasanti pakṣihiṃsakāḥ |
garuḍakukkuṭahaṃsapārāvātādibhakṣakāḥ ||48||
kalau sarve miliṣyanti tvekāhāre prajājane |
jātibhedo yadā naiva sthāsyatyadanalagnayoḥ ||49||
athāpi kṣudhayā yukto yayāce bhakṣyamuttamam |
kaśyapena tadādiṣṭo yayau sāgarasannidhau ||1.463.50 ||
tatra dṛṣṭvā mahāsattvau naikayojanavigrahau |
kūrmagajau nakhairbhitvotpapātākāśamujjayaḥ ||51 ||
merau dṛṣṭvā jambuśākhāṃ niṣasāda mahattamām |
bhagnāṃ śākhāṃ gajakūrmau gṛhītvoḍḍīya cāmbare ||52|||
satyalokaṃ yayau brahmasadanaṃ yatra mādhavaḥ |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo viṣṇuḥ stutastatra samāgataḥ ||53||
hariḥ prāha kathaṃ vyomni bhramasi tvaṃ khageśvara |
vidhṛtya mahatīṃ śākhāṃ mahāntau gajakacchapau ||54||
garuḍastu hariṃ prāha kāśyapo vinatāsutaḥ |
garuḍo’haṃ gajakūrmo gṛhītvā jambubhūruham ||55||
gataḥ sa meruvṛkṣo’pi bhagnastiṣṭhāmi kutra vai |
bhakṣituṃ kṣudhitaścāsmi kva yāmi vada me prabho ||56 ||
mama bhāraṃ tathā vegaṃ sahante na drumādayaḥ |
parvatāścāpi kampante grahāḥ kṣubhyanti cāmbare ||57||
ityukto bhagavānāha tiṣṭha bāhau mamātra vai |
kṣudhāṃ kuru praśāntāṃ tvaṃ bhakṣemau gajakacchapau ||58||
ityukto garuḍo bāhau papāta śrīharestadā |
śākhāṃ tyaktvā mahābdhau ca cakhāda gajakacchapau ||59||
kṣudhā tathāpi śāntā na tataḥ prāha haristu tam |
bhuṃjasva mama māṃsaṃ tvaṃ bhakṣayitvā sukhī bhava ||1.463.60||
ityukto bhujamāṃsaṃ sa khāditvā tṛptatāṃ gataḥ |
tathāpi na vraṇo bāhau jātaśceti vilokya saḥ ||6 1 ||
hariṃ prāha priyaṃ kiṃ te kariṣyāmi vada prabho |
hariḥ prāha bhava me vāhanaṃ tvaṃ sārvakālikam ||62||
avadhyaḥ sarvabhūteṣu bhava tvaṃ cājarāmaraḥ |
sarvatra te gatiścāstu karma tejaśca matsamam ||63||
āhāraṃ lapsyase pūrṇaṃ mātṛvyasananāśanāt |
ityuktaḥ sa yayau pakṣī pitaraṃ kaśyapaṃ prati ||64||
praṣṭuṃ cājñāṃ grahītuṃ cākathayat pitaraṃ ca saḥ |
prahṛṣṭātmā kaśyapastu tanayaṃ prāha sadvacaḥ ||65||
dhanyo’haṃ jananī dhanyā dhanyaṃ kulaṃ suputravat |
yasya putro viṣṇubhaktaḥ kulakoṭipramocakaḥ ||66||
kṣayāttu sarvapāpānāṃ viṣṇoḥ kiṃkaratāṃ vrajet |
viṣṇuryasya bhavet prītaḥ so’pi syātpuruṣottamaḥ ||67||
putraḥ patnī sutā gauśca kṛṣṇārthaṃ yasya vidyate |
dhanyaḥ sa dehavānatra pūtaṃ yasya kuṭumbakam ||68||
tapobhirbahubhirdharmairmakhairnānāvidhairapi |
viṣṇurna labhyate devaistvayā labdho hariḥ sa vai ||69||
mātaraṃ tvaṃ sevayitvā gaccha viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam |
iti tvājñāṃ gṛhītvā sa śīghraṃ jagāma mātaram ||1.463.70 ||
natvā tu mātaraṃ svalpaśarīreṇa sa bālakaḥ |
kāmarūpadharo bhūtvā reme jaharṣa sannidhau ||71 ||
kadrvāstu kiṃkarībhūtvā sthitāṃ dṛṣṭvā tu mātaram |
papraccha garuḍastatra kāraṇaṃ vada me’mbike ||72||
mātā prāha śṛṇu putra prāgvṛttaṃ kathayāmi te |
kadrvā saha yaḥ saṃjātaḥ paṇastaṃ tvaṃ nibodha me ||73 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne kaśyapāt kadrūprajāḥ sarpāḥ, vinatāyāmulūkasyāruṇasya garuḍasyotpattiḥ, garuḍena bhakṣitāḥ savipraśabarā udvamitāḥ, viṣṇubhujapalalaṃ bhakṣitam, viṣṇorvāhanaṃ varadānaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā triṣaṣṭyadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||463 ||

<1.464>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
purā kadrūśca vinatā dakṣaputryau tu yoṣitau |
kaśyapasya dharmapatnyau krīḍantyā vekadā śubhe || 1 ||
uccaiḥśravāṃsaḥ sūryāśvāḥ śabalā dhavalā nu vā |
kiṃrūpāḥ syuritivādaṃ cakrāte kaśyapagṛhe || 2 ||
kadrūruvāca vinate gatiste vyomnyakhaṇḍitā |
tataḥ sarvaṃ vijānāsi vada rūpaṃ nu kīdṛśam || 3 ||
paṇaṃ ca kuru kalyāṇi tubhyaṃ yo rocate’naghe |
vinatovāca kalyāṇi kiṃ paṇenātra dakṣaje || 4 ||
paṇe tu nāvayoḥ saukhyaṃ paṇo’nyataraduḥkhakṛt |
iti jñātvā paṇo naiva kartavyaḥ snehahānikṛt || 5 ||
tvajjaye kā ca me hānirme jaye kā ca te kṣatiḥ |
dhruvamekasyā vijaye’nyasyāstvavanatirbhavet || 6 ||
evameva kathayāmi vinā paṇena tat svasaḥ |
kadrūḥ prāha sadā khelavyavahāre paṇaṃ vinā || 7 ||
āsvādo mānaso naiva raso nāpi prajāyate |
tasmāt paṇaṃ puraskṛtya ramante khelakāriṇaḥ || 8 ||
bālā api mṛṣā paṇaṃ kurvanti ca hasanti ca |
ramante kālayānārthaṃ paṇaṃ kuru tato vada || 9 ||
vinatāha yathā prītistavātra vai |
atha kadrūḥ śaṭhā dhūrtā paṇarūpaṃ jagāda ha || 1.464.1 0||
tasyāstu sā bhaved dāsī parājīyet yā yayā |
asminpaṇe tvimāḥ sarvāḥ sakhyaḥ sākṣiṇya eva nau || 11 ||
paṇīkṛtya tathā kadrūḥ karburaṃ prāha vājinam |
vinatā dhavalaṃ prāha tato yayatuḥ svālayam || 12||
kadrūḥ kṛṣṇasutān sarpānāhūya prāṇa tatpaṇam |
uvāca yāta satputrā drutaṃ mama nideśataḥ || 1 3||
śvetaṃ taṃ vājinaṃ putrā valgata pratiromakam |
kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ pradṛśyeta kalmaṣayeta sarvataḥ || 14||
iti śrutvā vaco mātuḥ kecanāhuḥ svamātaram |
vayaṃ naiva gamiṣyāmo mṛṣā doṣabhayānvitāḥ || 1 5||
anye’pi tu tathā prāhurdoṣo viśvāsanāśanam |
anṛtaṃ narakadvāraṃ doṣaṃ kurmo na tad vayam || 16 ||
apare’pi svabandhūnāṃ snehaṃ mātṛsvasustathā |
puraskṛtya niṣedhaṃ tatkāryaṃkurvan nayānvitāḥ || 1 7||
tānsarvānuragī kadrūḥ śaśāpa krodhaśevadhiḥ |
tārkṣyabhakṣyāḥ sadā santu ye madvacovirodhinaḥ || 18||
iti śāpapradagdhāste yayuḥ pātālamāśrayam |
athānye bālakāstvāsan mātṛsnehasamākulāḥ || 1 9||
te matvā mātṛvacanaṃ yayuḥ sūryāśvamambare |
vavalgire parito’śvaṃ cakrurnīlaṃ sukarburam || 1.464.20 ||
atha sūryasya tāpena dagdhāste tvāyayurgṛham |
mātaraṃ prāha tatsarvaṃ tadā kadrūstu rāhukam ||2 1 ||
samāhūya samarcyāpi sūryatāpavināśakam |
suyojanaṃ samādiśya parvaṇi rāhuṇāvṛtam ||22||
gatvā sarpā arkavāhaṃ vavalgire samantataḥ |
vinatāpṛṣṭhamāruhya kadrūryayau divaṃ yadā ||23||
tābhyāṃ turaṃgamo’darśi karburo nīlavarṇakaḥ |
vinatā prāha dhavalo mayā vyaloki vai muhuḥ ||24||
tava bhāgyodayādaśvaḥ karburo’dya vilokyate |
astu yathā tathā bhāvi bhāgyaṃ kena nivāryate ||25||
vidhirbalīyān sarvatra śvetaṃ nīlāyate’pi yat |
adṛṣṭaṃ yādṛśaṃ yatra bhogyatvenopatiṣṭhati ||26||
pratikūlaṃ prajāyet sānukūlamapi drutam |
iti dṛṣṭvā nīlamaśvaṃ parābhūtā hi pakṣiṇī ||27||
kadrūgṛhasthitā nityaṃ tasyā dāsyaṃ sadākarot |
garuḍastāṃ tathābhūtāṃ dṛṣṭvā dāsīṃ svamātaram ||28||
prāha mātaḥ kathaṃ tvetaddāsyaṃ vai prohyate tvayā |
dhik tānsutānbaliṣṭhām̐stu yanmātā tvanyakiṃkarī ||29||
putrotpattistadarthā vai yā pitroḥ paripoṣikā |
putrairapoṣitā mātā gardabhyā tulanāyate ||1.464.3 0||
satsu saptasu putreṣu gardabhī bhāravāhinī |
dhik tān putrām̐stu yanmātā teṣu jīvatsu duḥkhinī ||3 1 ||
varaṃ vandhyātvamevāsyā yatsutā vandhyakarmiṇaḥ |
kleśitaṃ jananījaṭharaṃ yena mātā na modate ||32||
mātā lakṣmīrjanmadātrī nijasvatvapradāyinī |
sā duḥkhāt tāritā yairna teṣāṃ janma nirarthakam || 33||
mayi sattve baliṣṭhe ca yadi mātātiduḥkhinī |
kiṃ balaṃ me praśastaṃ vai nārakaṃ tat smṛtaṃ valam || 34||
api pāpakṛtaḥ putrā yadi rakṣanti mātaram |
taranti mātṛtīrthena sevayā toṣitena te |||35||
na yajñā na vrataṃ jāpyaṃ dānaṃ na cāpi dakṣiṇā |
mātṛsevāśatāṃśatvaṃ prāpnuvanti kadācana || 36||
api vighnasahasrāṇi yamadūtāyutāni ca |
viyanti dūrato mātuḥ sevayāśīrbhireva hi || 37||
itiputravacaḥ śrutvā vinatā bhaktabālakam |
provācāhaṃ purā dāsyaṃ kadrvāḥ prāptāsmi vai paṇe || 38||
aśvaḥ sūryasya dhavalo mayoktaśca tayā tataḥ |
karbura ityabhihitastatastatputrakaiḥ khalu || 3 9||
gatvāśvaścitritaḥ kṛṣṇaścāhaṃ dāsītvamāgatā |
yasmin kāle hyabhīṣṭaṃ ca tasyā dravyaṃ dadāmi cet ||1.464.40||
tadā dāsītvavigamaṃ prāpsye pṛccha tu sarpiṇīm |
garuḍo vinatāṃ natvā kadrūṃ natvā punaḥ punaḥ ||41 ||
papraccha mātṛdāsītvamokṣadaṃ kadrukāṃ hi saḥ |
kadrūḥ prāha sudhāṃ dehi bhaved dāsītvamokṣaṇam ||42||
garuḍastatsamākarṇya samāpṛcchya tu mātaram |
saṃsmṛtya śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ yayau sa kaśyapam ||43||
taṃ jagāda sudhārthaṃ svayātrāṃ taṃ prāha kaśyapaḥ |
svargalokasya vai cordhvaṃ nidhānaṃ devabhojanam ||44||
amṛtaṃ vartate devabhṛtyaiścakreṇa rakṣitam |
gaccha śīghraṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ smṛtvā jayo bhavet ||45||
jagāmākāśamāviśya garuḍaḥ pitṛvākyataḥ |
yatrāmṛtanidhānaṃ taddṛṣṭvā mumoda bhaktarāṭ ||46||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ smṛtvā kośādhyakṣān dadarśa saḥ |
pakṣavātena tānsarvān vidhūya sarvaśo balī ||47||
dadarśa kartarīyantramamṛtopari saṃsthitam |
bhramamāṇaṃ bahuvegāt sudarśanasamaṃ mahat ||48||
api spṛśantaṃ kamapi bhedayatyeva khaṇḍaśaḥ |
kṣaṇaṃ vicārya garuḍaḥ sūkṣmāṇutvamupāgataḥ ||49||
yadyahaṃ mātṛbhakto’smi kṛṣṇanārāyaṇānugaḥ |
tadā me rakṣaṇaṃ tvatra karotu bhagavān svayam ||1.464.50||
jaritau pitarau yasya bālāpatyaśca nirdhanaḥ |
sādhvī bhāryā ca tatpuṣṭyai doṣo’kṛtye’pi tasya na ||51 ||
māturviprasya bālasya goḥ patnyāśca gurorapi |
jīvadānasya hetvarthe tvakṛtye nāsti dūṣaṇam ||52||
evaṃ kṛtvā tu cakrasya hyadhobhāgasthitāṃ sudhām |
vilokya kalaśe bhṛtvā pītvāpi mṛtyunāśinīm ||53||
tataścakraṃ yogabalāt picchenotpāṭya kīlakāt |
bhramihīnaṃ mandavegaṃ sthiraṃ kṛtvā tu yāvatā ||54||
sudhākuṃbhena sahitaḥ samudgacchati tāvatā |
rakṣakāstaṃ vilokyaiva dudruvuḥ pāśahastakāḥ ||55||
pakṣavātena tān sarvān mūrchayitvātivegataḥ |
bahiryāto nidhestasmāt tāvatsureśvarādayaḥ ||56||
dūtasmṛtāstatra tūrṇaṃ yuddhāya tvāyayūḥ ruṣā |
mahendrastaṃ sahetirvai prāha kastvaṃ sudhāharaḥ ||17||
tiṣṭha tiṣṭha mahābāho vajreṇa sūdayāmi vai |
śrutvā vākyaṃ harestatra cukopa garuḍastadā ||58||
parākramaṃ darśayasva nayāmi garuḍo’mṛtam |
ityuktaścendra evainaṃ vajreṇa prajaghāna ha ||59||
kuliśasyātipātepi na vai kṣubdho mahābalaḥ|
svaṃ moghaṃ kuliśaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhītaścendrastamāha yat ||1.464.6 0 ||
yadi dāsyasi pīyūṣamidānīṃ nāgamātari |
bhujaṃgāstvamarāḥ sarve kriyante tu tvayā khaga ||6 1 ||
pratijñā te bhavennaṣṭā bhojanaṃ te na vai bhavet |
tasmānmā tāṃ sudhāṃ dehi kadrūṃ kuru na cāmṛtām ||62||
itiśrutvāha garuḍo nayāmi surarāṭ sudhām |
dāsye kadrūṃ ca mātā me syādadāsī tataḥ param ||63 ||
śīghraṃ tvayā prahartavyā sudhā na pānatāṃ vajret |
tathāstviti hariḥ prāha yayau kadrūṃ ca pakṣirāṭ ||64||
datvā dāsyaṃ vinirdhūya mātuḥ sa nirṛṇo’bhavat |
atha sarpāṃśca kadrūṃ ca prāha vai pakṣirāṭ svayam ||65||
aśuddhau nahi pātavyā sudhā tvaśuddhatāṃ vrajet |
rasasāmarthyahīnā syāt snātvātaśca pibantu tām ||66||
ityuktāste yayuḥ snātuṃ śakro jahāra tāṃ sudhām |
āgatya bhujagairnaiva dṛṣṭaṃ tvamṛtabhājanam ||67||
kuśastambe yatra pātraṃ sthāpitaṃ tvāsīdeva tat |
paryalihaṃstatasteṣāṃ jihvāḥ kuśairdvidhābhavan |||68||
tadā tu cukruśuḥ sarpāstvamṛtārthaṃ samulbaṇāḥ |
indreṇa tu tadā tvanyaḥ kalaśaḥ kṛtrimaḥ kṛtaḥ ||6 9||
yatra viṣaṃ sudhāraṃgaṃ pracchannaṃ nihitaṃ kṛtam |
tadādāya papuḥ sarve bindumātraṃ vibhāgaśaḥ || 1.464.70 ||
tānuvāca prasūḥ putrān yuṣmanmukhe sadā sutāḥ |
bindavaḥ khalu tiṣṭhantu no lopaḥ syāt kadācana ||71 ||
ityāśīrvādamāptāste sarpā yayunijaṃ gṛham |
hṛṣṭāstvamṛtabhrāntyā te nāgāḥ pramuditāstvatha || 72||
tām̐stān garuḍaḥ kṣudhitaścakhāda balavām̐stataḥ |
palāyitāstu te nāgā parvatādiṣvavasthitāḥ ||73 ||
evaṃ sa garuḍaḥ svasya mātaraṃ kiṃkarīpadāt |
mocayitvā gṛhītvā ca pitrorāśīrvacāṃsi saḥ ||74 ||
yayau vaikuṇṭhalokaṃ saṃvāhātmako harerabhūt |
harerdāsyaṃ sadā prāpto viṣṇuvatpūjyatāṃ gataḥ ||75||
yanmātā vinatā cāpi bhaktaputraprasūryataḥ |
kaśyapasya sadā mānyā hyabhavat satyasaṃsthitā ||76 ||
amṛtādāḥ sutāścāsan vinatāyāḥ satīstriyāḥ |
śaṭhāyā viṣavaktrāyāḥ kadrvāstvāsan sutāḥ śaṭhāḥ ||77||
tasmāllakṣmi sadā pālyaṃ pātivratyaṃ harau mayi |
svapratāpena teṣāṃ vai dūrayāmi durantakam ||78||
pitṛbhaktirmātṛbhaktirgurorbhaktiśca tāriṇī |
patibhaktiḥ putrabhaktiḥ satībhaktiḥ sutāriṇī ||79||
bhṛtyabhaktirdevabhaktirbhāryābhaktiśca tāriṇī |
sādhubhaktiḥ kṛṣṇabhaktirmokṣadā mama dhāmani ||1.464.8 0 ||
sarvadehiṣvahaṃ tvasmi tvayā śaktyā saha dhruvaḥ |
iti matvā mama bhaktiṃ kuryād dehiṣu dehibhiḥ ||8 1 ||
samarpayet kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ mayyeva tvāntarasthite |
matprasādātmakaṃ matvā bhakto bhuñjīta nānyathā |||82||
nāryāṃ nare paśau vṛkṣe vallyā jaḍe ca cetane |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo bhoktā bhogyaṃ ca sarvameva saḥ ||83 ||
iti matvā tu yo dehī bhuṃkte yat taddhi nirguṇam |
pātivratyamidaṃ proktaṃ mayi sarvātmanā mayā ||84||
evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ dehi mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ |
paṭhanācchravaṇāt tvasya pātivratyaphalaṃ labhet ||85||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne kadrūvinatayoḥ sūryāśvasya karburatvaṃ śvaityaṃ veti paṇe kadrūśāṭhyena vinatāyā dāsītvasya garuḍena pramārjanaṃ kṛtamityādinirūpaṇanāmā catuḥṣaṣṭyadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 464 ||

<1.465>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi mahāsādhvīṃ līlāvatīṃ patipriyām |
kāśīrājadivodāsagṛhiṇīṃ saṃśitavratām || 1 ||
divodāso’bhavat kṛṣṇapārṣado dhāmavāsakṛt |
bhaktipravartanāyātra bhuvi kṛṣṇanideśataḥ || 2 ||
mānuṣastvabhavadrājā mahābhāgavataḥ priye |
tasya bhaktiḥ sadā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe tu nirmalā || 2 ||
āsīnniṣkāmarūpā vai kṛṣṇaprasannatāpradā |
līlāvatī hareḥ patnī dāsī golokavāsinī || 4 ||
sakhī lakṣmyāḥ sadā pārśvavartinī kṛṣṇakāminī |
kṛṣṇājñayā satī sādhvī surāṣṭreśasutābhavat || 5 ||
tasyā janmani devendrāḥ ṛṣayo munayaḥ striyaḥ |
devyo gandharvavidyādhrā īśāśca manavastathā || 6 ||
āyayustadgṛhe tvāśīrvādān daduḥ śubhāvahān |
puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ tadā cakrurdevā jaguśca yoṣitaḥ || 7 ||
nanṛtuścāpsarasastu mahotsavaḥ śubho’bhavat |
jātamātrātha sā kanyā caturbhujā kṣaṇaṃ śubhā || 8 ||
adṛśyata varārohā sundarī kamalā yathā |
kṣaṇāntare’bhavat kanyā jātā sūtakaśāyinī || 9 ||
atha yogye vayasyasyā vivāhaṃ tvakaronnṛpaḥ |
pṛthivījinmahārājastadā vai viṣṇupārṣadāḥ || 1.465.1 0||
kāśīsthāstu śaṃkarasya sarve koṭigaṇādayaḥ |
samājagmurvivāhe’syā līlāvatyā samantataḥ || 11 ||
āśīrvādān daduste ca devā devyo’tiharṣitāḥ |
kāśīṃ yayau vimānena divodāsayutā satī || 12||
tadā devaiḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ kṛtā vimānamastake |
dampatī vardhayāmāsuḥ śaṃkarādyāśca vaiṣṇavāḥ || 1 3|||
dampatyoścābhavatputraḥ samaraṃjayasaṃjñakaḥ |
tataḥ pañcaśataṃ tvāsītputrāṇāṃ dharmavartinām || 14||
divodāso’pi rājendraḥ kumāraṃ samaraṃjayam |
abhiṣicya mahābuddhiryayau digvijayāya saḥ || 15|||
mahāsatīṃ rathe nītvā līlāvatīṃ pativratām |
dākṣiṇātyānnṛpān jigye līlāvatyāḥ prabhāvataḥ || 16||
prāgjyotiṣāṃ nṛpān jigye himaparvatabhūbhṛtaḥ |
uttarasthānpaścimasthān jitvā kāśīmagāddhi saḥ || 17||
prāsādaṃ kārayāmāsa svardhūnyāḥ paścime taṭe |
ripūn pramathya samare yāvatī śrīrupārjitā || 18||
tāvatyā saha bhūpālo devālayānakārayat |
bhūpālalakṣmīrakhilā yattatra viniyojitā || 1 9||
tanmadhye śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇārcā sthāpitā śubhā |
śaṃbhuśca sthāpitaḥ pārśve brahmā pārśvāntare’pi ca ||1.465.20 ||
anye devāḥ sthāpitāśca rājñā satīpratuṣṭaye |
līlāvatī mahālakṣmīmandiraṃ cāpyacīklṛpat ||21 ||
līlāvatyāścamatkāraṃ kathayāmi śṛṇu priye |
līlāvatī prage snātvā karoti devapūjanam ||22||
patyuśca pūjanaṃ nityaṃ karotyeva vidhānataḥ |
ekadā cintayāmāsa prathamaṃ kasya pūjanam || 23 ||
kartavyaṃ yoṣitā pativratayā prātareva tu |
itisaṃśayamāpannā sasmāra kamaleśvaram || 24||
lakṣmīpatiḥ saha lakṣmyā prāyayau prasamujjvalaḥ |
satkṛto vandito devyā pūjitaḥ pṛṣṭa ityapi || 25||
kasya vai pūjanaṃ pūrvaṃ mayā kāryaṃ kṛpānidhe |
bhagavān śrīpreritaśca prāha tūrṇaṃ pativratām ||26 ||
pātivratyaṃ paro dharmaḥ patyuḥ pūjā viśiṣyate |
patirdvedhā śarīrasya cātmanaśceti sundari || 27||
ubhayasya patiḥ śreṣṭhaḥ pūjyaḥ pūrvaṃ tvayā sati |
līlāvatī prasannābhūt parīkṣāmakarot tataḥ ||28||
śarīrasya patiḥ ko’sti cātmanaśca patirhi kaḥ |
ubhayasya patiḥ ko vai tadākarṇaya padmaje ||29||
patirdhātuḥ śarīrasya śarīraṃ pāti rakṣati |
dhātukṣaye kṣayastasya tadrakṣaṇaṃ pativratam ||1.465.3 0||
brahmacaryavrataṃ pativrataṃ narasya yoṣitāḥ |
anena brahmaśīlena pātivratyena padmaje ||3 1 ||
brahmalokātparaṃ lokaṃ yānti śīlavratāḥ prajāḥ |
saṃnyāsināṃ yatīnāṃ ca tyāgināṃ brahmacāriṇām ||32||
kanyakānāṃ ca bālānāṃ vṛddhānāṃ narayoṣitām |
yūnāṃ cāpi dhāturakṣā dampatīnāṃ vrataṃ tathā ||33||
niyamena yathā rakṣā yathāpatyajanirbhavet |
vyarthavyayo yathā naiva pātivratyaṃ tu tat sadā ||34||
mokṣadaṃ vaṃśadaṃ svargapradaṃ dehe’pi puṣṭikṛt |
pātivratyaṃ vrataṃ jñeyaṃ dvitīyaṃ cāpi tacchṛṇu ||35||
dehaṃ pāti sadā puṣṭyā yadannaṃ tatpatirbhavet |
annād bhūtāni jāyante jīvantyabhiviśanti tat ||36||
annaṃ brahma vijānīyādupāsyaṃ pañcayajñakaiḥ | bha
saṃvibhajya pradātavyaṃ cāttavyaṃ ca tataḥ param ||37||
yā nindyādannamevātra devāya prāk samarpayet |
ṛṣibhyaḥ pitṛbhyaścātha gobhyo bhṛtyebhya ityataḥ ||38||
pataye svāmine cāpi tṛptidaṃ brahma cārpayet |
annaṃ patirvrataṃ tasya pātivratyaṃ sadāvratam ||39||
pātivratyaṃ tvannasatraṃ svargo mokṣaśca tena vai |
anne’pi bhakṣate lakṣmi yadi prāṇo na tiṣṭhati ||1.465.40||
tadā śavo bhaved dehastasmāt prāṇastṛtīyakaḥ |
patirūpaḥ sadā proktaḥ prāṇavrataṃ samācaret ||41 ||
vṛddhānāṃ cāpi pūjyānāmāgame svagṛhe sati |
utthātavyaṃ samīpe ca gantavyaṃ tānnamettathā ||42||
anutthāne svayaṃ prāṇaḥ samuttiṣṭhanti vai valāt |
āyuḥkṣayastathā syācca tasmātprāṇān surakṣayet ||43||
vṛddhānāṃ yat sadā mānaṃ prāṇavrataṃ tu tatsmṛtam |
pātivratyaṃ hi patyarthe tatprāṇavratamācaret ||44||
śvaśrūśvaśurayoḥ pitroḥ svāminaśca tapasvinaḥ |
viduṣāṃ tyāgināṃ śreṣṭhajanānāṃ ca guroḥ striyāḥ ||45||
rājñāṃ devasya sādhvīnāṃ guṇināṃ nāvamānanam |
prāṇavrataṃ hi tatproktaṃ pātivratyaṃ mahattaram ||46||
pālayet tat sadā sādhvī svargo mokṣaśca tatkare |
caturthaṃ tu śṛṇu lakṣmi mānasaṃ hṛdayaṃ sadā ||47||
vāsanākoṭi vikṣiptaṃ kāmakrodhādisaṃbhṛtam |
rāgadveṣabhṛtaṃ nityaṃ lobhamohādyadhiśritam ||48||
sāttvikaṃ cenmanastadvai pāti rakṣati dehinam |
sthāne syāścenmanastasya yaśaḥ sarvatra jāyate ||49|||
vicittaṃ cenmanastasya pramattasya kṣayo bhavet| |
mano vājī sumārgasthaḥ svargaṃ mokṣaṃ dadāti ca ||1.465.50 ||
sa eva rakṣaṇakartā patiḥ prokto’tra koṭare |
manastasmānnigṛhītaṃ patirūpaṃ prarakṣati || 51 ||
tadvrataṃ vai pātivratyaṃ rāgadveṣādivarjanam |
māyāyā vāsanāyāśca mithyākāmasya varjanam ||52||
pātivratyaṃ caturthaṃ tanmano brahmasamarcanam |
mano brahma vijānīyādupāsīta manovratam ||53 ||
pañcamaṃ tu śṛṇu lakṣmi jñānaṃ rakṣati dehinam |
dehasya rakṣaṇaṃ jñānaṃ vijñānaṃ dharmarakṣakam ||54||
arthakāmapradaṃ jñānaṃ vijñānaṃ cātmabodhakam |
vijñānaṃ rakṣakaṃ pāti rakṣatyeva śucaḥsthale |||55||
yāvaddehavatāṃ pātā vijñānaṃ patireva saḥ |
vijñāne naiva rakṣanti tvātmānaṃ prāṇinaḥ priye ||56 ||
tasmāt patiḥ suvijñānaṃ bālake’pi stanandhaye |
rakṣyaṃ jñānavrataṃ pātivratyaṃ kathāprasaṃgataḥ ||57||
kṛṣṇakathāmṛtāsvādagrahaṇaṃ tatpativratam |
patirdevaḥ patiḥ kṛṣṇaḥ patirjñānaṃ tu śārṅgiṇaḥ ||58||
ārādhanā sadā kāryā devopāstisamanvitā |
pātivratyaṃ vrataṃ taddhi svargamokṣapradaṃ param ||59||
śṛṇu lakṣmi tathā ṣaṣṭhaṃ vrataṃ tvānandasaṃjñakam |
sarve sadā mahāvijñāḥ svalpajñāśca tṛṇādayaḥ ||1.465.60 ||
abhilaṣanti cānandaṃ sukhaṃ snehaṃ pramodanam |
utsavaṃ ca samutsāhaṃ tena jīvanti jantavaḥ ||6 1 ||
ānandena tu bhūtāni prajāyante’pi tena te |
jīvantyapi tathā mṛtyuṃ yāntyānandārthameva ca ||62||
tasmātpāti sadānando jīvān rakṣati vai patiḥ |
ānandaḥ sa parabrahma vijānīyāt patiṃ param ||63||
ānande tu sadā muktāstiṣṭhanti yogino’pi ca |
ānandaṃ tatparabrahma patiḥ pativrataṃ tu tat ||64||
pātivratyaṃ mahālakṣmi jñātvā tvetat samācaret| |
dehasyaite patayo vai kkacidātmani vai manāka ||65||
pañcabhūtātmake dehe kāntātmake ca te sadā |
tiṣṭhantyeva striyāścāpi pātivratyaṃ nijaṃ nijam ||66||
svāminastu tathā patnyāṃ tiṣṭhantyete nije’pi ca |
etad vijñāya vai dharmasvarūpaṃ vratamācaret ||67||
athātmanaḥ śṛṇu lakṣmi pātivratyaṃ vadāmi te |
śravaṇaṃ kīrtanaṃ kṛṣṇasmaraṇaṃ kṛṣṇasevanam ||68||
arcanaṃ vandanaṃ dāsyaṃ sakhyamātmanivedanam |
viśvāso varaṇaṃ nyāsaḥ kārpaṇyaṃ niścalapradhīḥ ||69||
ānukūlyaṃ sadā kṛṣṇe paramātmani mādhave |
sa eva rakṣitā pātānandayitāvitā hariḥ ||1.465.70||
tadvrataṃ sarvathā tvātmārpaṇaṃ sarvārpaṇātmakam |
naitādṛśaṃ vrataṃ kiñcit svargadaṃ mokṣadaṃ ca vā ||71 ||
svargadaṃ sarvakṛccāpi yatra śeṣaṃ na vidyate |
yatra nāsti kṣatiḥ kācid yatra bandho na vidyate ||72||
yatra nāsti vyayaḥ kaścidalābho nāsti vai priye |
etatpativrataṃ kṛtvāsaṃkhyātmāno divaṃ gatāḥ ||73||
yānti yāsyanti vai tvanye narā nāryastathetarāḥ |
ātmā brahma patiḥ so’yaṃ parabrahmavratānvitaḥ ||74||
śāśvatavratavām̐ścāya pātivratyaparāyaṇaḥ |
ityuktāni sati tubhyaṃ pātivratyāni sarvathā ||75||
līlāvatyai mayoktāni śrutvā sāścaryagarvitā |
kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā viditvaiva kānte vivāhite nije ||76||
dvedhā cakre pātivratyaṃ divodāse satī sadā |
brahmacaryaṃ divodāse prathamaṃ sā pativratam ||77||
annārpaṇaṃ divodāse dvitīyāṃ sā pativratam |
prāṇārpaṇaṃ divodāse tṛtīyaṃ sā pativratam ||78||
mano’rpaṇaṃ divodāse caturthaṃ sā pativratam |
jñānamātraṃ divodāse pañcamaṃ sā pativratam ||79||
ānandaṃ ca divodāse ṣaṣṭhaṃ cāpi pativratam |
pālayitvā satī līlāvatī patimapūjayat ||1.465.80||
dehasya pātivratyaṃ vai divodāse tadātmani |
ātmasthe śrīharau svasyātmanaścāpi pativratam ||81 ||
pālayāmāsa sā sādhvī pūjayāmāsa taṃ patim |
svāmine sārpayāmāsopacārān ṣoḍaśāpi hi ||82||
ātmane cārpayāmāsa svātmānaṃ līnabhāvataḥ |
ātmātmani sthitāyāntaryāmiṇe sarvameva sā ||83||
arpayāmāsa bhāvena dadarśa tatra taṃ harim |
divodāse divyarūpaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ parameśvaram ||84||
patyau patiṃ paraṃ dṛṣṭvā pramumoda satī tadā |
sākṣāt kṛṣṇasvarūpaṃ svasvāminyapaśyadañjasā ||85||
bhautikena tu netreṇa divodāsaṃ dadarśa sā |
divyenāntaranetreṇa śrīkṛṣṇaṃ taṃ dadarśa sā ||86 ||
evaṃ prāpya parāṃ divyāṃ dṛṣṭiṃ līlāvatī sadā |
pātivratyena dharmeṇa yogaṃ siddhiṃ ca śāśvatīm ||87||
yogināmapyalabhyāṃ saṃprāpat kṛṣṇaprasādataḥ |
ante’kṣaraṃ padaṃ lebhe tenaiva divyavarṣmaṇā ||88||
sārdhaṃ svasvāminā vaṃśenāpi satprajayā tathā |
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi divyaṃ pativrataṃ śubham ||89||
sarvā ātmanivedinyastathā kṛtvākṣaraṃ padam |
prāpnuvanti na sandehaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ patim || 1.465.90 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne kāśīnṛpatidivodāsapatnyā līlāvatyā anekavidhadivyapātivratyacamatkāreṇa śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇapadadāsyaprāptyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcaṣaṣṭyadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 465 ||

<1.466>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi dharmapatnyāḥ pātivratyaparāyaṇām |
kathāṃ kāśīpaṃcagaṃgātīrthakarīṃ supāvanīm || 1 ||
kāśyāṃ pañcanadaṃ tīrthamadhyāsa bhagavān svayam |
bhurbhuvaḥsvaḥpradeśeṣu tīrthaṃ pañcanadaṃ param || 2 ||
sthitaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ svayaṃ tatra tīrthe pañcanade pare |
purā vedaśirā nāma mahāsaṃyamatāpasaḥ || 3 ||
bhṛguvaṃśamunirāsīt tapasyānirataḥ sadā |
yuvānaṃ taṃ samālokya śucināmnyapsarovarā || 4 ||
cakame tena ṛṣiṇā skhalitaṃ sā papau śuciḥ |
śuciṃ vedaśirāḥ prāha dhārmikaṃ doṣavarjitam || 5 ||
śṛṇu sādhvi yauvanasya vikṛtiḥ sarvadehiṣu |
jāyate sā na doṣāya kāmavarjitadehinaḥ || 6 ||
svābhāvikaṃ nirmanastvaṃ dhātūnāṃ skhalanaṃ sati |
tapobhaṃgāya naivāsti snānena śuddhiriṣyate || 7 ||
kintu te manasi tvasti bhāvanā bījalabdhaye |
tena dhātuḥ sravito me vinā maithunasaṃcarāt || 8 ||
tasmād dhāraya garbhe tva yaṃ tvaṃ pītavatī priye |
devapatnī yatheṣṭaṃ vai kartuṃ śaknoti sarvathā || 9 ||
amoghabījā munayo mama bījāttava priye |
kanyāratnaṃ vaiṣṇavāgryaṃ bhaviṣyati pativratam || 1.466.1 0||
ityuktā sāśrame tasya tasthau prasavavāñchayā |
atha kālena divyastrīkanyāratnamajījanat || 11 ||
atīva bhāsuraṃ netrānandadaṃ rūpaśevadhim |
datvā putrīṃ yayau svargaṃ śucināmnyapsarovarā || 1 2||
tāṃ tu vedaśirā kanyāṃ snehena samavardhayat |
hariṇyāḥ svāśramasthāyāḥ stanyena payasā muniḥ || 1 3||
munirnāma dadau tasyā dhūtapāpeti sārthakam |
daśavarṣottarāṃ kanyāṃ dṛṣṭvā papraccha tāṃ muniḥ || 14||
kasmai dadyāṃ varāya tvāṃ tvamevāsyāhi ye śubhe |
śrutvā pituḥ śubhaṃ vākyaṃ provāca bhaktimānasā || 15||
sarvebhyo’tipavitro yo yaḥ sarveṣāṃ namaskṛtaḥ |
sarve yamabhilaṣyanti yasmāt sarvasukhodayaḥ || 16||
kadācidyo na naśyedvai yaḥ sadaivānuvartate |
ihāmutrāpi yo rakṣenmahāpadbhyaḥ svarūpavān || 17||
sarve manorathā yasmāt prapūrṇāḥ saṃbhavanti me |
dine dine’tisaubhāgyaṃ vardhate yasya sevayā || 18||
nairantaryeṇa yatpārśve bhaya kasyāpi naiva me |
yannāmagrahaṇāccāpi bādhā līyanta utkaṭāḥ || 1 9||
yadādhāreṇa tiṣṭhanti brahmāṇḍānyapi sṛṣṭiṣu |
evamādyā guṇā yatra tasmai māṃ dehi śarmaṇe ||1.466.20||
etacchrutvā muniścātiprasanno mudamāpa ha |
dhanyo’smi yadgṛhe putrī dhārmikī kulatāriṇī ||21 ||
dhūtapāpā sārthanāmnī dhanyeyaṃ jñānaśevadhiḥ |
anayā varṇitaḥ ko’tra bhavedvai sadguṇodayaḥ ||22||
varaṃ taṃ dharmadevākhyaṃ manye tasmai dadāmi tām |
paraṃ sa sukhalabhyo na sarvasadguṇamaṇḍanaḥ ||23||
tapaḥpaṇena sa krayyo bahupuṇyena vā kvacit |
vicāryetthaṃ sutāṃ prāha kanye varo’sti tādṛśaḥ ||24||
nārthabhāraiḥ sa sulabho na kaulīnyena kanyake |
na caiśvaryabalenāpi na buddhyā na parākramaiḥ ||25||
manaḥśuddhyendriyaśuddhyā tapasā damanena ca |
labhyate sa mahāprājño nānyathā sadṛśaḥ patiḥ ||26||
itipitṛvacaḥ śrutvā pitaraṃ praṇipatya ca |
anujñāṃ tu piturlabdhvā tepe tapaḥ sudāruṇam ||27||
kaṭhoraṃ varṣma saṃsādhya varṣādhārāsu sā sthitā |
śilāsu himavāteṣu na cakampe manāgapi ||28||
pañcāgnīn paridhāyāpi tapasyati tapovane |
jalābhilāṣiṇī bālā jalaṃ naivāpibat tadā ||29||
apāstabhogasaṃparkā vāyvāhārābhavat satī |
kṛśātitapasā kṣāmā didīpe tattanustarām ||1.466.3 0||
brahmā tvāgatya tāmāha prasanno’smi varaṃ vṛṇu |
dhūtapāpā namaskṛtyovāca śrīparameṣṭhinam ||3 1 ||
pitāmaha pavitrebhyaḥ kuru māmatipāvanīm |
tuṣṭo brahmā ca tāmāha saṃpavitrāṇi yāni vai ||32||
tebhyo’dhikaṃ supāvitryamedhimadvaradānataḥ |
tisraḥ koṭyo’rdhakoṭi ca santi tīrthāni kanyake ||33 ||
aṣṭaṣaṣṭipradhānāni śreṣṭhāni teṣu santi ca |
tāni sarvāṇi tīrthāni tvattanau pratiloma vai || 34||
vasantu mama vākyena bhava sarvātipāvanī |
kalpāntare tu mūrtistvaṃ bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ || 356||
dharmadevapriyā patnī harermātā tu dakṣajā |
ityuktvāntardadhe brahmā yayau sāpi piturgṛham ||36||
jñātvā vedaśirā sarvaṃ tutoṣa tapasā muhuḥ |
sāpi nityaṃ dharmamūrtiṃ saṃvidhāya caturbhujām ||37||
ṣoḍaśavastubhirdivyāṃ prātarnityamapūjayat |
pātivratyena dharmeṇa sarvaṃ vṛṣāya cārpayat || 38||
svapne dharmaṃ dhūtapāpā dadarśa nityameva sā |
kadācid dharmadevaḥ saḥ sākṣādāgatya taṃ munim || 39 ||
yayāce kanyakāṃ yogyāṃ munistasmai dadau tataḥ |
kanyā candrasamā kāntimatī dharmaṃ prasevate || 1.466.40||
atha tatra mahākṣetre dhūtapāpā mahāsatī |
adṛśyena svarūpeṇa dharmagṛhe virājate ||41 ||
dvitīyena svarūpeṇa candrakāntamaṇiḥ svayam |
bhūtvā jale tu gaṃgāyā rājate sā tapasvinī |||42||
dharmadevo’pi tu dharmanado bhūtvā jalāntare |
candrakāntaśilāyukto rājate vai divāniśam || 43||
dharmasya mandire divyasvarūpeṇāpi rājate |
evaṃ kāśyāṃ tu gaṃgāyāṃ dharmo dharmanado’bhavat || 44||
dhūtapāpābhavat svalpā nadī cāpi nadānvitā |
atha sūryaḥ samāgatya tapa ugraṃ cacāra ha ||45||
kiraṇebhyaḥ pravavṛte mahāsvedajasantatiḥ |
tataḥ sā kiraṇā nāma nadī jātātipāvanī ||46||
atha tatra samāyātā sarasvatī mahāsatī |
yamunā gaṃgayā yuktā tatra tiṣṭhati pāvanī ||47||
kiraṇā dhūtapāpā ca yamī gaṃgā sarasvatī |
pañcanadyo mahāsatyo nado dharmanadāhvayaḥ ||48||
militāḥ sarva evaitāstīrthaṃ pañcanadātmakam |
pañcagaṃgetināmnā vai prasiddhaṃ sarvathābhavat ||49||
tatra snātvā jalaṃ pītvā mucyate sarvabandhanāt |
datvā pañcanade dānaṃ kṛtvā vai pitṛtarpaṇam ||1.466.50||
bindumādhavamabhyarcya na bhūyo janmabhāg bhavet |
pañcakūrcena pītena yā tu śuddhirudāhṛtā ||51 ||
sā śuddhiḥ śraddhayā prāśya binduṃ pāñcanadāmbhasaḥ |
purā dharmanadaṃ nāma tataśca dhūtapāpakam ||52||
tato vai bindutīrthaṃ tat tataḥ pañcanadāhvayam |
gobhūtilahiraṇyāśvavāso’nnasragvibhūṣaṇam ||53||
yatkiṃcid bindutīrthe’tra dattvākṣayamavāpnuyāt |
tatrāgatya vahnibindustapastepe’tidāruṇam |||54||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sākṣādāgatyāha varaṃ vṛṇu |
agnibindurhariṃ prāha vasātra mama sannidhau ||55||
tathāstviti hariḥ prāha nivāsaṃ cākaronmudā |
bindumādhavasaṃjño’haṃ vasāmi tatra padmaje ||56||
dharmadevagṛhe putro bindumādhavasaṃjñakaḥ |
nityaṃ vasāmi divyo’haṃ dhūtapāpāsuputrakaḥ |||57||
dhūtapāpā jananī me pitā dharmo mama priye |
ahaṃ mādhavarūpaśca vasāmo bindutīrthake ||58||
vasusvarūpiṇī lakṣmīlakṣmīrnirvāṇasaṃjñikā |
dharmapārśve sthitā sā me hṛdi pañcanade’pyaham ||59||
vrataiḥ saṃśodhite dehe dharmo vasati nityaśaḥ |
kṛṣṇaścāpi dhūtapāpā śrīśca vasanti sarvathā ||1.466.6 0||
arthakāmau sanirvāṇau tatra vasataḥ sarvadā |
ādimādhavanāmāhaṃ tataścānantamādhavaḥ ||61 ||
śrīdamādhavasaṃjño’pi tato vai bindumādhavaḥ |
evaṃ nāmabhiḥ sarveśaḥ sthāsyāmyānandakānane ||62||
mama mātā dharmapatnī dhūtapāpā pativratā |
śrīdharmaṃ sevate nityaṃ pātivratyaparāyaṇā ||63||
pañcanade mahāpuṇye divye śrīdharmamandire |
narā nāryaśca tatkṣetre snātvā kṛtvā vṛṣārcanam ||64||
dhūtapāpārcanaṃ kṛtvā mādhavasya mamārcanam |
dharmapratijñāṃ kṛtvā ca cāturmāsyavratādikam ||65||
kṛtvā kārtikadānādi vratī mokṣamavāpnuyāt| |
dharmapatnyastathā tatra vasanti dharmasevane ||66||
dvitīyena svarūpeṇa sarvā viśvasya mātaraḥ |
śraddhālakṣmīrdhṛtistuṣṭiḥ puṣṭirmedhā kriyā tathā ||67||
buddhirlajjā vapuḥ śāntiḥ siddhiḥ kīrtistrayodaśa |
tāśca sarvā dharmasevāṃ kurvantyeva saha sthitā ||68 ||
pātivratyaparāḥ sarvā yatra dharmastu tatra tāḥ |
dhūtapāpā viśeṣeṇa sevate śrīvṛṣaṃ patim ||69||
prātaḥ snātvā tu sā devī prātaḥ snāpayati vṛṣam |
vastrālaṃkārakastūrīcandanākṣatakuṃkumaiḥ ||1.466.70 ||
pūjayitvā tato devī nīrājayati taṃ patim |
pradakṣiṇāṃ stutiṃ kṛtvā natvā tatpādayoḥ satī ||71 ||
gaṃgājalena dharmasya prakṣālya caraṇāvubhau |
ācamanāmṛtaṃ śuddhaṃ pītvā datvā sumāñjalim ||72||
tato dharmāya ṣaṭpañcāṣanmiṣṭānnāni bhojane |
savyañjanāni rasyādyapeyayuktāni sā priyā ||73 ||
samarpayati tāmbūlaṃ karoti dehamardanam |
nṛtyaṃ karoti dharmāgre kīrtiṃ karoti śārṅgiṇaḥ ||74||
naranārāyaṇagāthāṃ karoti dharmadeśataḥ |
sapatnīnāṃ tataḥ sevāṃ śraddhādīnāṃ karoti sā ||75||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktiṃ dharmājñayā karotyapi |
ekadā śrīdharmadevaścāturmāsyavrate sthitaḥ ||76 ||
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ pārāyaṇaṃ śubham |
vācayāmāsa satataṃ tīrthe pañcanade gṛhe ||77||
ṛṣayo munayo devāḥ pitaro mānavāḥ striyaḥ |
caturdaśabhuvāṃ saṃsthāścāyātāstatra tūtsave ||78||
nadyo nadāśca tīrthāni kṣetrāṇi vividhānyapi |
sarveṣāṃ sunivāsādi dhūtapāpā cakāra ha ||79||
dhūtapāpā satī prāha yadyahaṃ dharmacāriṇī |
dharmapatnī dharmadhartrī dharmapativratārthinī ||1.466.80 ||
tadā divyaṃ sunagaraṃ paṃcāśatkrośavistṛtam |
brahmendraśaṃbhumukhyānāṃ sampado yāstu santi vai ||8 1 ||
tato’dhikāni me saudhe khādyapeyāni santi vai |
yānavāhanabhogyāni śayyāśṛṃgārakāṇi ca ||82||
pātrāṇi rasabhojyāni dṛśyāni vividhāni ca |
vahniśuddhāṃśukādīni santu matpatisadgṛhe ||83 ||
dadhikulyā ghṛtakulyā madhukulyāḥ sitādrayaḥ |
payaḥkulyāstathā dāsā dāsyaḥ santu ca lakṣaśaḥ ||84||
itisaṃkalpitaṃ smṛtvā dharmasya caraṇāmbujam |
tāvad divyā bahuvidhāḥ smṛddhayaḥ kṣaṇato’bhavan ||85||
svarṇaratnavibhūṣāśca hīrakādyā maṇivrajāḥ |
samudbhūtā dhūtapāpāsaṃkalpāt tannadāntike ||86 ||
sudharmāsadṛśī divyā sabhā jātā kṣaṇāt priye |
durgā sarasvatī lakṣmīḥ sāvitrī rādhikā dayā ||87||
jayā lalitā māṇikyā ramā padmā ca pārvatī |
prabhā haṃsā ca manasā maṃjulā śrīśca padminī |||88||
śāntiḥ śāntā hemalatā devī muktā ca mauktikā |
āsan vai sevikā dharmagṛhe tatra kathotsave ||89||
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitākathāśravaṇakāriṇām |
svāgatādimahatkārye bhojyapeyasamarpikāḥ ||1.466.90||
kārtike ca prabodhanyāṃ kathānte pūjanaṃ param |
dharmadevasya taiḥ sarvaiḥ sarvābhiśca kṛtaṃ mahat ||91 ||
anantapuṇyadaṃ ratnasvarṇahīrakavastubhiḥ |
dharmo’pi dakṣiṇāḥ sarvā dadau tābhyo mudānvitaḥ ||92||
devebhyaḥ śrotṛvargebhyo viprebhyo’tidhanaṃ dadau |
tatra yajñe samāyātaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ ||93||
kaṃbharā ca mahālakṣmīrgopālakṛṣṇa āgatau |
vimānena tadā sarvaiḥ pratyakṣe puruṣottame ||94||
puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ kṛtā divyā jayakāro’bhavanmuhuḥ |
pitṛbhyāṃ sahitaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo mahāmakhe ||95||
daśāṃśahavanaṃ cakre dharmājñayātibhāvataḥ |
yajñaṃ samāpya vidhivat kṛtvāvabhṛthamantimam ||96||
dharmadevo dadau divyāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ ca dvijātaye |
kāśīrājo maithileśaḥ sāketeśaḥ kaliṃgarāṭ ||97||
saurāṣṭreśo marusvāmī sindhubhūpo nipālarāṭ |
kurukṣmeśaḥ śvetabhūpaḥ prāgjyotirbhūpa ārcayan ||98||
dharmadevaṃ bhūsurām̐śca sādhūn sādhvīḥ sahasraśaḥ |
svarṇahīrakarūpyāṇi dadurvastrāṇi dakṣiṇāḥ ||99||
vyasarjayat tataḥ sarvān bhojayitvā samarcya ca |
dharmadevaḥ parīhāraṃ ca svatejasā satī || 1.466.10 0||
dhūtapāpā jalaṃ haste gṛhyāsaṃkalpayan mudā |
vidyahaṃ dharmadevasya svāmino me pratuṣṭaye || 101 ||
sarvaṃ klṛptavatī tarhi patyurbhakterbalena me |
adṛśyaṃ bhavatu saudhādikaṃ smṛddhaṃ nade mayi || 1 02||
iti saṃkalpite tūrṇaṃ kṣaṇāt sarvaṃ tiro’bhavat |
jagmurāścaryamati vai devādyāḥ koṭiśo janāḥ || 1 03||
pātivratyapratāpaṃ taṃ jñātvā śaśaṃsurādarāt |
tāṃ satīṃ dhūtapāpāṃ vai devyaḥ śaśaṃsurīśvarīm || 1 04||
evaṃ pañcanadaṃ tīrthaṃ dharmadevāśramātmakam |
pāvanaṃ sarvadevānāṃ dhūtapāpāprabhāvataḥ || 1 05||
dhūtapāpāpativratabalaṃ te kathitaṃ priye |
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya muktirbhuktirbhavettathā || 1 06||
pātivratyātmako dharmo bhavedvai mokṣado dṛḍhaḥ |
sarvasampatpradaścāpi dharmabhaktipradastathā || 1 07||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vedaśirasaḥ ṛṣeḥ śucināmnyapsarasi jātāyā dhūtapāpākhyakanyāyā dharmadevapatiprāptyā mūrtidevītvaṃ, pañcanade saṃhitākathāprasaṃge pātivratyabalena paṃcāśatkrośeṣu nagararacanā, devādibhūpādimānavādīnāmāgamaḥ, yajño’vabhṛthaṃ cetyādi, nūtnanagarasmṛddhitirobhāvacamatkāraścetinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭṣaṣṭyadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 466 ||

<1.467>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi kalāvatyā vṛṣabhānostu yoṣitaḥ |
pativratāyāḥ sāmarthyaṃ pravadāmi mahottamam || 1 ||
pitṝṇāṃ mānasī kanyā kamalāṃśā kalāvatī |
sundarī vṛṣabhānasya pativrataparāyaṇā || 2 ||
yasyāstu tanayā rādhā kṛṣṇaprāṇādhikā priyā |
śrīkṛṣṇārdhāṃśasambhūtā tena tulyā ca tejasā || 3 ||
babhūvuḥ kanyakāstisraḥ pitṝṇāṃ mānasātpurā |
kalāvatī ratnadhanyā menakā ca dināntare || 4 ||
ratnadhanyā tu janakaṃ varayāmāsa bhūbhṛtam |
himācalaṃ hareraṃśaṃ varayāmāsa menakā || 5 ||
ratnadhanyāsutā sītā rāmapatnī pativratā |
menāputrī satī śaṃbhupatnī ca pārvatī tathā || 6 ||
ayonisaṃbhave cobhe pativrate rame śubhe |
kalāvatī sucandraṃ tu varayāmāsa satpatim || 7 ||
manuvaṃśīyanṛpatiṃ prāpya varṣasahasrakam |
reme rājye tato rājā saṃvirakto babhūva ha || 8 ||
jagāma tapase vindhyaśailaṃ saha svayoṣitā |
pulahāśramamāsādya tapastepe’tidāruṇam || 9 ||
mokṣākāṃkṣī nirāhāro divyavarṣasahasrakam |
samādhimāpa nṛpatirdhyātvā kṛṣṇapadāmbujam || 1.467.1 0||
tadgātravyāptavalmīkaṃ patnī dūraṃ cakāra sā |
niśceṣṭitaṃ patiṃ dṛṣṭvā prāṇāsañcāravigraham || 11 ||
māṃsaśoṇitaśūnyaṃ tamasthisaṃsaktavigraham |
śokaṃ cakāra sā rājñī sā ruroda kalāvatī || 12||
he nāthanāthetyuccārya pātivratyaparāyaṇā |
śrutvā tu rodanaṃ tasyāḥ kṛpayā sa kṛpālayaḥ || 13||
āvirbabhūva jagatāṃ pitāmaho hyajaḥ svayam |
brahmā tāṃ ca nṛpaṃ cāpi vilokya śokamāpa ha || 14||
tataḥ kamaṇḍalujalenāsicya nṛpavigraham |
jīvaṃ saṃcārayāmāsa brahmaśaktyā sa viśvasṛṭ || 15||
rājā tu purato dṛṣṭvā jagaddhātārameva tam |
praṇanāma pratuṣṭāva prasannavadanekṣaṇam || 16||

śrutvā brahmā varaṃ dātumudyatastvabhavad yadā |
kalāvatī mahāsādhvī brahmāṇamāha sādaram || 18||
yadi muktiṃ nṛpendrāya dadāsi kamalodbhava |
tato’balāyā he brahman kā gatirme vinā dhavam || 1 9||
vinā kāntaṃ tu kāntānāṃ kā śobhā vidhavātmani |
vrataṃ ta pativratāyāśca patireva śrutau matam ||1.467.20 ||
guruścābhīṣṭadevo hi tapodharmamayaḥ patiḥ |

sarvadharmāt parā brahman patisevā sudurlabhā ||22||
vrataṃ dānaṃ tapaḥ pūjā japahomādikaṃ tu yat |
svāmisevāvihīnāyāḥ sarvaṃ tanniṣphalaṃ bhavet || 23||
sarvatīrtheṣu ca snānaṃ tathā pṛthcyāḥ pradakṣiṇā |

nirvāṇatāṃ samāpnoti dharmī bhogena nāśane |
bahukālaṃ svargabhogaṃ kuruṣva svāminā saha ||5 9||
tataśca yuvayorjanma bhavitā yamunātaṭe |
yadā bhaviṣyati satī kanyā te rādhikā svayam ||1.467.60||
jīvanmuktau tayā sārdhaṃ golokaṃ saṃgamiṣyathaḥ |
sādhvī vai sattvayukteyaṃ mā māṃ śaptuṃ samarhasi ||61 ||
jīvanmuktāḥ samāḥ santaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe ratāḥ |
ityaktvā prayayau brahmā svālayaṃ yayatuśca tau ||62||
svargaṃ bhuktvā sucandraśca vṛṣabhānurbabhūva ha |
padmāvatyā hi jaṭhare surabhānasya retasā ||63||
jātismaro hareraṃśo haripādābjamānasaḥ |
nandabandhurmahāyogī vaiṣṇavaḥ paramo mahān ||64||
kalāvatī kānyakubje babhūvāyonisaṃbhavā |
jātismarā mahāsādhvī bhanandasya suputrikā ||65||
yajñakuṇḍotthitāṃ tāṃ ca labdhvā sukanakaprabhām |
mālāvatyai dadau patnyai sā pupoṣa praharṣitā ||66||
cakre kalāvatīnāma cakāra sumahotsavam |
bhavandano nṛpatistāṃ pradadau vṛṣabhānave ||67||
jātismaro hareraṃśo vṛṣabhānurupādade |
tasyāṃ kanyābhavad rādhā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapriyā ||68||
tasyā vivāho bhāṇḍīre vaṭe brahmā vyadhāpayat |
kṛṣṇena saha rādhāyāḥ sukhaṃ prāpātirādhikā ||69 ||
rādhaikadā satī kṛṣṇaṃ vṛndāvane rahasthale |
kṛṣṇajanmadine kṛṣṇaṃ snapayāmāsa sundarī ||1.467.70||
yamījalena tatraiva sasmāra svakagodhanam |
golokādāgatā gāvastasyāḥ smaraṇamātrataḥ || 7 1 ||
sunandā sumanāścāpi suśīlā surabhistathā |
kapilā paṃcamī ceti svavaṃśavistarairyutā ||72||
vātsalyadṛṣṭyā kṛṣṇasya tāsāmūdhāṃsi susruvuḥ |
vavṛṣuḥ payasāṃ pūraistadūdhāṃsi payodharāḥ ||73||
kṛṣṇaḥ saṃsnāpitastābhiḥ śṛṃgāritaśca rādhayā |
kṛṣṇena kṛtasatkārā vārāṇasīṃ yayustu tāḥ ||74||
rādhā saṃbhojayāmāsa ramayāmāsa taṃ patim |
janmotsavaṃ sukhaṃ kṛtvā yayau kṛṣṇo gṛhaṃ nijam |||75||
vārāṇasyāṃ tu tā gāvaḥ śaṃkaraṃ paramīśvaram |
dhārāsārairavicchinnardugdhānāṃ pāpanāśinām ||76 ||
snapayāmāsuratyarthaṃ tāvadyāvaddhrado’bhavat |
śaṃbhuryatrābhavat pūrvaṃ sthitaḥ snātaśca dugdhakaiḥ ||77||
āgatānāṃ gavāṃ snehāt pratijagāma yatsthale |
tatsthalaṃ tvabhat khyātaṃ kapilāhrada eva yat| ||78||
kapiladhārā tattīrthe tatra śrāddhena pāyasaiḥ |
agniṣvāttā barhiṣada ājyapāḥ sāmapāstathā ||79||
pitarastvanyajātīyā api tṛpyanti śāśvatam |
paṭhanācchravaṇāllakṣmi mokṣadaṃ kathitaṃ tava ||1.467.80||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne rādhikāmātuḥ kalāvatyā vṛṣabhānoḥ patnyā prāgbhave sucandrapatnyāḥ kalāvatyāstasyāḥ pātivratyena patyustapasā ca dampatyorvṛṣabhānukalāvatīrūpeṇa yamunātaṭe janma, tayoḥ putrī rādhikā kṛṣṇajanmotsave godugdhaiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ snapayāmāsetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptaṣaṣṭyadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 467 ||

<1.468>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi śaṃkarasya bhaktāyāstu kathāṃ śubhām |
asacchūdrāyā nartakyā naṭyāḥ pativratātmikām || 1 ||
purā tu nartakī śaṃbhorbhaktā nāmnā kalāvatī |
brahmacaryaparā tvāsīnnṛtyanāṭyārthakovidā || 2 ||
saikadā phālgune kṛṣṇe śivarātryāṃ śivālaye |
nanarta jāgaraṃ kṛtvā jagau gītaṃ svareṇa su || 3 ||
svayaṃ pravādayāmāsa vādyānyapi nanarta ca |
patiḥ kṛṣṇaḥ patiḥ śaṃbhuḥ patirnnārāyaṇo mama || 4 ||
divyaḥ patirmayā jñāto labdho devaḥ patirmayā |
dhartā pātā rakṣitā cānandayitā harirmama || 51 ||
nānyenā svāminā tvatra prayojanaṃ mama prabho |
ityevaṃ gāyati vakti nṛtyatyapi prahṛṣyati || 6 ||
nityaṃ snāpayati śaṃbhuṃ śṛṃgārayati bhāvataḥ |
bhojayati sumiṣṭānnaṃ pāyayati payaḥ śubham || 7 ||
nīrājayati sandhyāyāṃ rātrau dhyāyati śaṃkaram |
patiṃ matvā sadā śaṃbhuṃ samarcayati sarvathā || 8 ||
evaṃ śaṃbhoḥ pātivratyaparā puṇyayutā naṭī |
kāladharmavaśaṃ yātā yadā sā bhaktanartakī || 9 ||
sutā gandharvarājasya vasubhūterbabhūva sā |
