ramyā ratnāvalīnāmnī rūpalāvaṇyaśālinī || 1.468.1 0||
kalākalāpakuśalā madhurālāpavādinī |
piturānandadā nityaṃ vasubhūteḥ suputrikā || 11 ||
sarvagāndharvakuśalā guṇaratnamahākhaniḥ |
tasyāḥ sakhītrayaṃ tvāsīccārucāturyabhājanam || 1 2||
tadapyāsīddhare pātivratyadharmānvitaṃ priye |
śaśilekhānaṅgalekhā citralekheti nāmataḥ || 1 3||
tisṛbhistābhirekatra vāgdevī pariśīlitā |
tābhyaḥ sarvāḥ kalāḥ prādāt pariprītā sarasvatī || 14||
prāpya ratnāvalī svasyā gatajanmasmṛtiṃ muhuḥ |
śaṃkarasya prajagrāha niyamaṃ paramaṃ tu sā || 15||
nityaṃ sandarśanaṃ kṛtvā kāśyāṃ kṛṣṇeśvarasya vai |
anyat kāryaṃ kariṣyāmi vakṣyāmyapi vaco mukhe || 16 ||
itthaṃ niyamavatyāsīt sā gandharvasutā satī |
tābhiḥ sakhībhiḥ sahitā nityaṃ śaṃbhuṃ prapaśyati || 17||
ekadā sā samānarca kṛṣṇeśvaraṃ tu śaṃkaram |
rañjayāmāsa taṃ bālā ramyayā gītamālayā || 18||
sakhyaḥ pradakṣiṇīkartuṃ kṛṣṇeśvaraṃ yayuryadā |
tadā ratnāvalī gītaiḥ prasannaḥ śaṃkaraḥ svayam || 1 9||
vaiṣṇavaiḥ sarvacihnaiśca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ gṛṇan |
uvāca darśanaṃ datvā varaṃ vṛṇu sukanyaka ||1.468.20 ||
kanyā prāha prabho śaṃbho bhavān brahma pravarṇyate |
tvāṃ jānāmi mahādevaṃ parātparapumuttamam ||21 ||
tvayā tvārādhanā kasya mālayā kriyate prabho |
kasyedaṃ tilakaṃ bhāle candrakaḥ kasya śaṃkaraḥ ||22||
tulasīmālikā kasyāt kaṇṭhe sandhāryate tvayā |
śaṃbhuḥ prāha hitaṃ miṣṭaṃ śrutvā kṛṣṇasmṛtipradam ||23 ||
dhanyāsi tvaṃ bhāgavatī bāle yaṃ māṃ supṛcchasi |
iṣṭadevaḥ svayaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo harirmama ||24||
tasya caraṇarekhāyāstilakaṃ dhāryate mayā |
candrakaḥ kuṃkumakṛto bhāle lakṣmyāḥ pradhāryate ||29||
tulasī bhagavatpatnī hareḥ prāsādikaṃ dalam |
tasyāḥ sandhāryate bāle mālā kṛṣṇajapārthikā ||26||
kare kaṇṭhe sadā vṛndāmālā yasya tu vidyate |
sa vai bhāgavataśreṣṭhaḥ paramo vaiṣṇavaḥ sadā ||27||
etacchratvāha sā kanyā yanmālā japyate tvayā |
sa me bhartā bhavennāthaḥ kāntaḥ patirvaro mama ||28||
varāṇāṃ śreṣṭhamenaṃ vai varaṃ dehi maheśvara |
tathāstviti haraḥ prāha prāha cātihitaṃ tataḥ ||29||
adya rātrau svayaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ raṃsyate tu tvayā saha |
tava bhāvaprasannaḥ saḥ tava bhartā bhaviṣyati ||1.468.3 0||
imāḥ sakhyaḥ kṛṣṇadāsyo bhaviṣyanti tvayā saha |
varaṃ labdhvā tu tāḥ sarvā yayurgṛhaṃ tataḥ param ||3 1 ||
prāhuḥ sakhyastu tāṃ ratnāvalīṃ vihasya vai śṛṇu |
yadyāyāti sa te rātrāvadya kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ || 32||
cauro bāhulatāpāśaiḥ pāśitavyo’tiyatnataḥ |
gocarīkriyate’smābhiryathā sa rādhikāpatiḥ ||33||
aho bhāgyodayaste’dya mahānpuṇyodayastava |
ekasyāste’bhavat siddhistvayā sākaṃ ca naḥ khalu || 34||
iti saṃvyāharantyastā ninyū rātriṃ yathātatham |
atha prātaḥ samutthāya punarekatra saṃgatāḥ ||35 ||
prātaḥ kalāvatī snātvā pūjayitvā haraṃ tataḥ |
nirbandhena vayasyābhiḥ paripṛṣṭā jagāda ha ||36||
guroḥ kṛpāstathā tvāśīrvādāḥ phalanti vai dhruvam |
guroḥ sevā tapaḥ śīghraṃ dadātyeva paraṃ sukham ||37||
adya kṛṣṇaṃ hṛdi kṛtvāviśaṃ śayyāṃ hi satvaram |
nidrādhiṣṭhitanayanā tadvilokanalālasā ||38|||
kṣaṇāt svapnadaśāṃ prāptā bhāvino’rthasya gauravāt |
ātmavismaraṇe hetū tato me dvau babhūvatuḥ || 39||
tandro kṛṣṇāṃgasaṃsparśau mama bodhāpahārakau |
tandryāṃ paravaśā tvāsaṃ tatastatsparśanena ca ||1.468.40||
ānandaśevadhau magnā na jāne māṃ ca taṃ prabhum |
sukhayitvā jigamiṣuṃ yāvaddhartuṃ samutsahe ||41 ||
tāvaddhastaṃ vañcayitvā vihasya satvaraṃ gataḥ |
doṣṇoḥ kaṃkaṇaśabdaiśca drāgahaṃ tvavabodhitā || 42||
sukhasantānapīyūṣahṛde parinimajjya vai |
kṣaṇaṃ tu tadviyogāgnau patitāhaṃ samutkaṭe |||43 ||
dunoti nitarāṃ sakhyastadviśleṣānalo mahān |
prāṇānāṃ me yiyāsūnāṃ punarāśā mahauṣadham ||44||
aho tasya punaḥ śaktiraho tasya balaṃ kriyā |
aho tasya prasaundaryaṃ ramaṇaṃ tasya cādbhutam ||45 ||
aho cūḍāmaṇistasya picchaṃ māyūrakaṃ śubham |
lalāṭaphalakaṃ ramyaṃ padmapatrāyatekṣaṇe ||46||
sasmitaṃ tvānanaṃ miṣṭaṃ miṣṭaścāsaprapūritam |
candrakoṭyujjvalaṃ vaktraṃ tejaḥparidhimaṇḍitam ||47||
kāmagarvaharā bhrūśca vakṣaḥ śītalapaṃkavat |
karau sukomalau puṣṭau bāhupārśvau manoharau ||48||
udaraṃ jaghanaṃ yatra hṛdayaṃ me jaḍaṃ hyabhūt |
ūrū netrānandakarau yathā maṇī prakāśakau ||49||
caraṇau komalau sparśaḥ svākarṣaṇakaraḥ paraḥ |
aho tasya pumaṃkasya sukhadatvaṃ cirāyitam ||1.468.50||
sarvasvena mayā tatra hutaṃ varṣma pramodane |
aho yogo balaṃ tasya tvaho vīryaṃ dṛḍhāṃgatā ||51 ||
punaḥ punaḥ prayogeṇa jitā śaktiśca me hṛtā |
kālīkamālayo vakti snigdhe mugdhe sakhījane ||52||
daśamyavasthā sannahyed bādhituṃ māṃ hi taṃ vinā |
iti tasyā giraḥ śrutvā mūrchā prāpustadālayaḥ ||53 ||
tāvat kṛṣṇaḥ samāyātastāsāṃ saubhāgyahetave |
svapne surūpo bhagavān yuvā tāḥ pariṣasvaje ||54||
tāstu datvā sukhaṃ tatra tiro’bhūd vai kṣaṇāntare |
śaśilekhānaṅgalekhācitralekhā jajāgaruḥ ||55||
dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇakṛtāśleṣacihnāni svakalevare |
parasparaṃ vilokyaitā hrīyuktāḥ saṃvirejire ||56 ||
nanṛtuḥ sukhasaṃhṛṣṭāḥ sakhyo mumudire bhṛśam |
śravaṇaṃ cāpi kṛṣṇasya sākṣātkārapradaṃ tvabhūt ||57||
catasrastāḥ svapitaraṃ pitṛtulyaṃ suvaiṣṇavam |
vasubhūtiṃ tu gandharvaṃ prātaḥ procurhidarśanam ||58||
svapne kṛṣṇo yathā dṛṣṭo yathā kṛṣṇaḥ pratoṣitaḥ |
yathā varo mahādevāt pūrvaṃ labdho’pyabhūt tathā ||59||
śrutvā sarvaṃ pitā prāha tāstu catuḥkumārikāḥ |
kṛṣṇasyaiva kṛte putryo mayā jalena cārpitāḥ ||1.468.6 0 ||
adya kṛṣṇo yadi tvāyād vaktavyā mannatiḥ stutiḥ |
vāgdānaṃ ca mahādevyo bhavatād bhagavānpatiḥ ||6 1 ||
jāmātā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ kutra hi labhyate |
śaṃkarasya varadānāllabdho yuṣmābhireva saḥ ||6 2 ||
dhanyo’haṃ kṛtakṛtyo’haṃ dhanyaṃ me’pi kulaṃ sadā |
jāmātā yasya bhagavān śrīkṛṣṇaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ||63 ||
dhanyā yūyaṃ sadā sādhvyo dhanyā yūyaṃ pativratāḥ |
dhanyā yūyaṃ kṛṣṇapatnyo dhanyāḥ kṛṣṇavratāḥ striyaḥ ||64||
ityuktvā kārayāmāsa maṇḍapaṃ kanyakājñayā |
śrīkṛṣṇāya pradātavyāḥ kanyakā itivāñcchayā ||65||
dvitīyāyāṃ niśāyāṃ sa samājagāma mādhavaḥ |
bubhuje tāḥ kanyakā vai tābhistūktaḥ pareśvaraḥ ||66 ||
vivāhārthaṃ tathāstviti kṛṣṇaḥ prāha kṛpāvaśaḥ |
prātareva mahābrāhme muhūrte vahnisannidhau ||67||
gavāṃ madhye dadau kanyāḥ kṛṣṇāya paramātmane |
vasubhūtiḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ cānarca bhāvataḥ ||68||
śyāmaṃ suyauvanaṃ puṣṭaṃ pītakauśeyavāsasam |
sundaraṃ sasmitaṃ śāntaṃ rādhākāntaṃ manoharam ||69||
śaratpārvaṇacandrāsyaṃ ratnālaṃkārabhūṣitam |
ratnakuṇḍalayugmābhyāṃ gaṇḍasthalavirājitam ||1.468.70||
ratnakeyūravalayaratnanūpurabhūṣitam |
ājānulambitāṃ śubhrāṃ bibhrataṃ ratnamālikām ||7 1 ||
mālatīmālayā kaṇṭhavakṣaḥsthalavirājitam |
candanāgurukastūrīkuṃkumāñcitavigraham ||72||
sunakhaṃ sukapolaṃ ca pakvabimbādharaṃ varam |
pakvadāḍīmabījābhaṃ bibhrataṃ dantamaṇḍalam || 73||
śikhipicchasamāyuktaṃ baddhacūḍaṃ parātparam |
kadambapuṣpayugmābhyāṃ karṇamūle virājitam ||74||
samarcya sarvabhūṣāḍhyaṃ nanāma kanyakāpitā |
kṛṣṇastāḥ kanyakā divyā jagrāha vidhinā prabhuḥ ||75||
śaratpārvaṇacandrābhā muṣṭavaktramanoharāḥ |
śaranmadhyāhnapadmānāṃ śobhāmocanalocanāḥ ||76||
paritastārakāpakṣmavicitrakajjalojjvalāḥ |
khagendracañcucāruśrīśaṃsānāśukanāsikāḥ ||77||
tanmadhyasthalaśobhārhasthūlamuktāphalojjvalāḥ |
kabarīveṣasaṃyuktā mālatīmālyaveṣṭitāḥ ||78 ||
grīṣmamadhyāhnamārtaṇḍaprabhāmuṣṭakakuṇḍalāḥ |
pakvabimbaphalānāṃ ca śrīmuṣṭādharayugmakāḥ ||79||
muktāpaṃktiprabhātaikadantapaṃktisamujjvalāḥ |
īṣatpraphullakundānāṃ suprabhāsaṃśubhasmitāḥ ||1.468.80||
kastūrībindusaṃyuktasindūrabindubhūṣitāḥ |
kapālāni ca mallikāyuktāni śrīyutāni ca ||81||
saṃdadhānāḥ kṛṣṇakāntāḥ kṛṣṇatulyasuśobhitāḥ |
sucāruvartulākārakapolapulakānvitāḥ ||82||
maṇiratnendrasārāṇāṃ hāroraḥsthalabhūṣitāḥ |
sucāruśrīphaladvayakaṭhinastanasaṃbhavāḥ ||83 ||
patrāvalīśriyā yuktā dīptāḥ sadratnakāntibhiḥ |
yāsāṃ suvartulākāramudaraṃ sumanoharam ||84||
vicitratrivalīyuktaṃ nimnanābhiśca vartulā |
sadratnasāraracitamekhalājālabhūṣitāḥ ||85||
kāmāstrasārabhrūbhaṃgayogīndracittamohikāḥ |
sthalapadmaprabhāśobhāñcitatalapadāmbujāḥ ||86||
ratnabhūṣaṇasaṃyuktā yāvakadravaśobhitāḥ |
maṇīndraśobhāsaṃmuṣṭasālaktakakaradvayāḥ ||87||
sadratnasāraracitakvaṇanmañjīrarañjitāḥ |
ratnakaṃkaṇakeyūracāruśaṃkhavibhūṣitāḥ ||88||
ratnāṃgulīyanikaravahniśuddhāṃśukojjvalāḥ |
cārucampakapuṣpāṇāṃ prabhāmuṣṭakalevarāḥ ||89||
sahasradalasaṃyuktakrīḍākamalaśobhitāḥ |
ratnadarpaṇasaṃyuktā navavadhūḥ svayaṃ hariḥ || 1.468.90||
rañjayan bahudhā nītvā yautakaṃ cātimūlyakam |
yayau prasthāpito yānairvaihāyasaiḥ paraṃ padam ||91 ||
tenaiva varṣmaṇā tāstu divyāḥ kṛṣṇaprasaṃgataḥ |
golokayogyāḥ sañjātā rādhālakṣmīsamāḥ priyāḥ ||92||
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi pātivratyaparāyaṇam |
kṛṣṇaprāptyātmakaṃ puṇyaṃ śravaṇādapi mokṣakṛt ||93||
paṭhanādasya tatpuṇyaṃ kṛṣṇasaubhāgyadaṃ bhavet |
anūḍho labhate kanyāratnaṃ śreṣṭhakulocitam ||94||
kanyāpīmaṃ samākarṇya kṛṣṇabhaktisamanvitā |
śraddhayā satpatiṃ prāpya bhaviṣyati pativratā ||95||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne kalāvatīnartakyāḥ śaṃkaradvārā kṛṣṇapativratādharmeṇa tisṛbhiḥ sakhībhiḥ saha janmāntare gāndharvītvaṃ kṛṣṇena vivāhya ca golokaprāptimattvaṃ cetinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭaṣaṣṭyadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 468 ||

<1.469>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu kṛṣṇakathāṃ lakṣmi dvijapatnīsamanvitām |
yāṃ śrutvā pātivratyena mokṣaṇaṃ mānasaṃ bhavet || 1 ||
ekadā tu purā kṛṣṇo balarāmaśca bālakāḥ |
vṛndāvanād yayuryamītaṭe madhuvane śubhe || 2 ||
vicerurgosahasraiste cikrīḍurvai parasparam |
śrāntāḥ kṣudhitāstṛṣitāḥ śiśavastūcuracyutam || 3 ||
kṣudasmān bādhate kṛṣṇa kiṃ kurmo’tra vane’danam |
śrīkṛṣṇastām̐stadā prāha bālā gacchata sannidhau || 4 ||
yajñasthānaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ yācatānnaṃ tu bhūsurān |
āṃgirasān vaiṣṇavām̐śca mumukṣūn yajatastu mām || 5 ||
ajānantaśca māṃ viṣṇuṃ māyāpracchannavigraham |
na ced dadati yuṣmabhyamannaṃ yajñasthitā dvijāḥ || 6 ||
tatkāntā yācata bālā dayāyuktāḥ śiśūn prati |
śrīkṛṣṇavacanaṃ śrutvā yayurbālakapuṃgavāḥ || 7 ||
brāhmaṇānāṃ purastasthurbhikṣārthaṃ namrakandharāḥ |
tānūcurbālakā namrā annaṃ datta dvijottamāḥ || 8 ||
dvijā na śuśruvustām̐stu śṛṇvanto na mano daduḥ |
atastasmāt sthalād dūre gatā randhanaśālikām | | 9 ||
brāhmaṇyo yatra sūpādi pācayanti mahānase |
gatvā namrā viprapatnīryayācire’nnamāsthayā || 1.469.1 0||
yūyaṃ vai mātaraḥ sarvā viprapatnyaḥ pativratāḥ |
dattānnaṃ mātarastvasmān kṣudhitān gopabālakān || 11 ||
śiśūnāṃ mṛduvākyāni śrutvā dṛṣṭvā hi tān striyaḥ |
papraccha sādaraṃ sādhvyaḥ ke yūyaṃ kena darśitam || 12||
yadatrānnaṃ hi labdhaṃ syād brūtātra gopabālakāḥ |
dāsyāmo’nnaṃ mṛṣṭamuṣṇaṃ vyañjanādisamanvitam || 13||
śrutvā prasannāḥ śiśavo yaṣṭihastā jagustu tāḥ |
preṣitā rāmakṛṣṇābhyāṃ darśitaṃ tvanmahānasam || 14||
dattānnaṃ mātaro’smabhyaṃ tūrṇaṃ yāmastadantikam |
ito vidūre bhāṇḍīre’tiśobhe’tra madhauvane | | 15||
vaṭādhaḥsthitabhrātṛbhyāṃ yācitānnaṃ pradatta naḥ |
śrutveti komalaṃ kṛṣṇasambandhaṃ vākyamuttamam || 16 ||
pulakāṃkitasarvāṃgā hṛṣṭānandāśrulocanāḥ |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ smṛtvā śālyannaṃ pāyasaṃ dadhi || 17||
miṣṭānnaṃ svastikādyaṃ ca laḍḍukānnaṃ supolikāḥ |
nānāvyañjanasūpādi kṛtvā pātreṣu yoṣitaḥ || 18||
pātrāṇi rājatādīni santyato vayameva tu |
āgacchāmaḥ sahabālā ityuktvā prayayurmudā || 1 9||
viprāṇyo manasā hṛṣṭāḥ kṛtvā nānāmanorathān |
pativratāstā dhanyāśca śrīkṛṣṇadarśanotsukāḥ ||1.469.20||
śrīkṛṣṇaṃ dadṛśurgatvā baladevaṃ ca bālakān |
vaṭacchāyāsthitān dṛṣṭvā dadṛśustāḥ punarharim ||2 1 ||
śyāmaṃ kiśoravayasaṃ pītakauśeyavāsasam |
sundaraṃ sasmitaṃ śāntaṃ rādhākāntaṃ manoharam ||22||
śaratpārvaṇacandrāsyaṃ ratnālaṃkṛtirājitam |
ratnakuṇḍalayugmābhyāṃ gaṇḍasthalavirājitam ||23||
ratnakeyūravalayaratnanūpurabhūṣitam |
ājānulambitāṃ śubhrāṃ bibhrataṃ ratnamālikām ||24||
mālatīmālayā kaṇṭhavakṣaḥsthalavirājitām |
candanāgurukastūrīkuṃkumāñcitavigraham ||25||
sunakhaṃ sukapolaṃ ca pakvabimbādharaṃ harim |
pakvadāḍīmabījābhadantapaṃktivirājitam ||26 ||
mayūraparṇasaṃśobhadbaddhacūḍāmaṇiṃ prabhum |
karṇayordhṛtakādambapuṣpagucchasuśobhitam ||27||
dhyānāsādhyaṃ yogināṃ ca bhaktānugrahakātaram |
brahmeśadharmaśeṣendraiḥ stūyamānaṃ pareśvaram ||28||
koṭikandarpalāvaṇyavātsalyapremapūritam |
dṛṣṭvaivamujjvalaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ bhaktyā nemurdvijastriyaḥ ||29||
svānāṃ jñānānurūpaṃ ca tuṣṭuvuḥ parameśvaram |
tvaṃ brahma paramaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ sākṣācchrīpatiracyutaḥ ||1.469.3 0||
nirguṇastvaṃ nirākāraḥ sākāraḥ saguṇaḥ svayam |
sākṣirūpaśca nirlepaḥ paramātmā nirākṛtiḥ ||3 1 ||
akṣarātparataḥ śreṣṭhastvakṣarātīta eva ca |
muktasevyaḥ śriyā sevyo rādhāramādipūjitaḥ ||32||
pārvatīmāṇikīlakṣmīprabhādyābhiḥ patiḥ kṛtaḥ |
prakṛteḥ puruṣasyāpi mahāviṣṇośca vedhasaḥ ||33 ||
śivādīnāṃ manūnāṃ ca kāraṇaṃ paramaṃ bhavān |
jaḍaṃ tattvātmakaṃ yadyaccetanaṃ ca tadanvitam ||34||
tvayā vyāptaṃ tava tejobalāttejasvitāśrayam |
sarvaiśvaryāṇi śaktyādyāstavamūrteḥ samudbhavāḥ ||35||
sarvānandaḥ pareśo’si patiḥ prāṇādhikaḥ priyaḥ |
adivyacakṣuṣā naiva grāhyo’si dehavānapi ||36||
maheśaḥ kārtikeyaśca śeṣo dharmo vidhirguruḥ |
sarasvatī jaḍāḥ sarve stavane tatra kā vayam ||37||
pārvatī kamalā rādhā sāvitrī śāradā prabhā |
māṇikī śrīrlakṣmavatī pravartante na kā vayam ||38||
prasanno bhava no deva dīnabandho kṛpāṃ kuru |
iti petustu tā viprapatnyaḥ kṛṣṇapadāmbuje ||39||
abhayaṃ pradadau tābhyaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ |
varaṃ vṛṇuta kalyāṇaṃ bhavitā cetyuvāca saḥ ||1.469.40 ||
tataḥ sādhvyastu tā ūcurgṛhṇīmaḥ pravaraṃ prabho |
dehi svadāsyamasmabhyaṃ dṛḍhāṃ bhaktiṃ padāmbuje ||41 ||
paśyāmo’nukṣaṇaṃ vaktraṃ sevayāmaḥ padāmbuje |
anugrahaṃ kuru śreṣṭhaṃ yāsyāmo na gṛhaṃ punaḥ ||42||
pativratānāṃ vākyāni śrutvā kṛṣṇaḥ kṛpānidhiḥ |
omityuktvā viprapatnīdattamannaṃ sudhāsamam ||43||
bālakān bhojayitvānububhuje bhagavān svayam |
etasminnantare tatra śātakuṃbhaṃ rathaṃ param ||44||
golokādāgataṃ tāstu dadṛśurdivyapārṣadam |
ratnadarpaṇatejaskaṃ vastrasāraparicchadam ||45||
suvarṇakalaśopetaṃ ratnastaṃbhadharādikam |
sarvataścāmarairyuktaṃ pārijātasumālikam ||46||
śatacakropariklṛptaṃ vanamālādiśobhitam |
divyapārṣadavaryaiśca kṛṣṇatulyaiḥ suvāhitam ||47||
pītavastraparīdhānaiḥ ratnālaṃkārabhūṣitaiḥ |
navayauvanasampanneḥ śyāmalaiśca manoharaiḥ ||48 ||
dvibhujairmuralīhastairgopiveśadharairvaraiḥ |
śikhipicchaguñjamālābaddhavakrimacūḍakaiḥ ||49||
pārṣadaiḥ sannataḥ kṛṣṇo viprapatnyastu bodhitāḥ |
gamanārthaṃ tu golokaṃ tāścāsan muditānanā |||1.469.50 ||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ natvā tyaktvā mānuṣavigrahān |
babhūvurgopikāḥ sadyo jagmurgolokamīpsitam ||5 1 ||
kṛṣṇaśchāyāṃ vinirmāya tāsāṃ rūpāntarāṇi vai |
gṛhān prasthāpayāmāsa viprāṇāṃ viprakāminīḥ ||52||
viprā gaveṣaṇaṃ cakruḥ kva gatāstā itibruvāḥ |
dadṛśuḥ pathi cāyāntīḥ patnīḥ śāntiṃ yayustataḥ |||53 ||
pulakāṅkitasarvāṃgāḥ prasannavadanekṣaṇāḥ |
ūcuraho’tidhanyāḥ smo yūyaṃ cāpi pativratāḥ ||54||
yāsāṃ patnyaḥ kṛṣṇabhaktā lakṣmīrādhāsamā harau |
tapo japo vrataṃ jñānaṃ vedādhyayanamarcanam ||55|||
tīrthasnānamanaśanaṃ saphalaṃ kṛṣṇasevayā |
śrīkṛṣṇaḥ sevito yābhiḥ kiṃ tāsāṃ puṇyaparvataiḥ ||56|||
prāptaḥ kalpataruryābhiḥ kiṃ tāsāṃ tarukoṭibhiḥ |
śrīkṛṣṇo hṛdaye yāsāṃ kiṃ tāsāṃ karmakoṭibhiḥ ||57||
iti kṛṣṇasya māhātmyaṃ patnīnāṃ cāpi sarvathā |
jānantaste yayuryajñaṃ tato yayurgṛhāṇi vai ||58||
tāsāṃ tato’dhikaṃ prema krīḍāsu sarvakarmasu |
dākṣiṇyaṃ sevanaṃ sarvaṃ tvāsīd viprairatarkitam ||59||
prāgbhavīyottamapuṇyaiḥ prāpyate bhagavān yataḥ |
āsam̐stāstu purā saptarṣīṇāṃ patnyaḥ pativratāḥ ||1.469.60||
guṇavatyo ramaṇyastā rūpeṇāpratimā parāḥ |
navīnayauvanāḥ sarvāḥ pīnaśroṇipayodharāḥ ||6 1 ||
divyavastraparīdhānā ratnālaṃkārabhūṣitāḥ |
taptakāñcanavarṇābhāḥ smerānanasaroruhāḥ ||62||
yajñasthānasthitāḥ svāmisahitāścakrurarpaṇam |
vahnau dravyādivastūnāṃ cakame’gnirvilokya tāḥ ||63||
tato vahniḥ svīyajvālākaraiḥ pasparśa tā muhuḥ |
agniraṃgāni tāsāṃ ca darśaṃ darśaṃ mumoha ca ||64||
haviṣyaṃ bhakṣayam̐ścāpi sparśaṃ kṛtvātikāmukaḥ |
samāśliṣat karaistāstvadṛśyairbhāvaiḥ punaḥ punaḥ ||65||
cakāra surataṃ sūkṣmaṃ śikhābhiḥ pariṣvajya tāḥ |
pativratāśca tā naiva jānanti vahnivartanam ||66||
divyadraṣṭāṅgirā vahnerjñātvā guptaṃ tu vartanam |
kāmabhāvānvitaṃ vahniṃ śaśāpa śeṣamāvahan ||67||
adyaprabhṛti vahne te śikhāyāṃ ca kareṣu ca |
jvālāyāṃ ca tathāṅgārādiṣu kāmau bhavenna vai ||68||
napuṃsakaḥ sadā syāstvaṃ jvālātmakaḥ supuṇyadaḥ |
mūrtimām̐stvaṃ sakāmaḥ syāḥ svāhāpi tādṛśī tathā ||69||
evaṃ śaptastato vahnirniṣkāmo jvālayābhavat |
yajñayāgādikāryāṇi yataḥ puṇyāni tadbalāt ||1.469.70||
athāṅgirā aśuddhāstā vahnispṛṣṭā hi kāmataḥ |
śaśāpa śuddhilābhāya yāta yoniṃ tu mānuṣīm ||71 ||
kulajairbrāhmaṇaiḥ pāṇirgṛhīto vo bhaviṣyati |
ityuktāstāḥ kṣaṇaṃ śokaṃ jagmuścakruśca taṃ natim ||72||
hitaṃ tathyaṃ prārthayāmāsuśca sarvāḥ pativratāḥ |
na tyajāsmān muniśreṣṭha niṣpāpā vai pativratāḥ ||73||
ajānantyaḥ paraspṛṣṭā na vai nastyaktumarhasi |
bhaktānāṃ kiṃkarīṇāṃ ca na daṇḍaṃ kartumarhasi ||74||
yuṣmākaṃ caraṇāmbhojaṃ kadā drakṣyāmahe vayam |
khaḍgacchedād vajrapātāt sarvapraharaṇāttathā ||75||
dāruṇaḥ kāntavicchedaḥ sādhvīnāṃ duḥsahaḥ sadā |
brahmiṣṭhānāṃ guṇavatāṃ parān kāntān mahāmunīn ||76 ||
patnīvratān kathaṃ tyaktvā yāsyāmaḥ pṛthivītalam |
yāsyāmo yadi vipreśa kadātrāgamanaṃ vada ||77||
anyeṣāṃ tu bhayāt kāntā vrajanti śaraṇaṃ patim |
svakāntabhayasaṃvignāḥ śaraṇaṃ kaṃ vrajanti tāḥ ||78||
abhayaṃ dehi dharmiṣṭha bhayayuktābhya eva yat |
putre śiṣye kalatre ca ko daṇḍaṃ kartumakṣamaḥ ||79||
daṇḍaṃ datvā vāraṇaṃ ca kartuṃ tvapi na kaḥ kṣamaḥ |
kāminīnāṃ vacaḥ śrutvāṅgirāḥ premṇā ruroda vai ||1.469.80 ||
saṃjñāmavāpya ca bhrātṝn pṛṣṭvā provāca tāstataḥ |
hitaṃ satyaṃ priyaṃ yogyamanyeṣāṃ bodhadaṃ param ||81||
parabhuktāṃ svasya kāntāṃ vinā tacchodhanaṃ patiḥ |
naiva bhuñjīta vai kvāpi pāpaṃ saṃkramate priye |||82 ||
na sā daive na sā paitrye pākārhā pāpasaṃyutā |
tasyā āliṃgane bhartā bhraṣṭaśrīstejasā hataḥ ||83||
devatāḥ pitarastasya havyadāne ca tarpaṇe |
sukhino na bhavantyeva kavoṣṇamupabhuṃjate ||84||
tasmād yatnena bhāryāyā rakṣaṇaṃ kāryamanvaham |
pade pade sāvadhānaiḥ kāntā rakṣyāḥ supaṇḍitaiḥ ||85||
nānyādhīnā bhaved yoṣā doṣāṇāṃ hi karaṇḍikā |
kalatraṃ pākapātraṃ ca sadā rakṣitumarhati ||86||
parasparśādaśuddhe te śuddhe svasyaiva hastage |
aśuddhānāṃ praśuddhiścartunā vratena janmanā ||87||
tasmānnārī parairyatnādadṛṣṭā pūrvajaiḥ kṛtā |
asūryaṃpaśyā yā dārā śuddhāstāstu pativratāḥ ||88||
svāmisādhyā tu yā nārī kuladharmabhiyā sthitā |
kāntena sārdhaṃ sā kāntā vaikuṇṭhaṃ yāti niścitam ||89||
ṛṣilokanimeṣeṇa pṛthvyāṃ viṃśativarṣakaḥ |
kālo yāsyati śīghraṃ vai janmanā śuddhirarthyate ||1.469.90 ||
yāta yūyaṃ ca pṛthivīṃ mānuṣīṃ yonimīpsitām |
kṛṣṇabhojanadānena vaḥ śāpasya hi mocanam ||91 ||
śrīkṛṣṇasya pratāpena rūpatrayaṃ dhariṣyatha |
divyakanyāsvarūpeṇa golokaṃ yāsyatha dhruvama ||92||
devīkanyāsvarūpeṇa ṛṣilokaṃ prayāsyatha |
chāyākanyāsvarūpeṇa vipragṛhaṃ prayāsyatha ||93 ||
yuṣmadaṃśā viprapatnyo mṛtau prāpsyatha no dhruvam |
yuṣmākaṃ mamaśāpo’yaṃ vartate’dya varādhikaḥ ||94 ||
bhuktirmuktirgṛhaprāptistrayametadavāpyate |
ityuktāstā yajñabhūmeryayuḥ pṛthvīṃ yamītaṭe || 95||
yogyagṛhe samudbhūya babhuvurviprayoṣitaḥ |
datvānnaṃ haraye bhaktyā jagmurgolokameva tāḥ || 96 ||
tathānyarūpaiḥ kāntasya lokaṃ jagmuśca tāstadā |
chāyārūpairyayurvipragṛhāṇyeva tu tāḥ striyaḥ || 97||
babhūva niścitaṃ tāsāṃ śāpo vai sampado’dhikaḥ |
aho sadyaḥ satāṃ kopastūpakārāya kalpate || 98||
vinā vipattermahimā kutaḥ kasya bhavet khalu |
bhūtāḥ kāntaparityāgānmuktā brāhmaṇayoṣitaḥ || 99||
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ lakṣmi pativratāharivratam |
paṭhanācchravaṇāttvasya bhuktirmuktistathonnatiḥ || 1.469.100 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne saptarṣipatnīnāṃ vahnibhogena śāpād viprapatnītve śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇapātivratyena yajñe yamītaṭe śrīkṛṣṇādibālānāṃ vatsacārāṇāṃ bhojanadānena mokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikonasaptatyadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 46 9||

<1.470>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi sarpajātau pativratā vṛṣaṃ śubham |
yamunāyāstaṭe ramye yayau kṛṣṇo balānvitaḥ || 1 ||
gopālakavṛṣairgābhirvijahāra jalāntikam |
gāvo vṛṣāstathā bālāḥ papurvāri tṛṣāturāḥ || 2 ||
viṣāktaṃ tajjalaṃ tvāsīt kālīyasarpavāsataḥ |
kecinmūrchāṃ gatāstatra tvanye prāṇāṃśca tatyajuḥ || 3 ||
kṛpṇanārāyaṇo jñātvā jīvayāmāsa tāṃstadā |
kṛṣṇaḥ kadambamāruhya kṛtvā dehaṃ mahattamam | | 4 ||
papāta jalamadhye sa nāgasyopari mādhavaḥ |
naikahastapramāṇaṃ tu jalotthānaṃ tadābhavat || 5 ||
sa sarpo mānuṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā dudrāva krodhavegataḥ |
baddhuṃ taṃ mānuṣaṃ rūpaṃ yāvajjagrāha taṃ harim || 6 ||
taptalohasamaṃ jātaṃ kṛṣṇavarṣma hi tejasā |
dagdhakaṇṭhodaro nāgastūdvignaḥ kṛṣṇatejasā || 7 ||
prāṇā yāstyevamuktvā vai cakārodvamanaṃ punaḥ |
bhagnadanto raktamukhaḥ kṛṣṇavajrāṃgacarvaṇāt || 8 ||
raktavaktrasya bhagavānuttasthau mastakopari |
nāgo viśvaṃbharākrāntaḥ papāta mūrchitaḥ priye || 9 ||
punaḥ sa cetanāṃ prāpya phaṇābhiḥ śrīnarāyaṇam |
svapucchena muhuryuktyā śrīkṛṣṇaṃ samatāḍayat || 1.470.1 0||
bhagavān śrīhariḥ kalānidhistūnnamitāṃ phaṇām |
pallatayā punaryuktyā tatāḍa ca nanarta ca || 11 ||
phaṇā śithilatāṃ prāptā sarpo’bhūttu mṛdurbahuḥ |
mūrchitaṃ taṃ tadā dṛṣṭvā nāginyo rurudurbhṛśam || 1 2||
patiprāṇāḥ svāmidharmāḥ patyarthaṃ kṛtajīvanāḥ |
tāsu śreṣṭhā surasākhyā patnī tasya śubhā satī ||1 3||
nāginībhiḥ saha premṇā ruroda purato hareḥ |
baddhāñjalipuṭā tūrṇaṃ praṇamya śrīhariṃ satī || 14||
dhṛtvā pādāravindaṃ śrīkṛṣṇamāha bhayākulā |
he jagatkānta me kāntaṃ dehi mānaṃ sumānada || 15||
patiḥ prāṇādhikaḥ strīṇāṃ nāsti bandhustu tatparaḥ |
pativratāhaṃ nāgasya patnī svecchāsvarūpiṇī || 1 6||
nāge mṛge ca vaidhavyaduḥkhitā syāṃ tataḥ prabho |
maraṇaṃ me prathamaṃ ca kuru me svāminastataḥ || 17||
tannāśe mama nāśo’sti strīhatyā te bhaviṣyati |
nāgapatnīvacaḥ śrutvā śrīkṛṣṇastāmuvāca ha || 18||
uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha nāgeśi varaṃ vṛṇu bhayaṃ tyaja |
gṛhāṇa kāntaṃ nāgeśi cirajīvājarāmarā || 6 ||
yamīhradraṃ parityajya sakuṭumbānyato vraja |
khaṇḍaṃ ramaṇakaṃ gaccha tatra saṃsukhino bhava || 1.470.20||
yatpādapadmacihnena garuḍastvatpati śubhe |
kṛtvā tu stavanaṃ bhaktyā praṇamiṣyati matpadam || 21 ||
śrutvadaṃ sā bhaktinamrā surasovāca mādhavam |
tvatpādābje dṛḍhā bhaktiṃ niścalā dehi me hare || 22||
manmanastvatpadāmbhojaṃ bhramatu bhramaro yathā |
svakāntaṃ mama sobhāgyaṃ sarvadā dehi me vibho || 23||
evaṃ samprārthya surasā dadarśa śrīharermukham |
locanābhyāṃ papau vaktraṃ nimeṣarahitaṃ satā || 24||
sarvāṃgapulakodbhinnā sānandāśrupariplutā |
uvāca purataḥ kṛṣṇaṃ bhaktyudrekapariplutā || 25||
na yāsyāmi ramaṇakaṃ tatra me na prayojanam |
sarpaḥ karotu saṃsāre kuru māṃ tava kiṃkarīm || 26||
nāgapatnyā vacaḥ śratvā śrīśa omityuvāca ha |
etasminnantare tūrṇaṃ ratho divyaḥ samāgataḥ || 27||
pārṣadapravarairyukto divyavastuparicchadaḥ |
avaruhya śatacakrādrathācchrīkṛṣṇapārṣadāḥ || 28||
praṇamya kṛṣṇaṃ tāṃ nītvā jagmurgolokamuttamam |
kṛṣṇaśchāyāṃ vinirmāya dadau sarpāya sarpiṇīm ||29||
sarpaḥ kiñcinna bubudhe camatkāraṃ kadambinaḥ |
avaruhya harirmūdhno dadau hastaṃ tu bhogini ||1.470.30 ||
sarpaḥ prabodhamāsādya dadarśa purato harim |
nāginī sāśrunetrāṃ ca surasāṃ svapativratām ||3 1 ||
bālakṛṣṇaṃ namaskṛtya ruroda premavihvalaḥ |
śrīkṛṣṇastaṃ paraṃ bhaktaṃ varaṃ vṛṇvityuvāca ha ||32||
tvaṃ me bhakto yataḥ sarpa sukhaṃ tiṣṭha bhayaṃ tyaja |
tasyāhamanugṛhṇāmi yo me bhakto’tigārpitaḥ ||33||
kiñcittaddamanaṃ kṛtvā tatprasādaṃ karomyaham |
tvadvaṃśajātān sarpāṃśca hanti yo mānavaḥ kvacit ||34||
brahmahatyāsamaṃ pāpaṃ bhavitā tasya niścitam |
matpādapadmacihne yaḥ karoti daṇḍaghātanam ||35||
dviguṇā brahmahatyā vai bhavitā tasya niścitā |
lakṣmīryāsyati tadgehācchāpaṃ datvā sudāruṇam ||36||
vaṃśāyuryaśasāṃ hānirbhavitā tasya niścitam |
dehānte tasya mṛtyuśca sarpadaṃśād bhaviṣyati ||37||
tasya vaṃśodbhavānāṃ ca tvadvaṃśād bhavitā bhayam |
ye tu tvadvaṃśajān dṛṣṭvā supadāṃkaṃ madīyakam ||38||
praṇamiṣyanti bhaktyā te mokṣyante cauragād bhayāt |
gaccha śīghraṃ ramaṇakaṃ tyaja bhītiṃ khagādhipāt ||39||
matpadāṅkaṃ tava mūrdhni dṛṣṭvā pakṣī namiṣyati |
tava tvadvaṃśajānāṃ ca garuḍānna bhayaṃ kvacit ||1.470.40||
varaṃ cāpyaparaṃ sarpa vāñchitaṃ varayādhunā |
ityuktaḥ prāha kālīyo bhaktiṃ dehi smṛtiṃ tava ||41||
dāsyaṃ dehi tvatpadābje dhruvaṃ janmani janmani |
tadbhavet saphalaṃ yatra smṛtistvaccaraṇāmbuje ||42||
tanniṣphalaḥ svargavāso nāsti cet tvatpadasmṛtiḥ |
tvatpādadhyānayuktasya yattatsthānaṃ tu tat param ||43||
kṣaṇaṃ vā koṭikalpaṃ vā puruṣāyuḥ kṣaṇo’stu vā |
yadi tvatsevayā yāti saphalo niṣphalo’nyathā ||44||
teṣāṃ tvāyurvyayo nāsti ye tvatpādābjasevakāḥ |
na santi janmamaraṇarogaśokārtibhītayaḥ ||45||
samprāptastvanmanurbrahmannanantād yāvadeva tu |
tāvat tvadbhāvanenaiva tvadvarṇo’hamanugrahāt ||46||
māṃ tu bhaktamapakvaṃ vā vijñāya garuḍaḥ svayam |
deśād dūraṃ ca nyakkāraṃ cakāra dṛḍhabhaktimān ||47||
bhavatā tu dṛḍhāṃ bhaktiṃ datvāhaṃ svīkṛtaḥ svakaḥ |
garuḍaśca samuktastu mā bhaktaṃ khāda coragam ||48||
anugṛhītaścāhaṃ saṃrakṣitaḥ sarvadā tvayā |
he nātha karuṇāsindho dīnabandho kṣamādhamam ||49||
iti bruvantaṃ nāgendramotvityāha haristadā |
nāgendrāya varaṃ datvā gacchetyāha hariḥ punaḥ ||1.470.5 0||
sarpaḥ prāha kadā viṣṇo drakṣyāmi tvatpadāmbujam |
praṇamya śatakṛtvaśca yayau ramaṇakaṃ sthalam ||51 ||
jalaṃ jātaṃ sudhākalpaṃ prasannāḥ sarvajantavaḥ |
śṛṇu lakṣmi tasya pūrvasthalatyāgasya kāraṇam |||52||
śeṣājñayā nāgagaṇā pratisaṃvatsaraṃ bhiyā |
kārtikīpūrṇimāyāṃ tu kurvanti garuḍārcanam ||53||
puṣpairdhūpaiḥ sudīpaiḥ sannaivedyairbalibhistathā |
puṣkare te mahātīrthe susnātāstasya pūjanam ||54||
cakrustadā tu kālīyo na cakārāpyahaṃkṛtaḥ |
nāgapūjopakaraṇaṃ balād bhakṣitumudyataḥ ||55||
tāvattatra samāyāto garuḍo yuyudhe tu taiḥ |
kālīyajātīyasarpaiḥ sarpāstena palāyitāḥ ||56 ||
anantaṃ śaraṇaṃ jagmustatra gatvā tu pakṣirāṭ |
yuddhaṃ cakāra tumulaṃ tvanantaṃ jitavān khagaḥ ||57||
kālīyastu vidudrāva jagāma yamunāhradam |
na taṃ saubhariśāpena khagendro gantumīśvaraḥ ||58||
garuḍastvekadā pūrvaṃ matsyabhakṣaṇavāñchayā |
tapataḥ saubhareryamītaṭasthasya samīpataḥ ||59||
jagrāha cañcunā mīnaṃ mīno’pi daivayogataḥ |
cañcvā viyukto nikaṭe papāta saubharestadā ||1.470.6 0 ||
śaraṇāgatarakṣāṃ saṃkuru cetyāha mīnarāṭa |
munirāha garuḍaṃ taṃ punarādātumudyatam ||6 1 ||
gaccha dūraṃ gaccha dūraṃ khagendra matsamīpataḥ |
karomi bhasmasāttūrṇaṃ yadyāgacchasi me hradam ||62|||
madīyaśāpāt tūrṇaṃ tvaṃ bhasmasād bhavitāsi vai |
saubharestu vacaḥ śrutvā pracacāla khageśvaraḥ ||63 ||
smāraṃ smāraṃ kṛṣṇapādaṃ taṃ praṇamya jagāma ha |
itihetorgaruḍaḥ sa nāyāti yamunāhradam ||64||
ato nirbhayatāmāpya kālīyastatra saṃsthitaḥ |
śrīkṛṣṇasya pratāpena divyo bhakte’bhavattataḥ ||65 ||
gato ramaṇakaṃ khaṇḍaṃ nāginyāśchāyayā saha |
mūlarūpā tu mokṣaṃ sā surasā saṃjagāma ha ||66||
nāgarūpāpi tiryañcī pātivratyaparāyaṇā |
patiṃ prāptvā rakṣayitvā bhūtvā dvedhācyutārthanāt ||67||
kṛṣṇadāsyaṃ gatā dhāmni patyau chāyāpyavartayat |
evaṃ rakṣā kṛtā cāpi kṛṣṇanārāyaṇena vai ||68||
kimasti durlabhaṃ lakṣmi bhagavaddhyāyino’tra vai |
paratrāpi ca daurlabhyaṃ saulabhye parivartate ||69||
tasmād dhyeyaḥ sadā kṛṣṇaḥ sukhavāñcchāprapūrakaḥ |
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya nāgabhītirna jāyate ||1.470.70||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne yamunāhradasthakālīyasarpasya pativratāyāḥ surasānāginyā bhagavatprāptiḥ patisaubhāgyasātatyaṃ, nāgabhakṣakagaruḍasya saubhariśāpāt yamunāhrade sarpasyanirbhayatā, paścād ramaṇake vāsa ityādinirūpaṇanāmā saptatyadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 470 ||

<1.471>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi ca maṇḍukyāḥ kathāmuddhārakāriṇīm |
ānandakānane śaṃbhormandiraṃ tvāsa śobhanam || 1 ||
ekā bhekī sadā tatra saṃvaste śivasannidhau |
pradakṣiṇaṃ karotīyaṃ nirmālyākṣatabhakṣiṇī || 2 ||
ekadā sā bahiryātā vihārārthaṃ tṛṇādiṣu |
kaścit kākaḥ samālokya maṇḍūkī tāmitastataḥ || 3 ||
saṃplavamānāmādāya cañcvā kṣetrād bahirgataḥ |
varṣābhvī tena sā kṣiptā kākena kṣetrabāhyataḥ || 4 ||
mṛtā cañcuprahāreṇa pradakṣiṇādipuṇyataḥ |
puṣpabaṭugṛhe kanyā gāndharvī sā vyajāyata || 5 ||
śaṃkarasya tu liṃgasya śaivālādi tu bhakṣitam |
tena puṇyaprabhāveṇa śuddhā miṣṭasvarānvitā || 6 ||
bālyādeva nipūṇā sā saṃvyajāyata gītiṣu |
nāmnā sā mādhavī sādhvī śaṃbhupativratābhavat || 7 ||
śubhāvayavasaṃsthānā śreṣṭhalakṣaṇalakṣitā |
mahābhāgavatī jātismarā bhaktottamābhavat || 8 ||
samyaggītarahasyajñā nitarāṃ madhurasvarā |
gāyatyeva yathākālaṃ ṣaḍjamṛṣabhaṃ vā svaram || 9 ||
gāndhāraṃ madhyamaṃ pañcamaṃ vā dhaivatamityapi |
kvacinniṣādaṃ sā bālā gāyati pravarocchrayam || 1.471.10 ||
ṣaḍjagrāmairmadhyamagrāmaiśca gāndhāragrāmakaiḥ |
atha tatra ṣaḍjagrāme mūrchanāḥ suyunakti sā || 11 ||
uttaramandāṃ ca rajanīṃ tṛtīyāmuttarāyatām |
śuddhaṣaḍjāṃ matsaritāmaśvakrāntābhirudgate || 12||
evaṃ madhyamagrāmeṣu sauvīrī hāriṇāṃ tathā |
aśvāṃ ca kālopatatāṃ śuddhamadhyamāṃ gīrmayīm || 13 ||
pauravīṃ cetyatha gāndhāragrāmeṣu tu nandikām |
viśālāṃ sumukhīṃ citrāṃ citravatīṃ sukhāṃ tathā || 14||
ālāpāṃ ca yathāvāhaṃ suyunakti dhiyā satī |
tānām̐stvekonapañcāśat kramātrūṭyā yunakti ca || 15||
agniṣṭomaṃ tathātyagniṣṭomaṃ ca vājapeyakam |
ṣoḍaśīṃ puṇḍarīkaṃ cāśvamedhaṃ rājasūyakam || 16||
evamādīn darśayitvā karoti śubhagāyanam |
tālānekottaraśataṃ dhruvaṃ sāmyaṃ tathāparān || 17||
sannipātādikān lāti gāyatyapi tathāvidhān |
ṣaḍrāgān śrīṃ vasantaṃ ca paṃcamaṃ bhairavaṃ tathā || 18||
meghaṃ jaṭularāyaṇaṃ niṣkāsayati yatnataḥ |
pratyekasya ca pañcāpi rāginīḥ pañca sā satī ||19||
ṣaṭtriṃśadrāgarāgiṇīḥ prakāśayati kaṇṭhataḥ |
deśakālavibhedena pañcaṣaṣṭyaparāstathā || 1.471.20 ||
yāvanta eva tālāḥ syū rāgāstāvanta ityapi |
tān sarvān nityadā sādhvī gāyati gītivedinā ||21 ||
mādhavī madhurālāpā oṃkāraṃ śaṃkaraṃ sadā |
santoṣayati rāgādyairnartanaiḥ pūjanaiḥ stavaiḥ |||22||
prāpyāpyanarghyatāruṇyamoṃkāraṃ bahvamanyata |
svabhāvacañcalaṃ cetaḥ śaṃbhau sthairyaṃ samāgamat || 23 ||
na vai tāṃ bādhayāñcakre kṣuttṛṇnidrāśramādikam |
atandritamānasāsīnnityaṃ śaṃkarasevikā ||24||
nimeṣaṃ vighnarūpaṃ sā mene kālaṃ nirarthakam |
nimeṣāntaritaḥ kālo yo yo vyartho gato mama ||25||
śivānavekṣaṇāttasya prāyaścittaṃ karoti ca |
iti sañcintayantyeva sevāṃ tatyāja naiva sā ||26 ||
jalābhilāṣiṇī śaṃbhunāmāmṛtaṃ pibatyapi |
nānyaddidṛkṣiṇī tasyā akṣiṇī śrutige hyapi ||27||
tasyāḥ karṇau śivaśabdetaraśabdagrahau na vai |
atīva sundarau hastau śivārthaṃ mālikākarau |||28||
nānyatra caraṇau tasyāścarataḥ sukhavāñcchayā |
nāmāntaraṃ na gṛhṇāti kvacidanyasya kasyacit || 29||
śivaṃ śaṃbhuṃ haraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ satīpatim |
paraṃ patiṃ ca raṭati svāminaṃ praṇavābhidham ||1.471.30||
rasanā naiva jānāti tasyā anyada rasāntaram |
sammārjanaṃ raṃgamālāḥ prāsādaṃ paritaḥ sadā ||3 1 ||
vidadhāti mādhavī sā pratimāpūjanaṃ mudā |
pātrāṇāṃ śodhanaṃ nityaṃ mandirasya prasevanam ||32||
ye ke’pi ca hare bhaktimantasteṣāṃ samarcikā |
śuśrūṣayati nityaṃ tān pitṛbuddhyātibhaktitaḥ ||33||
vaiśākhasya caturdaśyāmekavāraṃ tu mādhavī |
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā divopavāsasadvratā ||34||
bhaktyā militabhakteṣu prātargateṣu vai tataḥ |
sammārjanādikaṃ kṛtvā śaṃbhumabhyarcya bhāvataḥ ||35||
gāyantī madhuraṃ gītaṃ nṛtyantī nijalīlayā |
dhyāyantī śrīhariṃ kṛṣṇamoṃkāreśvarabimbake ||36||
atīva dravabhāvena paśyatāṃ tu tapasvinām |
anenaiva śarīreṇa pārthivena mahāmatiḥ ||37||
tatraivoṃkāramūtā sā layaṃ yātā rasātmikā |
tatra jyotiṣi sā bālā jyotirmayyapi sā satī || 38||
vaiśākhaśuklapakṣasya caturdaśyā pativratā |
divyabhāvaṃ gatā tatra śaṃbhustasyā vimuktaye ||39||
dadau tasyai kṛṣṇamantraṃ tulasīmālikāṃ gale |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ ||1.471.40 ||
mantraṃ trivāraṃ tilakaṃ vaiṣṇavītvaṃ dadau haraḥ |
caturbhujā satī bhūtvā yayau golokamīśvarī ||4 1 ||
matsyodarītaṭe kṣetre goghaṭṭaṃ ca pativratāḥ |
snānti divye kṛṣṇadevālaye kurvanti darśanam ||42||
ghanaśyāmasya ye lokā akṣaraṃ te prayānti vai |
pañcanade tu prāk snātvā tata oṃkārasannidhau ||43||
matsyodarīṃ tataḥ snātvā goghaṭṭe tu tataḥ param |
matsyodaryudyānadakṣe śrīghanaśyāmamandire ||44||
lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ kāśīviśveśvaraṃ prapūjya ca |
gaṇeśaṃ hanumantaṃ ca natvā mukto bhavatyapi ||45||
yadāprabhati viśveśo mandarādāgato’bhavat |
kāśyāmānandavanake lakṣmīnārāyaṇo’pyaham ||46||
matsyodarītaṭe saptaśikharāḍhye sumandire |
padmākāre mahāramye kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāhvayaḥ ||47||
yo’haṃ golokadhāmasthaḥ kāmbhareyo’tra bhūtale |
so’haṃ tatra nivasāmi pratimāyāṃ tvayā saha ||48||
mama nāma sadā viprā japanti tatra śāśvatam |
lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ tathā priye ||49 ||
viśveśvaraṃ tathauṃkāraṃ pūjayanti ca paṇḍitāḥ |
yāvannendriyavaikalyaṃ yāvannaivāyuṣaḥ kṣayaḥ ||1.471.5 0 ||
yāvatsuyogaḥ puṇyasya mānasasyātibhāvanā |
tāvat sevyaḥ prayatnena mokṣado bhagavān hariḥ ||5 1 ||
ya ānandavane śaṃbhoḥ śiśriyuḥ śrīniketanam |
acalā śrīrna muñcet tānmahāsaukhyapradāyinī ||52||
imamadhyāyamākarṇya janāḥ śrīśvaramānasāḥ |
vimuktāḥ sarvapāpebhyo’kṣuraṃ padamavāpnuyuḥ |||53 ||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne maṇḍūkyāḥ śivaprasādādane maraṇottaraṃ gāndharvītvaṃ śivapātivratyena śivālaye gāyantyā mādhavyāstasyā mokṣa ityādinirūpaṇanāmaikasaptatyadhikacatuśśakṛtayugasantāne modhyāyaḥ ||47 1 ||

<1.472>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi tathā tvanyāṃ kathāṃ pārāvatībhavām |
devālaye nivasantyāḥ pārāvatyāstu bhartari || 1 ||
pātivratyena dharmeṇa sevayā toṣaṇena ca |
devadevaprasādena bhuktirmuktirbabhūvatuḥ || 2 ||
nāmnā rathantare kalpe trilocanasya mandire |
pīṭhe vīrajake kṣetre ratnasātau suśobhite || 3 ||
dedīpyamānasauvarṇakalaśaiḥ saṃvirājite |
śṛṃge pārāvatadvandvaṃ vasati sma kṛtālayam || 4 ||
prātaḥ sāyaṃ ca madhyāhne kurvānnityaṃ pradakṣiṇām |
uḍḍīyamānaṃ paritaḥ pakṣavātairitastataḥ || |5 ||
rajaḥ prāsādasaṃlagnaṃ dūrīkaroti sarvadā |
trilocaneti satataṃ nāma kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam || 6 ||
bhaktairudāhṛtaṃ tābhyāṃ tayoḥ kaṇātithīkṛtam |
maṃgalārātrikaṃ tayorbhaktiṃ vardhayati dhruvam || 7 ||
divā bhaktajanākīrṇaṃ prāsādaṃ parito’nvaham |
taṇḍulādi carantau tau prakurvāte pradakṣiṇam || 8 ||
prāsādikajalaṃ tā ca pibataḥ sma nalāgatam |
tayoritthaṃ vicaratormahādevasamīpataḥ || 9 ||
agād bahutithiḥ kālo dvijayoḥ sādhuceṣṭayoḥ |
atha devālayaskandhe gavākṣāntargatau kvacit || 1.472.10 ||
śyeno dṛṣṭvāpatad vegāt pārāvātajighṛkṣukaḥ |
uḍḍīya tau gatāvantardevālayaṃ rirakṣayā || 11 ||
śyeno vilokayāmāsa tatra tayorvinirgamam |
kathaṃ yugapadetau me grāhyau syātāmacintayat || 12||
sāyaṃ śyeno yayau sthānāntaraṃ labdhau na tau yataḥ |
atha pārāvatī dakṣā patisevāparāyaṇā || 1 3||
kālaṃ pakṣiṇaṃ saṃlakṣya prāha pārāvataṃ patim |
priya pārāvata prājña śyenaḥ sa prabalo ripuḥ || 14||
bhakṣayiṣyati nau nātha yāvaḥ sthānāntaraṃ prabho |
vidhavātvaṃ vidhuratvaṃ yadvā dvayorvināśanam || 15||
śyenena cet kṛtaṃ syādvai mahāpattimayaṃ bhavet| |
patnīvrataṃ tava svāmin mama svāmivrataṃ tathā || 16||
vilupyeta paro lokaḥ pratibadhyeta tena vai |
iti śrutvā kalaravyāḥ sādhvyā prāha patistu tām || 17|
durgātmamandire sādhvi nāsti cintā harāśraye |
vastavyaṃ tvadyadivasāt sunipūṇatayā priye || 18||
durgastho nābhibhūyetābalo’pi kenacit kvacit |
mandiraṃ durgarūpaṃ vai vartate tatra kiṃ bhayam || 19||
naitādṛśaṃ vai lapsyeta svāśrayaṃ susthalāntaram |
iti pārāvatavākyaṃ śrutvā pārāvatī tadā ||1.472.20||
maunamālambya tatraiva patyuḥ pādārpitekṣaṇā |
hitavartmopadiśyāpi priyapriyacikīrṣayā ||21 ||
sādhvyā joṣaṃ samāstheyaṃ kāryaṃ patyurvacaḥ sadā |
anyedyurapyathāyātaḥ śyeno’paśyat sa dampatīm ||22||
aparicchinnayā dṛṣṭyā prāsādaṃ parito bhraman |
anādhṛṣyau śṛṃgamadhye sthitau matvā yayau hi saḥ ||23||
gate’tha nabhasi śyene punaḥ pārāvatī patim |
provāca preyasī nātha dṛṣṭo duṣṭo vighātakaḥ ||24||
avaśyaṃ sa kadācidvai nau vighnaṃ hi kariṣyati |
tasmāt sthānāntaraṃ nātha gantavyaṃ sukhadaṃ bhavet ||25||
tasyā vākyaṃ samākarṇya punaḥ kalaravo’bravīt |
kiṃ kariṣyatyasau mugdhe durge svargasamaṃ hi nau ||26||
yatra tasya praveśo na na jānāti praveśikām |
devasaudhāntare vāso yogakṣemakaraḥ priye ||27||
yadi daivādgagane’pi bhavedākasmiko’bhigaḥ |
tathāpi vedmi tā gatīryā na vetti mamāhitaḥ ||28||
praḍīnoḍḍīnasaṇḍīnakāṇḍavyāḍakapāṭikāḥ |
sraṃsanīmaṇḍalavatī gatayo’ṣṭāvudāhṛtāḥ ||29||
bhramaṇaṃ recanaṃ syandamūrdhvayānaṃ ca vakratā |
patanaṃ mūrchanaṃ baddhaṃ gatayo’ṣṭau tathāparāḥ ||1.472.3 0 ||
sarvā jānāmi me tatra kauśalyaṃ sarvathā priye |
yathā tathāmbare nāsti pakṣiṇo’nyasya matsamam ||3 1 ||
sukhena tiṣṭha kā cintā mayi jīvati te priye |
itipatyurvacaḥ śrutvā sā sthitā mūkavat satī ||32||
aparedyurapi śyenastatra padmaśilopari |
kiyantaṃ kālamāsādyopaviṣṭo’tiprahṛṣṭahṛt ||33||
mārgaṃ tvantaḥpraveśasya bhramitvā samalokya ca |
punaryayau vyomamārgaṃ dṛṣṭvā tvantaḥsthitau tu tau ||34||
atha bhītā satī pārāvatī prāha punaḥ patim |
priya sthānamidaṃ tyājyaṃ śatrudṛṣṭividūṣitam ||35||
asau krūro’tivelaṃ vai samāyāti jighṛkṣayā |
śrutvā priyāvacaḥ prāha kiṃ kariṣyatyasau priye ||36||
yoṣitāṃ tu nisargo’yaṃ prāyaśo bhīruvṛttitā |
athetaredyurapi sa śyenaḥ prāpto jighṛkṣayā ||37||
yayorabhimukhastatra sthito yāmadvayāvadhim |
punarvilokya tau śīghraṃ yayau tataśca sāha tam ||38||
nātha sthānāntaraṃ yāvo mṛtyurnau nikaṭo’tra yat |
gatiste’bhihitā naikavidhātra kiṃ tavāgrahaḥ ||39||
yatra kvāpi nivatsyāvaḥ siddhirudyogasanmukhā |
sopasargaṃ nijaṃ deśaṃ yo na tyajati mānavaḥ ||1.472.40||
sa paṃgurnāśamāpnoti balyapi daivavarjitaḥ |
priyoditaṃ khago naiva mene bhāvidaśārditaḥ ||41 ||
prāha mā bhaiḥ khagāt sādhvi sthānaṃ naitādṛśaṃ param |
athāparasminnahani sa śyenaḥ prātareva tu ||42||
tanmārgadeśamāsādya sāyaṃ yāvat sthito balaḥ |
sūryāste tu khage yāte prāha pārāvatī patim ||43 ||
nātha nirgamanasyāyaṃ kālo’stīdaṃ gṛhaṃ tyaja |
tyaktvā māmapi niryāhi paścād yogyaṃ bhaviṣyati ||44||
tvayi jīvati duṣprāpyaṃ na kiñcijjagatītale |
punardārāḥ punarmitraṃ punarvasu punargṛham ||45||
ātmā ced rakṣitaḥ puṃsā dārairapi dhanairapi |
priyo bandhurayamātmā rakṣaṇīyo mahaddhanam ||46||
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāmayamātmārjakaḥ paraḥ |
yāvadātmani vai kṣemaṃ tāvat kṣemaṃ jagattraye ||47||
ataḥ kṣemakaraṃ vākyaṃ mamaśrutvā nayānvitam |
ito’nyatra vraja svāminnanyathā māṃ smariṣyasi ||48||
ityukto’pi sa vai patnyā patisevāsumedhayā |
na niryayau tataḥ sthānād bhavitryā prativāritaḥ ||49||
athoṣasi samāyātaḥ śyenaḥ prāha prasahya tam |
āgaccha sthānato bāhye tvadya bhakṣyo bhaviṣyasi |||1.472.50|||
yadvā kṣudhitaścāhaṃ vai svārthī kaṣṭaṃ na paśyati |
āgacchāmi gṛhāntaste priye vā mārayāmi vā ||51 ||
ityuktvāntaḥpraviśyaiva śyenena caraṇena saḥ |
dhṛtaḥ khagastataścatrcvā balinā sā dhṛtā khagī |||52||
ākrośaṃ cakratustau vai na vai kenāpi rakṣitau |
śyenastaṃ bhakṣituṃ sthānaṃ nirvighnaṃ cintayanmuhuḥ ||53||
vyomni saṃbhramaṇaṃ cakre tāvat khagyā sumedhayā |
kathitaṃ nātha vacanaṃ tvantimaṃ me’nuvartaya ||54||
cañcvā tvātmavimuktyai tvamareḥ pādaṃ dṛḍhaṃ daśa |
ityādiṣṭaścakāraivaṃ śyenaḥ pīḍāṃ jagāma ha ||55||
atyatidaṃśitaḥ śyenaścitkārān kṛtavām̐stadā |
pārāvatī mukhāttasya niḥsṛtā kalayā balāt ||56||
sāpi pṛṣṭa muhuścañcvā padbhyāṃ jaghāna ghātakam |
tena pārāvataścāpi muktastvākulitena vai ||57||
ubhābhyāṃ mūrchitaḥ śyeno vipadyavi samudyamāt |
durbale’pyudyamavati phalaṃ bhāgyaṃ dadāti vai ||58||
praśaṃsantyudyamaṃ tasmāt sarvāvasthāsu rāgiṇaḥ |
atha tau kṣatamāpannāvapi bhāgyavaśāt khalu ||59||
jīvavantau sarayvāśca nadyāstaṭe manohare |
ciraṃ sāketanagare sthitvā mṛtyumupāgatau ||1.472.60||
pakṣī tatrābhavad vidyādharo mandāradāmajaḥ |
anekavidyānilayo nāmnā parimalālayaḥ ||61 ||
kaumāraṃ vaya āsādya śivabhaktiparo’bhavat |
niyamaṃ cātijagrāha brahmacaryaparāyaṇaḥ ||62||
ekapatnīvrataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ cariṣyāmi ṛtusthitam |
yāvajjīvaṃ mahādevamanarcyāśnāmi nāṇvapi ||63||
evaṃ karoti nityaṃ sa niyamaṃ tvatha sā khagī |
ratnāvalīti nāmnābhūnnāgakanyā satīvṛṣā ||64||
kāmarūpadharā nityaṃ sāketāraṇyavāsinī |
tasyāḥ sakhīdvayaṃ tvāsīt prabhāvatī kalāvatī ||65||
surūpe yauvanaṃ prāpte kāmarūpadhare śubhe |
ratnāvalī yuvatyapi jagrāha niyamaṃ satī ||66 ||
śaṃbhuṃ prātaḥ saṭā dṛṣṭvā maunaṃ tyakṣyāmi nānyathā |
dine dine tu sā naikavarṇagandhasupuṣpakaiḥ ||67||
mālācandanadīpādyaiḥ pūjayitvā haraṃ tataḥ |
tisro’pi gītaṃ gāyanti lasadgāndhārasundaram ||68||
rāsamaṇḍalabhedaiśca lāsyaṃ tisro’pi kurvate |
vīṇāveṇumṛdaṃgāṃśca layatālavicakṣaṇāḥ |||69||
vādayanti mudā yuktāstisro nāgakumārikāḥ |
vicitragandhamālābhiḥ sammārjanavilepanaiḥ ||1.472.70||
sevayanti haraṃ nityaṃ nṛtyagītasubhojanaiḥ |
vaiśākhe tvekadā tisrastṛtīyāyāmupoṣitāḥ ||71 ||
cakrurjāgaraṇaṃ rātrau prātaḥ pūjāṃ pracakrire |
sādhūn saṃbhojayāmāsustato madhyāhnake kṣaṇe |72||
naivedyaṃ tā dadurmiṃṣṭaṃ jalaṃ ca śaṃkarāya vai |
ārārtrikaṃ pracakruśca puṣpāñjalīn daduryadā ||73||
tāvacchrīśaṃkarastuṣṭaḥ sākṣāt tāsāṃ babhūva ha |
śuddhakarpūragaurāṃgo jaṭāmukuṭamaṇḍalaḥ ||74||
satyadhiśritavāmorurnāgayajñopavītikaḥ |
prasannavadano devaḥ kāmārirmokṣadāyakaḥ ||75||
taṃ vilokya tu tāḥ kanyā babhūvuḥ pulakāṃkitāḥ |
vavandire tuṣṭuvuśca sannakaṇṭhyo’tigadgadam ||76||
jaya śaṃbho jaya bhaktavatsala prajaya prabho |
jaya sādhvīpate paśupate viśvapate jaya ||77||
jaya mokṣapate bhaktapate pāvana śaṃkara |
jayaste’stu namaste’stu namastubhyaṃ namo namaḥ ||78||
ityuktvā daṇḍavat bhūmau praṇipetuḥ kumārikāḥ |
tāḥ samāśliṣya bhagavān samuvāca kṛpānidhiḥ ||79||
suto mandāranāmno yo nāmnā parimalālayaḥ |
patirvidyādharavaro bhavatīnāṃ bhaviṣyati ||1.472.80||
ciraṃ vidyādhare loke bhogān bhuktvā samantataḥ |
tato nirvedamāpannā mokṣasiddhimavāpsyatha ||8 1 ||
yūyaṃ tisro’pi me bhaktāḥ sa ca vidyādharo mama |
catvaro’pyeta evātra prānte mokṣamavāpsyatha ||82||
janmāntare purā sevā yuṣmābhirvihitā mama |
tenāpi vihitaṃ dāsyaṃ vrataṃ brahmavrataṃ tathā ||83||
tena puṇyena bhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayam |
gururme bhavatīnāṃ ca mokṣadātā bhaviṣyati ||84||
bhavantu ca mahābhāgyavatyaḥ kṛṣṇapativratāḥ |
ahaṃ japāmi sarveśaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ patim ||85||
bhavatyo’pi bhajantyenaṃ gṛhṇantvasya manuṃ param |
prasādaṃ ca jalaṃ tvetad gṛhṇantvacyutasevitam ||86||
iti kṛtvā harastābhyo dadau manuṃ sumokṣadam |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa svāmine namaḥ ||87||
trivāraṃ sampradāyaiva dadau tulasikādalam |
tulasīmālikāṃ cāpi kaṇṭhe kare ca sandadau ||88||
binduṃ dadau lalāṭe’tha candanasya haraḥ svayam |
evaṃ datvātu vidhinā pratimāṃ maṇinirmitām ||89||
prāha svasti sadā cāstvakhaṇḍasaubhāgyamacyute |
vaiṣṇavītvaṃ sadā kṛṣṇe dāsyaṃ pativrataṃ tathā ||1.472.90||
ārādhanaṃ tathā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe’stu sarvadā |
patisevā kṛṣṇasevā vinā bhedaṃ sadāstu vaḥ ||91 ||
ityuktvā śirasi datvā karaṃ tvadṛśyatāṃ gataḥ |
tāstu prahṛṣṭahṛdayā gatvā gṛhaṃ jagurmudā |||92||
divyabhāvaṃ samāpannā bhittyādyāvaraṇādibhiḥ |
aniruddhā vyomamārgagatayaḥ kamalā yathā ||93||
pūrvajātismarāḥ satyo brahmacaryaparāyaṇāḥ |
kṛṣṇabhaktiparāḥ śaṃbhorādeśāt sāttvatīmukhāḥ ||94||
jīvanmuktāḥ prasañjātāḥ svatantragatikā iha |
lakṣmi pārāvataḥ pūrve dvijo nārāyaṇāhvayaḥ |||95|||
āmuṣyāyaṇaputro’bhūt pitṛśuśrūṣaṇavrataḥ |
sarpadaṃṣṭo mṛtaścātha so’yaṃ pārāvato’bhavat ||96||
cārāyaṇasya putryau dve bhavānī gautamī tathā |
āmuṣyāyanaputrasya patnī nārāyaṇasya te ||97||
vaidhavyaduḥkhamāpanne dainyagraste babhūvatuḥ |
atharṣeḥ kasyacid daivādāśrame paramādbhute ||98||
raṃbhāphalāni saṃgṛhya khādataḥ sma tadā muneḥ |
śāpātte kanyake naṣṭe vānaryau te babhūvatuḥ ||99||
jale patitvā tatyajatuḥ prāṇām̐stīrthottame tataḥ |
te jāte nāgakanye vai devālayāśramāśrayāt ||1.472.1 0 0||
kṛṣṇadharmapare sādhvyau prabhāvatī kalāvatī |
parimalālayavidyādharapatnyāḥ sakhīdvayam || 101 ||
pitṛbhyāṃ te premavatyau jñātvā vidyādhare śubhe |
parimalālaye paścāttasmai datte vivāhite || 1 02||
evaṃ patnītrayaṃ ratnāvalī prabhā kalāvatī |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe raktā pātivratyaparāyaṇā || 103 ||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ nityaṃ bhajante sma sukhānvitāḥ |
pūjāṃ japaṃ ca naivedyaṃ stutiṃ nīrājanaṃ kṣamām || 1 04||
puṣpāṃjaliṃ prakurvanti nityaṃ naimittikotsavān |
kārtike kṛṣṇapakṣe tā aṣṭamyāṃ kṛṣṇapūjanam || 1 05||
jayantīṃ tā abhipretya kṛṣṇavrataṃ pracakrire |
golokāttu svayaṃ kṛṣṇo rādhāramāprabhāpatiḥ || 106 ||
ājagāma vimānena netuṃ tāḥ patisaṃyutāḥ |
divyaṃ svaṃ darśanaṃ datvā nītvā vimānakottame || 1 07 ||
yayau golokamevāsau muktiṃ dāsyātmikāṃ dadau |
vad lakṣmi na kṛṣṇāgre bhaktānāṃ bhinnabhāvanā || 1 08||
yatra kvāpi prasūto’pi bhakto haripadaṃ labhet |
sarve vai bālakāstasya kṛṣṇānārāyaṇasya vai || 1 09||
taṃ bhajitvā prayāntyeva paramaṃ dhāma śāśvatam |
śrīkṛṣṇasya kathāmetāṃ śrutvā pāpād vimucyate || 1.472.1 10 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pārāvatadampatyau śivamandirāśrayeṇa vidyādharajanma lalabhatuḥ, parimalālayavidyādharasya ratnāvalīprabhāvatīkalāvatīpatnītrayam, kārtikakṛṣṇāṣṭamīvratena kṛṣṇapātivratyena catvāro’pi te muktiṃ jagmuritinirūpaṇanāmā dvāsaptatyadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||472||

<1.473>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi dharmapīṭhe kṣetre tvānandakānane |
camatkāro’bhavad dharmatapasyāyā vadāmi tam || 1 ||
dharmapīṭhaṃ taduktaṃ vai kṣetre tvānandakānane |
tatpīṭhadarśanādeva janaḥ pāpaiḥ pramucyate || 2 ||
purā vivasvataḥ putro yamī dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ |
tapastatāpa tatkṣetre lokānugrahakāraṇāt || 3 ||
śiśire jalamadhyastho varṣāsvabhrāvakāśakaḥ |
tapatau pañcavahnisthaḥ kadācittvativātagaḥ || 4 ||
pādāgrāṅguṣṭhabhūsparśī bahukālaṃ sa tasthivān |
ekapādasthitaḥ so’pi bahukālaṃ tataḥ punaḥ || |9 ||
samīrābhyavahartāsīt tataḥ papau jalaṃ manāk |
kuśāgramātreṇa tadbindūn tataścāhāravarjitaḥ || 6 ||
divyāṃ caturyugīmitthaṃ sa nināya tapaścaran |
caturguṇaṃ didṛkṣuḥ śrīśaṃkaraṃ vai samādhinā || 7 ||
śaṃkarastasya tapasā santuṣṭaḥ sthiracetasaḥ |
yayau tasmai varān dātu dharmarūpāya sākṣiṇe || 8 ||
pratyavocattu taṃ dharma varaṃ vṛṇu yathepsitam |
dṛṣṭvā sa māṃ praṇanāma cakāra stavanaṃ tathā || 9 ||
vavre saṃhārakṛdrūpaṃ mama draṣṭuṃ tadānaghaḥ |
mayā pradarśitaṃ tasmai bhayānakaṃ mamaiva tat || 1.473.1 0||
mahārudrasvarūpaṃ yat saṃkarṣaṇasvarūpakam |
atha tvaṃ matsvarūpo’si dharmarājo bhaveti vai || 1 1|
samastadehināṃ dharmādhikāre śāsanaṃ kuru |
karmasākṣī ca jantūnāṃ bhava sarvajña ityapi || 1 2||
dharmakṣetramidaṃ sarvavāñchāprapūrakaṃ tathā |
mokṣadaṃ bhavatu prāṇipāpaprajvālanakṣamam || 13|
dharmeśvaraṃ mama rūpaṃ tava nāmnā bhavatvapi |
gṛhāṇa tvaṃ kṛṣṇamantraṃ vaiṣṇavaḥ paramo bhava || 14||
ityuktvā dharmarājāya dadau mantraṃ maheśvaraḥ |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya brahmaṇe namaḥ || 15|
mālāṃ kaṇṭhe ca vṛndāyā dadau kare japārthikām |
lalāṭe candrakaṃ cakre tvāśīrvādān dadau bahūn || 16 |
nyāyopadeśaṃ bahudhā dadau śrīśaṃkaraḥ svayam |
sukhaṃ dharmaphalaṃ proktaṃ svecchāviṣayameva tat || 17|
duḥkhaṃ tvicchāvighātau vai duṣkarmaṇāṃ tu tatphalam |
svargaṃ sukhaṃ tu devānāmārādhanena jāyate || 18|||
sādhanānāṃ sukhaṃ pūrṇaṃ dānenaiva prajāyate |
anyātmanāṃ pratuṣṭyaivānandārthi jīvanaṃ bhavet || 1 9|||
parapīḍākaraṃ sarvaṃ svasyāpi duḥkhadaṃ bhavet |
paropakāraḥ kartavyaḥ kartavyaṃ tvātmadarśanam |||1.473.20|||
kṛṣṇārādhanabhaktyādi kartavyaṃ mokṣaṇāya ca |
loke vai sampadaḥ puṃsāṃ prāgdānena bhavanti hi ||21 |
yanna dattaṃ tanna labhyaṃ tasmād dharmaṃ samācaret |
kṛtasya phaladānaṃ vai sarvatra niyamaḥ kṛtaḥ ||22|
śubhasya cāśubhasyāpi tvayā kāryo vinirṇayaḥ |
tatra tatra phalaṃ tebhyo dāsyatyeva janārdanaḥ ||23|
indriyāṇāṃ svabhāvena bhogaḥ pāpaṃ na tanmatam |
anyāyena kṛto bhogaḥ pāpaṃ prasahya jāyate ||24|
prasannabhāvanājanyaṃ karma santoṣakārakam |
adrohaṃ naiva pāpāya puṇyaṃ santoṣadaṃ tu tat ||25|
kṛṣṇe samarpaṇaṃ sarvaṃ niṣkāmaṃ mokṣadaṃ tu tat |
tasmād dharmaḥ sadā kāryaḥ kāryaṃ mokṣapradaṃ vratam ||26||
parātmahiṃsanaṃ tvanyadrohastathānyanindanam |
anyāpaharaṇaṃ tadvadudvejanaṃ parātmanām |||27|
etatpāpapradaṃ proktaṃ tadanyatpuṇyakṛtparam |
teṣāṃ phalaṃ yathāyogyaṃ dehi dharmabhṛtāṃ vara ||28|
yāhītyukvā ca pāṇibhyāṃ mṛḍaḥ pasparśa taṃ vṛṣam |,
sūryaputraḥ punaḥ prāha he nātha prārthayāmyaham ||29|
he śaṃbho kīraḍimbhānāṃ matpuraḥprāptajanmanām |
amīṣāṃ pitṛhīnānāṃ śukī mātā mṛtiṃ gatā ||1.473.3 0||
śukaḥ śyenena sahasā bhakṣitaśca tato mayā |
rakṣitānāmanāthānāmitihāsakathāvidām ||3 1 ||
varado bhava deveśetyuktvā maunaparo’bhavat |
atha śaṃbhuḥ śukānāha ko varo bhavatāṃ kṛte ||32||
deyo mayeti saṃśrutvā śukaśāvā jagustu tam |
pakṣiṇāmapi deveśa darśanaṃ te mahaddhanam ||33||
etattapasviyogena janmāntarasahasrajām |
kathāṃ vidmo vayaṃ nātha smarāmo devakoṭiṣu ||34||
daityeṣu bhogiṣu niśācareṣu kinnareṣu ca |
vidyādhreṣu gandharveṣu manuṣyeṣu jaleṣu ca ||35||
sthaleṣvapi vaneṣvapi vivareṣu bhuvo’ntare |
yācitṛṣu ca dātṛṣu rakṣakeṣu ca ghātiṣu || 36||
sukhiteṣu duḥkhiteṣu mūrkheṣu paṇḍiteṣu ca |
svāmiṣu sevakeṣvanyabhūtātmakeṣu śākhiṣu ||37||
janmāni tatprakāryāṇi smarāmo’sya prabhāvataḥ |
ito yonestato yonau tato yonestato’nyataḥ || 38 ||
pinākin kvāpi na prāpi sukhaleśo manāgapi |
idānīṃ tvāṃ samīkṣyaiva kṛtakṛtyā babhūvima ||39||
athāpi cedbhaved deyaṃ varadānaṃ kṛpā tava |
dehi jñānaṃ yena muktā bhavāmo bhavabandhanāt ||1.473.40||
karāmalakavat sarvaṃ brahmāṇḍagolakādikam |
asmadvāggocare’styeva dharmasānnidhyasevanāt ||41 ||
dharmarājasya tapasā jātāḥ smo jñānabhājanam |
śrutveti kīrabālānāṃ tānuvāca śivāpatiḥ ||42|||
kāśyāmānandavanake dharmapīṭhe mama gṛham |
mokṣalakṣmīvilāsākhyaṃ maṇiratnādinirmitam ||43||
patattriṇo’pi mucyante yatkurvāṇāḥ pradakṣiṇam |
bindumādhavarūpeṇa dharmanade vasāmyaham ||44||
naye pañcanadasnātān tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam |
dharmapīṭhe bālakīrā yūyaṃ vai jñānabhājanam ||45||
jātāḥ stha tat pragṛhṇīdhvaṃ manuṃ vai vaiṣṇavaṃ param |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye namaḥ ||46||
gṛhṇīdhvaṃ tulasīmālāṃ japatānvahamacyutam |
dehānte divyayānena gantāstho’cyutadhāma yat ||47||
ityuktvā ca kīrān kṛtvā vaiṣṇavān bhagavān haraḥ |
antardhānaṃ jagāmātha dharmakṣetre ca te kīrāḥ ||48||
bhajante śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ rādhāpatiṃ prabhum |
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitākathāṃ vācayanti ca ||49||
nityaṃ kalpāntarakathāḥ śrāvayanti janān śukāḥ |
kāmarūpadharā vijñā vidvāṃso vai dvijottamāḥ ||1.473.50||
evaṃ kṛṣṇapātivratyaparāste hyabhavan sadā |
kṛṣṇapūjāṃ kṛṣṇakathāṃ cakrurnityaṃ vihaṃgamāḥ ||51 ||
tatraikadā samāyātā paulomī vratakāminī |
manorathavrataṃ cakre tatāpa paramaṃ tapaḥ ||52||
nityaṃ tāṃ śrāvayantyete kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśinīm |
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitātmikāṃ mokṣadāyinīm ||53||
kathāṃ śrutvā śacī bhaktyārcayat kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam |
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhirdharmakṣetre nadītaṭe ||54||
pañcanade pūjayitvā śivaṃ viśveśvaraṃ vibhum |
śacī nityaṃ pūjayati karoti nartanaṃ tathā ||55||
gītena sarahasyena kalakaṇṭhīkalena ca |
tadgānenātisantuṣṭo haraḥ sākṣād babhūva ha ||56||
uvāca tvaṃ varaṃ brūhi prasanno’smi pulomaje |
śacī prāha prasannaścenmanorathaṃ prapūraya ||57||
sarvadeveṣu yo mānyaḥ sarvadeveṣu sundaraḥ |
yāyajūkeṣu sarveṣu yaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ so’stu me patiḥ ||58||
yathābhilaṣitaṃ rūpaṃ yathābhilaṣitaṃ sukham |
yathābhilaṣitaṃ cāyuḥ prasanno dehi me bhava ||59||
yadā yadā tu patyā me saṅgaḥ syāt sukhavāñcchayā |
tadā tadā tu taddehaṃ tyaktvānyadehamāpnuyām ||1.473.60 ||
bharturvyaye’pi vaidhavyaṃ kṣaṇamātraṃ na me bhavet |
pātivratyaṃ śāśvataṃ me patināśe’pi cāstu vai ||61||
itivṛṇomi bhagavannakhaṇḍitasubhāgyatām |
etacchrutvā mahādevo jahāsa samuvāca tām ||62||
kuru vrataṃ manorathatṛtīyāyāḥ śubhe śuci |
tena vratena cīrṇena mahāsaubhāgyadena tu ||63||
avaśyaṃ bhavitā ceṣṭastava caivaṃ manorathaḥ |
pūjyā viśvabhujā gaurī bhujaviṃśatiśālinī ||64||
varado’bhavahastaśca sākṣasūtraḥ samodakaḥ |
devyāḥ purastād vratinyā pūjya āśāvināyakaḥ ||65||
caitraśukladvitīyāyāṃ gṛhṇīyānniyamaṃ śubham |
brahmacaryaṃ bhūśayanaṃ prātarutthāya vai śuci ||66||
aśokavṛkṣasya śubhaṃ kuryādvai dantadhāvanam |
anyat sarvaṃ nityakarma vidhāya snānamācaret ||67||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāṃśaṃ taṃ gaṇeśaṃ samapūjya ca |
ghṛtapūrān vinivedya gaurīpūjāṃ samācaret ||68||
aśokakusumaiḥ śreṣṭhairaśokavartidhūpanaiḥ |
dīpairnaivedyakairnānāvidhaiḥ saṃbhojayet satīm ||69||
evaṃ kuṃkumaśobhāḍhyā hyekabhuktaṃ vrataṃ caret |
evaṃ caitratṛtīyāyāmārabhya phālgunāvadhim ||1.473.70||
dvādaśatṛtīyānāṃ vai vrataṃ manorathapradam |
yathālabdhopacārairvai pavitraiḥ pracared vratam ||71 ||
vratasampūrtaye kuryāt sthaṇḍile’gnisamarcanam |
śatamaṣṭādhikaṃ homaṃ tilājyādibhirācaret ||72||
sadaiva nakte pūjoktā sadā nakte tu bhojanam |
nakta eva hi homo’yaṃ nakta eva kṣamāpanam ||73||
namo’stu te viśvabhuje pūrayāśu manorathān |
nama āśāgaṇeśāya mama dehi manoratham ||74||
ācāryaṃ pūjayed dānaṃ dadyāt yathābalaṃ vratī |
dadyāt payasvinīṃ gāṃ ca vratasya paripūrtaye ||75||
prātaścaturthyāṃ caturo bhojayitvā kumārakān |
yadvā dvādaśa saṃpūjya satībuddhyā kumārikāḥ ||76||
dadyād dānāni vidhinā vratametat sunirmalam |
patnīṃ manoramāṃ kulyāṃ manovṛttyanusāriṇīm ||77||
tāriṇīṃ duḥkhasaṃsārasāgarasya pativratām |
kurvannetadvrataṃ varṣaṃ kumāraṃ prāpnuyāt sphuṭam ||78||
kumārī patimāpnoti svāḍhyaṃ sarvaguṇādhikam |
suvāsinī labhetputrān patyuḥ saukhyamakhaṇḍitam ||79||
durbhagā subhagā syācca daridrā syāddhanānvitā |
vidhavāpi na vaidhavyaṃ punarāpnoti kutracit ||1.473.80||
gurviṇī tu śubhaṃ putraṃ labhate sucirāyuṣam |
yo yo manoratho yasya taṃ taṃ dhruvaṃ sa vindati ||8 1 ||
vrataṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vinā caindri naiva siddhyati sarvathā |
tasmād gṛhāṇa mantraṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai ||82||
vaiṣṇavī bhava cendrāṇi tataḥ siddhimavāpsyasi |
avaiṣṇavakṛtaṃ vyarthaṃ vrataṃ dānaṃ japastapaḥ ||83||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ |
japaṃ kuru sadā tanvi gṛhāṇa tulasīsrajam ||84||
kaṇṭhe dhāraya vṛndāyā mālāṃ binduṃ lalāṭake |
hṛdaye śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ svasvāminaṃ patim ||85||
evaṃ kṛtvā vraja gehaṃ kuru vrataṃ phalaṃ bhavet |
arundhatyā vasiṣṭho’pi labdho’triranasūyayā ||86||
sunītyottānapādācca dhruvaḥ prāpto’ṅgajottamaḥ |
sunīterdurbhagatvaṃ tu punarasmād vratād gatam ||87|
caturbhujaḥ patiḥ prāptaḥ kṣīrābdhikanyayā tathā |
tasmād vrataṃ prakartavyaṃ vaiṣṇavyā tattathā kuru |||88|.
ityuktā sā śacī jātā vaiṣṇavī prayayau gṛham |
vrataṃ kṛtavatī sādhvī kṛṣṇapativratānvitā |||89|.
brahmacaryaparā tvekabhuktavatī hi vatsaram |
bhūśayānā saniyamā vratānte cendrakāmyayā ||1.473.90||
udvāhitā surendreṇa kṛtā kalpāyuṣī satī |
yathā yathābhilaṣitaṃ tathā tasyā hyabhūt phalam || 91 ||
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi vratasya phalanaṃ śubham |
kīrabālāḥ śacī ceti vaiṣṇavāḥ kalpanāśane ||92||
yayurgolokadhāmābhidhyeya kṛṣṇapadāmbujam |
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya bhuktirmuktiḥ subhāgyatā |||92||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne sūryaputrasya tapasā dharmarājatvaṃ, kīrabālānāṃ sārvajñyaṃ, paulomyā indrapatnītvaṃ, teṣāṃ vaiṣṇavatvaṃ, tato muktiḥ, manorathavrataṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā trisaptatyadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 473 ||

<1.474>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ ramyāmamitrajinnṛpasya vai |
mayi nārāyaṇe pātivratyayuktāṃ kuṭumbinaḥ || 1 ||
amitrajinmahārājaḥ paramo vaiṣṇavo’bhavat |
sarvarājanyaguṇadhīḥ sarvadūṣaṇavarjitaḥ || 2 ||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe deve cetovṛttiṃ nidhāya saḥ |
cakāra rājyaṃ nirdvandvaṃ viṣṇubhaktiparāyaṇaḥ || 3 ||
abhunak pracurān bhogān samastān viṣṇusātkṛtān |
harerāyatanānyuccaiḥ pratisaudhaṃ pade pade || 4 ||
tasya rājye samabhavan gṛhāṇi mandirāṇi ca |
govinda gopa gopāla gopagopīśvareśvara || 5 ||
guṇātīta garuḍastha kṛpālo kamalāpate |
kṛṣṇa keśava kaṃjākṣa kīnāśabhayanāśaka || 6 ||
puruṣottama padmeśa puṇḍarīkavilocana |
pītāmbara prabhānātha pārvatīśa pareśvara || 7 ||
janārdana jayāsvāmin janmamṛtyujarāhara |
śrīvatsavakṣaḥ śrīkānta śrīprada śreyasāṃprada || 8 ||
dāmodara dayāsindho māṇikīśvara cakradhṛk |
viṣṇo nārāyaṇa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa narottama || 9 ||
akṣareśa ca rādheśa kambhareśa hṛdisthita |
ityādīni pavitrāṇi nāmāni pratimandiram || 1.474.10||
strībālavṛddhagopālavadanodīritāni tu |
śrūyante cāpi dṛśyante ramyāṇi mokṣadāni vai || 11 ||
tulasīkānanānyeva vilokyante gṛhe gṛhe |
caritrāṇi sugīyante pavitrāṇi harerjanaiḥ || 12||
saudhabhittiṣu dṛśyante pratimā līlayānvitā |
ṛte hareḥ kathāyāśca nānyā vārtā niśamyate || 1 3|||
yadrājye naiva hiṃsāsti dveṣo nāsti parasparam |
hanyante naiva cāhitāḥ kṛṣṇabhaktiparāyaṇāḥ || 14||
api bālāstathā vṛddhāstasya rāṣṭre striyo’pi ca |
payaḥpānaṃ na kurvanti samprāpya harivāsaram || 16||
paśavo’pi tṛṇāhāraṃ tyajanti harivāsare |
mahāmahotsavaḥ sarvaiḥ puraukobhirvitanyate || 16||
sa eva daṇḍyo yo bhuṃkte samprāpte harivāsare |
antyajā api tadrāṣṭre śaṃkhacakrāṃkadhāriṇaḥ || 17||
kṛṣṇa eva paro devaḥ kṛṣṇa eva parā gatiḥ |
kṛṣṇa eva paro bandhustasyāsīdavanīśituḥ || 18||
etad draṣṭuṃ nāradarṣiḥ samāyayau tadā kvacit |
rājñā samarcitaḥ prāha rājānaṃ nārado muniḥ || 1 9||
dhanyo’si kṛtakṛtyo’si mānyo’pyasi divaukasām |
sarvabhūteṣu govindaṃ yastvaṃ paśyasi bhaktarāṭ ||1.474.2 0 ||
etādṛśaṃ vilokya tvāṃ śucitvamagamaṃ tvaham |
eka eva hi sāro’tra bhaktibhāvaḥ pareśvare ||21 ||
kṛṣṇaṃ bhajantaṃ bhajante padārthāḥ sarva eva tu |
kṛṣṇe sthiratvamāptasya yogaḥ siddho vimuktidaḥ ||22||
yauvanaṃ dhanamāyuṣyaṃ jñātvā padme tu vārivat |
śāśvataṃ kṛṣṇacaraṇaṃ mokṣadaṃ prasamāśrayet ||23 ||
hṛdi netre ca jihvāyāṃ rakṣaṇīyo janārdanaḥ |
so’pi janārdano bodhyo janārdanasamāśrayāt ||24||
niṣkāmasevayā śrīśaṃ pūjayitvā ramāpatim |
puruṣottamatāṃ śreṣṭhāṃ prāpnuyānmānave bhave ||25|||
rājaṃste śrīkṛṣṇabhaktyā prasanno bhagavān hariḥ |
preṣayāmāsa māmatra bhaktakāryakaraḥ svayam || 26||
śṛṇu vidyādharaputrī kṛṣṇabhaktātisundarī |
kṛṣṇapātivratyaparā nāmnā malayagandhinī || 27||
krīḍantī piturākroḍe hṛtā kaṃkālaketunā |
dānavaścampakāvatyāṃ nagaryāmadya vartate ||28||
sa svatriśūlaghātena mariṣyanti tvayā nṛpa |
adya nidrāti paryaṃke pārśve kṛtvā triśūlakam |||29||
kanyā sā dāsyati tubhyaṃ vañcayitvā triśūlakam |
gaccha śīghraṃ kṛṣṇabhaktāṃ rakṣa hastaṃ gṛhāṇa ca ||1.474.3 0 ||
ityuktaḥ sa yayau diṣṭamārgeṇa nṛpatirgṛṇan |
kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇeti kṛṣṇeti kṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti ca ||3 1 ||
nagaryāṃ sa praviṣṭaśca yatra saudhe’sti kanyakā |
praviveśa tu taṃ saudhaṃ kanyāṃ jagāda caikalām ||32||
nāradasyopadeśena tava rakṣārthamatra vai |
samāgato’smi daityaṃ ca hantuṃ triśūlakena vai || 3 3||
sā vilokya samākarṇya viśvastābhūt sukanyakā |
darśayāmāsa taṃ śūlaṃ rājā śūlena dānavam ||34||
jaghāna śrīhariṃ gṛṇan mṛto’sau dānavo balī |
surūpaṃ rakṣakaṃ bhūpaṃ provāca madhuraṃ satī ||25||
athodāramate vīra nijaprāṇaiḥ paṇīkṛtām |
gṛhāṇa māṃ varārohāṃ kulakanyāmadūṣitām ||36||
iti bruvatyāṃ kanyāyāṃ nārado’tarkito muniḥ |
āyayau tau tutuṣaturdṛṣṭvā taṃ munisattamam ||37||
pāṇigraheṇa vidhinābhiṣiktau nāradena tau |
jagmaturnāradādiṣṭavartmanā kṛtamaṃgalau ||38||
kāśīṃ tvāyayatustau ca manyamānau kṛtārthatām |
saikadā taṃ patiṃ rājñī patibhaktā sutārthinī ||39||
raho vijñāpayāñcakre kartuṃ putrapradaṃ vratam |
mārgaśuklatṛtīyāyāmabhīṣṭatṛtīyāvratam ||1.474.40 ||
rājñādiṣṭā bhaktanārī cacāra tadvrataṃ śubham |
pativratā bhāgavatī kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe ratā ||41 ||
kṛṣṇapativratā sādhvī tvābālyād vaiṣṇavī satī |
purā kuberapatnyā vai ṛddhyākhyayā kṛtaṃ vratam |||42|||
sāpi prāptavatī putraṃ samarthaṃ nalakūbaram |
pūjyātra pārvatī devī stanandhayayutāsatī ||43 ||
mārge śukle tṛtīyāyāṃ suvarṇakalaśopari |
tāmrapātraṃ nidhāyaikaṃ taṇḍulaiḥ paripūritam ||44||
nūtnaṃ saraṃgaṃ vastraṃ ca nidhāya tatra sūkṣmakam |
tatra satkamalaṃ nyasya yadvā svarṇavinirmitam ||45||
brahmāṇīṃ pūjayet tatra ratnapaṭṭāmbarādibhiḥ |
puṣpaiḥ phalaiśca nāraṃgaiḥ sugandhaiścandanādibhiḥ ||46 ||
paramānnādinaivedyaiḥ pakvānnaiśca jalādibhiḥ |
dhūpairdīpaiḥ stavanaiśca nīrājanādibhistathā ||47||
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryāt sotsavaṃ harikīrtanaiḥ |
hastamātramite kuṇḍe jātavedasetyṛcā ||48||
ghṛtena madhunāplāvya juhuyān mantraviddvijaḥ |
sahasrakamalānāṃ tu homaṃ kuryād vratī mudā ||49||
navaprasūtāṃ kapilāṃ dhenuṃ dadyād dvijātaye |
upoṣya dampatī bhaktyā caturthyāṃ tu dvijātaye ||1.474.50||
datvā sadbhojanaṃ dānaṃ vastrāṇi bhūṣaṇāni ca |
ācāryāya dhanaṃ mūrtiṃ dadyātāṃ gāṃ ca dakṣiṇām |||51 ||
bhojayitvātha taṃ paścāt stuvīyātāṃ puṭāñjalī |
sutaṃ vaṃśakaraṃ dehi tuṣṭā śivā ramā hyajā ||52|||
bhuktaśeṣeṇa cānnena kuryātāṃ pāraṇaṃ tataḥ |
evaṃ kṛtaṃ vrataṃ tābhyāṃ dampatībhyāṃ sutapradam ||53||
pūjanānte śivā lakṣmīḥ sāvitrī tvāgatāḥ puraḥ |
smerānanāḥ śubhāśiṣo datvāntardhānamāgatāḥ ||54||
tataḥ sā kāntasevābhirantarvatnī babhūva ha |
tayā tu prārthito divyaḥ putro viṣṇvaṃśasaṃbhavaḥ ||95||
jātamātro vrajet svargaṃ punarāyād gṛhaṃ prati |
bhaktaḥ sadā trideveṣu prasiddho bhuvanatraye ||56||
vinaiva stanyapānena ṣoḍaśābdākṛtiḥ kṣaṇāt |
sarvasāmarthyasampanno vaiṣṇavānāṃ sadāgraṇīḥ ||57||
atha kālena tanayaṃ mūlarkṣe sāpyajījanat |
atha ṛkṣābhividbhiḥ sā vijñaptāriṣṭasaṃsthitā ||58||
devī rājārthinī cet tvaṃ tyaja duṣṭarkṣajaṃ sutam |
sā tu śrutvā mahābhaktā sarvathā patidevatā ||59||
atyākṣīt taṃ tathā prāptaṃ tanayaṃ nayakovidā |
vikaṭāyā mahāgauryāḥ puro nyasya gṛhaṃ gatā ||1.474.60||
gauryārpitaḥ sa yoginyai yoginī vyomamārgataḥ |
yayau yatra vasantyeva rakṣikā navamātaraḥ ||61 ||
brahmāṇī vaiṣṇavī raudrī vārāhī nārasiṃhikā |
kaumārī cāpi māhendrī cāmuṇḍā cāpi caṇḍikā ||62||
dṛṣṭvā taṃ vālakaṃ prāptaṃ tā ūcuḥ sundaraṃ sutam |
rājyayogyo bhavatveṣa mahālakṣaṇalakṣitaḥ ||63 ||
punastatraiva netavyo yatrāsya janma vidyate |
ṣoḍaśābdo jātamātro bhaviṣyati mahābalaḥ ||64||
evaṃ mātṛgaṇāśīrbhiḥ prāpito janmanaḥ sthale |
ānandakānane divyaṃ tatāpa sa paraṃ tapaḥ ||65||
tapasā tu prasanno’bhūcchivastvāvirbabhūva ha |
provāca taṃ varaṃ brūhi dadāmyatra tavepsitam ||66||
sa tu praṇamya śaṃbhuṃ vai parituṣṭāva bhāvataḥ |
varaṃ ca prārthayāñcakre yadi deyo varo mama ||67||
mama nāmnā bhavet tīrthaṃ vīravīreśvarāhvayam |
tathāstviti haraḥ prāha tato’yaṃ bālakaḥ punaḥ ||68||
varaṃ vavre mama muktirbhaved golokadhāmani |
haraḥ prāha vinā kṛṣṇaṃ sā muktirnahi labhyate ||69||
gṛhāṇa kṛṣṇamantraṃ tvaṃ bhava bhakto viśeṣataḥ |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāyeti muhurjapa ||1.474.70|||
tulasīmālikāṃ kaṇṭhe kare cāpi gṛhāṇa vai |
ityuktvā pradadau mantraṃ kṛtaḥ sa vaiṣṇavo mahān ||71 ||
āha taṃ śaṃkaraḥ paścājjaneturvaiṣṇavottamāt |
viṣṇoraṃśaḥ samutpanno bhavān bhakto mamāpi ca ||72||
tvaṃ tu rājyaṃ paraṃ prāpya sarvabhūpāladurlabham |
bhuktvā bhogāṃśca vipulānante muktimavāpsyasi ||73||
patnīṃ pativratāṃ prāpya labdhvā putrāṃśca tatsutān |
śrīviṣṇordivyayānena golokaṃ yāsyasi dhruvam ||74||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye namaḥ ||75||
kurutaṃ saṃjapaṃ nityaṃ tvaṃ tathā bhāvinī satī |
pativratāpi te kāntā mokṣamāpsyatha taṃ param ||76||
ityuktvā śaṃkarastvantardhānaṃ jagāma tatparam |
vīravīro mahābāhurjajāpa taṃ manuṃ muhuḥ ||77||
bhāryā kailāsarājasya nṛpateḥ putrikāṃ satīm |
nāmnā vasumatīṃ prāpya samutpādya śataṃ sutān ||78||
yayau golokamokṣaṃ sa bhāryayā saha bhaktarāṭ |
divyayānena vai bhaktaprajābhiḥ saha pārthivaḥ ||79||
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi kṛṣṇabhaktiparāyaṇam |
dampatyoḥ pāvanaṃ vṛttaṃ śrotṝn vaktṝm̐śca pāvayet ||1.474.80||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne amitrajinnṛpaternāradasya kṛpayā pativratāstrīprāptiḥ tathā malayagandhinyā bhāryayā kāśyāmabhīṣṭatṛtīyāvratena vīravīro mahāvaiṣṇavaḥ sutaḥ prāptaḥ, pativratayā sahitasya rājño goloke muktirityādinirūpaṇanāmā catuḥsaptatyadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 474 ||

<1.475>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi durvāsaso’tikaṣṭadam |
kadalyāścaritaṃ paścājjñānena mokṣadaṃ param || 1 ||
patnīvrataṃ tu muninā vāgdānāvasare dhṛtam |
kṣamāmayaṃ tathā samyag vairāgyadaṃ tapaḥkaram || 2 ||
baleḥ putraḥ sāhasiko vane tilottamāyutaḥ |
ratiṃ cakāra vijane divā kāmena mohitaḥ || 3 ||
yatra durvāsaso dehe valmīkastapato’bhavat |
durvāsāstvāntaradṛṣṭyā jñātavām̐staṃ baleḥ sutam || 4 ||
amaryādaṃ śaśāpāpi dhenuko bhava dānavaḥ |
kharavad vartase yasmāt sannidhau mama cāśrame || 5 ||
kharo bhava vane ceyaṃ tilottamāpi bāṇajā |
uṣāniruddhapatnī ca bhavatviti śaśāpa vai || 6 ||
uṣā śaśāpa taṃ durvāsasaṃ tvaṃ pīḍitaḥ striyā |
bhavātiduḥkhitaḥ kāmamohitaśceti vai tadā || 7 ||
tena doṣeṇa durvāsāḥ kāmavānabhavat kvacit |
tadā tatrāgamadaurvanāmarṣiḥ svasutāyutaḥ || 8 ||
ūrūdbhavo brahmaṇastu purā kalpe tapasyataḥ |
ūrdhvaretā hi yogīndra aurvasteneti sa smṛtaḥ || 9 ||
tasya jānūdbhavā kanyā kadalīnāma viśrutā |
durvāsasaṃ prārthayantī nānyaṃ manasi rocate || 1.475.1 0||
sutāyukto muniraurvo durvāsasaṃ nanāma ha |
durvāsāśca praṇanāma samuttasthau mudānvitaḥ || 11 ||
aurvo durvāsasaṃ proce kanyakāyā manoratham |
kadalī mama kanyeyaṃ dhyāyantī tvāṃ smaratyapi || 1 2|||
sarvarūpaguṇādhārā doṣeṇaikena saṃyutā |
atīva kalahāviṣṭā kopena gālikābruvā || 13 ||
nānāguṇayutaṃ vastu na tyajedekadoṣataḥ |
aurvasya vacanaṃ śrutvā dṛṣṭvā kanyāṃ susundarīm || 14 ||
navayauvanasampannāṃ munirmumoha kāmataḥ |
uvācaurvaṃ sukhayatā hṛdayena vidūyatā || 15||
nārī narasya saṃsāre muktimārganirodhikā |
vyavadhānaṃ tapasyāyā mohapāśanibandhinī || 16||
kārāgārākhyasaṃsāre durvahaṃ nigaḍaṃ tu sā |
ato me dhyāyataḥ kṛṣṇapādābjaṃ vighna āgataḥ || 17||
enaṃ mohaṃ phalaṃ tilottamāśāpasya vedmyaham |
aurva me rocate naiva saṃsāro yadyapi kṣayaḥ || 18||
tavājñāṃ mastake kṛtvā grahīṣyāmi sutāṃ tava |
upetāṃ kāminīṃ tyaktvā bhayaṃ syānnāśakārakam || 1 9||
rahasyupasthitāṃ kāmād gṛhṇīyānnāśasaṃkare |
kintvatininditaḥ sa syāt strījitaścet sadā bhavet ||1.475.20||
aurva tvaṃ tu svayaṃ cātra kanyayā saha cāgataḥ |
dātuṃ mahyaṃ hi te kanyāṃ tato’smi dharmasaṃkaṭe ||2 1 ||
vināśāpekṣayā grāhyo dharma eva sanātanaḥ |
grahīṣyāmi tava kanyāṃ sahiṣye śatagālikāḥ ||22||
atireke kaṭuvākye dāsyāmi tatkṣaṇe phalam |
śatagālīsahiṣṇutvaṃ patnīvrataṃ mama dhruvam ||23||
asyāḥ pativrataṃ nityaṃ śatagālīpradānakam |
yādṛśo vararājo’sti tādṛśī ca vadhūḥ kṛtā ||24||
aho bhāgyasya vaicitryaṃ bhogine sarpiṇī dhṛtā |
yadyahaṃ śatapūrvaṃ syāmadhairyaḥ sā pradaṇḍayet ||25||
bhāṣābandhaṃ prakṛtvaivamaurvo dadau sutāṃ nijām |
svastītyuvāca durvāsā vivāhaṃ vidhinākarot ||26||
aurvastāṃ sukhakṛdvākyairbodhayāmāsa kanyakām |
śṛṇu putri pravakṣyāmi nītisāraṃ sukhāvaham ||27||
hitaṃ satyaṃ ca gārhasthyapārakṛdvacanaṃ mama |
svakāntastu paro bandhuriha loke paratra ca ||28||
nahi kāntāt paraḥ preyān kulastrīṇāṃ paro guruḥ |
devapūjā vrataṃ dānaṃ tapaścānaśanaṃ japaḥ ||29||
tīrthasnānaṃ yajñadīkṣā pṛthvīpradakṣiṇādayaḥ |
ta ete patisevāyāḥ kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm ||1.475.3 0||
kimetaiḥ patibhaktāyāḥ sarvapuṇyapraśevadheḥ |
duḥkhī janaḥ sukhārthaṃ vai sākāṃkṣaḥ prathamo bhavet ||3 1 ||
patisevā sukhārtheti tatra dattamatirbhava |
patisevā paro dharmaḥ svargamokṣaprado’sti te ||32||
svaprajñānena satataṃ kāntaṃ nārāyaṇādhikam |
dṛṣṭvā taścaraṇāmbhojasevāṃ nityaṃ kariṣyasi ||33||
parihāsena kopena bhrameṇāvajñayā muneḥ |
kaṭūktiṃ svāminaḥ sākṣātparokṣānna kariṣyasi ||34||
striyā vāgyoniduṣṭāyā yamadaṇḍo bhaved dhruvam |
sarvadharmaparītāṃ yā kaṭūktiṃ kurute patim ||35||
naikajanmakṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ tasyā naśyati niścitam |
gālī dānaṃ na kartavyaṃ kvāpi kutrāpi kenacit ||36||
tvayā putri vadhūrbhūtvā munernaiva viśeṣataḥ |
gālīdānaṃ manasāpi smartavyaṃ na pativrate ||37||
tadā saukhyaṃ ca te nityaṃ saubhāgyaṃ saṃbhaviṣyati |
anyathā tatra vighno’sti vatse nibodha madvacaḥ ||38||
prāpto maṇirna hātavyo nirmūlyaḥ kaṃkaro yathā |
labdhaḥ patirna dhikkāryo yathā cauraḥ śaṭho’hitaḥ ||39||
svāmī naivāvamantavyo yathā śvā markaṭo yathā |
tvaṅkāryo na tvayā kāntaḥ kiṃkaro’niṣṭakṛd yathā ||1.475.40||
bhartā nāvagaṇanīyo yathā kṛttimayo mṛgaḥ |
trātā vaśe na kartavyo yathā ḍitthamayaḥ karī ||41 ||
vaṃśadātā na vaṃśena tāḍanīyaḥ kadācana |
bhojanasyārpake patyau nabhojanavadācaret ||42||
nindāyitaṃ nācaredvai priye tvānandadāyini |
sevanīye gurau naiva vanīyatāṃ samācaret ||43||
sadāpāraprade patyau pāradatvaṃ na vai caret |
puruṣārthapratimāyāṃ ruṣārthaṃ na caret satī ||44||
kāmanāyāṃ pravṛttāyāṃ na kiṃmanāyate priyā |
patyuḥ śeṣatayā śiṣṭā varteta na śirastathā ||45||
patyau prāṇām̐ścārpayitvā tiṣṭheta prāṇahā na tu |
ratiṃ dadyād yathātṛptiṃ kaṣṭadāṃ viratiṃ na vai ||46||
sarvaṃ dadyāt svāmine vai gālīdānaṃ na vai kvacit |
ātmārpaṇaṃ prakuryādvai kaṣṭārpaṇaṃ vinā satī ||47||
iti kanyāṃ bodhayitvā jagāmaurvaḥ svakāśramam |
durvāsāścetanārāmaḥ tvāśramaṃ strīyuto yayau ||48||
aho sukṛtināṃ kāmo vāñcchāmātreṇa siddhyati |
kadalī taṃ navaṃ kāntaṃ siṣeve sa ca tāṃ satīm ||49||
tapo dhyānaṃ parityajya gṛhāsakto’bhavanmuniḥ |
karoti kalahaṃ nityaṃ prātarutthāya kandalī ||1.475.50||
gālīvākyaṃ vinā naiva prabodhayati taṃ patim |
tasyāṃ pituḥ kṛtā śikṣā ūṣare bījavad vṛthā ||51 ||
khāne pāne bhojane’rthe vihāre saṃgame’rcane |
kaṭūktiṃ prāyaśo brūte sehe tāṃ krodhano muniḥ ||52||
patnīvrataṃ pratijñātaṃ śatagālīsahiṣṇutā |
durvāsā bodhayāmāsa nītivākyaistu kāminīm ||53||
sā tanna bubudhe kiñcit karoti kalahe spṛhām |
tātapradattajñānaṃ tu nāntaḥsthānaṃ cakāra vai ||54||
ugrā pūrvād viśeṣā sā patiputravatī yataḥ |
na hīyate prabodhena svabhāvo duratikramaḥ ||55||
nityaṃ kaṭūktiṃ kāntaṃ sā karoti hetunā vinā |
tatrāpi bhojane devapūjane tu viśeṣataḥ ||56||
jagat prakampitaṃ yena sa kampitastayā ruṣā |
putrāḥ putryo’bhavam̐stasyāṃ viṃśatirviṃśatistataḥ ||57||
kaṭūktirvardhitā nāryā śatādhikaguṇā sadā |
atha sthānaṃ parityajya lokalajjāvigarhitaḥ ||58||
yayau sthānāntaraṃ nītvā bālām̐styaktvā tu tāṃ priyām |
eko bālo dhṛto mūrdhni dvau dhṛtau skandhayoḥ punaḥ ||59||
kaṭyāṃ dhṛtau dvāvṛṣiṇā pārśvayoryānti cāpare |
anye tvagre pṛṣṭhataśca prayānti vānarā yathā ||1.475.6 0||
sarve mātṛsvabhāvāste pitraṃśāstāmasāstathā |
mārge kīśakulāyante nāṭayanti naṭā yathā ||61 ||
vigṛhṇanti vinā tattvaṃ krośanti ca mṛṣā mudhā |
durvāsasaḥ śirodeśe’patyaṃ mūtraṃ cakāra vai ||62||
skandhayośca malaṃ cakre kaṭyāṃ ṣṭhīvanamācarat |
vinā jalaṃ na vai śuddhistata evaṃ yayau puraḥ ||63||
tatrāyayau ca devarṣirnāradaḥ śaṃkarastathā |
brahmā viṣṇuḥ sanakādyāḥ saptarṣayaḥ kutūhalāt ||64||
rūpāntaraiśca te prāhuḥ kimevaṃ vahase malam |
durvāsāḥ prāha gārhasthyasukhamatrānubhūyate ||61||
jīvanvai narake magno yamakuṇḍo gṛhāśramaḥ |
aho kaṣṭaṃ malinatvaṃ naraka candanāyate ||66 ||
mūtraṃ jayati tailasya sthāne jaṭāsu me’dya vai |
aho mohasya kedāro viṣaṃ yatrāmṛtāyate ||67||
dukhaṃ sukhāyate’jñānādajñānaṃ kandalīkṛtam |
kaṃ sukhaṃ dalitaṃ yasmānmama sā kandalī priyā ||68||
tyajāmi vā rakṣayāmi kiṃ karomi tayā vinā |
evaṃ niḥśvasya durvāsāḥ sārthamadhye sthitaḥ kṣaṇam ||6 9||
hasito bodhitaścāpi nāradādyairmaharṣibhiḥ |
gṛhasthānāṃ bhavet kleśaḥ saṃsāraḥ kleśasaṃbhṛtaḥ ||1.475.70||
gaccha gṛhaṃ punarvipra maivaṃ tyaja gṛhaṃ svakam |
iti sambodhito yāvat tāvat sā kandalī satī ||71 ||
rudatī pṛṣṭhataḥ samājagāmānayanāya tam |
pādayoḥ patitā prāha gālīṃ dāsyena na vai kvacit ||72||
karotvanugrahaṃ krodhin śaṭhāpate sthavīraka |
itivākyāni miṣṭāni kandalyāḥ sammatāni vai ||73||
jagāda kandalī namrā dīnā ca kātarā muhuḥ |
dayāṃ kṛtvā ca durvāsā dhṛto vastre ca yoṣitā ||74||
yayau gṛhaṃ śarīreṇāpatyakardamalepinā |
sasnau śuddhiṃ cakārāpi jajāpa brahma cāntare ||75||
evaṃ roṣo layaṃ yātaḥ karmavaśyasya roṣiṇaḥ |
putravatī kaṭūktiṃ sā śatottarāṃ jagāda ha ||76 ||
jñānināṃ pravaro vipraḥ kṣamāsaṃsthāṃ cakāra ha |
nityaṃ śatottarāṃ vakti bodhaṃ cakre dayānidhiḥ ||77||
maunaṃ tathāpi sā dhatte naiva vegād dine dine |
evaṃ gālīpradānaiśca pradagdhaṃ mānasaṃ muneḥ ||78||
tasyāḥ kaṭūktivācinyā āyuḥ pūrṇaṃ babhūva ha |
svātmārāmo’pi munirāṭ kopāveśātivegitaḥ ||79||
śaśāpa kāminīṃ roṣād bhasmarāśirbhaveti vai |
muneriṅgitamātreṇa bhasmasāt sā babhūva ha ||1.475.80 ||
evamatyucchritānāṃ vai mattānāṃ śreya eva na |
apatyāni munestasya cakruśurmātṛnāśanāt ||8 1 ||
atha tasyā ātmatattvaṃ jīvo’ntarīkṣago’vadat |
he nātha sarvadarśī tvaṃ jñānavān yogināṃ varaḥ ||82||
sarvaṃ jānāsi sarvajña kimahaṃ bodhayāmi te |
saduktirvā kaṭūktirvā kopaḥ santāpa eva vā ||83||
lobho mohaśca kāmaśca kṣutpipāsādikaṃ ca yat| |
sthaulyaṃ kārśyaṃ vināśaśca śāntaghorasumūḍhatāḥ ||84||
sarve śarīradharmāste śabdo gālī ca bhautikāḥ |
sattvaṃ rajastamaścaiva śarīraṃ triguṇātmakam ||85||
nyūnādhikaṃ bhavet tacca saṃsārastena jāyate |
rodanaṃ hasanaṃ kleśaścodvego bhayamityapi |||86 ||
krodhaḥ śāntiśca śāpaśca śārīrā nātmanaḥ priya |
sattvodayāttu mokṣecchā karmecchā tu rajoguṇāt ||87||
tamoguṇāt kalahecchā dvayornau sadṛśaṃ tamaḥ |
tamaḥ kopasya janako yathā tvayi tathā mayi ||88||
kopāt kaṭūktirgālī ca kaṭūktyā śatrutā bhavet |
tayā tvapriyatā sadyaḥ śatruḥ kaḥ kasya kaḥ sakhā ||89||
ko vā priyo’priyaḥ kaḥ kiṃ kiṃ mitraṃ ko ripurbhavet |
rāgadveṣau pradhānau vai sarvatra śatrumitrayoḥ ||1.475.90||
prāṇādhikaḥ priyaḥ strīṇāṃ bhartuḥ prāṇādhikā priyā |
babhūva śatrutā sadyo duruktyā ca kṣaṇād ruṣā || 91 ||
yadgataṃ tadgataṃ sarvaṃ bhautikaṃ bhūtadoṣataḥ |
śocanīyaṃ gataṃ naiva jātaṃ yattacca nānyathā |||92||
ahaṃ dagdhā tava patnī te’pi dagdhaṃ tapodhanam |
dagdhayordehayoścātha guṇayornāgamaḥ punaḥ ||93||
gate tadvai gataṃ sarvaṃ naṣṭaṃ tannaṣṭameva hi |
athādhunā prakartavyaṃ yathā śreyo bhavettu nau ||94||
kṣamāparādhaṃ nikhilaṃ kiṃ kartavyaṃ vadādhunā |
kiṃ karomi kva yāmīti bhavitā kutra janma me ||95||
tava jāyā sadā cāsmi nānyasya kutracit kvacit| |
na bhūtā na bhaviṣyāmi prāpsyāmi tvāṃ punaḥ punaḥ ||96||
iti śrutvā vacastasyāḥ śokena hṛtacetanaḥ |
kṣaṇottaraṃ ca svasthaḥ sa prāṇām̐styaktuṃ samudyataḥ ||97||
strīvicchedo vidagdhānāṃ yataḥ śokaṃ karoti hi |
tato yogāsanaṃ kṛtvā mumurṣurna hyuvāca tām ||98||
sā tvambare muniṃ dṛṣṭvā mumurṣuṃ śokavihvalā |
sasmāra śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ durgamarakṣakam ||99||
tāvat tatrāyayau bālo vipro bhūtvā janārdanaḥ |
sasmitaḥ śyāmavarṇaśca durvāsasaṃ jagāda ca || 1.475.1 00||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne durvāsasaḥ aurvakanyayā kadalyā saha śatagālīsahanapūrvakapratijñayā vivāhastataḥ pātivratyātmakataddharmanirūpaṇaṃ, viṃśatiputraputrīmatvaṃ, krodhenātikrāmantyāḥ kadalyāḥ ṛṣiśāpena bhasmatā, kadalyāḥ stutiḥ, janārdanāgamaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcasaptatyadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 475 ||

<1.476>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi yathā prāha durvāsasaṃ dvijārbhakaḥ |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo viṣṇuḥ samayocitameva tat || 1 ||
durvāsasaṃ praṇamanta śocantaṃ karma vai svakam |
pūjayantaṃ vāsayantaṃ kuśāsane’tibhāvataḥ || 2 ||
uvāca brāhmaṇabaṭustasmai datvā sadāśiṣam |
sarvaṃ jānāsi durvāsargurormantraprasādataḥ || 3 ||
tathāpi brāhmaṇabaṭuḥ kathayāmi nibodha me |
brāhmaṇānāṃ tapo dharmastapaḥ sādhyaṃ jagattrayam || 4 ||
vaiṣṇavānāṃ harerbhaktirdāsyaṃ ca paramaṃ tapaḥ |
hareḥ kathāyāḥ śravaṇaṃ bhajanaṃ tasya sarvadā || 5 ||
sevanaṃ pūjanaṃ sarvaṃ kartavyaṃ vaiṣṇavasya vai |
munestu te viśeṣeṇa śreyaḥ kāryaṃ śubhaṃ sadā || 6 ||
etat sarvaṃ parityajya śokaṃ ca śokakāraṇam |
kathaṃ duḥkhapradaṃ buddhernāśakaṃ tvavalambase || 7 ||
kā kasya patnī kaḥ kāntaḥ kasyā vā bhavacakrake |
mūrkhāṇāṃ vañcanāṃ kartuṃ karoti māyayā hariḥ || 8 ||
mithyā patnī taveyaṃ tu kṣaṇāntena gatādhunā |
nahi mithyā bhavennityaṃ nityaṃ nādṛśyatāṃ vrajet || 9 ||
tava patnī sadā ceyaṃ kandalī nirmitā satī |
nārāyaṇena te chāyā tava śikṣāpradāyinī || 1.476.1 0||
yat tvayā kalpito lokastvatkampārthaṃ tu sā kṛtā |
mā śokaṃ kuru cātrārthe sā te patnī punarmune || 11 ||
bhaviṣyati na sandeho dvedhā bhūtvā variṣyati |
vada kāntāṃ prārthanāḍhyāmākāśasthāṃ pativratām || 12||
pratīkṣamāṇāṃ te tvājñāṃ brūhi kiṃ sā kariṣyati |
tāvad durvāsasā dṛṣṭā kathitā kadalī bhava || 1 3||
śubhadā phaladā kāntā sakṛtsūtā sudurlabhā |
bahuputrīmatī mūlāt sadā pativratā bhava || 14||
ityuktā sā pratyuvāca tvaṃ cāpi kardamo bhava |
yathā nāma tathā durvāsātmakaḥ kardamo mama || 15||
mūle kledamayo nityaṃ śaityabhāvānvito bhava |
ityuktaḥ kardamo bhūtvā rūpāntareṇa vai muniḥ || 16||
durvāsaḥ kardamo nityaṃ kadalīmūlago’bhavat |
kandalī kadalījātirbhūtā kadaladāyinī || 17||
sakṛtprasūtā phaladā mūlāpatyapradāyinī |
saṃjātā vanamadhye ca vandhyā kadalī cetyapi || 18||
hastīnāṃ bhojanaṃ sā tu hyabhavat sarvadā vane |
atha taṃ brāhmaṇabaṭuḥ punaḥ prāha muniṃ hitam || 1 9||
śṛṇu vipra tava patnī kalpe kalpe punaḥ punaḥ |
kadalī śāntarūpā ca bhaviṣyati sukhapradā ||1.476.20 ||
ekānaṃśābhidhā kṛṣṇasvasā śrīdevakīsutā |
pārvatyaṃśasamudbhūtā suśīlā cirajīvinī ||21 ||
kalpe kalpe tava patnī sundarī sā bhaviṣyati |
mano dehi tapasyāyāṃ mudā tatkāla āgate ||22||
śāntasvarūpā sā bālā kṛṣṇadvārā miliṣyati |
ityuktvā bhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścaturbhujaḥ ||23||
datvā svadarśanaṃ tasmai so’ntardhāno babhūva ha |
muniḥ sarvaṃ bhramaṃ tyaktvā tapasyāyāṃ mano dadhe ||24||
atyucchritasya damanaṃ sūcitaṃ jāyate kvacit |
dviguṇābhyudayaścānujāyate damitasya vai ||25||
kandalī kadalījātirbabhūva dharaṇītale |
yādṛśī sābhavattūgrā tādṛśīṃ śītatāṃ gatā ||26|||
kandalyāstu pituḥ sarasvatyā nadyāstaṭe śubhe |
āsīd bhavyāśramastatra kandalyāḥ pātivratyataḥ |||27||
brahmaśīlavratenāpi bhaktyā śrīmādhavasya ca |
piturvastrāṇi sarvāṇi śuṣkāṇyārdrāṇi yāni ca ||28||
vāyunā dhāryamāṇāni tiṣṭhanti tvambare sadā |
vinā tu kīlakaṃ lakṣmi camatkāro’yamadbhutaḥ ||29||
yāvat sā kandalī dagdhā durvāsaḥśāpatastadā |
tatkṣaṇaṃ dhautavastrāṇi peturūrdhvād bhuvastale ||1.476.30||
pṛthivyāṃ patite vastre tapastyaktvaurva eva tu |
dhyānena bubudhe sarvaṃ kanyābhasmādi saṃkaṭam ||3 1||
śokāviṣṭo jagāmāśu jāmāturāśramaṃ kṣaṇāt |
siṣeca pṛthivīreṇūn rudan nayanabindubhiḥ ||32||
he vatse kadalītyevaṃ rurodoccārya vai punaḥ |
śvaśurasya svaraṃ jñātvā durvāsā bhayavihvalaḥ ||33||
ūṭajāyā bahirbhūtvā papāta tatpadāmbuje |
vilalāpa bhṛśaṃ paścāt sāntvayitvā guruṃ munim ||34||
vṛttāntaṃ kathayāmāsa mūlamārabhya taṃ munim |
śrutvā vārtāṃ punaraurvaḥ śuśoca bahudhā punaḥ ||35||
jāmātāraṃ samuvāca bhītaṃ praṇatakandharam |
aye brahmannatriputra pautrastvaṃ brahmaṇaḥ śubhaḥ ||36||
svalpadoṣe bahutaraḥ kṛto daṇḍastvayā katham |
tvajjanmaśaṃkarāṃśena śiṣyastvaṃ brahmaṇastathā ||37||
vedavijñaśca guṇavān jñānavām̐śca vratasthitaḥ |
anasūyā mahāsādhvī kamalāṃśā tava prasūḥ ||38||
guṇavān janako yasya mātā guṇavatī satī |
tayoḥ putro dayāhīnaḥ sṛṣṭeḥ sūkṣmā tyaho gatiḥ ||39||
na jāne kena doṣeṇa tava tvaitādṛśī matiḥ |
hiṃsāpradhānā śaśvadvaṃśasampadvināśinī ||1.476.40||
mama prāṇādhikā tvekā kanyā tvayi samarpitā |
mahāpativratā vāṇīmātradoṣasamanvitā ||41 ||
vāgduṣṭāyāstu daṇḍo hi parityāgo nayaḥ smṛtaḥ |
parityaktāṃ punaḥ putrīṃ pitā pālayati dhruvam ||42||
madapatyaṃ svalpadoṣe yato bhasmīkṛtaṃ tvayā |
parābhavaste’pi mahān bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ||43||
drogdhuḥ karmaphalaṃ tūrṇe dadāti karuṇānidhiḥ |
ityuktvātivilapyaiva hā putrīti vahan muhuḥ ||44||
jñātvā tāṃ kadalīvṛkṣasvarūpāṃ saritastaṭe |
āmūlāttāṃ khanayitvā sahanītvā yayau gṛham ||45||
asvāminīṃ phalahīnāṃ putrīṃ kumārikāṃ tu tām |
kandalīṃ kadalīrūpāṃ pupoṣa jalasecanaiḥ ||46||
kardamastanmūladeśe klidyamāno’bhavattataḥ |
durgandhaḥ sa ca durvāso durvāsāḥ śāpato’bhavat ||47||
tayoryoge tvapatyāni niṣphalānyabhavanpunaḥ |
vanāni tāni jātāni gajabhuktipradāni vai ||48 ||
durvāsasastu catvāriṃśadapatyāni yāni vai |
kadalīgarbhajātāni tānyaurvāśramamāyayuḥ ||49||
aurveṇa pālitānyeva teṣāṃ vaṃśo vyavardhata |
atha smṛtvā priyāṃ durvāsāstapasyāparo’bhavat |||1.476.5 0||
tataḥ kālāntare rājāmbarīṣāt sa parābhavam |
śvaśuraśāpato lebhe śṛṇu lakṣmi vadāmi te ||51 ||
ambarīṣaḥ sūryavaṃśī rājā paramadhārmikaḥ |
śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇāmbhoje tanmanaḥ satataṃ hyabhūt |||52|||
na rājyeṣu na bhāryāsu na putreṣu prajāsu na |
na sampatsu kṣaṇaṃ cittaṃ puṇyakarmārjitāsvapi ||53||
dhyāyate’harniśaṃ bhakto jñāne svapne hariṃ sadā |
mahābhāgavataḥ śānto viṣṇuvrataparāyaṇaḥ ||54||
ekādaśīvratarataḥ kṛṣṇapūjāsu tatparaḥ |
sarvakarmasvaliptaśca kartā kṛṣṇārpiteṣu ca ||55||
sutīkṣṇaṃ ṣoḍaśāraṃ ca hareścakraṃ sudarśanam |
prabhuṇā rakṣitaṃ śaśvad rakṣāyai nṛpasannidhau ||56||
ekādaśīvrataṃ kṛtvā dvādaśī divase sati |
snātvābhyarcya hariṃ dānaṃ datvā sauvarṇarājatam ||57||
sādhūn viprān bhojayitvā bhojanārthamuvāsa saḥ |
tāvattatra samāyāto durvāsāḥ kṣudhito muniḥ ||58||
dṛṣṭvā natvā samutthāya datvā taṃ pādyamāsanam |
papraccha rājā taṃ prītaḥ kājñā te vada kāmitam ||59||
durvāsāḥ prāha dehyannaṃ vidhinā kṣudhitasya me |
kintvaghamarṣaṇamantraṃ japtvāyāmyacireṇa vai ||1.476.60||
kṣaṇaṃ pratīkṣatāṃ rājannityuktvā prayayau tataḥ |
śīghraṃ nāyāti durvāsāḥ dvādaśīṃ vigatonmukhīm ||61 ||
vilokya rājā papraccha vaśiṣṭhaṃ dharmasaṃkaṭam |
nāyāti muniśārdūlaḥ prayāti dvādaśī tithiḥ ||62||
saṃkaṭe’smin vidheyaṃ kiṃ vadeti pratyuvāca tam |
vaśiṣṭho hitakṛt tathyaṃ puṇyadaṃ sarvasammatam |||63||
dvādaśyāṃ samatītāyāṃ trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇam |
upavāsaphalaṃ hatvā vratinaṃ hanti niścitam ||64||
na bhojayitvā mūḍhaścedatithiṃ samupasthitam |
sa trastaḥ kṣudhito bhuṃkte kuṃbhīpāke vrajed dhruvam ||65||
śatavarṣaṃ tatra tiṣṭhan naraścāṇḍālatāṃ vrajet |
vyādhiyukto daridraśca bhavejjanmani janmani ||66||
ato’tisūkṣmaṃ te brūmo’dhunā paramasaṃkaṭe |
rakṣāṃ kuru dvayordharmaṃ samālokya vadāmi te ||67||
