na pāpāni cāparādhān kurvantyapi bhayāt prajāḥ ||1.496.3 0 ||
evaṃ dharmasya sanpanthāḥ tena kṛto hi bhūbhṛtā |
tasya rodhaṃ prakurvantu brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ ||3 1 ||
śrutvaivaṃ yamarājasya brahmā sasmāra śaṃkaram |
viṣṇuṃ ca tau samāyātau śaṃbhuṃ prāha ca viśvasṛṭ || 32||
kiṃ kartavyaṃ cātra kārye vada śaṃbho vada prabho |
śaṃbhurāha sudharme vai pravṛttasya śubhārthinaḥ || 33 ||
kathaṃ nivāraṇaṃ tatra kriyate kaśca nigrahaḥ |
āyustasya kiyaddīrghaṃ vartate vada me yama || 34||
yena tatsamaye prāpte tannayāmi nijaṃ kṣayam |
yamaḥ prāha tadāyuśca ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrakam || 35||
pañcavarṣasahasrāṇi gatāni tasya sāmpratam |
tiṣṭhanti pañcapañcāśatsahasrāṇi bhaviṣyakam ||36||
aho dīrghaṃ tadāyuśca vilokya śaṃkaro yayau |
vyāghrarūpaṃ samāsthāya tasya rājñaḥ samīpataḥ || 37|||
meghagarjananirghoṣaṃ garjamāno muhurmuhuḥ |
ajāścātha taṃ saṃvīkṣya dudruvuḥ sarvato diśaḥ || 38 ||
vyāghreṇa bhakṣitāḥ sarve tadā sa pṛthivīpatiḥ |
vyāghraṃ hantuṃ mantrayuktānyastrāṇi prairayatta taḥ || 3 9||
tāni śastrāṇi mantrām̐ścāstrāṇi jagrāha śaṃka raḥ |
svavaktreṇa samastāni na cāyānti nṛpaṃ prati ||1.496.4 0 ||
astrābhāvāt tatastūrṇaṃ dvandvayuddhaṃ cakāra saḥ |
tāvadvyāghro’bhavacchaṃbhustrilocanastriśūlavān ||41 ||
rājā tvānandamagno’bhūt mudā tuṣṭāva śaṃkaram |
ajñānādavamānaṃ te kṛtaṃ śaṃbho kṣamāṃ kuru ||42|||
śaṃbhuḥ prāha mayā kṣāntaṃ parituṣṭena sarvaśaḥ |
tvayā kṛtaṃ mahat karma nānyaiḥ pūrva kṛtaṃ tathā ||43 ||
prajānāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ cātimānuṣaṃ vai kṛtaṃ tvayā |
tasmād gaccha mayā sārdhaṃ kailāsaṃ pārthivottama ||44||
anayā dharmapatnyā te sahitaśca sukhī bhava |
nātra loke tvayā stheyaṃ virodhena yamasya vai ||45||
devānāṃ ca virodhena tvayā stheyaṃ na bhūtale |
ityuktaḥ sa nṛpaḥ prāha kariṣyāmi yathāttha me ||46 ||
devyā pūrvaṃ tu me proktaṃ yadā tvaṃ pṛthivītalāt |
prayāsyasi tadāstrāṇi śastrāṇi sarvamantrakān ||47 ||
mahyaṃ datvā prayātavyaṃ tat kṛtvā yāmi śaṃkara |
śaṃbhustasmai dadau tāṃśca śastrāstramantrakām̐stataḥ ||48 ||
rājā yayau camatkārakṣetraṃ śrīpārvatīṃ prati |
dadau sarvāṇi pārvatyai jale nyasya prapūjya ca ||49||
māghaśuklacaturdaśyāṃ snātvā pārvatīkuṇḍake |
yayau rājā tu sāketaṃ śaṃbhuryatra pratīkṣate ||1.496.50||
rājyaṃ putre’rpayitvaiva sabhāryo nṛpatiryayau |
kailāsaṃ śaṃbhunā sārdhaṃ śaṃbhunā bhūbhṛte tataḥ ||51 ||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ |
itimantraḥ pradattaśca tulasīmālikārpitā |||2||
paramo vaiṣṇavo bhūtvā sabhāryaḥ śrīhariṃ bhajan |
golokaṃ prayayau lakṣmi mukto babhūva śāśvataḥ ||53||
tasya putro’bhavad rājā daśarathaḥ sudhārmikaḥ |
vimānena divaṃ yāti pātālādau prayāti ca ||54||
yasya putraḥ svayaṃ viṣṇū rāmacandro babhūva ha |
kasyacittvatha kālasya daivajñaistasya bhūpateḥ ||55||
kathitaṃ rohiṇī bhedaṃ śanirgrahaḥ kariṣyati |
tena dvādaśavarṣāṇi durbhikṣaṃ saṃbhaviṣyati ||56 ||
tathā sampatsyate sarvaṃ bhūtalaṃ naṣṭamānavam |
iti śrutvā yayau rājā tanmārgaṃ yatra vai śaniḥ ||57||
śakradattavimānena śanaiścaramupādravat |
sajjaṃ kṛtvā dhanustatra śanaiścaramuvāca ha ||58||
tyajainaṃ rohiṇīmārgaṃ tvāṃ haniṣyāmi cānyathā |
divyāstramantrayuktena śareṇānataparvaṇā ||59||
iti śrutvā śaniḥ prāha kastvaṃ ruṇatsi māṃ divi |
rājā prāha nṛpaścāsmi ajaputro bhuvaḥ patiḥ ||1.496.60||
nāmnā daśarathaḥ prajārakṣārthamatra cāgataḥ |
śaniḥ prāha tvayā sākaṃ virodho nāsti me kvacit ||61 ||
kathaṃ cāpena vai rājan manmārgaṃ hantumicchasi |
rājā prāha śane tvaṃ rohiṇīmārgeṇa gacchasi ||62||
rohiṇīsaṃbhavaṃ tvaṃ hi śakaṭaṃ bhedayiṣyasi |
tathā jāte navai vṛṣṭirannānāṃ saṃbhavo na ca ||63||
tena prajāvināśaśca yajñanāśaḥ surārdanam |
tasmād ruddhastavaḥ mārgaḥ śrutvā śaniruvāca tam ||64||
tuṣṭo’haṃ tava vīryeṇa na kṛtaṃ kenacittu yat |
tat kṛtaṃ vai tvayā rājan varaṃ vṛṇu dadāmi te ||65||
tasmātprajāsukhārthaṃ na bhedayiṣyāmi rohiṇīm |
rājā prāha tava vāre tailābhyaṃgaṃ karoti yaḥ ||66||
tasya pīḍā cāsaptāha tvayā kāryā na vai kvacit |
tiladānaṃ lohadānaṃ yaḥ karoti dine tu te ||67||
varṣamātraṃ tvayā tasya pīḍā kāryā na vai kvacit |
tava gocarapīḍāyāṃ śāntikarturjanasya vai ||68||
sapta sārdhāni varṣāṇi pīḍā kāryā na vai tvayā |
tathāstviti śaniḥ prāha virarāma bhuvaḥ patiḥ ||69||
idaṃ śrutvā mahendraśca śīghraṃ yayau ca tatsthalam |
bhūpālaṃ prāha tuṣṭo’smi tava cādbhutakarmaṇā ||1.496.70||
varaṃ matto gṛhāṇādya śrutvā rājā hyuvāca tam |
tvayā saha sadā maitrī mahendra cāstu me śubhā ||71 ||
indrastathāstviti prāha maitrī mayyastu te sadā |
nityaṃ sāyaṃ pragantavyaṃ mamālayaṃ tvayā nṛpa ||72||
ityuktvā prayayāvindro nṛpo yāti divaṃ sadā |
indrasadasi saṃśrutvā gāndharvīṇāṃ sugītikāḥ ||73||
nṛtyaṃ tālānvitaṃ cāpi kathā devarṣivaktrataḥ |
dṛṣṭvā śrutvā samāyāti cāyodhyāṃ prati pratyaham ||74||
yadā niryāti śakrasya sabhātastadanantaram |
daśarathānasyābhyukṣaṇaṃ kārayati sadā ||75||
athaikadā nāradastaṃ samuvāca nṛpaṃ mudā |
rājam̐stvadāsaṃnasśabhyukṣaṇaṃ cendraḥ karoti hi ||76||
daśarathastato yātaḥ svāsane saṃsthitastataḥ |
utthāya vīkṣayāmāsa svāsanaṃ dūramāsthitaḥ ||77||
indrājñayā tadā bhṛtyaḥ prokṣayāmāsa cāsanam |
dṛṣṭvā rājā mahendraṃ ca papraccha tasya kāraṇam ||78||
indraḥ prāha bhavānadyāvadhiṃ pitṛṛṇānvitaḥ |
aputrasya gatirnāsti na ca svargaṃ tataḥ param ||79||
yadā paśyati putrasya vadanaṃ puruṣo nṛpa |
so’nṛṇyaṃ samavāpnoti pitṝṇāṃ ca tataḥ param ||1.496.80||
ityuktaḥ sa nṛpastarhi tanayārthaṃ suduḥkhavān |
vaśiṣṭhena tataścakre putreṣṭiṃ gṛhamāgataḥ ||8 1 ||
jyeṣṭhā prāsūta kauśalyā rāmaṃ putraṃ narāyaṇam |
kalahā kekayī putraṃ prāsūta bharataṃ sutam ||82||
śatrughnalakṣmaṇau madhyā sumitrā suṣuve sutau |
kanyāṃ caikāṃ suṣuve sā lomapādā putrikā ||83||
putrīrūpā pradattā vai putrahīnāya tāriṇī |
ānṛṇyaṃ tvabhavattasya yayau vaikuṇṭhameva saḥ ||84||
atha rāmo’bhavad rājā vanavāsottaraṃ tataḥ |
daśavarṣasahasrāṇi daśavarṣaśatāni ca ||85||
sītādehāntakālottarakāle rājyamākarot |
ekādaśasahasrānte devadūtaḥ samāyayau ||86||
tenoktaṃ devarājena preṣito’haṃ samāgataḥ |
tasmācchṛṇu prasandeśaṃ kuru gṛhaṃ ca nirjanam ||87||
paścātte kathayiṣye’haṃ śrutvā rāmo jagāda ha |
lakṣmaṇa nirjanaṃ kuryāḥ devadūtaṃ śṛṇomyaham ||88||
yāvadvārtā kriyate ca tāvadanye samāgatāḥ |
kṛtvāto vārtikāmaunaṃ devadūta uvāca ha ||89||
yathā daṃṣṭrācyutaḥ sarpo nāgo vā madavarjitaḥ |
ājñāhīnastathā rājā mānavaiḥ paribhūyate ||1.496.90||
ke ime’tra samāyātā rahasyavacane’pi te |
śaṃkālāpamapi tvaṃ yannaikānte śrotumicchasi ||91 ||
śrutvā kopaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā dṛḍhaṃ sa prāha lakṣmaṇam |
niṣkāsaya bahistvanyān mā praveśaya kām̐ścana ||92||
yadi kaścinnaro mohādāgamiṣyati cāntaram |
svahastena na sandehaḥ sūdayiṣyāmi taṃ drutam ||93||
na hanmi taṃ dṛṣṭicaraṃ tadā dharmagatirna me |
bhavediti pratijāne bhava svastho’tra vartane ||94||
omityuktvā lakṣmaṇaśca saudhadvāri dṛḍhaḥ sthitaḥ |
devadūto’pi rāmeṇa samaṃ cakre sumantraṇām ||95||
rāvaṇasya kṛto nāśo dharmaḥ saṃsthāpito bhuvi |
āyuḥ pūrṇaṃ kṛtaṃ cātra vaikuṇṭhaṃ yāhi rocate ||96||
etasminnantare prāpto durvāsāḥ kṣudhayānvitaḥ |
vyagraścovāca kutrāste rāmaḥ śīghraṃ nivedaya ||97||
gaccha lakṣmaṇa śīghraṃ cānyathā śāpaṃ dadāmyaham |
śāpena vai kulaṃ sarvaṃ dhakṣyāmi nātra saṃśayaḥ ||98||
lakṣmaṇo vinayaṃ kṛtvā dadau śāntiṃ maharṣaye |
sa na śāntaḥ pradātuṃ ca śāpamūrdhvaṃ karaṃ dadhe ||99||
tacchrutvā lakṣmaṇaḥ śīghraṃ rāmaṃ prāhāgamamṛṣeḥ |
rāmaḥ prāha drutaṃ praveśaya durvāsasaṃ munim || 1.496.1 00||
lakṣmaṇastu muniṃ praveśayāmāsa drutaṃ tadā |
gṛhītvā ca madhuparkaṃ rāmo yayau samīpagaḥ || 101 ||
nanāmārghyaṃ pradatvā ca svāgataṃ pracakāra ha |
dhanyo’smyanugṛhīto’smi yattvaṃ me gṛhamāgataḥ || 1 02||
etadrājyaṃ prajāścemā vibhavo’nugrahāttava |
ityukto munirāṭ prāha nirāhāro’smi vai vrate || 1 03||
cāturmāsye tadante ca samicchāmīha pāraṇām |
yaccha me bhojanaṃ śīghraṃ raghūttamastataḥ ṛṣim || 1 04||
bhojayāmāsa miṣṭānnaiḥ sthitvāgrataḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ |
munirbhuktvā pradatvāśīrvādān yayau yathāgataḥ || 1 05||
atha rāmaṃ prāha khaḍgaṃ gṛhītvā lakṣmaṇaḥ svayam |
vinipātaya khaḍgena māṃ pratijñāṃ ca pālaya || 1 06||
rāmaḥ sañcintya taṃ prāha vivāso maraṇādhikaḥ |
vraja lakṣmaṇa muktatvaṃ mayā deśāntaraṃ drutam || 1 07||
tyāgo vātha vadho vātha sādhūnāmubhayaṃ samam |
na mayā darśanaṃ bhūyastvayā kāryaṃ ca lakṣmaṇa || 1 08||
ityuktaḥ sa yayau tūrṇaṃ sarayūtīrameva hi |
snātvā padmāsanaṃ kṛtvā brahmarandhreṇa nirgataḥ || 1 09||
tejomayo’mbare yāto dṛṣṭo rāmeṇa dehibhiḥ |
yayuḥ sarve dadṛśuśca patitaṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ śavam || 1.496.11 0||
vilepurbāndhavādyāśca karuṇaṃ paryavedayan |
candanādicitāṃ kṛtvā dehaṃ nidadhuste tadā || 11 1||
ākāśavāgabhavacca māgniṃ dehi raghūttama |
tavāyaṃ bāndhavo rāma brahmaṇaḥ sadanaṃ gataḥ || 1 12||
tvayā sugrīvabhaktaṃ ca vibhīṣaṇaṃ prabhaktakam |
lakṣmaṇaṃ sahanītvaiva gantavyaṃ dhāma caiva ha || 11 3||
tato rāmo vimānena puṣpakeṇa tu dakṣiṇām |
diśaṃ yayau saha nītvā sugrīvaṃ ca vibhīṣaṇam || 1 14||
samāgataḥ svanagarīṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ tadvimānake |
kṛtvā kuśaṃ lavaṃ rājye’bhiṣicya dhāma saṃyayau || 1 15||
vibhiṣaṇaṃ dvitīyena rūpeṇa ca raghūttamaḥ |
rarakṣa rājyakāryārthaṃ laṃkāyāṃ cirajīvinam || 1 16||
seturvināśito yasmād rākṣasā neyurityataḥ |
etacchravaṇapāṭhābhyāṃ bhuktirmuktirbhavet priye || 1 17||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne ajāpālamahārājasya rogāṇāmajāmaṇḍalarūpeṇa nigraho daśarathasya śanikṛtarohiṇīśakaṭavedhanirodho rāmakṛtapratijñayāvaikuṇṭhagamanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṇṇavatyadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 496 ||

<1.497>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
aṣṭaṣaṣṭipramāṇāni tīrthakṣetrāṇi bhūtale |
kīrtayāmi śṛṇu lakṣmi pāvanāni hi dehinām || 1 ||
somanāthaṃ mahattīrthaṃ saurāṣṭre revatācalaḥ |
kuṃkumavāpikātīrthaṃ dvārikātīrthamityapi || 2 ||
camatkārapuraṃ tīrthaṃ nārāyaṇasarovaram |
arbudādrirmahattīrthaṃ puṣkaraṃ tīrthamuttamam || 3 ||
hiṃgalājīmahattīrthaṃ haridvāraṃ tathottamam |
kāśmīramaṇḍalaṃ tīrthaṃ badrikāśramamityapi || 4 ||
kedāranāthastīrthaṃ ca kurukṣetraṃ ca pāvanam |
śālagrāmābhidhaṃ kṣetraṃ kāmākṣī kāmarūpake || 5 ||
nepāle ca pāśupataṃ kapilāśramamabdhike |
muktināthaṃ tathā kṣetraṃ mahālakṣmīnivāsanam || 6 ||
tīrthaṃ hariharakṣetraṃ jagannāthapurī tathā |
gayākṣetraṃ ca sāketanagarītīrthamuttamam || 7 ||
parśurāmaprakuṇḍāni māthuraṃ maṇḍalaṃ tathā |
siddhapuraṃ mahattīrthaṃ prayāgarāja ityapi || 8 ||
kāśīkṣetraṃ daṇḍakāraṇyake śrītryambakaṃ tathā |
oṃkāreśvaratīrthaṃ ca śuklatīrthaṃ tathottamam || 9 ||
bhṛgukṣetraṃ śriyāstīrthaṃ narmadābdhisamāgamaḥ |
kalkibhūḥ saṃbhalatīrthaṃ candrabhāgāsthatulasī || 1.497.1 0||
aruṇādrirmahattīrthaṃ śrīśailastīrthamuttamam |
kāñcīdvayaṃ śubhaṃ tīrthaṃ cidambaraṃ ca pāvanam || 1 1||
janārdanakṛtaṃ kṣetraṃ bhūtapurīsumaṇḍalam |
kumārikāsatīkṣetraṃ dharmāraṇyaṃ ca pāvanam ||1 2||
rāmeśvaraṃ mahatkṣetraṃ mallikārjunatīrthakam |
malayācalatīrthaṃ ca tāmraparṇī ca pāvanī ||1 3||
ujjayinīmahākālavanaṃ naimiṣakaṃ vanam |
mahendrādrirmahattīrthaṃ viśālākṣīvanaṃ tathā || 14||
kālaṃjaraṃ mahatkṣetraṃ kṣetraṃ gokarṇakaṃ tathā |
amarakaṇṭakaṃ tīrthaṃ sāptagodāvaraṃ tathā || 15||
vindhyācalītrikūṭākhyaṃ tīrthaṃ ca pakṣitīrthakam |
mahākailāsakaṃ tīrthaṃ tāpīsāgarasaṃgamaḥ || 16||
jāmadagnyāśramaparśurāmakṣetraṃ sutīrthakam |
pulahāśramatīrthaṃ ca kāverītīrthamityapi || 17||
kṣetraṃ vārāhatīrthaṃ ca ṛṣabhakṣetramityapi |
nṛsiṃhācalatīrthaṃ ca mīnākṣītīrthamityapi || 18||
padmanābhamahākṣetramaṣṭaṣaṣṭīni tāni vai |
lakṣmi cānāditīrthāni santyevaitāni bhūtale || 1 9||
anyānyapi trayastriṃśatkoṭitīrthāni santi ca |
tārakāḥ sādhavo devāḥ ṛṣayo munayastathā ||1.497.20||
satyaḥ sādhvyaḥ kumāryaśca pātivratyaparāyaṇāḥ |
tāpasyastāpasā brahmacaryavrataparāyaṇāḥ ||21 ||
dharmiṣṭhāśca camatkṛtikarā yativarāstathā |
gāvaścānye jātismarā bhaktāśca vaiṣṇavāstathā ||22||
śaivāḥ saurā gāṇapatyā devībhaktāśca śāṃkarāḥ |
brāhmāścāndramasā īśabhaktā vahniprabhaktakāḥ ||23||
sādhakā māntrikāścāpi parakāyapraveśakāḥ |
siddhimantaśca ye yatra nivasanti virāgiṇaḥ ||24||
santaḥ paramahaṃsāśca sāṃkhyayoginya ityapi |
yatra vasanti puṇyāni tāni tīrthāni padmaje ||25||
bhavanti pāpanāśārthaṃ samarthāni jaḍānyapi |
cetanāni tu tīrthāni jaḍatīrthakarāṇi vai ||26||
devasthānāni sarvāṇi tīrthānyeva bhavanti hi |
gurvāśramāśca guravastīrthāni sarvadā priye ||27||
tārayitvā ca saṃsārāt sthāpayatyaiśvare pade |
mokṣe vā tāni tīrthāni pāpakṣālanakāni vai ||28||
patistīrthaṃ pitā tīrthaṃ tīrthaṃ mātā pativratā |
satī tīrthaṃ ca gaustīrthaṃ santastīrthaṃ samuttamam ||29||
gurustīrthaṃ haristīrthaṃ devāstīrthaṃ ca sarvadā |
jñānaṃ tīrthaṃ paraṃ śuddhaṃ bhaktistīrthaṃ tataḥ param ||1.497.3 0||
dāsyaṃ tīrthottamaṃ sevā tīrthaṃ tīrthottamottamam |
sevayā labhyate sarvaḥ puruṣārthaḥ sudurlabhaḥ ||3 1 ||
hareḥ sevā satāṃ sevā tīrthaṃ tīrthottamottamam |
anyāni yāni tīrthāni tanmūlāni bhavanti vai ||32||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ |
evaṃ jāpaḥ paraṃ tīrthaṃ mahāvaiṣṇavakārakam ||33||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmī nānyaḥ svāmī mato mama |
ityevaṃ tvarpaṇaṃ tīrthaṃ cātmanaḥ parikīrtitam || 34||
sthūlasūkṣmāntarāṇāmarpaṇaṃ dāsyaṃ hi tīrthakam |
yathā kṛṣṇaḥ prasannaḥ syāttatkāryaṃ tīrthameva vai || 35||
nṛtyaṃ tīrthaṃ tvapsarasāṃ tuṣyed yena janārdanaḥ |
gītaṃ tīrthaṃ ca nārīṇāṃ tuṣyed yena tu mādhavaḥ ||36||
gāndharvāṇāṃ vādyatīrthaṃ tuṣyed yena narāyaṇaḥ |
kāmastīrtha tu gopīnāṃ tuṣyed yena vrajeśvaraḥ || 37||
dhyānaṃ tīrthaṃ yogavatāṃ yena tuṣyati keśavaḥ |
evaṃ tīrthaṃ paraṃ matvā jñātvā śrīkṛṣṇamiṣṭadam ||38||
sarvaṃ tasmin samarpyaiva mokṣaṃ sañcinuyād budhaḥ |
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya sarvatīrthaphalaṃ bhavet ||39||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne’ṣṭaṣaṣṭitīrthataditarādhyātmikatīrthādinirūpaṇoddeśādikathananāmā saptanavatyadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 497 ||

<1.498>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi brāhmaṇānāṃ camatkāramayīṃ kathām |
ānartādhipatirbhūbhṛt prasanno brāhmaṇān varān || 1 ||
samāhūya samuvāca praṇipatya muhurmuhuḥ |
suvarṇaṃ vā gajāśvaṃ vā saṃkrāntau makare raveḥ || 2 ||
yasya yadrocate dātumicchāmi pṛthivīmapi |
prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ mahyaṃ dīnasya praṇatasya ca || 3 ||
viprāstvāhurvayaṃ nityaṃ niṣparigrahadharmiṇaḥ |
bhikṣāhārāstāpasāśca kiṃ gajāśvasuvarṇakaiḥ || 4 ||
camatkāro nṛpaḥ prāha bhavanto lokapāvanāḥ |
rājyalakṣmyāḥ praśuddhyarthaṃ dānaṃ gṛhṇantu pāvanāḥ || 5 ||
dvāsaptatibrāhmaṇāśca vartante’tra nadītaṭe |
parṇakuṭīrvidhāyaiva vyomamārgavihāriṇaḥ || 6 ||
tapaḥśaktyā sadā yānti nānātīrtheṣu bhaktitaḥ |
japaṃ snānaṃ tarpaṇaṃ ca kṛtvā tvāyānti vai punaḥ || 7 ||
vārāṇasyāṃ prayāge vā puṣkare naimiṣe tathā |
aśvapaṭṭasarasi prabhāse kedārake tathā || 8 ||
kvacit prayānti saṃkrāntau cāturmāsye’pi yānti ca |
atra varṣe ca saṃkrāntau nāgavatyāstaṭe dvijāḥ || 9 ||
gṛhṇantu mama dānaṃ ca kurvantu pāvanān hi naḥ |
ityuktā api viprāste virāgāḥ puṣkaraṃ yayuḥ || 1.498.1 0||
pañcarātrinivāsārthaṃ saṃkrāntau makare raveḥ |
rājā vijñāya tatsarvaṃ damayantīṃ priyāṃ tadā || 11 ||
prāha tvaṃ kanakaṃ bhūṣā vastrāṇyādāya saddhanam |
nāganadyāstaṭaṃ yāhi yatra brāhmaṇayoṣitaḥ || 1 2||
bhūṣaṇādīni vastūni tāsāṃ yaccha yathecchayā |
na tāsāṃ patayo’smākaṃ prakurvanti pratigraham || 1 3||
striyo’vaśyaṃ grahīṣyanti dānaṃ bhūṣaṇaprabhṛti |
yādṛśaṃ yādṛśaṃ vāpi nārī dhatte vibhūṣaṇam || 14||
sā tatheti pratijñāya bahūnyābharaṇāni ca |
maṇimuktāpravālāni kuṇḍalāni śubhāni ca || 15||
tathā candrojjvalān hārān nūpurāṇi bṛhanti ca |
indranīlamahānīlavaidūryakhacitāni ca || 16||
padmarāgaistathā vajrairmāṇikyaiśca manoharaiḥ |
keyūraiḥ kaṃkaṇairdivyaiḥ śṛṃkhalāhemasūtrakaiḥ ||17||
gṛhītvā nāgavatyāṃ vai snātuṃ saṃkrāntiparvaṇi |
samāyātā tilamiṣṭānnāni nītvā bṛhanti ca || 18||
snātvā tīre niveśyaitanmahābhūṣaṇaparvatam |
pratīkṣate ca pātrāṇi dānasya tannadītaṭe || 1 9||
etasminnantare prāptāstāpasyaḥ kautukānvitāḥ |
jñātvā dānārthamāyātāṃ damayantīṃ nṛpapriyām ||1.498.20||
kīdṛśī rājapatnī sā kiṃrūpā kiṃvibhūṣaṇā |
itikautukamāpannā viprapatnyaḥ samāgatāḥ ||21 ||
āgatāstā namaścakre prāha rājñī manoharam |
mayāyaṃ bhūṣaṇastoma uddiśya garuḍadhvajam ||22||
kalpito’dya dine dānaṃ brāhmaṇīṣu phalapradam |
tasmād gṛhṇantu tāpasyo mayā dattāni vāñchayā ||23||
bhūṣaṇāni hyanekāni prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ mama |
tataścaikābravīt tāsāmenāṃ muktāvalīṃ mama ||24||
dehi śrutvā nṛpapatnyā prakṣālya caraṇau svayam |
dattā muktāvalī tasyai vastrairdivyaiḥ samanvitā ||25||
tathānyāyai dadau hāraṃ hārākāṃkṣāṃ vibudhya sā |
tṛtīyāyai kuṇḍale ca dadau jñātvā ca tanmanaḥ ||26||
tataśca śeṣāstāpasyo jagṛhurbhūṣaṇāni ca |
yāni yāni dadau tasyai tasyai mudā ca tāni ca ||27||
yathā yathā pragṛhṇanti tāpasyo bhūṣaṇāni tāḥ |
tathā tathāsyāḥ saṃjajñe damayantyāḥ pramodakaḥ ||28||
anyāni ca pracikṣepa śataśo’tha sahasraśaḥ |
gṛhṇantviti kathayitvā maunaṃ tasthau nṛpapriyā ||29||
gṛhītāni tu sarvāṇi tāpasībhistato hyapi |
na tṛptirjāyate tāsāṃ rājñī tadāha tāḥ punaḥ ||1.498.3 0 ||
santoṣaḥ kriyatāṃ gatvā cānayāmi punaḥ punaḥ |
ityuktvā prayayau tūrṇaṃ gṛhītvā cāyayau drutam ||3 1 ||
anantāni bhūṣaṇāni cāmbarāṇi dhanāni ca |
dadau pañcāhaparyantaṃ brāhmaṇībhyo muhurmuhuḥ ||32||
tāpasyo’pi dadhustāni vastrāṇi vividhāni hi |
bhūṣaṇāni ca gātreṣu saspṛhāstoṣapūrvikāḥ ||33||
ūṭajāni dhanavastrabhūṣāpūrṇāni cakrire |
atha catasro brāhmaṇyo valkalājinaśobhitāḥ ||34||
dānagrahaṇaṃ necchantyo na tasyāḥ pārśvamāgatāḥ |
tāsāṃ dānasya lābhārthaṃ rājñī tu pañcame dine ||35||
bhūṣaṇāni mahārhāṇi gṛhītvā tāḥ yayau drutam |
rājñī provāca tāḥ sarvāḥ prasādaḥ kriyatāmiti ||36||
imāni bhūṣaṇārthāya gṛhyantāṃ bhūṣaṇāni vai |
tāpasyastu virāgiṇyaḥ patīcchānugatāḥ sadā ||37||
pātivratyaparāḥ prāhuḥ patīnāṃ nāsti tanmanaḥ |
patyurājñāṃ vinā patnī karoti dehaśobhanam ||38||
pāpaṃ sā prāpnuyāt tasmād gṛhṇīmo na vayaṃ tava |
nāsmākaṃ bhūṣaṇaiḥ kāryaṃ bhūṣitā valkalairvayam ||3 9 ||
evaṃ saṃvadatāṃ tāsāṃ tayā sārdhaṃ tu tatkṣaṇam |
catvāraḥ patayaḥ prāptā vyomamārgeṇa cāśramān ||1.498.40||
śunaḥśepo’tha śākreyo boddho dāntaścaturthakaḥ |
śeṣāḥ sarve gatibhraṃśaṃ prāpya bhūmārgamāśritāḥ ||41 ||
patnīnāṃ tṛṣṇayā bhūṣādānagrahaṇadoṣataḥ |
catvāraste ṛṣipatnīḥ kanyakāśca vibhūṣitāḥ ||42||
dṛṣṭvā kimidaṃ kimidaṃ procurvikṛtamāśritāḥ |
kena datvābhūṣaṇāni yat tāpasyo viḍambitāḥ ||43||
dhanavastrāṇi datvā naścāśramo’yaṃ vikāritaḥ |
tadā prāhustu tāpasyaścamatkāranṛpasya vai ||44||
mahiṣī damayantīyaṃ vartate sāmprataṃ tayā |
sampradattāni sarvāsāṃ bhūṣaṇānyambarāṇi ca ||45||
asmākamapi saṃprāptā dātuṃ seyaṃ pratiṣṭhati |
asmābhirna gṛhītāni niṣiddhā sā nivāritā| ||46 ||
itiśrutvā ca tāṃ dṛṣṭvā brāhmaṇāstapasaḥ kṣayāt |
tāṃ śepuste śrāvayitvā śṛṇu lakṣmi tapobalam ||47||
dvāsaptatirvayaṃ rājñi snānārthaṃ puṣkare gatāḥ |
vyomamārgeṇa tapasā manomārutaraṃhasā ||48||
catvārasta ime prāptā yeṣāṃ dāraiḥ parigrahaḥ |
na kṛtaste’pare vyomno mārgād bhraṣṭāśca puṣkare ||49||
nārīṇāṃ ca satīnāṃ tu satītvena mahadbalam |
dānagraheṇa naṣṭaṃ tad vaihāyasaṃ balaṃ yataḥ ||1.498.50||
tapaso vañcito’smākamāśramo’yaṃ tvayā dhanaiḥ |
vibhūṣaṇādidānaiśca tat tvaṃ śilā bhavātra vai ||51 ||
atha tuṣṭāva sā rājñī muktyarthaṃ ca tadā tu te |
prāhuścātra mādhavīti śāṇḍilī kamalāṃśajā ||5 2||
viprakanyā samāgatya tavoddhāraṃ kariṣyati |
acireṇaiva kālena sāgamiṣyati mādhavī ||5 3 ||
lakṣmīrūpā śilāyāṃ sā sthāsyatyeva nadītaṭe |
śilā kanyāsvarūpā sā bhaviṣyati ramā yathā ||54||
śṛṇu lakṣmi tatra kanyāṃ śilāṃ brāhmaṇasannidhau |
tatkṣaṇameva sañjātāṃ jñātvā vṛttāntameva tam ||55 ||
rājā tatra drutaṃ prāpa patnīṃ śuśoca vai drutam |
catvāro brāhmaṇā nītvā kuṭumbaṃ vyomasatpathā ||56||
yayurhimālayaṃ vighnaśūnyaṃ sthalaṃ tapasvinaḥ |
rājā śilāṃ prasaṃspṛśya smṛtvā smṛtvā priyāguṇān ||57||
vilalāpa kṣaṇaṃ pativratāṃ śrāddhaṃ cakāra ha |
tasyā upari saudhaṃ ca kārayāmāsa pārthivaḥ ||58||
svayaṃ karpūradhūpādyairvastrakuṃkumacandanaiḥ |
pūjāṃ cakāra nityaṃ ca kārayāmāsa bhūsuraiḥ ||59||
atha padbhyāṃ mahīṃ krāntvā cāṣṭaṣaṣṭidvijāḥ śubhāḥ |
āyātā nāganadyāste tīre śrāntāḥ sudūragāḥ ||1.498.60||
dṛṣṭvābharaṇayuktām̐śca jñātvā vṛttāntamityapi |
vividuḥ kāraṇaṃ vyomnaḥ pātasya dānasaṃgraham ||61 ||
damayantyāḥ śilābhāvaṃ jñātavantaśca vai tataḥ |
camatkāranṛparāṣṭranāśārthaṃ jagṛhurjalam ||62||
yataścāsmadgatirvyomni nāśitā dānalobhataḥ |
brāhmaṇīnāṃ mano jātaṃ rājasaṃ rāgamiśritam ||63||
tatphalaṃ yātu rājā ca rāṣṭraṃ ceti vicintyate |
śāpaṃ vaktumārabhante tāvadvai viprayoṣitaḥ ||64||
vārayāmāsuratyarthaṃ śāpo deyo na sarvathā |
yato vayaṃ narendrasya bhāryayā samalaṃkṛtāḥ ||65||
suvastrairbhūṣaṇairdivyaiḥ śraddhāpūtena cetasā |
vayaṃ dāridryadoṣeṇa karṣitā bhavatāṃ gṛhe ||66||
na prāptaṃ tu sukhaṃ martye vastrabhūṣādisaṃbhavam |
kevalānāṃ tāpasānāṃ paro lokaḥ sukhapradaḥ ||67||
nīcānāṃ viṣayasthānāṃ tvihaiva sukhamātrakam |
tapodharmagṛhasthānāmubhayatra sukhaṃ sadā ||68||
tadasmābhiḥ sukhaṃ cātra bhoktavyaṃ dharmavartibhiḥ |
tā vayaṃ vastrabhūṣāṇāṃ sukhaṃ saṃsevya sarvadā ||69||
gṛhasthadharmān saṃsevya patisevāṃ surārcanam |
saṃsevya sādhayiṣyāmo lokadvayamanuttam ||1.498.70||
tasmād yūyaṃ cātra viprā bhūmimādāya bhūpateḥ |
vṛttiṃ cāpi gṛhītvaiva ramyāṇi ca gṛhāṇi ca ||71 ||
gṛhītvaivātha vīkṣadhvaṃ putrapautrasamudbhavam |
saukhyaṃ cāpi kumārīṇāṃ bāndhavānāṃ viśeṣataḥ ||72||
na kariṣyatha cedvākyametadasmadudīritam |
sarvāḥ prāṇaparityāgaṃ kariṣyāmo na saṃśayaḥ ||73||
yūyaṃ strīvadhapāpena yuktāḥ yāsyatha rauravam |
śrutvaitacchāpadānārthaṃ dhṛtaṃ vāri bhuvastale ||74||
tatyajurdāravākyaiste sā bhūrūṣaratāṃ gatā |
atha śrutvā ca tadvārtāṃ rājā mumoda cāyayau ||75||
brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pradānārthaṃ bhuvo dhanasya sampadām |
brāhmaṇānāṃ vacanena rājā puramakārayat ||76 ||
prākāraparikhāyuktaṃ gopuraiḥ saudhapaṃktibhiḥ |
śobhitaṃ nagaraṃ nāma camatkārapuraṃ tu tat ||77||
aṣṭaṣaṣṭibrāhmaṇānāṃ vāsastatra kuṭumbinām |
kārito bhūbhṛtā tebhyo jīvikāpi samarpitā ||78||
tataḥ paraṃ ca sā lakṣmīrmādhavī yā ca śāṇḍilī |
nāganadyāṃ nacirādvai puraṃ draṣṭuṃ samāgatā ||79||
snātvā kṣaṇaṃ śilāyāṃ sā niṣasāda tadā satī |
damayantī punarjātā nārīrūpā yathā purā ||1.498.80||
brāhmaṇībhyo namaskṛtya svapnotthitaiva harṣitā |
yayau rājagṛhaṃ mahotsavaṃ cakāra bhūpatiḥ ||81||
grāmāṇāmaṣṭaṣaṣṭiṃ ca dadau dānaṃ sukhapradam |
viprāṇāmatha catvāri gotrāṇyanyānyapi priye |||82|||
yayurhimālayaṃ cātra catuḥṣaṣṭiśca śeṣitāḥ |
taiḥ samyakkāritā yajñā bahuhavyasudakṣiṇāḥ ||83 ||
yajñe kṛte’bhavad rājā rogeṇātiprapīḍitaḥ |
kāraṇaṃ tatra vai cāsīdekasya brāhmaṇasya vai ||84||
trijātasya spṛṣṭadravyahomaḥ krūraphalapradaḥ |
trijātasya parīkṣārthaṃ vahninā divyasajjalam ||85 ||
kuṇḍaṃ pradarśitaṃ tatra snāne visphoṭako bhavet |
yasya sa eva boddhavyastrijāta iti tatkṛtam ||86||
parīkṣyaivaṃ ca vipraḥ sa niṣkāsito vanaṃ yayau |
tapaścakre haraṃ smṛtvā harastuṣṭo babhūva ha ||87||
varaṃ vṛṇu haraḥ prāha vipra uvāca śaṃkaram |
trijātadoṣaṃ niṣkāsya dehi sarvottamocchratām ||88||
śaṃkaraśca dadau tasmai na garaṃ na garaṃ manum |
yaduccāraṇamātreṇa sarpā nirviṣatāṃ tathā ||89||
prāpnuyurmaraṇaṃ cāpi gṛhāṇa gaccha tatsthalam |
etanmantraṃ gṛhītvā sa nagaraṃ ca yayau dvijaḥ ||1.498.9 0||
nagarasthā dvijā hyāsam̐stadā sarpaprapīḍitāḥ |
trijātena ca mantreṇa rakṣitāḥ sarvato dvijāḥ ||9 1 ||
te sthitā nāgarāḥ sarve trijātādyāḥ samuttamāḥ |
kṛṣṇabhaktiparāḥ sarve hāṭakeśvarapūjakāḥ ||9 2||
hāṭakeśvaradevātte labdhavanto manuṃ tadā |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ ||9 3||
cakruśca bhajanaṃ jāpaṃ narā nāryaśca sarvadā |
golokaṃ prayayuścānye prayānti bhajanāt priye ||94||
ityākhyātaścamatkāro brāhmaṇānāṃ tapasvinām |
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya vāñcchitaṃ ca phalaṃ bhavet || 95||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne camatkāranṛpatibhāryayā damayantyā kṛtaratnasvarṇādidānagrahaṇena vyomamārgagāmibrāhmaṇānāṃ patanaṃ vipraśāpena damayantyāḥ śilātvaṃ punarmādhavīsparśena rājñītvaṃ nagaravāsādi cetinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭanavatyadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||498||

<1.499>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi bhadrikāyāḥ kathāṃ divyāṃ manoramām |
revatyāśca kathāṃ divyāṃ kathayāmi nibodha me || 1 ||
camatkārapure nāgā hāṭakeśvarabhaktitaḥ |
āgatya khalu pātālānnivasanti kvacitkvacit || 2 ||
ekadā nāgabālaṃ vai rudramālābhidhaṃ dvijaḥ |
kratho nāmāhanannadyāṃ laguḍena vṛthā jale || 3 ||
hā hato’smītyuvācāyaṃ sarpastasya prasūstadā |
tathā sarpāścāyayuśca manuṣyarūpadhāriṇaḥ || 4 ||
prāṇām̐statyāja bālaḥ sa sarpāḥ kruddhā bhayaṃkarāḥ |
dudruvurvipranāśārthaṃ vipro dudrāva cāśramam || 5 ||
nāgā gatvā sakuṭumbaṃ bhakṣayāmāsurulbaṇāḥ |
tasya viprasya bhaginī bālavaidhavyaduḥkhitā || 6 ||
brahmacaryaparā sādhvī kṛṣṇabhaktiparāyaṇā |
tāpasī bhadrikānāmnī śaśāpa nāginīṃ tadā || 7 ||
nāgamātā revatī tvaṃ savaṃśaṃ nāśamāpnuhi |
revatī śāpamāpannārādhayāmāsa pārvatīm || 8 ||
tataḥ katipayāhasya tasyāstuṣṭā maheśvarī |
provāca varadāsmīti revatī varamārthayat || 9 ||
bhadrikāśāpanāśo me bhavatviti samārthayat |
pārvatī prāha śāpasya nāśo naiva bhavet kvacit || 1.499.10 ||
kintu sarpastakṣako vai saurāṣṭre raivato nṛpaḥ |
ānartaviṣaye bhāvī tasya kṣemaṃkarī priyā || 11 ||
bhaviṣyati tayoḥ putrī mānuṣī tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi |
tava bhartā tadā śeṣaḥ svayaṃ tatra bhaviṣyati || 1 2||
tava varasya lābhārthaṃ brahmāṇaṃ prati me gatiḥ |
kṣaṇamātraṃ bhāvinī vai tatra te vaṃśavistaraḥ || 13 ||
nāśameṣyati cetyevaṃ vaṃśanāśo bhaviṣyati |
punaste balarāmeṇa vivāhaḥ saṃbhaviṣyati || 14|
śrīkṛṣṇaśca svavaṃśasya nāśaṃ kariṣyati prabhuḥ |
kaṇvaśāpena vai tatra hyevaṃ śāpaḥ phaliṣyati || 15||
evamuktā revatī sā yayau pātālameva ca |
śeṣaṃ nivedayāmāsa vṛttāntaṃ nirvṛttaṃ bhuvi ||16|
atha sā brāhmaṇī nāmnā bhadrikā vidhavā satī |
kathāṃ śuśrāva śāstrāṇāṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇānanāt ||19||
devayātrāṃ tīrthayātrāṃ cakre bhaktiṃ narāyaṇe |
athaikadā takṣakaśca samāyayau bhuvastalam ||18|||
nāgavatyāstaṭe dṛṣṭvā bhadrikāṃ tu surūpiṇīm |
nināya nararūpeṇa pātālaṃ bhadrikā ca tam || 1 9|||
śaśāpa mānuṣo bhūtvā saha patnyā sutābhavam |
duḥkhaṃ vai prāpsyase vaṃśanāśasampādakaṃ tadā ||1.499.20|
takṣako bhayamāpannastuṣṭāva tāṃ tu bhadrikām |
bhadrikā prāha māṃ pṛthvyāṃ naya tatra sthale punaḥ ||21 |
takṣakeṇa tadānītā camatkārapuraṃ prati |
atha lokāpavādena citāṃ sā praviveśa ha ||22||
paśyatāṃ janavṛddhānāṃ śuddhyarthaṃ bhadrikā yadā |
na dagdhā romaśo vāji janāstvāścaryamāgatā ||23||
vahnirvai śītalo jātaḥ śuddhā sā bhadrikā yataḥ |
papātātha mahāvṛṣṭiḥ kusumānāṃ nabhastalāt ||24||
devāḥ prāhuḥ paraṃ śuddhā vartase tvaṃ subhadrike |
na tvayā sadṛśī cānyā kācit satī bhaviṣyasi ||25|
tisraḥ koṭyo’rdhakoṭiśca yāni lomāni mānuṣe |
teṣāṃ madhye na te sādhvi pāpamekamapi kvacit ||26||
tvaṃ ca sādhvī satī kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapativratā |
bhūtvā ca tyāginī devī sāṃkhyayogamupāśritā ||27||
satāṃ sevāṃ kuru puṇyaṃ samārādhaya keśavam |
bhadrikā prārthayāmāsa śrutvā devaṃ janārdanam ||28|
tāvat kṛṣṇo dvijo bhūtvāvātatāra bhuvastalam |
dadau tasyai śubhāṃ dīkṣāṃ tulasīmālikāṃ gale ||29|
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye namaḥ |
ityuktvā triḥ karṇamantraṃ yayāvadṛśyatāṃ dvijaḥ ||1.499.30||
bhadrikārādhayāmāsa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ sadā |
tatra paraṃ tapaścakre bhikṣānnakṛtabhojanā ||3 1 ||
nāganadyāṃ ca tannāmnā bhadrikātīrthamuttamam |
camatkārakaraṃ jātaṃ snātvā niṣpāpatā bhavet ||32||
atha sā bhadrikā kālaṃ prāptā divyaśarīriṇī |
bhūtvā mokṣaṃ yayau dhāma kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai ||33||
evaṃ satībalaṃ lakṣmi muktidaṃ pāpanāśanam |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktyā bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ ||34||
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya kīrtanādapi padmaje |
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labhet sampadvarāmārogyamīśatām ||35||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne bhadrikākhyabrāhmaṇyāḥ śāpena nāgamātuḥ revatītvaṃ takṣakasya mānuṣatvaṃ bhadrikāyāḥ kṛṣṇabhaktyā muktiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā navanavatyadhikacatuśśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ |||499|||

<1.500>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ karṇotpalāyā brahmayoṣitaḥ |
satyasandha iti khyātaḥ purāsīt pṛthivīpatiḥ || 1 ||
tasya karṇotpalānāmnī kanyāsīd dharmapālinī |
lakṣmyaṃśarūpā cihnaiśca rekhābhiḥ kamalāsamā || 2 ||
yuvatīṃ tāṃ varayogyāṃ dṛṣṭvā sa pṛthivīpatiḥ |
cintayāmāsa ca muhuḥ kasyemāṃ pradadāmyaham || 3 ||
na tasyāḥ sadṛśaḥ kaścid varo’tra dharaṇisthale |
na svarge na ca pātāle tasmād yāmi pitāmaham || 4 |
brahmātra viṣaye’vaśyaṃ yaṃ varaṃ darśayiṣyati |
tasmai putrīṃ pradāsyāmi nānyasmai vai kathaṃcana || 5 ||
atha putrīṃ sahanītvā brahmalokaṃ jagāma saḥ |
brahmā cāsīt kṛṣṇapūjāparaṃ kṣaṇaṃ jagatpatiḥ || 6 ||
pūjānte satyasandhaḥ sa rājā brahmāṇamādarāt |
putryā saha namaskṛtya provāca vinayānvitaḥ || 7 ||
ahaṃ pitaḥ samāyāto martyalokāttavāntikam |
satyasandho mahīpāla ānartadeśaviśrutaḥ || 8 ||
iyaṃ karṇotpalānāmnī kamalāṃśā sutā mama |
asyā yogyaḥ patiḥ kaścinnānyaloke vilokyate || 9 ||
tasmānme brūhi bhartāramasyā yena dadāmyaham |
śrutvā brahmā ca taṃ prāha śṛṇu rājan vṛṣaṃ prati ||1.500.1 0||
ātmaśreṇīprasūtāya vayojyeṣṭhāya sarvathā |
kanyā deyā tu dharmāya yaśase kulavṛddhaye || 11 ||
seyaṃ tava sutā martye jyeṣṭhabhāvaṃ samāśritā |
sarveṣāṃ bhūmipālānāṃ vārdhakyamatra tacchṛṇu || 1 2||
mamāntikaṃ prapannasya tava jātaṃ yugatrayam |
atītā bhūtale martyā ye dṛṣṭā prāk tvayā nṛpa || 1 3||
anyā sṛṣṭiḥ samutpannā sāṃprataṃ dharaṇisthale |
mamātra satyaloke tu ye vartante maharṣayaḥ || 14||
na vai te mānuṣīṃ bhāryāṃ kurvanti hi kathaṃcana |
śleṣmamūtrapurīṣāṇāṃ saṃsthānamatigarhitām || 15||
tapasā kanyakā ceyaṃ kāyāntaraṃ karoti cet |
kāmadevo divyarūpāṃ grahīṣyati sutāṃ tava || 16||
nāmnā prītiṃ dvitīyāṃ vai bhāryāṃ ratyuttarāgatām |
tasmād rājendra bhūlokaṃ yāhi tvasutayā saha || 17||
kāmadevāya dātavyā tvayā kālāntare sutā |
ityuktaḥ sakanyakaḥ sa bhūtalaṃ prasamāyayau || 18||
yāvatpaśyati deśaṃ saḥ sthalasthāne jalāśayān |
jalasthāneṣu vai jātān sthalasaṃghān vicitrakān || 1 9||
anyān lokāṃstathā dharmān deśe tatra vyavasthitān |
pṛcchannapi na jānāti sambandhaṃ kenacit saha ||1.500.20||
putrāḥ pautrāstathā bhṛtyā hastyaśvādikamityapi |
te sarve nidhanaṃ prāptā yugāntare ca bāndhavāḥ ||21 ||
atha martyānilaspṛṣṭastatkṣaṇāt sa mahīpatiḥ |
sā ca kanyā jarāgrastau tāvubhau śvetamūrdhajau ||22||
śīrṇadantau balipūrṇī virūpau jarjarātmakau |
amanojñāvatijātau cipiṭākṣau purātanau ||23||
sa tu rājā tathābhūto vepamānaḥ pade pade |
papraccha mānavān ko’tra deśaḥ ko’yaṃ puraṃ ca kim ||24||
atha procurjanāstasya deśaścānartasaṃjñakaḥ |
bṛhadbalākhyo rājātra prāptipuraṃ ca pattanam ||25||
śubhramatī sariccaiṣā gartātīrthaṃ ca nāmataḥ |
iti śrutvānyanāmāni vismayaṃ tvāpa bhūpatiḥ ||26||
śuśoca vai kṣaṇaṃ paścāt snātvā nadyāṃ sa bhūpatiḥ |
vidyamānaṃ bṛhadbalaṃ prati yayau sakanyakaḥ ||27||
satyasandhastamuvāca rājan vṛttaṃ nibodha me |
ānartādhipatiścāhaṃ satyasandhaḥ purātviti ||28||
āsaṃ karṇotpalānāmnī sutā me guṇaśālinī |
seyaṃ mayā sahaivāste lakṣmītulyā ramākalā ||29||
so’hamasyāḥ pradānārthaṃ satyalokamito gataḥ |
praṣṭuṃ pitāmahaṃ devaṃ sthitastatra muhūrtakam ||1.500.3 0 ||
tāvadatra vyatītā vai yugā bahutarā nṛpa |
satyalokāt samāyāto yāvatpaśyāmi bhūtalam ||3 1 ||
sarvaṃ pariṇataṃ vāri sthalaṃ vanaṃ ca pattanam |
ajñātamiva me sarvaṃ lokyate kintu mānavaiḥ ||32||
tava nāma pradattaṃ tatsamāyāto’smi te’ntikam |
rājā bṛhadbalo lakṣmi śrutvā vaṃśaprapūrvajam ||33||
śrutaṃ satyagataṃ cātrāyātaṃ dṛṣṭvātivihvalaḥ |
harṣāśrunayano bhūtvā papāta tasya pādayoḥ ||34|||
uvāca svāgataṃ rājan bhūyaḥ susvāgataṃ pitaḥ |
idaṃ rājyaṃ nijaṃ bhūyo mayā bhṛtyena rakṣitam ||35||
svecchayā dehi dānāni kuru rājyaṃ nijaṃ pitaḥ |
tataḥ so’pi vaṃśajaṃ svaṃ samāliṃgya nṛpaṃ nṛpaḥ ||36||
śirasyāghrāyāśrupūrṇanetrābhyāṃ taṃ siṣeca ca |
prāha rājyaṃ mayā cīrṇaṃ dattaṃ dānaṃ purā bahu ||37||
vājimedhamukhairyajñairiṣṭaṃ sampūrṇadakṣiṇaiḥ |
tasmāt tapaścariṣyāmi sutayā tvanayā saha ||38||
bṛhadbalastamuvāca yatheṣṭaṃ kuru pārthiva |
tavaivāsti mahadrājyaṃ gṛhāṇa vā tapaḥ kuru ||39||
pāramparyeṇa rājendra mayaitatsakalaṃ śrutam |
satyasandho mahīpālaḥ kanyāmādāya nirgataḥ ||1.500.40||
punaściraṃ sa nāyātastatastasya sumantribhiḥ |
abhiṣiktaḥ sutastasya suhayo nāma pārthivaḥ ||41 ||
tasyāhaṃ kramaśaḥ saptasaptatitamavaṃśajaḥ |
puruṣo’smi samuddhartā dhanyohaṃ darśanāttava ||42||

śreyaḥ prāpnomyasaṃndigdhaṃ prasādaḥ kriyatāmiti |
atha prajā brāhmaṇāśca narā nāryaśca rāṣṭrajāḥ ||44||
samāyayuḥ satyasandhaṃ draṣṭuṃ kutuhalānvitāḥ |
āśīrvādān prayuñjānāḥ pupūjustaṃ mudānvitāḥ ||45||

kṛtvā parṇāśramaṃ tatra tepāte tapa uttamam ||46||

bhaktyā tvārādhayāmāsa rājā ca śaṃkaraṃ tataḥ ||47||
sākṣāttuṣṭo mahādevaḥ prasannāsyaḥ samāyayau |
rājānamāha tapasā vardhate puṇyamatyati ||48||

śaṃbhuḥ prāha paraṃ mokṣaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayam ||49||
pradāsyati prabhustvāṃ tvaṃ gṛhāṇa tulasīsrajam |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ ||1.500.50||
mantraṃ gṛhāṇa cetyuktvā dadau mantraṃ ca mālikām |
śaṃbhustiro’bhavad rājā bheje jajāpa mādhavam ||51 ||
atha rājā vṛhadbalo hyavāpa nidhanaṃ tadā |
satyasandhena viprebhyo jīvikādyāḥ samarpitāḥ |||52|||
evaṃ yāte dine gaurī santuṣṭā kanyakopari |
sākṣāt provāca te putri tuṣṭāhaṃ vāñcchitaṃ vada ||5 3 ||
karṇotpalāha tāto me madarthaṃ kaṣṭamāptavān |
mama patyurmārgaṇāya rājyād bhraṣṭaḥ kuṭumbataḥ ||54||
vairāgyeṇa tapastepe kanyāhaṃ vṛddhatāṃ gatā |
tataste kṛpayā gauri yathāhaṃ taruṇī navā ||55||
rūpayauvanasampannā sundarī syāṃ tathā kuru |
tathā bhavatu me bhartā kaścid devottamottamaḥ ||56||
rūpasampadyauvanādiyuktaściraṃprajīvanaḥ |
yathāpiturme santoṣo bhavenmātastathā kuru ||57||
gaurī provāca māghasya śuklasya tṛtīyātithau |
śanaiścaradine vasudaivatyarkṣe tu yauvanam ||58||
rūpaṃ saṃkalpya nadyāṃ ca snānaṃ kurvatra sundari |
tato divyaśarīrā tvaṃ navayauvanaśālinī ||59||
bhaviṣyasi na sandeho bhaja kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye namaḥ ||1.500.6 0||
japa mantraṃ sadā tvenaṃ dhyānaṃ kuru harestathā |
sarvaṃ prāpsyasi tapasā bhaktyābhīṣṭaṃ kṣaṇaṃ kuru ||6 1 ||
evamuktvā kṛṣṇamantraṃ datvā ca tulasī srajam |
tirobabhūva gaurī ca kanyā yathoktamācarat ||62||
tṛtīyāyāṃ śaneryoge vasudevarkṣasaṃyute |
dhyātvā sārūpya saubhāgyayauvanāni navāni ca ||6 3 ||
viveśārdhaniśāyāṃ sā jale yāvattadaiva sā |
navayauvanarūpāḍhyā niṣkrāntā salilāt tadā ||64||
tāvacchrībrahmaṇājñaptaḥ kāmadevaḥ svayaṃ khalu |
patnyarthaṃ prītisaṃyuktaścājagāmābravīcca tām ||65 ||
brahmaṇā preṣitaścāhaṃ navayauvanarūpavān |
pārvatyānumataścātra tvadarthaṃ tvāgato’smyaham ||66 ||
asmyahaṃ kāmadevo vai ciraṃjīvī ratīśvaraḥ |
prītināmnī mama bhāryā śāśvatī bhava mā ciram ||67||
karṇotpalāha me tātaṃ gatvā prārthaya māṃ svayam |
kanyā nāsti kadācidvai svacchandā pitṛsannidhau ||68||
tatrāhaṃ pūrvato gatvā kanyā tiṣṭhāmi sundarī |
bhavānāgatya paścācca prārthayiṣyati māṃ mudā ||69||
ityuktvā taṃ praṇipatya kanyā svapitaraṃ yayau |
atha tāṃ sa samālokya pitā sutāṃ suyauvanām ||1.500.70 ||
āścaryamāpa papraccha kāraṇaṃ rūpayovane |
kanyā prāha pitargauryāḥ prasādāt snānamātrataḥ ||71 ||
nadyāṃ labdhavatīrūpaṃ yauvanaṃ ca navaṃ vapuḥ |
hariṃ cārādhya kāntaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ tathā ||72||
sarvamāptavatī devyā brahmaṇā ca madarthakaḥ |
patiḥ surūpalāvaṇyatejoyauvanaśobhitaḥ ||73 ||
preṣitaḥ sundaraḥ puṣpabāṇadhṛk so’pi te’ntikam |
samāyāti vilokyainaṃ samarpya māṃ sukhī bhava ||74||
ityuktaśca pitā putrīṃ vilokya kamalāsamām |
abravīdadya me putri saṃjātaṃ tapasaḥ phalam ||75||
etasminnantare kāmo rājño’ntikamupāgamat |
natvābravīt tava kanyāṃ dehi me bhūpa sundarīm ||76||
brahmaṇātra samādiṣṭaḥ pārvatyānumatastathā |
varaṇārthaṃ svayaṃ samāgato’smi kāmadevakaḥ ||77||
tataḥ samarpayāmāsa tāṃ kanyāṃ vahnisannidhau |
sā ca rateranusthānā prītināmābhavat priyā ||78||
tāṃ ca nītvā yayau kāmaḥ kāmalokaṃ surājasam |
satyasandho’pi hṛṣṭātmā sutāṃ dṛṣṭvā sukhānvitām ||79||
abhīṣṭapatinā yuktā kṛtakṛtyo babhūva ha |
dṛḍhaṃ padmāsanaṃ kṛtvā brahmadvāreṇa yogavit ||1.500.80 ||
dehānniḥsārayāmāsa cātmānaṃ brahmaṇā saha |
yayau yatrāsti kanyā sā kāmaloke suputrikā ||8 1 ||
tasmāt kanyāṃ dvitīyāṃ tu tāṃ surūpādidhāriṇīm |
nītvā datvā caikarūpāṃ kāmāya tvaparāṃ tanum ||82||
rājā muktaḥ sutāṃ muktāṃ sahanītvā ca pārṣadaiḥ |
harermuktaiḥ saha dhāma golokaṃ prāpa śāśvatam ||83 ||
evaṃ karṇotpalā lakṣmi bhaktyā ca tapasā tathā |
prītirūpā kāmapatnī muktā ca mokṣagābhavat ||84||
bṛhadbalasya rājñyā ca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ |
ārādhitaśca putrārthaṃ viprarūpeṇa mādhavaḥ ||85 ||
samāgatya dadau garbhaṃ mānasaṃ ca kṣaṇāntare |
jātismaro’bhavatputro nārāyaṇasamudbhavaḥ ||86||
viṃśativarṣakāyuṣko nārāyaṇasamo guṇaiḥ |
dhanurvidyāvedavidyācamatkārādiśevadhiḥ |||87||
aṭacandro’bhavannāmnā camatkāranarādhipaḥ |
ya etacchṛṇuyādvāpi śrāvayed bhaktibhāvataḥ ||88||
caturvargasya saṃsiddhiṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ |
kanyā nārī ca saubhāgyaṃ labhate prītivat sadā ||89||
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ sampadaśca putraṃ dhānyaṃ dhanādikam |
saubhāgyaṃ puṇyapuñjaṃ ca labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||1.500.90||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne satyasandhanṛpateḥ kanyāyāḥ karṇotpalāyāḥ kamalāṃśāyāḥ patimārgaṇārthaṃ brahmalokagamanaṃ tataḥ pṛthivīmāgatya kāmadevapatnītvaṃ prītināmnātha ca mokṣaṇaṃ dvitīyarūpeṇetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||500||

<1.501>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi yājñavalkyaṛṣeḥ kathāṃ manoharām |
āsīd brāhmaṇaśārdūlaḥ śākalya iti viśrutaḥ || 1 ||
bhārgavānvayasaṃbhūto vedavedāṃgapāragaḥ |
vardhamāne pure dharmāraṇye śiṣyapraśiṣyavān || 2 ||
sadā vidyādānadātā yogasiddhyādiśobhitaḥ |
tasya śiṣyo’bhavadyājñavalkyaḥ sevāparāyaṇaḥ || 3 ||
śākalyaśca vardhamānanṛpatervai purohitaḥ |
paurohityaṃ karotyeva sarveṣu nṛpakarmasu || 4 ||
prerayati cāśīrvādān dātuṃ prabhātake |
yājñavalkyaṃ śreṣṭhaśiṣyaṃ yājñavalkyo’pi nityadā || 5 ||
yātyāśīrvādadānārthaṃ prātaḥ snātvā mudānvitaḥ |
ekadā tu vinā snānaṃ malināmbarasaṃyutaḥ || 6 ||
yājñavalkyaḥ prabhāte vai vartate ca tadā guruḥ |
yājñavalkyamuvācedaṃ gaccha śīghraṃ nṛpaṃ prati || 7 ||
evaṃ taṃ yojayāmāsa śāntyarthaṃ nṛpamandire |
yājñavalkyo yayau śāntipāṭhaṃ kṛtvā japottaram || 8 ||
śāntyudakapradānāya taṃ nṛpaṃ prati saṃyayau |
pārthivo’pi muniṃ vinā snānaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca śaṃkitaḥ || 9 ||
na jagrāha jalaṃ cāśīrvacanaṃ cāpi taddine |
asatyaṃ ca prāha rājā nāhaṃ snāto dvijottama || 1.501.1 0||
muniṃ snānavihīnaṃ tu tathyaṃ pravaktumakṣamaḥ |
atra śālāgate kāṣṭhe tasmādetajjalaṃ kṣipa || 11 ||
yājñavalkyo’pi vijñāya svasyāsnātasya kāraṇam |

yājñavalkyastadā prāha rājan śaṃkāparo bhavān |
mamābhiṣekadānasya tvamanarho’si sāmpratam || 16||
guravastu sadā śuddhā bhavanti brāhmaṇā nṛpa |
sādhavaśca na vā snātāḥ snātā vā śrīharestanuḥ ||17||
tatrāpi yadi vidvāṃsastatrāpyaiśvaryaśālinaḥ |
siddhā vā brāhmaṇā devā devavāsāḥ pratāpinaḥ || 18||
nārīsaṃgakṛtāścāpi na snātā api pāvanāḥ |
mantrasiddhibrahmasiddhitapaḥsiddhiparāstu ye || 1 9||
tatra śuddhirna draṣṭavyā gurau sādhau sure harau |
pitari mātari patyau satyāṃ gavi kadācana ||1.501.20||
kāmaḥ krodhastathā lobhaḥ pāruṣyaṃ vāsanā ratiḥ |
sarve divyāstatra bodhyāḥ samarthe nāsti dūṣaṇam ||21 ||
malinā pṛthivī pādaspṛṣṭā tasya hi pāvanī |
rathyāmbu gaṃgayā miśraṃ gāṃgavatpāpanāśakam ||22||

vahnivāyusamaḥ pūtastejasā bhāskaropamaḥ |

śṛṇu sādhvi mama tātaḥ śāṇḍilyo munipuṃgavaḥ|
tasyaikāhaṃ samutpannā mādhavīnāmakanyakā ||71 ||
pituḥ karomi śuśrūṣāṃ homakāle yathocitām |
nīvārādīni dhānyāni nityaṃ caivānayāmyaham ||72||
kadācittvatha kālasya nārado munirāgataḥ |
āśrame mama tātasya śrānto mayā prasevitaḥ ||73||
snāpito bhojitaḥ saṃvāhito dehe’tibhāvataḥ |
niviṣṭaścāsane mātrā saṃpṛṣṭo vinayāttadā ||74||
ekeyaṃ kanyakāsmākaṃ vārdhakye vartate mune |
tadasyāḥ kīrtaya kṣipraṃ bhartāraṃ susukhodayam ||75||
vrataṃ vā niyamaṃ vā tvaṃ tapo homaṃ japaṃ ca vā |
mantraṃ vā yena cīrṇena bhartā syāt saumyasadguṇī ||76 ||
snehilaśca prasannāsyaḥ priyavāk svapriyāpriyaḥ |
śrutvā śrīnāradaḥ prāha gaurīpūjanamuttamam ||77||
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre gatvā karotu te sutā |
bhartāraṃ prāpsyati gauryā āśīrvādena te sutā ||78||
tatra pūrvaṃ gatā gaurī gaṃgerṣyayā śubhasthalam |
tataḥ sā cintayāmāsa kāṃ devīṃ pūjayāmyaham ||79||
saubhāgyārthaṃ yato’nyā māṃ pūjayeyuḥ sadā striyaḥ |
iti vicārya sā bhaktyā pupūjātmānameva ca ||1.501.80||
svīyamūrtiṃ mṛdā kṛtvā sthāne caikatra cāsane |
ātmaprāṇāgnihotraiśca mantrairātharvaṇaistathā ||81 ||
pṛthvīṃ jalaṃ tathā tejo vāyumākāśamityamūn |
mūrtau saṃyujya cātmānaṃ tāpasī sā yatavratā ||82||
gaurīṃ saṃpūjayāmāsa puṣpadhūpānulepanaiḥ |
tanmantrākṛṣṭacitto vai śaṃkaraḥ satvaraṃ yayau ||83 ||
vad devi tava śaktyā gauryākṛṣṭo’hamāgataḥ |
kathaṃ tvaṃ kuruṣe caitattava rūpasya pūjanam ||84||
ākarṣayati māṃ gaurī prasahya tava sannidhau |
tasmādāgaccha kailāsaṃ brūhi doṣo’sti cenmayi ||85 ||
pārvatī prāha mūrdhnā tvaṃ dhatse gaṃgāṃ sapatnikām |
tasmānnāhaṃ gamiṣyāmi yāvanna tyajasi priyām ||86 ||
śaṃbhuḥ prāha nṛpo bhāgīrathastaptvātidāruṇam |
tapo māṃ prārthayāmāsa gaṃgāyā dhāraṇāya vai ||87||
ākāśājjāhnavīvegaṃ patantaṃ dharaṇītale |
gamiṣyantaṃ ca pātālaṃ vijñāya māṃ nyayojayat ||88||
atraiva gaṃgāsthityarthaṃ tataścaivaṃ dhṛtā mayā |
sā manmūrdhnā śanairhimālayaṃ labdhvā śubhālayam ||89||
bhārate pāvanārthaṃ vai dehināṃ yāsyati dhruvam |
enāṃ jalasvarūpāṃ ca kṛtvā pitre dadāmi te ||1.501.90||
āgaccha me priye kānte saubhāgyaṃ sarvadāstu te |
sāpatnyaṃ naiva boddhavyaṃ sā nāsti me vivāhitā ||91 ||
nāpi patnī na vā dāsī nānyā bhāryātmikāpi ca |
āśritāsti satī tasmādāgaccha gṛhameva me ||92||
evamuktvā mahādevo vṛṣamāropyatāṃ śivām |
svayamāruhya paścācca yayau kailāsaparvatam ||93||
tāṃ gaurīṃ tava putrīyaṃ samārādhayatu drutam |
prītikaraṃ yatheṣṭaṃ ca tataḥ prāpsyati satpatim || 94||
ityuktvā nāradaḥ satyaṃ lokaṃ yayau tataḥ param |
mayā kumāryā ca bhaktyā gaurī prapūjitā vrate || 95||
mārgaśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ naivedyagandhalepanaiḥ |
tatprabhāvādayaṃ prāpto jaiminirbrāhmaṇaḥ patiḥ ||96||
tasmāttvamapi kalyāṇi pūjayaināṃ samāhitā |
saṃprāpsyasi susaubhāgyaṃ maitreyyā sadṛśaṃ śubhe ||97||
śrutvā kātyāyanī sarvaṃ śāṇḍilyā yatprakīrtitam |
cakāra mārgatṛtīyāvrataṃ gaurīprapūjanam ||98||
tato’syāḥ patirāgatya gṛhītvā dakṣiṇe kare |
niyāya svagṛhaṃ tāṃ vai bahumānapuraḥsaram ||99||
tataḥ paraṃ tayā sārdhaṃ vartate harṣitaḥ sadā |
maitreyyā sadṛśo yadvat tato’pi ca viśeṣataḥ || 1.501.10 0||
kātyāyanī suputraṃ suṣuve kātyāyanaṃ param |
kātyāyanasuto vararucirjāto guṇālayaḥ || 101 ||
kātyāyanasya sāmarthyaṃ śṛṇu lakṣmi vadāmi te |
purā pṛthvyāḥ samudbhūtaṃ kiñcitprāṇimayaṃ caram || 102 ||
apūrvaṃ cāndhakamugraṃ kṛṣṇadantaṃ bhayānakam |
śaṃkukarṇaṃ kṛśāsyaṃ ca ūrdhvakeśaṃ bubhukṣitam || 103 ||
nṛpeṇa balinā mantrairākṛṣṭaṃ balavanmahat |
atha devān bhakṣituṃ tat pradudrāva punaḥ punaḥ || 1 04||
balinā samparityaktaṃ devaistat tāḍitaṃ muhuḥ |
tathāpi na kṣatiṃ prāpa pātitaṃ dharaṇisthale || 1 05||
upaviṣṭāstatastasya devā bhūtvā samantataḥ |
tasyodare gato brahmā śakrādyaḥ pārśvataḥ sthitāḥ || 1 06||
tāvacchukreṇa sandiṣṭā daityā hantuṃ surām̐stadā |
āyayuḥ pakṣamādāya tāvadviṣṇuḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ || 1 07||
prāha bhūtaṃ śṛṇu bhūta tvadarthaṃ devadaityayoḥ |
saṃgrāmo’tra bhavet tadvai naiṣa śobhana eva ha || 1 08||
devā daityāstvayi bhūte tiṣṭhantu mitravad yathā |
tava pūjāṃ karomyevaṃ vāstunāmā bhavānmataḥ || 109|
tatra te bhojanaṃ cārpayāmi gṛhāṇa bhāvataḥ |
tatastena pratijñātamavikalpena cetasā ||1.501.1 1 0|
uktaṃ ca yo na me pūjāṃ kariṣyati nave sthale |
kathaṃcinmānavaḥ kaścid bhakṣyaḥ sa me bhaviṣyati || 111 |
bāḍhamityevamukte ca viśvakarmākarod vidhim |
kātyāyano gṛhaṃ cakre vāstuṃ cāpūjayattadā || 1 12||
vāstupūjāṃ ca sakalāṃ kātyāyanaścakāra ha |
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre tataḥ pūjā pravartitā || 11 3||
tathā na prāpnuyād doṣaṃ gṛhajātaṃ kathaṃcana |
śilotthaṃ kupadotthaṃ ca kuvāstujamathāpi vā || 1 14||
vaiśākhasya tṛtīyāyāṃ vāstoḥ pūjābhavatpurā |
tadā pūjāprakartuśca gṛhaṃ rājyasamaṃ bhavet || 115||
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi tvākhyānaṃ cottamottamam |
bhuktimuktisusaubhāgyapatiputrādidāyakam || 116 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne śaṇḍilyaśiṣyasya yājñavalkyasya śuṣkakāṣṭhepallavīkaraṇatā vidyāpracchardanaṃ yājñavalkyasya tatputrakātyāyanasya ca camatkārāḥ, vāstupuruṣārcanādi cetinirūpaṇanāmaikādhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 501 ||

<1.502>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi purā cāsīd hārītanāmako muniḥ |
vānaprasthāśramī tasya bhāryā pūrṇakalābhidhā || 1 ||
sādhvī pativratā rūpaudāryayauvanaśobhitā |
lakṣmīsamāṃ tāṃ dṛṣṭvā vai kāmadevo mumoha ca || 2 ||
snāntīṃ vivastrāṃ saṃpaśyan tyaktvā prītiṃ ratiṃ striyau |
vijanaṃ tatsthalaṃ matvā prasuptaḥ sa taṭe kṣaṇam || 3 ||
kautukaṃ pracakārāsau niḥśvāsān niḥśvasan muhuḥ |
tiṣṭhan sandarśane tasyā rugṇo dīno yathā janaḥ || 4 ||
sāpi tathāvidhaṃ kaṃcidanāthaṃ bhikṣukaṃ śubham |
matvā pārśvaṃ yayau kiṃcid phalaṃ dātuṃ prabhojanam || 5 ||
tāvat kāmo yauvanastho vahnivacca prabhāsuraḥ |
kāmaprabhṛtanayanaḥ sarvāṃgasundaro dṛḍhaḥ || 6 ||
abhavat kṣaṇamātreṇa sānurāgaśca bhāvukaḥ |
pūrṇakalā tu taṃ dṛṣṭvā sānurāgaṃ tu nirjane || 7 ||
jambhābhagakṛtāyāsavepamānaśarīrakam |
drutaṃ tadbāṇanirbhinnā sābhilāṣā babhūva ha || 8 ||
pārśve sā niṣasādāsya spṛṣṭvā vihasya vai muhuḥ |
hanyamānā viśeṣeṇa kāmabāṇaiḥ pativratā || 9 ||
bhūmiṃ lilekha cāṃgulyā paśyantī tanmukhāmbujam |
sāyaṃ samayaḥ sañjāto hārītastāmanāgatām || 1.502.10 ||
jñātvānveṣṭuṃ ciraṃ tatrāyayau yatra tu sā satī |
tiṣṭhatyeva na saṃbhogaṃ labdhavatī ca tāvatā || 11 ||
hārītastāṃ satīṃ pativratāṃ dṛṣṭvā tu mohitām |
tāṃ vimohāṃ kārayantaṃ jalpantaṃ ca rajomayam || 1 2||
kāmasya hṛdgataṃ bhāvaṃ jñātvā kopāt samabravīt |
yasmāt pāpa tvayā patnī mamaivaṃ śarapīḍitā || 13 ||
anabhijñā tathā sādhvī svāmidharmaparāyaṇā |
pratāryate surūpaḥ san bhoktumicchati me priyām || 14||
kuṣṭhavyādhisamāyuktastasmād vipriyadarśanaḥ |
svakairdāraistathā mukto bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ || 15 ||
ityuktaḥ saḥ praṇipatyovāca hārītamuttaram |
mayā bhāryā tava dṛṣṭā mohamātreṇa vai mune || 16 ||
na ca bhuktā tathā naiva kuceṣṭāpi kṛtādhunā |
tasmānnāhaṃ śāpapātraṃ kṣamāṃ kuru kṛpānidhe || 17||
pāpaṃ tredhā mānasaṃ vācikaṃ karmajamityapi |
manastāpād vrajetpāpaṃ mānasaṃ tadgataṃ mama || 18||
vācikaṃ tu japenaiva yadvā stavanamātrataḥ |
tasya prasādanenaiva naśyati yatra tatkṛtam || 19 ||
prāyaścittairyathoktaiśca karmajaṃ pātakaṃ vrajet |
karmajaṃ na kṛtaṃ kṛtaṃ mānasaṃ vācikaṃ ca yat ||1.502.20||
bhavatprasādato naśyet prasanno bhava sarvathā |
hārītaḥ prāha taṃ kāmaṃ dehaprābalyayogataḥ ||2 1 ||
prathamaṃ manasā sarvaṃ cintyate tadanantaram |
tataḥ prajalpate vācā kriyate karmaṇā punaḥ ||22||
prathamaṃ hi manastasmāt sarvakṛtyeṣu doṣavat |
tasmātte nigrahaścātra mānaso’pi kṛto mayā ||23||
raverārādhanenaiva kuṣṭhaste vigamiṣyati |
iyaṃ bhāryā mama patnī bhūtvā khaṇḍaśilā kṣaṇam ||24||
sūryārādhanapuṇyena satī patnī bhaviṣyati |
ityuktvā ca yayau svasyāśramaṃ hārītako muniḥ ||25||
pūrṇakalā śilā jātā kāmaḥ kuṣṭhī tato’bhavat |
nāganadyāstaṭe sūryaṃ dhyātvārādhanamācarat ||26 ||
māsānte ravirāgatya kāmakuṣṭhaṃ hyanāśayat |
śilāṃ spṛṣṭvā satīṃ patnīṃ kṛtvā pūrvaṃ yathāsthitām ||27||
dadau nārāyaṇamantraṃ yayau sūryo divaṃ prati |
kāmaḥ kāmasya bhavanaṃ satī hārītakagṛham ||28||
yayau patiṃ namaskṛtya vastutaḥ pāvanī tadā |
siṣeve bhāvataḥ sādhvī bheje nārāyaṇaṃ harim ||29||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye namaḥ |
jajāpa nityadā mantraṃ babhūva divyavaiṣṇavī ||1.502.3 0||
atha tasyāḥ sannidhau vai dīrghikānāmakanyakā |
samāgacchati nityaṃ vai sevanārthaṃ gṛhāntarāt ||3 1 ||
parṇaśālā ca sānnidhye vartate itibhāvataḥ |
nityaṃ pūrṇakalāpārśve tiṣṭhati catvare drume ||32||
vedikāyāṃ ca śālāyāṃ japati śrīharermanum |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye namaḥ ||3 3||
evaṃ jāpaprabhāveṇa divyadehā hi kanyakā |
vabhūva vyomacārā ca nirāvaraṇasiddhikā ||34||
vīraśāntasya ca ṛṣeḥ putrī sā dīrghikā hyabhūt |
atidīrghā pramāṇena janahāsyavivardhinī ||35 ||
na kaścid varayāmāsa dṛṣṭvātidīrghikāṃ tu tām |
atisaṃkṣiptakeśīṃ ca hyatidīrghāṃ ca vāmanām ||36 ||
udvāhayati yaḥ saḥ ṣaṇmāsāntare mṛtiṃ vrajet |
itikāraṇamālambya na gṛhṇāti janaśca tām ||37||
tato vairāgyamāpannā tapastepe sudāruṇam |
cāndrāyaṇāni kṛcchrāṇi tathā cīrṇānyanekaśaḥ ||38||
pārākāṇi yathoktāni tathā sāntapanāni ca |
evaṃ tasyā vratasthāyāstejo vṛddhiṃ gataṃ bahu ||3 9||
ākāśagāminī śaktirudbhūtā tapaso balāt |
tato mahendrasadasi yāti samutsavādiṣu ||1.502.40||
yadā devasabhātaḥ sā prayāti svagṛhaṃ tadā |
tadāsanābhyukṣaṇaṃ ca kurvantīndrasya kiṃkarāḥ ||41 ||
tathā dṛṣṭvābhyukṣaṇaṃ ca papraccha sā purandaram |
kaṃ doṣa vīkṣya me śakra prokṣyate tvāsanaṃ mama ||42||
indraḥ prāha sute te’sti śārīro doṣa eva ha |
tvaṃ kumāryapi saṃprāptā ṛtukālaṃ vigarhitam ||43 ||
avivāhaśca te’dyāpi tvaśuddhiṃ sā tvayi sthitā |
ṛtukāle patiyogaḥ śuddhikaro hi yoṣitām ||44||
tat tvaṃ varaya bhartāraṃ yena yāsyasi medhyatām |
tacchrutvā pṛthivīṃ gatvā catvareṣu trikeṣu ca ||45||
uddhṛtya dakṣiṇaṃ pāṇiṃ vakti varārthameva yat |
yadi kaścid dvijo jātyaḥ pāṇigrahaṃ karotu me ||46||
mama tapasaścārdhaṃ tu tasmai dadāmi sāmpratam |
jalpantī tāṃ janā hāsyaṃ cakrurnarma parasparam ||47||
ekaḥ kaścit kuṣṭharogī brāhmaṇaḥ prāha dīrghikām |
ahaṃ tvāmudvahiṣyāmi kṛtvā pāṇigrahaṃ tava ||48||
tatastasyāḥ kumāryāḥ sa pāṇiṃ jagrāha sāpyatha |
patiṃ prāha vada me kāṃ sevāṃ karomi te pate ||49||
patiḥ prāhāṣṭaṣaṣṭitīrtheṣu gantuṃ mayeṣyate |
sahāyena tvadīyena yadi śaknoṣi tatkuru ||1.502.5 0||
aho bhāgyamiti matvā tatastūrṇaṃ pativratā |
kārayāmāsa sulabhaṃ vaṃśakuṭīrakaṃ śubham ||5 1 ||
mṛdutūlāsanayuktaṃ tataḥ prāha nijaṃ patim |
mama devāroha maṃjuṣāsaneṃsagamūrdhani ||52||
nayāmi sarvatīrtheṣu kṣetreṣu ca śubheṣu ca |
tataḥ kuṣṭhī prahṛṣṭaśca niṣasāda kuṭīrake ||53||
sā tat svamastake kṛtvā sarvatīrthe yathāsukham |
sarvakṣetreṣu babhrāma snāpayantī nijaṃ patim ||54||
tīrthe snānāt satīyogāt patyuḥ kuṣṭho nivartate |
nityaṃ kuṣṭhasya saṃhrāso dṛśyate tejasādhikaḥ ||55||
evaṃ sā hāṭakeśasya kṣetraṃ prāptā niśāmukhe |
nāgavatyāstaṭe vṛkṣacchāyāmāśritya peṭikām ||56||
sthāpayitvā viśaśrāma patistasyā nadītaṭam |
prātarutthāya ca śanaiḥ snātuṃ māṇḍukyasaṃjñakaḥ ||57||
yaṣṭyā yāti sṛtau patrasamudāyaṃ vilaṃghya ca |
tāvat patreṣu ṛṣirāṭ māṇḍavyo nidrito’bhavat ||58||
māṇḍukyena padā yaṣṭyā spṛṣṭaḥ patrāntarasthitaḥ |
ajānatā gatermārge māṇḍavyo jāgṛto’bhavat ||5 9 ||
prāha ko’yaṃ mahāmūḍhaḥ padā yaṣṭyā ca māmiha |
tāḍayati mama nidrābhaṃgaṃ karoti pāpavān ||1.502.60||
sūryodayāt prāgeva te mṛtirbhavatu vai dhruvā |
māṇḍukyastaṃ tathā śrutvā nanāma vai muhurmuhuḥ ||61||
tathāpi toṣamevāyaṃ nāpanno māṇḍavīsutaḥ |
māṇḍukyastvaritaḥ snātvā cāgatya vṛkṣasannidhau ||62||
patnīṃ prāha yathāvṛttaṃ kuru sevāṃ tathāntimām |
māṇḍavyaśāpataścāhaṃ mariṣye prāk raverdṛśeḥ ||63||
dīrghikā ca tadā prāha pātivratyaṃ tu me yadi |
tīrthayātrā ca vidhinā patisevā ca bhāvataḥ ||64||
sarvaṃ satyavrataṃ cenme sūryodayo’tra mā bhavet |
ityukto bhāskarāśvānāṃ staṃbhanaṃ vyomamaṇḍale ||65||
babhūva sahasā tena nābhyudeti prabhākaraḥ |
rātrikālo mahāñjātaḥ sarve sūryodayaṃ vinā ||66||
babhūvuścātiduḥkhasthā ruddhā yajñādikāḥ kriyāḥ |
śrāddhādhyayanadānāni dharmakṛtyāni yāni ca ||67||
sūryādhārāṇi sarvāṇi ruddhāni ca viśeṣataḥ |
devāḥ svargaparāḥ sarve yajñabhāgavivarjitāḥ ||68||
jātāśca duḥkhitāḥ sarve yayuryatra divākaraḥ |
prāhurdeva kathaṃ naiva karoṣyudayanaṃ prabho ||69||
etat tvayā vinā sarvaṃ jagad vyākulatāṃ gatam |
sūryaḥ prāha bhayāt pativratāyā nodayo mama ||1.502.70||
tasmād gatvā surāḥ sarve tāṃ vadantu kṛte mama |
yena tadvākyamāsādya gamiṣyāmyudayaṃ sukham ||71 ||
anyathā māṃ śapet kruddhā nūnaṃ sā hi pativratā |
pātivratyena tapasā vartate sā sureśvarī ||72||
kastasyā vacanaṃ śaktaḥ kartuṃ caivamato’nyathā |
etasmātkāraṇād bhīto nodgacchāmi kathaṃcana ||73||
pativratātvamāpannā nārī vidanti tatphalam |
aśvamedhasahasreṇa yatphalaṃ jāyate hi tat ||74||
ityuttamatapoyogādbibhemi satyayoṣitaḥ |
tato devā drutaṃ yāntu yatrāsti sā pativratā ||75|||
atha devāḥ samāyātā dīrghikāṃ jagaduśca te |
tvayā pativrate sūryo yanniṣiddho divākaraḥ ||76||
śubhaṃ tanna kṛtaṃ bhadre kriyā naṣṭā raviśritāḥ |
tasmādudgacchatu prājñe tava vākyād divākaraḥ ||77||
yajñakriyā japo homaḥ pravartante yataḥ śubhe |
dīrghikā ca tadā prāha māṇḍavyena ca roṣataḥ ||78||
me patiḥ śapta evāsti ravyudaye mṛto bhavet |
tato mayā niruddho’sti sūryo hyudayanaṃ prati ||79||
vinā kāntaṃ na me sūryodayenāsti prayojanam |
śrāddhadānādikaiḥ kṛtyairanyairvā na prayojanam ||1.502.80||
atha te vibudhāḥ prāhurvicārya vinayānvitāḥ |
udgacchatu ravirbhadre tavāyaṃ dayitaḥ patiḥ ||81 ||
kāyākalpaṃ samāsādya punarjīvatu tatkṣaṇam |
pañcaviṃśativarṣīyaṃ kāmadevamivāparam ||82||
tvaṃ ca drakṣyasi saṃbhūtvā kanyā pañcadaśābdikī |
evaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sukhaṃ loke svecchayā sādhayiṣyasi ||83 ||
sūryodaye tava patyuḥ śarīraṃ nidhanaṃ gatam |
punaḥ sañjīvayiṣyāmo dehi sūryodayaṃ hi naḥ ||84||
ityuktā bāḍhamityaṃgīkṛtyovāca satī punaḥ |
yathā devāḥ pravadanti dampatyorvai navaṃ vayaḥ ||85||
kariṣyantyāvayostena satyenodaya bhāskara |
ityuktamātre prāk kāṣṭhā prabhātā cābhavad drutam ||86||
aruṇasya praveśaścādṛśyatāruṇaparvate |
tāvat sūryodayo jātaḥ saṃmṛto dīrghikāpatiḥ ||87||
vibudhānāṃ karaiḥ spṛṣṭaḥ punareva samutthitaḥ |
pañcaviṃśativarṣīyaḥ kāmarūpo’tisundaraḥ ||88||
dīrghikāpyabhavatpañcadaśavarṣātisundarī |
divyā devīsamā devasparśena kamalāsamā ||89||
devāstāṃ sādaraṃ procuḥ sakāntāṃ vai pativratām |
varaṃ vṛṇu sati sādhvi nādeyaṃ vidyate tava ||1.502.90||
sā covāca nadītīrthaṃ dīrghiketi jagattraye |
adyaprabhṛti loke vai khyātaṃ me nāmato bhavet ||91 ||
ante dhāma harermokṣasthala labheyamācyutam |
saha bhartreti tāṃ prāhustathāstviti surā yayuḥ ||52||
tataḥ sā bahukālaṃ vai sukhaṃ prāpya pativratā |
uttare vayasi prāpte kāntaṃ vīkṣya mṛtaṃ satī ||93||
saha tena jagāmeyaṃ brahmalokaṃ pativratā |
evaṃ te lakṣmi cākhyātaṃ dīrghikāvratamuttamam ||94||
paṭhanācchravaṇāttathāvartanāt sevanādapi |
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labhennārī naro’pi nātra saṃśayaḥ ||95||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne hārītapatnyāṃ pūrṇakalāyāṃ mohitakāmadevasya kuṣṭhitvaṃ pūrṇakalāyāḥ śilātvaṃ punaruddhāraḥ, dīrghikāyāḥ patisevāpuṇyena sūryastambhanaṃ patisahitāyāstasyā navayauvanaṃ mokṣaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvyadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 502 ||

<1.503>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ munerjābālermokṣakāriṇīm |
jabālāyāḥ ṛṣidāsyāḥ putro jābālisaṃjñakaḥ || 1 ||
brāhmaṇasya tu bījena samutpanno babhūva ha |
kaumārabrahmacaryeṇa yena cīrṇaṃ tapaḥ sadā || 2 ||
kṛcchracāndrāyaṇādīni pārākāṇi śanaiḥ śanaiḥ |
kurvatānena vai devā saṃnītā bhayagocaram || 3 ||
tato devā hi militāścakrurvighnasya mantraṇām |
raṃbhāṃ sapreṣayāmāsurbrahmacaryavighātinīm || 4 ||
brahmacaryaṃ tapomūlaṃ siddhisampādakaṃ mahat |
ābālād brahmacārī ca jābālistejasā mahān || 5 ||
kāmadharmaṃ na jānāti nārīsaṃgamavarjitaḥ |
tasya kṣobhāya ca devaṃ vasanta sāyudhaṃ tathā || 6 ||
kāmaṃ ratiṃ tathā prītiṃ preṣayāmāsurīśvarāḥ |
indrājñayā gatāḥ sarve hāṭakeśvarabhūtalam || 7 ||
jābāleḥ parṇaśālāyāḥ sannidhau kusumākaraḥ |
cakre’kasmādaśokasya suśobhāṃ puṣpasañcayaiḥ || 8 ||
tilakānāṃ ca cūtānāṃ śobhāṃ mañjarikādibhiḥ |
sarojāni samantācca vikāsaṃ prāpuruttamam || 9 ||
vavau ca surabhirvāyurdākṣiṇātyaḥ smarapradaḥ |
tatrāntare tasya muneḥ raṃbhā sāmīpyamāgatā || 1.503.10||
muniḥ paśyati yāvat tāṃ sāpi vastraṃ vihāya ca |
samīpavartisalile saṃsnātuṃ praviveśa ha || 11 ||
vivastrāṃ tāṃ samālokya kāmasya vaśago’bhavat |
pulakāṃcitasarvāṃgaḥ kṣubhitaścābhavat tataḥ ||1 2||
rambhā jalād vinirgatya vastramāvṛtya cārdhakam |
ārdrarūpā muneḥ pārśve gatā nanāma sasmitā || 1 3||
provāca madhuraṃ brahmannāśrame kuśalaṃ kimu |
muniḥ prāha sadā me’sti kuśalaṃ ca tavāgamāt || 14||
kā tvaṃ devī mānuṣī vā mama manmathavardhinī |
rambhā prāha kathaṃ gātre svedaste vikṛtistathā || 15||
muniḥ prāha tavālokāt svedo me manmathodbhavaḥ |
brahmacaryaparasyāpi mahāvrate’pi vartinaḥ || 16||
rambhā prāha ca yadyeva māṃ bhajasva yathāsukham |
nātra kaścid bhaved doṣo bhajamānāsmi yat svayam || 17||
apsaro’haṃ svargapatnī tava bhaktāṃ bhajasva mām |
yo nārīṃ kāmasantaptāṃ svayaṃ prāptāṃ parityajet || 18||
nārīniḥśvāsadagdhaḥ sa sarvathā hīyate janaḥ |
evamuktvā tayā so’pi pariṣvakto mahāmuniḥ || 1 9||
evaṃ tayā samaṃ reme sthito yāvaddinakṣayam |
tato niṣkāmatāṃ prāpto visasarja ca tāṃ tataḥ || 1.503.20||
sā ca gatvā surānprāha kṣobhito vai mahāmuniḥ |
tapastasya hataṃ sarvamindra tvaṃ sukhabhāg bhava || 21 ||
atha dadhre munergarbhaṃ suṣuve sā ca bālikām |
muniryatra punaścakre tapastatra yayau ca sā ||22||
nītvā sarojapatrākṣīṃ kanyāṃ candraśubhānanām|
gatvāśrame ṛṣeragre mumocedaṃ ca sābravīt ||23||
tava vīryasamutpannāṃ mama garbhe praropitām |
kanyakāṃ te sutāṃ divyāṃ paripālaya te namaḥ ||24||
na svarge vidyate vāso mānuṣāṇāṃ kathaṃcana |
etasmāt kāraṇāt tubhyaṃ datvā yāmi divaṃ punaḥ ||25||
evamuktvā yayau raṃbhā jābāliḥ snehapūritaḥ |
kanyāṃ tāṃ pālayāmāsa rasairmiṣṭaphalodbhavaiḥ ||26||
vardhate sma mṛgaiḥ sārdhaṃ krīḍati sma ca pakṣibhiḥ |
tasyarṣeḥ sarvakāryeṣu sāhāyyaṃ sma karoti ca ||27||
samitkuśādi ca vanādānayāmāsa nityadā |
ekadā svāśramād dūraṃ phalārthaṃ sā jagāma ca ||28||
tadā vyomnā vimānasthaścitrāṃgadābhidho divaḥ |
gāndharvo niryayau dṛṣṭvāvatīrya tāṃ jagāda ca ||29||
kā tvaṃ caikākinī bāle vane bhramasi kanyake |
kanyā prāha ca jābāle kanyā phalavatī hyaham ||1.503.30||
phalapuṣpārthamāyātā samīpe me pitāsti ca |
citrāṃgadastadovāca pitā te bhāryayā vinā ||3 1 ||
kumārabrahmacārī tvāṃ janayāmāsa vai katham |
kanyovāca mama mātā rambhānāmnyapsarovarā ||32|||
muniṃ saṃsevya taddvārā putrīṃ prāpa tataḥ pitā |
jābālirme janako’sti poṣitā tena sadrasaiḥ |||33||
citrāṃgadastataḥ prāha varārohe bhajasva mām |
ahaṃ citrāṃgado nāma gandharvastridivaukasām ||34||
kanyā prāha kumāryasmi tathā ca vaśagā pituḥ |
tasmātprārthaya me tātaṃ sa māṃ tubhyaṃ pradāsyati ||35||
mamāpi rocate citte bhavān yuvā surūpavān |
citrāṃgadaḥ prāha śaknomyarthayituṃ na vai tathā ||36||
ko jānāti hi taccittaṃ kīdṛgrūpaṃ bhaviṣyati |
kanyā prāha ca yadyevaṃ vinājñā kiṃ karomyaham ||37||
jānīyāccet pitā me tvāṃ māṃ cāpi sampradhakṣyati |
iti pravadamānāṃ tāmadhīraścitrakāṃgadaḥ ||38||
jagrāha cāṃke prabalo reme tayā vanadrume |
sāpi kāmena saṃvyāptā ramayāmāsa taṃ muhuḥ || 39 ||
divyabhāvaṃ parityajya kāmabhāvamupāśritā |
divaso nirgataḥ sāyaṃ gataṃ tad bubudhe na sā ||1.503.40||
jābāliratha taccintāmagno duḥkhasamanvitaḥ |
anāyātāṃ sutāṃ vipadgatāṃ jñātvā niśāmukhe ||41 ||
paribabhrāma sarvatrānveṣayituṃ vane vane |
aho vyāghrairbhakṣitā kiṃ vṛkṣāt sampatitā kimu ||42||
agādhajalamagnā vā nītā vānyena vai balāt |
ityevaṃ ca parivadan babhrāma śokakarṣitaḥ ||43 ||
kaṃcicchabdaṃ samākarṇya matvā bālāṃ prayāti tam |
atha vṛkṣatale śabdaṃ śuśrāva kanyakākṛtam ||44||
śīghraṃ tatra samāyāto dadarśa sanarāṃ sutām |
krodhāviṣṭo gṛhītvā ca kāṣṭhaṃ dudrāva taṃ naram ||45||
dhikdhik pāpa vane putryāḥ kaumāryaṃ dūṣitaṃ tvayā |
tvayā putri lāñcchanaṃ ca dattaṃ loke mamopari ||46||
tasmādenaṃ tathā tvāṃ ca nāśayāmīti saṃvadan |
prahāraṃ yāvat kṣipati tāvat citrāṃgado’mbare ||47||
adṛśyo’bhūcca sā kanyā vivastrā śaktivarjitā |
piturbhayācca tatraiva niṣasāda prakampitā ||48||
muniḥ kāṣṭhaprahāreṇa santāḍya patitāṃ kṣitau |
mṛtāṃ matvā ca visṛjya yāvat paśyati cāmbare ||49||
tāvaccitrāṃgado dṛṣṭo vimānena divaṃ vrajan |
śapto muninā drāk saḥ kuṣṭhī bhava patātra ca ||1.503.50||
gāndharvastu papātorvyāṃ kuṣṭhī jātaḥ kṣaṇāttadā |
prāha kuru kṣamāṃ mahyaṃ putryai dayāyuto bhava ||51 ||
bhūtaṃ tad bhūtamevātra svalpaḥ kopo hi sādhuṣu |
jābālistaṃ tadā prāha daṇḍapātraṃ vicārya vai ||52||
yathā putrī tathā tvaṃ ca vastrahīnaḥ sadā bhava |
ubhau tvatra sadā nagnau tiṣṭhata vai vanadrume ||53||
yadyanyatrāgamiṣyataṃ śiraḥsphoṭo hi vāṃ bhavet |
evaṃ śāpaṃ tu tau prāptau kṣetre śrīhāṭakeśvare ||54||
tatraiva tau tathā ruddhvā munirnijāśramaṃ yayau |
caitramāse śuklapakṣe niśārdhe bhagavān haraḥ ||55||
yoginībhistatra rantuṃ daivāt samāyayau vane |
tatra tadā hyubhābhyāṃ ca nagnābhyāṃ gāyanaṃ tathā ||56||
nartanaṃ ca kṛtaṃ śaṃbhoḥ prasādārthaṃ muhurmudā |
śaṃbhustuṣṭaścakārainaṃ gandharvaṃ nirujaṃ tadā ||57||
vyomagāmitvasāmarthyaṃ gaṇatvaṃ ca dadau haraḥ |
kanyāṃ tāṃ yoginītvaṃ ca vyomagāmitvamādadau ||58||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye namaḥ |
iti mantraṃ dadau tābhyāṃ dadau tulasīmālikām ||59||
bhaktau tau vaiṣṇavau jātau hāṭakeśvaratīrthake |
citrāṃgadena saṃśapto jābāliśca nirambaraḥ ||1.503.60||
janahāsyāspado nityaṃ yathāhaṃ tvaṃ tathā bhava |
itiśāpena saṃdagdho garhayāmāsa yoṣitam ||61 ||
aho pāpātmanāṃ puṃsāṃ yoṣitsaṃgo hi jāyate |
sakṛd yoṣitprasaṃgena mama duḥkhaṃ hi kīdṛśam ||62||
ājanmamaraṇaṃ yāvatpāpaṃ prāptaṃ vivastrakam |
tarhi strīṣu prasaktānāṃ kā gatirityacintayat ||63||
evaṃ tasya bruvāṇasya putrī prāha ca yoginī |
etaccarācaraṃ viśvaṃ strībhiḥ sandhāryate śubham ||64||
kathaṃ tāṃ nindasi pitarnindako duḥkhamavāpnuyāt |
pitā prāha striyaḥ śaśvat sarvāvasthāsu duḥkhadāḥ ||65||
iha loke paratrāpi tābhyaḥ saukhyaṃ na labhyate |
putrī prāha pitaste vai buddhirnāsti damo na ca ||66||
kimantyajo’pi tatkarma kurute yat tvayā kṛtam |
ahaṃ kāṣṭhaprahāreṇa tvayā prahāritā muhuḥ ||67||
strīhatyodbhavapāpasya cintā nābhūcca te hṛdi |
viśeṣeṇa sutāyāśca kā te gatirbhaviṣyati ||68||
śapkāhaṃ sarvadā nagnabhāve tvatpātakaṃ ca te |
nityaṃ navanavotthaṃ manniśvāsajaṃ mahattaram ||69||
kalpānte’pi ca te tasya naivāntaḥ saṃbhaviṣyati |
tasmād bhuṃkṣva tathaiva tvaṃ gandharvaśāpataḥ pitaḥ ||1.503.70||
na bhūyo nindasi prāyo na ca saṃtāḍayiṣyasi |
anindyā yoṣitaḥ sarvā naitā dūḥṣyanti karhicit ||71 ||
māsi māsi rajo hyāsāṃ duṣkṛtaṃ parikarṣati |
pitā prāha striyaḥ pāpā naitāḥ śuddhyanti karhicit ||72||
sutā prāha na caivaṃ vai vedoktaṃ śṛṇu śāsanam |
brāhmaṇāḥ pādato medhyā gāvo medhyāstu pucchataḥ ||73||
ajāśca mukhato medhyāḥ striyo medhyāśca sarvataḥ |
pitā prāha tadā śāstraṃ parityajya ca kalpitam ||74||
brāhmaṇāḥ sarvato medhyā gāvo medhyāśca sarvataḥ |
ājāścāpi kvacinmedhyā na medhyāśca striyaḥ kvacit| ||75||
putryuvāca gṛhe cintāmaṇiḥ kalpadrumo gṛhe |
kuberaḥ kiṃkarastasya yasyāsti kāminīgṛhe ||76 ||
pitovācāpadastasya duḥkhaṃ tasyākhilaṃ gṛhe |
narako’styatra vai tasya yasyāsti kāminī gṛhe ||77||
putryuvācātra saukhyāni bhogasthānāni yāni ca |
dharmārthakāmajātāni tāni strībhyo bhavanti hi ||78||
pitovācātra duḥkhāni yāni pāpāni dehinām |
yāna kaṣṭāni gaṇyante strībhyastāni bhavanti hi ||79||
putryuvāca vivāhena dharmārthakāmamokṣakān |
vahnipradakṣiṇābhiśca nārī jñāpayati dhruvān ||1.503.80||
pitovāca vivāhena janmajanmāntarāṇi ca |
saṃsārabhramaṇānyeva nārī jñāpayati bhramaiḥ ||8 1 ||
putryuvāca satīṃ patnīṃ prāpya sarvārthasādhikām |
ke nāma naiva rajyante dehino jñānino’pi ca |||82||
pitovāca na rajyante virāgāścātmani sthitāḥ |
mūḍhāstāsu nipatanti jvālāyāṃ śalabhā iva ||83||
putryuvāca stanau śroṇyau jaghanaṃ mukhamaṇḍalam |
sevyante puṇyavadbhiśca tadanye bhāgyavañcitāḥ ||84||
pitovāca vināśasyonmukhā lekhā lalāṭajā |
yasyāsti tena sevyante tānyanye puṇyaśālinaḥ ||85||
putryuvāca striyāḥ sparśo darśanaṃ racanādayaḥ |
pariṣvaṃgaśca sukhadāḥ sarvathā śramanāśakāḥ ||86 ||
pitovāca striyāḥ sparśādayo miṣṭaviṣātmakāḥ |
saṃgādyā duḥkhadāḥ sṛṣṭau sādhvāśramavināśakāḥ ||87||
putryuvāca striyā duṣṭaḥ sukhī sukṛtī ko na vai |
spṛhaṇīyatamaḥ ko na strījano yasya vallabhaḥ ||88||
pitovāca striyā dṛṣṭo duḥkhabhāk pāpavānna kaḥ |
tiraskāryo bhavetko na strījano yasya vallabhaḥ ||89||
putryuvācāpi kīṭasya rocate strīsamāgamaḥ |
manuṣyasya ca devādeḥ kiṃ punarjñānino’pi ca ||1.503.90||
pitovācātipāpasyāmedhyasya rocate kṛmeḥ |
amedhyaṃ strīśarīraṃ kāmino nānyasya vai sataḥ ||91 ||
putryuvāca svayaṃ brahmā pāśaṃ nārīsvarūpakam |
kathaṃ vai janayāmāsa brahmā bhunakti yaṃ svayam ||92||
tvayā raṃbhā kathaṃ bhuktā pālitāhaṃ sutā katham |
anyalagnā kathaṃ śaptā yadi mūlyaṃ na gaṇyate ||93 ||
tvaṃ ca mātrā kathaṃ labdho jabālayā hi sevayā |
ṛṣīṇāmāśrameṣveva paśya mūlyaṃ striyāstadā ||94||
kasya putro’si pṛṣṭastvaṃ yājñavalkyena pāṭhane |
mātaraṃ pṛṣṭhavān tvaṃ ca tadā mūlyaṃ striyāstava ||95||
idānīṃ kva gataṃ tadvai jñānaṃ nārīpradarśitam |
mātṛputro’si samyak tat pitṛputro na vai hyasi ||96||
ajñātapitṛkā nārīṃ nindanti tvādṛśāḥ pitaḥ |
te sadā kālasūtre vai pacyante nindakāḥ striyāḥ ||97||
pitarau sarvadā pūjyāviti matvā mayā pitaḥ |
tvaṃ na śaptastathāpyatra gāndharveṇa praśāpitaḥ ||98||
svakṛtyasya phalaṃ labdhaṃ tvayā cāpi mayāpi ca |
kanyā deyā yogyakāle yasmai kasmaicideva ha ||99||
daivayogādahaṃ prāptā gāndharvāya kṣatistu kā |
apsaraḥkanyakā cāhaṃ gāndharvaṃ samupāśritā || 1.503.10 0||
kā hāniste’tra sambandhe śāpe vā lābha eva kaḥ |
vinā vicāraṃ kṛtavān kruddhaśca jñānadurbalaḥ || 101 ||
kṣamasvādhikavāco me hyanuneyāsmi vai yataḥ |
ityuktvā sāśrunetreyaṃ praṇanāma ca pādayoḥ || 1 02||
pitā tu lajjito jātaḥ putryā jñānaṃ vilokya ca |
prāha dhanyataraṃ manye tvahamātmānamadya vai || 1 03||
yasya me tvaṃ sutā jātā īdṛkśāstravicakṣaṇā |
tasmānme kopa evādya śāntaḥ putri sukhā bhava || 1 04||
ityuktvā prayayau vipraḥ parṇaśālāṃ prati drutam |
putrī cakre tapastatra yoginīmadhyavartinī || 1 05||
atha kālāntare tuṣṭo nārāyaṇaḥ samāyayau |
divyarūpāṃ vidhāyaiva tāṃ nināya pramokṣaṇam || 1 06||
caturbhujābhavatsādhvī nārāyaṇapativratā |
citrāṃgado yayau svasya gāndharvalokagāśramam || 1 07||
jābālistapasā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ bhajaṃstataḥ |
śāpamukto’bhavat kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapratāpataḥ || 1 08||
yayau golokamutkṛṣṭaṃ dhāma kṛṣṇakṛpāvaśāt |
ātmaniveditā kiṃ kiṃ na karoti sudurlabham ||1 09||
akāṭyaṃ cāvināśyaṃ cāpradhṛṣyaṃ śāśvataṃ ca yat |
parāvṛtya navaṃ kṛtvā samarpayati padgatam || 1.503.110 ||
api vajrasamaṃ bhāgyaṃ śaithilyaṃ nayati dhruvam |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktirnavaṃ bhāgyaṃ karoti ca || 11 1||
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ lakṣmi vāñcchāprapūrakam |
paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ caiva tviha loke paratra ca || 1 12||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne jābālinā rambhādvārotpāditaputryāḥ phalavatyāścitrāṃgadagandharvakṛtabhoge pitṛśāpena nagnayoginītvaṃ, piturapi samīpasthāyitvaṃ, tatastapasāmuktiḥ, saṃvādaśca padmaśilāyāṃ dvayorvāsaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā tryadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 503 ||

<1.504>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
ādityā vasavo rudrā aśvinau devateśvarāḥ |
pūjanīyāḥ sadā lakṣmi yogakṣemakarā hi te || 1 ||
varuṇaśca tathā sūryo bhānuḥ pūṣā ca tāpanaḥ |
indraścaivāryamā caiva dhātā caiva bhagastathā || 2 ||
gabhastirdharmarājaśca ta ādityā daśa dvayam |
dharo dhruvaśca somaśca makhaścāpyanilo nalaḥ || 3 ||
pratyūṣaśca prabhāsaśca vasavo’ṣṭau hi nāmataḥ |
mṛgavyādhaśca śarvaśca mṛgīvyādhastṛtīyakaḥ || 4 ||
ajaikapādahirbudhnyaḥ pinākī ṣaṣṭha ityapi |
dahanaśca kapālī ca raivato navamastathā || 5 ||
vṛṣākapistryambakaśca rudrā ekādaśaiva te |
nāsatyaścāpi dasraśca dvāvetāvaśvinīsutau || 6 ||
trayastriṃśatsamākhyātā ete tu suranāyakāḥ |
dānavānāṃ ca devānāṃ mānavānāṃ ca dehinām || 7 ||
pūjanīyāḥ sadā tena nāpamṛtyuḥ prajāyate |
aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ rudrāḥ pūjyāḥ sadā priye || 8 ||
daśamyāṃ vasavaḥ pūjyāstatra śukle viśeṣataḥ |
saptamyāmatha ṣaṣṭyāṃ ca ādityānpūjayet tathā || 9 ||
aśviputrau tathā pūjyau dvādaśyāṃ ṣoḍaśādibhiḥ |
rudrāstuṣṭā rakṣaṇaṃ ca dadatyapi paraṃ padam ||1.504.1 0 ||
vilāsādīn dadatyeva svargaṃ tu vasavo’rcitāḥ |
ādityāḥ pūjitāstuṣṭā aiśvaryaṃ tvarpayanti vai || 11 ||
devavaidyau pūjitāvaśvinau nāśayato rujaḥ |
sarveṣāṃ ca surādīnāṃ guṇagānādilekhakaḥ || 1 2||
vyāsastu sarvadā pūjyo jñānamokṣaprado guruḥ |
yatputraḥ śukanāmāpi śukyāṃ brahma babhūva ha || 1 3||
vedavyāsasya vai cāsīt kalatrārthaṃ matiḥ kvacit |
tato vicitravīryasya kṣetre putrān dhurandharān || 14||
satyavatyāḥ samādeśājjanayāmāsa sa prabhuḥ |
pāṇḍuṃ ca dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ ca viduraṃ ceti kauravān || 15||
vānaprasthe’pi santiṣṭhan cakāra vaṃśavistaram |
tataḥ sa cintayāmāsa bhāryāmadya karomyaham || 16||
tataḥ sa prārthayāmāsa jābāliṃ munipuṃgavam |
tasya kanyāṃ dvitīyāṃ tu ceṭikākhyāṃ śukīṃ śubhām || 17||
jābālistu dadau tasmai ceṭikāṃ svasutāṃ śubhām |
sāpi garbhavatī jātā garbho yāti bahirnahi || 18||
dvādaśābdā atikrāntā na niryāti bahiḥ khalu |
yatkiṃcicchṛṇute sarvaṃ garbhe garbhagataḥ sutaḥ || 19||
śukī sā garbhatejobhiḥ śuśubhe vedasūriva |
garbho’pi hṛdaye sarvaṃ dadhāra jñānacintanam ||1.504.20||
vedāḥ sāṃgāḥ śrutāstena garbhe’dhitā yathāśrutāḥ |
smṛtayaḥ saṃhitā mokṣaśāstrāṇi nītayastathā ||21 ||
brahmādhyayanamevāpi tyākhyānānyātmavanti ca |
sarvaṃ garbhe śrutaṃ yadyadadhītaṃ yāvadeva tat ||22||
yathā yathā suto vṛddhiṃ yāti jaṭharamāśritaḥ |
mātā tathā tathā gurvī pīḍāṃ yāti tataḥ pitā ||23||
vyāsaḥ papraccha kastvaṃ vai praviṣṭo garbharūpadhṛk |
kathaṃ bahirna cāyāsi vada sarvaṃ yathātatham ||24||
garbhaḥ prāha piśāco’haṃ rākṣaso’haṃ ca mānuṣaḥ |
suro’haṃ turagaścāhaṃ gajo’haṃ kukkuṭo’smi ca ||25||
chāgo’haṃ ca kumāro’haṃ vṛkṣo’haṃ bālako’smyaham |
caturaśītilakṣāsuyoniṣu vai bhraman muhuḥ ||26||
āgato’smi kathaṃ vedmi ko’haṃ te vacmi kaṃ ca mām |
mānuṣe jaṭhare cātra praviṣṭo’smi nirañjanaḥ ||27||
atra yogaṃ sādhayāmi prāpya jñānaṃ tu vedajam |
nirviṇṇo’smi mokṣamārgaṃ pratīkṣāmi ca śāśvatam ||28||
na vai ghore’tra saṃsāre bhramaṇaṃ me prarocate |
na yāsyāmi bahirgarbhādatraiva brahmacintanam ||29||
kariṣye’tha gamiṣyāmi mokṣaṃ tava kṛpāvaśāt |
vyāsaḥ prāha śṛṇu cātman nirañjanasya te suta ||1.504.30 ||
yonikuṇḍe’tidurgandhe vastuṃ prītiḥ kathaṃ vada |
niṣkrāmasva tato vidvan garhitāt mūtrakuṇḍakāt ||3 1 ||
bahirāgatya yogaṃ vā jñānaṃ cārjaya śobhanam |
garbhaḥ prāha navaṃ jñānaṃ navo yogaśca neṣyate ||32||
tāvajjñānaṃ ca vairāgyaṃ pūrvajātismṛtistathā |
yāvadgarbhasthitirme’sti mokṣecchā tāvadeva ha || 33 ||
jantuśced garbhaniṣkrāntaḥ spṛśyate bāhyavāyunā |
sarvaṃ garbhagataṃ jñānaṃ yogo bhānaṃ vinaśyati ||34||
tasmānnāhaṃ kṛtahānerniṣkramiṣye kathañcana |
garbhādeva prayāsyāmi mokṣamityasti niścayaḥ ||35||
vyāsaḥ prāha na te cātman vāyupāśo bhaviṣyati |
jñānaṃ yogaśca te sarvaṃ yathārthaṃ sthāsyati dhruvam ||36||
māyā te bādhate naiva garbhe vā bahireva vā |
tasmād darśaya me vaktraṃ cānṛṇyaṃ saṃvṛjāmyaham ||37||
pitaraśca sutṛptāḥ syustava janmaśravād drutam |
garbhaḥ prāha yadi tvaṃ me viṣṇuṃ sākṣiṇaṃ rakṣaya ||38||
tadā bahirniḥsarāmi tatra yogyaṃ kuru drutam |
vyāsaḥ sasmara tacchrutvā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ||39||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo devastatra kṣipraṃ samāyayau |
sākṣī tatrābhavat prāha śṛṇu garbha hitāvaham ||1.504.40||
pratibhūste bhavāmyadya sarvaṃ jñānādikaṃ tava |
sthāsyatyeva bahiryāhi gaccha yogārthameva ca ||41 ||
māyā me vāyusaṃsparśakṛtā vyāptā na te bhavet |
atha garbho viniṣkrāntaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇecchayā ||42||
dvādaśābdapramāṇastu yauvanasya samīpagaḥ |
jātamātro jātismaro yogirāḍiva cetanaḥ ||43 ||
kṛṣṇaṃ jananīṃ janakaṃ praṇamyaiva ca tatkṣaṇāt |
vanaṃ sa prasthito bālo vyāsastiṣṭhetyuvāca tam ||44||
saṃskārān jātakarmādīn te karomi sthiro bhava |
ceṭikāyāḥ sutaḥ prāha saṃskārāḥ pratijanmani |||45||
sahasraśaḥ koṭiśaśca jātā me bhavasāgare |
yairahaṃ bandhanarūpaiḥ parikṣipto’smi yoniṣu ||46 ||
atha vyāsaḥ śukaṃ nāma dadhāra bhagavān svayam |
śuko gantuṃ padanyāsām̐ścakre vyāsa uvāca tam ||47||
pitaraṃ taṃ parityajya yogārthaṃ yo vanaṃ vrajet |
sa yāti narakaṃ putra mā vraja tvaṃ gṛhe vasa ||48||
śukaḥ prāha yathāhaṃ te sutastathā gate bhave |
tvaṃ cāsīrme sutaścāhaṃ pitā te tatra śāsanam ||49||
tvayā pālyaṃ mama vyāsa yadyeṣā dharmasaṃsthitiḥ |
nāhaṃ niṣedhanīyastu vrajamānastapovanam ||1.504.50||
vyāsaḥ prāha janiṃ labdhvā puṇyaprāpyāṃ dvijagṛhe |
saṃskārān yaśca gṛhṇāti vedoktān sa viśiṣyate ||5 1 ||
śukaḥ prāha ca saṃskārādātmamuktirna niścitā |
saṃskārāccedbhavenmuktistādṛgdhūrtasya sā bhavet ||52||
vyāsaḥ prāha bhavetpūrvaṃ brahmacārī tato gṛhī |
atha tyāgaṃ puraskṛtya tato muktirbhavet suta |||53||
śukaḥ prāha brahmacaryānmokṣaścet ṣaṇḍha āpnuyāt |
gārhasthyena ca mokṣaścejjagatsarvaṃ tamāpnuyāt ||54||
vane vāsād yadi mokṣo mṛgādīnāṃ sa vai bhavet |
tyāgāccenmuktirutkṛṣṭā daridrāṇāṃ ca sā bhavet |||55||
vyāsaḥ prāha gṛhasthādikrameṇa satpathāśrayaḥ |
ihāmutrānandadātā tena mokṣaḥ phalātmakaḥ ||56 ||
śukaḥ prāha gṛhaiḥ sakto moharāgavaśaṃgataḥ |
vāsanābandhabaddhaśca yamamārgaṃ phalaṃ labhet ||57||
vyāsaḥ prāha vinā rāgaṃ paitryaṃ daivaṃ prasādhayet |
śukaḥ prāha vinā bhaktiṃ paitryaṃ daivaṃ pratārayet ||58||
vyāsaḥ prāha gṛhe bhaktiṃ paitryaṃ daivaṃ sadā kuru |
śukaḥ prāha nijātmā me gṛhaṃ tatra karomyaham ||19||
vyāsaḥ prāha vinā putraṃ puṃnāmanarako dhruvaḥ |
putreṇa tasya taraṇaṃ tasmātputraḥ praśasyate ||1.504.60||
śukaḥ prāha tathaiva cet kharavānarasūkarāḥ |
putravantastariṣyanti ko viśeṣo’tra mānuṣe ||6 1 ||
vyāsaḥ prāha yadi jñānaṃ teṣāmapi ca mokṣaṇam |
śukaḥ prāha pitastadvai garbhādevārjitaṃ mayā ||6 2||
gamiṣyāmi samāyātaṃ mokṣaṃ bhaktyā ca keśavam |
prāptaṃ cintāmaṇiṃ tyaktvā kaṃkaraṃ kathamāvahet| ||63||
prāggrāse’mṛtamutsṛjya makṣikāṃ vai kathaṃ graset |
prāpte svarṇarase cāgre kardamaṃ mardayet katham ||64||
sūryasya darśanaṃ tyaktvā rāhuṃ kathaṃ vilokayet |
divyadīpaṃ parityajya dhūmrolkāṃ kathamarjayet ||65||
ekakārāgāramuktau dvitīye vai kathaṃ patet |
brahmamārge cāvagate kṣudrasṛtyā kathaṃ saret ||66||
śreṣṭhaṃ copasthitaṃ tyaktvā kaniṣṭhaṃ nāvalambayet |
satyaṃ prāptaṃ parityajya kṛtrimaṃ cāśliṣet katham ||67||
akke cenmadhuvindeta kimarthaṃ parvataṃ vrajet |
iṣṭasyārthasya saṃsiddhau ko vidvān yatnamācaret| ||68||
ityuktvā pitaraṃ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaṃ hṛdi sthitam |
mātaraṃ ceṭikāṃ kṛṣṇaśaktiṃ praṇamya sādaram ||69||
yayau vanaṃ sadāvanaṃ yatrātmanā bhavatyapi |
vyāsaḥ śokaṃ ceṭikā ca duḥkhaṃ jagāma vai kṣaṇam ||1.504.70 ||
śukī vyāsaṃ tataḥ prāha cariṣyāmi tapaḥ punaḥ |
putrārthaṃ yena vaṃśasya vardhako me bhavet sutaḥ ||71 ||
vyāsājñāṃ sā samāsādya tapastepe pativratā |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye namaḥ ||72||
iti mantraṃ dadau vyāso jajāpa sā divāniśam |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastatra tvāyayau hṛṣṭamānasaḥ ||73||
varado’smīti tāṃ prāha varaṃ varaya suvrate |
śukī prāha sutaṃ dehi mama vaṃśavivardhanam ||74||
tathāstviti hariḥ prāha yayāvadarśanaṃ tataḥ |
ceṭikā susutaṃ lebhe kapiñjalamiti śrutam ||75||
kapiñjalo mahāyogī pitroścaiva samājñayā |
gārhasthyaṃ svīcakārāsau bharadvājīṃ sukanyakām ||76 ||
pariṇeme tato bhāradvājaḥ putro babhūva ha |
bharadvājasya taittiraḥ kāmarūpadharaḥ sutaḥ ||77||
saca prāgjyotiṣadeśe yayau parvatabhūstare |
tataḥ punaḥ samāgatya navalakṣābhidhe’cale ||78||
nivāsaṃ svīcakārāsau kāmākṣīṃ cābhajat satīm |
kāmarūpo mahāyogī parvatīyo maheśvaraḥ ||79||
parvatīyaprajānāṃ vai guruḥ rājā tapobalāt |
abhavat tena girayaḥ kāmarūpābhidhāstataḥ ||1.504.80||
abhavam̐śca narāḥ svalpā nāryo bahvyaḥ satīcchayā |
bhajanti smaikapuruṣaṃ śataṃ śataṃ hi yoṣitām ||81 ||
atha bālavayogīndro brahmaputrātaṭe vasan |
tapaścacāra kaṭhinaṃ bālavanmohavarjitaḥ ||82||
te tāḥ samprārthayāmāsurnarāṇāṃ vṛddhaye tataḥ |
sarvāḥ putraprasavābhimukhyo bhavantu madvarāt ||83||
yādṛksaṃkhyāḥ kanyakānāṃ narāṇāṃ santu tāḥ samāḥ |
sāmyottaraṃ sāmyabhāve kanyākumāramātaraḥ ||84||
bhaviṣyatha yathāyogyā iti tāśca tathābhavan |
evaṃ te kathitaṃ lakṣmi purāvṛttaṃ yuge yuge ||85||
navaṃ navaṃ punaḥ sañjāyate nirmāṇavad bhave |
kāmarūpaṃ tathā tīrthaṃ bālavākuṇḍakaṃ tathā ||86||
bhuktimuktipradaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ paṭhanācchravaṇādapi |
yatheṣṭadāyakaṃ mantrasiddhipradaṃ hi vidyate ||87||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne kṛṣṇadvaipāyanavyāsasya śukyāṃ śukakapiñjalau sutau, kapiñjalasya bharadvājastasya taittiraḥ sutaḥ, bālavayogivaradānāt kāmarūpadeśe narāṇāṃ nārīsamasaṃkhyākotpattirityādinirūpaṇanāmā caturadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||504||

<1.505>
śrīlakṣmīruvāca
nārāyaṇa parabrahma bhagavan karuṇānidhe |
dhyātvā rūpaṃ tava bhaktā bhuktiṃ muktiṃ prayānti ca || 1 ||
sanatkumāraḥ sanakaḥ sanandaśca sanātanaḥ |
sanatsujātaḥ pañcaite tvatsamā bhuktimuktidāḥ || 2 ||
vaiṣṇavānāmagraṇīśca śaṃkaro lomaśastathā |
mārkaṇḍeyo yājñavalkyo dharmaḥ śeṣo vṛṣastathā || 3 ||
vedāśca vaiṣṇavā nityā balirbāṇo vibhīṣaṇaḥ |
hanumān jāmbavānaśvatthāmā prahlāda āsuriḥ || 4 ||
voḍhuḥ pañcaśikho divodāsastathāmbarīṣakaḥ |
uddhavaśca śaśī sūryo’nilaścāpi hutāśanaḥ || 5 ||
ete bhaktāstava nityaṃ tvājñāvahāḥ sutāstava |
tava dhyānaṃ sadā kṛtvā ciraṃ tiṣṭhanti jīvinaḥ || 6 ||
śaṃkaraśca tava putraḥ kathaṃ pañcaśirā hyasau |
tvatsvarūpādvibhinnaśca kimatra kāraṇaṃ vada || 7 ||
ekamastakadevasya pañcamastakaputrakaḥ |
tadidaṃ mahadāścaryaṃ saṃśayaṃ me nirāsaya || 8 ||
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
pūrvaṃ bhagavatājena kṛtvā sṛṣṭiṃ tu vistṛtām |
caturvidhāṃ bahukālaṃ naranārīmayīṃ śubhām || 9 ||
tataḥ sa cintayāmāsa nārīrūpāṇi sarvaśaḥ |
mohasthānāni ramyāṇi kṛtānyapi tato’pi ca || 1.505.1 0||
nārīṇāmapi yatra syānmohastādṛśaputtalīm |
racayāmīti saṃkalpya rūpasañcayasaṃyutām || 11 ||
ekāmapsarasaṃ divyāṃ devībhyo’pi ca taijasīm |
sarveṣāṃ dyusadāṃ tejaḥ samādāya tilaṃ tilam || 1 2||
rūparūpātirūpāḍhyāṃ camatkṛtiṃ sa nirmame |
yāṃ dṛṣṭvā kṣobhamāpannaḥ svayameva pitāmahaḥ || 1 3||
tatastāṃ preṣayāmāsa yoginaḥ śaṃkarasya vai |
dhairyasya samparīkṣārthaṃ sāpi kailāsamāyayau || 14||
apaśyacchaṃkaraṃ kṛṣṇadhyānamagnaṃ ca nirjane |
nityaṃ tatra sthitā bhaktā yathā dhyānakarī satī || 15||
samīpasthā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇajāpaṃ cakāra sā |
tasyā dehāt koṭicandratulyaṃ miṣṭaṃ ca śītalam || 16||
kānakaṃ prasasārograṃ tejomaṇḍalamadbhutam |
tattejo vartulākāraṃ gatvā śaṃkarapakṣmaṇoḥ || 17||
lagnaṃ prakāśarūpaṃ ca netrāntaḥ praviveśa ha |
raśmidvārāgataṃ cāntarhṛdayaṃ yatra yogirāṭ || 18||
tiṣṭhatyātmani cātmānaṃ saṃyujya tejasāṃ khanau |
tatra śaṃbhuśca tattejo dadarśa kamanīyakam || 1 9||
dvedhā vṛttiḥ samādhau ca jātā satyā mṛṣā samā |
mṛṣāṃ lokayituṃ cehā babhūva śaṃkarasya vai ||1.505.20||
satyāṃ visṛjya cāyāto bahiḥ kimiti kautukāt |
netramuddhāṭya ca yāvat puraḥ paśyati sundarīm ||21||
visasmāra satīṃ mūrtiṃ vismayaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ |
vṛttyā tallīnayā jñātvā mugdhaṃ darśanalālasam ||22||
sāpi tṛtīyanetrasyodghāṭane bhasmatābhayāt |
mugdhaṃ vilokayantaṃ taṃ hitvā pūrvasthalīṃ tataḥ ||23 ||
pradakṣiṇāyā vyājena sā praṇamya kṛtāṃjaliḥ |
dakṣiṇaṃ sā gatā pārśvaṃ śaṃbhuniścalamastakaḥ ||24||
draṣṭukāmaśca tāṃ hṛdā samīyeṣātirāgataḥ |
tāvadvai dakṣiṇaṃ vaktraṃ nirgataṃ tatkṣaṇaṃ śubham ||25||
atha sā bhayasampannā yayau paścimatodiśam |
śaṃbhustasyāḥ svarūpākṛṣṭāntarbhāvo’pi paścimam ||26 ||
vadanaṃ tṛtīyaṃ cakre darśanārthaṃ navaṃ śubham |
atha sā bhayamāpannottarabhāgaṃ gatā tataḥ ||27||
tāṃ draṣṭuṃ cottaraṃ vaktraṃ nirmāya sā dadarśa tām |
athākāśe gatā sā ca tāṃ draṣṭuṃ pañcamaṃ śiraḥ ||28||
vyomagaṃ śaṃkarastatra cakāra ca dadarśa tām |
jahāsa ca mudhā premṇā rūpalīno babhūva ha || 21||
grīvāṃ na cālayāmāsa yogābhyāsabalānvitaḥ |
etasminnantare devo nāradaḥ pārvatīṃ prati ||1.505.3 0||
sarvaṃ nivedayāmāsa prāha śaṃkaraceṣṭitam |
dṛṣṭvā rūpavatīṃ nārīṃ kṛtavān sa navaṃ navam ||3 1 |
mukhaṃ tenābhavad vaktrapañcaka śaṃkarasya vai |
ahaṃ jānāmi nāstyanyā nārī tvatsadṛśī kvacit| ||3 2 ||
patiste ca kathaṃ mugdho hāsyāspado bhaviṣyati |
hāsyasya padavīṃ tvaṃ ca gamiṣyasyadya pārvati || 33 ||
yena kāmo bhasmarūpaḥ kṛto yogīśvaraḥ svayam |
sa cādya māyayā viṣṇormohaṃ yāto divaḥ striyām ||34||
sarvāsāṃ devapatnīnāṃ pūjyā tvaṃ tvatpatiśca saḥ |
taccittaṃ snigdhatāṃ yātaṃ devadāsyāṃ vilokaya || 35||
drāgeva tāṃ samādāya nijāṃke sthāpayiṣyati |
tava mūlyātparaṃ mūlyamapsarasaḥ kariṣyati ||36 ||
kuru śīghraṃ nirodhaṃ vai yāvadaṃke karoti na |
iti śrutvā nāradasya dṛṣṭvā pañcamukhaṃ patim ||37||
vikṛtaṃ taṃ samālokya netreṣu praviveśa sā |
sarvanetrāṇi vai śaṃbhoḥ rodhayāmāsa yoginī ||38||
etasminnantare sarvatejāṃsyapi hatāni ca |
andhakāramayaṃ sarvaṃ puṣpavantau vitejasau ||39 ||
pralayasya samutthānaṃ kālarātreḥ samāgamaḥ |
bhūkampāśca tadā jātā bhayabhītāśca dehinaḥ ||1.505.40||
evaṃ jāte sarvasṛṣṭikṣobhe nandyādayo gaṇāḥ |
sarve satīṃ namaskṛtya stutvā cāpi punaḥ punaḥ ||41 ||
muñca muñca suraśreṣṭhe śaṃbhornetrāṇi muñca vai |
paśyantu haranetrāṇi jagadāndhyaṃ prasarpatu ||42||
evamuktāpi sā devī na netrāṇi mumoca sā|
tāvaddhareṇa bhālasthaṃ visṛṣṭaṃ locanaṃ param ||43 ||
kṛpāviṣṭena lokānāṃ yena rakṣā prajāyate |
vārayituṃ na śakto’smi devīṃ prāṇagarīyasīm ||44||
atha devī tato netrayogaṃ vihāya susthirā |
harasya sannidhau tilottamāmuvāca vai ruṣā ||45||
yasmānme dayitaḥ pāpe tvayā rūpādviḍambitaḥ |
tasmāttvaṃ rūpahīnā ca śīrṇakeśā mahodarī ||46||
cipiṭākṣī bṛhaddantī bhava vai bhagnanāsikā |
atha jātā tatkṣaṇena tilottamā kurūpiṇī ||47||
tuṣṭāva pārvatīṃ kṛtāñjaliḥ kṣamāṃ yasma yācate |
nāsti me’trāparādho vai dāsyā darśanayoṣitaḥ ||48||
devasya tava kiṃkaryāḥ prasādaṃ kartumarhasi |
pārvatī ca tadā prāha samāgaccha mayā saha ||49||
