śūnyena manasā yātā praskhalantī pade pade ||1.512.70 ||
kārāgrahasamaṃ taṃ ca maṇḍapaṃ sā dadarśa ha |
dṛṣṭvā nūtanayā tatra sapatnyā sahitaṃ patim ||71 ||
kopasaṃraktanayanā paruṣaṃ vākyamabravīt |
vibudhā brāhmaṇā ārṣā ye sadaspatayastviha ||72||
mūkībhāvaṃ gatā nāryaḥ śṛṇvantu nyastamānasāḥ |
kimetad yujyate kartuṃ tava vṛddhatamākṛteḥ ||73||
ubhayoḥ pakṣayoreṣā hyaśuddhā vai vivāhitā |
paśudharmaparā takravikretrī malinā sadā ||74||
pāpapracurajātīyā gṛhītā garhitaṃ kṛtam |
avaśyaṃ yadi te kāryaṃ bhāryayā parayā makhe ||75||
vidhe viprā tvayā kvāpi na labdhā kiṃ jagattraye |
ūḍhā tvābhīrakanyeyaṃ nūnaṃ bhraṣṭo’si vai vidheḥ ||76 ||
tasmādetena kṛtyena na tvaṃ prāpsyasi pūjanam |
tava pūjāprakartāro bhaviṣyanti hi nirdhanāḥ ||77||
putrāṇāmatha pautrāṇāmanyeṣāṃ ca divaukasām |
ayogyaṃ cāpi viprāṇāṃ yadetat| kṛtavānasi ||78 ||
athavā naiṣa doṣaste svārthāḥ kurvanti vai tathā |
na lajjanti na jānanti kṛtyākṛtyaṃ śubhāśubham ||79 ||
akṛtyaṃ manyate kṛtyaṃ mitraṃ śatruṃ ca manyate |
śatruṃ ca manyate mitraṃ janaḥ svārthavaśaṃgataḥ ||1.512.80||
dyūtakāre na vai satyaṃ caure cāpi na sauhṛdam |
maitrī nāsti nṛpe kvāpi lajjā svārthiṣu naiva ca ||81 ||
na me syād duḥkhametaddhi yatsāpatnyamupasthitam |
samarthasya sahasrāṇi nārīṇāṃ tu bhavanti vai ||82||
kulīnānāṃ svajātyānāṃ na tu nīcajayoṣitām |
etatpunarmahad duḥkhaṃ yadābhīro vigarhitā ||83 ||
vallavī naṣṭacāritrā kiṃ karomi mriye dhruvam |
tasmād yāsyāmyaraṇyaṃ drāg viḍambitā tvayā vidhe ||84||
tava pūjāprakartā vai daridraḥ saṃbhaviṣyati |
yataścābhīrasuteyaṃ mama sthāne kṛtā tvayā ||89||
bhaviṣyati na santānaṃ tava macchāpato vidhe |
gāyatrīpūjikā nārī vandhyā kliṣṭā bhaviṣyati ||86 ||
asyā vai mānasāḥ putrā bhaviṣyanti yadi kvacit |
sarve mlecchā rātriṃcarā aśiṣṭāścāpyaketanāḥ ||87||
lokanāśakarāḥ sarve bhaviṣyanti yugāntare |
indra tvaṃ śatrubhiryuddhe jito bandhanamāpsyasi ||88||
viṣṇo tvaṃ mānuṣo bhūtvā ciraṃ bhṛtyatvamāpsyasi |
rudraṃ tvaṃ strīviyogasya duḥkhaṃ ciramavāpsyasi ||89||
agne tvaṃ sarvabhakṣo’bhūḥ, viprā yāta daridratām |
kubera te dhanaṃ bhogyaṃ kadāpi no bhaviṣyati ||1.512.90 ||
devā yajñe tvābhīrāṇīsahāyyā anapatyakāḥ |
bhavatāpi tathā daityaiḥ parābhūtā muhurmuhuḥ ||91 ||
gāyatryāḥ pārśvataścānyā yāyāścātra vyavasthitā |
tāsāṃ parasparaṃ saṃgaḥ kadāpi na bhaviṣyati ||92||
evamuktvā devapatnīrvihāya tvekalā tadā |
sāvitrī prayayau pūrvapuṣkaraṃ tvarbudācale ||93||
sāvitrīṃ pūjayet samyak pūrṇamāsyāṃ viśeṣataḥ |
sarvānkāmānavāpnoti dīpanaivedyadānataḥ ||94||
yāvantastantavastasyā dahyante dīpasaṃbhavāḥ |
muhūrtāni ca yāvanti ghṛtadīpaḥ pratiṣṭhati ||95||
tāvajjanmāni sā nārī bhavet saubhāgyaśālinī |
putrapautrasametā ca dhaninī śīlamaṇḍanā ||96 ||
na durbhagā na vandhyā ca na vā kāṇā virūpiṇī |
sāvitryāḥ sannidhau nṛtyaṃ karoti yā tu sundarī ||97||
gītaṃ vā kurute yā ca vaset sā divi devatā |
yā miṣṭānnaṃ phalaṃ dadyāt sā vased divi devatā ||98||
camatkārapure lakṣmi sāvitrītīrthasusthale |
snātvā saṃpūjya cādhyāyaṃ śṛṇuyādvā paṭhettu yaḥ ||99||
sarvapāpavinirmukto yajñasya phalabhāg bhavet |
evaṃ gatāyāṃ sāvitryāṃ gāyatrī samudairayat || 1.512.10 0||
matkṛte ye’tra saṃśaptāḥ sāvitryā brāhmaṇādayaḥ |
teṣāmahaṃ karomyuddhāraṇaṃ patyuḥ prabhāvataḥ || 10 1||
brahmakāryeṣu sarvatra siddhirna syādvinā hyajam |
brahmā satreṣu sarvatra mukhyasthāno bhaviṣyati || 1 02||
viṣṇurdvedhā bhavan kṛṣṇo’rjunaśchāyātmakastathā |
kṛṣṇo martyo’rjunasārathyaṃ bhṛtyatvaṃ kariṣyati || 103 ||
gopāḥ kṛṣṇaprasaṃgena kīrtiṃ yāsyanti devatāḥ |
indra te bandhanaṃ brahmā nāśayiṣyati cāsurāt || 1 04||
vahne tvaṃ sarvabhakṣitve pāvakaḥ pāvano bhava |
rudra tvaṃ tu satīnāśe gaurīyukto bhaviṣyasi || 1 05||
kubera tvaṃ devatānāṃ dhanado vai bhaviṣyasi |
devānāṃ tvanapatyatvaṃ tvaicchikaṃ saṃbhaviṣyati || 106 ||
anyāḥ striyastu yāḥ śaptāstāsāṃ chāyāḥ pṛthak pṛthak |
asaṃyuktā bhaviṣyanti mūlarūpāṇi naiva ha || 1 07||
uktvaivaṃ sā virarāma devāḥ sādhviti cābruvan |
gāyatryāṃ pūjanaṃ nityaṃ prātarjapaṃ tathārcanam || 1 08||
kariṣyanti dvijā nityaṃ sāvitrīṃ naiva naiva ca |
evamuktvā tu te sarve gāyatrīpūjanaṃ vyadhuḥ || 1 09||
svasvasthāne gatāḥ sarve koṭiśo devatādayaḥ |
udumbarī vimānena pitṛbhyāṃ saha svaryayau || 1.512.11 0||
brahmā tvarbudamāsādya nītvā sāvitrikāmapi |
yayau satyaṃ ca tai lakṣmi kathitaṃ kratuvartanam || 111 ||
śravaṇātpaṭhanāttvasya bhuktimuktirbhaveddhruvam |
sampatputrapaśuvrātadravyādi vardhate’nvaham || 11 2||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne’ṣṭaṣaṣṭidevīnāṃ kuladevītvaṃ yajñāntāvabhṛthasnānaṃ yakṣmarogāgamanaṃ gāyatrīvirodhāt sāvitrīdattaśāpāḥ, gāyatrīkṛtanivāraṇāni, sarveṣāṃ svasvalokagamanaṃ, cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvādaśādhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 512 ||

<1.513>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi camatkāre kṣattrā ca brāhmaṇīti ca |
sakhīdvayaṃ samāste vai tapovṛttipare hyubhe || 1 ||
chāndogya iti nāmnāsīt sāmavedī purā dvijaḥ |
paścime vayasi tasya kanyāpatyaṃ babhūva ha || 2 ||
yasminnahani sañjātā tasminneva dine tadā |
ānartādhipateścāpi kanyāpatyaṃ babhūva ha || 3 ||
rājā cakre’bhidhānaṃ vai ratnavatīti śobhanam |
ratnavatyā hyabhūnmaitrī vipraputryā śubhākṣayā || 4 ||
ekāsanaṃ tathā śayyā tvekānnena ca bhojanam |
vipro duhituḥ samaye yogye prāpte’pyacintayat || 5 ||
udvāhaṃ kintu kanyā sā sakhyā viyogakātarā |
gatvā nṛpateḥ putrīṃ sā jagāda bahuduḥkhitā || 6 ||
sakhi tāto vivāhaṃ me prakariṣyati sāmpratam |
tena sakhyaṃ vinaśyecca viyogaḥ syāttadāvayoḥ || 7 ||
śrutvā nṛpasya duhitā kṛtvā kaṇṭhe ruroda tām |
rājñī mṛgāvatī śrutvā tatrājagāma satvaram || 8 ||
jñātvā rodanahetuṃ ca jagāda ca śubhākṣiṇīm |
putri tvāṃ mama putryāśca sakhitve niścinomyaham || 9 ||
mama putryai pradāsye tvāṃ sakhīrūpāṃ sadā priyām |
rājñī brāhmaṇamāhūya prāha vipra sutā tava || 1.513.1 0||
mama putryāścātisnigdhā priyā sakhī hi vartate |
tasmāt kuru vaco mahyaṃ kanyāṃ dehi ca me tava || 1 1||
yadvā yasya mama kanyā dīyate tannṛpasya vai |
purodhāstasya yo viprastasmai deyā sutā tava || 12||
ekasthāne sthitayostu maitrīsaukhyaṃ sadā bhavet |
chāndogya svasutāyāścābhiprāyaṃ tvavagamya vai || 1 3||
dadau rājñyai kumārīṃ tāṃ brahācaryaparāyaṇām |
viprakanyā ratnavatyā samaṃ vāsaṃ cakāra ha || 14||
nṛpagṛhe tu sā jātā yuvatyatīva śobhanā |
nṛpaḥ svāṃ kanyakāṃ dātuṃ suyogyāya varāya tu || 15||
viprairanveṣaṇaṃ pṛthvyāṃ kārayāmāsa tasya vai |
daśārṇādhipatirbhūpaḥ patyarthaṃ saṃvṛtastayā || 16 ||
bṛhadbalaḥ sa nṛpatirvivāhārthaṃ samāgataḥ |
viśvāvasorbrāhmaṇasya rājñaḥ purohitasya ca || 17||
parāvasuritināmnā kumāro’bhūt tadā yuvā |
so’pi rājñā samaṃ tatra tvāyayau sa purohitaḥ || 18||
rājā lagnanamuhūrte vai maṇḍape vahnisannidhau |
āgatastatra kanyā ca viprakanyāsakhīyutā || 1 9||
pitṛbhyāmanyanārībhiryuktā hedīsamīpataḥ |
samānītā pradānāya tatrāścaryamabhūnmahad ||1.513.20||
kanyā jātismarā brahmacaryaparā śivāṃśajā |
pārvatīkalayā jātā yoginī janmato’bhavat ||21 ||
kāmarūpadharā sādhvī viprakanyāpi tādṛśī |
sarvasiddhimayī tvāsīd brahmacaryaparāyaṇā || 22||
tābhyāṃ gaurīpratāpena kāyavyūhaḥ prasādhitaḥ |
siddhayaḥ sādhitāḥ sarvāḥ kāmadevo jitastathā ||23||
pārvatyā vaiṣṇavo mantrastābhyāṃ datto rahasyakṛt |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye namaḥ ||24||
patiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ vinā nānyaḥ pātivratyaṃ hareḥ sadā |
pālanīyaṃ na cānyasyetyāha śrīpārvatī ca te ||25||
yogasiddhīrdadau tābhyāṃ siddhibhirdivyavaibhave |
camatkārānvite jāte maṇḍape te ca kanyake ||26||
rājakanyābhavat tatra siṃhikārūpadhāriṇī |
vikarālā lalajjihvā sphāranetrā sagarjanā ||27||
vipraputrī tadā vyāghrī krūrā samabhavat kṣaṇāt |
trastāḥ sarvajanā dṛṣṭvā dudruvurmaṇḍapād bahiḥ ||28||
kanyake dve vinā sarve palāyitā hi maṇḍapāt |
kolāhalo mahān jāto grāme rāṣṭre prajājane ||29||
bṛhadbalo vihāyaite yayau svanagaraṃ tadā |
pitṛbhyāṃ vārite paścāt pārvatīrūpameva te ||1.513.3 0||
dhṛtavatyau tadā śāntirjātā prajājanasya vai |
pūjitaṃ divyadehaṃ vai lokeśca pārvatīdvayam ||3 1 ||
śatacandrasame te’ dve kanyake śaṃkarānvite |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye namaḥ ||32||
iti japantyau vaiṣṇavyau jāte te kanyake tataḥ |
pūrvarūpānvite dṛṣṭvā santuṣṭāśca nirīkṣakāḥ ||33 ||
vārtā sarvatra lokeṣu pārvatīdvayameva tat |
devīdvayaṃ vartate vai pravṛttaivaṃ gṛhe gṛhe ||34||
nityaṃ lokāḥ pūjayanti paśyanti ca namanti ca |
ārārtrikaṃ ca kurvanti camatkārapure sadā ||35||
evaṃ kāle vyatīte’tha tīrthaṃ devīdvayātmakam |
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre sañjātaṃ pāvanaṃ param ||36 ||
ratnavatī prasasmāra kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ muhuḥ |
mayātmāstyarpitaste’taḥ kṛṣṇatvaṃ naya māmitaḥ ||37||
viprakanyāpi tat prāha yatra tvaṃ tatra cāpyaham |
sakhīṃ tyaktvā sakhī nānyasthalaṃ yāti kadācana ||38||
tadā devī smṛtā tābhyāṃ durgā cāpyāgatā drutam |
ājñayāmāsa tapase te cobhe prasthite yadā ||39||
tadā mṛgāvatī rājñī māyāmohasamanvitā |
aśrupūrvekṣaṇā dīnā putrīmetadduvāca ha ||1.513.40||
mā putri sāhasaṃ kāryaṃ tapo’rthaṃ te kathaṃcana |
bālā tvaṃ sukumārāṃgī sadaiva sukhabhāginī ||41 ||
kathaṃ tapaḥsamarthāsi vidhātuṃ tvamanindite |
kandamūlaphalāhārā cīravalkaladhāriṇī ||42||
tasmānmukhyasya bhūpasya kasyacittvāṃ dadāmyaham |
eṣā te brāhmaṇī nāmasakhī paramasammatā ||43||
yāsyati vai tvayā sākaṃ kaumārabhāvamāśritā |
yasya bhūpasya harmye tvaṃ prayāsyasi vivāhitā ||44||
ratnavatī ca tāṃ prāha mātarnaivaṃ tvayā punaḥ |
vācyaṃ madarthe yadi me prāṇān rakṣitumicchasi ||45||
haṭhena yadi vighnaṃ me kariṣyasi tadā tanum |
tyakṣyāmi viṣayogeṇa carvayitvā ca jihvikām ||46||
analaṃ vā pravekṣyāmi prāpsyāmi śrīhariṃ patim |
nānyaṃ patiṃ kariṣyāmi niścayo’yaṃ mayā kṛtaḥ ||47||
sāha tapaścariṣyāmi kaumāravratadhāriṇī |
patiṃ śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prāpsyāmi satpatim ||48||
sakṛjjalpanti rājānaḥ sakṛjjalpanti ca dvijāḥ |
sakṛt satyaḥ prajalpanti krīṇyetāni sakṛt sakṛt ||49||
manasā cintyate kāryaṃ vācā saṃprocyate tataḥ |
karmaṇā kriyate paścād satī tadvat karomyaham ||1.513.50||
evaṃ sā procya jananīṃ virarāma hareḥ priyā |
atha rājñī sakhīṃ tasyā brāhmaṇīṃ prāha vai tataḥ || 51||
mama putrī patiṃ naivodvāhaṃ vāñchati putrike |
tvayā kāryo vivāhastu gaccha harmyaṃ pitustava ||52||
yadvāhaṃ kārayiṣyāmi vivāhaṃ te yathepsitam |
kṣamasva yanmayoktaṃ tat kadācit kaṭukaṃ vacaḥ ||53||
tvayoktaṃ vā kadācit tat kṣāntaṃ sarvaṃ mayā sute |
brāhmaṇī prāha tāṃ rājñīṃ dharmayuktaṃ vacastadā |||54||
aṣṭavarṣā bhaved gaurī navavarṣā ca rohiṇī |
daśavarṣā bhavet kanyā kanyādānaṃ praśasyate ||55||
ṃ tataścordhvaṃ yāvannaiva tu dṛśyate |
tāvad dānaṃ hi kanyāyāḥ pūrṇapuṇyapradaṃ śrutam ||56||
kanyātvaṃ tu praṇaṣṭaṃ me kaumārye cāpi gacchati |
atīte ṣoḍaśe varṣe strīdharmiṇī bhavāmi vai ||57||
rajasvalāṃ tu yaḥ kanyāmudvāhayati tasya vai |
santānaṃ pāpasaṃyuktaṃ pātayatyaparān daśa ||58||
rajasvalāṃ tu yaḥ kanyāṃ pitā yacchati so’pi ca |
pātayet svakulānāṃ tu daśapūrvān daśāparān ||59||
tasmādahaṃ kariṣyāmi sakhyā sārdhaṃ tapaḥ param |
pitrā mātrā tvayā cāpi na me kāryaṃ kathaṃcana ||1.513.60 ||
samprāptaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ patiḥ paraḥ prabhuḥ |
evamuktvā kanyake dve yogajñānasamanvite ||61 ||
natvā tvājñāṃ gṛhītvā ca pitrornatkā gaṇādhipam |
yayaturvyomamārgeṇa bhartṛyajñaṃ muniṃ vane ||62||
āśramaṃ sāttvikaṃ cāvalokayāmāsatuḥ śubham |
ṛṣestapaḥprabhāveṇa parasparavirodhinām ||63 ||
melanaṃ sarvadā tvāste vairaṃ yatra na dṛśyate |
bhartṛyajñaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ saṃgatvā natvā ca tasthatuḥ ||64||
procaturvinayopete kṛtāñjalipuṭe hyubhe |
āvāṃ tapo’rthe tvāyāte tad brūhi tapaso vidhim ||65||
bhartṛyajño mahāyogī jagāda tapaso vidhim |
yena samprāpyate mokṣaḥ kiṃ punastridaśālayaḥ ||66||
cāndrāyaṇāni kṛcchrāṇi tathā sāntapanāni ca |
tapodvārāṇi sarvāṇi kārtikeyavratāni ca ||67||
rāgadveṣavihīnatvaṃ sārvabhaumamahiṃsanam |
satyaṃ ca brahmacaryaṃ cāsteyaṃ kṛṣṇaparigraham ||68||
santoṣaṃ cātmaśuddhiṃ ca prāṇanigrahaṇaṃ tathā |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇādhyāyaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe’rpaṇam ||69||
sukhiteṣu tathā maitrīṃ duḥkhiteṣu dayāṃ śubhām |
puṇyavatsu muditāṃ cāpuṇyavatsu hyupekṣaṇam ||1.513.70||
satāṃ sevāṃ sarvarītyā devasevanamityapi |
prakuryācchrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇārādhanamanvaham ||71 |
vyavasthāsu tridehaiśca triguṇānāṃ tadarpaṇam |
yātrāmātraṃ tanau snehaḥ śrīkṛṣṇe prema śāśvatam ||72||
kāryaṃ ca kalpanaṃ dhyānaṃ svapnaṃ bhānaṃ tadarpaṇam |
sattvena rajasā yadvā tamasā ca tadarpaṇam ||73||
daihikaṃ mānasaṃ kāmyamakāmyaṃ vā tadarpaṇam |
upādideśa japanaṃ smaraṇaṃ kīrtanaṃ kṛtim ||74||
prekṣaṇaṃ bhāṣaṇaṃ spṛśyaṃ gamyaṃ grāhyaṃ visarjanam |
sarvaṃ kṛṣṇātmakaṃ kāryaṃ tapastvetatparaṃ matam ||71||
yena vai śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prāpyeta karmaṇā |
pravṛttaṃ vā nivṛttaṃ vā karma tat tapa uttamam ||76||
anyat sarvaṃ hi labhyeta kṛṣṇaḥ prāpyeta naiva cet |
kṛṣṇaṃ vinā nirayaḥ sa labdhastanna tapo matam ||77||
kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇeti kṛṣṇeti grāhye dhārye tathātmani |
yadā sañjāyate tvaikyaṃ tadā mokṣamavāpnuyāt ||78||
kṛṣṇadāsyaṃ kṛṣṇabhaktiḥ paramaṃ tapa ucyate |
anekajanmatapasā saṃprāpya janma mānavam ||79||
kṛṣṇabhaktiryadi bhavet saphalaṃ janma mānavam |
saphalaṃ jīvanaṃ tasya kurvataḥ karmaṇaḥ phalam ||1.513.80 ||
pitṝṇāṃ ca sahasrāṇi svasya mātuśca niścitam |
mātāmahānāṃ puṃsāṃ ca śatānāṃ sodarasya ca ||81 ||
bāndhavasyāpi patnyāśca gurūṇāṃ śiṣyabhṛtyayoḥ |
tatkarma śobhanaṃ putryau yacca kṛṣṇe samarpaṇam ||82||
tattapaḥ śobhanaṃ karma kṛṣṇasantoṣaṇaṃ yataḥ |
tadvrataṃ tattapaḥ satyaṃ tadbhaktiḥ pūjanaṃ tathā |||83||
taduddeśyamanaśanaṃ yad bhaved dāsyadṃ hareḥ |
samastapṛthivīdānaṃ prādakṣiṇyaṃ bhuvastathā ||84||
samastatīrthasnānaṃ ca samastaṃ ca vrataṃ tapaḥ |
samastayajñakaraṇaṃ sarvadānaphalaṃ tathā ||85||
samastavedavedāṃgapaṭhanaṃ pāṭhanaṃ tathā |
bhītasya rakṣaṇaṃ caiva jñānapradānamuttamam ||86||
atithīnāṃ pūjanaṃ ca śaraṇāgatarakṣaṇam |
sarvadevārcanaṃ cāpi vandanaṃ japanaṃ manoḥ ||87||
bhojanaṃ vipradevānāṃ puraścaraṇapūrvakam |
guruśuśrūṣaṇaṃ cāpi pitrorbhaktiśca poṣaṇam ||88||
sarvaṃ śrīkṛṣṇadāsasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm |
tasmāt putryau prayatnena bhajate kṛṣṇamīśvaram ||89||
śāśvataṃ satpatiṃ divyaṃ paramātmānameva hi |
nityaṃ satyaṃ parabrahma kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ patim ||1.513.90||
paripūrṇatamaṃ śuddhaṃ nirliptaṃ sākṣiṇaṃ harim |
bhaktidaṃ dāsyadaṃ svasya nijasampatpadapradam ||91 ||
bhajataṃ paramānandaṃ svāminaṃ kāntamāntaram |
kiṃvā jalaṃ sthalaṃ kimvā naktaṃ kimvā dinaṃ tathā ||92||
vrataṃ kimvā tapaḥ kimvā kiṃ bhojyaṃ peyameva kim |
dehaḥ kimvā manaḥ kimvā vismṛtya bhajataṃ harim ||93||
śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa kṛṣṇakṛṣṇa śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa kāntakṛṣṇa |
śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇacāntarātmanpradehi dāsyaṃ caraṇe priyeśa||94||
premṇā nu bhaktyā stavanena pūjayā
samarpaṇenāpi hṛdi sthitaṃ sute |
śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇamāntaraṃ patiṃ
surakṣakaṃ saṃbhajataṃ sukhapradam ||95||
ramāpadmārcitaṃ lakṣmīsevitaṃ prabhayārcitam |
māṇikīcumbitaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ caraṇaṃ bhajataṃ sute ||96||
satataṃ śaṃbhunā gītaṃ pārvatyā cintitaṃ hṛdi |
dhyātaṃ sanakasadbhiśca bhajataṃ tatpadaṃ hareḥ ||97||
śrīśrīkṛṣṇapādapadmaṃ svapne japati yaḥ sute |
śatajanmakṛtātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||98||
tadvrataṃ tattapaḥ satyaṃ tatpuṇyaṃ tacca pūjanam |
saphalaṃ kṛṣṇasambandhi svajanmakhaṇḍanaṃ yataḥ ||99||
śrīkṛṣṇaṃ taṃ parityajya kiṃ bhavet tapasā sute |
tapasāṃ phalamāpnoti śrīkṛṣṇasmaraṇena vai || 1.513.10 0||
yato bhaktirna ca bhavecchrīkṛṣṇe paramātmani |
sa guruḥ paramo vairī karoti janma niṣphalam || 101 ||
te tatheti paraṃ jñānaṃ labdhā bhaktyātmakaṃ śubham |
natvā gatvā sarastīraṃ cāndrāyaṇādi cakratuḥ || 1 02||
ṣaṣṭhakālādanaṃ śarattrayaṃ jagāma vai tayoḥ |
hemante jalavāsinyo grīṣme pañcāgnisādhike || 103 ||
nirāśraye ca varṣāyāṃ babhūvaturhareḥ priye |
dhyāyamāne divānaktaṃ japantyau śrīhariṃ patim || 1 04||
tato varṣaśataṃ sārdhaṃ nirāhāre babhūvatuḥ |
tāvatkālaṃ śīrṇaparṇāśinyau cāpi babhūvatuḥ || 1 05||
tataścāpi jalāhāre yāvadvarṣaśatāni ṣaṭ |
vāyubhakṣe sahasraṃ ca varṣāṇāṃ taṃ babhūvatuḥ || 1 06||
tatra nityaṃ ca tapasi sthite sakhyāvubhe hyapi |
atha tuṣṭaḥ svayaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo jagatpatiḥ || 1 07||
yuvā surūpaḥ śyāmaśca garuḍena samāyayau |
tejovyāptapratibhaḥ sa tāpasyau samuvāca vai || 1 08||
netre conmīlya vīkṣethāṃ varaṃ dātuṃ samāgataḥ |
śrutveti te bahirdṛṣṭiṃ kṛtvā lokayataḥ prabhum || 1 09||
satpatiṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ kāntaṃ manoharam |
rūpānurūpāvayavaṃ yogyaṃ sevyapadāmbujam || 1.513.11 0||
tapastyaktvā petatustatpādayorūcatuḥ pate |
gṛhāṇa kiṃkarīdvandvaṃ dehi dāsyaṃ patirbhava || 111 ||
kṛṣṇaṃ kaṇṭhe vavalgāte sāśrunetre’tikarṣite |
kṛṣṇaścucumba pasparśa kareṇājñāya bhāvanām || 11 2||
divyarūpe ramātulye pidhāya ca niyāya ca |
garuḍe te nijāṃke dve sakthnorupari sthāpite || 113 ||
bhujābhyāṃ pārśvayornītvā bhartṛyajñasthalaṃ yayau |
tayorguruṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ taṃ nītvā garuḍapṛṣṭhake || 1 14||
catvāraste garuḍena yayurgolokadhāma vai |
śrīkṛṣṇasyāgamaṃ jñātvā ṛṣayastatsthalaṃ yayuḥ || 1 15||
vyomni yāntaṃ namaścakruḥ pūjayāmāsurīśvaram |
nāganadyāhradaḥ so’pi ratnasaraḥ sunāmataḥ || 1 16||
tadānīṃ suprasiddhaṃ vai jātaṃ snānātpramokṣadam |
kṛṣṇadāsyau tu te jāte śāśvatānandasevike ||1 17||
svarge devībhirāgatya prārthite sthātumeva yat |
devīnāṃ śreyase svarge sthātavyaṃ ceti vai tadā ||1 18||
śrīkṛṣṇena kṛte te dve tārake sthāpite’pi ca |
chāyārūpe muktide vai paṭhanācchravaṇādapi || 11 9||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne camatkārapurīyarājaputrīvipraputryorvivāhakāle siṃhavyāghrarūpadhartrītvaṃ, tato bhartṛyajñāśramavāsaḥ, tato durvahaṃ tapaḥ, tataḥ bhartṛyajñena saha tayoḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprāptirgolokagamanaṃ cetinirūpaṇanāmā trayodaśādhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||513||

<1.514>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi martyaloke sarvapātakanāśanam |
kṣetratrayaṃ tathāraṇyatrayaṃ purītrayaṃ tathā || 1 ||
vanatrayaṃ tathā grāmatrayaṃ tīrthatrayaṃ param |
śailatrayaṃ tathā nadītrayaṃ sarvaphalapradam || 2 ||
kurukṣetraṃ hāṭakeśakṣetraṃ prabhāsakṣetrakam |
yathoktavidhinā kṛtvā janaḥ pāpāt pramucyate || 3 ||
prathamaṃ puṣkarāraṇyaṃ naimiṣāraṇyamityapi |
dharmāraṇyaṃ tṛtīyaṃ ca sarveṣṭaphaladāyakam || 4 ||
vārāṇasīpurī tvekā dvitīyā dvārakāpurī |
tṛtīyāvantikāpūśca yatheṣṭaphaladāyinī || 5 ||
vṛndāvanaṃ dvaitavanaṃ tathā ca khāṇḍavaṃ vanam |
snānādvāsāt svargamokṣapradaṃ pāpavināśakam || 6 ||
kālagrāmaḥ śālagrāmo nandigrāmastṛtīyakaḥ |
indriyagrāmatṛṣṇānāṃ dhvaṃsako mokṣadastathā || 7 ||
agnītīrthaṃ śuklatīrthaṃ pitṛtīrthaṃ tṛtīyakam |
tatra snānād bhuktimuktī labhate mānavo dhruvam || 8 ||
śrīparvataścārbudādriḥ raivatācala ityapi |
yātrākartā svargabhoktā paścānmuktiprago bhavet || 9 ||
gaṃgānadī narmadākhyānadī sarasvatīnadī |
snānād bhuktistathā muktistatheṣṭaṃ sarvadā dadet || 1.514.1 0||
jñānavāpī ca kuṃkumavāpī rohaṇavāpikā |
jalapānād bhavenmuktirvāpītrayaṃ hi pāvanam ||1 1 ||
nārāyaṇasara indrasaro mānasakaṃ saraḥ |
sarastrayaṃ bhuktimuktipradaṃ snānādbhavatyapi || 1 2||
pārvatī ca prabhā lakṣmīrmāṇikī ca jayā ramā |
rādhā padmāṣṭanāmāni tārayed bhavasāgarāt || 1 3||
vastrāpathaścottarapatho dakṣiṇāpatha ityamī |
muktidāstraya evātra yātrayā nātra saṃśayaḥ || 14||
brahmahatyādikaṃ pāpaṃ jātyantarādibhojanam |
cāṇḍālagṛhavāsitvaṃ surāmāṃsāśanādkim || 16||
nāganadyāṃ kṛtasnānāt sarvaṃ śuddhyati sarvathā |
nāgalīlānāmato vai śrīkṛṣṇasya tu dāsikā || 16||
rādhikākabarīgranthiṃ narmaṇā kṛṣṇasannidhau |
nirbandhanāṃ vikīrṇāṃ ca cakāra svakareṇa vai || 17||
punaḥ keśān valayitvā dhammilaṃ rādhikākarot |
nāgalīlā punargranthiṃ vikīrṇāṃ cākarod dhiyā || 18||
goloke ca muhurgranthirmuhurviyojanaṃ tayoḥ |
narmaṇānyonyasāhacaryājjātaṃ tena tu rādhikā || 1 9||
kruddhā provāca gaccha tvaṃ nāgalīle bhuvastalam |
ābhīrasya gṛhe yāhi tvābhīreṇa dhṛtā bhava ||1.514.20 ||
ityuktvā sā sakhī rādhāṃ tuṣṭāva śāpamocane |
rādhā prāha yadā tvābhīreṇa dhṛtā bhaviṣyasi ||21 ||
tadā jalasvarūpeṇa pāvanī vicariṣyasi |
agrāhyā tvaṃ vinā kṛṣṇaṃ bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ ||22||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmī yadā tatrāgamiṣyati |
tadā tvaṃ kanyakā bhūtvā golokaṃ tvāgamiṣyasi ||23 ||
tāvanmuktipradā pāpakṣālinī śuddhidā sadā |
śvapacādijātibhraṣṭamānavānāṃ ca pāvanī || 24||
snānamātreṇa tu śuddhipradā tvaṃ vai bhaviṣyasi |
ityuktā rādhayā natvā yayau sā bhūtalaṃ tadā ||25||
ānartīyābhīravaryagṛhe jātā hi kanyakā |
śyāmasuraḥ pitā tasyā nāgalīletināmataḥ ||26||
jātismarā tvājuhāva mātā ca rāṇikā tathā |
mumoda kanyakāṃ labdhvojjvalā divyasvarūpiṇīm ||27||
sarastīre gavāṃ śakṛdgṛhṇānā tu divā sadā |
gomaṇḍale bhramatyeva tāṃ dṛṣṭvābhīrabālakaḥ ||28|||
yuvā tāṃ dharṣayāmāsa yuvatīṃ rūpaśālinīm |
sā smṛtvā rādhikāśāpaṃ jalarūpā babhūva ha ||29||
nāganadī tu sā jātā kṛṣṇasyaiva priyā sakhī |
yasyāṃ snānena cāṇḍālagṛhiṇī brāhmaṇī bhavet || 1.514.3 0||
śṛṇu lakṣmi vardhamānapure tvantyajajātijaḥ |
caṇḍālaḥ kuṃbhako nāma tasyābhūttvātmajaḥ sutaḥ ||3 1 ||
ghūkakarṇa itikhyātaḥ surūpastīrthayātrayā |
camatkārapuraṃ prāpto dvijarūpaṃ samāśritaḥ ||32||
sa snāti sarvatīrtheṣu bhikṣānnakṛtabhojanaḥ |
dvijavadvartate nityaṃ sahavāsāddvijakriyaḥ ||33 ||
camatkārapure tatra subhadrabrāhmaṇasya vai |
santāne kanyakā tvekā dviguṇaiśca radairyutā ||34||
āsīt tristanayuktā ca mahodarī bhayaṃkarā |
yasyāḥ patirbhavecced yaḥ ṣaṇmāse nidhanaṃ vrajet| ||35||
nāto jagrāha tāṃ kaścidaṣṭādaśādhivatsarām |
tāvat tasyā gṛhe bhikṣāṃ kartuṃ so’ntyajajātikaḥ |||36 ||
ghūkakarṇaḥ samāyātastaṃ dṛṣṭvā sā mumoha ca |
tasyāḥ pitā surūpaṃ ca dvijaveṣaṃ vilokya ca ||37||
papraccha gotrajātyādi kulaṃ nāmādikaṃ tataḥ |
ghūkakarṇo dvijaṃ prāha sthānaṃ me goḍadeśake || 38||
grāme bhojakaṭe me’sti pitā mādhavabhūsuraḥ |
vasiṣṭhagotrī tasyāhaṃ candraprabhābhidhaḥ sutaḥ ||39|||
aṣṭame vatsare me tu pitā vai nidhanaṃ gataḥ |
vārāṇasyāmadhītyaiva kiñcinmātraṃ śubhakriyam ||1.514.40||
tīrthāni bhramamāṇo’trāyāto yāsyāmi gomatīm |
prabhāsaṃ ca tataḥ śuklaṃ tīrtha tataḥ punargṛham ||41 ||
iti śrutvā tathā putryā vṛttiṃ jñātvā sutāpitā |
prāha cenme sutāṃ tvatra gṛhṇāsi te dadāmyaham ||42||
tathetyuktvā sa jagrāha cāṇḍālo vidhinā tataḥ |
vivāhottarakāle sa vilāsānakarod bahūn |||43||
khādyaiḥ pānaiḥ suvastraiśca dvijayogyaiḥ samutsavaiḥ |
paraṃ sa vrajati prāyo yena mārgeṇa kenacit ||44||
sārameyā bhaṣantyenaṃ pṛṣṭhato’nuvrajanti ca |
viprayoge vedavākyaṃ yadi coccarati kvacit ||45||
raktaṃ patati vaktrācca tatkṣaṇāt tasya durmateḥ |
svapne ca jalpanāṃ cakre malaniṣkāsanakriyām ||46 ||
evaṃ cihnairayaṃ kiściccāṇḍāleti viśaṃkitaḥ |
janaiḥ śaṃkāvināśāya daivī śuddhirapekṣitā ||47||
taptāyasaṃ kare dhṛtvā śuddhiśaṃkā nivartate |
tathā kāryaṃ tvayā prātarna ced dagdho’si vai dvijaḥ ||48||
dagdhaścedanyajātīya iti vai niścayo bhavet |
atha rātrau nijāṃ bhāryāṃ provācāhaṃ na vai dvijaḥ ||49||
asmi tvantyajajātīyo jñātaśca śaṃkito janaiḥ |
deśāntaraṃ gamiṣyāmi tvamāgaccha mayā saha ||1.514.50||
patnī prāha mama bhāgye duṣṭaṃ vahnyarthameva ha |
pāpasandūṣitaṃ sarvaṃ kuṭumbaṃ mama varṣma ca ||51 ||
gaccha rātrau bahirno cet saṃprāpsyasi mahāpadam |
ityuktaḥ sa yayau deśāntaraṃ rātrau bhayāt khalu ||52||
prabhāte duhitā bāṣpanetrā provāca mātaram |
mātaḥ pūrvaṃ mama pāpaṃ dattāhamantyajasya yat ||53||
sa prayāto madhyarātrau samāvedya nijaṃ kulam |
mamāgnisnānamevāsti śuddhirnānyā bhuvastale ||54||
pitā jñātvā śuśocāti tvanye’pi śokamāvrajan |
viprāḥ sarve militvā ca prāyaścittaṃ praśodhakam ||55 ||
kanyāyāśca tadā prāhurvahnipraveśanaṃ tataḥ |
anyeṣāṃ tasya saṃsarge gatānāṃ tu vratāni vai ||56 ||
atha kāṣṭhāni cādāya vahniṃ datvā tu kanyakā |
natvā pitṝn surān smṛtvā samārohati yāvatā ||57||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye namaḥ |
japamevaṃ prakurvāṇā dadau pādaṃ hutāśane ||58||
tāvadvahniḥ śītalaśca nādahyat tāṃ dayāvaśaḥ |
nāsyā doṣo’sti tasmāt sā rājasvalyena śuddhyati ||59||
atha tāvat samāyātaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ |
sādhuveṣo vaiṣṇavaśca dharmaśāstrādipaṇḍitaḥ ||1.514.6 0||
trikālajñaḥ svayaṃ lakṣmīpatiḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ |
prāha kiṃ jāyate ceyaṃ kathaṃ dahyati cānale ||61 ||
lokā nivedayāmāsurvṛttāntaṃ saṃgajaṃ tataḥ |
prāha tān śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmī dayāparaḥ ||62||
mayā pūrvaṃ śrutaṃ svarge camatkārapure nadī |
nāgalīlābhidhā kṛṣṇapatnī golokadhāmataḥ ||6 3 ||
pāvanārthaṃ śvapacādisaṃgamādyaghakāriṇām |
vartate tajjale snātvā śuddhyanti śvapacādayaḥ ||64||
tasmād gacchata tatraiva snānaṃ kuruta sarvathā |
vahniḥ śrutvā tathetyāha tataḥ sarve yayurnadīm ||65 ||
kanyaikā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvābhisaṃyayau |
natvā tvaṃ svāminaṃ prāha gṛhītvā tatkaraṃ mudā ||66||
tīrthaṃ tvantyajapāpaghnaṃ nātidūre’sti vai hradaḥ |
samāyāta ca kuruta snānaṃ tatra dvijeśvarāḥ ||67||
tayoktāste tayā sākaṃ gatvā sasnuśca sāmbarāḥ |
viprakanyā yadā snātā tadā tasyāḥ śarīrataḥ ||68||
śvapacī kṛṣṇavarṇā tu nirgatā snānamātrataḥ |
anyeṣāmapi dehebhyaḥ kākā ghūkāḥ pīpilikāḥ ||69||
kṛṣṇavarṇā nirgatāśca yayurdeśaṃ tu paścimam |
sahasrayojanātpāraṃ abrikte bhūtale tadā ||1.514.70||
ete viprā pāvanāśca brāhmaṇī śuddhatāṃ gatā |
evaṃ sarve samāyātā nagaraṃ svasvakāśramam ||71 ||
kanyakā brāhmaṇī paścād brahmacaryaparāyaṇā |
hyavartata satī sādhvī kṛṣṇasvāmipativratā ||72||
nāgavatīṃ sadā yāti snānārthaṃ tu tadā nadī |
nityaṃ vai kanyakā bhūtvā brāhmaṇyā saha mandire ||73||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmidarśanārthaṃ prayāti ca |
prāpte tu brāhmaṇaputryā āyuṣastu kṣaye hariḥ ||74||
nadīṃ ca tāṃ brāhmaṇīṃ ca divyarūpāṃ vidhāya ca |
golokaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo nināya te hyubhe ||75||
divyaratnasunaddhena koṭisūryaprabhāvatā |
vimānena patiṃ kṛṣṇaṃ prāpya te yayaturmudā ||76||
golokaṃ dhāma nityaṃ yad rādhāramādiśobhitam |
atha brahmāpi kulaṭāśāpādatra sutīrthake ||77||
purā vai kulaṭāśāpāt pramuktaḥ saṃbabhūva ha |
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ lakṣmi pāvanaṃ tīrthamuttamam ||78||
yatra snānena vai śuddhiḥ sarvā nirvāhameti hi |
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya sadā śuddhyati mānavaḥ ||79||
mantraṃ prāpya guruṃ natvā nāgavatyāṃ samāhitaḥ |
snāyād yaḥ sa bhavecchuddhaḥ kṛṣṇavannātra saṃśayaḥ ||1.514.80||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne goloke rādhikāyāḥ śāpād nāgalīlāsakhyā nāgavatīnadītvaṃ, yasyāṃ snānena ghūkakarṇacāṇḍālena vivāhitāyā brāhmaṇakanyayā brāhmaṇānāṃ ca śuddhirjātā, tato brāhmaṇakanyā nāgavatīnadī ca divyakanyake bhūtvā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena saha golokaṃ yayaturityādinirūpaṇanāmā caturdaśādhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||514|||

<1.515>
śrīlakṣmīruvāca
kadā brahmā kulaṭayā śaptaḥ kimarthameva ca |
nāganadyāṃ tataḥ snātvā yena śuddho hi viśvasṛṭ || 1 ||
nārāyaṇahare kṛṣṇa me vadātra kathāṃ tu tām |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrutvā lakṣmyai saṃprāha tāṃ kathām || 2 ||
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi purā brahmā janayāmāsa kanyakām |
mohinīṃ mānasīṃ tāṃ cāpsarasaṃ kṛtavān svayam || 3 ||
sarvasādhāraṇī sā tu devapatnī tato’bhavat |
atha sā tvekadā dṛṣṭvā brahmāṇaṃ samumoha vai || 4 ||
vismṛtya pitaraṃ ceti kāmasaṃkalpamācarat |
manvantare raivatasya sucandro vaiṣṇavo nṛpaḥ || 5 ||
tapase malayadroṇīṃ yayau varṣasahasrakam |
valmīkācchāditaṃ dehaṃ dṛṣṭvā dhātā samāyayau || 6 ||
varaṃ vṛṇu pratuṣṭo’smītyuvāca taṃ jagatpitā |
vavre sa śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktiṃ ca dāsatām || 7 ||
brahmā kamaṇḍalorvāri cikṣepa ca siṣeca vai |
rājā samyaccharīraḥ san nanāma tu punaḥ punaḥ || 8 ||
tathāstviti varaṃ brahmā dadau tadā rathottamam |
golokādāgataṃ divyaṃ samāruroha bhūpatiḥ || 9 ||
pārṣadaḥ sa divyarūpo bhūtvā kṛṣṇapadaṃ yayau |
brahmā yāntaṃ satyalokaṃ dadarśa mohinīṃ pathi || 1.515.1 0||
tadā mumoha sadyaḥ sā nirjane rantumeva ca |
vilokya vakranayanā jugopa sasmitaṃ mukham || 11 ||
pulakāñcitasarvāṃgī kāmavegena pīḍitā |
niṣasāda śanairbhūmau purato brahmaṇaḥ pade || 1 2||
brahmā nirīkṣya tāṃ putrīṃ vikāraṃ nahi cāpa saḥ |
brahmalokaṃ yayau tāṃ ca samāśvāsya pitā yathā || 13 ||
sakāmā sā tadā jātā nirāśā hatacetanā |
divāniśaṃ sacintā sā svapne jñāne caturmukham || 14||
āsīnā saṃsthitā yadvā śayanaṃ kurvatī kṣaṇam |
taptapātre yathā sasyaṃ bhramatyeva tathā pathi || 15||
kāmaṃ sahāyamāsādya tena sārdhaṃ hi mohinī |
brahmalokaṃ yayau cājaṃ nirjane sā dadarśa tam || 16||
tameva mohitaṃ kartuṃ samārebhe puraḥ sthitā |
kṣaṇaṃ nanarta suciraṃ sugānena kṣaṇaṃ jagau || 17||
vidhātā susvaraṃ śrutvā mumoha sāśrulocanaḥ |
dṛṣṭvā mugdhaṃ kalāḥ sarvā darśayāmāsa nartane || 18||
datvā tathāpi vai pāritoṣikaṃ virato yayau |
hatodyamā tu sā prāha kāmaṃ deva namo’stu te || 1 9||
nikṣipa tvaṃ svakān bāṇān kāmadeva vidhau tataḥ |
antarīkṣe sthitaḥ kāmo mahāstraṃ prerayanmudā ||1.515.20||
babhūva cañcalo brahmā cakre nirīkṣaṇaṃ muhuḥ |

gaccha putri mamāgrāhyā tvanyatra viharasva yat ||22||

aye vatse gaccha dūraṃ vihāya pitaraṃ hi mām ||23||
tava yogyaṃ paraṃ devaṃ yuvānaṃ paśya mohinī |
mohinī prāha dhātāraṃ me mano na sthiraṃ yataḥ ||24||
bhūtaṃ tvayi viśeṣeṇa cañcalaṃ vīkṣite mayā |
aho gantumaśaktāhaṃ tvayā yadyapi bhartsitā ||25||
kṛpāṃ kuru kṛpāsindho na māṃ hantuṃ tvamarhasi |
santo garvaṃ na kurvanti paropakṛtiśālinaḥ ||26||

kācittu karmaṇā bhuṃkte naraṃ kṛtvāṅgavikrayam ||27||

bhuktvā tṛptirbhavet tadvat kartavyaṃ narasevanam ||28||

tat tvāṃ karmānyathākartuṃ samarthaṃ cāhamāgatā ||29||
mahatāṃ sevayā śaśvad yaśasā bhānti yoṣitaḥ |
gṛhī tapasvī kāmī vā tyajet striyamupasthitām || 1.515.30||
niḥśvāsahatapuṇyaḥ saḥ śāpapātraṃ bhavediha |
naṣṭaśrīrbhraṣṭarūpaśca bhraṣṭabuddhirbhavettathā ||3 1 ||
sadyaḥ sa klībatāṃ yāti brahman śāpena yoṣitaḥ |
vidhuraśca sadā śāpabalena jāyate’sukhaḥ ||32||
uttiṣṭha tajjagannātha pāraṃ kuru smarārṇave |
satataṃ tvanmanaskāṃ māṃ dāsīṃ krīṇīhi sādaram ||33||
ityuktvā vedhaso vastraṃ vicakarṣa hi mohinī |
brahmā dhairyaṃ samālambya sāramāha sutāṃ prati ||34||
tyaja māmambike vṛddhaṃ niṣkāmaṃ paśya cāparam |
tvayā saha nibandho me kāmalekho na vidyate ||35||
pūrvakarmakṛtā rekhā patiṃ dadāti yoṣite |
muñca vastraṃ mama putri dhairyamālambaya kṣaṇam ||36||
etasminnantare vighnarūpā ājagmurīśvarāḥ |
atriḥ pulastyaḥ pulaho vasiṣṭhaḥ kraturaṃgirāḥ ||37||
bhṛgurmarīciḥ kapilo voḍhuḥ pañcaśikho ruciḥ |
āsuriśca pracetāśca patnīvrato bṛhaspatiḥ ||38||

sanakaśca sanandaśca kardamaśca sanātanaḥ || 39||
sanatkumāraḥ pippalaḥ śaṃku śukraḥ parāśaraḥ |
śātātapo lomaśaśca mārkaṇḍeyo vibhāṇḍakaḥ || 1.515.40||
mṛkaṇḍuścavano jaratkārurāstikakauśikau |
bhāradvājaḥ ṛṣyaśṛṃgo bharadvājaśca nāradaḥ ||41 ||
vāmadevaśca durvāsāḥ svayaṃprakāśa ityamī |
tatyāja mohinī dṛṣṭvā vrīḍayā vedhasaṃ tadā ||42||
brahmā cāsanamārūḍho mohinī pārśvataḥ sthitā |
praṇemurmunayastaṃ ca brahmā dadau śubhāśiṣam ||43||
papracchurmunayo devaṃ kathameṣā tavāntike |
brahmā prāha ciraṃ nṛtyaṃ gītaṃ cāpūrvamityapi ||44||
darśayituṃ tvāgateyaṃ kṛtvā śrāntā sthitā yataḥ |
munayo jahasustatra kulaṭāṃ prati sarvathā ||45||
sadyaścukopa tūtthāya sāha viśvasṛjaṃ tadā |
ete tvanigrahāḥ sarve vṛddhā hasanti māṃ vidhe ||46 ||
te’pi hāsyaṃ prayāsyanti lokānāṃ svasvakarmabhiḥ |
tvaṃ ca māṃ bhajamānāṃ vai yato gṛhṇāsi naiva ca ||47||
naitān vārayasi brahman hāsyapātraṃ tato bhava |
apūjyo bhava sarvatra nārīṇāṃ mānavarjitaḥ ||48||
tava patnī tava kārye bhartsanā vai kariṣyati |
kṛtvājaṃ pūjanahīnaṃ yayau svargaṃ tu mohinī ||49||
kṣaṇaṃ brahmā ca munayaḥ śuśucuḥ śāpamokṣaṇam |
brahmā vicārya ca tataścamatkārapurāntike ||1.515.50||
nāgavatyāṃ samāyātaḥ śuddhyarthaṃ śāpahānaye |
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ ||51 ||
japan mantraṃ kṛṣṇadattaṃ sasnau tīrthe’ghanāśane |
jahau dehaṃ tu taṃ brahmā śaptaṃ nāganadītaṭe ||52||
tasmāt sahasraśastatra cotpannā vṛndalāstataḥ |
nagaraṃ tatra saṃśritya sthitā brahmā divaṃ yayau ||53||
divyarūpadharaścaiva śāpaḥ pūrvatanusthitaḥ |
vṛndalāste sadā loke hyapūjyāstvabhavam̐stataḥ ||54||
nārībhirbhartsitāḥ śaśvannārīrūpaviḍambakāḥ |
mohakā mohinītulyā ratihīnā avīryakāḥ ||55||
na narā na ca nāryaste yoniliṃgavivarjitāḥ |
svalpamūtrachidramātrayutāste tu tataḥ param ||56||
brahmāṇaṃ ca samuddiśya cakrurvai tarpaṇaṃ jale |
brahmā tatra samāyātaścakruste prārthanāṃ vidheḥ ||57||
napuṃsakatvanāśāya brahmā prāha ca tām̐stadā |
tapaḥ kuruta satataṃ samuddiśya tu mohinīm |||58||
sā nistāra hi bhavatāṃ kariṣyati hitāvahā |
tataste vai taṭe nadyāstapaścakrurnirantaram ||59||
mohinīṃ te namo mātarvṛndalatvanivāriṇīm |
svāhā kāmapriye tubhyamuddhāraṃ kuru nastviha ||1.515.6 0||
iti samprārthayantaste vṛndalānāṃ gaṇāstadā |
dadṛśurnāganadyāstu taṭe saubhāgyasundarīm ||6 1 ||
bahucarāsvarūpāṃ tāṃ raktakañcukikānvitām |
raktaśāṭikayā yuktāṃ vahnivarṇāṃ sabhūṣaṇām ||62||
puṣṭāṃ puṣṭastanīṃ puṣṭajaghanāṃ tanumadhyamām |
surūpāṃ padmapatrākṣīṃ keśadhammilaśobhitām ||63||

valayena karayośca kaṃkaṇairūrmikādibhiḥ ||64||

karṇanāsābhujākaṇṭhabhālabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām ||65||
aṃkuritastanāṃ pṛthuśroṇīṃ vṛttakapolakām |
kundottamakalīdantāṃ raktabimbādharāṃ śubhām ||66||
śaraccandrānanāṃ miṣṭasvarāṃ smerānanānvitām |
puṣṭāṃ premabharāṃ kanyāṃ bhaktānugrahakātarām ||67||
kāmadharmavihīnāṃ ca rājasvalyavivarjitām |
kāmarūpadharāṃ vyomni dṛṣṭvā sarve napuṃsakāḥ ||68||
tasyāstu tejasā channanetrāḥ kṣaṇaṃ tadābhavan |
sā tvājagāma pṛthivītalaṃ nāgavatītaṭe ||69||
sarvaiḥ saṃvanditā cāpi pūjitā toṣitārthitā |
marditā ca tathā sarvāṃgeṣu saṃvāhitā satī ||1.515.70||
uvāca tān prasannāsmi varairyuṣmān madāśritān |
yojayāmi vṛṇudhvaṃ vai yatheṣṭaṃ mā ciraṃ tadā ||71 ||

ṣaṇḍhatvasya vināśāya tuṣṭuvuste muhurmuhuḥ ||72||
tadā devī tu tānprāha mohinyahaṃ purābhavā |
prakṛteśca tiraskārād yūyaṃ brahmatanūdbhavāḥ ||73||
ṣaṇḍhā sarve hi sañjātā nārībhartsanapāpataḥ |
nārīṇāṃ kāmaśāntyarthaṃ narāḥ kṛṣṇena nirmitāḥ ||74||
nārīṇāṃ māsike dharme kāmanalo vivardhate |
tacchāntiṃ tvicchati bhāryā patinā sārdhameva tu ||75||
yasyā nāsti patiḥ sā tu sveṣṭaṃ gacchanti śāntaye |
śāntikarma tu nārīṇāṃ dharmaḥ śāntiprado nṛṇām ||76||
bhajamānāṃ bhajante ye te tvāśīrvādabhūmayaḥ |
āgatāṃ kāmasantaptāṃ tiraskurvanti ye narāḥ ||77||
ātmahanaśca te bodhyāḥ sevikāghātakāśca te |
tena pāpena ṣaṇḍhatvaṃ prayānti pratijanmani ||78||
kāmakriyāsthayorvighnakartāro’pi napuṃsakāḥ |
kāmānandahanaḥ sarve ṣaṇḍhā bhavanti śāpataḥ ||79||
prasahya bhogakartāraścāpi daṇḍā bhavanti vai |
patiśūnyā tu yā nārī kāmataptā bhaved yadi ||1.515.80||
agṛhṇannaparādhī syāt phalaṃ ṣaṇḍhatvameva yat |
tasmānnaraiḥ sadā nāryaḥ pūjyāḥ sevyāstadicchayā ||81 ||
bhavantaḥ ṣaṇḍhatānivṛttyarthaṃ bhavantu dīkṣitāḥ |
śmaśrūhīnā nārīvastradharā nārīvibhūṣaṇāḥ ||82||
mama bhaktā mama pūjākartāro mama jāpakāḥ |
mama vaṃśadharā muktāḥ ṣaṇḍhatāto bhaviṣyatha ||83||
bahucaretyabhidhāya dadau mantraṃ nijaṃ tu sā |
oṃ namo bahucarāyai mohinyai kāmayoṣite ||84||
ṣaṃḍhatvaṃ hara mātastvaṃ śreyaḥ kuru paraṃ mama |
itimantraṃ nāganadyāṃ snāpayitvā dadau śubham ||85||
oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ kāmadātryai svāhā daśākṣaram |
mantraṃ dadau dvitīyaṃ ca kāmanāsiddhihetave ||86||
yasyāsīccaṇakāmātraṃ yonicchidraṃ tu tatsthale |
devī sā citrayāmāsa yoniṃ pūrṇāṃ tu dīkṣaṇe ||87||
yasmāsīcca lavaṃgābhaṃ liṃgacihnaṃ tu tatsthale |
pūrṇaṃ liṃgaṃ sāṇḍayugmaṃ citrayāmāsa rekhayā ||88||
hiṃgulārasadānena pūrṇakāmatvalabdhaye |
janmāntare bhavennārī naro vā tadvirekhitaḥ ||89||
śāṭikāṃ kañcukīṃ śreṣṭhāṃ ghargharīṃ dorakaṃ tathā |
dantikāṃ sindūracūrṇaṃ hiṃgulaṃ mantramityapi ||1.515.90||
jalaṃ ca mantritaṃ snigdhaṃ cumbanaṃ ca dadau tadā |
sarvānnapuṃsakān devī pasparśa stanayostadā ||9 1||
gṇḍayorbhālayoḥ kapolayoḥ keśeṣu netrayoḥ |
pṛṣṭhe nitambayoścāgre jaghanayostathodare ||92||
nābhyāṃ sakthnoḥ pādayośca siṣeca mastake ca tān |
ṣaṇḍhatvapāpanāśovābhavatviti jagāda tān ||93 ||
evaṃ dīkṣāṃ gṛhītvā te pupūjurdevikāṃ tadā |
sā ca pūjāṃ samagṛhya yayau vai cottarāṃ diśam ||94||
evaṃ ṣaṇḍhatvanivṛttiṃ kartuṃ dīkṣāṃ dadau satī |
bahucarā hiṃgulājā bhuvi tiṣṭhati śāśvatī ||95 ||
brahmā tāṃ bhajamānāṃ ca yato jagrāha naiva tu |
kāraṇaṃ tatra te vacmi śṛṇu lakṣmi purābhavam ||96 ||
brahmā svakamale taptvā śrutvā vyomagirāṃ purā |
sṛṣṭiṃ sarvāṃ samārebhe sasmāra śrīhariṃ punaḥ ||97||
nārāyaṇaṃ dadarśāgre yayāce varadānakam |
tava māyā yathā me na bādheta strīsvarūpiṇī ||98||
tathā cāśīrvaco dehi tataḥ sṛṣṭiṃ karomi vai |
nārāyaṇastathāstvityevāha tatra hi vedhasam ||99||
sṛṣṭiṃ caturyugānāṃ ca yogyāṃ nārīnarātmikām |
kāle yathā yathā yogyāṃ racaya tvaṃ tathā tathā || 1.515.10 0||
kāmaṃ krodhaṃ tathā lobhaṃ mohaṃ ca kapaṭaṃ kvacit |
gṛhṇantaṃ tvāṃ ca nirlepaṃ rakṣayiṣye sṛjiṃ kuru || 10 1||
dharmabhānaṃ sadā te’stu sadā te rāgahīnatā |
mama smṛtiḥ sadā cāstu sadā jīvanpramuktatā || 1 02||
dharmādharmau tavecchaiva tava dehodbhavau sadā |
karmaṇāṃ phaladātā ca bhava tvaṃ mama vāñchayā || 1 03||
akartā kriyamāṇe’pi hyabhoktā bhogasāgare |
nirlepo lepavām̐ścāpi sadā bhavasi padmaja || 1 04||
itihetorhareranugrahād brahmā prajāpatiḥ |
icchayā naiva jagrāha mohinīṃ mohavarjitaḥ || 1 05||
bhaktā bhagavato naiva gṛhṇanti viṣayān kvacit |
harerbhaktiṃ vihāyaiva pāvanīṃ bandhanāśinīm || 1 06||
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi mohinīkṛtamulbaṇam |
śāpasya kāraṇaṃ muktiḥ ṣaṇḍhatvaṃ dīkṣaṇaṃ tathā || 1 07||
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyād bhaktyā paṭhedvā tasya dūṣaṇam |
kāmabhāvakṛtaṃ sarvaṃ naśyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ || 1 08||
nāgavatyāṃ pratāpo’yaṃ nāgalīlāsakhīkṛtaḥ |
pāpānāṃ nāśakaḥ sarvajīvānāṃ tārakastathā || 1 09||
yasyāḥ sasevanāt pānāt snānāttathābhiṣecanāt |
bhuktirmuktirbhavet pūrṇaṃ puruṣārthacatuṣṭayam || 1.515.11 0||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyā prathame kṛtayugasantāne mohinyapsaro brahmāṇaṃ vīkṣya mohitā, brahmaṇā tu na gṛhītā, tataḥ taṃ śaśāpa, brahmā nāgavatīnadyāṃ śuddhaḥ, tyaktadehānnapuṃsakānāmutpattiḥ, bahucarāhiṃgulājādīkṣayā napuṃsakānāṃ mokṣaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcadaśādhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 515 ||

<1.516>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ ramyāṃ vṛkāsurakṛtāṃ śubhām |
purā babhūva ca vṛko daityastepe paraṃ tapaḥ || 1 ||
śatavarṣaṃ tu kedāre kṣetre tuṣṭo harastu tam |
varaṃ dātuṃ yayau nityaṃ na jagrāhāsuro varam || 2 ||
sarvaiśvaryaṃ sarvasiddhiṃ bhuktiṃ muktiṃ hareḥ padam |
daityaḥ kiñcinna gṛhṇāti paritaḥ śūlapāṇinaḥ || 3 ||
śaṃbhuḥ ruroda taṃ dṛṣṭvā premapāśena veṣṭitaḥ |
rodanaśravaṇenāsya dhyānabhaṃgo babhūva ha || 4 ||
dadarśa purataḥ śaṃbhuṃ dātāraṃ sarvasampadām |
varaṃ vavre vṛkastasmānnatvā ca bhaktipūrvakam || 5||
hastaṃ dadhe ca yanmūrdhni sa bhasma bhaviteti ca |
omityuktvā prayāntaṃ taṃ dudrāva daityapuṃgavaḥ || 6 |
papāta ḍamaruḥ śaṃbhorvyāghracarma ca bhūtale |
daityaṃ pṛṣṭhe ca dhāvantaṃ kṛpayā na ca hanti saḥ || 7 ||
duṣṭānusāraṃ sādhuśca na karoti kadācana |
sādhavo ghnanti ghnantaṃ ca bhṛtyaṃ putraṃ priyāṃ vinā || 8 ||
śivo māṃ mama śaraṇaṃ tvāyayau nirahaṃkṛtaḥ |
he hare rakṣa rakṣeti japantaṃ bhayavihvalam || 9 ||
tadā mayā dhṛtaṃ rūpaṃ nāryā daityaśca mohitaḥ |
dāpayitvā nijamūrdhni hastaṃ taṃ daityapuṃgavam || 1.516.1 0||
bhasmībhūtaṃ kṛtavām̐śca śaṃkaro vijvaro’bhavat |
tathāpi śaṃkaro bhakto mama garvānvito’bhavat || 11 ||
sadā viṣṇurmama kāryaṃ karotyeva mahāpadi |
saṃhartāhamiti matvā tripuraṃ hantumudyataḥ || 12||
ko’yaṃ pataṃgavaddaitya iti matvā raṇaṃ yayau |
vihāya śūlaṃ maddattaṃ madīyakavacaṃ tathā || 13||
ciraṃ babhūva samaro varṣamekaṃ divāniśam |
śaṃbhoḥ rathaṃ babhaṃjāpi jahārāstrāṇi śaṃkarāt || 14||
śivaṃ śayānamuttolya pātayāmāsa bhūtale |
tadāhaṃ kalayā śīghraṃ vṛṣarūpaṃ vidhāya ca || 15||
śayānaṃ śaṃkara dhṛtvā viṣāṇābhyāmurukramam |
sa maddattena śūlena jaghāna tripuraṃ haraḥ || 16||
sadyaḥ papāta daityendraścūrṇībhūto hi bhūtale |
tuṣṭuvurdevatāḥ śaṃbhuṃ darpaṃ tatyāja śaṃkaraḥ ||17||
tato’haṃ vṛṣarūpeṇa vahāmi bhaktaśaṃkaram |
mama priyatamo nāsti trailokyeṣu śivātparaḥ || 18||
śṛṇu lakṣmi harasyātra kathāṃ ramyāṃ purābhavām |
yugaṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi tapaḥ kṛtvā maheśvaraḥ || 1 9||
virarāma tataścāgre māṃ dadarśa narāyaṇam |
atīva kamanīyāṃgaṃ kiśoraṃ śyāmasundaram ||1.516.20||
na babhūva vitṛṣṇaśca locanābhyāṃ trilocanaḥ |
paśyannimeṣarahito ruroda premavihvalaḥ || 21 ||
ekenāsyena vai kathaṃ staumi śrīpuruṣottamam |
evaṃ caturdhā manasi kalpayāmāsa mastakam ||22||
pratikalpanaṃ ca śiro nūtanaṃ nūtanaṃ tadā |
babhūva taccaturvaktraṃ pūrveṇa saha pañcamam ||23||
ekaikavaktraṃ śuśubhe locanaiśca tribhistribhiḥ |
babhūva tena śobhāḍhyaḥ pañcavaktrastrilocanaḥ ||24||
stavanādadhikā prītiḥ śivasya mama darśane |
tenādhikāni tasyaivaṃ babhūvurlocanāni vai ||25||
triguṇāni tu netrāṇi saṃhārakaṃ tṛtīyakam |
vibhūtigātraḥ sa vibhuḥ satīsaṃskārabhasmanā ||26||
dhatte tasyāstvasthimālāṃ premabhāvena bhasma ca |
anyeṣāṃ muṇḍamālāṃ ca dhatte saṃhṛtadehinām ||27||
jaṭāṃ tapasyākālīnāṃ dho’dyāpi vivekataḥ |
na cecchā keśasaṃskāre svāṃgaveṣeṇa yoginaḥ ||28||
samatā candane paṃke loṣṭe ratne maṇau dhane |
garuḍadveṣiṇo nāgāḥ śaṃkaraṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ ||29||
bibharti kṛpayā svāṃge tāneva śaraṇāgatān |
vāhanaṃ vṛṣarūpo’hamanyastaṃ voḍhumakṣamaḥ ||1.516.3 0||
pārijātādikaṃ puṣpaṃ sugandhi candanādikam |
mayi sannyasya teṣvevaṃ prītirnāsti kadācana ||3 1 ||
dhattūre tatsadā prītirbilvapatrānulepane |
gandhahīne sugandhe ca yogoṣṭhe vyāghracarmaṇi ||32||
divyaloke divyatalpe janatāyāṃ na tanmanaḥ |
śmaśāne’tīva rahasi dhyāyate māmaharniśam ||33||
jñānaṃ mṛtyuñjayaṃ śūlaṃ dhatte mattejasānvitam |
jalaṃ viṣapraśāntyarthaṃ dhatte śītaṃ divāniśam ||34||
pārvatīṃ ca mayā dattāṃ yoginīṃ kāryasiddhaye |
lokaśikṣaṇadānārthaṃ dhatte patnīṃ pativratām ||35||
śaṃkaraḥ paramātmā me prāṇebhyo’pi paraḥ śivaḥ |
tryambake manmanaḥ śaśvanna priyo me bhavātparaḥ ||36||
na saṃvasāmi goloke vaikuṇṭhe tava vakṣasi |
sadā śivasya hṛdaye nibaddhaḥ premapāśataḥ ||37||
svarasiddhaṃ sutānena pañcavaktraiśca śaṃkaraḥ |
śaśvad gāyati madgāthāṃ tenāhaṃ tatsamīpataḥ ||38||
mama bhaktiṃ ca dāsyaṃ ca muktiṃ ca sarvasampadaḥ |
sarvasiddhīrdātumīśo na dātā śaṃkarāt paraḥ ||39||
pañcavaktraiḥ sa me nāma premṇā gāyatyaharniśam |
madrūpaṃ dhyāyati śaśvanna bhaktaḥ śaṃkarātparaḥ ||1.516.40||
bhaktatvāt svapratāpādvā pātrabhedāt kṣaṇāntarāt |
bhinnarūpakriyāceṣṭā dhatte manvantarāddharaḥ ||41 | |
ahaṃ sudarśanaṃ śaṃbhustejasā ca vayaṃ samāḥ |
brahmā sraṣṭā tu yogena nāsmābhistejasā samaḥ ||42||
sanatkumāro vaikuṇṭhamekadā prajagāma ha |
dadarśa bhuktavantaṃ ca nāthaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ hi mām ||43||
mayā dattaṃ cāvaśeṣaṃ tasmai tuṣṭena cetasā |
prāptamātreṇa tatraiva bhuktaṃ tenaiva kiñcana ||44||
kiṃcid rarakṣa bandhūnāṃ bhakṣaṇārthaṃ ca durlabham |
kiṃcid dattaṃ śaṃkarāya bhuktaṃ sarvaṃ tu śaṃbhunā ||45||
bhaktyudrekāt prāptamātraṃ bhuktvā bhaktyā nanarta saḥ |
pulakāṃkitasarvāṃgaḥ sāśrunetro mudānvitaḥ ||46||
gāyan mama guṇān bhaktyā sukaṇṭhaḥ paṃcavaktrataḥ |
rāgabhedaikatānena tālamānena sundaram ||47||
papāta ḍamarurhastācchṛṅgaṃ ca vyāghracarma ca |
svayaṃ nipatya paścācca rudan mūrchāmavāpa ha ||48||
atīva kamanīyaṃ tadrūpaṃ dhyātvaikamānasaḥ |
sahasradalamadhyasthaṃ māṃ paśyan hṛtsaroruhe ||49||
etasminnantare devī pārvatī parameśvarī |
mudājagāma śīghraṃ taṃ prasannavadanekṣaṇā ||1.516.50||
rudantaṃ mūrchitaṃ dṛṣṭvā nipatitaṃ ca bhaktitaḥ |
prahasya vārtāṃ papraccha pārśvasthaṃ sarpameva sā ||51||
kāmarūpadharaṃ bhaktaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ skandhavāsitam |
sarvaṃ tāṃ kathayāmāsa nāgarāṭ saṃpuṭāñjaliḥ ||52||
nārāyaṇaprasādasyādanena premavihvalaḥ |
īdṛśīṃ susamādheścāvasthāṃ prāpto’sti śaṃkaraḥ ||53||
śrutvā cukopa sā mahyaṃ prasādo nārpitaḥ katham |
śaptaṃ cakre taducchiṣṭamabhakṣyaṃ viduṣāmapi |||54||
uvāca śaṃbhuṃ tvaṃ poṣṭā karoṣi durnayaṃ katham |
sadā te paripālyāhaṃ poṣyā bhaktyā ca kiṃkarī ||55||
vañcitāhaṃ tvayā nātha hareḥ prasādabhakṣaṇe |
pātraṃ hareḥ prasādasya tvaṃ bhaktaḥ prathamaṃ hareḥ ||56||
pātraṃ tava prasādasya pārvatyahaṃ tava priyā |
pātraṃ harerharasyāpi prasādasyāhamīśvarī ||57||
adattvā vañcitā tvadya haranirmālyabhakṣaṇe |
adatvā vañcitā cādya hareḥ prasādabhakṣaṇe |||58||
ato matto gṛhāṇedaṃ phalaṃ vañcanajaṃ śiva |
adya prabhṛti ye lokā naivaidyaṃ bhuñjate tava ||59||
te janmaikaṃ sārameyā bhaviṣyantyeva sarvathā |
ityuktvā pārvatī tatra ruroda purataḥ kṣaṇam ||1.516.60||
śivaḥ kareṇa tannetrajalamārjanamācarat |
kṛtvā vakṣasi sadvākyairbādhayāmāsa sāntvanaiḥ ||61 ||
parituṣṭā tu sā devī bhartāraṃ samuvāca ha |
kalevaraṃ saṃtyakṣyāmi naivedyena vinā hareḥ ||62||
bibharmi dehaṃ satataṃ tava saubhāgyavardhanam |
kathaṃ vahāmi saubhāgyarahitaṃ nu kalevaram ||63||
apūrvaṃ tava naivedyaṃ janmamṛtyujarāharam |
śaptaṃ mayā kṛtaṃ duṣṭaṃ sārameyajanupradam ||64||
yadi bhakṣyāmyahaṃ cāpi sārameyī bhavāmi ca |
na bhakṣyāmi tadā patyuḥ prasādena tu vañcitā ||65||
pātivratyena dharmeṇa hīnā jīvāmi vai katham |
tasmād dehaṃ parityajya yāmi golokameva ca ||66||
pārvatīṃ cetyuktavatīṃ dadau dhairyaṃ haraḥ svayam |
śṛṇu devi kuru pākaṃ naivedyaṃ dehi viṣṇave ||67||
tatprasādamahaṃ bhuktvā tubhyaṃ dāsye sthirā bhava |
liṃgaprasādastvagrāhya iti te’stu vacaḥphalam ||68||
pratimāyāḥ prasādastu grāhyaḥ sarvo bhaviṣyati |
pratimāliṃgamiśro’pi sarvagrāhyo bhaviṣyati ||69||
evaṃ gṛhāṇa me śiṣṭaṃ pātivratye sthitā sadā |
sārameyajanirnaiva tathā kṛte bhaviṣyati ||1.516.70||
liṃgamātraprasādādhikāre caṇḍapracaṇḍakau |
niyuktau tau mayā bhaktau gaṇau mama nirantaram ||71 ||
ityuktā pārvatī kṛtvā pākaṃ śrīharaye dadau |
śaṃkarāya dadau taṃ ca śiṣṭaṃ sā bubhuje satī ||72||
ityevaṃ liṃgaśiṣṭasyāgrāhyatvaṃ kathitaṃ rame |
atha devī mahādevaṃ miṣṭānnaṃ vividhaṃ sadā ||73 ||
mama prasādaṃ nirvartya bhaktyā bhojayati satī |
ṣaṭpaṃcāśatprasaṃkhyāni pakvānnavyañjanāni ca ||74||
nityaṃ mama prasādaṃ taṃ bhojayāmāsa sādaram |
kṛṣṇajanmadine kṛtvā matprasādaṃ vidhāya ca ||75||
bhojayituṃ yadārabdhā vaiṣṇavaḥ śaṃkarastadā |
devīṃ prāha śṛṇu tvadya dharmasaṃkaṭamāgatam ||76||
vratasyeṣṭasya divase bhojanaṃ grāhyameva na |
kṛṣṇaprasādastyājyo na tyāge pāpaṃ śatādhikam ||77||
vadātra kiṃ prakartavyaṃ karomi cenna dūṣaṇam |
pārvatī kṣaṇamātraṃ svahṛdaye’ntarviveśa ha ||78||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ tatra prasasmāra hariḥ svayam |
samāgatyāha deveśī paśya māṃ prati pārvati ||79||
śaṃkaro matsvarūpo’sti nātra bhedo hi vidyate |
matsvarūpeṇa bhuñjīta nātra doṣo bhavettadā ||1.516.80||
bhaktarūpeṇa naivātra vrate bhoktavyameva ha |
matsvarūpeṇa bhoktavyaṃ tatra doṣo na vidyate ||81||
vada tvaṃ śaṃkaraṃ devi bhaktaṃ rūpaṃ vihāya ca |
bhagavadrūpamāsthāya karotu bhojanaṃ haraḥ ||82||
ityuktā sā satī tūrṇaṃ natvā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam |
bahirāgatya kāntaṃ svaṃ yathoktaṃ prāha bhāvataḥ ||83||
bhaktarūpaṃ vihāyātra bhagavadrūpamāpnuhi |
tato bhojanamādhatsva kṛṣṇe vibhau parātmani ||84||
śaṃbhuḥ prāha kathaṃ devi bhaktatvaṃ śāśvataṃ mama |
tyājyaṃ bhaved vadātrārthe tattyāge dūṣaṇaṃ mahat ||85||
abhaktasya jalaṃ cānnaṃ grāhyaṃ paścānna vai bhavet |
abhaktaḥ sarvathā varjyo vaiṣṇavaiśca surādibhiḥ ||86||
pārvatī prāha devāhaṃ tvabalā buddhivarjitā |
tathāpi cātra vādārthe kathayāmi tathā kuru ||87||
yadi cāsmi tava bhaktā nānyabhaktā kadācana |
siddhānnasya susārthakyaṃ bhavedevaṃkṛte kuru ||88||
kṛṣṇaḥ śaṃbhuśca sannyāsītyevaṃ trirūpavān bhava |
kṛṣṇarūpeṇa vai sarvaṃ bhuṃkṣva siddhānnamatra me ||89||
tatprasādasvarūpaṃ tvaṃ bhuṃkṣva sannyāsirūpataḥ |
sādhoḥ sannyāsinaścāpi prasādo me’rthakṛd bhavet ||1.516.90||
tavājñayā grahīṣyāmi na cennaiva spṛśāmyapi |
jalaṃ phalaṃ kusumaṃ cauṣadhaṃ dugdhādiko rasaḥ ||91 ||
gurorvākyaṃ svāmivākyaṃ na vrataghna kadācana |
ityuktaḥ śaṃkarastatra dadhāra pratimātrayam ||92||
kṛṣṇarūpo’nnasarvasvaṃ bubhuje pārvatīkṛtam |
sārūpyena svarūpeṇa bhaktā bhuñjanti dhāmani ||93||
atha sannyāsanaiṣkarmye bhojane’pi na dūṣaṇam |
iti kṛtvā ca bubhuje sannyāsī śaṃkaraḥ svayam ||94||
tatprasādaṃ satī devī sannyāsinīsvarūpiṇī |
śaṃkarasyājñayā bhūtvā bubhuje haribhojanam ||95||
bhaktā pātramārjanādi cakre satīsvarūpiṇī |
tāni rūpāṇi saṃhṛtya pārvatīparameśvarau ||96||
babhuvaturyathāpūrvarūpiṇau bhaktikāriṇau |
ityevaṃ mama bhaktānāṃ lakṣmi bhaktirhi vidyate ||97||
sūkṣmaṃ vai dharmasarvasvaṃ ko nu jānāti taṃ vinā |
śaṃkaraḥ sa tu sannyāsī triloke vyacaranmudā ||98||
mama bhaktiṃ cakārogrāmakārayacca vaiṣṇavān |
kāle kāle tathā bhūtvā bhaktiṃ karoti me śivaḥ ||99||
śivāpi yatinī bhūtvā bhaktiṃ karoti me tathā |
mama jñānāśrayaḥ śaṃbhurācāryaḥ śāstrakṛt tathā || 1.516.1 00||
tārako baddhajīvānāṃ jñānabhaktipradāyakaḥ |
na hyammayāni tīrthāni na devā mṛcchilāmayāḥ || 10 1||
yajñarūpāṇi puṇyāni vratānyanaśanāni ca |
tapāṃsi nānādānāni vipradevārcanāni ca || 1 02||
ciraṃ punanti sarvāṇi darśanādeva sādhavaḥ |
susatāṃ viṣṇubhaktānāṃ rajasāṃ sparśamātrataḥ || 103 ||
pūtānāṃ pādapadmānāṃ sadyaḥ pūtā vasundharā |
tīrthāni ca pavitrāṇi samudrāḥ parvatāstathā || 1 04||
surā darśanamicchanti satāṃ pātakanāśinām |
so’jñānī naiva bubudhe santaṃ manuṣyajanmanā || 1 05||
paramaṃ svādu dugdhaṃ vai na jānāti tathā dadhi |
tathā sadbhyo jāyamānaṃ na jānāti sato janān || 1 06||
svagṛhaṃ naiva jānāti parajñānena vai vṛthā |
sa eva paramo lābho vaiṣṇavānāṃ satāṃ kṛpā || 107||
bhavābdhitaraṇe taryyāṃ tatra santo hi nāvikāḥ |
viprā guravo lokasya santo vipragurūttamāḥ || 108||
sanakādyā mahāsantaḥ sannyāsino’tipāvanāḥ |
śodhayanti bhuvanāni vāsanā dīrghakālajāḥ || 1 09||
evaṃ sa śaṃkaro bhakto bhaktā śivā tathā mama |
sādhusādhvīrūpayuktau prasādārthaṃ babhūvatuḥ || 1.516.11 0||
padmaje mama bhaktānāṃ madarthaṃ kimasādhyakam |
mama lābhārthamevaite sarvaṃ tyajanti rodhakam || 111 ||
iti te kathitaṃ pūrvaṃ punaśca smāritaṃ śubham |
mama dāsyaṃ hare devyāṃ tvayi cāpi parātparam || 11 2||
etasya śravaṇātpāṭhānmananādvartanāttathā |
bhuktirmuktirmama dāsyaṃ sarvaṃ syānnātra saṃśayaḥ || 113 ||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne śaṃkarasya garvaharaṇaṃ, bhaktyudrekatā, paramabhāgavatasarvasvārpaṇadharmavattvaṃ, sannyāsarūpadhāritvaṃ, bhagavatprasādāśitvaṃ, cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣoḍaśādhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 516 ||

<1.517>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi purā tvāsīd hiraṇyakaśipurmahān |
tasya putradvayaṃ jajñe prahlādaścāndhakastathā || 1 ||
hiraṇyakaśipau prāpte paralokaṃ hareḥ karāt |
amātyairabhiṣekāya prahrādaḥ sanniyojitaḥ || 2 ||
kintu naicchat sa rājya tad dānavairdveṣakāraṇāt |
tato’ndhako’bhiṣiktaśca rājye dānavapuṃgavaiḥ || 3 ||
andhako’pi samārādhya brahmāṇaṃ tvamaro’bhavat |
yāvatkalpa varapuṣṭastataḥ śakraṃ jigāya saḥ || 4 ||
amarāvatikāṃ svasya rājadhānīṃ cakāra saḥ |
indraḥ śaṃbhuṃ samārādhya varaṃ vavre surārthakam || 5 ||
andhakena hṛtaṃ sarvaṃ devarājyaṃ makhādikam |
yajñabhāgādikaṃ sarvaṃ rājyaṃ hṛtaṃ prayaccha me || 6 ||
śivastathāstviti prāha preṣayāmāsa taṃ prati |
vīrabhadraṃ nijadūtaṃ sa gatvovāca cāndhakam || 7 ||
harādeśātparityajya svargaṃ gaccha dharātalam |
pitṛpaitāmahaṃ rājyaṃ pṛthivyāṃ tvaṃ samācara || 8 ||
no cet tava padaṃ sarvaṃ śaṃkaraḥ saṃhariṣyati |
andhakastaṃ vīrabhadraṃ samuvāca haraṃ vada || 9 ||
kastvaṃ śmaśānavāso’si gaṇanāyāṃ mamāntike |
kailāsaṃ me samarpya tvama kāśyāṃ gaccha śmaśānake || 1.517.10 ||
no cet prāṇān hariṣyāmi tava sendrasya śaṃkara |
śrutvā vīraprabhadrastaṃ vinirbhartsya yayau haram || 11 ||
kathayāmāsa tadvākyaṃ sannaddhaśca haro’bhavat |
gaṇairdevaistathā cānyaiḥ sainyairyukto’marāvatīm || 1 2||
yayau tāṃ vāhinīṃ dṛṣṭvā tatrasurdaityapuṃgavāḥ |
andhakena tu nidrāyāṃ dṛṣṭaṃ duḥsvapnamulbaṇam || 13 ||
samudvegabhayavyāptaścāhārotsāhavarjitaḥ |
andhakaḥ putramitrādīnāha sarvamariṣṭakam || 1 4||
mayā dṛṣṭo niśīthe’dya duḥsvapno’tibhayapradaḥ |
bibhrato raktapuṣpāṇāṃ mālā ca raktacandanam || 15||
raktāmbaraṃ tīkṣṇakhaṅgaṃ kharparaṃ ca bhayānakam |
prakṛtyāṭṭāṭṭahāsaṃ ca lalajjihvā bhayaṃkarī || 1 6||
atīva vṛddhā kṛṣṇāṃgī nārī pure’tra nṛtyati |
muktakeśī chinnanāsā kṛṣṇā kṛṣṇāmbarānvitā || 1 7||
vidhavā sā mahāśūdrā mamāliṃganakāmukī |
malinaṃ celakhaṇḍaṃ ca bibhratī rūkṣamūrdhajān || 18||
dadhatī cūrṇatilakaṃ kapole mama vakṣasi |
hasitvā krūratāṃ darśayitvā cumbati māṃ muhuḥ || 19 ||
kṛṣṇavarṇāni pakvāni chinnabhinnāni sarvaśaḥ |
patanti kṛtvā śabdāṃśca śaśvattālaphalāni hi || 1.517.20 ||
kucailo vikṛtākāro mleccho hi rūkṣamūrdhajaḥ |
dadāti mahyaṃ bhūṣāyāṃ chinnabhinnakapardakān ||2 1||
mahāruṣṭā ca divyā strī patiputravatī satī |
babhaṃja pūrṇakuṃbhaṃ ca sābhiśapya punaḥ punaḥ ||22||
amlānāṃ muṇḍamālāṃ ca raktacandanacarcitām |
dadāti mahyaṃ vipraśca mahāruṣṭo’tiśapya vai ||23||
kṣaṇamaṃgāravṛṣṭiśca bhasmavṛṣṭiḥ kṣaṇaṃ kṣaṇam |
kṣaṇaṃ kṣaṇaṃ raktavṛṣṭirjāyate nagare mama |||24||
vānaraṃ vāyasaṃ śvānaṃ bhallūkaṃ sūkaraṃ kharam |
paśyāmi vikaṭākāraṃ śabdaṃ kurvantamulbaṇam ||25||
paśyāmi śuṣkakāṣṭhānāṃ rāśimamlānakajjalam |
aruṇodayavelāyāṃ kapīṃśchinnanakhāni ca |||26||
pītavastraparīdhānā śuklacandanacarcitā |
bibhratī mālatīmālāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitā |||27||
krīḍākamalahastā ca sindūrabinduśobhitā |
kṛtvābhiśāpaṃ māṃ ruṣṭā yāti manmandirāt satī ||28||
pāśahastām̐śca puruṣān muktakeśān bhayaṃkarān |
atirūkṣām̐śca paśyāmi viśato nagaraṃ mama ||29||
nagnanārīṃ muktakeśīṃ nṛtyantīṃ ca gṛhe gṛhe |
atīva vikṛtākārāṃ paśyāmi sasmitāṃ sadā ||1.517.30||
chinnanāsā ca vidhavā mahāśūdrī digambarā |
sā tailābhyaṃgitaṃ māṃ ca karotyatibhayaṃkarī || 31 ||
nirvāṇāṃgārayuktāśca bhasmapūrṇā digambarāḥ |
atiprabhātasamaye citrāḥ paśyāmi sasmitāḥ ||3 2||
paśyāmi ca vivāhaṃ ca nṛtyagītamanoharam |
raktavastraparīdhānānpuruṣān raktamūrdhajān ||33||
raktaṃ vamantaṃ puruṣaṃ nṛtyantaṃ nagnamulbaṇam |
dhāvantaṃ ca śayānaṃ ca paśyāmi sasmitaṃ tathā ||34||
rāhugrastaṃ ca gagane maṇḍalaṃ candrasūryayoḥ |
ekakāle prapaśyāmi sarvagrāsaṃ ca tāmasam ||35||
ulkāpātaṃ dhūmaketuṃ bhūkampaṃ rāṣṭraviplavam |
jhañjhāvātaṃ mahotpātaṃ paśyāmi ca kṣitiāsthitaḥ ||36||
vāyunā ghūrṇyamānām̐śca chinnaskandhānmahāruhān |
patitān parvatāṃścaiva paśyāmi pṛthivītale ||37||
puruṣaṃ chinnaśirasaṃ nṛtyantaṃ nagnamucchritam |
muṇḍamālākaraṃ ghoraṃ paśyāmi ca gṛhe gṛhe ||38||
dagdhaṃ sarvāśramaṃ bhasmapūrṇamaṅgārasaṃkulam |
hāhākāraṃ prakurvantaṃ sarvaṃ paśyāmi sarvataḥ ||39||
snātuṃ gacchāmi ca nadīṃ sā tu śuṣkāyate kṣaṇāt |
mūrtayo devatānāṃ ca dṛṣṭā vilīnatāṃ gatāḥ ||1.517.40||
gardabhaṃ ghoṭakaṃ gantrīyutaṃ yāntaṃ ca dakṣiṇām |
gantryāṃ sthitaṃ ca māṃ tatra prapaśyāmi ciraṃ muhuḥ ||41 ||
anyatra gamanaṃ me vai bhāti lokāntaraṃ prati |
mayaiva ca vivāho’pi mayā dṛṣṭo hi yoṣitā ||42||
gāgreśamastakaṃ skandhādviyuktaṃ dagdhamityapi |
nadyāṃ mayeti sandṛṣṭaṃ kṣaṇājjāgaruko’bhavam ||43||
uṣṭro bhūphalinīrbhuktvā māṃ pratyetīti vīkṣitam |
siddhānnāni vīkṣitāni na ca bhuktāni vai mayā ||44||
svapne cātīva kalahaḥ parasparaṃ pravīkṣitaḥ |
svasyaiva muṇḍanaṃ svapne kāritaṃ ca mayā muhuḥ || 45||
haritadrumaśākhānāṃ bhaṃgā vilokitā mayā |
samudre brūḍati kaścinmama bandhurvilokitaḥ ||46||
kasyacilliṃgato raktaṃ niḥsṛtaṃ vīkṣitaṃ mayā |
brāhmaṇastvatiruṣṭaśca śapatītyavalokitam || 47||
jīrṇāmbaraṃ dhṛtaṃ dehe naṣṭaṃ tatpatitaṃ tathā |
kukkurā māṃ vilokyaiva bhaṣantītyavalokitam ||48||
śuṣkakāṣṭhāni ca mayā dvedhīkṛtāni hastataḥ |
nikṛntane yantreṇa vellaṇārthaṃ vilokitam ||49||
phaṇāphullo mahāsarpo dṛṣṭaścāpi mṛto’pi saḥ |
vyomasetorbālakaścākūrdayat patituṃ jale ||1.517.50||
jalaṃ vihāya ca dūraṃ pāṣāṇe patito bhramāt |
anyasya bhavane dṛṣṭaṃ goṣṭhaṃ riktaṃ vivartitam ||51 ||
āraṇyakaśca mārjāro vilokito mayā vane |
kṛṣṇāmbaro jano māṃ dhūṣkṛtīyantreṇa vai sukṛt ||52||
alakṣayad yathā hantuṃ kṛtvā māṃ vai pradakṣiṇam |
mayā riktā dhūṣkṛtī sā sphoṭitā taṃ janaṃ prati ||53 ||
gauḥ savatsā bahiryāti rātrau mamāśramāt tathā |
bhavanasya dhvajaścāpi patitaścāvalokitaḥ |||54||
satkāryārthaṃ ca kośasya kuñcikā naiva vīkṣitā |
āśīrvādaparā viprā māṃ vihāyānyato gatāḥ ||55||
evaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ mayā svapne sarvamadya niśātyaye |
na jāne kiṃ daivayogād viparītaṃ bhavediti ||56||
śuśoceti varṇayitvāndhakastāvacca tatpriyā |
patnī rātrau ca duḥsvapnaṃ yad dadarśa jagāda tat ||57||
śṛṇu rājan mamāpyadyārīṣṭāni hi niśātyaye |
upasthitāni nidrāyāṃ taiśca bhayaṃ vrajāmi vai ||58||
aho svāminnihāgaccha tvāṃ karomi svavakṣasi |
pariṇāme vidhātā me na jāne kiṃ kariṣyati |||59||
ratnasiṃhāsane’haṃ ca ratnacchatraṃ ca bibhratī |
tadātapatraṃ jagrāha ruṣṭo viprastu me prabho ||1.517.60||
sāgare kajjalākāre mahāghore ca dustare |
gabhīre prerayāmāsa māmeva durbalāṃ sa ca |||61 ||
tatra srotasi śokārtā bhramāmi ca muhurmuhuḥ |
mahaurmīṇāṃ ca vegena vyākulā nakrasaṃkulaiḥ ||62||
trāhi trāhīti he nātha tvāṃ vadāmi mṛtaṃ patim |
tvāṃ na dṛṣṭvā mahābhītā karomi bahurodanam ||63||
nātha tatra nimajantī paśyāmi candramaṇḍalam |
nipatantaṃ ca gaganācchatakhaṇḍaṃ ca bhūtale ||64||
kṣaṇāntare śatakhaṇḍaṃ sūryaṃ paśyāmi bhūtale |
ekakāle dvayorgrāhaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ cākāśamaṇḍalam ||65||
kṣaṇāntare prapaśyāmi brāhmaṇo dīptimāniti |
matkroḍasthasudhākuṃbhaṃ babhañja praruṣeti ca ||66||
kṣaṇāntare prapaśyāmi mahāruṣaṃ ca bhūsuram |
gṛhītvā saṃvrajantaṃ ca sannidhau vai patiṃ mama ||67||
krīḍākapāladaṇḍaṃ ca hastāddhastaṃ mama prabho |
sahasā khaṇḍakhaṇḍaṃ ca babhūva saha hetunā ||68||
hastāddhastaṃ ca sahasā darpaṇo valayastathā |
nirmalaḥ kajjalākāraḥ khaṇḍakhaṇḍo babhūva ha ||69||
hāro me ratnasārāṇāṃ chinno bhūtvā ca vakṣasaḥ |
atīva malinaṃ padmaṃ papāta dharaṇisthale ||1.517.70||
saudhaputtalikāḥ sarvā nṛtyanti ca hasanti ca |
āsphoṭayanti gāyanti rudanti ca kṣaṇe kṣaṇe ||71||
kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ bṛhacchastraṃ triśūlaṃ khe samāgatam |
nipatantaṃ bhramantaṃ cotpatantaṃ tvavalokaye ||72||
prāṇādhidevaḥ puruṣo niḥsṛtyābhyantarānmama |
priye vidāyaṃ dehīti tato yāmītyuvāca mām ||73||
kṛṣṇavarṇā ca pratimā māmāśliṣyati cumbati |
kṛṣṇavastraparīdhānā svapne paśyāmi sāmpratam ||74||
itīdaṃ viparītaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā vai prāṇavallabha |
nṛtyanti dakṣiṇāṃgāni prāṇā āndolayanti me ||75||
rudanti śokāt karṣanti samudvignaṃ ca mānasam |
tava vāmāṃgakampaṃ ca lokayāmi punaḥ punaḥ ||76||
kimidaṃ kimidaṃ nātha viparītaṃ bhaviṣyati |
ityuktvā taṃ samāśliṣya kṣaṇaṃ sukhaṃ lalābha ha ||77||
andhakastāṃ samāśliṣya dadau dhairyaṃ punaḥ punaḥ |
premṇā tvākṛṣya tanvaṃgīṃ parirebhe cucumba ca ||78||
etasminneva samaye mahendrasya śubhāni vai |
susvapnānyabhavam̐stena tutoṣa hṛṣṭamānasaḥ ||79||
dadarśa prathamaṃ viprabālakaṃ padmalocanam |
bhūṣitaṃ sasmitaṃ puṣpamālācandanarājitam ||1.517.80||
baddhaśikhaṃ satilakaṃ japantaṃ vedamātaram |
tato dadarśa rucirāṃ patiputravatīṃ satīm ||8 1||
svarṇavastraparīdhānāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām |
jvalatpradīpahastāṃ ca śukladhānyakarāṃ varām ||82||
śaraccandranibhāsyāṃ ca sasmitāṃ varadāṃ śubhām |
tato dadarśa vipraṃ ca prakurvantaṃ śubhāśiṣam ||83 ||
śvetapadmaṃ rājahaṃsaṃ turagaṃ ca sarovaram |
dadarśa citritaṃ cāru phalitaṃ puṣpitaṃ śubham ||84||
āmranimbanārikelāgurvarkakadalītarum |
daśantaṃ śvetasarpa ca svātmānaṃ parvatasthitam ||85||
vṛkṣasthaṃ ca gajasthaṃ ca tarīsthaṃ turagasthitam |
vīṇāṃ pravādayantaṃ ca bhuñjānaṃ miṣṭapāyasam ||86||
dadhikṣīrayutānnaṃ ca padmapatrasthamīpsitam |
kṛmiviṭsahitāṃgaṃ ca śuklacandanacarcitam ||87||
śukladhānyapuṣpahastaṃ prāsādasthaṃ samudragam |
tato dadarśa rajataṃ maṇiṃ śubhraṃ ca kāñcanam ||88||
muktāmāṇikyaratnaṃ ca pūrṇakuṃbhajalaṃ śubham |
surabhiṃ sahavatsāṃ ca vṛṣabhendraṃ mayūrakam ||89||
śukaṃ ca sārasaṃ haṃsaṃ cillaṃ khañjanamityapi |
tāmbūlaṃ puṣpamālyaṃ ca jvaladagniṃ surārcanam ||1.517.90 ||
pārvatīpratimāṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya sannidhau |
śāṃkaraṃ cojjvalaṃ liṃgaṃ guruṃ devaṃ bṛhaspatim ||91 ||
viprabālāṃ suphalitāṃ kṛṣiṃ pakvaphalānvitām |
devasthalīṃ ca rājendraṃ siṃhaṃ vyāghraṃ gajaṃ munim ||92||
dṛṣṭvā svapnaṃ samuttasthau cakārāhnikamīpsitam |
śaṃkaraṃ kathayāmāsa sarvaṃ vṛttāntameva tam ||93||
śaṃkaro’pi tadā prāha mahendraṃ śakunāni vai |
yāni dadarśa mārge sa maṃgalārhāṇi sarvathā ||94||
jayapradāni sarvāṇi maṃgalāsūcakāni vai |
vāme vipraṃ śivāṃ pūrṇakuṃbhaṃ nakulacāṣakam ||95||
patiputravatīṃ sādhvīṃ divyābharaṇabhūṣitām |
śuklapuṣpaṃ ca mālyaṃ ca dhānyaṃ ca khañjanaṃ śubham ||96||
dakṣiṇe jvaladagniṃ ca vipraṃ ca vṛṣabhaṃ gajam |
vatsaprayuktāṃ dhenuṃ ca śvetāśvaṃ rājahaṃsakam ||97||
veśyāṃ ca puṣpamālāṃ ca patākāṃ dadhi pāyasam |
maṇiṃ suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ muktāmāṇikyamīpsitam ||98||
madyaṃ māṃsaṃ candanaṃ ca mādhvīkaṃ ghṛtamuttamam |
kṛṣṇasāraṃ phalaṃ lājāṃ siddhānnaṃ darpaṇaṃ tathā ||99||
vicitritaṃ vimānaṃ ca sudīptāṃ pratimāṃ tathā |
śuklotpalaṃ padmavanaṃ śaṃkhacillaṃ ca korakam || 1.517.10 0||
mārjāraṃ parvataṃ meghaṃ mayūraṃ śukasārasam |
śaṃkhakokilavādyānāṃ dhvaniṃ śuśrāva maṅgalam || 101 ||
vicitrakṛṣṇasaṃgītaṃ hariśabdaṃ jayadhvanim |
evaṃbhūtaṃ śubhaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ kathayāmāsa sarvathā || 1 02||
tāvad bheryo hyavādyanta śaṃkhāḥ śaṃkarasainyake |
andhakaścāpi vijñāya sasainyaḥ samaraṃ yayau || 1 03||
prathamaṃ militā nagnā vidhavā khaṇḍavastrikā |
malinā vikṛtākārā chinnanāsordhvamūrdhajā || 1 04||
gardabho mahiṣaścoṣṭraḥ sūkaraḥ śvā ca bhallukaḥ |
kāko gṛdhro vānaraśca kaṃkaḥ śuṣkatṛṇāni ca || 1 05||
kulālastailakāraśca nāpito rajakastathā |
dagdhakāṣṭhaṃ galatkuṣṭho vṛṣalo kalahadvijaḥ || 1 06||
ruṣṭabhikṣuḥ pramuṇḍā ca pramuṇḍī kṛpaṇastathā |
kṣutkāraḥ śastrapatanaṃ rathātmukuṭapātanam || 1 07||
dhvajadarpaṇapatanaṃ tvaśvānāṃ jānubhugnatā |
riktaṃ kalaśayugalaṃ kṛṣṇasarpo bhayaṃkaraḥ || 1 08||
ghūkasya darśanaṃ ceti samīpe mīlitāni vai |
mṛtyusūcakavastūni vīkṣitānyandhakena vai || 10 9||
pavanaścātivegena sammukhaṃ vāti duḥkhakṛt |
yantrīcakraṃ prabhagnaṃ ca hastiḥ pramattatāṃ gataḥ || 1.517.11 0||
viditvaivaṃ raṇe trasto bahirdhairyāvalambanaḥ |
uparyāḍambarayukto mṛtyuniścitamānasaḥ || 111 ||
andhakaḥ koṭisainyena harāntikamupāyayau |
dadarśa devasainyāni bhuvi vyomni jale’pi ca || 1 12||
dānavānāṃ ca sainyāni sannaddhāni pratikramāt |
yuddhāraṃbhasya vādyāni tvavādyantāsurādiṣu || 113 ||
yuddhabodhakacihnātmadhvajā vyomni cakāśire
daityaḥ saśaṃkaraṃ natvā mumoca śatasāyakān || 1 14||
śaṃkarastānardhacandraiśchitvā mumoca mārgaṇān |
śilīmukhān śatasaṃkhyān daityastān pracakarta ha || 1 15||
evaṃ samabhavad yuddhaṃ devānāṃ dānavaiḥ saha |
gaṇaiśca vikṛtākārairdānavānāṃ bhayaṃkaram || 1 16||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne’ndhakāsurasya tatpatnyāśca duṣṭasvapnādyapaśakunāni, indrasya suśakunāni, śaṃkareṇa sahāndhakasya yuddhaṃ ceti nirūpaṇanāmā saptadaśādhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||517||

<1.518>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi tadā yuddhe senayorubhayorapi |
dāruṇaścāprameyaśca saṃgrāmo jīvadakṣiṇaḥ || 1 ||
bhayaṃkaro’bhavad vyomni pṛthvyāṃ jale’pi sarvaśaḥ |
etasminnantare tatra bhadrākhyastu mahābalaḥ || 2 ||
andhakasya mahāsenāpatirbalī mahārathī |
nirbhartsya śaṃkaraṃ kārtikeyaṃ gaṇādhipaṃ tathā || 3 ||
cikṣepa śrīgaṇeśe vai bāṇaṃ pralayavahnibham |
tadbāṇaṃ tvardhacandreṇa saṃciccheda gaṇādhipaḥ || 4 ||
bhadraścikṣepa sūryābhāṃ śaktiṃ skandaṃ prati krudhā |
kārtikeyastu tāṃ vaiṣṇavāstreṇa vyahanat tadā || 5 ||
bhadraścikṣepa tu nārāyaṇāstraṃ raṇamūrdhani |
praṇamya kārtikeyastu śete pṛthivīmāśritaḥ || 6 ||
ūrdhvamastraṃ tu babhrāma śatasūryasamaprabham |
pralīnamastramākāśe viśvasaṃhārakārakam || 7 ||
astre gate kārtikeyo gṛhītvā svagadāṃ dṛḍhām |
bhadrarathaṃ prababhañja jaghānāśvām̐śca sārathim || 8 ||
andhakasya tu senāpastadā dudrāva kārtikam |
bhadraṃ taṃ kārtikeyastu śaktyā jaghāna vai krudhā || 9 ||
dvedhā vibhidya patito mamāra sa raṇāṃgaṇe |
hate bhadre’ndhakaputro dhūmro mahāparākramaḥ || 1.518.1 0||
bāṇānāṃ śatakaṃ skande cikṣepa raṇamūrdhani |
kārtikeyo’gnibāṇena bāṇaughān pradadāha ca || 11 ||
dhūmraścikṣepa brahmāstraṃ sṛṣṭisaṃhārakārakam |
dṛṣṭvā śaṃbhvātmajaḥ śīghraṃ sabījaṃ mantrapūrvakam || 1 2||
brahmāstreṇaiva sahasā sañjahārāvalīlayā |
dhūmraḥ śilīmukhairbāṇairjaghāna kārtikaṃ muhuḥ || 1 3||
kārtikeyastu tad dṛṣṭvā dhanurbāṇaughasaṃyutam |
mumoca jṛmbhaṇaṃ yuddhe śīghraṃ taṃ ca mahāratham || 14||
jaḍo babhūva dhūmrastu niśceṣṭo raṇamūrdhani |
punaścikṣepa nidrāstraṃ dhūmraśca nidrito’bhavat || 15||
tāvadvai tvandhakastaṃ ca bodhāstreṇāprabodhayat |
skandastu śatabāṇaistaṃ jaghānāsuramandhakam || 16||
andhako’pi kārtikaṃ ca triśūlena jaghāna ha |
gadayā kārtikarathaṃ babhañja ratnanirmitam || 17||
gadayā kārtikaḥ kruddho babhaṃjāndhakavāhanam |
andhakaścārdhacandreṇa kṣuradhāreṇa līlayā || 18||
ciccheda kārtikadhanurbhallāstreṇa niyojitam |
kārtiko gadayā gatvāndhakaṃ pṛṣṭhe jaghāna ha || 19||
andhakaḥ patito mūrchāṃ jagāmātha kṣaṇāntare |
vīrabhadro gaṇeśaśca kārtiko bhairavāstathā ||1.518.20||
kālyaśca raṇacaṇḍyaśca yuyudhurdānavaiḥ saha |
dānavāstu śaṃkukarṇo māhiṣākṣo vṛkānanaḥ || 21 ||
vindhyahanuryamaskandho vṛṣaśṛṃgo guhānanaḥ |
krūrakramo vivarākṣo yuyudhuste suraiḥ saha ||22||
śaṃkarastu tadā śūlaṃ gṛhītvā cāndhakāsuram |
hantuṃ cakāra yatnaṃ ca mahāśaṃkhaṃ hyavādayat ||23||
rathamadhye svayaṃ śaṃbhuḥ sthitaḥ saṃhārakārakaḥ |
mahārathānāṃ lakṣaiśca rathānāṃ ca trikoṭibhiḥ ||24||
trikoṭibhirgajendrāṇāṃ mallānāṃ ca trikoṭibhiḥ |
śatakoṭibhiraśvānāṃ carmiṇāṃ taccaturguṇaiḥ ||25 ||
khaḍgināṃ tatsaptaguṇairdviguṇaistaddhanuṣmatām |
aṣṭau cāpi diśāṃpālā bhairavā devakoṭayaḥ ||26 ||
sānnāhikā yuyudhuśca dānavaiḥ śatakoṭibhiḥ |
unmattabhairavaścāpi saṃhārabhairavastathā ||27||
asitāṃgo bhairavaśca rurubhairava ityapi |
mahābhairavasaṃjñaśca kālabhairava ityatha ||28||
pracaṇḍabhairavaścāpi krodhabhairava ulbaṇaḥ |
śaktibhiḥ sahitāḥ sarve yuyudhire raṇāṃgaṇe ||29||
ugracaṇḍā pracaṇḍā ca caṇḍikā caṇḍināyikā |
caṇḍeśvarī ca cāmuṇḍā caṇḍī caṇḍakapālikā ||1.518.3 0||
koṭaryādyāstathā cānyā yuyudhire raṇāṃgaṇe |
candrāṇī vaiṣṇavī śāntā brahmāṇī brahmavādinī ||3 1 ||
kaumārī nārasiṃhī ca vārāhī vikaṭākṛtiḥ |
māheśvarī mahāmāyā bhairavī bhīmarūpiṇī ||32||
rathasthāstāstadā sarvā yuyudhire’suraiḥ saha |
rākṣasyaḥ parvataprāyā yuddhaṃ cakruśca koṭiśaḥ ||33||
andhakaḥ śaṃkaraṃ hantuṃ divyāstreṇa niyojitam |
dhanurdadhāra saguṇaṃ cikṣepa ca śaraṃ hare ||34||
aṃjanaṃ nāma divyāstraṃ grīṣmamārtaṇḍasannibham |
hariścikṣepa dhāvalyaṃ divyāstraṃ candrasannibham ||35 ||
vahniṃ cikṣepāndhakaśca harastaṃ vāruṇena vai |
prajvalantaṃ tālamānaṃ nirvāṇaṃ pracakāra saḥ ||36||
vāyuṃ cikṣepāndhakaśca cikṣepa pārvataṃ haraḥ |
nārāyaṇāstraṃ cikṣepa hyandhako raṇamūrdhani ||37||
śaṃbhurbhārgavasaṃśreṣṭho nārāyaṇaṃ nanāma tam |
cikṣepa cāndhako nāgamastraṃ śrīśaṃkaropari ||38||
śaṃkaro garuḍenaiva saṃjahāra kṣaṇena vai |
andhakastvardhacandraṃ ca cikṣepa śaṃkaropari ||3 9||
śaṃbhurgadāṃ pracikṣepāndhakaṃ prati bhayānakām |
andhakasya rathaścūrṇo babhūva sārathistathā ||1.518.40||
indro vajraṃ pracikṣepāndhakaṃ bhasmakaraṃ tadā |
andhakena mukhe grastaṃ vidyudrūpaṃ jalaṃ yathā ||41||
andhakaśca tadā pracikṣependraṃ hantumeva ca |
brahmāstraṃ śaṃkarastacca brahmāstreṇa nyavārayat ||582||
andhakastu tadā śaṃbhuṃ hantuṃ khaḍgena vegataḥ |
dudrāvābhimukhaḥ sainye hāhākāro’bhavattadā ||43||
martukāmo maheśasya sannidhau yajjagāma ha |
śaṃkaraṃ sa jaṭāyāṃ vai jaghānātibalena tu ||44||
jaṭā dvedhābhavat tūrṇaṃ khaḍgo dvedhābhavattathā |
vīrabhadreṇa ca gadā tāḍitā gadayā saha ||45||
andhako bhūtale tvardhaḥ praviṣṭo vivare tadā ||46||
vīrabhadradhṛtāṃ lauhīṃ gadāmāśliṣya cāndhakaḥ |
ākṛṣṭayā tu gadayā sahaiva niryayau talāt ||47||
viyuktaḥ san haraṃ hantuṃ śaktiṃ jagrāha cāyasīm |
śaṃbhustriśūlamādāya cikṣepāsuravakṣasi ||48||
sa viddho’pi svayaṃ tena triśūlena mahāsuraḥ |
brahmaṇo varamāhātmyānna ca prāṇairviyujyate ||49 ||
tasya tapaḥphalaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ rakṣatyeva punaḥ punaḥ |
śatavarṣaṃ phalāhāraḥ śatavarṣaṃ dalādanaḥ |||1.518.5 0||
śatavarṣaṃ mūlabhakṣī śatavarṣaṃ sumādanaḥ |
śatavarṣaṃ kandabhakṣī śatavarṣamayācitaḥ ||51 ||
śatavarṣaṃ jalāhāraḥ śatavarṣaṃ tu bāṣpapaḥ |
śatavarṣaṃ vāyubhakṣī śatavarṣaṃ tvabhojanaḥ |||52||
tato varṣasahasraṃ vai jalāntavartisaṃsthitaḥ |
tasya vai tapasā jātānalena vāriśuṣkatā ||5 3 ||
jātā tatra tu pṛthivī samadṛśyata lāvaṇī |
tatra varṣasahasraṃ tu tṛtīyaṃ vyagamattadā ||54||
valmīkaḥ sumahān jāto vaṃśastambābhyadhiṣṭhitaḥ |
prasanno viśvasṛṭ tasmai varaṃ vṛṇu samāha ca ||55||
sa ca vavre tava hastānna me śaṃkarahastataḥ |
na vā viṣṇoḥ karādvāpi devībhyo devatādibhiḥ ||56||
tava sṛṣṭau bhavenmṛtyuściraṃjīvo bhavāmi ca |
anenaiva tu dehena divyatāṃ pravrajāmi ca ||57||
itiśrutvāha vedhāstaṃ tathāstviti tathā bhava |
ityevaṃ varadānena divyakāyo mahāsuraḥ ||58||
nāyaṃ nāśamavāpnoti punarutthāya vai balī |
jaghāna ca samākruddho viśeṣeṇa bahūn gaṇān ||59||
śaṃkaraṃ tāḍayāmāsa gadāpātairmuhurmuhuḥ |
evaṃ yuddhaṃ samabhavacciraṃ svarge pinākinā ||1.518.6 0||
triśūlabhinno daityaḥ sa yadā mṛtyuṃ na gacchati |
utthāyotthāya kruddhastu prahāreṇārdayadbalī ||6 1 ||
śaṃkarastaṃ suvimṛśya mṛtyunā parivarjitam |
tato nirbhidya śūlāgre protkṣipya gaganāṃgaṇe ||62||
chatravad dhārayāmāsa lambamānamadhomukham |
kṣarantaṃ rudhiraṃ bhūmau gātrebhyo varṣmasaṃbhavam ||63 ||
ciraṃ taṃ sthāpayāmāsa tathaiva śūladhārayā |
tataḥ kālena yuddhena carmāsthisnāyumātrakaḥ ||64||
dhātutrayayutaścāyaṃ naṣṭadhātucatuṣṭayaḥ |
ato’ndhako balahīnaḥ stutiṃ cakāra dīnavat ||65||
na tvaṃ devo mayā jñāto vāgduṣṭena durātmanā |
īdṛgvīryasamopetastasmād yuktaṃ bhavatkṛtam ||66||
anurūpaṃ madāndhasya vivekarahitasya ca |
durvinītaḥ śriyaṃ prāpya vidyāmaiśvaryamityapi || 67||
na tiṣṭhati ciraṃ kālaṃ yathāhaṃ madagarvitaḥ |
pāpo’haṃ pāpakarmāhaṃ pāpātmā pāpasaṃbhavaḥ ||68||
trāhi māṃ deva īśāna sarvapāpāni kṣālaya |
duḥkhito’haṃ varāko’haṃ dīno’haṃ śaktivarjitaḥ ||69||
trātumarhasi māṃ deva prapannaṃ śaraṇe sthitam |
sarvapāpakṣaṇe śaṃbho tvayi sañjāyate matiḥ ||1.518.70||
nāmamātraṃ tava kṛtvā muktimāpnoti pāpakṛt |
tava pūjāvihīnānāṃ divasā vandhyatānvitāḥ ||71 ||
tasmād bhaktaṃ tava rūpaṃ jānantaṃ mocayātra mām |
svagaṇaṃ kuru divyaṃ vai dehenānena nānyathā ||72||
gato me dānavo bhāvastyaktaṃ rājyaṃ tathā prabho |
tyaktāḥ putrāḥ praputrāśca vibhavāśca mayādya vai ||73||
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā daityaṃ vigatakalmaṣam |
uttārya śanakaiḥ śūlācchaṃbhurvinayasaṃśritam ||74||
tasya nāma tadā cakre bhṛṃgirīṭiriti prabhuḥ |
abravīcca sadā me tvaṃ vallabhaḥ saṃbhaviṣyasi ||75||
tiṣṭha saumyatayā sarvagaṇeṣu mama cāśritaḥ |
ityevaṃ jalasaṃskārāt kṛtvā taṃ navavigraham ||76||
nināya śaṃbhuḥ kailāsaṃ devādyāḥ svagṛhaṃ yayuḥ |
svargarājyaṃ yathāyogyaṃ prāptavantaḥ punaḥ svakam ||77||
atha duṣṭaḥ sutastasyāndhakasya dānaveśvaraḥ |
vṛko nāma mahākrūraḥ praviveśābdhivāriṣu ||78||
indro yayau purīṃ ramyāmamarāvatīsaṃjñikām |
yajñabhāgān punarlebhire sudevā dharātale ||79||
vṛko varṣasahasrāṇi tapastepe padā sthitaḥ |
aṃguṣṭhamātrasaṃsthānaḥ pañcasāhasravatsare ||1.518.80||
brahmaṇo varadānaṃ ca jarāmaraṇavarjitam |
lebhe tato yayāvadriṃ saurāṣṭre revatācalam ||81 ||
tataḥ svargaṃ yayāvindrapadaṃ jigāya vai sthitaḥ |
śukrātprāpyābhiṣekaṃ ca svayamindro babhūva ha ||82||
tena yajñādayaḥ sarve devakāryāṇi yānyapi |
japahomādayaḥ pitṛkāryāṇi viprapūjanam ||83||
sarvaṃ vināśitaṃ svasya kṛtaṃ karādikaṃ tathā |
sva eva yajñabhāgānāṃ bhoktā nānyaḥ kadācana ||84||
yajanādividhātā ca daṇḍya eva na saṃśayaḥ |
ityevaṃ śāsanaṃ cakre dharmakarmavirodhi saḥ ||85||
sāṃkṛtiṃ tapasāṃ pūrṇaśevadhiṃ sa vṛkāsuraḥ |
gatvā jaghāna taṃ tatra śastrāṇi naiva sarvathā ||86||
pasparśustasya khaḍgaśca śatadhā khaṇḍaśo’bhavat |
sāṃkṛtistaṃ śaśāpātha śīghraṃ nāśo’stu te’sura ||87||
śaṃkaraśca jaghānainaṃ vṛkaṃ tat kathitaṃ ca te |
lakṣmi kathāprasaṃgena śṛṇu cānyatkathānakam ||88||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasahitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne’ndhakāsuro yuddhe śaṃkareṇa svatriśūle ropito bhṛṃgirīṭigaṇaḥ kṛtaḥ, vṛkastatputro’pi śaṃkareṇa sūdita ityādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭādaśādhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||518||

<1.519>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi ca rājāno devā daityastathāpare |
māyāmohaṃ samālabhya ramante prāṇadevane || 1 ||
gantavyaṃ tvasti sarveṣāṃ pañcatve pañcavarjitaḥ |
svayaṃ tvanyatra pañcatve pañcaikatvaṃ prayāti ca || 2 ||
nahi māyā gatā kaiścidātmabhiḥ saha naśvarī |
arbudārbudavarṣāyurjīvibhirapi karhicit || 3 ||
śṛṇu rājā purā tvāsīdindradyumna iti śrutaḥ |
brahmaṇyaśca śaraṇyaśca sādhulokaprapālakaḥ || 4 ||
yajvā dānapatirdakṣaḥ sarvabhūtahite rataḥ |
na durbhikṣaṃ na ca vyādhirna ca caurakṛtaṃ bhayam || 5 ||
na nyūnatā prajāyāṃ vai bhogyadravyasya kasyacit |
asaṃkhyātāḥ kratavaśca kṛtāḥ sampūrṇadakṣiṇāḥ || 6 ||
agniṣṭomo’tirātraśca ukthaḥ ṣoḍaśikastathā |
sautrāmaṇyatha paśujaścāturmāsyaṃ vratakratuḥ || 7 ||
vājapeyo’śvamedhaśca rājasūyaśca somapaḥ |
puṇḍarīkaśca putreṣṭiḥ sasyeṣṭiḥ rudravaiṣṇavau || 8 ||
kārīrirvaiśvadevaścetyādyān yajñāṃścakāra saḥ |
na tadasti dharāpṛṣṭhe nagaraṃ pattanaṃ ca vā || 9 ||
tīrthaṃ śālā vanaṃ vāpī yatra satraṃ na tasya vai |
sarvatraivendradyumnasyānnāni bhujyanta īśvaraiḥ || 1.519.10 ||
devāḥ ṛṣayo bhṛtyāśca vidyārthinaśca bhūsurāḥ |
yatayaḥ sādhavaḥ sādhvyaḥ sāṃkhyayoginya ityapi || 1 1||
brahmacārī vānaprasthaḥ sannyāsī tyāgavānapi |
anātho dīna ityādyā bhuṃjate tasya satrake || 1 2||
tīrthaṃ na vidyate tādṛg yatra tasya na devalam |
tena kanyārbudāyutānāṃ dānamuttamam || 13||
kṛtaṃ prakāritaṃ cāpi sadā santaḥ supūjitāḥ |
daśamīdivase tasya rājye vai gajapṛṣṭhagaḥ || 14||
dundubhistāḍyamānastu babhrāma sakalaṃ puram |
ujjayinyāṃ ca vai prātarbhāvī śrīharivāsaraḥ || 15||
tenaiva svaśarīreṇa brahmalokaṃ svayaṃ gataḥ |
tataḥ kalpasahasrānte sa prokto brahmaṇā svayam || 16||
indradyumna dharāṃ yāhi na sthātavyaṃ tvayātra vai |
tava kīrtisamucchedaḥ saṃjāto’dya dharātale || 17||
yāvatkīrtirdharāpṛṣṭhe tāvatsvarge vasennaraḥ |
etasmātkāraṇāllokāḥ kurvanti nāmalekhanam || 18||
vāpīkūpataḍāgādau devatāyatanādiṣu |
gaccha śīghraṃ dharāpṛṣṭhaṃ svāṃ kīrtiṃ nūtanīkuru || 1 9||
kīrtau satyāṃ mama satye draṣṭā tvaṃ bhavitāsi vai |
tataḥ saḥ prayayau pṛthvīṃ kāmpilyanagaraṃ prati ||1.519.20||
atha papraccha deśaḥ ko nagaraṃ kiṃ janān tadā |
ūcuste’yaṃ pradeśo’sti tvānarto nagaraṃ tu vai ||21 ||
kāmpilyaṃ ko bhavānatrāparijñātā pravartate |
rājā prāha purā cāhamindradyumno mahīpatiḥ ||22||
deśe vejahake rocakākhye vai nagare’dhipaḥ |
sa deśaḥ kva puraṃ kvāste mayā stheyaṃ ca tatra vai ||23||
janāḥ prāhurna vidmastaṃ nṛpaṃ deśaṃ ca pattanam |
rājā prāha cirāyuṣkaṃ pradarśayata māṃ janāḥ ||24||
yadi kaścidbhavedatra yastaṃ vetti mahīpatim |
janāḥ prāhurdaśakalpajīvī saṃśrayūte muniḥ ||25||
naimiṣāraṇyake pṛccha mārkaṃḍeyo vadiṣyati |
rājā gatvā vyomapathā papraccha taṃ munīśvaram ||26||
indradyumneti bhūpo’tra tvayā dṛṣṭaḥ śruto’thavā |
muniḥ prāha mayā naiva dṛṣṭo vāpi śruto’pi vā ||27||
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā rājā nairāśyamāptavān |
muniḥ prāha mayā sākaṃ samāgaccha himācalam ||28||
tatrāste ca bako nāma ṛṣirmattaḥ purātanaḥ |
iti tau vyomamārgeṇa gatvā papracchaturnatau ||29||
indradyumnamahīpālastvayā dṛṣṭaḥ śruto’pi kim |
bakaḥ prāha mama kālo viṃśatikalpako gataḥ ||1.519.30||
samaye tatra tatpūrvaṃ naiva vedmi hi taṃ nṛpam |
indradyumno bakaṃ prāha cirāyuṣṭvaṃ kathaṃ tava ||31||
bakaḥ prāha purā viśvarūpo’hamabhavaṃ dvijaḥ |
kasyacittvatha kālasya saṃkrāntau makarasya vai ||32||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pañcāmṛtena snāpito mayā |
śaṃkaraḥ snāpitastatra hareḥ prasādavāriṇā ||33||
tato’haṃ rājaputratvaṃ prāptaḥ paścimabhūtale |
jātismaraḥ sadā pañcāmṛtaiḥ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ||34||
śivaṃ ca pūjayāmyevaṃ prātarvarṣasahasrakam |
tena puṇyaprabhāveṇa jāto’haṃ vai cirasthiraḥ ||35||
kailāse śaṃbhudāsyaṃ cākaravaṃ vai tataḥ param |
gālavasyāśrame gatvā vidyādhyayanamācaram ||36||
tasya patnī ṛtusnātā mayā spṛṣṭā vikārataḥ |
sā tu śaśāpa māṃ dhūrta bako’raṇyagato bhava ||37||
tenāhaṃ bakarūpo’smi ṛṣiḥ kāmasvarūpadhṛk |
vartāmyatra mahāraṇye bakākāraḥ sadā śuciḥ ||38||
jātismaraḥ sadā tvatra bhajāmi śrīhariṃ bakaḥ |
mārkaṃḍeyastu taṃ prāha vetsi tvatto’pi pūrvajam ||39||
yadi kaṃcid darśayasva yena pṛcchāmi taṃ ca tat |
bakaḥ prāha samāyāhi mattaścāpi purātanaḥ ||1.519.40||
yatrāsti dayito me’ti hyulūkarṣiścirasthiraḥ |
trayaste ca gatāstatra kailāse śikhare hi me ||41 ||
sopi dṛṣṭvā bakaṃ mitraṃ svāgatenābhyanandayat |
bakaḥ papraccha colūkam indradyumnanṛpaṃ prati ||42||
vada jānāsi cenmitra kadā jātaḥ sa bhūpatiḥ |
ulūkaḥ prāha me kalpāścatvāriṃśatprasaṃkhyakāḥ ||43||
vyatītā na śruto dṛṣṭastvindradyumno mahīpatiḥ |
indradyumnastu taṃ prāholūkatā vai kathaṃ tava ||44||
ulūkaḥ svakathāmāha purāsaṃ brāhmaṇo bhuvi |
brahmacārī harabhakto bilvapatraiḥ prapūjakaḥ ||45||
tato varṣasahasrānte dadau svadarśanaṃ haraḥ |
dadau me vaiṣṇavaṃ mantraṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti ca ||46||
śaṃbhuradṛśyatāṃ prāptaścāhaṃ bhārgavasannidhau |
āśramaṃ tasya saṃprāpto virūpo’pi śubhāśrayam ||47||
bhārgavasyābhavatpatnī nāmnā sudarśanā satī |
gālavakanyakā sā ca pātivratyaparāyaṇā ||48||
tasyāṃ tvāsīd bhārgavasya kanyaikā yuvatī śubhā |
sā mayā yācitā cātha vivāhitāpi vai tataḥ ||49||
virūpaṃ māṃ sadā matvā kanyakā prāha mātaram |
virūpāya pradattāsmi nāhaṃ jīvitumutsahe ||1.519.50||
viṣaṃ vā bhakṣayiṣyāmi pravekṣyāmi hutāśanam |
atha tāṃ bhārgavaḥ prāha yasmai dattā sthirā bhava ||51||
vedadharmaḥ sa evāsti patiṃ nārāyaṇaṃ smaret |
saṃsevya svapatiṃ tvaṃ vai bhaviṣyasi divaṃgatā ||52||
ataḥ sevasva taṃ nāthaṃ kuru janma phalānvitam |
ityevaṃ śikṣitā sāpi naiva mene hitaṃ tataḥ ||53||
na māṃ vai sevate rātrau tato mayā prasahya sā |
ardharātre hṛtā tasyāḥ piturgṛhānmamāśramam ||54||
prātarvipro jajāgāra pitā tasyāstathā prasūḥ |
kvāsau sā duhitetyevaṃ babhramaturmamāśramam ||55||
āgatyaināṃ dadṛśatuḥ sāpi ruroda vīkṣya tau |
tataḥ kopaparītātmā māṃ provāca sa bhārgavaḥ ||56||
niśāyāṃ tu tvayā patnī mama putrī hṛtā yataḥ |
niśācaro bhavānastu ulūkaśceti śāpataḥ ||57||
ulūko’smi hi sañjāto jātismaraśca sarvadā |
kāmarūpadharaścāsmi vartāmi cātra parvate ||58||
patnī me svapiturharmye sthitā nārāyaṇāśritā |
yayau śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇadāsyapradaṃ padam ||59||
evaṃ me kauśikatvaṃ vai sañjātaṃ cātra parvate |
akhaṇḍabilvapatraistu pūjanasya phalaṃ param ||1.519.60||
cirāyuṣṭvaṃ tu me divyarūpadhāritvamityapi |
bakaḥ prāhetaraṃ kaṃcic cejjānāsi cirāyuṣam ||6 1 ||
vada tatra pragacchāmaḥ pṛcchāmastaṃ nṛpaṃ prati |
ulūkaḥ prāha tu mayā sārdhamāgacchatātra vai ||62||
gandhamādanaśikhare gṛdhrarṣirvartate mahān |
cirantano yadi taṃ ca nṛpaṃ jñāsyati pūrvajam ||6 3 ||
ityuktvā tān samādāyolūko gṛdhraṃ samāyayau |
gṛdhrarṣistām̐stathā dṛṣṭvā prahṛṣṭaḥ sammukhaṃ yayau ||64||
svāgataṃ kṛtavām̐ścāpi pṛṣṭhavām̐ścāśrame ṛtam |
ulūkaḥ prāha me mitraṃ nāḍījaṃgho bako hyayam ||65||
yasya mitraṃ tu mārkaṇḍastasyāyaṃ nṛpatiḥ suhṛt |
ayaṃ cātrāgataḥ praṣṭuṃ purendradyumnabhūpatiḥ ||66 ||
āsītkaścinnavetyevaṃ vettuṃ cāsti samāgataḥ |
gṛdhraḥ prāha tu me kalpā aśītiḥ prayayuḥ khalu ||67||
na dṛṣṭo na śrutaḥ ko’pi kvāpīndradyumnabhūpatiḥ |
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā so’pi rājā sudurmanāḥ ||68||
manasā cintayāmāsa maraṇe kṛtaniścayaḥ |
papraccha gṛdhraṃ jāto’si cirāyustvaṃ kathaṃ vada ||69||
gṛdhraḥ prāha purā caityavṛkṣe’haṃ nyavasaṃ sukham |
vasante ca janāstaṃ cāpūjayan phalitaṃ drumam ||1.519.70||
kāminyastatra vṛkṣe ca dolāṃ babandhuruttamām |
tatra saṃsthāpya ca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ muhurmuhuḥ ||71 ||
sarvā āndolayāmāsuḥ kumāryaḥ sadhavāstathā |
ahaṃ tu kautukāviṣṭo rātrau tatra svayaṃ sthitaḥ ||72||
karomyāndolanaṃ tābhiḥ ramāmi viramāmi ca |
janairdṛṣṭastāḍitaśca pañcatvaṃ prāptavām̐stataḥ ||73 ||
jātismaro’bhavaṃ rājā nāmnā khyātaḥ kuśadhvajaḥ |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ nityaṃ cāndolayāmi pūrvavat ||74||
śaṃbhuṃ cāndolayāmyeva śivarātrau punaḥ punaḥ |
janmāṣṭamyāṃ tathānādiśrīkṛṣṇaṃ nyasya tatra ca ||75 ||
āndolayāmi satataṃ naranārāyaṇaṃ tathā |
evaṃ prakurvato me śrīśaṃbhuḥ pratyakṣatāṃ gataḥ ||76 ||
bhavate varadaścāsmi vaiṣṇavāya varaṃ vṛṇu |
ityuvāca haro mahyaṃ mayāpi ca tadārthinam ||77||
kailāse me dehi vāsaṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ samāgame |
vaiṣṇavasya ca te nityaṃ kariṣyāmi susevanam ||78||
evamukto mahādevo māṃ kailāsaṃ nināya saḥ |
kadācittvatha kālasya vimānena nijecchayā ||79||
mayā ca bhramamāṇena dṛṣṭāgniveśyaputrikā |
jale praviṣṭā snānārthaṃ tvālibhirbahvībhiryutā ||1.519.80 ||
mayāvatīrya sā bālā patnyarthaṃ yācitā tadā |
kāmabhāvena sā naiva vyalokayattu māṃ prati ||8 1 ||
mayoddhṛtya jalāt sā ca balānnītā vimānake |
tadā tadrodanaṃ śrutvā tatpitā māṃ śaśāpa ha ||82||
gṛdhravad bālikāṃ vaṃ cāspṛśaḥ sadvrataśālinīm |
tasmādgṛdhro bhava cātra vimānaṃ te praṇaśyatu ||83 ||
ahaṃ gṛdhrastadā jāto vimānaṃ naṣṭameva me |
bālā cākṛtabhogā sā yayau svaṃ pitaraṃ prati ||84||
etadvai sarvamākhyātaṃ sakhe gṛdhratvakāraṇam |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprītyā cirāyuścāsmi bhūtale ||85||
indradyumnaṃ na jānāmi vada kiṃ karavāṇi te |
itiśrutvā nṛpatiḥ sa nirāśaśca hutāśane ||83||
praveśaṃ cecchati tatra maraṇaṃ kartumicchati |
tāvad gṛdhrastu taṃ prāha vahniṃ mā viśa bhūpate ||87||
ahaṃ te kīrtayiṣyāmi mamāpyasti cirantanaḥ |
sa jñāsyati mama mitraṃ hīndradyumnaṃ purātanam ||88||
yāmastatra tu kamaṭho māntharako’sti yatra ca |
mānase sarasi khyātastatraiva kṛtaketanaḥ ||89||
sarve yayustatkamaṭhaṃ sevamānaṃ śubhātapam |
tīrasthaṃ sarasastatra te’vatīrṇāstato’mbarāt ||1.519.90||
tāvat sa kacchapaḥ śīghraṃ salile’ntarjagāma ha |
gṛdhrastaṃ nijamitraṃ ca prāha kasmāt prayāsi bhoḥ ||91 ||
mitraṃ dṛṣṭvā kathaṃ yāsi bhīta iva vilokyase |
sunīco’pi gṛhaṃ prāpto bhavetpūjyatamaḥ satām ||92||
atha kūrmo jalamadhye śiromātrabahirmukhaḥ |
pratyuvāca paraṃ mitraṃ karomi svāgataṃ tava ||93||
tava mitrasya ca tathā mitramitrādimānanam |
