paraṃ tvayaṃ nṛpaḥ kaścit pañcamo yaḥ pradṛśyate ||94||
tasyendradyumnasaṃjñasya bhayād yāmi jalāntaram |
anena tu purā dagdhā pṛṣṭhirme tu makhāgnibhiḥ ||95||
nādyāpi sā kṣatiḥ saṃpūryate pṛṣṭhagatā mama |
enaṃ dṛṣṭvā yajñakīrtiṃ smṛtvā pṛṣṭhakṣatiṃ tathā ||96||
vidravāmi jale mitra karomi svāgataṃ tu vaḥ |
indradyumnasya rājarṣeḥ kīrtisaṃśravaṇaṃ mahat ||97||
sahasrasaṃkhyayā rājñā sarve vai kratavaḥ kṛtāḥ |
nādyāpi kīrtipuṇye ca naśyete’sya tu bhūpateḥ |||98||
pañcāśacca śataṃ kalpā mama tvatra jale gatāḥ |
tatpūrvaṃ rocake nāmnā pattane cābhavaṃ tadā ||99||
asya bhayena tat tyaktvā vasāmyatra sarovare |
ityuktvā sa bahirgatvākarot sanmānanaṃ bahu || 1.519.100 ||
saṃbhāṣāṃ vividhāṃ kalpāntarīyāṃ cakrire mithaḥ |
kūrmo jātismaraḥ kāmarūpadhṛg devarūpavān || 10 1||
satkāraṃ bhojanādyaṃ ca kalpayāyāsa tatkṣaṇam |
indradyumnaḥ prahṛṣṭo’bhūt papracchata kacchapaṃ tataḥ || 1 02||
cirāyuṣṭvaṃ kathaṃ te’sti rocakāt pūrvameva kim |
kutra vāsaśca te tvāsīt kutra janma vrataṃ tava || 1 03||
vada me jāyate cātyānando mitrasya darśanāt |
śrutvaivaṃ kacchapaḥ prāha śṛṇu rājan purābhavam || 1 04||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne indradyumnarājñaḥ pṛthivyāṃ mārkaṇḍeyabakarṣighūkarṣigṛdhrarṣikamaṭharṣikṛtakīrtinavīnatvaṃ, prāgaparāddhajanyabakādijanmāni, puṇyakṛtacirajīvitvādi cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ekonaviṃśadadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||51 9||

<1.520>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi kacchapaḥ saḥ provāca prāgbhavaṃ svakam |
indradyumnamahārāja śṛṇu dṛṣṭaṃ mayā tu yat || 1 ||
ahaṃ vaikuṇṭhadhāmastho nārāyaṇasya pārṣadaḥ |
vasuhārītanāmāsaṃ caturbāhurmanoharaḥ || 2 ||
suvarṇavāṭikāyāṃ tu nityāyāṃ vai sarovare |
nityaṃ kamalapuṣpāṇi samāhartuṃ niyojitaḥ || 3 ||
lakṣmyā mālā kṛtā nityamarpyate śrīharergale |
mayā tvānīya puṣpāṇi dīyate nityadā śriyai || 4 ||
ekadā snānamagno’haṃ vicinvan kamalāni tu |
suciraṃ kṛtavām̐statra sarasyevāplavaṃ rataḥ || 5 ||
mālāyāḥ samayastatra vyatītaśca tataḥ param |
lakṣmīḥ svayaṃ samāgatya prāha māṃ kiṃ karoṣi re ||6||
cirāyate tu pūjāyāṃ jale magno’si durmate |
jale eva sadā tiṣṭha na me te’sti prayojanam || 7 ||
karoṣi taraṇaṃ kūrmasamaṃ kūrmaḥ sadā bhava |
ityuktaḥ kūrmatāṃ prāpto vaikuṇṭhasya sarovare || 8 ||
sṛṣṭau tu jāyamānāyāṃ gaṃgā satye samāgatā |
tasmādvai brahmasarasastenāhaṃ ca samāgataḥ || 9 ||
tato’nyapārṣadastatra kamalārthe ca yojitaḥ |
nāmnā tvanantaśīlaḥ saḥ kadācid jalamadhyagaḥ || 1.520.1 0||
prasarpan satyalokaṃ vai jalena saha cāgataḥ |
brahmaṇā sa viṣṇurūpau matvā saṃpūjito mudā ||1 1 ||
anantaśīlastatrāha prasanno’smi varaṃ vṛṇu |
brahmā prāha mayā yāvadbrahmāṇḍānāṃ tu koṭayaḥ || 12||
kriyante sarṣapatulyāstān sadā dhāraya prabho |
tathāstviti tadā prāha kintu me dehi vedikām || 1 3||
yatra sthitvā dhārayāmi sthiro brahmāṇḍamaṇḍalam |
satyaloke ca gaṃgāyāṃ tadā cāhaṃ hyupasthitaḥ || 14||
āsaṃ tatraiva gaṃgāyāṃ brahmā prāha ca māṃ tadā |
kacchapa tvaṃ vahānantaṃ hyabhīṣṭaṃ karavāṇi te || 15||
mayoktaṃ ca yathā lakṣmīnārāyaṇasya dāsatā |
bhavenme tu tathā brahman kuru tatpārṣado’smyaham || 16||
vedhāstathāstviti prāha mayā śeṣaśca saṃdhṛtaḥ |
anantākhyo mama pṛṣṭhe’nantena ca phaṇopari ||17||
brahmāṇḍāni dhṛtānyeva jāyante viramanti ca |
brahmaṇā tu tapastaptaṃ mama lābhasya siddhaye || 18||
nārāyaṇasya dāsyasya prāptyarthaṃ śrīharistadā |
brahmāṇaṃ ca samāgatya varṣānte prāha sanmukhaḥ || 1 9||
varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te kathaṃ smṛto’smi me vada |
brahmā prāha hare kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa jagatprabho ||1.520.20||
pārṣadaste mayā prāpto vasuhārītasaṃjñakaḥ |
lakṣmīśāpena kamaṭhasvarūpaṃ labdhavām̐stu yaḥ || 21 ||
mayā samprārthito’nantastava śreṣṭhaḥ supārṣadaḥ |
brahmāṇḍānāṃ dhāraṇārthaṃ tenārthitaṃ śubhāsanam ||22||
tadā sa kamaṭhaḥ samyagādhāro vai mayārpitaḥ |
anantāya ca kamaṭho vavre nārāyaṇāśrayam ||23||
dāsyaṃ yathā bhavet tasmād dehi dāsyaṃ ca bhaktayoḥ |
pārṣadayorubhayostvaṃ kṛpāṃ kuru tathā prabho ||24||
nārāyaṇastadā prāha tathāstviti punaḥ punaḥ |
andhakādyasuravrātānnāśayitvā kṣaṇāntare ||25||
pariśramavināśārth kṣīrode sāgare tadā |
śeṣasya gendukaṃ kṛtvā kacchapasya tu pṛṣṭhake ||26||
śayiṣye tatra me dāsyaṃ kacchapānantayoḥ sadā |
dāsye ceti varaṃ datvā nārāyaṇastiro’bhavat ||27||
āgataḥ śrīharistatra lakṣmīṃ nītvā payodadhau |
yatrāhaṃ kacchapo nityaṃ pratiṣṭhāmi mahājale ||28||
śeṣo’nanto mama pṛṣṭhe paryaṃkagenduko’bhavat |
tatra śete jagannāthaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ ||29||
dāsyaṃ dvābhyāṃ tatra labdhaṃ nityaṃ śrīharipādayoḥ |
brahmaṇāṃ tu śate naṣṭe tvekadā lomaśo muniḥ ||1.520.30||
kṣīrode śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya darśanāya vai |
samāgato mayā dṛṣṭaḥ pṛṣṭaśca kuśalaṃ prati ||2 1 ||
gṛhādikaṃ sukhaṃ cāste pratyuttaraṃ jagāda saḥ |
brahmaṇāṃ daśakaṃ naṣṭaṃ sannidhau mama kacchapa ||32||
brahmaṇāṃ tu śate naṣṭe mariṣyāmi kṣaṇāntare |
svalpāyuśca kathaṃ kuryād gṛhaṃ yannaśvaraṃ kṣaṇāt ||33||
tato’haṃ muninā sārdham ājñayā śrīharestathā |
rūpaṃ dvitīyaṃ dhṛtyaiva svalpaṃ vai śatayojanam ||34||
tīrthayātrākṛte’gacchaṃ brahmāṇḍāntaḥpravīkṣitum |
so’haṃ lomaśamuninā sārdhaṃ pātālabhūmitaḥ ||35||
uparyupari cāgacchaṃ tathā tathaiva vāyunā |
deha me tu svabhāvena paraṃ saṃkocatāṃ gatam ||36||
pṛthvyāṃ kṛṣṇamaṇijanye saurāṣṭre tvaśvapaṭṭake |
vyāghrāraṇyāntare śreṣṭhe miṣṭode vai sarovare ||37||
pañcayojanakāyāme lomaśasyāśrame taṭe |
pūrvasmin raivatādbhāge viśrāntiṃ cālabhaṃ kṣaṇam ||38||
tatra kuṃkumavāpyāṃ ca kambharākṛṣṇamandire |
patnīvrato brāhmaṇaśca kṛṣṇāṃśo vartate sadā ||39||
śrīḥ svayaṃ kambharālakṣmīḥ kṛṣṇo gopālakṛṣṇakaḥ |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo yatra mandire vartate sadā ||1.520.40||
ekādaśa tathā rudrā aṣṭau ca vasavastathā |
ādityā dvādaśa cāpi devavaidyau ca sarvadā ||41 ||
trayastriṃśacca te devāḥ kalpe kalpe navā navāḥ |
nityaṃ tiṣṭhanti yaddvāre tatra tīrthottame śubhe |||42|||
patnīvrato mahāviṣṇusamāyurvīkṣito mayā |
lomaśenārcito vipro mayāpi tvarcitastadā ||43||
brahmaṇāṃ koṭayo yasya sannidhau līnatāṃ gatāḥ |
yasya vaṃśāścaturdaśalokeṣu brāhmaṇā matāḥ ||44||
sṛṣṭyantare’pi tasyaiva vaṃśāste brāhmaṇāḥ sadā |
tasyāhaṃ darśanaṃ kṛtvā nyavasaṃ lomaśāśramam ||45||
tadāsīnnṛpatirindradyumno’tra bhūtale mahān |
saptadvīpasamudrāṇāṃ pṛthvīnāṃ sārvabhaumakaḥ ||46||
rocakāyāṃ rājadhānyāṃ raivatācalasannidhau |
pūrvasyāṃ vai diśi vyāghrāraṇyabhūmau babhūva saḥ ||47||
dvitīyā rājadhānyasya mahākālavane’bhavat |
tṛtīyāsīt tathā śrīmatpuruṣottamapūrgatā ||48||
vedhaso vartamānasya catvāriṃśatsamāsu ca |
gatāsu bhūtale hyāsīdindradyumno mahīpatiḥ ||49||
sa ca dṛṣṭvā svake tīrthe tvaśvapaṭṭasarovare |
kacchapaṃ māṃ mahākāyaṃ yojanārdhasuvartulam ||1.520.50||
lomaśasyādhīnakaṃ ca matvā jñātvā ṛtukṣamam |
vavre rājā lomaśānmāṃ yajñapīṭhārthamuttamam ||51 ||
lomaśena tathāstveva kṛtvā datto’hameva yat |
mama pṛṣṭho bhūbhṛtā 3 bahuvarṣāṇi santatam |||2||
anena tu kṛtā yajñā lomaśena prakāritāḥ |
tataḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ mama dagdhaṃ mayā saṃprārthito muniḥ ||53||
lomaśaḥ sudayālurmā prāha gacchatu mānasam |
saro himagireḥ prānte tato’haṃ tvatra cāgataḥ ||54||
atra vai brahmaṇo varṣapañcakaṃ me gataṃ bhavam |
kalpāstu brahmaṇo me’tra gatāni tāni vai śṛṇu ||55||
aṣṭādaśasahasrāṇi tathā ca pañcaviṃśatiḥ |
mānase’tra gatāḥ kalpāstān smarāmi yathātatham ||56||
dvitīyena svarūpeṇa cātra tiṣṭhāmi sarvadā |
pṛṣṭhaṃ me nirujaṃ samyag jātaṃ himādrisaṃśrayāt ||57||
lomaśarṣirgururme’sti gaccha tatrāśramaṃ śubham |
rājam̐stvaṃ prathamaṃ yāhi puruṣottamasatpurīm ||58||
yatra tvayā jagannāthaḥ svahastena purāhitaḥ |
tato yāhi mahākālavanaṃ yatra tava gṛham ||59||
tato yāhi surāṣṭraṃ yatrāśvapaṭṭasarovaram |
kuṃkumavāpikā yatra lomaśo vartate muniḥ ||1.520.6 0||
yatra vai śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo lakṣmīpatiḥ svayam |
pārvatīmāṇikīrādhāprabhāsvāmī pumuttamaḥ ||61 ||
sāptabhaume mahāsaudhe divye saṃrājate hariḥ |
gaccha rājaṃstatra sevāṃ kṛtvā yāhi tataḥ param ||62||
satyalokaṃ kalpakālaṃ punardrakṣyasi māṃ tataḥ |
ebhirvai munibhiḥ sārdhaṃ yaśaste’vyāhataṃ bhuvi ||63||
śrutvā yāsyasi satyaṃ tatkalpaṃ prati dhruvam |
kacchapasya hitaṃ miṣṭaṃ vākyaṃ saṃgṛhya te tataḥ ||64||
nivṛttāśca tataḥ sthānāt svasvasthāni bhejire |
indradyumnaḥ samāyāto lomaśaṃ prati tatkramāt ||65||
yasya vai pārśvato dikṣu caturyojanabhūtale |
māyā nāsti na vai rāgadveṣau kutastu vāsanā ||66||
brahmarūpāśramaṃ prāpya rājā tṛpto’bhavattadā |
lomaśasya mukhāt sarvaṃ śrutvā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ||67||
sampūjya kambharālakṣmīṃ śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇakam |
trayastriṃśatsurām̐ścāpyājñayovāsa sa vatsaram ||68||
śuśrāva satkathāstatra lomaśasya mukhāmbujāt |
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyā nityaṃ navā navāḥ ||69||
tatra śuśrāva ca yajñān svakṛtān lomaśānanāt |
tathā śrīmajjagannāthapratiṣṭhāṃ svakṛtāṃ śubhām ||1.520.70||
tathā sarvatra satrāṇi tvannānāṃ bhojanāni ca |
dānāni gajagovājihiraṇyaratnayoṣitām ||71 ||
pṛthivyāṃ santi yāvanti vastūni tāvatāmapi |
dānāni japapūjādi śrutavām̐śca gurormukhāt ||72||
jñānaṃ cātmapradaṃ svargapradaṃ mokṣapradaṃ tathā |
lomaśasya mukhāt sarvaṃ labdhavām̐ścātmadarśanam ||73||
lomaśena śrutaṃ yacchrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇānanāt |
śṛṇu lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi te’haṃ bhaktaupayaugikam ||74||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne mānasasarovarasthena kacchapena svasya śeṣasya ca viṣṇoḥ pārṣadatvaṃ kathitaṃ, tataḥ kuṃkumavāpīkṣetre lomaśāśrame’śvapaṭṭasarovare vāsaḥ, āyuḥ, indradyumnayajñāścetyādivṛttāntakathananāmā viṃśatyadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 520 ||

<1.521>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi cendradyumnaḥ papraccha lomaśam ṛṣim |
ṛṣe śāntikaraṃ jñānaṃ kathaṃ jāyeta tadvada || 1 ||
ātmaśāntiṃ vinā sarvaṃ jālaṃ codvejakaṃ matam |
ātmaśāntisamo lābho nānyaḥ kaścicca taṃ vada || 2 ||
lomaśaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ smṛtvā jagāda tam |
śṛṇu rājan pravakṣyāmi śrīhareḥ smaraṇaṃ kuru || 3 ||
akṣaraṃ brahma paramaṃ dhāma vyāpakamuttamam |
śāśvataṃ yatra vityaistu muktaiḥ sevyaḥ parātparaḥ || 4 ||
śrīharī rājate śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ |
divyo yuvātibalavān rūparūpānuśevadhiḥ || 5 ||
koṭikoṭyarkatejāṃsi sadā yasyāṇubhāgataḥ |
prakāśante sarvasūṛṣṭigato muktābhisevitaḥ || 6 ||
anantarūpadhṛk śrīmatpuruṣottama eva saḥ |
akṣarādisamastānāṃ svāmī nārāyaṇaśca saḥ || 7 ||
akṣarātīta evāsau dvibhujo divyavigrahaḥ |
śrotavyaścāpi mantavyo dhyeyaśca śrīpatiḥ prabhuḥ || 8 ||
netre kajjalasaṃśobhe padmapatrāyate’ruṇe |
premṇā ca nibhṛte śaśvadbhāvagarbhe’tikarṣaṇe || 9 ||
svarṇaromṇāṃ rājibhiśca virājite’timañjule |
hṛdayasya tu sarvasvaṃ nivedayata ādarāt || 1.521.1 0||
bhrūkuṭibhyāṃ kāmakoṭiśaravedhanakārake |
ātmānandabhṛte snigdhe rasikānāṃ rasānvite || 11 ||
tārakāpānapīyūṣaprade mīnasucañcale |
ākarṇāntagataprānte koṇakauśalyasaṃbhṛte || 1 2||
raktarekhānvite śvete paritaḥ sphaṭikojjvale |
sarvadṛśyapratibimbānvite dhyeye manohare || 13||
nāsikāṃ tilapuṣpābhāṃ pakvabimbasamauṣṭakau |
tanurekhācamatkārakaraśmaśruvibhūṣitau || 14||
svalpanimnaṃ tataḥ samyagucchrāyaṃ cibukaṃ smaret |
kapolau sūryacandrābhau bhālaṃ binduvirājitam || 15||
smaret satilakaṃ cātiprojjvalaṃ caikarekhakam |
keśāṃśca mañjulān snigdhān vakrān kṛṣṇām̐śca piṃgalān || 16||
smaret mukuṭaprabhayā projjvalān dīrgharaśmikān |
karṇau śaṣkulikāśobhau ratnahīrakakuṇḍalau || 17||
dhyāyet svāmini paridhivyāptaṃ mukhaṃ ca tejasām |
koṭikandarpakāntyādirājitaṃ hṛdayaṃgamam || 18||
kambukaṇṭhaṃ dṛḍhapuṣṭaskandhau dhyāyenmanoharau |
bhogibhogasamau bāhū svarṇacampakasūjjvalau || 19||
karihastābhakarabhau padmābhe hastayostale |
nakhacandrām̐śca dhavalān yogyaraktān samunnatān ||1.521.20||
sarekhāṅgulikāḥ sarvā aṅguṣṭhau ca prakoṣṭhakau |
dhyāyed vakṣaḥsthale lakṣmīcihnayuktaṃ samunnatam ||21||
viśālaṃ śrīvatsacihnaṃ romṇāṃ dakṣiṇavartanam |
stanaṃ dvayaṃ tathā dhyāyedudaraṃ trivaliśritam ||22||
nimnanābhiṃ jaghanaṃ ca pārśvadvayaṃ samujjvalam |
kaṭiṃ siṃhakaṭitulyāṃ dhyāyelliṃgaṃ nitambakau ||23||
urū dhyāyed gajahastasamau jānū suvartulau |
jaṃghe ramye pattale ca padmapatrābhapāṇḍure ||24||
aṃgulīrnakhacandrāḍhyā dhyāyed bhūṣāmbarāṇi ca |
hārarājīn dantapaktiṃ hṛdayaṃ mānasaṃ smaret ||25||
bhāvanāṃ ca guṇān sarvaiśvaryāṇi ca kriyāṃ smaret |
evaṃ vai śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇamūrterhi cintanāt ||26 ||
śāntirvai śāśvatī rājan jāyetaiva na saṃśayaḥ |
tato dhyāyeddharau tasmin śrīkṛṣṇaṃ rādhikāṃ tathā ||27||
dhyāyennārāyaṇaṃ lakṣmīṃ brahmāṇaṃ ca sarasvatīm |
sāvitrīṃ cāpi gāyatrīṃ śivaṃ durgāṃ ca pārvatīm ||28||
dhyāyed gaṃgāṃ ca viṣṇuṃ ca lakṣmīṃ vṛndāṃ ca tūlasīm |
dhyāyettatrākṣarātīte vyūhām̐śca vibhavām̐stathā ||29||
arcā aṃśakalāveśān vibhūtīśca harau smaret |
kṣīrasthaṃ śvetabhūsaṃsthaṃ himasthaṃ svagataṃ smaret ||1.521.3 0 ||
sarvadehigataṃ taṃ vai viṣṇuṃ dhyāyejjanārdanam |
nare nāryāṃ sadā taṃ vai paśyet kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ||3 1||
satye svarge kṣitau vyomni pātāle hṛdayāmbare |
putre patnyāṃ paśau kānte jaḍe cetanavargake ||32||
dṛśye’dṛśye priye grāhye vipriye varjyavastuni |
dhyāyed vai śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ gopālabālakam ||33||
kambharālālitaṃ divyaṃ tvaśvapaṭṭasaro’ntikam |
lomaśena sadā dhyātaṃ brahmarudrādivanditam ||34||
rādhālakṣmīramāpadmāprabhāpadmāvatīśvaram |
māṇikīpārvatīnāthaṃ jayeśaṃ lalitāpatim ||35||
mukteśaṃ cāvatāreśaṃ saccidānandavigraham |
śrīkṛṣṇavallabhaṃ nāthaṃ jagajjanmādikāraṇam ||36||
siddhisaṃsevitaṃ jñānānandasampatpraśevadhim |
dhyāyet kāntasvarūpaṃ taṃ svāminaṃ hṛdayāmbuje ||37||
ekatānatayā dhyāyennaro nārī patiṃ prabhum |
kuṃkumavāpikātīrthaprasevitaṃ pareśvaram ||38||
dhyāyetsmarejjapennityaṃ namet saṃsevayettathā |
pūjayedarcayetpādapadme dhṛtāmṛtaṃ pibet ||39||
prasādaṃ saṃgrasettasya sugandhyādi samāvahet |
pradakṣiṇāṃ stutiṃ kuryāddīpaṃ naivedyamarpayet ||1.521.40||
ārārtrikaṃ prakuryāśca sarvasvārpaṇamācaret |
evamātmā samarpyaścārpaṇīyaḥ sarvadā harau ||41 ||
kāmaḥ krodhaḥ sukhaṃ sneho lobho mohādayastathā |
dayā dānaṃ ca dākṣiṇyaṃ damanaṃ doṣamaṇḍalam ||42||
sarvaṃ samarpayet tasmai tatra kṣipennirantaram |||
tena vahnau yathā dhātustathā śuddhyati mānavaḥ ||43||
indradyumna phalaṃ hitvā kuryād dāsyaṃ sadā hareḥ |
ahaṃ śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇadāsyena divyatām ||44||
alabhaṃ cirajīvitvaṃ brahmatulyaṃ vapustathā |
jīvanmuktiṃ tathaiśvaryasiddhīrvairāgyasampadam ||45||
santoṣaṃ cālabhaṃ tṛṣṇākṣayaṃ māyāvivarjitam |
māyālepādirāhityaṃ tathāvaraṇahīnatām ||46||
kleśān karmāśayān dagdhvā vicarāmi hariryathā |
loṣṭhaṃ kāṣṭhasya yogena taratyeva jalārṇavam ||47||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasaṃgāllomaśo lepaśātanaḥ |
brahmamukto vartate’tra kalpānāṃ kālaśātanaḥ ||48||
brahmādistambaparyantamasaṃkhyaṃ viśvameva yat |
sarve carācarādhāraṃ yaḥ sṛjatyeva līlayā ||49||
brahmeśaśeṣadharmāśca dineśaśca gaṇeśvaraḥ |
munīndravargo devendro dhyāyati yamaharniśam ||1.521.50||
vedāḥ stuvanti yaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ jagatprabhum |
stauti yaṃ prakṛtirhṛṣṭā stauti bhītā sarasvatī ||51 ||
ṣaṇmukhaścaturāsyaśca pañcāsyaḥ stauti yaṃ harim |
sahasrāsyaśca vedāsyā analāsyāḥ stuvanti yam ||52||
svecchāmayaṃ nirīhaṃ ca nirguṇaṃ ca nirañjanam |
parātparataraṃ brahma paramātmānamīśvaram ||53||
nityaṃ jyotirabhivyāptaṃ bhaktānugrahavigraham |
nityānandaṃ ca nityaṃ ca nityamakṣaravigraham ||54||
bhaja nityaṃ guruṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhuṃ patim |
so’vatīrṇo’tra bhagavān bhūbhārādyapanuttaye ||55||
gopālabālaveṣaśca vallabho māyayā prabhuḥ |
sa eva rakṣitā poṣṭā saṃhartā taṃ sadā bhaja ||56 ||
pitaraṃ mātaraṃ vidyāmantradaṃ sadguruṃ patim |
tameva śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ bhaja mahīpate ||57||
indradyumna nibodhedaṃ jñānaṃ mattaḥ parātparam |
tyaja sarvaṃ vighnakaraṃ mudaṃ labha hareḥ param ||58||
kiṃ rājyaṃ kiṃ yaśo grāmaḥ kaḥ svadeśo’paraśca kaḥ |
kaḥ kasya putraḥ kastātaḥ kā mātā kasyacit kutaḥ ||59||
āyānti yānti saṃsāraṃ paraṃ svakṛtakarmabhiḥ |
karmānusārājjantuśca jāyate sthānabhedataḥ ||1.521.60||
karmaṇā jāyate kaścid viprāṇyāṃ vā nṛpastriyām |
vaiśyāyāṃ vā śūdranāryāṃ paśau pakṣiṇi vṛkṣake ||6 1 ||
nārāyaṇapradatteṣu sānandā viṣayeṣu te |
dehatyāge viṣaṇṇāśca viyoge bāndhavasya ca ||62||
māyayā tatkṛtaṃ sarvaṃ kanyā vadhūrvirāgiṇī |
avasthāstā vibhinnā vai ekasyā eva yoṣitaḥ ||63||
prajābhūmidhanādināṃ vicchedo maraṇādhikaḥ |
nityaṃ bhavati mūḍhasya viduṣo na kadācana ||64||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktastadyājī tatparāyaṇaḥ |
kṛṣṇamantropāsakaśca kṛṣṇasevārato bhava ||65||
yadbhayād vāti vāto’yaṃ ravirbhāti ca nityaśaḥ |
bhāti candro mahendraśca kālabhede pravarṣati ||66||
vahnirdahati mṛtyuśca caratyeva tu jantuṣu |
bibharti vṛkṣaḥ kālena puṣpāṇi ca phalāni ca ||67||
vyomādhāro’pi vāyuśca vāyvādhāraṃ jalādikam |
jalādhāraḥ kacchapaśca tadādhāro hyanantakaḥ ||68||
anantaśeṣabhogeṣu brahmāṇḍāni ca parvatāḥ |
niścalaṃ ca jalaṃ tasmājjalastheyaṃ vasundharā ||69||
saptasvargaṃ dharādhāraṃ jyotiścakraṃ grahāśrayam |
aṣṭāvaraṇayuktānāṃ brahmāṇḍānāṃ mahāvirāṭ ||1.521.70||
ādhārastasya vai bhūmā mahāviṣṇuḥ sadāśivaḥ |
tasyādhāraśca vaikuṇṭho golokaśca tadāśrayaḥ ||71 ||
golokasyāśrayo’nantākṣaradhāma paraṃ śubham |
brahmalokaḥ parāt paraḥ paramaṃ dhāma tatparam ||72||
divyaṃ sarvatra saṃvyāptaṃ sīmavarjitameva tat |
yatra vai sarvadhāmāni tripādasyāmṛtaṃ divi ||73||
pādo’sya viśvā bhūtāni paraṃ tato na vidyate |
tatrasthaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ gopālabālakam ||74||
kambharānandanaṃ rājan bhajākṣarapatiṃ harim |
parame dhāmani so’yaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ ||75||
ananta muktamadhyastho vartate puruṣottamaḥ |
akṣare ca tathā dhāmni vartate’kṣarapūruṣaḥ ||76||
rādhākṛṣṇaśca goloke vaikuṇṭhe śrīpatiḥ prabhuḥ |
śivaloke śivarūpaḥ satye brahmā harirmataḥ ||77||
tejasvināṃ ca vai sūryaḥ pavitrāṇāṃ tathānalaḥ |
dravāṇāṃ sa harirvāri cendriyāṇāṃ manaḥ sa ca ||78||
śīghragānāṃ samīraḥ sa daṇḍadānāṃ yamo hi saḥ |
kālaḥ kalayatāṃ so’pi cākṣarāṇāmavarṇakaḥ ||79||
sāmnāṃ sāma surāṇāṃ sa indro rājñāṃ pratāpakaḥ |
īśānaḥ saṃ digīśānāṃ kubero dhanināṃ hi saḥ ||1.521.80 ||
vyāpakānāṃ namaḥ so’pi sākṣī cāpi sa eva hi |
taijasānāṃ suvarṇaṃ sa ratnaṃ dhaneṣu caiva saḥ ||81 ||
maṇīnāṃ kaustubhaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ |
śālagrāmastathārcyānāṃ patrāṇāṃ tulasī ca sā ||82||
puṣpāṇāṃ pārijātaḥ saḥ tīrthānāṃ puṣkaraḥ sa ca |
vaiṣṇavānāṃ kumāraḥ sa yogīndrāṇāṃ gaṇādhipaḥ ||83 ||
senāpatīnāṃ skandaḥ saḥ naro dhanuṣmatāṃ hi saḥ |
nakṣatrāṇāṃ śaśī so’yaṃ rāmaḥ śastrabhṛtāṃ hi saḥ ||84||
māsānāṃ mārgaśīrṣaḥ saḥ vasantaḥ saḥ kratūttamaḥ |
rājendrāṇāṃ ca rāmaḥ so’vatārāṇāṃ narāyaṇaḥ ||85||
śrīkṛṣṇaḥ sa bhagavatāṃ vāreṣu ravivāsaraḥ |
tithiṣvekādaśīrūpaḥ pṛthvī kṣamāvatāṃ hi saḥ ||86||
apatyānāṃ sa vai mātā bhakṣyāṇāṃ tvamṛtaṃ hi saḥ |
gavyeṣvājyaṃ sa vai prokto druṣu kalpadrumo hi saḥ ||87||
surabhiḥ kāmadhenūnāṃ gaṃgā saḥ saritāṃ hariḥ |
paṇḍitānāṃ vāṇīrūpo mantrāṇāṃ praṇavaśca saḥ ||88||
parā vidyā ca vidyānāṃ sasyānāṃ dhānyameva saḥ |
aśvatthaḥ phalināṃ kṛṣṇo gurūṇāṃ mantradaśca saḥ ||89||
kaśyapaḥ saḥ prajeśānāṃ garuḍaḥ pakṣiṇāṃ hi saḥ |
anantaḥ sa ca nāgānāṃ narāṇāṃ nṛpatiḥ sa hi || 1.521.90||
brahmarṣīṇāṃ bhṛguḥ so’yaṃ devarṣīṇāṃ ca nāradaḥ |
rājarṣīṇāṃ janakaḥ sa maharṣīṇāṃ śukaḥ sa ca ||91 ||
gandharvāṇāṃ citrarathaḥ siddhānāṃ kapilaḥ sa ca |
lomaśaścirajīvānāṃ gururbuddhimatāṃ sa vai ||92||
śukraḥ kavivarāṇāṃ sa grahāṇāṃ ca śaniḥ sa vai |
śilpināṃ viśvakarmā saḥ mṛgāṇāṃ mṛgarāṭ sa vai ||93 ||
vāhānāṃ śivavāhaḥ sa airāvataśca hastiṣu |
gāyatrī chandasāṃ so’pi śāstrāṇāṃ veda eva saḥ ||94||
yādasāṃ varuṇaḥ kṛṣṇa ūrvaśyapsarasāṃ hi saḥ |
jalāśayānāṃ cābdhiḥ saḥ sumerurbhūdhareṣu saḥ ||95 ||
himādriḥ sa ratnavatāṃ rādhikā prakṛtiṣvapi |
devīnāṃ kamalā kṛṣṇaḥ śatarūpā ca yoṣitām ||96 ||
santaḥ priyāṇāṃ kṛṣṇaḥ sa sāvitrī suśilāsu saḥ |
prahlādaḥ so’pi daityānāṃ baliṣṭhānāṃ baliḥ sa ca ||97||
nārāyaṇarṣirbhagavān jñānināṃ brahmacāriṇām |
hanumān vānarāṇāṃ sa vīrāṇāṃ ca naraḥ svayam ||98
manasā nāgakanyānāṃ vasūnāṃ droṇa eva saḥ |
kāmināṃ kāmarūpaḥ sa raṃbhā saḥ kāmukīṣu vai ||99||
golokaḥ sa ca lokānāṃ dhāmnāṃ cākṣaradhāma saḥ |
vāsānāṃ śrīramāvāso vaikuṇṭho bhagavān hi saḥ ||1.521.1 0 0||
śāntirmātṛkavarge saḥ ratiḥ sa sundarīṣu vai |
dharmaḥ sākṣigaṇe so’sti sandhyā vai vāsareṣu saḥ ||1 01 ||
deveṣvindro rākṣaseṣu vibhīṣaṇo hariḥ svayam |
kālāgnirudro rudrāṇāṃ saṃhāro bhairaveṣu saḥ || 1 02||
śaṃkheṣu pāñcajanyaḥ saḥ śarīre mastakaṃ ca saḥ |
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitātmakaḥ svakathāsu saḥ || 1 03||
svāyaṃbhuvo manūnāṃ sa vyāso vidvatsu mādhavaḥ |
svadhā saḥ pitṛpatnīṣu svāhā vahnipriyāsu saḥ || 1 04||
yajñānāṃ rājasūyaḥ saḥ yajñapatnīṣu dakṣiṇā |
nītivatsvaṃgīrā sūtaḥ kathakeṣu harirhi saḥ || 1 05||
śastrāstrajñeṣu ca parśurāmo daivaṃ baleṣu ca |
vratānāṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmivrataṃ hi saḥ || 1 06||
dātṝṇāmindradyumnaḥ sa dūrvā sa oṣadhiṣvapi |
tṛṇānāṃ darbharūpaḥ saḥ satyaṃ vrateṣu dhārmiṣu || 1 07||
snehapātreṣu putraḥ saḥ sa vyādhiḥ śatrumaṇḍale |
sevāsu dāsyameva śrīharirvaro vareṣu ca || 1 08||
āśrameṣu gṛhasthaḥ saḥ sannyāsaśca vivekiṣu |
sudarśanaṃ saḥ śastrāṇāṃ kuśalaṃ saḥ śubhāśiṣām || 1 09||
aiśvaryāṇāṃ mahājñānaṃ vairāgyaṃ ca sukheṣu saḥ |
miṣṭavākyaṃ prītideṣu dāneṣu cātmadānakam || 1.521.11 0||
sañcayeṣu dharmakāryaṃ karmaṇāṃ cārcanaṃ hi saḥ |
kaṭhoreṣu tapaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ phaleṣu mokṣa eva saḥ || 111 ||
nārīṣu cānuvṛttiḥ saḥ nareṣu vīryameva saḥ |
aṣṭasiddhiṣu prākāmyaṃ kāśī kṛṣṇaḥ purīṣu ca || 1 12||
nagareṣu kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya nagaraṃ hi saḥ |
deśeṣu vaiṣṇavakṣetraṃ virāṭ tathāśrayeṣu saḥ || 113 ||
sūkṣmeṣu paramāṇuḥ sa hyauṣadhyādau rasāyanam |
vaidyānāmaśvinīputrau viṣādaḥ kṣayakāriṇām || 1 14||
dhanvantarirmantravidāṃ miṣṭānāṃ ca kṣudhā hi saḥ |
rāgāṇāṃ meghamallāraḥ śrīdāmā pārṣadeṣu saḥ || 1 15||
paśujantuṣu dhenuḥ saḥ vṛkṣeṣu candanaṃ hi saḥ |
vaiṣṇavaḥ sarvapūteṣu kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hi saḥ || 116 ||
vṛkṣeṣvaṃkurarūpaḥ saḥ vastuṣu cākaro hi saḥ |
sarvabhūteṣu vai kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’sti sarvadā || 1 17||
yathā vṛkṣe phalānyeva phale bīje tathāṅkuraḥ |
sarvakāraṇarūpaḥ saḥ nānyadvai kāraṇāntaram || 1 18||
sarveśaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ |
tanmāyāmohamāpannāstaṃ na jānanti durdhiyaḥ || 11 9||
tamograstena durbuddhyā vidhinā vañcitena ca |
svātmā saḥ sarvajantūnāṃ svāmī vai sarvadehinām || 1.521.120 ||
bhaja taṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ rājan prabhāpatim |
svargaṃ mokṣaṃ labhasvāpi bhajitvā pārvatīpatim || 121 ||
imaṃ vibhūtiyogaṃ yo jñānavijñānakārakam |
paṭhedvā śṛṇuyāttasyopasthitaḥ śrīharirbhavet || 1 22||
maṃjulā mañjuṣā ceyaṃ munīnāṃ manasāṃ sthirā |
haṃsā paramahaṃsānāṃ mānasī saguṇā hareḥ || 1 23|||
yāmabhyasya bhaved yogī dharmameghasamādhimān |
sarvasiddhipramājñaptibodhānandamayo bhavet || 1 24||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne indradyumnāya lomaśoktajñānavijñānavibhūtisaṃbhṛtabhagavanmahimādinirūpaṇanāmaikaviṃśatyadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||521 ||

<1.522>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi tataścāpi lomaśaḥ sa mahāmuniḥ |
indradyumne dadau jñānaṃ līnaṃ māyikavāyunā || 1 ||
lomaśaḥ prāha rājastvaṃ śṛṇu vṛttaṃ purābhavam |
ekadā nāradaḥ satyāllokācchrībadarīvanam || 2 ||
nārāyaṇaṃ naraṃ draṣṭuṃ tīrthayātrāprasaṃgataḥ |
viśālāyāṃ tadā tvāsīt svāyaṃbhuvamanoḥ sutaḥ ||3 ||
tapasyāṃ saṃprakurvan śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ japan |
priyavratābhidhānastaṃ dṛṣṭvā śrīnārado muniḥ || 4 ||
yayau tasya tu nikaṭe rājā nanāma cādarāt |
rājā ceṣṭvā bahuyajñairvipulairbhūridakṣiṇaiḥ || 5 ||
nivṛttiṃ dharmamāśritya sādhuṃ nanāma nāradam |
abhyutthānena ca mudā jvaladbhāskaratejasam || 6 ||
dadau pādyaṃ cāsanaṃ sunaivedyaṃ badarīphalam |
tataḥ papraccha kuśalaṃ papraccha lokavartanam || 7 ||
bhagavan kiñcidāścaryametasmin kṛtasaṃjñite |
yuge dṛṣṭaṃ śrutaṃ vāpi tanme kathaya nārada || 8 ||
nāradaḥ prāha dṛṣṭaṃ yacchṛṇuṣvāścaryamadbhutam |
hyastane’hani rājendra śvetadvīpaṃ gato’bhavam || 9 ||
tatra dugdhasaro dṛṣṭvā phullapaṃkajaśobhitam |
tathā tasya taṭe ramyāṃ kumārīṃ pṛthulocanām || 1.522.1 0||
dṛṣṭvāhaṃ vismayāpannastāṃ kanyāmāyatekṣaṇām |
pṛṣṭavānasmi rājendra tadā madhurabhāṣiṇīm || 11 ||
kāsi bhadre kathaṃ vāsi kiṃ vā kāryamiha tvayā |
kartavyaṃ cārusarvām̐gi tanmamācakṣva sundari || 1 2||
evamuktā mayā sā ca māṃ dṛṣṭvānimiṣekṣaṇā |
kṣaṇaṃ tūṣṇīṃ sthitā yāvat tāvanme jñānamuttamam || 1 3||
vismṛtaṃ sarvavedāśca śāstrāṇi saṃhitāstathā |
yogāḥ śikṣāstathā sarvā dharmanyāyāḥ kalādayaḥ || 14||
sarve dṛṣṭvaiva me rājan kumāryāpahṛtaṃ kṣaṇāt |
tato’haṃ vismayāviṣṭaścintāśokākulaḥ svayam || 15|||
tāmeva śaraṇaṃ gatvā hṛdā paśyāmi tāṃ punaḥ |
tāvad divyaḥ pumām̐stasyāḥ śarīre samadṛśyata || 16||
tasyāpi puṃso hṛdaye tvaparastasya corasi |
anyo raktekṣaṇaḥ śrīmān dvādaśādityasannibhaḥ || 17||
evaṃ dṛṣṭvā pumāṃso’tra trayaḥ kanyāśarīragāḥ |
kṣaṇena līnāḥ kanyaikā prapaśyāmi na tānpunaḥ || 18||
tataḥ pṛṣṭā mayā devī sā kumārī kathaṃ mama |
vedā naṣṭā mamācakṣva bhadre tannāśakāraṇam || 1 9||
kanyā prāha ca mātāhaṃ vedānāṃ tava nārada |
sāvitrī brahmaṇaḥ patnī jananī tava nārada ||1.522.20||
tvayā nāhaṃ samāgatya satkṛtā vā namaskṛtā |
māṃ na jānāsi yena tvaṃ tato vedā hatāstava || 21 ||
sāvitrīṃ cāpi gāyatrīṃ yo na jānāti vai dvijaḥ |
tasya jñānaṃ tu vedānāṃ jāyate na kadācana ||22||
mātṛnāśe bhavennāśaḥ putrāṇāṃ mātṛsevinām |
mātṛbhaktāśca te putrā vinā kvāpi ca mātaram ||23||
nahi tiṣṭhanti pātreṣu vedā naṣṭāstatastava |
mātṛpūjā na kurvanti manvate na ca mātaram ||24||
namanti mātaraṃ naiva te syurmūrkhā jaḍātmakāḥ |
mātaraṃ nahi jānanti sevante na ca mātaram ||25||
āśīrvādavihīnāste jaḍā bhavanti tāmasāḥ |
mātṛduḥkhaṃ kṛtaṃ yena mātā naiva ca poṣitā ||26||
garbhabhārahatā tena kṛtā mātāvamānitā |
te vicittāstathonmattā daridrā duḥkhinastathā ||27||
udvejinaḥ savighnāśca rugṇā bhavanti putrakāḥ |
tasmānmātā piturdaśaguṇā mānyā sutena vai ||28||
kāryārthaṃ gamane kvāpi mātāhvayati pṛṣṭhataḥ |
tatkāryaṃ saphalaṃ siddhyenmātā tasmādgarīyasī ||29||
pitā bījapradātā tannavamāsān pupoṣa yā |
kaṣṭaṃ prasahya sūte taṃ pañcavarṣāṇi rakṣati || 1.522.3 0||
mūtramalādi bālasya prakṣālayati sarvadā |
tasmācchataguṇā mātā bālaṃ kaṭyāṃ dadhāti yā ||3 1 ||
udare ca tathā kaṭyāṃ hṛdye ca dadhāti yā |
sadā pūjyatamā mātā sevanīyā śubhecchubhiḥ ||32||
nāradastāṃ samutthāya jñātvā mātaramityatha |
natvā prapūjya papraccha ke trayaḥ puruṣā iti ||33 ||
mātovāca mayi dṛṣṭaḥ sarvāṃgaścāruśobhanaḥ |
eṣa ṛgvedanāmā vai vedo nārāyaṇaḥ svayam ||34||
vahnibhūto dahatyāśu pāpānyuccāraṇādanu |
etasya hṛdaye yo’yaṃ dṛṣṭa āsīttvayātmaja ||35||
sa yajurvedarūpeṇa sthito brahmā mahābalaḥ |
tasyāpyurasi saṃviṣṭo ya eṣa śucirujjvalaḥ || 36||
sāmavedo mahābhāgavatabhaktaḥ sa śaṃkaraḥ |
eṣa ādityavat pāpānyāśu nāśayati smṛtaḥ ||37||
ete trayo mahāvedāstathā devāstrayaśca te |
etasmin sarasi putra jñānātmake mamāntike ||38||
snātvā gṛhāṇa vedādīn sarvajñatvaṃ tathā labha |
kṛte vedasaraḥsnāne prāgbhavīyaṃ smariṣyasi ||39||
evamuktvā tirobhāvaṃ gatā mātā tadā mama |
ahaṃ tatra kṛtasnāno labdhvā sahasrajanmajam ||1.522.40||
jñānaṃ samāgataścātrāścaryaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ hi tanmayā |
tatraikaṃ mama te janma kathayāmi purābhavam ||41 ||
pūrvakalpe bhavānāsīd rājā bāhudhano bhuvi |
dakṣiṇe paścime deśe siṃhāraṇye ca raivate ||42||
tadāhamabhavaṃ tatra śatruṃjitānadītaṭe |
brāhmaṇo vedavidyādiniṣṇātaḥ śāradābhidhaḥ ||43||
bahubhṛtyaparīvāro bahudhānyadhanādimān |
kintu jñānena sampannaścāsaṃ paramabuddhimān ||44||
tato dhyātaṃ mayaikānte kimanena karomyaham |
dvandvena sarvametaddhi nyasya putreṣu yāmyaham ||45||
tapase dhṛtasaṃkalpo vicārya ca rasāyanam |
dāsyabhaktyā haristuṣyet pitaraḥ śrāddhakarmabhiḥ ||46 ||
devā yajñairjanā dānaiḥ striyaḥ kāmaiḥ ripuḥ kṣayaiḥ |
tato’haṃ nirgato gehādaśvapaṭṭasaraḥ prati ||47||
lomaśo yatra vai śaśvad rājate sarasastaṭe |
tatra gatvā mayā viṣṇuḥ purāṇapuruṣottamaḥ ||48||
ārādhito’tisadbhaktyā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ |
tato me bhagavām̐stuṣṭaḥ pratyakṣatāṃ jagāma me ||49||
stuto mayā tadā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśca tadyathā |
paraṃ parāṇāmamṛtaṃ purāṇaṃ puruṣaṃ prabhum ||1.522.50||
namāmyapratimaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ patiṃ param |
īśitāraṃ hariṃ cogratejasaṃ vīryavattamam |||51||
parabrahma pareśaṃ tvāṃ staumi nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum |
śrīpatiṃ kambharālakṣmībālaṃ gopālabālakam ||52||
rādhālakṣmīramāpadmāprabhāpadmāvatīpatim |
pārvatīmāṇikīgaṃgālalitāmanasāpatim ||53||
satāṃ ca svāminaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ namāmyaham |
prasiddhaḥ śaraṇaṃ me’stu kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||54||
pradhāneśaśca dhāmeśo hyakṣareśaḥ satīpatiḥ |
sahasramūrdhānantākṣo’nantabāhūrupādavān ||55||
kṣīrasthaścāmṛtasthaśca kuṃkumavāpikāsthitaḥ |
triyugaśca trivedasthaḥ kṛte śvetatanuśca yaḥ ||56||
tato raktaśca pītaśca kṛṣṇaścāpi tataḥ punaḥ |
vartate bahudhā yaśca viprān mukhāt sasarja yaḥ ||57||
bhujayorbahudhā kṣatraṃ corvorviśaḥ padāccarān |
varṇān sasarja yo devo viśvatanuṃ namāmi tam ||58||
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadhanurdhvajatriśūlavān |
svastikasvarṇarekhātmaśrīvatsahāraśobhitaḥ ||59||
śaraṇaṃ me sadā cāstu muktido mestu vai bhavān |
itistuto mayā devaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||1.522.6 0||
varaṃ vṛṇīṣvetyasakṛt prāhāhaṃ mokṣamiṣṭavān |
iṣṭadevaśca māṃ prāha bhaja tvaṃ prakṛtiṃ mune ||61 ||
mamājñayā ca pravṛttirmokṣa eva na saṃśayaḥ |
vinājñāṃ me ca nivṛttirbandhanāya bhaved dhruvam ||6 2 ||
tasmāt kalpāntaraṃ yāhi sāyaṃ jāto’dya vai divā |
nāraṃ pānīyamityuktaṃ nāraṃ jñānaṃ tathocyate ||63 ||
nāraṃ tvātmasthitaṃ viṣṇuṃ yo dadāti sa nāradaḥ |
sadā te nāma caitadvai khyātaṃ samyag bhaviṣyati ||64||
evamuktaśca taṃ natvā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum |
lomaśaṃ taṃ maharṣiṃ ca rājam̐stvadgṛhamāgataḥ ||6 5 ||
tvayā sammānitaścāhaṃ tvarthito mokṣaṇaṃ prati |
mayāpyuktaṃ bhaja kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ patiṃ prabhum ||66 ||
pravṛttiṃ ca harernārāyaṇasyaiva kuru nṛpa |
tvayā rājyaṃ parityaktaṃ nirgatastvaṃ mayā saha ||67||
brahmalokaṃ gatau cāvāṃ rātrirjātā dinasya ca |
divasaśca punaḥ sṛṣṭo brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinā ||68||
tatrāhaṃ nāradī jātaḥ smṛto nṛpa bhavān mayā |
priyavrataḥ sa evāyaṃ ceti tvāṃ draṣṭumāgataḥ ||69||
yasmānnārāyaṇaṃ dhyātvā prāpto’smi gurutāṃ nṛpa |
tasmāt tvamapi rājendra bhava viṣṇuparāyaṇaḥ ||1.522.70||
matsyaḥ kūrmo varāhaśca narasiṃho’tha vāmanaḥ |
rāmo rāmaśca kṛṣṇaśca buddhaḥ kalkī ca te daśa ||71 ||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaviṣṇormūrtayastāḥ śubhapradāḥ |
darśanaṃ prāptumicchūnāṃ sopānāni ca śobhanāḥ ||72||
yattāsāṃ paramaṃ rūpaṃ dṛṣṭavānahameva tat |
purā kalpe tadā tatra kuṃkumavāpikālaye ||73||
naranārāyaṇau cātra mūrtī tasyaiva śobhane |
brahmacaryavratasthe’tra lokakalyāṇahetave ||74||
dharā mūrtistasya cādyā sarvadhāraṇapoṣikā |
dvitīyā salilaṃ mūrtistṛtīyā taijasī prabhā ||75||
caturthī prāṇamūrtirvāyurvyomākhyā tu pañcamī |
mana ātmā cāntarātmā harestāścāṣṭamūrtayaḥ ||76||
abhivyāptamidaṃ sarvaṃ jagannārāyaṇena hi |
ityukto nāradenāsau rājā bhāgavato mahān ||77||
nārāyaṇātmakaṃ brahmaparaṃ japtvā svayaṃbhuvaḥ |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇamanāḥ paraṃ nirvāṇamāptavān ||78||
ityevaṃ lomaśaḥ sarvaṃ kathayāmāsa bhūbhṛte |
indradyumnāya vijñānaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāśritam ||79||
śrutvā lakṣmi mahābhāgavato rājā tutoṣa ha |
punastaṃ lomaśaṃ prāha sudhāṃ cātmāśritāṃ mune ||1.522.80||
pātraṃ matvā śubhaṃ śiṣyaṃ brahmāmṛtaṃ ca pāyaya |
ityukte lomaśastaṃ ca brahmajñānaṃ tato’bravīt ||81 ||
vaidikaṃ sāmavedoktamārṣaṃ ca gahanaṃ tathā |
jñānacakṣuṣmatā grāhya hṛtprakāśakṛtāṃ sthiram ||82||
dhyātṝṇāṃ pacanīyaṃ ca brahmaupaniṣadaṃ param |
yacchrutvā vāsanālipto brahmabhūyāya kalpate ||83 ||
chidyate hṛdayagranthirbhidyate saṃśayastathā |
līyate tāmaso bhāvo vardhante sukhasampadaḥ ||84||
kṣīyante sarvakarmāṇi śuṣkārdrāṇi dṛḍhānyapi |
yajjñānenāntaraṃ cakṣuraiśvaryāḍhyaṃ prakāśate ||85||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne kuṃkumavāpīkṣetre lomaśendradyumnasaṃvāde nāradasya śvetadvīpe sāvitryāṃ jñānahrāsastataḥ sāvitrīpradavedādijñānaṃ, badaryāṃ priyavratāya tatkathanaṃ, priyavratasya mokṣaḥ, bhagavaddhāmāvatārāvatārijñānaphalaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvāviṃśatyadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||522||

<1.523>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
ekāgramānasī bhūtvā kṛtvātmani pareśvaram |
kathyamānāṃ parāṃ vidyāṃ lomaśoktāṃ tu bhūbhṛte || 1 ||
ākarṇaya bahirvṛttiṃ tyaktvānyā mokṣakāriṇīm |
yāmāśrityarṣayaḥ sarve niṣedurbrahmaṇo’ntike || 2 ||
lomaśaḥ prāha rājānam omityātmānamāntaram |
smṛtvā dhyātvā yathoktaṃ ca kathayāmi nibodha me || 3 ||
oṃ namaḥ parabrahmaṇe bhrājadabhrājadvarṣmaṇe |
brahmasavitre’kṣarabrahmādivāsyāya trikraṇe || 4 ||
divye brahmapure yo ha divyamūrtiḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ |
amūrtamūrteṣvantaryāmī mūrtaśca paraṃ hi tat || 5 ||
viprāso vidyuratrapuruṣamadvarūpamatijñam |
kamanāsyaṃ kapyākṣaṃ yugagrahagaṃ puruṣottamam || 6 ||
parāṇakhasvaruṇimnībhirbhrājate pari ya ut yaḥ |
hṛdruhadakṣabhrāṃkanaṃ yamete’tra santo biduḥ || 7 ||
brahmagavā vividuretamīśvarīndubhaprabhālam |
tilasumanonāsaṃ nṛrūpaṃ vibhāntamāpūrṇam || 8 ||
hiraṇyakeśamakuṇṭhadṛśyaṃ yatte’ntarābhitaḥ |
kiśorapratimaṃ saccidānandamayogaṃ preyuḥ || 9 ||
brahmapātrāṇi ha vai samupāsata śreyaḥkhaṇeyam |
ṣoḍaśakalaṃ patkajāntarābhaṃ parasya pūṣṇaḥ || 1.523.1 0||
kalā bhavante’ṣṭāstryūllekhāsvastikādikā dakṣe |
vyomārdhenduśapharādyā dakṣetare’sya caraṇe || 11 ||
eko hyeṣaḥ sarvayantā surūpo
rūpaṃ rūpaṃ rūpyamāṇo’dhiśete |
sahasradhā cāpyatha nāntadhā san
samānarūpo rūpyate’kṣayyaloke || 12||
sarve jīvā īśvarāścātha muktā
guṇātītaṃ cākṣaraṃ brahmamūlam |
yasyānandaṃ labdhvānandībhavanti
hyeṣaḥ sahajānandabhūmiḥ parātmā || 13 ||
sarve jīvā īśvarāścātha muktā
guṇātītaṃ cākṣaraṃ brahmamūlam |
yasyaiśvaryaṃ labdhvā īśā bhavanti
hyeṣaḥ sahajaiśvaryabhūmiḥ parātmā || 14||
sarve jīvā īśvarāścātha muktā
guṇātītaṃ cākṣaraṃ brahmamūlam |
yasya vittiṃ labdhvā vido bhavanti
hyeṣaḥ sahajavittibhūmiḥ parātmā || 15||
sarve jīvā īśvarāścātha muktā
guṇātītaṃ cākṣaraṃ brahmamūlam |
yasyā sattāṃ labdhvā santo bhavanti
hyeṣaḥ sahajasatyabhūmiḥ parātmā || 16 ||
sarve jīvā īśvarāścātha muktā
guṇātītaṃ cākṣaraṃ brahmamūlam |
yasya tṛptiṃ labdhvā tṛptā bhavanti
hyeṣaḥ sahajatṛptibhūmiḥ parātmā || 17||
araṃ dāso na mīhluṣe karāṇyahaṃ devāya bhūrṇaye’nāgāḥ |
acetayadacitto devo aryo gṛtsaṃ rāye kavitaro junāti || 18||
veśobhagyasya śāntāteḥ kaṇe dhūmā ramannā īśanāni kat tam |
stavāmanenasaṃ gṛbhaṃ taruṣema enaḥ prayuñjya tsarūpaṇīśanībhiḥ || 19||
parāñci tat khāni parātmarūpāṇyabhinnatattvānyapi bhakticārāt |
pṛthagbhidheyāni haranti tajjñā rasaikaśaktīnyapṛthagbhūtaṃ hi tat || 1.523.20 ||
śrotrasya śrotraṃ manaso manastat
vāco ha vāk cakṣuṣastaddhi cakṣuḥ |
tvacastvamityeva tadīyaśaktayo
muktasya khānāmuta brahmaṇastat ||21 ||
jñānasvarūpo’tha manaḥsvarūpo
jñānasya vittirmana eva tasya |
tadeva dhīrhrīśca tadeva kāmo
medhā tathecchā dhiṣaṇā kṛtaśca || 22||
pumaṃkapūrṇe’pi ratirna guptā prākāmyasevye’pi na rūpataḥ strīḥ |
grāhye’pi tasminna hatiḥ khavitterviyogayoge’pi na tattvavyāhatiḥ ||23||
amātṛjatvānnahi koṣaṣaṭkam
anannakoṣānnahi cityacityatiḥ |
prāṇaḥ svaśaktistadaprāṇakasya
kāśo’pi nirāvaraṇātmabhāvaḥ || 24||
anannagrāsānnahi mehanādikaṃ
tato na gurvādi kuto hi nidrā |
nityaprasannasya kuto’prasannatā
preṣṭyaikabhāvānna pareṣṭadhīnatā ||25||
hiraṇyakeśāśca hiraṇyavannakhāḥ
sukundadantā nahi yogabhāginaḥ |
cidaikarūpā ramaṇīyasyātmakāḥ
sadaikamānāḥ pravibhānti tasya ||26||
ago’pi gantā manaso javīyo’
viprāṃsa enaṃ nāpnuvan prāgupāsteḥ |
vipreṣṭako’nyānatyeti javīyaḥ
tiṣṭhannaciti citi cāpi īśaḥ ||27||
tadabhyāśe na bhayaṃ kiṃcanāsti
na tatrānyat kiṃcanāpūrvamasti |
ubhau tīrtvā jīvamāyeśabhāvau
dhūmrātigo modate tatsayujaḥ ||28||
śravaṇāyāpi bahubhiryo na labhyaḥ
śṛṇvanto’pi bahavo yaṃ na vidyuḥ |
niyāmyajñaṃ tamīḍyaṃ viditvā
nicāyya tāṃ śāntimatyantameti ||29||
taṃ durdarśaṃ gūḍhamanupraviṣṭaṃ
guhāhitaṃ gahvareṣṭhaṃ purāṇam |
adhyātmayogādhigamena devaṃ
matvā dhīraḥ puṇyapāpe jahāti ||1.523.30||
aṇoraṇīyānmahato mahīyān
laghorlaghīyām̐śca gurorgarīyān |
tamakriyaḥ paśyati dhūtapāpo
hareḥ prasādāt prapūritasatvaḥ ||3 1 ||
na saḥ parātmā pravacanena labhyo na medhayā na bahunā śrutena |
yamevaiṣa vṛṇute tena labhyastasya parātmā vivṛṇute tanuṃ svām ||32||
aśuklamakṛṣṇamarājasaṃ tat
niyāmakaṃ nityamanantapāram |
anādinaṃ brahmaparaṃ dhruvaṃ hariṃ
nicāyya taṃ mṛtyumukhātpramucyate || 33||
sa brahmasat muktasadīśasadvasuravyaktasajjīvasadeva kāryasat |
tathāpi na lipyate hyantarātmā alepyaśaktiḥ pratirūpako’sau ||34||
vaśyadvitīyaḥ sarvabhūtāntarātmā bījaṃ pradhānaṃ bahurūpaṃ vyākaroti |
tamāntaraṃ ye paripaśyantimuktāsteṣāṃ śāntiḥ śāśvatī netareṣām ||35||
nityo nityānāṃ cetanaścetanānāmeko bahūnāṃ yo vidadhāti kalpān |
tamāntarasthaṃ ye paripaśyanti muktāsteṣāṃ śāntiḥ śāśvatī netareṣām ||36||
na bhāti savitā tadagre na kaumudīśo na saudāminyo bhānti kuto’nalo’yam |
tameva bhāntamanu bhāti sarvaṃ tadantastasya bhāsā sarvamidaṃ pravibhāti tat sat| ||37||
aśvatthaloke bhayādasya sūryastapatyagnirvahati cāpyanilaḥ |
īśā apyaṇḍaṃ parikurvanti yadbhayāttaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ yānti tadvidaḥ ||38||
tamacchāyaṃ śubhraṃ snehamūrtiṃ śīlabhrājat nityavijñānadharmam |
sveṣṭaṃ devaṃ vedayate yastu vidvān sa tatprasādāt tadvat sārvajñyameti ||39||
tamadreśyamagrāhyamagotramavarṇamacakṣuḥśrotraṃ tamapāṇipādam |
nityaṃ vibhuṃ sarvagataṃ susūkṣmaṃ tamavyathaṃ kāryayoniṃ paripaśyanti muktāḥ ||1.523.40||
yathorṇanābhiḥ sṛjate gṛhṇate ca
yathā kṣitāvoṣadhayo bhavanti |
yathā sato narāt keśalomāni saṃbhavanti
tathā pareśāt saṃbhavatīha viśvam ||41 ||
paraṃ brahmaivedamamṛtaṃ purastāt|
paraṃbrahma paścād dakṣiṇe cottare ca |
adhaścordhvaṃ vyāpakaṃ brahmakṛtyā
paraṃ brahmavyāptamidaṃ viśvaṃ samastam ||42||
na cakṣuṣā gṛhyate nāpi vācā nānyairdevaistapasā karmaṇā vā |
jñānaprasādena viśuddhasattvastatastu taṃ paśyati dhyāyamānaḥ ||43||
bṛhacca taddivyamacintyarūpaṃ
sūkṣmācca tatsūkṣmataraṃ vibhāti |
dūrāt sudūre tadihāntike ca
paśyatsvihaiva nihitaṃ guhāyām ||44||
satyena labhyastapasā saḥ parātmā
māhātmyajñānena brahmacaryeṇa nityam |
svasya svarūpe divyarūpo hi śubhro
yaṃ paśyanti yatayaḥ kṣīṇadoṣāḥ ||45||
yadā draṣṭā paśyati svarṇavarṇaṃ
vidhātāraṃ puruṣaṃ brahmapāram |
tadā vettā śuklakṛṣṇe vihāya
niravidyaḥ kṛṣṇasāmyaṃ prayāti ||46||
samāpadehe dehī nityaṃ nimagno
māyāgrāhyo muhyati śokameti |
yadā svānyaṃ paśyati sarvavyāptaṃ
tadā cātmā jāyate śokahīnaḥ ||47||
dvau tau sumitre caikavṛkṣaṃ śrayete’nyonyaṃ kārye protsāhanaprade staḥ |
adhīraiko gradhnayā cātti miṣṭaṃ dhīraścānyaḥ taṃ sutṛpto dadāti ||48||
yathāpagā vārdhibhāvaṃ prayānti
bhinnakhyātipratimāne visṛjya |
tathā jñātākhyāpratimāvidhuro’
kṣarātparaṃ divyapūruṣameti ||49||
parabrahma veda yo brahma sa syānna cāvartte bhramate karmakṛṣṭaḥ |
auṣṇyaṃ tyaktvodvejanaṃ vai jahāti hṛdbgranthibhistyajyate cāmṛtāya ||1.523.50||
yaścātra nityaṃ pratibodhamāptaścāsmindehe hṛdguhāyā virājan |
tadantaḥsthaḥ sṛṣṭikṛt sarvahartā vyatirekī vartate divyaloke ||5 1 ||
vidanti santo’tha vidmo vayaṃ tamavedane syātpatanaṃ mahatkṛtam |
tasyaiva vijñā amṛtāḥ sambabhūvuranye tu duḥkhaṃ cāvidyakaṃ yayurvai ||52||
evaṃ vidyānmahimānaṃ parātmano
nāsyāsti vṛddhiḥ karmabhirvā kṣatiśca |
tasyaiva bhūyāḥ padavit dhāmagantā
tamālambya lipyate nāghakarmabhiḥ ||5 3 ||
sarvaṃ yasya cākṣare brahmaṇi yat
sarvaṃ tasya muktavṛnde’nuṣaktam |
tadvai sarvamīśvareṣu praviṣṭaṃ tadevā
smin jīvabhūte tathānye ||54||
yadakṣare tad bhavatyeva kevale
tathā ha vai śabale vai nirañjane |
hiraṇmaye mahadviṣṇvākhye’tha viṣṇau
rudre’thāpi vartamāne virāje ||55 ||
prakṛtyādāvaṣṭakāvṛttikāsu
taleṣvatra dvisaptakeṣu virājate |
atra bhūmau rājate kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ
svāmī taṃ viditvāmṛtaṃ vraja ||56 ||
tasmāddhi sūkṣmacidacidviśiṣṭāt
sthūlaṃ hi cidacidviśiṣṭaṃ prajāyate |
upādānopādeyayorabhedāt
sarvaṃ tattvaṃ parabrahmaikameva ||57||
parātmanastasya pūrṇāvatāriṇaḥ
kācicchaktirvyūhasaṃjñāmupaiti |
kramānnyūnā saiva vibhavāvatārā
pūrṇāṃśamukhyāveśagauṇādirūpā ||58||
tattadyogāttatsvarūpasya labdhistasmin līnālīnabhāvaṃ hyupaiti |
parātmanaścopāsanayā pareśaṃ parāṃ muktimāpnuvantīti tat sat ||59||
muktādhāraṃ parabrahmavyāpyacetanamakṣaram |
sarvādhāraṃ parabrahmaśarīraṃ dhāma yatra saḥ ||1.523.6 0 ||
tadevāstyakṣaraṃ brahmadhāma tejomayaṃ hareḥ |
yāvadvedatapobrahmacaryacīrṇaṃ hi tatpadam ||6 1 ||
aśarīraṃ śarīraṃ ca mūrtaṃ cāmūrtamityapi |
śuddhaṃ nityaṃ ca māyādiprakāśakaṃ harestanu ||62||
saccidānandavāsātma janmamṛtyujarātigam |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmiśritaṃ sadvartate param ||6 3 ||
yadarcimatparabrahmatejo’bhinnaṃ sanātanam |
rajasaśca pare pāre tatrādhyakṣaṃ hariṃ bhaja ||64||
hiraṇmayātparātkośādapi cordhvaṃ ca niṣkalam |
śubhraṃ jyotirjyotiṣāṃ ca tatrādhyakṣaṃ hariṃ bhaja ||65 ||
yadgolomākṛtipratyaṃgānyabhinnātmaśaktayaḥ |
na vai bhāgo na vai tyāgo rasaikyaṃ ca pareśavat ||66 ||
sārvajñyaṃ śeṣasāpekṣaṃ tatrasthaṃ śrīhariṃ bhaja |
parabrahmagataṃ tejomayaṃ tatra hariṃ bhaja ||67||
muktā hyanādino nityā vasanti yatra śāśvate |
tatrasthaṃ śrīhariṃ rājan kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ bhaja ||6 8||
evamakṣaradhāmasthaṃ paradhāmasthitaṃ param |
bhajitvā sāmyabhāvāptā bahavastaṃ sadā bhaja ||6 9 ||
yaḥ setuḥ sarvadharmāṇāmakṣaraṃ brahma yasya bhūḥ |
tatrasthaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ jñātvā sadā bhaja ||1.523.70||
yaḥ syādasyānavajñānī bhaktidāsyavivarjitaḥ |
aśuddhaḥ sa na taṃ yāyāt saṃsārāgamaveṣṭitaḥ ||71 ||
aparokṣānubhavavām̐stasya nārāyaṇasya yaḥ |
sa ca taddhāma cāpnoti tato bhūyo na jāyate ||72||
bhaktirbalaṃ bhaved yasya jñānaṃ puṣṭipradaṃ tathā |
gurusevārathārūḍhaḥ prāpnoti śrīhareḥ padam ||73 ||
jīvebhyastu parā īśā īśebhyaḥ paramakṣaram |
akṣarātparamaṃ kāntaṃ jñātvā taddhāma cāpnuyāt ||74||
hṛdayagranthibhedāntaṃ sarvaṃ syādanuśāsanam |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇagranthiṃ labdhvā gaccha paraṃ padam ||75 ||
pare tvayi mayi cānye yo’sti taṃ bhaja sādaram |
mṛtyupāśān sa cāpnoti yastaṃ bhedena paśyati ||76 ||
hṛdā cāntaścakṣuṣā taṃ jñātvā nānāvivarjitam |
nānābhāvakṛtaṃ mṛtyuṃ hatvā yāhi paraṃ padam ||77||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ |
japa mantraṃ sadā rājan sa tvāṃ pāraṃ kariṣyati ||78||
visraṃsamānadehasya bandhanaṃ nāvaśiṣyate |
abandhanasya muktasya te kimatrāvaśiṣyate ||79||
ūrdhvamūlo’rvākpraśākha eṣo’śvattho mahān taruḥ |
taṃ vihāyākṣaraṃ brahma paśyāmṛtaṃ hariṃ vraja ||1.523.80||
yadbhayāt sarvatejāṃsi prakāśante vidhānavat |
īśā īśatvamāpannā yasmāttaṃ śrīhariṃ bhaja ||81 ||
hṛtsthān kāmān parihāya kṛṣṇaṃ cātra samaśnuhi |
amṛtaṃ paramānandaṃ bhuṃkṣva kṛṣṇanarāyaṇāt ||82||
satyaṃ tapo brahmacaryaṃ dāsyaṃ yeṣu pratiṣṭhitam |
teṣāṃ cāsti brahmaloko yeṣu jaihmyaṃ na nānṛtam ||83||
dve vidye sarvathā rājan parā vedyā tathāparā |
parayā tvāpyate kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’kṣare pade ||84||
tadanyāścāparāḥ sarvā yābhirbrahma na cāpyate |
ye vai parātmanaḥ preṣṭhāṃ vācaṃ sad vyāharanti te ||85||
puṇye brahmapade yānti dāsyaṃ śrīparamātmanaḥ |
parabrahma vijānāti sevate bhajate ca yaḥ ||86||
jāgrati cāntare svapne tryavasthottaravaibhave |
so’śnute sarvakāmāṃśca brahmaṇā saha miśritān ||87||
annaṃ prāṇaṃ mano jñānaṃ cānandaṃ tamavehi ca |
ātmānaṃ cāntarātmānaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ bhaja ||88||
kaṃbharāputrasevābhiḥ kenānandena pūryate |
gopālabālasevābhirgobhiḥ saṃbhriyate nṛpa ||89||
vāṇī manaśca viṣayaṃ karotyeva na yaṃ prabhum |
ānandaṃ taṃ hareryāhi kutaścana bhayaṃ na te ||1.523.90 ||
jñānād yajñāḥ prajāyante karmāṇyapi bhavanti ca |
sampadyate suratṛptiḥ śrīmatkṛṣṇe samarpite ||9 1 ||
parabrahma ca yo veda yastato na pramādyati |
māyāpāpmānamutsṛjya brahmabhogān samaśnute ||92||
santaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ pravadantaṃ santaṃ dhyāyantameva ca |
sevamānaṃ tathā santaṃ satpadaṃ sa hi karṣati ||9 3 ||
sa hi sṛṣṭvā tadevānuprāviśatsaḥ parātparaḥ |
satyaṃ yathānṛtaṃ tena satyamityeva buddhyate ||94||
asad vyākṛtabhāvaṃ ca sukṛtaṃ tena buddhyate |
so’kṣarātpuruṣadvārā naikāṇḍānyudapādayat ||95 ||
tasya parātmano yogāt teṣu satyaṃ ca sukṛtam |
akṣare ca yathā tadvajjñātvā mokṣamavāpnuyāt ||96||
sadeva rājan bhagavānabhūtpurā
tataḥ samastaṃ satsvarūpaṃ vikāsitam |
rasātmako’yaṃ sarvarasapradātā
labdhvā rasaṃ tasyānandībhavanti ||97||
asyānandena vai lokā bhavanti cābhayaṃ gatāḥ |
mano vāco na vai yānti yatra taṃ bhaja keśavam ||98||
tasmājjāyanta imāni jīvantyapi tataḥ prabhoḥ |
tatraiveme palīyante śāśvataṃ pralayaṃ vraja ||99||
paramātmā divyarūpo dhyeyaścāsītpurāgṛhe |
racayitvā dvitīyaṃ ca tatrovāsa ca taṃ bhaja || 1.523.10 0||
sthāvaraṃ jaṃgamaṃ sarvaṃ prajñānetraṃ prabhāsate |
prajñāne vartate yaśca taṃ netraṃ bhaja mādhavam || 101 ||
śāntaṃ sarvātmakaṃ brahmaparaṃ kaṃ khaṃ hariṃ bhaja |
śraddhayā tapasā divyaṃ netāraṃ tvarciṣācyutam || 1 02||
divyāntaḥsthaṃ śuklapakṣāntarātmānaṃ hariṃ bhaja |
uttarāyaṇamāsasthaṃ samvatsarāntarasthitam || 103 ||
ādityavartinaṃ candrāntarātmānaṃ ca taṃ bhaja |
vidyutprakāśadātāraṃ varuṇasthaṃ jalāntaram ||1 04||
indrāntaraṃ prajāpaterāntarasthaṃ virāḍgatam |
rudrahṛdayaṃ viṣṇusthaṃ mahāviṣṇupratiṣṭhitam || 1 05||
nirañjanasthaṃ śabalānvitaṃ kevalagaṃ bhaja |
akṣarabrahmago bhūtvā tatpumāṃsaṃ sadā bhaja || 1 06||
dānānāṃ phaladātāraṃ dhūmrarātristhitaṃ prabhum |
kṛṣṇapakṣāntarasthaṃ ca dakṣiṇāyanagaṃ harim || 1 07||
samvatsarāntarasthaṃ ca pitṛsthaṃ vyomagaṃ bhaja |
candrasthaṃ ca prajāpālasthitaṃ rājan sadā bhaja || 1 08||
vāyusthaṃ cābhrasaṃvāsaṃ meghasthaṃ kaṇavartinam |
bījasthaṃ kāryarūpaṃ cābhivyāptaṃ śrīhariṃ bhaja || 1 09||
ramaṇīyakhanijeṣu viprādiṣu hariṃ bhaja |
dayanīyakhanijeṣu gavādiṣu hariṃ bhaja || 1.523.11 0||
eṣa devo hatapāpmā vijaro mṛtyuvarjitaḥ |
viśokaḥ kṣuttṛṣāhīnaḥ satyakāmaprakalpanaḥ || 111 ||
tvatsvarūpastvatsamānastvādṛśaṃ taṃ prabhuṃ bhaja |
tasya rūpeṇa te cābhiniṣpattistaṃ tathā bhaja || 1 12||
krīḍannṛtyan kīrtayam̐ścānandayan saṃsmaran sadā |
svena rūpeṇa kurvantaṃ tvāṃ taṃ tathāvidhaṃ bhaja || 11 3||
vinā bhaktaṃ na ramate dvitīyaṃ taṃ hyakalpayat |
taṃ tvayi vyāptamevainaṃ hṛdayasthaṃ sadā bhaja || 1 14||
so’yamātmā tvayā rājan draṣṭavyo hṛtsthacakṣuṣā |
śrotavyo hṛcchravasā ca mantavyo divyatejasā || 1 15||
nirṇetavyastasya buddhyā na tyājyaḥ sa kadācana |
evaṃ sarvātmabhāvena paśya kṛṣṇaṃ sanātanam || 1 16||
tasmin sarvāṇi bhūtāni cārpitāni ca taṃ bhaja |
yaḥ pṛthivyāṃ jale vahnau vāyau vyomni ca taṃ bhaja || 1 17||
yasyemāni śarīrāṇi śarīrasthaṃ ca taṃ bhaja |
ātmā santaḥ pratimā ca yasya taṃ keśavaṃ bhaja || 1 18||
yasmāt sarve samānandā jīvā cānanditā yataḥ |
āptakāmaṃ mahānandaṃ pūrṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ bhaja || 1 19||
kāmān vihāya hṛdaye hariṃ sthāpaya bhāvataḥ |
sthitaṃ cāvehi vai rājan yāhi taṃ śaraṇaṃ bhaja || 1.523.1 20||
nānavāptaṃ tadā te’trāvaśiṣṭaṃ nahi śiṣyate |
saiṣā brāhmī parāvidyā pāṭhitā te pramokṣadā || 121||
athāyaṃ rājā santṛptaścātmanyeva janārdanam |
paramaṃ puruṣaṃ divyaṃ dadarśa puruṣottamam || 1 22||
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadhanuḥśūlādirājim |
rādhālakṣmīprabhāpadmāpārvatīmāṇikīśvaram || 123||
sarvābhiḥ sevikābhiśca sevitaṃ pārṣadaistathā |
hṛdaye taṃ prabhuṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ vilokya ca || 1 24||
tadicchayā bahiścāpi taṃ dadarśa śriyāḥpatim |
lomaśasya ca kṛpayā parāvidyāprabhāvataḥ || 1 25||
vyomnaḥ samāgataṃ divyaṃ vimānaṃ cātisundaram |
brahmaṇaścājñayā devadūtena tvadhivāsitam || 126||
devadūtaḥ samuvācāgacchāgaccha vimānake |
rājannayāmi te satyaṃ lokaṃ śrīparameṣṭhinaḥ || 1 27||
indradyumnaśca taṃ prāha na me satye prayojanam |
yāsyāmi śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya caraṇaṃ dhruvam || 1 28||
akṣarātparamaṃ dhāma lomaśasya kṛpālavāt |
ityukto devadūtaḥ sa yayau lokaṃ tu vedhasaḥ || 1 29||
indradyumno virarāma lomaśasya tu sannidhau |
lomaśastaṃ sarastīre tṛṇāsanaṃ dadau śubham || 1.523.1 30||
kadambadrumanikaṭe kṛṣṇanārāyaṇālaye |
rājā snātvā hariṃ dhyātvā pūjayitvā narāyaṇam || 131 ||
lomaśaṃ pūjayitvā ca ṛṣīnnatvā tadāśrame |
phalādi śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya vinivedya ca || 1 32||
samarpya gurave tatra bubhuje ca papau jalam|
yoganidrāṃ sukhamayīṃ lebhe rātrau hariṃ smaran || 1 33||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne indradyumnāya lomaśarṣisamupadiṣṭabrāhmīparāvidyaupaniṣadātmasmaraṇanāmā trayoviṃśatyadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||523||

<1.524>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
ākarṇaya mahālakṣmi lomaśasya kathāṃ śubhām |
prātaḥ samutthito rājā kṛtāhniko guruṃ prati || 1 ||
jagāma darśanārthaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam |
guruṇāśīryojitaḥ sa papraccha lomaśam ṛṣim || 2 ||
bhagavan mokṣadātastvaṃ māyātīto jitendriyaḥ |
vartase ca yathā dhāmni tathaivātra karāgradṛk || 3 ||
vada me bhagavaddhāmni kālo nāsti tataḥ prabho |
nityaḥ sevāprakārāderniyāmakaḥ kṣaṇātmakaḥ || 4 ||
dinātmako vyavahāraḥ kathaṃ bhaktairvidhīyate |
iti pṛṣṭo lomaśastu rājānaṃ prāha bhūpate || 5 ||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇamūrteḥ kiraṇaiḥ suprabhānvitaiḥ |
prasaradbhirbhinnarūpaiḥ kṣaṇādyāḥ santi sarvadā || 6 ||
tajjñāstatkiraṇaiḥ prātarmadhyaṃ sāyaṃ vidanti ca |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasteṣāṃ sevāṃ gṛhṇāti tatra ca || 7 ||
mūrtau līnasthitirnidrā dāsyasevā tu jāgratī |
śvetaprakāśanaṃ cāhaḥ sandhyā raktaprakāśanam || 8 ||
meghaśyāmāvaloke ca mūrtau sthairyaṃ niśeti ca |
goloke’pi tathā kṛṣṇakiraṇairvyavahṛtayaḥ || 9 ||
vaikuṇṭhe’pi tathā nārāyaṇatejaḥprarītayaḥ |
akṣare tu pare dhāmni parabrahmaprabhādibhiḥ || 1.524.1 0||
ityevaṃ tadgatebhyaśca śrutaṃ muktebhya eva yat |
kathitaṃ te cendradyumna kimanyat praṣṭumicchasi || 11 ||
indradyumnastato lakṣmi papraccha lomaśam ṛṣim |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścātra kṣetre prākaṭyamicchati || 12||
yadā tadā sa kiṃ mātṛgarbhe tiṣṭhati vā na vā |
bhautikaṃ kiṃ tasya varṣma utānyādṛśameva kim || 1 3||
chindhi me saṃśayaṃ jātaṃ laukikaṃ ca kṛpāṃ kuru |
lomaśaḥ prāha rājarṣe kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ || 14||
nārāyaṇasya sarvasyāvatārāderyadā yadā |
sṛṣṭau bhavati prākaṭye tadā garbhānusārataḥ || 15||
vāyuṃ garbhasthitaṃ tvājñāpayatyeva hariḥ sadā |
garbhakukṣo tvayā stheyaṃ jalena saha tāvatā || 16||
yathā garbhavatī mātā bahirdṛśyeta vai tathā |
kukṣiṃ procchrayatāṃ prāptāṃ kuru kālena yāvatā ||17||
yatra yatra yādṛśaśca samayaḥ samapekṣyate |
tāvattatra darśayitvā garbhasyāpyabhivardhanam || 18||
prasavasya samaye ca vāyorjalasya kukṣitaḥ |
bahirniḥsāraṇaṃ tatra darśanīyaṃ ca laukikam || 1 9||
mayā tatra tadā tatrasthitairanabhilakṣitam |
bālarūpaṃ yathā garbhajanyaṃ dṛśyeta vai tathā ||1.524.20||
bhāsamātraṃ karaṇīyaṃ garbhajalābhiyojitam |
māyayā channanetrāṇāmatra nāsti gatirmayi ||21 ||
divyadṛśaḥ prapaśyanti divyāṃ sūkṣmāṃ mama kṛtim |
sthūladṛśaḥ prapaśyanti garbhājjāto hi bālakaḥ||22||
evameva hi muktāśca bhavantyayonisaṃbhavāḥ |
mātāpitrorna tajjñānaṃ yato ratipriyau hi tau || 23|||
kāmadevasya rītyaiva tayorbhānaṃ mamodbhave |
akāmayostu divyaṃ vai tatkṣaṇānmama darśanam || 24||
tato vāyo na me garbhāgamo na dhātusaṃśrayaḥ |
na ca garbhagṛhe vāso yonerniṣkāsanaṃ na hi || 25||
bālyabhāvo na me tvasti na janmamaraṇe hyubhe |
na hi deho bhautiko me kintu darśaya tattathā || 26|||
evamājñāpayati śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ |
rājam̐stadanusāreṇa vāyudarśayati kṛtim ||27||
bhojanādi tathā tasya nityatṛptasya vai hareḥ |
laukikaṃ naiva bhavati bhaktāḥ kurvanti bhāvataḥ ||28||
yadyadātmana evāsti priyaṃ bhogyaṃ manoharam |
tasmai samarpya bhoktavyaṃ dharmaścāyaṃ sanātanaḥ ||29 ||
evaṃ bhaktakṛtā sevā nityatṛptasya tṛptidā |
lakṣmyai purā pradattaṃ ca varadānaṃ tu śārṅgiṇā 1.524.30||
niveditaṃ na vai nyūnaṃ kathaṃ bhavati tatra vai |
hariḥ prāha mayā bhuktaṃ vardheta na kṣayaṃ vrajet ||31 ||
yathā yathāhaṃ bhuñje tat vardhate ca tathā tathā |
jaḍaṃ cetanatāṃ yāti divyabhāvaṃ prapadyate ||32||
prasannatāṃ samāsādya yāti praphullatā tadā |
navaṃ navaṃ bhavatyeva rasānvitaṃ śubhapradam || 33||
divyadṛśaḥ prapaśyanti paśyanti na bahirdṛśaḥ |
ityetat kathitaṃ rājan naivedyasya pravardhanam ||34||
evaṃ kṛṣṇe pradattānāṃ hrāso nāsti kvacinnṛpa |
pratyuta vardhate sarvaṃ kimanyacchrotumicchasi ||35||
indradyumnastato’pṛcchallomaśaṃ sadguruṃ harim |
kasmāt tvaṃ groṣmakāle’pi madhyaṃ prāpte divākare || 36||
nivāsārthaṃ gṛhaṃ ramyaṃ kimarthaṃ na karoṣi vai |
lomaśastaṃ nṛpaṃ prāha svalpāyuścāsmi sarvathā ||37||
kasyārthaṃ kārya āvāsastvanityaṃ jīvitaṃ yataḥ |
yadi syācchāśvataṃ dīrghaṃ jīvitaṃ gṛhamābhajet ||38||
rājā prāha ca sarveṣāṃ cirāyuḥ śrūyate bhavān |
tenāhamapi saṃprāpto bhavaddarśanakāmyayā ||39||
lomaśastu tadā prāha śṛṇu rājan vadāmi tat |
kalpe kalpe prasaṃprāpte romaikyaṃ mama naśyati ||1.524.40||
abhāve vakṣaso romṇāṃ mama nāśo bhaviṣyati |
trilakṣaṃ ca pañcaṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi gatāni me ||41 ||
kalpāni tatra vai naṣṭā vedhaso dṛśa me puraḥ |
nābheruparicākaṇṭhaṃ romāṇi santi me nṛpa ||42||
ṣaṭtriṃśallakṣapañcāśatsahasrāṇi ca tāni vai |
trilakṣaṃ ca pañcaṣaṣṭisahasrāṇyadhikāni ca ||43||
tāvatkalpānuṣitvaiva brahmāṇḍeṣu tataḥ param |
yāsyāmi paramaṃ lokaṃ kiṃ karomi gṛheṇa vai ||44||
paśya tvaṃ maccharīre’tra jānoradho’ṅgulāyatam |
yāvatkalpaṃ pratispardhi saṃjātaṃ romavarjitam ||45||
jīvitavyaṃ dhruvaṃ nāsti jñāyate romanāśanāt |
na karomi gṛhaṃ tena kāraṇena mahīpate ||46||
rājā prāha ṛṣe pūrvaṃ kiṃ karma vihitaṃ tvayā |
tapo dānaṃ kṛtaṃ kīdṛg yenedṛgjīvitaṃ ciram ||47||
lomaśastu tadā prāha śṛṇu rājan ciraṃ mama |
ahamāsaṃ purā sṛṣṭau śūdro dāridryapīḍitaḥ ||48||
dāsyaṃ kurvan tadāsaṃ saṃgato’haṃ badarīvanam |
kṣutkṣāmaḥ supipāsārto dṛṣṭvā nārāyaṇaṃ naram ||49||
jalaṃ kamalapuṣpāṇi samarpyārcanamācaram |
atha pūjāṃ vinirvartya girermārgaṃ samāśritaḥ ||1.524.50||
himena kṣudhayā mṛtyuṃ gato vipragṛhe tataḥ |
jātismaro’bhavaṃ tena maunaṃ rakṣāmi sarvathā ||51 ||
īśāna iti me nāma pitā cakre praharṣitaḥ |
anyaiḥ sampreryamāṇo’pi naiva jalpāmi kiñcana ||52||
vairāgyaṃ paramaṃ prāpto dṛṣṭvā saṃsārasaṃsthitim |
pitā me’yojayad vācaḥ prakāśārthaṃ tu bheṣajam ||53 ||
tena me jāyate hāsyaṃ kṛtamantrajanānprati |
aśvapaṭṭasaraḥkṣetre nivasan bhaktibhāvataḥ |||54||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ pūjayāmi samāhitaḥ |
śiloñcchavṛttimāsādya prāṇavṛttiṃ samācaran ||55||
nāraṃgairbadaraiḥ śākaiścirbhaṭaiḥ phalapatrakaiḥ |
tato me śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pratyakṣatāṃ gataḥ ||56|||
uvāca parituṣṭo’smi varaṃ varaya suvrata |
tato’rthitaṃ mayā kuru jarāmaraṇavarjitam ||57||
kṛṣṇaḥ prāha na vai martye’maratvaṃ kasyacidbhavet |
maryādāṃ kuru tasmātte jīvitasya dadāmi tat ||58||
tataścokto hariḥ kalpe kalpe raumaikapātanam |
bhavenme nābhitaḥ kaṇṭhāvadhiṃ romṇāṃ prapātanam ||59||
tāvadāyurmamaivāstu vedho’bdānāṃ daśādhikam |
śataṃ yatra vilīyeta tato yāsyāmi dhāma te || 1.524.60 ||
tathāstviti hariḥ prāha yayau cādarśanaṃ tataḥ |
tata ārabhya caivātra kuṃkumavāpikāntike ||61 ||
aśvapaṭṭasaraḥkṣetre nivasāmi tathāvadhim |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasevāphalaṃ me cirajīvanam ||62||
pṛthvīnāṃ pralayā dṛṣṭā jīvane’tra sahasraśaḥ |
pralaye yāmi vaikuṇṭhaṃ jalasyopari saṃsthitam ||63||
tejaāvaraṇaprānte punaḥsṛṣṭau bhuvaṃ prati |
āgacchāmi nivasāmi kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāśrame ||64||
patnīvratastathā vipraḥ pativratā ca tatpriyā |
bhavatastau cirajīvau pratikeśājapātanau ||65||
tathā śrīkambharālakṣmīgopālakṛṣṇabhūsurau |
bhavatastau cirajīvau pratikeśājapātanau ||66||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastasya bālo’kṣarapatiḥ svayam |
pratisṛṣṭi pratikalpaṃ jāyate ca tayorgṛhe ||67||
tameva śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ bhajāmi sarvadā |
teṣāmāyurvilokyaiva mama garvo na vartate ||68||
bhajāmi śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ tvaṃ bhaja taṃ harim |
lokasya haribhaktasya vāñcchitaṃ nāsti durlabham ||69||
ityevaṃ mama vṛttāntaḥ kathitaścendradyumnaka |
tvaṃ jātaḥ kīrtimān loke gacchākṣarapadaṃ hareḥ ||1.524.70||
indradyumnastataḥ prāha sarveṣāṃ śāpamokṣaṇam |
kacchapolūkagṛdhrarṣibakamārkaṇḍamokṣaṇam ||71 ||
kadā bhāvi vada vidvan sarvajñastvaṃ hariryathā |
lomaśastu tadā prāha yadā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ||72||
bhajiṣyanti ca te sarve mantragrahaṇapūrvakam |
tadā mokṣo’tra vai kṣetre bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ||73||
indradyumnastu tān sarvān sasmāropakṛto muhuḥ |
jātismarāśca te kāmarūpadharāḥ samāyayuḥ ||74||
natāste lomaśaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ samārcayan |
pupūjuḥ kambharālakṣmīṃ gopālakṛṣṇamārcayan ||75||
cakāra svāgataṃ tvaśvapaṭṭasarastaṭe ṛṣiḥ |
lomaśaḥ pradadau mantraṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai ||76||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ |
jepuste saṃsthitāstatra lomaśasyāśrame’naghe ||77||
aśvapaṭṭasarasyete snātvā kuṃkumavāpikām |
gatvā cakrurjalapānaṃ jepurmantraṃ divāniśam ||78||
teṣāṃ lomaśakṛpayā vāsanā vilayaṃ gatā |
muktāste śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇānugrahato’bhavan ||79||
kacchaparṣiḥ kacchadeśe nārāyaṇasarovare |
ghūkarṣiḥ śrīhāṭakeśakṣetre nāganadītaṭe ||1.524.80 ||
gṛdhrarṣiḥ śrīraivatādrau dattātreyatapaḥsthale |
bakarṣiḥ śrīsomanāthakṣetre samudrasannidhau ||8 1 ||
mārkaṇḍeyastalaśyāmasthale’raṇye vasanti ca |
divyāste cirajīvāśca kāmarūpadharāḥ sadā ||82||
vartiṣyante pratikalpaṃ lokakalyāṇahetave |
raivate kārtike sarve tvāyānti prativatsaram ||83||
pradakṣiṇārthaṃ devānāṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya ca |
lomaśo’haṃ pragacchāmi divasān pañca tatra vai ||84||
śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaityudāraṃ
gṛṇanta evādrimanukramante |
teṣāṃ pṛthivyākramaṇasya puṇyaṃ
jāyeta saṃvacmi tu lomaśo’ham ||85||
athendradyumnanṛpaterbhajanena hariḥ svayam |
tutoṣa parayā bhaktyā lomaśānugraheṇa ca ||86||
dadau divyāṃ parāṃ dṛṣṭiṃ nirāvaraṇikāṃ hṛdi |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ vilokayāmāsa hṛdi prabhum ||87||
lomaśe dakṣiṇāṃ nyasya kṛtvātmānaṃ parātmani |
brahmarandhreṇa tu pathā niryātuṃ yāvadicchati ||88||
tāvaddivyākṣarānmuktairjuṣṭaṃ vimānamāgatam |
koṭikoṭyarkasaṃkāśaṃ samāruroha tat nṛpaḥ ||89||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ natvā yayau brahmākṣaraṃ padam |
lomaśo vidhivaccakre jaladānādi tatkṛte ||1.524.90||
evaṃ te kathitaṃ lakṣmi lomaśātanatodbhavam |
lomaśetiṛṣernāmākhyānaṃ ciraprajīvinaḥ ||91||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne bhagavaddhāmni samayajñānaparicayaḥ, janmagrahaṇe divyatā, naivedye’bhipūrakatā, lomaśasya prāgvṛttāntaḥ, mārkaṇḍeyādiciraṃjīvānāṃ tataḥ saurāṣṭrādauciravāsaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā caturviṃśatyadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 524 ||

<1.525>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
ekadā cāgamannāmnā khyātastvaśvaśirānṛpaḥ |
lomaśasyāśrame kṣetre cāśvapaṭṭasarovare || 1 ||
kapilastu mahātejā darśanārthaṃ samāyayau |
aśvaśirāḥ kapilaṃ tamṛṣiṃ papraccha saṃśayam || 2 ||
mokṣaḥ syāt karmaṇā kiṃ vā jñānena nirṇayaṃ vada |
śṛṇu lakṣmi kapilarṣiryamāha nirṇayaṃ śubham || 3 ||
pravadāmi gṛhasthānāṃ karmiṇāṃ hitakāmyayā |
yatkiṃcit karma vai dehī karoti sādhvasādhu vā || 4 ||
sarvaṃ nārāyaṇe nyasya kurvannapi na lipyate |
śṛṇu saṃyamano vipra ātreyavaṃśajo’bhavat || 5 ||
tapasyabhirataḥ prātaḥ snātuṃ bhāgīrathīṃ nadīm |
dharmāraṇye gatastatra hariṇānāṃ gaṇaṃ sthitam || 6 ||
lubdho niṣṭhurako nāma vyādho dhanuḥsamanvitaḥ |
jighāṃsurāyayau tīre sajyaṃ kṛtvā sasāyakam || 7 ||
dhanurdṛṣṭvā tu vipraḥ sa vyādhaṃ taṃ mṛgayāratam |
vārayāmāsa mā bhadra jīvaghātamimaṃ kuru || 8 ||
śrutvā prahasya vyādhastaṃ provāca munisattamam |
nāhaṃ hiṃsāmi vai jīvān nāhaṃ karomi sarvathā || 9 ||
paramātmā tvayaṃ bhūtaiḥ krīḍati svīyamāyayā |
māyā tasya janiḥ puṣṭirnidhanaṃ ceti vai kramāt || 1.525.1 0||
bhavantyeva hi jīvānāṃ tatra naimittikā vayam |
ahaṃbhāvaḥ sadā brahmanna vidheyo mumukṣubhiḥ || 11 ||
prāṇayātrāmātrarataṃ karoti cenna lipyate |
ahaṃkārastatra yasya sa sādhutvaṃ na gacchati || 12||
ahaṃkāraṃ parityajya gṛhṇāmyekaṃ mṛgaṃ dvija |
ityākarṇya sa viprendro niṣiṣedha ca lubdhakam || 13||
hiṃsanaṃ sarvathā pāpaṃ mā kurvevaṃ kadācana |
santi phalāni mūlāni patrāṇi ca jalāni ca || 14 ||
sasyāni śākapatrāṇi nirvāhaṃ taiḥ samācara |
ahiṃsane suyātrā cennirvahet hiṃsi mā vṛthā || 15||
ahaṃkāro na kartavya iti te vāci vartate |
nātmani kintu vai svārthe bhavān mṛgādano yataḥ | 16||
upadeśaṃ prakurvanti sarve’bhimānavarjane |
na tyajanti cābhimānaṃ vāṅmanasoḥ pṛthakpṛthak || 17||
vadanti cānyat prakurvanti cānyat
pramūṣya cānyān viharanti cānyat |
svārthapravīṇāśca nijārthamāpya
dūrī bhavantyeva parān vināśya || 18 ||
vyādhaḥ prāha ṛṣe nāhaṃ kapaṭī svārthasādhakaḥ |
parīkṣāṃ me kuru tvatra pratyakṣaṃ te bhavennanu ||19||
kuru loṣṭhamayaṃ jālaṃ tasyādho vahnimāvaha |
atīva tatra śuṣko jvālayatāṃ kāṣṭhasañcayaḥ || 1.525.20 ||
tathākṛte tu vipreṇa pradhmātaścānalo hyati |
gavākṣairnirgatā jvālāḥ sahasrāṇi ca jālake ||21 ||
lohajālaṃ tadā raktaṃ yadā vahnirivābabhau |
tadā vyādho yogasiddhiṃ samālambya nijāṃ tanum ||22||
vahnirūpāṃ tu kṛtavān sūryavaddāhasaṃcayām |
vahniryasya purastatra nistejasko babhūva ha ||23||
niṣasāda samutthāya jāle tatra sa lubdhakaḥ |
vahnirvai vahninā naiva dahyate ca yathā tathā ||24||
lubdhako naiva dagdho hi kāṣṭhajanyena vahninā |
saṃyamano brāhmaṇaśca tathānye vismayaṃ gatāḥ ||25||
prāhuḥ kastvaṃ vada cāsmān saḥ prāhāhaṃ hutāśanaḥ |
svayaṃ cāsmi na me hiṃsā pacyante mayi dehinaḥ ||26||
ahaṃ buddhiṃ vihāyaiva karomi svasvabhāvavat |
ahaṃkāro mama naṣṭastapasā jñānayojinā ||27||
ahaṃkāre vinaṣṭe ca karmabhirnahi lipyate |
ahaṃkāro mūlamasti stambo mamatvamucyate ||28||
śākhā rāgastathā dveṣo graghro lobhaśca mohanam |
patrāṇi tatra karmāṇi rasaścāsvādanaṃ sadā ||29||
puṣpaṃ pravartanākhyaṃ ca phalaṃ miṣṭaṃ sukhaṃ tathā |
amiṣṭaṃ tu bhaved duḥkhaṃ bhuñjate dehinaḥ sadā ||1.525.3 0||
vahnermūle kṣipa vāri jvālā niryānti yatsthalāt |
ityukto brāhmaṇastatra toyapūrṇaṃ ghaṭaṃ drutam ||3 1 ||
cikṣepa sahasā vahniḥ praśaśāma yadā tale |
jvālāḥ sarvā vinaṣṭāśca mūlanāśāt samantataḥ ||32||
lubdhakastvāha taṃ vipraṃ pratyakṣaṃ vai nidarśanam |
mūlanāśe samastasya vṛkṣasya nāśanaṃ bhavet ||33||
abhimānaṃ pramūlaṃ cennaṣṭaṃ karmakṛtāṃ yadi |
pāpenāpi ca puṇyena lipyate na kadācana ||34||
etasmin jvalito vahnirbahuśākhaśca sattama |
mūlanāśe’bhavannaṣṭastathāhaṃ karmavān sadā ||35||
ātmā dehaṃ samāśritya piṇḍadharmaṃ samāśritaḥ |
kṣudhayā tṛṣayā vyāptaḥ khādan piban pravṛttimān ||36||
kurvan sarvaṃ varjayitvābhimānaṃ lepakāraṇam |
antarātmani saṃyuktaḥ kurvāṇo nāvasīdati ||37||
athāha lubdhako vipraṃ spṛśa loṣṭhaṃ dvijottama |
loṣṭhaṃ coṣṇaṃ dāhakāri jñātaṃ tyaktaṃ dvijena tu ||38||
tataḥ pasparśa sa vyādhastasya dāho na cābhavat |
lubdhakastaṃ tadā prāha saṃskārāścābhimānajāḥ ||39||
yathā loṣṭhe vahnijanyāḥ saṃskārā dāhakā iva |
yāvadbhavanti puruṣāstāvad dahyanti sarvathā ||1.525.40 ||
tathābhimānasaṃskārā yāvadbhavanti dehiṣu |
tāvat puṇyena pāpena lipyante nātra saṃśayaḥ ||41||
abhimānaṃ ca saṃskārāstyājyāstapasyayā tathā |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktyā yogena dhyānavṛttibhiḥ ||42||
sarvasamarpaṇabhaktyā lipyate nahi karmabhiḥ |
evamukte tu vai vipre vyādhasyopari cāmbarāt ||43||
papāta puṣpavṛṣṭiśca viprasyopari vai manāk |
tato vyādho hariṇaṃ taṃ jaghānaikaṃ tadāpi ca ||44||
vipraḥ prāha mṛgātmā ca kutra yāti pradarśaya |
vyādhaḥ saṃkalpayāmāsa vimānaṃ svargalokajam ||45||
tāvad divyavimānāni kāmagāni mahānti ca |
bahuratnāni mukhyāni dadarśa brāhmaṇottamaḥ |||46|||
teṣu niṣṭhurakaṃ lubdhaṃ sarveṣu samavasthitam |
dadarśa brāhmaṇastatra kāmarūpiṇamuttamam ||47||
advaitabhāvanāsiddhaṃ yogādbahuśarīrakam |
mṛgaṃ divyasvarūpaṃ ca devātmakaṃ vilokya ca ||48||
dṛṣṭvā vipro mudā yuktaḥ saṃyamano babhūva ha |
anye cāpyabhavam̐statra dehāhaṃkāravarjitāḥ ||49||
evaṃ jñātaṃ bhavet karma kurvato’pi svajātikam |
nirbandhaṃ tat pāpapuṇyavilepena vivarjitam ||1.525.50||
tādṛśaṃ naiva cātmānaṃ karoti bandhanaṃ kvacit |
yathā nārāyaṇo devo nirlepo vastumātrakam ||51 ||
kurvan gṛhṇan kārayam̐śca grāhayan lepavarjitaḥ |
pratyuta svapadaṃ prāptaṃ nirguṇaṃ prakaroti tat ||52||
tathātmā māyayā hīno na karoti na lipyate |
prāptaṃ bhuktaṃ jaḍaṃ vastu karoti divyameva tat ||53||
nirliptaṃ bandhanahīnaṃ muktisthaṃ tat karoti vai |
jñātvā saṃyamano vipraḥ prayayau nijamāśramam ||54||
kapilaścāśvaśirasaṃ nṛpaṃ prāha tathā punaḥ |
tasmāt tvamapi rājendra devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ||55||
ātmanyeva svadehe tu paśya tvārādhayanprabhum |
nirlipto bhavitā śīghraṃ yathā vyādho’bhavatpurā ||56||
kapilasya vacaḥ śrutvā sa rājāśvaśirāḥ śubhaḥ |
mene ca karmiṇāṃ muktiṃ kṛṣṇārpitena karmaṇā ||57||
atha tatrāgamat tāvajjaigīṣavyo mahāmuniḥ |
pañcāśatkalpakāyuśca lomaśasyāśrame śubhe ||58||
ṛṣayaste tadā cakruḥ svāgataṃ ca parasparam |
cakruḥ svargādilokānāṃ saṃbhāṣāṃ kṣemakāriṇīm |||59||
aśvaśirā praṇamyaiva kapilaṃ saṃsthiteṣu ca |
sarveṣu ṛṣiṣu madhye saṃpapraccha praṇamya tam ||1.525.6 0 ||
kathamārādhaye devaṃ hariṃ nārāyaṇaṃ param |
kapilaḥ prāha vai rājan nārāyaṇā hyanantakāḥ ||61 ||
bhavanti śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇopāsanayātra vai |
ka eṣaḥ procyate rājaṃstvayā nārāyaṇo guruḥ ||62||
āvāṃ nārāyaṇau dvau tu tvatpratyakṣagatau nṛpa |
aśvaśirāstadākarṇya samuvāca dvijau ca tau ||63||
jaigīṣavyaḥ kapilaśca śrutau mayā purā śubhau |
bhavantau brāhmaṇau siddhau tapasā dagdhakilbiṣau ||64||
kathaṃ nārāyaṇāvāvāmiti me vadatho vacaḥ |
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadhanuḥsvastikaketubhiḥ ||65||
yuktaḥ pītāmbaro lakṣmīpatirgaruḍavāhanaḥ |
nārāyaṇaḥ parabrahma kastasya sadṛśo bhuvi ||66||
itirājño vacaḥ śrutvā tau viprau siddhayoginau |
jahasatuḥ paśya nārāyaṇaṃ ceti jajalpatuḥ ||67||
evamuktvā sa kapilaḥ svayaṃ viṣṇurbabhūva ha |
jaigīṣavyaśca garuḍastatkṣaṇaṃ samajāyata ||68||
rājā tvāścaryamāpanno dṛṣṭvā sagaruḍaṃ harim |
natvāha śāmyatāṃ viprau nemaṃ pṛcchāmi nrāyaṇam ||69||
kintu brahmā yato jāto nābhipaṃkajamadhyagaḥ |
tamenaṃ brahmapitaraṃ nrāyaṇaṃ saṃvadāmyaham ||1.525.70||
śrutvā ca kapilastatra padmanābho babhūva ha |
jaigīṣavyo’bhavad brahmā nābhipadmopari sthitaḥ ||71 ||
brahmaṇastu lalāṭādvai rudro’bhūd raktanetrakaḥ |
rājā tavā vicāryaiva punaḥ prāha ca tau dvijau ||72||
nekṣyo bhavati sarvātmā sarvavyāpī narāyaṇaḥ |
bhavadbhyāṃ darśitā māyā yogibhyāṃ yogasiddhijā ||73||
nārāyaṇastu bhagavān nekṣyaḥ sarvātmakaḥ prabhuḥ |
tatastatra kapilena jaigīṣavyena vai tadā ||74||
sarvātmakāni rūpāṇi darśitāni nijātmanoḥ |
matkuṇā maśakā yūkā bhramarā bhoginaḥ khagāḥ ||75||
aśvā gāvo dvipāḥ siṃhā vyāghrā gomāyavo mṛgāḥ |
anye’pi paśavaḥ kīṭā grāmyā āraṇyakāstathā ||76||
paśavo mānavā vṛkṣā vallikādyāśca sarvaśaḥ |
taddṛṣṭvā bhūtasaṃghātaṃ sa rājā vismayaṃ gataḥ ||77||
viveda jaigīṣavyasya māhātmyaṃ kapilasya ca |
papraccha tāvṛṣī bhaktyā kimidaṃ dvijasattamau ||78||
tau dvijābūcaturbhūpa tvayā pṛṣṭhaṃ ca kiṃ smara |
kathamārādhaye devaṃ hariṃ nārāyaṇaṃ param ||79||
ārādhanāya pratyakṣo harirvai te pradarśitaḥ |
kapilo’haṃ ca pratyakṣo bhavāmyatra narāyaṇaḥ ||1.525.80 ||
bhaja māṃ yadi te śraddhā pratyakṣaṃ prāptameva ha |
sarvajñasya guṇāḥ sarve mayi santi tadaṃśataḥ ||81 ||
tasmāllabdhā mayā sarve bhaktyā tava pradarśitaḥ |
sa tu nārāyaṇo devaḥ sarvajñaḥ kāmarūpavān ||82||
padmanābhādapi dūraṃ mahāviṣṇoḥ pare’sti ca |
golokāccāpi vaikuṇṭhātpare cākṣaradhāmani ||83||
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo mukteṣu rājate |
saumyaḥ kvāpi svecchayātra prāpyate mānavaiḥ kila ||84||
lomaśo’yaṃ prāptavām̐staṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaṃ param |
atrāśvapaṭṭasarasaḥ kṣetre śrīkṛṣṇavallabham ||85||
sarveṣāmavatārāṇāmavatāriṇamacyutam |
āvāṃ tasya darśanārthamāgatau svaḥ śubhāśrame ||86||
sa vai sarvaśarīrasthaḥ paramātmā jagatpatiḥ |
svadehe vartate cāpi dṛśyate nijabhaktitaḥ ||87||
ato’rthaṃ darśitaṃ rūpaṃ śrīkṛṣṇannārāyaṇasya ca |
āvayostava rājendra pratītiḥ syādyathā tava ||88||
evaṃ sarvagato devastava dehe’pi vartate |
sarvaprajāsu bhṛtyeṣu mantriṣvapi sthitaḥ sa hi ||89||
paśavaḥ kīṭasaṃghādyāḥ sarve viṣṇumayā nṛpa |
bhāvanāṃ tu dṛḍhāṃ kuryād yadvai sarvamayo hariḥ ||1.525.90 ||
nānyat tatsadṛśaṃ bhūtaṃ sarvabhūteṣvavasthitaḥ |
tamāntarasthaṃ vai devamitibhāvena sevatām ||91 ||
eṣa te darśitaścārādhanāmārgo’timokṣadaḥ |
paripūrṇena bhāvenārcaya kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ||92||
pūjopahārairdhūpādyairnaivedyārārtrikādibhiḥ |
dhyānena dāsabhaktyā ca suprāpyaḥ sa pareśvaraḥ ||93||
yo’sau nārāyaṇo devaḥ paramātmā sanātanaḥ |
tattadrūpeṇa bahudhā vartate kāryakṛt prabhuḥ ||94||
matsyaḥ kūrmo varāhaśca narasiṃhaśca vāmanaḥ |
rāmo rāmaśca kṛṣṇaśca buddhaḥ kalkī tathāpare ||95||
ityetāḥ kathitāstasya mūrtayaḥ kapilādayaḥ |
sādhavaścāpi siddhāśca sādhvyaḥ satyaśca yoginaḥ ||96||
darśanaṃ prāptumicchūnāṃ sopānāni bhavanti vai |
yattasya parama rūpaṃ tanna paśyanti devatāḥ ||97||
asmadādisvarūpeṇa pūrayatyeva bhāvanām |
tasmād vyāptamidaṃ sarvaṃ jagannārāyaṇena hi ||98||
bhaja taṃ ca priye yathābhimate sthitamacyutam |
bṛhaspatiḥ purā raibhyaṃ brahmaputraṃ jagāda ha ||99||
vasusaṃjñaṃ tu rājānaṃ cākṣuṣe tvāntare manoḥ |
raibhya śṛṇu vaso rājan samākarṇaya cādarāt || 1.525.10 0||
yatkiñcit kurute karma puruṣaḥ sādhvasādhu vā |
sarvaṃ nārāyaṇe nyasya kurvannapi na lipyate || 101 ||
sa ca nārāyaṇaḥ śrīmān sarvaprāṇiṣvavasthitaḥ |
bhaja taṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ cāntaragaṃ prabhum || 1 02||
tatastau śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ saṃbhejatuḥ sadā |
muktiṃ yātau pare dhāmni dāsyātmikāṃ ca śāśvatīm ||1 03||
ityetat kathitaṃ sarvaṃ kapilasya vaco’rthadam |
rājā cāśvaśirāḥ putraṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ sthūlaśirāhvayam || 1 04||
abhiṣicya nije rājye natvā gurūn punaḥ punaḥ |
naimiṣākhyaṃ vanaṃ dūraṃ yayau tatra hariṃ prabhum || 105||
tapasārādhayāmāsa pratyakṣo’bhūddhariḥ svayam |
vimānena nijaṃ bhaktaṃ nināyākṣaradhāma saḥ ||1 06||
ityetat kathitaṃ sarvamaśvaśiraḥpramokṣaṇam |
karmaṇā cārpiteneśeśvare jñānānvitena vai || 107 ||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne kapilena aśvaśirase rājñe jñānadāne saṃyamanadvijaniṣṭhurakavyādhanidarśanena karmaṇā sarvasamarpaṇātmakena mokṣaḥ pradarśitaḥ, kapilasya jaigīṣavyasya cānekavibhūtirūpatvaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcaviṃśatyadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||525||

<1.526>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi vasoḥ pūrvavṛttāntaṃ cābhavadyathā |
kathayāmi camatkāraṃ raibhyasyāpi tataḥ param || 1 ||
vasurāsīnmahābhaktaḥ kāśmīranṛpatiḥ svayam |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya śaraṇāgataḥ || 2 ||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya svāmine namaḥ |
itimantraṃ prajagrāha vārdhakye tu narāyaṇāt || 3 ||
bādarīṃ sa samāyāti pratisaṃvatsaraṃ nṛpaḥ |
nārāyaṇasya sevārthaṃ darśanārthaṃ ca bhāvataḥ || 4 ||
kaṇṭhe ca tulasīmālāṃ sadā rakṣati śobhanām |
kare’pi japanārthaṃ sarvadā rakṣati mālikām || 5 ||
jānan kṣaṇasthitiṃ svasya saṃsārasyāpi tādṛśīm |
saṃsāre nirmitāḥ sarve saṃghātāḥ śokabhīpradāḥ || 6 ||
vāyuśca bhūmirākāśo jalaṃ tejaśca paṃkajam |
śarīraṃ pañcabhūtaiśca nirmitaṃ sarvadehinām || 7 ||
mithyābhramaḥ kṛtrimaśca svapnavanmāyayānvitaḥ |
ko vā kasya sutastatra kā strī kasya patistathā || 8 ||
karmabhirnirmitaṃ sarvaṃ karmabandhanajaṃ tvidam |
sukha duḥkhaṃ bhayaṃ śokaṃ dehayoge pragacchati || 9 ||
mānuṣe ca paśau deve druṣu kīṭeṣu jantuṣu |
pakṣiṣvapi tṛṇe cāpi janma yāti svakarmabhiḥ || 1.526.1 0||
punaḥ punarbhramatyeva yāvatkarmalayo na vai |
satyaṃ tretā dvāparaśca kaliśceti caturyugam || 11 ||
nimeṣasya caturbhāgastruṭiḥ syāt taddvayaṃ lavaḥ |
lavadvayaṃ yavaḥ proktaḥ kāṣṭhā taddaśapaṃcabhiḥ || 12||
triṃśatkāṣṭhāḥ kalāḥ proktā kṣaṇastriṃśatkalo mataḥ |
kṣaṇaiḥ ṣaṣṭyā palaṃ proktaṃ ṣaṣṭyā teṣāṃ ca nāḍikā || 1 3||
nāḍīdvayaṃ muhūrtaṃ triṃśanmuhūrtaṃ divāniśam |
māsastriṃśadahorātrairdvau māsau tu ṛturmataḥ || 14||
ṛtutrayaṃ syādayanamayane dve tu vatsaram |
anenaiva tu mānena mānavānāṃ kṛte’tra vai || 15||
lakṣaiḥ saptadaśākhyaiśca saurābdaiśca tathā paraiḥ |
aṣṭāviṃśatisāhasrairniścitaṃ vai kṛtaṃ yugam || 16||
aṣṭaśatādhikyayuktacatuḥsāhasrasaṃkhyakāḥ |
ṣaṣṭyadhikatriśatakairguṇitāste kṛte matāḥ || 17||
tatra vai jāyate śuklavarṇo hi bhagavān svayam |
lokāḥ pāpavinirmuktāḥ kṣāntā dāntā jitendriyāḥ || 18||
dīrghāyuṣastapomagnaḥ kāmakrodhādivarjitāḥ |
na putrasaṃbhavo mṛtyurvīkṣyate janakaiḥ kvacit || 1 9||
tatastretāyugaṃ syācca lakṣairdvādaśabhistathā |
ṣaṇṇavatisāhasraiḥ saurābdairniścitaṃ suraiḥ ||1.526.20||
ṣaṭśatādhikyayuktatrisāhasrasaṃkhyakāḥ khalu |
ṣaṣṭyadhikatriśatakairguṇitāste trike yuge ||21 ||
pāpenaikena pādena raudraṃ dharmaṃ tadā viśet |
tato raktatvamabhyeti śrīmatkṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ||22||
pāpāṃśena mitho lokaḥ saṃsparddhī jāyate tadā |
svargārthaṃ dānayajñāśca kurvanti yāni vai divam ||23||
kecitsvalpāyuṣastatra jāyante spardhayāpi ca |
janake vidyamāne tu putrāṇāṃ maraṇaṃ na vai ||24||
kāmakrodhādayastatra bhavanti na bhavanti ca |
ekavāraṃ tadā kṛṣyā vāpitaṃ kṣetramuttamam ||25||
saptavārān pragṛhṇanti vaiśyāḥ kṛṣṇaparāyaṇāḥ |
sarvā ghaṭastavā gāvo mahiṣyaśca caturguṇāḥ ||26||
śāpānugrahakṛtyeṣu samarthā mānavāstadā |
na cauro jo rū śca sarve dharmaratā janāḥ ||27||
tatastṛtīyayugako dvāparo vidyate kramāt |
dvau pādau tatra pāpasya dvau ca dharmasya saṃsthitau ||28||
taccāṣṭalakṣamānena saurābdānāṃ prakīrtitam |
catuḥṣaṣṭibhiranyaiśca sahasraiśca yugaṃ tadā ||29||
catuḥśatādhikadvisāhasraprasaṃkhyakāḥ khalu |
ṣaṣṭyadhikatriśatakairguṇitāste dvike yuge ||1.526.3 0||
kāmaḥ krodho mado lobho dambho matsara eva ca |
ṣaḍete tatra jāyante īrṣyā cāpi tu saptamī ||3 1 ||
atha tairanvitāḥ sarve viruddhā vai parasparam |
ke’pi śāntāśca dāntāśca jitendriyā bhavanti hi ||32||
tataḥ kaliyugaṃ proktaṃ sarvadoṣāśrayaṃ tadā |
ekapādo vṛṣo yatra pāpaṃ pādaistribhiḥ sthitam ||33||
śvetaḥ satye raktavarṇaṃstretāyāṃ bhagavānapi |
nīlaśca dvāpare kṛṣṇo’livad vai jāyate kalau ||34||
pramāṇaṃ tu kalerdiṣṭaṃ lakṣāścatvāra eva ca |
dvātriṃśacca sahasrāṇi saurābdāni bhavanti hi ||35||
dviśatādhikaikasāhasrātmaprasaṃkhyakāḥ khalu |
ṣaṣṭyadhikatriśatakairguṇitāste kalau matāḥ ||36||
ekadvitrīṇi catvāri sahasrāṇi daśa kramāt |
kalidvītatrītasatyayugābdāni bhavanti hi ||37||
mānavāni dvicatuḥṣaḍaṣṭaśatānyanukramāt |
bhavantyabdāni sāhasre dve, militvā tu tānyatha ||38||
dvādaśābdasahasrāṇi mānavānāṃ caturyugam |
bodhyaṃ saurāṇi tricatvāriṃśallakṣāṇi cāpyatha ||39||
viṃśatisāhasrasaṃkhyādhikānyeva caturyugam |
yugakṣayakṛtaścāyuḥkṣayaḥ sṛṣṭau mato’pi hi ||1.526.40||
yasya cāsti gṛhe vittaṃ tathā nāryo manoramāḥ |
tairnaraistu samaṃ maitrīṃ kalau kurvanti mānavāḥ ||41 ||
svārthamātraparāḥ putrā bhūṣāsvārthaparāḥ priyāḥ |
snuṣā vetti ca vittena yadi śvaśrūḥ kṣayaṃ vrajet ||42||
mama syād gṛhamaiśvarye sarve vāñchanti tattathā |
alpodakāstadā meghā alpasasyā ca medinī ||43||
dhūrtā viḍambakāḥ santo guravaśca kalau yuge |
alpakṣīrāstadā gāvaḥ kṣīre sarpirna vidyate ||44||
sarvabhakṣāstadā viprā nṛpā niṣkaruṇāstadā |
cauryakāryaparāḥ sarve pṛthivī gatayauvanā ||||45||
atikrāntaśubhāḥ kālāḥ paryupasthitadāruṇāḥ |
varṣe catuṣṭaye kanyā garbhavatī bhaviṣyati ||46||
pañcadaśanyūnavarṣe mṛtyureva bhaviṣyati |
bhaviṣyanti kalau cānte janā vitastimātrakāḥ ||47||
daśavarṣāyuṣaścānte gṛhaṃ bilaṃ bhuvo’ntare |
prāvaraṇaṃ tadā vai syād guptavastraṃ hi kevalam ||48||
ekavarṇā bhaviṣyanti varṇāḥ sarve mitho’nvitāḥ |
mlecchībhūtā durācārā dharmakarmavivarjitāḥ ||49||
caturyugānāṃ saptatiṃ tvekādhikāṃ manustathā |
mahendraśca prabhuṃkte vai dīrghamāyuḥ punaḥ punaḥ ||1.526.50||
manoḥ samaṃ mahendreṇa paramāyuḥ prakīrtitam |
caturdaśendravicchittau brahmaṇo dinamucyate ||51 ||
evaṃ parimitā rātrirdivārātraṃ hi kalpakaḥ |
brahmaṇastu varṣaśataṃ paramāyurvinirmitam ||52||
saurasāvanacandrarkṣairmānairebhiścaturvidhaiḥ |
kālo niryāti sarveṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ kṣitimaṇḍale ||53||
pañcaṣaṣṭyadhikaiścāpi dinānāṃ ca śataistribhiḥ |
bhavenmānavavarṣaṃ tat pañconaistaiśca sāvanam ||54||
cāndramekādaśonaṃ tu triṃśaddhīnaṃ tu ṛkṣajam |
śītātapau tathā vṛṣṭirmānavābdena jāyate ||55||
agniṣṭomādayo yajñā vivāhā utsavādayaḥ |
sāvanena bhavantyeva sarvavarṇeṣu vai kṣitau ||56||
kusīdādyā vyavahārā utpannāni ca yānyapi |
adhimāsaprayuktena cāndreṇaiva bhavanti hi ||57||
nakṣatreṇa tu mānena bhidyante cābhitārakāḥ |
evaṃ devā mānavāśca daityāstvanye sadā kṣitau ||58||
pravartante ca jāyante mriyante cedṛśaṃ jagat |
tatra māyābandhanenāvṛtaḥ pāraṃ na yāti vai ||59||
tasmānmayā sadā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pumuttamaḥ |
bhajanīyaḥ pūjanīyo dhyātavyaśca nirantaram ||1.526.6 0||
kālo bhakṣayati sarvān kṣaṇe varṣe yuge tathā |
māṃ śikhāyāṃ dattahastaḥ kālo grasitumicchati ||61 ||
ityevaṃ bodhayuktaḥ sa rājā bhaktiparāyaṇaḥ |
vasurdharmānumatyā ca svarājyaṃ pratyapālayat ||62||
ayajad bahubhiryajñairmahadbhirbhūridakṣiṇaiḥ |
karmārpaṇena deveśaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ harim ||63||
toṣayāmāsa bahubhirdāsyabhāvaiśca vartayan |
tataḥ kālena mahatā vasurvairāgyayogataḥ ||64||
nivṛttarājyabhogecchādvandvasyāntamupeyivān |
nijaputraṃ vivasvantaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ bhrātṛśatasya ca ||65||
abhiṣicya nije rājye puṣkaraṃ samupāyayau |
yatra śrīpuṇḍarīkākṣannārāyaṇaḥ saṃvirājate ||66||
vasuḥ kāśmīrabhūpaḥ sa tapobhirugrasādhitaiḥ |
bhaktyā smaran hariṃ tatra divyadehaṃ dadarśa tam ||67||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ sarvāntaryāmiṇaṃ prabhum |
tuṣṭāva taṃ namaste’stu puṇḍarīkākṣa te namaḥ ||68||
viśvamūrte sarvatejonivāsa kṛṣṇa te namaḥ |
śaraṇyaṃ rakṣakaṃ viṣṇuṃ jiṣṇuṃ vyomanivāsinam ||69||
gopālakṛṣṇabālaṃ tvāṃ namasye cakrapāṇinam |
nānyat kiñcitprapaśyāmi vyatiriktaṃ tvayācyuta||1.526.70||
evaṃ tu vadatastasya mūrtimān puruṣaḥ kila |
nirgatya dehānnīlābho ghanacaṇḍo bhayaṃkaraḥ ||71 ||
raktākṣo hrasvakāyaścovāca rājan karomi kim |
vasuḥ papraccha taṃ pāparūpaṃ ko’si vadātra me ||72||
pāparūpaḥ sa vai prāha tava pāpaṃ bhavāmyaham |
na cāsmi kevalaṃ pāpaṃ pāpapreto’smi te’nagha ||73 ||
śṛṇu pūrvaṃ kalau rājam̐stvaṃ rājā dakṣiṇāpathe |
janasthāne kadācittvaṃ mṛgayārthamupāgataḥ ||74||
tatra tvayā tu daṇḍena mṛgaveṣadharo muniḥ |
prasravaṇe girau santāḍito mṛtaḥ sa satvaram ||75||
hariṇaṃ taṃ hataṃ matvā yāvad grahītumicchasi |
tāvanmṛgavapurvipro vīkṣito hi narastvayā ||76 ||
tvaṃ cātibhayamāpanno hatyayā mānavasya vai |
hatyāhaṃ tu mahāghorā pretabrāhmaṇanāśajā ||77||
ahaṃ brahmagraho rājan śarīre nyavasaṃ tava |
adyāvadhiṃ pīḍayituṃ khādituṃ tava varṣma ca ||78||
rājyabhogā mayā dṛṣṭā bhuktā dehe ca te nṛpa |
raktaṃ pītaṃ khāditaṃ ca māṃsaṃ te nūtanaṃ sadā ||79||
tvaṃ ca rājyaprabhāveṇa kṛśo naiva vilokyase |
bahubhojanapānādismṛddhimattvānnṛpottama ||1.526.80||
atha tvayā tatpāpasya prāyaścittaṃ vicintitam |
śrīharerdvādaśī śuddhā tvayā rājannupoṣitā ||81 ||
vratānyanyāni ca nārāyaṇo me prīyatāmiti |
kṛtāni ca tathā dānaṃ gavāṃ dattaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ||82||
tatastvaṃ dakṣiṇāpathe svagṛhe kukṣiśūlataḥ |
rugṇo mṛtastava patnī nāmnā nārāyaṇī satī ||83||
dadau jalaṃ tavāsye ca śrīviṣṇoścaraṇāmṛtam |
kintu tvayā tadā patnī smṛtā dhyātā mṛtikṣaṇe ||84||
tena tvaṃ kalpamekaṃ ca jāto viṣṇupure punaḥ |
kumāro vāsanāyukto mokṣādvai vañcito yataḥ ||841||
ahaṃ tatra tvayā sārdhaṃ tava dehastha eva tu |
saṃsthitaḥ kalpaparyantaṃ sadbhogān bubhuje tvayi ||86||
tatra kalpe tvayā svargaṃ bahudhā bhuktameva ca |
svargasya ca tvayi rājan sthito’haṃ svena tejasā ||87||
punā rājasvarūpe ca sthito’haṃ bahuvatsarān |
tato’haḥkalpanivṛttau rātrikalpe gate’pi ca ||88||
idānīmādisṛṣṭau ca satye yuge narādhipa |
saṃbhūtastvaṃ mahārāja rājñaḥ sumanaso gṛhe ||89||
kāśmīradeśādhipaterahaṃ tvaṅgaruheṣu te |
nivāsāmyadyaparyantaṃ bhuñjāno nūtanaṃ navam ||1.526.90 ||
yajñairiṣṭa tveyānekairbahubhiścāptadakṣiṇaiḥ |
na cāhaṃ tairapahato viṣṇusmaraṇavarjitaiḥ ||91||
idānīṃ ca viśālāyāṃ tvayā bhaktiḥ kṛtā hareḥ |
stotraṃ prahvaṇabhāvena kṛtaṃ sarvātmanātra ca ||92||
bhaktestava prabhāveṇa puṇḍarīkākṣaśārṅgiṇaḥ |
sarvātmanārpaṇenāpi prasādito hariḥ svayam ||93||
kiṃkarān preṣayāmāsa viṣṇurnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ |
paśya tvetān mahāvyomni vimāneṣvabhyavasthitān ||94||
tadetairviṣṇupuruṣairmūśalaiḥ prahato’smyaham |
kṣayaṃ yātaścyutaścāsmi romakūpebhya eva te ||95||
tava bhaktiprabhāveṇa vihāyāṅgaruhāṇyaham |
ekībhūtaḥ punarjāto vyādharūpī tavāntike ||96||
ahaṃ bhagavataḥ stotraṃ śrutvā bhaktyā ca te nṛpa |
viṣṇupārṣadadaṇḍasya sparśenāpi mahāghataḥ ||97||
mukto’smi pretabhāvācca dharmabuddhiśca me’sti ca |
tato rājannijamitraṃ tvadāśritaṃ nirāśrayam ||98||
bhaktaṃ māṃ dehi sukhadaṃ varadānaṃ kṛpāṃ kuru |
evaṃ śrutvā vasurvyādhāyāpi dadau varaṃ śubham ||99||
śṛṇu vyādha tvayā smārito’smi janmāntaraṃ mama |
tatastvaṃ madvareṇāto dharmavyādho bhaviṣyasi || 1.526.1 00||
evamuktvā tu bhūpaḥ sa vimānavaramāsthitaḥ |
pareṇa śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇenākṣaradhāma vai ||1 0 1||
yayau pārṣadayuktaḥ sa pārṣado’bhūddharestataḥ |
athāyaṃ dharmakarmā ca dharmavyādho babhūva ha ||1 02||
ityetat kathitaṃ lakṣmi vasoścaritamuttamam |
yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyāccāsya tīrthasnānaphalaṃ bhavet ||1 03||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne kāśmīranṛpasya vasoḥ prāgjanma mṛgarūpa brahmahatyāyā bhaktibalena niḥsṛtāyā dharmavyādhajanmatā, vasostato muktiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍviśatyadhikapañcaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||526||

<1.527>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu raibhyasya caritaṃ lakṣmi dehapramokṣadam |
raibhyaḥ svayaṃ jagāmātha gayāṃ puṇyāṃ tapodhanaḥ || 1 ||
tatra pitṝn parabhaktyā piṇḍadānena tarpayan |
tatāpa sumahat tīvraṃ tapaḥ paramaduścaram || 2 ||
caratastasya tattīvraṃ tapo raibhyasya dhīmataḥ |
ājagāma mahāyogī vimānastho’tidīptimān || 3 ||
trasareṇusame śuddhe vimāne sūryasannibhe |
paramāṇupramāṇena puruṣastatra dīptimān || 4 ||
so’bravīd raibhya kiṃ kāryaṃ tapaścarasi suvrata |
evamuktvā divo bhūmerantarāsa ca vai pumān || 5 ||
tāvad vai rodasīvyāptaṃ vimānaṃ samajāyata |
yatrānantāśca ṛṣayo dṛṣṭā aindreṇa dhīmatā || 6 ||
viṣṇulokamabhivyāptaṃ vimānaṃ sa dadarśa ha |
tataḥ sa vismayāviṣṭo raibhyaḥ praṇayapūrvakam || 7 ||
papraccha taṃ mahāyogin ko bhavān prabravītu me |
puruṣaḥ pañcavarṣāyurbālo raibhyamuvāca ha || 8 ||
ahaṃ rudrādavarajo brahmaṇo mānasaḥ sutaḥ |
nāmnā sanatkumāro’smi janaloke vasāmyaham || 9 ||
bhavataḥ pitṛtṛptyādikarmabhistṛpta eva te |
dhanyavādapradānārthamāgato’smi tavāntikam || 1.527.1 0||
dhanyo’si sarvadā vatsa brahmaṇaḥ kulavardhanaḥ |
vedānāśritya ca pitṝn prīṇāsi sarvadānagha || 11 ||
mantravratajapyahomairgayāyāṃ piṇḍadānakaiḥ |
